title: Beyond the section plane: Robust 3D reconstruction of multiplex immunofluorescence exposes limitations of 2D spatial cell statistics
summary: Spatial analysis of the tumour microenvironment with multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) typically relies on single thin tissue sections, which misrepresent the 3D tissue organisation and bias spatial cell statistics in ways that remain largely unquantified. We reconstruct 24 breast and lung tumour tissue microarray cores in 3D, each from 15-20 serial mIF sections, and compare spatial cell statistics in 3D with those from individual sections. Our pipeline combines affine pre-alignment with dense deformable refinement using RoMa v2, achieving a median target registration error of 1.79 $\mu$m, well below nuclear size, which allows nuclei to be linked across sections. While cell-type proportions are preserved in 2D (Pearson corr. $r \geq 0.99$), 3D analysis reveals up to 3.8 times shorter nearest-neighbour distances, 13-19% higher neighbourhood entropy, and 2-4 times more contacts per cell. Tissue composition can thus be reliably estimated from individual sections, whereas cell-cell interactions require volumetric analysis.

AI.tldr: 重建乳腺/肺癌组织芯片的3D多重免疫荧光（mIF）数据，量化单切片2D空间统计的偏差：细胞类型比例在2D可靠，但细胞间邻近距离、邻域熵、接触数在3D显著不同。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤微环境（TME）的空间分析普遍基于单个薄切片，无法反映真实3D组织结构，会系统性偏离空间细胞统计，且这种偏差此前缺乏定量评估。
AI.method: 对24个乳腺与肺肿瘤组织芯片芯块，各用15–20张连续mIF切片重建3D；配准流程为仿射预对齐 + 基于RoMa v2的稠密可变形精配准，中位目标配准误差1.79 μm（低于细胞核尺度），从而实现跨切片核级配准与串联；随后比较3D与单切片的空间统计量。
AI.result: 配准误差中位1.79 μm；细胞类型比例在2D中保持良好（Pearson r ≥ 0.99）；3D分析显示最近邻距离最多缩短3.8倍、邻域熵高出13–19%、每细胞接触数多2–4倍。
AI.conclusion: 组织组成可由单切片可靠估计，但细胞–细胞相互作用分析必须依赖体数据（3D）重建，否则会产生显著偏差。

title: Attributing Agentic Failure in Reasoning Vision-Language Models with Interactive 2D Environments
summary: Agentic benchmarks report a success rate that confounds distinct causes of failure: misreading the environment, never working out how components of the environment operates, operating the components in the wrong order, and failing to recover from a mistake, each of which calls for a different fix. We present an early preview of MultiNet v2.0-Gridworld - an interactive maze environment built for attribution rather than ranking. Four different types of mechanisms, namely key-door pairs, switch-gate pairs, distractors and decoys, and ordered combinations of these mechanisms, can be added, modified, or removed independently while the renderer, the action space, and the scoring function stay fixed. A breadth-first search over the joint state of position, facing direction, inventory, and mechanism state gives every instance an exact optimal action count, which sets its difficulty and grades unfinished episodes. We fix the evaluation protocol on 15 held-out mazes over 540 episodes, then evaluate three vision-language models on 50 mazes. They solve 6 of 150 episodes, 45 of the 50 mazes were not solved by any model, and no episode containing a switch-gate mechanism was solved.

AI.tldr: MultiNet v2.0-Gridworld：一个用于“归因”而非排名的交互式迷宫基准，可独立增减四类机制（钥匙锁、开关闸门、干扰项与诱饵、有序组合），并用BFS给出精确最优步数作为难度与评分基准；三个VLM在540回合中仅解出6个、开关闸门机制零成功。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准汇报的单一成功率混淆了多种失败成因（环境误读、组件机理未掌握、操作顺序错误、无法纠错），每种成因需不同改进方案，故需要一个将各失效因素解耦、可独立操控的评测环境。
AI.method: 构建Gridworld交互式迷宫，保持渲染器、动作空间与评分函数固定，仅通过增删/修改钥匙-门、开关-闸门、干扰项与诱饵及其有序组合来改变机制结构；在位置、朝向、库存、机制状态联合空间上做广度优先搜索，得到每实例的精确最优动作数，用于设定难度并给未完成回合打分；固定协议为15个留出迷宫、540回合，另在50个迷宫上评测三个视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 三款VLM合计仅解出150回合中的6个；50个迷宫中有45个无任何模型解出；含开关-闸门机制的回合无一成功，显示当前模型在多步骤状态依赖与顺序规划上的系统性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出面向失败归因的可控诊断基准，用精确最优解提供客观难度与部分得分，初步揭示VLM智能体在机制理解与有序组合任务上的严重不足；当前为早期预览，规模与机制维度有限，尚需更多机制类型与更细的归因分析。

title: Quantum Machine Learning for Signature Forgery Detection
comment: Accepted and presented at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Information, Communication and Systems (SPICSCON) for Publication IEEE Xplore
summary: Offline handwritten signatures remain a primary behavioural biometric in legal and financial documents. Detecting skilled forgeries from a static raster image is hard because pen pressure, timing and stroke order are missing. This work studies a family of quantum machine learning pipelines for offline signature forgery detection on a public Kaggle corpus of images split into two classes. We pair a ZZ feature map quantum kernel with three classical learners: K-Nearest Neighbours, Support Vector Machine and Random Forest. We then propose a deeper hybrid that uses EfficientNetB0 as a frozen feature extractor, reduces the resulting 1280 dimensional representation to a qubit register sized subspace through a quantum compatible principal component projection and decides class membership with a nearest neighbour rule. On a single held out test fold the proposed hybrid reaches 92.62 percent accuracy. On stratified five fold cross validation the same pipeline yields a mean accuracy of 91.26 percent with a standard deviation of 1.13 percent. The pipeline keeps a quantum embedding step that is portable to NISQ hardware. We report a controlled ablation across six quantum variants, confusion matrices, a t SNE projection and per class precision, recall and F1 score.

AI.tldr: 用ZZ特征映射量子核搭配KNN/SVM/RF做离线手写签名伪造检测，并提出EfficientNetB0冻结特征+量子兼容PCA投影+最近邻的混合流水线，五折交叉验证平均准确率91.26%。
AI.motivation: 离线静态签名图像缺失笔压、时序与笔顺信息， skilled forgery 检测困难；作者希望探索量子机器学习流水线在该任务上的可行性，并保持可迁移到NISQ硬件的量子嵌入步骤。
AI.method: (1) ZZ feature map 量子核 + KNN / SVM / Random Forest 三类经典学习器；(2) 更深的混合方案：EfficientNetB0 冻结特征提取（1280维）→ 量子兼容PCA降维至量子比特寄存器规模 → 最近邻分类；(3) 六种量子变体的受控消融、混淆矩阵、t-SNE可视化与分类别P/R/F1。
AI.result: 单次留出测试折准确率92.62%；分层五折交叉验证平均准确率91.26%，标准差1.13%。
AI.conclusion: 量子核+经典学习器与深度特征+量子PCA的混合流水线可在离线签名伪造检测上取得约91–93%精度，且量子嵌入保持可移植到NISQ硬件；但仅基于Kaggle公开数据集与单一任务，缺乏与强经典基线的充分对照及更大规模验证。

title: Real-time Food Recipe Generation with Mobile Deep Learning and Large Language Model
summary: Finding recipes that match available kitchen ingredients can be cumbersome and inefficient. This paper addresses this challenge by developing a mobile application that generates tailored food recipes based on ingredients identified using a mobile camera. Leveraging deep learning and large language model (LLM), our system offers a seamless and efficient solution for real-time recipe generation. By integrating deep learning for accurate ingredient recognition with LLM for generating detailed and practical recipes, our approach ensures users receive precise cooking instructions based on actual ingredients on hand. Extensive dataset augmentation and model training have resulted in a robust system capable of high performance. Experimental results demonstrate that EfficientNet, used for food recognition, offers a balance of accuracy and computational efficiency, making it ideal for mobile applications. This dual-approach method enhances the cooking experience, reduces food waste, and provides a comprehensive, real-time tool for everyday cooking needs, bridging a significant gap in current food recommendation systems.

AI.tldr: 结合手机摄像头识别食材（EfficientNet）与LLM生成定制菜谱的移动应用，实现实时菜谱生成。
AI.motivation: 寻找与现有厨房食材匹配的菜谱费时低效，现有食物推荐系统缺乏"基于实际在手食材"的闭环工具。
AI.method: 深度学习方法（EfficientNet）做食材识别 + 大语言模型生成详细可操作菜谱，并配合数据增强与模型训练；以移动端应用部署。
AI.result: EfficientNet在准确率与计算效率间取得平衡，适合移动端；系统具备较高识别性能并实现实时菜谱生成。
AI.conclusion: 双阶段方法提升烹饪体验、减少食物浪费，为日常烹饪提供实时工具，弥补现有食物推荐系统的空白。

title: PhoneWatchUI: A Dataset of Smartphone and Smartwatch Images from App Stores
summary: Smartwatch apps are unique as they must condense functionality into a tiny screen of a few square centimeters. Yet, public GUI datasets are almost exclusively phone- or web-centric. We present PhoneWatchUI: 966.2k publisher-curated gallery image records from 72k store-specific app IDs on the US Apple App Store and Google Play, collected during October 2026. The Apple App Store part covers 37.6k apps with explicit Apple Watch platform metadata: 143.8k watch and 212.2k phone images labeled by their source galleries. The Google Play part covers 34.3k keyword-selected apps and 610.2k gallery images, provisionally labeled as watch, phone, or others by aspect ratio. Image records link to app metadata (title, description, category, ratings, developer, price) and retain source URLs, device-label provenance, and dimensions where available. We describe the dataset composition, image properties, and limitations. PhoneWatchUI enables research on cross-device GUI adaptation, wearable GUI retrieval and generation, as well as app-store analysis that links textual claims to visual evidence. Dataset is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: PhoneWatchUI：从 Apple App Store 与 Google Play 采集的约 96.6 万张应用商店图库截图数据集，覆盖 7.2 万个应用，含手表/手机界面双设备标注，用于跨设备 GUI 适配、可穿戴 GUI 检索与生成研究。
AI.motivation: 公开 GUI 数据集几乎全是手机或网页导向，缺少智能手表这类极小屏幕的可穿戴界面数据，制约了跨设备 GUI 适配与可穿戴界面生成研究。
AI.method: 构建大规模图库图像数据集：Apple App Store 部分基于显式 Apple Watch 平台元数据，得到 3.76 万应用、14.38 万手表图与 21.22 万手机图，按来源图库打标；Google Play 部分基于关键词筛选 3.43 万应用、61.02 万张图，按宽高比暂标为手表/手机/其他。每条记录关联标题、描述、类别、评分、开发者、价格等元数据，并保留源 URL、设备标签来源与图像尺寸。
AI.result: 交付 96.6 万条图库图像记录，来自 7.2 万个商店特定应用 ID，其中手表图像合计约 14 万张以上；Google Play 部分标签为启发式（宽高比）而非权威，作者在论文中说明了数据组成、图像属性与局限。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为跨设备 GUI 适配、可穿戴 GUI 检索与生成、以及"文本宣称—视觉证据"关联的商店分析提供了基础资源，但仅提供数据与描述性分析，未提出方法或实证模型效果。

title: Confidence-Based Adaptive Retrieval Fails Where It Matters Most: A Paradox in Biomedical Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for biomedical question answering, but plausible incorrect answers remain a safety risk in clinical settings. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground responses in medical literature, while confidence-based adaptive RAG retrieves only when the model appears uncertain. We evaluate this routing strategy on three biomedical QA benchmarks of increasing difficulty and compare models across a broad range of parameter scales. The results reveal a paradox: confidence is well calibrated (AUROC 0.78--0.89) on standard medical exam questions where retrieval adds little value (+2.4\% to -1.4\%), yet becomes \emph{near-random} (AUROC 0.506) on specialist-level questions where retrieval helps most (+11.2\%). Five uncertainty signals---first-token probability, margin, entropy, consistency-based sampling, and verbalized confidence---show the same failure pattern. Five post-hoc calibration correction strategies, including density-ratio reweighting and rank-preserving transformation, do not recover a useful routing signal on hard questions (best AUROC: 0.507). Cross-model comparison shows that larger parameter scale and higher base accuracy do not guarantee reliable confidence-based routing under specialist-domain difficulty shift. These findings challenge the premise of confidence-based adaptive RAG: in high-stakes biomedical settings, defaulting to always-retrieve is safer and more accurate than confidence-based routing when calibration on the target domain is unknown.

AI.tldr: 该文发现在生物医学QA中，置信度校准在简单题上良好但检索无益，在专家级难题上近随机（AUROC 0.506）而检索增益达+11.2%，五种不确定性信号与五种事后校准均无法修复，故应默认始终检索。
AI.motivation: 临床场景中LLM会产生看似合理的错误答案，置信度驱动的自适应RAG（仅在高不确定时检索）被视为兼顾效率与准确性的方案，但其在生物医学领域难度迁移下的可靠性尚未被系统检验。
AI.method: 在三个难度递增的生物医学QA基准上、跨多个参数规模模型评估置信度自适应检索；比较五种不确定性信号（首token概率、margin、熵、一致性采样、语言化置信度）与五种事后校准修正策略（含密度比重加权、保秩变换），并用AUROC衡量路由信号质量。
AI.result: 标准医学考题上置信度校准良好（AUROC 0.78–0.89）而检索增益仅+2.4%至-1.4%；专家级题目上AUROC降至0.506（近随机），检索增益达+11.2%；所有信号呈现同一失效模式，事后校准最佳AUROC仅0.507；更大参数规模与更高基础准确率不保证路由可靠。
AI.conclusion: 置信度自适应RAG的前提在高风险生物医学场景下不成立：目标域校准未知时应默认始终检索；该结论对confidence-gated agentic retrieval设计具有警示意义。

title: Effect-Driven Skill Abstractions for Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems, NeurIPS 2026
summary: We seek to learn discrete skill abstractions to facilitate long-horizon, goal-conditioned reinforcement-learning (RL) tasks. Recent approaches have shown success by quantizing actions via clustering or reconstruction. However, these objectives lead to skills that are not directly related to what the current state affords or what the goal requires. Instead, we argue that goal-directed skills should be driven by \emph{how they affect the state} of the agent. To realize this, we introduce a novel quantization method for action chunks that optimizes next-state predictions conditioned on the current state and action. This objective encourages skills to be distinguished by the future states they lead to, resulting in a vocabulary that spans diverse outcomes reachable from a given state. Our framework can easily be paired with common offline RL methods by replacing their continuous actor head with a discrete one that selects among the learned skills. We can execute these skills in the environment by converting them back to continuous actions using a trained low-level controller. Experiments on benchmark navigation and manipulation tasks largely show substantial and consistent improvements over both the continuous-actor baselines and reconstruction-based discretizations. Our project page can be found at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出一种以“下一状态预测”为目标的动作块量化方法，学习离散技能词表，使技能按可达的未来状态区分，并可与离线RL结合用于长时序目标条件任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的动作离散化方法（聚类或重构）所得技能与当前状态的可用性（affordance）及目标需求无直接关联；作者主张目标导向技能应由其对智能体状态的影响来驱动。
AI.method: 对动作块（action chunk）进行量化，优化以当前状态与动作为条件的下一状态预测目标，使技能经其导致的未来状态而被区分，形成覆盖多样可达结果的离散词表；将离线RL策略的连续actor头替换为在学得技能上选择的离散头，并用训练好的低层控制器把技能转回连续动作执行。
AI.result: 在导航与操作基准任务上，相对连续actor基线与基于重构的离散化方法取得显著且一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: 以状态影响为目标的技能量化是构建长时序离线RL技能库的有效原则，且能即插即用地兼容常见离线RL框架。

title: A comprehensive survey of deep face verification systems adversarial attacks and defense strategies
summary: Face Verification (FV) systems have exhibited remarkable performance in verification tasks and have consequently garnered extensive adoption across various applications, from identity duplication to authentication in mobile payments. However, the surge in popularity of face verification has raised concerns about potential vulnerabilities in the face of adversarial attacks. These concerns originate from the fact that advanced FV systems, which rely on deep neural networks, have recently demonstrated susceptibility to crafted input samples known as adversarial examples. Although imperceptible to human observers, adversarial examples can deceive deep neural networks during the testing and deployment phases. These vulnerabilities raised significant concerns about the deployment of deep neural networks in safety-critical contexts, prompting extensive investigations into adversarial attacks and corresponding defense strategies. This comprehensive survey provides a comprehensive overview of recent advances in deep face verification, encompassing a broad spectrum of topics such as algorithmic designs, database utilization, protocols, and application scenarios. Furthermore, we conduct an in-depth examination of state-of-the-art algorithms to generate adversarial examples and the defense mechanisms devised to mitigate such adversarial threats.

AI.tldr: 本文综述深度人脸验证（FV）系统的对抗攻击与防御研究，梳理算法设计、数据集、协议、应用场景，并深入分析对抗样本生成算法与防御机制。
AI.motivation: 深度人脸验证系统广泛部署（身份核验、移动支付），但深度网络对对抗样本的脆弱性威胁安全关键场景，因此需系统梳理攻击与防御现状。
AI.method: 文献综述：覆盖人脸验证算法设计、数据库、评测协议与应用场景；分类梳理先进对抗样本生成算法（白盒/黑盒、迁移性等）及对应防御机制（对抗训练、检测、预处理等）。
AI.result: 提供人脸验证对抗攻防的系统性分类与对比总结，指出各方法的适用条件与局限（综述无实验性新结果）。
AI.conclusion: 人脸验证的对抗鲁棒性仍是开放问题，需在安全关键部署中结合多类防御并建立统一协议与基准。

title: How Many Samples Is RL Worth? Best-of-N versus RL Post-Training for Text-to-Image Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) on a reward that can be checked automatically has become a common last step in the training of text-to-image models. A simpler way to get more correct images is best-of-N: draw N images from the base model and keep the one that a picker prefers. We ask how many base model samples one RL sample is worth, and call this number the exchange rate. We measure it for Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and its public Flow-GRPO checkpoint on 398 new prompts in the style of GenEval, the benchmark behind the RL reward, with human labels on every prompt and two automatic judges other than the reward. The answer depends on the prompt. Four fifths of the prompts do not ask for a position (for example, one object left of another). On these, the base model catches up: best-of-16 with an off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) as the picker is about as good as one RL image. A person who looks through up to 3 base images finds a correct one as often as one RL image is correct. On the prompts that ask for a position, RL is far ahead: a person finds a correct image among 8 base images for only 52% of the prompts, against 92% for one RL image. Over all prompts, our primary test, which we fixed in advance, finds best-of-16 with the VLM picker 9.3 points behind one RL image when both automatic judges must pass an image. People see a smaller gap, 5.5 and 6.5 points in two checks. FLUX.1-dev shows a similar gap in the same test. RL also solves 20 prompts that the base model misses in 128 tries, and 1,024 tries recover half of them. The automatic judges are wrong in opposite directions: a detector-based judge like the reward, as used in our primary test, reports a larger gap than people see, and VLM judges report little or none. Comparisons of RL with best-of-N should therefore check the selected images by hand.

AI.tldr: 论文量化了"一张RL微调图像"与"N张基座模型采样"的等价性（exchange rate），在SD3.5 Medium与Flow-GRPO上以398条GenEval式新提示、人工标注及两个自动评测器比较；结果显示无空间位置约束的提示上best-of-16（VLM挑选）≈1张RL图，而含位置关系提示上RL显著领先（人工从8张基座图中找到正确图仅52%，单张RL图92%）；自动评判器偏差方向相反，建议人工核验选定图像。
AI.motivation: RL with verifiable rewards已成为文生图训练的常见末段，但best-of-N仅需采样+挑选，成本更低。社区缺乏对两种方案"性价比"的量化：一张RL样本究竟等价于多少张基座样本（exchange rate）？且已有比较多依赖自动评判器，其可靠性未知。
AI.method: 在Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium与其公开Flow-GRPO checkpoint上，构建398条GenEval风格的新提示（其中约4/5不含位置关系约束），为每条提示采集人工标注，并引入两个独立于RL奖励的自动评判器（一个检测器型、一个VLM型）。预先固定主检验（best-of-16 + 现成VLM挑选器，要求两个自动评判器同时通过），并补充人工小样本检查（最多3张、8张基座图）与FLUX.1-dev复现；另做128/1024次采样的难例覆盖分析。
AI.result: exchange rate高度依赖提示类型：在无位置约束提示上，best-of-16+VLM挑选≈1张RL图；人工查看≤3张基座图即可达到与单张RL图相同的正确率。含位置约束提示上RL远优：人工在8张基座图中找到正确图仅覆盖52%提示，而单张RL图为92%。全体提示上主检验显示best-of-16落后单张RL图9.3分（两评判器同时通过口径），人工检查差距较小（5.5/6.5分）；FLUX.1-dev呈类似差距。RL还解决了基座模型128次采样均失败的20条提示，1024次采样可恢复其中一半。评判器偏差相反：检测器型（与奖励同族）夸大差距，VLM型评判器几乎或完全不显示差距。
AI.conclusion: RL与best-of-N的优劣取决于提示是否要求组合性/空间关系；在多数提示上廉价采样即可追平。自动评判器不可作为唯一依据（偏差方向相反且量级不一），RL与best-of-N的比较必须对最终选中图像进行人工核验，并报告提示分层结果。

title: MonoQPM: Splitting Features into Concepts for Inherent Interpretability and Predictive Performance
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (10/2026). OpenReview: this https URL
summary: Alongside superposition, polysemanticity is one of the primary obstacles to achieving interpretable deep neural networks. While these phenomena are typically intrinsically linked, the Quadratic Programming Enhanced Model (QPM) naturally decouples them. By representing classes with a sparse binary assignment of very few features, QPM prevents superposition by design on its final features but still exhibits polysemanticity. However, measuring polysemanticity is an open problem. This work proposes a utility-focused approach to measuring polysemanticity by quantifying the decrease in interference-induced activation errors, which yields the practical utility of tighter prediction sets using Conformal Prediction (CP). We explicitly disentangle the polysemantic features of QPM into monosemantic concepts to create the Monosemantic QPM (MonoQPM). Because its features are disentangled, MonoQPM acts as a significantly more efficient Conformal Predictor. Additionally, we introduce CUBCars, a dataset providing ground truth information about shared concepts. Using this and other datasets, we demonstrate that polysemanticity emerges in QPM across all tested architectures, but is effectively alleviated by MonoQPM. For instance, MonoQPM guarantees 88% coverage using Adaptive Prediction Sets on ImageNet with just 66% of the frozen QPM's set size.

AI.tldr: 提出MonoQPM：将QPM模型的多义特征显式解耦为单义概念，并用保形预测（CP）预测集大小作为多义性的实用度量；MonoQPM作为CP预测器更高效。
AI.motivation: 叠加与多义性是深度网络可解释性的两大障碍，但二者常被捆绑；QPM在最终特征上天然规避叠加却仍存在多义性，而多义性的度量本身尚无公认方法。
AI.method: 用少量特征的稀疏二值分配表示类别；以"干扰引起的激活误差下降"来量化多义性，等价于CP预测集的实用收益；将QPM的多义特征解耦为单义概念得到MonoQPM，并构建含共享概念真值标注的CUBCars数据集。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上使用自适应预测集（APS），MonoQPM仅用冻结QPM 66%的预测集尺寸即可保证88%覆盖率；多义性在QPM所有测试架构中出现，MonoQPM可有效缓解。
AI.conclusion: 多义性可以与叠加解耦，并可用CP预测集效率作为操作性度量；显式解耦特征的MonoQPM在保持覆盖率的条件下显著提升预测效率。

title: CriticalScenes: Scalable Photorealistic Critical-Scenario Generation for Closed-Loop Driving Adaptation
summary: Safety-critical interactions are rare in recorded driving data, leaving end-to-end driving planners with limited exposure to evasive behaviour during training. This lack of critical supervision can lead to unsafe behaviour and, in rare instances, collisions. To address this gap, we introduce CriticalScenes, a reconstruction-based framework that transforms ordinary recorded driving scenes into photorealistic safety-critical interactions with corresponding collision-avoidance supervision. Across 53 reconstructed source scenes, 979 of 1,060 attempted interactions yield feasible threat trajectories (92.4\%), while the inserted threat actors remain detectable in more than 95\% of non-occluded observations within 5--35\,m. Experiments with two structurally different end-to-end planners show that the generated supervision improves critical-scenario planning, while closed-loop transfer varies across planner architectures. SparseDrive achieves a 46.5\% relative reduction in collision rate on an independent photorealistic closed-loop benchmark, whereas UniAD shows only a modest closed-loop improvement despite substantial open-loop gains. The results further highlight the importance of closed-loop evaluation, as improvements in open-loop trajectory prediction do not necessarily translate into equivalent safety gains.

AI.tldr: CriticalScenes: a reconstruction-based framework that converts ordinary recorded driving scenes into photorealistic safety-critical interactions with collision-avoidance supervision; 92.4% of attempted threat trajectories are feasible, supervision improves critical-scenario planning in two E2E planners (SparseDrive −46.5% relative collision rate closed-loop), but closed-loop transfer differs by architecture.
AI.motivation: Recorded driving data rarely contains safety-critical interactions, so end-to-end planners receive little evasive/critical supervision, leading to unsafe behavior and occasional collisions.
AI.method: Reconstruction-based scene editing: 53 reconstructed source scenes, inserting threat actors to synthesize photorealistic safety-critical interactions, automatically generating collision-avoidance supervision; validated with two structurally different E2E planners (SparseDrive, UniAD) plus detectability analysis of inserted actors (95%+ in non-occluded 5–35 m views).
AI.result: 979/1060 attempted interactions feasible (92.4%); inserted actors detectable >95% (non-occluded, 5–35 m). SparseDrive: 46.5% relative closed-loop collision-rate reduction on independent photorealistic closed-loop benchmark; UniAD: only modest closed-loop gain despite large open-loop gains.
AI.conclusion: Reconstruction-based critical-scenario synthesis is a viable data augmentation route for hard-case driving supervision; open-loop trajectory gains do not reliably translate into closed-loop safety, underscoring the need for closed-loop evaluation.

title: Same Tokenizer, Better Tokens: Choosing Image Tokens by MAP Inference
summary: Discrete visual tokens encode images for reconstruction and serve as training targets for autoregressive image generators. Vector-quantized tokenizers typically assign each encoder feature its nearest code independently. The decoder uses these codes jointly, so a sequence of individually nearest codes can reconstruct an image less faithfully than an alternative assignment. A local model of the reconstruction loss yields a closest-vector problem with a decoder-dependent target and metric. Reconstruction-only search improves PSNR across the frozen tokenizers we test. Different code sequences can achieve similar reconstruction quality, leaving room to favour more predictable ones. We introduce RecaP (Reconstruction and Predictability), which selects codes for a frozen tokenizer by balancing how faithfully they reconstruct the image with how likely their sequence is under a pretrained autoregressive prior. On ImageNet, LlamaGen GPT-B trained on RecaP tokens achieves lower early-checkpoint FID against training images than GPT-B trained on nearest-neighbour tokens. The difference is smaller against held-out images. On an ImageNet subset, the prior improves generation at comparable reconstruction FID. Our code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: RecaP 在冻结 VQ tokenizer 上联合优化"重建保真度 + 序列可预测性"来选择离散视觉 token，使自回归图像生成器训练目标更易学习。
AI.motivation: VQ tokenizer 通常对每个编码器特征独立取最近邻码字，但解码器是联合使用整段码序列的，因此逐个最近邻得到的序列未必是最优重建，且不同码序列可达相近重建质量——留下为自回归先验挑选更"可预测"序列的空间。
AI.method: 1) 将重建损失做局部建模，得到带解码器相关目标与度量的最近向量问题，做重建导向的码搜索；2) 引入 RecaP 目标：在冻结 tokenizer 下联合权衡重建保真度与序列在预训练自回归先验下的似然，选择 token 序列；3) 用 RecaP token 训练 LlamaGen GPT-B 等自回归生成器。
AI.result: 仅重建搜索即可在多个冻结 tokenizer 上提升 PSNR；ImageNet 上以 RecaP token 训练的 GPT-B 相对最近邻版本在早期 checkpoint 对训练图像的 FID 更低，但对留出图像差距缩小；在 ImageNet 子集上，先验在相近重建 FID 下改善生成。
AI.conclusion: token 选取应与下游自回归先验协同设计，而非逐特征贪心最近邻；不过增益在泛化到留出数据时减弱，说明存在一定训练集过拟合倾向，需更稳健的可预测性建模。

title: JetDiffusion: Pushing the Speed Limits of Video Generation with NVFP4 Sparse Attention
summary: Attention over long sequences is a major computational bottleneck in video generation, which can be alleviated through sparsity and low-bit quantization. We propose JetDiffusion, a video generation system built on trainable Video Sparse Quantized Attention (VSQA), with custom inference kernels that combine native NVFP4 computation and kernel fusion. At 90% sparsity, VSQA accelerates attention by 8-29x compared with FlashAttention on different hardwares. To further accelerate video generation, we combine VSQA with NVFP4 linear quantization and step distillation. Although each technique can individually preserve generation quality, jointly adapting to all three remains challenging, particularly under aggressive NVFP4 quantization. Through empirical studies, we develop an effective staged training recipe that enables stable adaptation to quantization, sparsity, and few-step denoising. On Wan2.1-14B, the resulting model achieves 273x end-to-end video generation speedup on the RTX 5090 while maintaining comparable video quality.

AI.tldr: JetDiffusion 用可训练的 Video Sparse Quantized Attention (VSQA) 加 NVFP4 线性量化和步蒸馏，通过分阶段训练配方在 Wan2.1-14B 上实现 273x 端到端加速（RTX 5090）且画质相当。
AI.motivation: 长序列注意力是视频生成的算力瓶颈，稀疏化与低比特量化理论上可缓解，但三者联合适配（尤其 NVFP4 激进量化下）难以保持生成质量。
AI.method: 可训练 VSQA（90% 稀疏）+ 原生 NVFP4 计算与 kernel fusion 的自定义推理 kernel + NVFP4 线性量化 + 步蒸馏；提出分阶段训练配方使模型稳定适配量化、稀疏化与少步去噪。
AI.result: 90% 稀疏下注意力较 FlashAttention 加速 8–29x（跨硬件）；Wan2.1-14B 上端到端 273x 加速，视频质量相当。
AI.conclusion: 三项加速技术的分阶段协同训练可实现激进的效率-质量折中，属于视频生成系统级加速工作，而非物理 AI/VLA/3D 重建方向。

title: CoSMo: A Compact Spectral Space of Body Motion in Video
summary: We introduce CoSMo, a compact spectral space of body motion in video, in which each motion is a single code that can be compared and edited without training, transferred to a new subject, interpolated, composed, scaled in intensity and detail, or sampled anew. Our encoder expresses how a clip's DINOv2 features change over time in a fixed temporal basis, the discrete cosine transform (DCT), and compresses this change into 384 numbers. Because each frequency band is the same cosine pattern in every code, codes are aligned in time, ordered from coarse to fine, and can be blended or added without matching frames. What stays constant over a clip cancels, and keeping fewer frequencies leaves less of the performer and scene. The encoder is trained on real videos and on synthetic motions of several characters, and lightweight adapters let a frozen image-to-video model render any code with any subject. On unseen videos, our code ranks the same motion on other bodies higher than DisMo, a per-frame representation, while its nearest neighbors show the same performer about 40% less often with a seven times more compact code. In generation, without per-motion training, CoSMo transfers motion more faithfully than FlexiAct and a text-prompt baseline, at least as faithfully as DisMo on automatic metrics and clearly better between humanoid bodies, and its blends keep much more of both source motions than DisMo's. Users rank CoSMo first nearly twice as often as DisMo for motion transfer (59% vs. 30%), place it top-two 94% of the time, and prefer it in 76% of the interpolation comparisons.

AI.tldr: CoSMo将视频中的人体运动编码为384维DCT频谱码，实现无训练的运动比较、编辑、迁移、插值与组合。
AI.motivation: 现有视频运动表示多为逐帧特征（如DisMo），码长冗余且时间未对齐，难以直接进行运动比较、混合与跨主体迁移；需要一种紧凑、时间对齐、可无训练编辑的运动表示。
AI.method: 用固定DCT基表达DINOv2特征随时间的演化，将变化压缩为384维码；各频带模式一致使码在时间上对齐并按粗到细排序，可直接相加/混合而无需帧匹配；恒定成分自动抵消，保留频率越少则主体与场景信息越少。编码器在真实视频与多角色合成运动上训练，并用轻量适配器让冻结的图像到视频模型以任意主体渲染任意码。
AI.result: 在未见视频上，同运动跨身体检索优于DisMo，而最近邻中同表演者出现率低约40%，码紧凑7倍；生成时无需逐运动训练，运动迁移忠实度优于FlexiAct与文本提示基线，自动指标至少与DisMo相当、类人身体间明显更优，混合保留更多双方源运动；用户研究中运动迁移偏好59% vs 30%，前二占比94%，插值比较中76%偏好CoSMo。
AI.conclusion: 表明固定频谱基+紧凑编码可作为一种通用、可组合、可迁移的运动表示，支撑检索、编辑与可控视频生成，并具有一定跨具身泛化潜力。

title: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis in Jacobian-Space: Language and Vision Models Agree Approximately Up to a Rotation
summary: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) posits that AI models converge toward a shared representation of the world, even when trained on different data modalities. Previous work has found evidence for the PRH in the activations of vision and language models. In this work, we ask whether vision and language models also converge in how they act on these representations: precisely, in how these internal representations affect the models' output. At a chosen layer of a transformer, the Jacobian lens gives every word in the vocabulary (or class in an image classifier) a vector in the hidden state: the vector that most increases the model's tendency to generate that word, at that position or later, or to predict that class. Collectively, these vectors make up what is referred to as the model's J-space. We find evidence of the PRH in J-space across vision and language models, and furthermore, we find that J-spaces mostly converge up to a rotation. That is, a single rotation, fitted on a subset of words, approximately maps one model's J-space onto another's, and so applies to words and classes it was not fitted on. A word's vector, rotated from a text-only language model's J-space into the visual patch tokens of a vision-language model, changes the object the vision-language model says is in the image (and only in the image region where it is added). Rotated into an image generator's text conditioning, a word's vector changes the object in the generated image. Rotated into an ImageNet classifier (trained without text), it raises that object's class score above almost all others, and vice versa. This suggests that models converge not only in how they represent the world, but also in how they act on it.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并在"J-space"（Jacobian lens 空间，即对各词/类最增大输出倾向的隐状态向量集）中验证 Platonic Representation Hypothesis（PRH），发现视觉模型与语言模型的表征在动作层面也趋同，且主要相差一个旋转映射。
AI.motivation: 已有的 PRH 证据仅停留在表征（activation）层面，未回答模型是否在"如何用表征影响输出"这一功能/行为层面也收敛。作者希望把信息论/几何层面的表征趋同推进到因果、可操作的层面。
AI.method: 在 transformer 选定层上计算 Jacobian lens：对词表中每个词（或图像分类器中每个类）求使该词/类生成概率最大化的隐状态方向向量，构成 J-space；用少量词拟合单一旋转矩阵，检验跨模型（纯文本语言模型、视觉语言模型、图像生成器、ImageNet 分类器）J-space 的对齐程度；并通过"把旋转后的向量注入"做因果干预实验。
AI.result: 跨视觉与语言模型在 J-space 中存在 PRH 证据；J-space 大致仅相差一个旋转（在部分词上拟合的旋转可泛化到未拟合的词与类）。将语言模型词向量旋转注入 VLM 的视觉 patch token 可改变其报告的对象类别且仅影响注入区域；注入图像生成器文本条件可改变生成图像中的对象；注入无文本训练的 ImageNet 分类器可使该类得分超过几乎所有其他类，反向亦成立。
AI.conclusion: 模型的趋同不仅在于"如何表征世界"，也在于"如何作用于世界"（表征→输出的功能映射），提示存在跨模态共享的、可旋转对齐的动作空间结构。

title: Change Partners at Every Layer: Balanced Random Regrouping for Model Merging
summary: Model merging combines fine-tuned experts into one model that serves many tasks without retraining, but merging many experts this way substantially reduces accuracy. Grouping offers a middle ground: at every layer or weight matrix, the $N$ experts are divided into $K<N$ groups, the experts in a group are merged into one shared module, and a task uses the module merged from its expert's group. Natural choices are to keep the same partners across layers or to group similar experts. Surprisingly, we find that randomly changing partners at every layer outperforms both. We call this Balanced Random Regrouping (BRR): it independently partitions the experts into $K$ equal-sized random groups at each layer (BRR-layer) or weight matrix (BRR-matrix) and merges each group with an existing method. With validation-selected merge scales, both BRR variants outperform reusing one grouping across layers in all 24 CLIP settings, by 1.0-6.8 points, and BRR-matrix also outperforms the similarity-based FlexMerge in every setting. A first-order analysis explains this gain. At each layer, merging a task's expert with its partners shifts the task's output features; when the partners are the same at every layer, these shifts tend to point in similar directions and add up, whereas with new partners at every layer they vary independently and add up less on average. A series of experiments supports this analysis, which further guides a grouping search that can outperform BRR.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Balanced Random Regrouping (BRR)：在每层或每个权重矩阵独立将N个专家随机均分为K组再合并，优于固定分组与相似度分组，并给出特征漂移叠加的一阶分析。
AI.motivation: 多专家模型合并（model merging）能在不重训的情况下让单一模型服务多任务，但合并大量专家会显著损失精度。分组合并是折中方案，然而"跨层保持同一搭档"或"按相似度分组"这两种直觉选择并非最优，作者希望找到更好的分组策略。
AI.method: BRR-layer：在每一层独立地把N个专家随机划分为K个等大小组，组内用现有合并方法合并；BRR-matrix：在每个权重矩阵上独立划分。合并尺度由验证集选择。作者用一阶分析刻画每层合并引入的输出特征偏移，指出固定搭档时偏移方向一致会累积，而每层换随机搭档则相互独立、平均累积更小。
AI.result: 在全部24个CLIP设置中，两种BRR变体相较跨层复用同一分组提升1.0–6.8个点；BRR-matrix在所有设置中均优于基于相似度的FlexMerge。系列实验支持一阶分析，并据此引导的分组搜索可进一步超越BRR。
AI.conclusion: 在层/矩阵级别进行平衡随机重分组，可通过打散合并误差的方向相关性来缓解多专家合并的精度衰减，这是一个简单有效且可分析的模型合并策略。

title: NeuroRefine: Six-Head MLP Content Conditioning and Qwen Refinement for Faithful fMRI Decoding
summary: Reconstructing seen images from fMRI has advanced through diffusion models, but the current state-of-the-art Brain-IT pipeline still has a lossy bottleneck: its low-level branch outlines the figure well, yet the diffusion model that follows frequently mispaints colour, object identity and layout. We move one step backward and condition the refiner directly on the fMRI-derived low-level image, using six one-hidden-layer MLP heads (scene, main-subject category, count, colour, object, layout) to predict the content prompt that guides a frozen Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 model. On the 930 shared NSD concepts, scored with Brain-IT's own metric code on the same ground truth, NeuroRefine reaches a CLIP image cosine of 0.755 against 0.735 for Brain-IT enhanced and produces markedly sharper images, while the saturated 2-way identification is unchanged. The low-level image supplies an explicit spatial prior rather than a lossless layout: refinement trades some layout agreement (0.541 against 0.638) for semantic fidelity and texture. We then show that the standard panel is multi-factor: a high PixCorr can coexist with completely different content, so we read the low-level and semantic factors separately and quantify where they disagree. Finally, we trace the cortical sources of the prompt heads across subjects and report their causal lesion profile and the fMRI noise ceiling. Direction errors are left to future work.

AI.tldr: NeuroRefine 将扩散精修模型直接条件化于 fMRI 解码出的低层图像，用六个单层 MLP 头预测内容提示词，驱动冻结的 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 完成图像重建，在 NSD 上提升语义保真度并分解多因素评价。
AI.motivation: Brain-IT 的低层分支能较好勾勒图形轮廓，但其后的扩散模型常出错颜色、物体身份与布局，形成有损瓶颈；作者希望绕过该瓶颈，把低层图像作为显式空间先验直接注入精修器。
AI.method: 以 fMRI 导出的低层图像作为条件输入，用六个单隐层 MLP 头（场景、主体类别、数量、颜色、物体、布局）预测内容提示词，引导冻结的 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 进行图像编辑式重建；在 NSD 930 个共享概念上使用 Brain-IT 原指标代码与同一真值评测，并将评价面板拆分为低层与语义因子分别读取，最后追踪提示词头的皮层来源，给出因果损伤剖面与 fMRI 噪声上限。
AI.result: CLIP 图像余弦相似度 0.755，优于 Brain-IT enhanced 的 0.735，图像明显更清晰，饱和的 2-way 识别率无变化；布局一致性下降（0.541 vs 0.638），以换取语义保真与纹理质量；发现高 PixCorr 可与内容完全不符共存；方向误差留待后续工作。
AI.conclusion: 低层图像提供的是显式空间先验而非无损布局，精修过程在布局一致性与语义保真之间形成明确权衡；标准评价面板是多因子混杂的，应分低层与语义因子分别解读。

title: Large-scale Model Merging via Recovery-aware Task Weighting
summary: Model merging combines multiple task-specific expert models into a single model. However, merging preserves expert capabilities unevenly across tasks. This imbalance is particularly pronounced in large-scale settings, where some tasks can suffer severe capability losses even when average accuracy remains high. To address this imbalance, we introduce Recovery-aware Task Weighting (RaTW), a model merging framework that assigns larger weights to tasks whose expert capabilities are poorly retained by an initial merged model. We quantify these recovery opportunities as the fraction of a task's labeled validation samples that its expert predicts correctly but the initial merged model gets wrong, and use the resulting task weights to re-merge the experts. To evaluate merging at large scale, we construct CLIPMerge-100, a 100-task benchmark with task-specific experts on CLIP ViT-L/14 and ViT-B/32. Across eleven merging methods with 20, 50, and 100 tasks on two CLIP backbones, RaTW improves both mean accuracy and tail20 (the mean expert-normalized accuracy of the 20% worst-retained tasks) in all 33 ViT-L/14 settings and 32 of 33 ViT-B/32 settings. We further introduce ReForge++, which combines RaTW with iterative model refinement and outperforms all evaluated baselines, including a matched-budget control, in both mean accuracy and tail20 across all settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 Recovery-aware Task Weighting (RaTW)：以“初始合并模型中专家能正确预测、而合并模型预测错误”的验证样本比例作为任务恢复空间，据此加大权重重新合并专家，缓解模型合并中各任务能力保留不均衡问题；并构建 100 任务的 CLIPMerge-100 基准与迭代式 ReForge++。
AI.motivation: 模型合并虽能将多个任务专家整合为单一模型，但各任务能力保留不均衡，大规模设置下部分任务能力严重退化，即使平均精度仍然较高。需要一种能针对性补偿“保留较差任务”的合并策略。
AI.method: 1) 量化恢复空间：对每个任务的带标签验证样本，统计专家预测正确但初始合并模型预测错误的样本占比；2) 以该占比作为任务权重进行再合并（RaTW）；3) 构建 CLIPMerge-100（100 任务、CLIP ViT-L/14 与 ViT-B/32 上的任务专属专家）；4) ReForge++ 将 RaTW 与迭代式模型精炼结合，并设等预算对照。
AI.result: 在 11 种合并方法、20/50/100 任务、两种 CLIP 骨干共 66 个设置中，RaTW 在 ViT-L/14 的全部 33 个设置、ViT-B/32 的 32/33 个设置上同时提升平均精度与 tail20（最差保留的 20% 任务的平均专家归一化精度）。ReForge++ 在所有设置下于平均精度与 tail20 两项指标上均超越全部基线，包括等预算对照。
AI.conclusion: 基于“恢复空间”的任务加权是一种简单有效的合并改进手段，能显著改善尾部任务的能力保留；结合迭代精炼后可稳定优于现有合并方法，为大规模多任务模型合并提供了可复用的基准与流程。

title: What Does RL Post-Training Teach Text-to-Image Models? A Skill-Wise Analysis of Flow-GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has become a standard way to improve text-to-image flow models: Flow-GRPO lifts the GenEval score of SD3.5-M from 0.63 to 0.95, a gain read as the model having learned compositional generation. We ask how much of that gain the base model's own samples already contained, by measuring pass@k over shared noise seeds, one skill at a time, before and after RL, on prompts never used in training. The answer differs by skill. On four of GenEval's six skills, where 32 base samples already solve almost every prompt, the gain is sharpening: one post-trained sample is worth 4 to 10 base samples, and pass@32 barely moves. On spatial relations it is unlocking: pass@32 rises from 0.69 to 1.00, 128 base samples do not match one post-trained sample, and prompts the base model never solved in 32 samples are solved 93% of the time, as often as those it solved. The benchmark average, 31 base samples per post-trained sample, describes no skill. Relations carry 35% of the gain; of the other 65%, selecting among 8 base samples with the judge behind the reward recovers nine tenths. We propose an account of when each occurs: within a prompt, a group-relative update re-weights only the outcomes its samples contain, and a flow policy cannot widen the noise that produces them; across prompts, shared parameters let successes on some prompts repair a deficit common to many. The same anatomy applies to a text-rendering checkpoint. The account's predictions are tested with a checkpoint trained without KL, within-prompt diversity, and controlled training that holds object classes out, where sharpening comes first and transfers, and unlocking follows, on practised objects before unseen ones.

AI.tldr: 该论文用共享噪声种子的 pass@k 解剖 Flow-GRPO 对 SD3.5-M 文本生成图像模型的增益，发现六项技能中四项是"锐化"（sharpen）而空间关系是"解锁"（unlock），并给出统一解释：prompt 内 group-relative 更新只重加权已有结果，跨 prompt 共享参数才可修复共性缺陷。
AI.motivation: Flow-GRPO 把 SD3.5-M 的 GenEval 分数从 0.63 提到 0.95，通常被解释为"学会了组合式生成"。作者质疑这一解读：需要区分基座模型已有能力的重新分配（锐化）与真正新增的能力（解锁），而单一的 benchmark 平均增益掩盖了技能间差异。
AI.method: 在训练未见的 prompt 上，用共享噪声种子做 pass@k 分析，逐技能比较 RL 前后基座与后训练检查点的采样分布；用相同噪声下"一个后训练样本等价于多少基座样本"量化增益来源；进一步用奖励背后的 judge 做 8 选 1 的 best-of-n 选择以剥离"选择"与"学习"的贡献；提出双机制解释（prompt 内 group-relative 重加权 vs. 跨 prompt 参数共享修复共性缺陷），并通过无 KL 训练、prompt 内多样性、以及留出物体类别的受控训练验证预测。
AI.result: 四项技能上 32 个基座样本已几乎解出全部 prompt，增益主要是锐化：1 个后训练样本约等于 4–10 个基座样本，pass@32 几乎不变。空间关系上则是解锁：pass@32 从 0.69 升至 1.00，128 个基座样本仍不及 1 个后训练样本，且基座 32 次采样从未解出的 prompt 有 93% 被解出，与曾解出的 prompt 成功率相当。benchmark 平均"31 个基座样本折合 1 个后训练样本"不对应任何单项技能；空间关系贡献 35% 增益，其余 65% 中九成可由 judge 驱动的 8 选 1 恢复。文本渲染检查点呈相同解剖结构；受控训练显示锐化先行并可迁移，解锁随后发生，且在练习过的物体上先于未见物体。
AI.conclusion: RL 后训练的 benchmark 平均增益不是单一能力的度量，需按技能拆分为锐化与解锁两类机制；group-relative 目标在 prompt 内只能重加权已有结果，真正的新能力来自跨 prompt 的参数共享。该分析提供了评估 RL 后训练"是否真的学到新东西"的可操作诊断框架（共享种子 pass@k + best-of-n 基线）。

title: StyleID++: Position-Decoupled and Structure-Coherent Style Retrieval across Diffusion Architectures
summary: Attention injection offers a remarkably simple route to training-free style transfer: content queries retrieve style keys and values inside a pretrained diffusion model. We show that this operation also creates an overlooked failure mode. Position signals that are useful within one image become a spurious shared coordinate system across two spatially unrelated images, causing content tokens to favor style tokens at similar coordinates. This cross-image positional leakage appears in both convolutional U-Nets and diffusion transformers (DiTs), despite their different position mechanisms. Removing the positional shortcut exposes a second problem: unconstrained global retrieval lets related content tokens select incompatible style regions, producing fragmented appearance. We present StyleID++, a training-free framework that addresses the two problems jointly. Position-Decoupled Retrieval reduces coordinate-dependent matching through circular padding in U-Nets and injection-only RoPE removal in DiTs, while preserving native position modeling elsewhere. Affinity-Coherent Refinement then regularizes style assignments with the content self-attention graph, encouraging structurally related tokens to retrieve compatible style evidence. We quantify the leakage with a coordinate--centroid correlation and a permutation test on the style reference. The permutation error can be driven to zero in both backbones, which identifies the position mechanism as the carrier of the leakage, and StyleID++ obtains the best ArtFID of all methods we compare.

AI.tldr: StyleID++指出免训练风格迁移中注意力注入存在"跨图位置泄漏"：单图内有用的位置信号在两幅无关图像间形成虚假共享坐标系，使内容token偏向同坐标的风格token；移除位置捷径后又出现全局检索导致的风格碎片化。方法以Position-Decoupled Retrieval（U-Net循环填充、DiT仅注入处去RoPE）与Affinity-Coherent Refinement（用内容自注意力图正则化风格分配）联合解决，两主干上置换误差可降至零，ArtFID最优。
AI.motivation: 免训练扩散风格迁移依赖内容query检索风格key/value，但此前工作未意识到位置编码在跨图像检索中成为虚假共享坐标系，造成位置泄漏；同时消除该捷径后暴露出检索无约束、风格区域错配与碎片化的问题。
AI.method: 问题诊断：坐标—质心相关性与风格参考置换检验量化跨图位置泄漏。方法一，Position-Decoupled Retrieval：U-Net用循环填充解耦坐标匹配，DiT仅在注入处移除RoPE而保留原生位置建模；方法二，Affinity-Coherent Refinement：以内容自注意力图作正则，使结构相关token检索兼容的风格证据。
AI.result: U-Net与DiT两类骨干均观察到泄漏；置换误差可被压至零，证实位置机制是泄漏载体；相比所有对比方法取得最佳ArtFID。
AI.conclusion: 跨图位置泄漏是注意力注入风格迁移中被忽视的失效模式，且可通过针对位置机制与检索一致性的两阶段设计联合修复，为免训练风格迁移提供可诊断、可迁移到两种架构的改进方案。

title: Do Not Let the Prior Heal the Anomaly: Selective Anchoring for Detection from Incomplete Measurements
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 23 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Generative priors can recover anatomical detail from incomplete medical measurements, but may erase the very lesions that imaging aims to detect, even when the measurements contain evidence of them. We introduce selective anchoring that protects reliably measured image components from prior-driven changes, while allowing expressive generative models to reconstruct unresolved structure. Acquisition uncertainty in the protected components is either added deterministically to the downstream test or carried by the ensemble through stochastic perturbations of the readings. We implement this principle as a wrapper for pretrained diffusion and flow samplers and as AnchoredFM, a fast constrained flow model. Under a linear-Gaussian measurement model, the protected coefficients are unbiased in expectation and achieve nominal interval coverage across repeated acquisitions, independently of the learned prior. Across sparse-view CT, accelerated brain MRI, and photoacoustic tomography, selective anchoring improves lesion contrast preservation and uncertainty reliability, and can reduce reconstruction error within lesions. For tumor detection in accelerated MRI, with a healthy reference estimated from the measurements alone, deterministic anchoring raises mean AUROC across eight samplers from 78.4% to 84.6% and lesion sensitivity at 0.25 false-positive marks per slice from 38.8% to 47.5%, with gains in all four predefined tumor-size groups. At thresholds frozen on healthy validation data, mean sensitivity rises from 20.2% to 44.1% (37.6% with stochastic anchoring). These findings show how expressive generative priors can reconstruct unresolved anatomy without healing away the abnormalities that the measurements support.

AI.tldr: 提出“选择性锚定”（selective anchoring）：对可靠测得的图像分量施加约束、阻止生成先验改写，仅让扩散/流模型重建未解析结构，从而在不“抹掉”病灶的前提下恢复解剖细节。
AI.motivation: 生成先验能从欠采样测量中恢复解剖结构，但其先验会抹除图像中本应被检测的病灶，即便测量数据中含有病灶证据。核心动机是在保留生成模型表达力的同时，保护测量支持的可信成分。
AI.method: 将测量不确定性显式建模：对受保护的可靠分量施加确定性或随机（集成扰动）锚定；实现为预训练扩散/流采样器的wrapper，以及快速的约束流模型AnchoredFM；在线性高斯测量模型下给出期望无偏与区间覆盖率名义值保持的理论分析。
AI.result: 在稀疏视角CT、加速脑MRI、光声断层成像上提升病灶对比度保持与不确定性可靠性，并降低病灶内重建误差；加速MRI肿瘤检测中确定性锚定使八种采样器平均AUROC由78.4%升至84.6%，0.25 FP/切片下病灶灵敏度由38.8%升至47.5%，冻结阈值下平均灵敏度由20.2%升至44.1%（随机锚定37.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 表达了“保留测量支持的异常”这一原则，证明强生成先验可在不消除病灶的情况下重建未解析解剖；方法为采样器wrapper，具有通用性与理论保证，但主要验证领域为医学成像。

title: Temporal Weight Surgery: Repairing Video Grounding with LLM Editors
comment: 35 pages, 18 figures, 23 tables, including supplementary material
summary: A surgeon first finds what is wrong, then fixes only that part. We use this idea for video grounding, where video-language models often find the right moment in a long video but write its time wrong. In Temporal Weight Surgery (TWS), a general-purpose LLM reads the model's weights and activations, finds where the error arises and repairs it there, without gradients. Separate sessions find the same cause, and this diagnosis of where and why the model fails is our main contribution. Three GPT-6 Astra sessions trace a dropped digit in TimeLens-8B to one MLP layer, and the largest edit gains 7.9 mIoU on 1,215 unseen questions and 18.3 on videos of 30 minutes or more. Two Claude Opus 5.5 sessions trace minutes written as seconds in Qwen3-VL-8B to the separator and gain 2.9 and 1.3. Before any edit, its answers often have the right minute and the wrong separator, and fixing only the separator lifts their mIoU from 13.1 to 19.2. Every improving edit beats a random edit of its size, and the edited models run as fast as before.

AI.tldr: Temporal Weight Surgery (TWS)：用通用LLM读取视频语言模型的权重与激活，无梯度地定位并修补导致时间标注错误的权重（如个别MLP层、分隔符token），实现时间定位（video grounding）精度提升。
AI.motivation: 视频语言模型常在长视频中找到正确时刻，但把时间写错（如丢数字、把分钟写成秒），需要解释“错误在哪里、为什么错”，并在此处直接修复，避免重新训练/微调。
AI.method: 让LLM（GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5）以agent方式检查模型权重与激活，诊断误差来源并做无梯度的局部权重编辑；多个独立会话复现同一诊断结论。案例：将TimeLens-8B丢数字归因于某一MLP层；将Qwen3-VL-8B的分钟/秒分隔符错误归因到分隔符token表示；并以同规模随机编辑作为对照。
AI.result: 最大编辑在1215个未见问题上提升7.9 mIoU，在≥30分钟视频上提升18.3 mIoU；Qwen3-VL-8B分隔符修复分别提升2.9与1.3；仅修分隔符即把mIoU从13.1提升到19.2；所有有效编辑均优于同规模随机编辑，推理速度不变。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出“先定位、再局部修补”的可解释权重干预范式，表明LLM可作为无梯度诊断/修复器用于视频时间定位；但属于视频理解模型的可解释性/编辑工具，未涉及具身、3D重建或世界模型。

title: LGCount: Layout-Guided Diffusion for Zero-Shot Object Counting
summary: Class-agnostic counting requires the user to specify what to count, usually with a class name or a few annotated boxes. We propose a richer text-based specification: a structured layout that names the target, the region that holds it, the distractors to ignore. A prompt upsampler writes this layout from the image and the requested category alone, and an image-editing diffusion model, adapted into a single-step counter, turns it into a density map. Because counting datasets pair each image with a single valid density map, a counter trained on it learns to ignore the layout. We therefore train on synthetic counterfactuals in which one image admits several valid density maps, so that the layout cannot be ignored. On FSC-147 we improve on the previous zero-shot state of the art and we set the best reported result on LOOKALIKES while being told the least about each image. A single photograph can be counted by category, by region, or by granularity without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出用结构化文本布局（目标类名+所在区域+需忽略的干扰物）作为类别无关计数的更丰富提示规范，由prompt upsampler从图像和类别生成布局，再用单步适配的图像编辑扩散模型输出密度图；由于真实数据集每图仅一个密度图会导致模型忽略布局，作者用"一图多有效密度图"的合成反事实数据训练，在FSC-147上超越零样本SOTA、在LOOKALIKES上取得最佳报告结果，并支持按类别/区域/粒度计数而无需重训。
AI.motivation: 现有类别无关计数只允许用户以类名或少量标注框指定计数目标，规范能力有限：无法显式指明目标所在区域、也无法显式排除外观相似的干扰物。这种贫乏的指定方式一方面限制了任务表达力（同一场景下用户可能想按区域或按粒度计数），另一方面使模型难以利用细粒度的用户意图。作者希望把"计数什么"的指定升级为更丰富的结构化文本布局，并让模型真正依赖该布局。
AI.method: 1) 提出结构化文本规范（structured layout）：同时命名目标类别、包含目标的区域、以及需要忽略的干扰物。2) 用prompt upsampler仅从图像与用户请求的类别自动生成该布局文本。3) 将图像编辑扩散模型适配为单步计数器，直接把布局+图像映射为密度图。4) 关键训练策略：常规数据集每张图只有一个有效密度图，模型会退化到忽略布局；因此构建合成反事实（counterfactual）样本——同一图像对应多个有效密度图（不同目标/区域/粒度），迫使模型必须读取布局才能正确输出。5) 单模型支持类别、区域、粒度三种计数模式，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在FSC-147上超过此前零样本最优结果；在LOOKALIKES上取得已报告的最佳结果，同时对每张图提供的先验信息最少。单一模型即可按类别、按区域、按粒度对同一张训练图像进行计数，且无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 将计数任务的目标指定从类名/标注框升级为结构化文本布局，可使零样本计数在表达力与精度上同时提升；通过合成反事实数据（一图多密度图）解决"布局可被忽略"的退化解问题，是该方法的要点。该思路对需按区域或粒度灵活计数、且需抑制外观干扰的实际应用有价值的参考。

title: Why Does Sensor Depth Fail Learned Manipulation Policies? Finding the Failure Mode with ACT
summary: Learned manipulation policies, from task-specific imitation policies to vision-language-action (VLA) models, rely primarily on RGB images. While some studies report gains from sensor depth, others avoid depth cameras because of measurement noise. Depth cameras introduce both noise and missing depth values (holes), whose relative effects remain unclear. In this study, we calibrate a sensor model using a real wrist-mounted stereo camera and separately evaluate noise and holes on RGB-D imitation policies with three visual encoders in simulation. We found that complete depth improves success by approximately ten percentage points, and most of this gain persists even at twenty times the camera's noise level. In contrast, holes covering about one-sixth of the wrist image eliminate the detectable benefit of depth. The validity mask strongly influences depth reliance: marking a small fraction of pixels as invalid reduces reliance, while filling holes and marking them valid restores most of the benefit. Policies trained on clean depth also lose performance when holes appear only at deployment, sometimes falling below RGB-only performance. These findings suggest that depth cameras for learned policies should therefore be judged by depth coverage more than measurement precision.

AI.tldr: 在仿真中用真实腕装双目相机标定的传感器模型，分别评估深度噪声与缺失（孔洞）对RGB-D模仿学习策略的影响：完整深度带来约10个百分点提升，噪声放大20倍仍保留大部分增益；而覆盖约1/6腕部图像的孔洞会完全消除深度收益，且有效性掩码的标注方式强烈影响策略对深度的依赖；部署时新出现的孔洞可使策略性能低于仅RGB基线。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作模型与模仿学习策略主要依赖RGB，深度相机的收益报道不一。现有工作常因测量噪声回避深度相机，但噪声与缺失深度值（holes）各自的影响未被区分，缺乏受控的、基于真实传感器标定的定量分析。
AI.method: 以真实腕装双目相机标定传感器模型，在仿真中对三种视觉编码器的RGB-D模仿学习策略做受控实验，分别操纵深度噪声水平与缺失像素比例，并对比有效性掩码的不同标注策略（小比例标为无效、填洞并标为有效），另做训练-部署分布偏移实验（干净深度训练、带洞部署）。
AI.result: 完整深度使成功率约提升10个百分点，噪声放大至相机噪声的20倍时大部分增益仍保持；孔洞覆盖约1/6腕部图像即消除可检测的深度收益；标注少量像素无效会降低深度依赖，而填洞并标为有效可恢复大部分收益；仅部署阶段出现孔洞时性能下降，有时低于仅RGB基线。
AI.conclusion: 对学习型策略而言，深度相机的价值主要取决于深度覆盖率而非测量精度；实践中应优先保证覆盖（填洞并合理标注有效掩码），并对训练-部署孔洞分布偏移显式建模。

title: DDxBasis: Explaining Frozen Foundation Encoder-based Medical Classification by Exact Differential Diagnosis
summary: In differential diagnosis (DDx), a clinician explains a diagnosis by the few findings that separate it from the alternatives. Medical image classifiers cannot yet explain themselves this way. Existing explanations are either faithful but spread over hundreds of concepts, or compact but leave part of each decision unexplained. We present DDxBasis, which explains a classifier on a frozen foundation encoder as a differential diagnosis in three steps. First, a concept bottleneck reads all patch tokens at every encoder layer using gated, second-order slot attention. A concept basis then regroups the concepts into two-pole axes, each a differential between groups of diagnoses. Finally, we read a differential diagnosis from each axis through the typical presentation of its poles, the pertinent findings of the case, and counterfactual edits of borderline cases. Across five medical datasets, DDxBasis is the most accurate frozen-encoder model and close to the best published domain-specific results. Because every concept adds its own evidence, its reproducible concept basis splits each decision exactly, at no cost in accuracy. Without ordered stage or concept labels, the axes recover cell lineages and rare subtypes, agree with dermatologists' structure annotations, and expose planted and real shortcuts.

AI.tldr: DDxBasis 将冻结基础编码器上的医学图像分类器解释为"鉴别诊断"：用门控二阶 slot attention 跨层读取 patch token 得到概念瓶颈，再以两极性概念基轴重组概念，并借助典型表现、相关征象与反事实编辑给出可精确分解决策的差异化解释。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分类器的解释方法存在两难：忠实但散布在数百个概念上难以阅读，紧凑却无法解释全部决策。临床鉴别诊断正是"用少数区分性征象排除替代诊断"的范式，因此希望让模型解释具备这种结构。
AI.method: 三步流程：(1) 概念瓶颈在所有编码层用门控（gated）二阶 slot attention 读取全部 patch token；(2) 概念基将概念重组为两极性轴，每轴为两组诊断之间的差异；(3) 通过两极的典型表现、本病例的相关征象以及对临界病例的反事实编辑，从每条轴读出鉴别诊断。
AI.result: 在五个医学数据集上，为最准确的冻结编码器模型，接近最佳领域专用结果；概念基可精确分解每个决策且不损失精度；在无有序阶段或概念标签的情况下，轴能恢复细胞谱系与罕见亚型，与皮肤科医生的结构标注一致，并揭示植入与真实的捷径特征。
AI.conclusion: 以鉴别诊断为组织原则的概念瓶颈可在保持精度的同时提供可分解、可复现的紧凑解释，具备临床可读性与捷径检测能力。

title: Searching Ultra-Long Videos with Decision Models
comment: Our code is available at this https URL
summary: Understanding ultra-long videos requires retrieving sparse, query-relevant evidence from extensive video histories. Existing similarity-based retrieval methods are efficient, but they encode the question and the video content independently and thus often miss evidence whose relevance requires reasoning over both. Generative large language models (LLMs) can perform such reasoning, but they typically generate text over multiple rounds of search, which makes each query slow and costly. In this work, we introduce DeLoVi (Decision Models for Long Video), a framework that leverages pretrained decision models to retrieve evidence from ultra-long videos. Like an LLM, a decision model reads the question together with the candidate evidence, so it can reason over both. Unlike an LLM, it directly outputs a relevance score without generating text, which makes it fast and inexpensive. We first present DeLoVi-S, a simple method that generates captions for short video clips and uses a decision model to rank those captions by their relevance to a question. A generative LLM then answers the question using the top-ranked captions. Despite its simplicity, DeLoVi-S achieves state-of-the-art performance on three ultra-long video understanding benchmarks, EgoLifeQA, EgoMemReason, and MM-Lifelong, and generalizes effectively to long-video understanding benchmarks, VideoMME-L and LVBench. However, DeLoVi-S scores every caption for every question, so its cost grows linearly with video length. To reduce this cost, we propose an automated policy evolution framework that iteratively refines the memory construction and retrieval policies around a fixed pretrained decision model. The resulting method, DeLoVi-E, maintains comparable performance while reducing input tokens by 34x on average compared with DeLoVi-S. It also runs over 3x faster than the best prior method on EgoLifeQA while achieving higher accuracy.

AI.tldr: DeLoVi 用预训练决策模型（而非生成式 LLM）对长视频片段与问题的相关性直接打分，实现快速、低成本检索；DeLoVi-S 简单有效刷新超长视频理解 SOTA，DeLoVi-E 通过自动化策略进化减少 34 倍输入 token 并提速 3 倍以上。
AI.motivation: 超长视频问答需要从海量历史中检索稀疏且与问题相关的证据。相似度检索编码独立、缺乏联合推理；生成式 LLM 多轮搜索虽能联合推理但速度慢、成本高。需要兼顾联合推理能力与推理效率的检索方案。
AI.method: 将视频切成短片并生成字幕，用预训练决策模型（decision model，无文本生成、直接输出相关性分数）对"问题+候选字幕"联合打分排序，再由生成式 LLM 基于 top 字幕作答（DeLoVi-S）。进一步提出自动化策略进化框架，在固定决策模型的前提下迭代优化记忆构建与检索策略，得到 DeLoVi-E。
AI.result: DeLoVi-S 在 EgoLifeQA、EgoMemReason、MM-Lifelong 三个超长视频基准上取得 SOTA，并有效泛化到 VideoMME-L、LVBench；DeLoVi-E 在性能相当的情况下平均减少 34 倍输入 token，在 EgoLifeQA 上比此前最优方法快 3 倍以上且准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: 以决策模型替代生成式推理做证据检索，是超长视频理解中兼顾"联合推理"与"低成本"的有效范式；配合策略自动化进化可大幅压缩检索预算。

title: Benchmarking Segmentation Models for Scalable Mangrove Mapping with Sentinel-1/2 Imagery
comment: Accepted at the Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning (TCCML) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026, Sydney, Australia
summary: Mangroves are dynamic coastal ecosystems that contribute to carbon storage, coastal protection and biodiversity conservation, but are vulnerable to climate change. Very-high-resolution imagery such as Pléiades enables detailed mangrove mapping but it is costly and have a low revisit rate. Large-scale monitoring requires free and regularly available data such as Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 but their spatial resolution poses challenges for detailed mangrove mapping. In this work, we benchmark deep learning approaches for mangrove mapping from Sentinel-1 radar and Sentinel-2 optical imagery using reference maps derived from very-high-resolution Pléiades imagery. We compare four segmentation configurations based on CROMA and BigEarthNet-pretrained ResNet50 representations with different segmentation decoders. We construct a mangrove mapping dataset covering French Guiana, Suriname, and Amapá. CROMA + UPerNet achieves the best performance, with an F1-score of 0.9218 and an IoU of 0.8549. These results highlight the potential of pretrained multimodal Earth observation representations and open Sentinel data to support mangrove resilience through scalable monitoring.

AI.tldr: 以Pléiades高分参考图为准，用CROMA、BigEarthNet预训练ResNet50搭配不同分割解码器，在Sentinel-1/2上基准测试红树林制图深度学习方案。
AI.motivation: 红树林生态价值高但易受气候变化影响；Pléiades等高分辨率影像精度高却成本高、重访率低，Sentinel-1/2免费且定期可得但空间分辨率不足，难以做精细红树林制图。
AI.method: 构建覆盖法属圭亚那、苏里南与阿马帕的红树林制图数据集，以Pléiades高分影像导出参考图；比较基于CROMA多模态表征与BigEarthNet预训练ResNet50表征的四种分割配置，并搭配不同分割解码器。
AI.result: CROMA + UPerNet组合最优，F1-score 0.9218，IoU 0.8549；预训练多模态对地观测表征结合开放Sentinel数据可支持可扩展的红树林监测。
AI.conclusion: 预训练多模态EO表征可显著提升中分辨率Sentinel数据上的精细地物制图能力，为红树林韧性监测提供可扩展路径。

title: MotifFlow: Training-Free, Self-Contained Style Transfer from Color to Motif in Rectified Flow Transformers
summary: Expressive style transfer must reproduce a painting's palette, brushwork, and characteristic motifs while retaining the content image's structure. Attention injection is effective in U-Net-based diffusion models, but adapting it to FLUX often transfers color without capturing the style's distinctive brushwork. Our analysis across backbones links this gap to how injected features are integrated across neighboring spatial locations. We introduce MotifFlow, a training-free, self-contained framework that combines style injection with style-alignment guidance in FLUX. Injection supplies style features during generation but does not explicitly encourage the model's native attention output to align with them. We therefore use the discrepancy between native and injected attention outputs to guide latent-space updates, encouraging the evolving image to develop the style's distinctive brushwork and motifs. Style encoding, guidance, and synthesis all use the same frozen backbone, without auxiliary image encoders or trained adapters. A single strength parameter controls the transition from color transfer to pronounced brushwork and motifs, with additional support for regional stylization and style mixing. Experiments on 1,000 content-style pairs show that MotifFlow better matches the local textures of the style image than baseline methods and produces more consistent stylization than injection alone. The same design extends to FLUX.2.

AI.tldr: MotifFlow：面向 FLUX 的无训练风格迁移框架，用「原生注意力输出与注入注意力输出之差」作为潜空间更新方向，从而在保持内容结构的同时复现风格图像的笔触与母题。
AI.motivation: 注意力注入在 U-Net 扩散模型中有效，但迁移到 FLUX 后往往只迁移了色彩而丢失风格特有的笔触与母题。作者分析认为问题源于注入特征在相邻空间位置上的整合方式，且纯注入并不显式约束模型原生注意力输出与注入特征对齐。
AI.method: 训练无关、自包含框架：冻结 FLUX 主干同时承担风格编码、引导与合成，不引入额外图像编码器或已训练适配器。1）风格注入在生成过程中提供风格特征；2）以原生注意力输出与注入注意力输出之间的差异作为引导信号，更新潜变量，推动图像发展出风格的笔触与母题。单一强度参数控制从色彩迁移到强笔触/母题的过渡，并支持区域化风格化与风格混合；同一设计可扩展到 FLUX.2。
AI.result: 在 1000 组内容-风格图像对上的实验表明，相较基线方法，MotifFlow 与风格图像局部纹理更匹配，风格化一致性优于单独注入。
AI.conclusion: 将注意力注入与风格对齐引导结合，可使 FLUX 类 DiT 扩散模型实现兼具色彩与笔触/母题的表达性风格迁移，且无需训练，方法可迁移到新版本主干。

title: VersionGS: Compact and Motion-Robust Dynamic Gaussian Splatting via Versioned Gaussians
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Recent dynamic Gaussian splatting methods encode temporal change, either as smooth functions of time or as constrained updates between frames. We observe that their reconstruction quality degrades significantly under fast motion. In challenging dance sequences, their PSNR drops by 1.1-4.0 dB on high-motion frames compared to low-motion frames. To overcome this limitation, we propose VersionGS, a method that directly encodes per-frame Gaussian states and uses motion estimation only to guide reconstruction. Within each group of frames, unchanged Gaussians keep their current versions in a shared dictionary, while modified Gaussians are appended as new versions. To maximize version reuse, we introduce selective sequential construction, which refines the Gaussians selected by optical flow, photograph differences or rendering errors and leaves the others unchanged. The dictionary is then pruned, fine-tuned with simulated quantization and encoded as images. Adjusting the pruning ratio trades off storage and quality without rebuilding the dictionary. On the fast dance sequences of DanceNet3D, VersionGS improves foreground PSNR by 2.7 dB over the best baseline, and its PSNR decreases by less than 0.3 dB on the highest-motion frames. On N3DV and Technicolor, it requires 6.0x and 5.7x less storage than TAD-GS, the strongest baseline overall, while achieving even higher PSNR. Finally, playback is fast and requires no motion model or neural network, only a 3DGS rasterizer.

AI.tldr: VersionGS: 用逐帧高斯状态字典+版本化复用替代时变函数/帧间约束建模，缓解快速运动下动态3DGS重建退化
AI.motivation: 现有动态高斯方法把时间变化编码为平滑时间函数或帧间约束更新，在快速运动（如舞蹈序列）下重建质量显著下降，高运动帧PSNR比低运动帧低1.1-4.0 dB。
AI.method: 直接编码每帧高斯状态，运动估计仅用于引导重建。帧组内未变化的高斯以当前版本保留于共享字典，被修改的高斯追加为新版本；提出选择性顺序构造，仅对光流、光度差或渲染误差选出的高斯进行细化；随后剪枝、带模拟量化微调并编码为图像存储；调整剪枝率可在不重建字典的前提下权衡存储与质量。
AI.result: DanceNet3D快速舞蹈序列上前景PSNR比最佳基线高2.7 dB，最高运动帧PSNR下降小于0.3 dB；N3DV与Technicolor上存储分别为TAD-GS的1/6.0和1/5.7，且PSNR更高；播放快，仅需3DGS光栅化器，无运动模型或神经网络。
AI.conclusion: 以版本化字典直接存储逐帧高斯状态、以运动线索做稀疏选择性更新，可兼顾高速动态重建质量与存储/实时回放效率。

title: DreamTour: Layout Steering for Training-Free World Exploration
summary: Video diffusion and world models generate plausible videos but do not reliably match the requested camera direction and travel distance. We present DreamTour, a training-free framework that generates camera tours from a single image with more accurate control over camera motion. DreamTour first uses a frozen image inpainting prior to extend the photograph beyond its original field of view while preserving the input pixels. Depth-based rendering of this extended scene along the requested camera path produces approximate target views that serve as spatial guidance. We introduce Layout Steering, which aligns early video latents with these views through decaying low-frequency corrections, leaving later denoising to refine appearance and dynamics. For longer tours, we autoregressively generate the video segments, repeating guidance construction from each segment's final frame to maintain camera control across the full trajectory. DreamTour improves directional accuracy and travel calibration on VBench while maintaining competitive video quality. On WorldScore, it strengthens camera control and scene consistency across chained movements. Together, these results demonstrate that training-free spatial guidance enables more accurate and consistent camera control in pretrained video diffusion and world models.

AI.tldr: DreamTour：免训练框架，用冻结的图像inpainting先验将单张图像外扩（保留原像素），再沿指定相机轨迹做深度渲染得到近似目标视图，通过"Layout Steering"以衰减的低频校正对齐早期视频隐变量，实现更准确的相机合成控制；长轨迹用自回归分段并逐段重建引导。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散与世界模型能生成合理视频，但难以可靠匹配用户指定的相机朝向与平移距离，相机运动可控性不足。
AI.method: (1) 冻结的图像inpainting先验做视野外扩（outpainting），保持输入像素不变；(2) 对扩展场景按请求相机路径做基于深度的渲染，得到近似目标视图作为空间引导；(3) Layout Steering：用递减的低频校正把早期视频隐变量与这些视图对齐，后续去噪步骤负责细化外观与动态；(4) 长时巡检采用自回归分段生成，每段以末帧重新构造引导以维持全程相机控制。
AI.result: 在VBench上提升方向精度与行进距离标定，同时保持有竞争力的视频质量；在WorldScore上链式运动下相机控制与场景一致性增强。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的空间引导可让预训练视频扩散/世界模型获得更准确、更一致的相机控制，且无需微调。

title: FOCI: Trajectory Optimization on Gaussian Splats for Gaussian Robots
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently gained popularity as a faster alternative to Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) in 3D reconstruction and view synthesis methods. Leveraging the spatial information encoded in 3DGS, this work proposes FOCI (Field Overlap Collision Integral), an algorithm that is able to optimize trajectories directly on the Gaussians themselves. FOCI leverages a novel and interpretable collision formulation for 3DGS using the notion of the overlap integral between Gaussians. The formulation presented applies to different robot morphologies (e.g., fixed and mobile base manipulators, legged robots, UAVs) and handles both static and dynamic Gaussian-Splat environments. Contrary to other approaches, which represent the robot with conservative bounding boxes that underestimate the traversability of the environment, we propose to represent the environment and the robot as Gaussian Splats. This not only has desirable computational properties, but also allows for orientation-aware planning, allowing the robot to pass through very tight and narrow spaces. We extensively test our algorithm in both synthetic and real Gaussian Splats, showcasing that collision-free trajectories for legged, aerial and manipulator robots can be computed in seconds, even with hundreds of thousands of Gaussians making up the environment. The code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: FOCI 提出一种可直接在 3D 高斯上优化机器人轨迹的算法，通过高斯之间的重叠积分构造可解释的碰撞代价，实现取向感知的紧致无碰撞规划。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 NeRF/3DGS 的规划方法多用保守包围盒表示机器人，低估环境可通行性，难以穿越狭窄空间；且需要一种统一、计算高效、可微的碰撞表述以支持直接在 Gaussian 场中做轨迹优化。
AI.method: 将机器人与环境统一表示为 Gaussian Splats；以两高斯间重叠积分（Field Overlap Collision Integral）定义碰撞度量，该度量可微、取向感知；在静态与动态高斯环境中对固定/移动基座机械臂、足式机器人、无人机等不同形态直接对轨迹进行梯度优化。
AI.result: 在合成与真实高斯场景中验证，即使环境含数十万个高斯，仍能在数秒内为足式、空中与机械臂机器人规划出无碰撞轨迹，并可穿越十分狭窄的空间；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 用高斯重叠积分替代包围盒碰撞检测，可在 3DGS 表示上实现快速、取向感知且形态通用的轨迹优化，为高斯场景中的机器人规划提供了可解释且高效的方案。

title: ArtTet: Watertight Part Meshes of Articulated Objects from Rigid-Body Rules and Partitioned Marching Tetrahedra
summary: We present ArtTet, a method that reconstructs an articulated object from multi-view observations of two articulation states and outputs one watertight mesh per rigid part together with the joints that move them. Mesh splatting gives explicit triangles, but it treats the object as one scene. It extracts a single global surface and cannot keep the triangles of different parts apart; the mesh it exports is layered, self-intersecting, and full of holes. ArtTet follows a divide-and-conquer strategy instead. We first divide the object into rigid parts with dynamic- and geometric-constrained articulation and ownership inference. A multibody registration of the two states recovers the parts and their screw joints. Rigid-body rules on attachment, contact, and swept motion then correct joint types and part labels without any part annotation. We then divide space into part cells with an articulated tetrahedral partition, and conquer each cell with its own differentiable signed distance field on a shared tetrahedral grid. In these partitioned marching tetrahedra the fields are mutually exclusive by construction, so the extracted part meshes are closed and never overlap. All part meshes are optimized jointly from the images of both states through the recovered joints. On Articulate-100, ArtTet gives the most accurate axis directions, part motions, and part geometry over all objects among methods that use no part masks, and its part meshes have virtually no open boundary edges. We also show reconstructions of real captures from the SplArt dataset.

AI.tldr: ArtTet 用"分而治之"策略从两个铰接状态的多视角图像重建铰接物体的闭合分部件网格：先做动态/几何约束的刚性部件划分与螺旋关节估计（无需部件标注），再用铰接四面体分割空间，各部件在共享四面体网格上训练互斥的SDF，通过分区 marching tetrahedra 得到闭合且不重叠的部件网格，并联合优化。
AI.motivation: Mesh splatting 虽能给出显式三角网格，但把物体当作单一场景，只提取一个全局表面，无法区分不同刚性部件，导出的网格出现层叠、自交和大量孔洞。铰接物体重建需要每个部件各自闭合、彼此不重叠的网格以及正确的关节。
AI.method: 1) 划分阶段：基于动态与几何约束的铰接关系推断 + 所有权(ownership)推断，对两个状态做多体配准恢复部件及螺旋(screw)关节；再用连接、接触与扫掠运动的刚体规则纠正关节类型与部件标签，无需任何部件掩码。2) 征服阶段：用铰接四面体划分将空间切成部件单元(part cells)，每个单元在共享四面体网格上拥有自己的可微SDF；在分区 marching tetrahedra 中这些场按构造互斥，故提取出的部件网格闭合且不重叠。3) 通过恢复的关节在两状态图像上联合优化所有部件网格。
AI.result: 在 Articulate-100 上，在无部件掩码的方法中取得最优的关节轴方向、部件运动与部件几何精度；部件网格几乎没有开放边界边。另在 SplArt 数据集上展示了真实拍摄的重建结果。
AI.conclusion: 将"部件级空间分区"引入隐式表面重建，用互斥SDF与分区 marching tetrahedra 从构造上保证多部件网格的水密性与无重叠，是一种可推广到铰接物体数字化与下游机器人交互的实用范式。

title: Synchronizing Cameras via 3D Object Relationships
summary: In this paper, we synchronize multiple videos of the same dynamic event through object relationships. Driven by dynamic reconstruction and novel view synthesis, many recent synchronization methods rely on pixel-level evidence, such as point correspondences across views or the photometric losses of a reconstructed scene. In dynamic scenes, however, fast motion and occlusions make the moving regions that carry much of the timing information hard to match across views. We thus propose to bring back the traditional wisdom that objects are reliable cues for global reasoning about cameras. Measured in 3D, the relationships between objects, such as the distance between two people, are stable across all views up to scale; they can serve as cues for alignment. To compare these relationships across cameras, we only need the identity of each object in every view, as the cues are relational. We obtain these identities by giving a vision-language model a few frames of every camera and prompting it to identify the objects in the scene. We then segment and track each identified object through every video with an open-vocabulary segmentor. To obtain the 3D locations of objects, we use a pretrained depth estimator. Where depth or segmentation fails, we complement these 3D cues with 2D motion from point tracks. Finally, we synchronize the cameras by finding the temporal offsets at which the cues of different cameras agree best, first for each camera pair and then for all cameras jointly with robust optimization. We evaluate our method on four standard benchmarks, outperforming the state of the art.

AI.tldr: 提出用物体间关系的3D度量作为跨视角稳定线索，结合VLM识别身份、开放词表分割跟踪与深度估计，实现多视频动态事件的时间同步。
AI.motivation: 现有基于像素级证据（点对应、光度损失）的同步方法在动态场景中受快速运动和遮挡影响，携带时序信息的运动区域难以跨视角匹配；作者回归"物体是全局相机推理可靠线索"的传统思路。
AI.method: 1) 用VLM看每个相机的少量帧识别场景物体身份；2) 开放词表分割器分段并跟踪每个物体；3) 预训练深度估计器得到物体3D位置；4) 在深度/分割失效处用点跟踪的2D运动作补充；5) 以成对相机找到使关系线索最一致的时间偏移，再用鲁棒优化联合求解全部相机。
AI.result: 在四个标准基准上超越当前最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 物体关系（如两人间距，3D下跨视角仅差尺度）可作为稳定、可关系化比对的同步线索，配合2D运动补强，可鲁棒地完成多相机动态事件同步。

title: Measuring and Predicting Image-Token Repair Boundaries in Vision-Language Models
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 17 tables; supplementary material included
summary: Degraded images make vision-language models answer wrongly. Using synthetic paired blur, noise, and low light, we trace which clean image states can still repair those answers from the vision encoder through the language model. In four encoder models, 12 to 23 ranked tokens recover half of the full-patch effect, whereas random orders require four to fifteen times as many; encoder-free Gemma needs 22.2 versus 53.1. Full-block repair expires at a model-specific language-model crossing. The matched reverse-direction intervention is algebraically identical to text-token restoration, so its gap from image restoration measures a redundancy band rather than an independent predictor. A clean-image gray-ablation crossing independently predicts held-out repair with 1.53-layer error, against 3.65 for shared depth. Gemma MMBench has the only large attention-to-repair point gap; Gemma GQA does not. Restormer provides a non-oracle consistency check on two models.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究退化图像（模糊、噪声、低光）导致视觉语言模型答错时，能否借助干净图像状态经由视觉编码器到语言模型的路径修复答案，并量化修复的稀疏性、深度交叉点与冗余带。
AI.motivation: 退化图像会使视觉语言模型（VLM）给出错误回答，但尚不清楚模型内部哪些干净图像状态、在哪些层深度上能够"修复"这些错误答案，即修复的可行边界与机制未被刻画。
AI.method: 构造成对的合成退化数据（模糊、噪声、低光）与干净图像；沿视觉编码器→语言模型的通路做逐层/逐token的干净状态替换干预（patch/block 级修复），进行排序采样与随机顺序对照；比较全块修复的失效层（LM crossing）；将反向方向干预与文本token恢复进行代数等价性分析以界定冗余带；用干净图像 gray-ablation crossing 作为预测量做留出集验证；并比较注意力与修复之间的对应关系（Gemma MMBench vs GQA），同时用 Restormer 做非oracle一致性检验。
AI.result: 四个编码器模型中，仅12–23个排序token即可恢复全patch效应的一半，而随机顺序需4–15倍数量；无编码器的Gemma为22.2对53.1。全块修复在模型特定的语言模型层交叉点失效。反向干预与文本token恢复代数等价，其与图像修复的差距反映的是冗余带而非独立预测量。gray-ablation crossing 独立预测留出集修复，误差1.53层，优于共享深度的3.65层。Gemma MMBench 存在唯一的大注意力-修复点差距，GQA 则无。Restormer 在两个模型上提供非oracle一致性检验。
AI.conclusion: VLM对退化图像的答案修复高度稀疏且受层深度约束，可由干净的内部状态预测，且"文本式恢复"与"视觉状态恢复"之间存在结构性冗余带。

title: RoboARC: Physical Puzzles for Robotic Manipulation under Spatial Constraints
summary: Many hard manipulation tasks come down to a spatial constraint that only a few motions satisfy, such as passing a part through a gap barely wider than itself or separating two interlocked parts. These motions depend on the exact geometry of each scene, so demonstrations and skills recorded elsewhere rarely transfer. We therefore ask: when manipulation hinges on spatial constraints, can robots reason out the right motions? We introduce RoboARC, a benchmark of 90 tasks in six constraint types over rigid and soft materials, on three robots in MuJoCo. Every task is a frozen scene with a physics-based grader and a verified reference solution that replays bit-identically. Each task comes in a Privileged regime, with the full simulator state and resets, and a Standard regime with real-sensor inputs (camera images and proprioception) and a single attempt without resets. We evaluate seven coding agents and four VLA policies, none trained on these tasks. The strongest agent, GPT-6 Astra in Codex, solves 86% of the tasks in the Privileged regime and 43% in the Standard regime, and the four VLA policies, run zero-shot, solve none of their 18 one-arm puzzles. On 15 puzzles that GPT-6 Astra solved in the Privileged regime and failed in the Standard regime, object poses add 4 points and part geometry 13, but both together add 36, from 24% to 60%. Only 7% of the coding agents' failed runs pass more than half of a task, and 53% of the failed runs in the Standard regime are stuck on a single step. Frontier coding agents already reason out the right motions for many of these tasks once they know where the parts are and what shape they have. From their own sensors, in a single attempt, the strongest solves fewer than half of the tasks. The website can be found at this https URL

AI.tldr: RoboARC：90个空间约束操作任务（6类约束、刚/软材料、3种机器人、MuJoCo）的基准，含特权/标准两种设置；编码智能体最强86%（特权）/43%（标准），4个VLA零样本全部失败。
AI.motivation: 许多难题归结为"只有少数运动能满足的空间约束"（穿过略宽于自身的缝隙、分离互锁零件），依赖精确几何，异地示范/技能难以迁移。作者追问：当操作取决于空间约束时，机器人能否"推理出"正确运动？现有基准缺乏对这类几何约束的可复现、可分级评测。
AI.method: 构建RoboARC基准：90任务×6类约束，覆盖刚性与软体材料，3种机器人（含单臂拼图），MuJoCo物理仿真。每任务为冻结场景+基于物理的评分器+可比特级重放的参考解。两种regime：(1) Privileged，给全仿真状态与重置；(2) Standard，仅真实传感输入（相机图像+本体感知），单次尝试、无重置。评测7个编码智能体与4个VLA策略（均零样本）。另做消融：在15个特化解成/标准失败的任务上，分别注入物体位姿、零件几何及二者联合。并统计失败模式（通过半数步骤的比例、卡单步比例）。
AI.result: 最强智能体GPT-6 Astra（Codex）特权解86%、标准解43%；四个VLA零样本在其18个单臂拼图上全败。消融：仅物体位姿+4点、仅零件几何+13点、二者联合+36点（24%→60%）。失败运行中仅7%通过超过一半步骤；标准regime失败运行中53%卡在单一步骤。
AI.conclusion: 前沿编码智能体在已知零件位置与形状时已能推理出许多空间约束任务的正解；但仅凭自身传感、单次尝试时最强者也解不到一半。瓶颈在感知（位姿+几何的联合估计）而非规划推理本身，为该类任务指明了具身感知方向。

title: BreathSplat: Grounding One Smooth Motion in the Breathing Phase for 4D Cone-Beam CT
summary: Four-dimensional cone-beam computed tomography (4D-CBCT) images the anatomy of a breathing patient, but sees each breathing phase from only a few angles. Breathing, however, is a smooth motion that repeats; it has a phase. Existing methods exploit this either by reconstructing the anatomy as a function of the breathing phase, often through bins, or by estimating smooth dynamic motions in time. Yet none of these grounds one smooth motion in the phase. We thus propose to share projections across breathing phases with splines. Specifically, we represent the 4D volume with dynamic Gaussians whose motion uses B-splines in space and time. We ground the motion state in the respiratory phase, which we read from well-studied conventional surrogates. Projections at the same phase in different breathing cycles then constrain the same anatomy and motion. On simulated lung scans, our method, BreathSplat, outperforms recent dynamic methods in reconstruction and motion accuracy, including those given the ground-truth phase. We further show qualitatively, on two real patient scans, that our method provides clearer reconstructions than the state of the art.

AI.tldr: BreathSplat 用带 B 样条时空运动约束的动态高斯表示 4D-CBCT 体数据，并把运动状态锚定在由常规呼吸替代信号读出的呼吸相位上，使不同呼吸周期的同相位投影共享同一解剖与运动约束。
AI.motivation: 4D-CBCT 每个呼吸相位仅由少数角度观测，但呼吸是平滑且周期性重复的运动并具相位属性。既有方法或是按相位分箱重建相位的解剖，或估计时间上的平滑动态运动，均未把单一平滑运动锚定到呼吸相位上，因此浪费了跨呼吸周期的同相位投影约束。
AI.method: 以动态高斯表达 4D 体积；每个高斯的时空轨迹由 B 样条（空间与时间）参数化；运动状态以从成熟常规替代信号（surrogate）中读取的呼吸相位为条件；从而把不同呼吸周期中同一相位的投影绑定到同一解剖与运动状态，实现跨相位投影共享与联合优化。
AI.result: 在模拟肺部扫描上，重建精度与运动精度均优于近期动态方法，包括被提供真实相位的对比方法；在两例真实病人扫描上的定性结果显示重建清晰度优于当前最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 将平滑运动显式锚定于呼吸相位，可有效利用跨周期的同相位投影冗余，动态高斯+B 样条时空参数化是 4D-CBCT 重建的有效框架；但验证限于医学影像场景，需更大量真实数据与定量评估。

title: Best-of-$N$ Test-Time Steering Can Lead to Reward Hacking in Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, to be presented at 1st Workshop on Physical World AI at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but adapting to changing environmental conditions still remains challenging. Recent test-time steering methods have shown promise in enabling adaptive VLA policies by utilizing additional computation during deployment. In this paper, we consider best-of-$N$ test-time steering for VLA models, where multiple action candidates are sampled from a fixed policy and a verifier is used to select the best one during deployment. We show that increasing $N$ does not always improve performance when the verifier is inaccurate, and can favor candidates whose scores exploit prediction errors, a form of reward hacking. We study this effect on 60 LIBERO-Safety task-level cases using a $\pi_{0.5}$ policy, with ten repetitions per case. We introduce controlled errors in a MuJoCo trajectory verifier and show that as $N$ increases, selected candidate rewards diverge from the accurate verifier rewards, leading to reward hacking. We also show that verifier calibration and softmax-based candidate selection can mitigate reward hacking in some settings.

AI.tldr: 该文研究VLA模型的best-of-N测试时引导，指出验证器不准确时增大N不总提升性能，反而引发"奖励黑客"；在60个LIBERO-Safety任务级案例（π0.5策略，每例10次重复）上，通过在MuJoCo轨迹验证器中注入受控误差，证明N增大时被选候选的奖励分数与真实验证器奖励逐渐偏离；提出验证器校准与softmax候选选择可在部分设置下缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在通用机器人操作上有前景，但环境变化下的自适应仍是难题；测试时引导（test-time steering）通过增加部署计算量提升适应性，但best-of-N选择依赖验证器准确性，其对性能的影响机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 从固定策略采样N个动作候选，用验证器打分择优；构建MuJoCo轨迹验证器并注入三种受控误差（类型/幅度），在60个LIBERO-Safety任务级案例、π0.5策略、每例10次重复下系统扫描N；对比候选奖励与精确验证器奖励的偏离程度量化奖励黑客；评估验证器校准和softmax候选选择两类缓解手段。
AI.result: 随N增大，所选候选的验证器得分与精确奖励之间的差距扩大，出现明显的奖励黑客现象；验证器校准与softmax式候选选择在一定误差设定下能降低奖励黑客，但并非普遍有效。
AI.conclusion: best-of-N测试时引导的收益受验证器精度强烈制约，N的规模扩展并非单调有效；需将验证器校准、候选选择的温度/采样分布与验证器误差特性协同设计。

title: Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge to Guide Continual Learning
