comment: Published at fifth conference on lifelong learning agents
summary: The goal of continual learning (CL) is to adapt to new data (plasticity) while retaining the knowledge acquired from old data (stability). Existing methods are explicitly designed to focus on balancing stability and plasticity to mitigate the challenge of catastrophic forgetting while promoting learning. However, the impact of order and nature of samples from the new data that the network is trained on remains an under explored factor. We argue that a CL algorithm should have the ability to rank incoming samples in terms of their relationship with prior data and their effect on the learning process. In this work, we investigate if scoring and prioritizing incoming data based on their semantic relationships with the model's current knowledge can benefit CL. We propose SACK, short for Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge, a plug and play technique for continual learning methods. SACK dissects categorical knowledge of the model into fine-grained concepts, computes the relationships between previously learned concepts and new concepts in each experience, and uses this relationship knowledge for prioritizing new samples. Experiments across several types of CL methods (regularization, replay, and prompt based) in class incremental and task incremental settings demonstrate that integration of SACK not only improves accuracy and reduces forgetting but also handles long tail distribution, helps focus on semantically interpretable regions, and yields better calibrated and robust models compared to prior approaches.

AI.tldr: SACK：一种即插即用的持续学习技术，将类别知识分解为细粒度概念，计算新旧概念的语义关系，并据此对新样本排序/优先级排序后再训练。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要关注稳定性-可塑性平衡以缓解灾难性遗忘，但忽略了新数据样本的顺序与性质对训练的影响；作者认为CL算法应能依据样本与先验知识的关系及其对学习过程的影响来排序样本。
AI.method: SACK（Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge）：把模型的类别知识拆解为细粒度概念，在每个experience中计算已学概念与新概念之间的关系，并将该关系知识用于新样本的优先级排序；作为plug-and-play模块可接入正则化、回放、prompt-based等CL方法。
AI.result: 在class-incremental与task-incremental设置下，与多类CL方法（正则化、replay、prompt-based）结合后，提升准确率、降低遗忘，并能处理长尾分布、聚焦语义可解释区域，得到更好校准且更鲁棒的模型。
AI.conclusion: 数据排序与语义关系驱动的样本优先级是持续学习中一个有效且被低估的维度，SACK以轻量插件形式带来了跨方法、跨设置的稳健增益。

title: ArtKit: Motion-Driven Re-Segmentation and Link Re-Generation for Articulated Objects from RGB-D Video
summary: An RGB-D camera that films an object being moved, often from one viewpoint, sees one side of it and how its parts move. We present ArtKit, which takes such a video as input to create an articulated model with complete parts, a kinematic tree, and typed joints. Our central idea is generating the hidden geometry and verifying it against what the camera sees. A generative part prior proposes complete, part-decomposed geometry based on the first frame. Point tracks, grouped into rigid trajectories, split and merge the generated parts into links. We then fit revolute and prismatic joints, with a visibility-aware energy ensuring that the articulated model explains the depth observed across the video. A rule checks against the video to choose between synchronous group fits and per-frame chain fits, so that one pipeline serves a diverse range of articulated objects, such as household items and robotic hands. Finally, we regenerate each link of the chosen fit as one part and keep it wherever it agrees better with the observations. We evaluate on Articulate-100 and on HArt, a new benchmark of 60 PartNet-Mobility objects and 8 robotic hands and grippers rendered as RGB-D videos with ground-truth parts and joints. ArtKit reduces the axis and part motion errors of the strongest baseline by more than half on the objects, as well as the axis error on the hands. ArtKit also runs on real recordings and generated videos.

AI.tldr: ArtKit从单视角RGB-D视频重建带完整部件、运动学树和关节类型的铰接物体模型：用生成式部件先验补全被遮挡几何，用刚体轨迹聚类划分连杆，拟合旋转/平移关节并以可见性感知能量对齐观测深度。
AI.motivation: 单视角拍摄的物体运动视频只能看到一侧及其部件运动，无法直接获得被遮挡几何、部件分割与关节结构，而现有铰接物体重建方法通常依赖多视角或强假设，难以覆盖家用物体与机械手等多样对象。
AI.method: 首帧输入生成式部件先验，得到完整、部件分解的几何；将点轨迹分组为刚体轨迹，用于分裂/合并生成部件成为连杆；拟合转动副与移动副关节，用可见性感知能量保证模型解释全视频观测深度；用规则在"同步组拟合"与"逐帧链拟合"间选择；最后把选中拟合的每个连杆重生成并保留与观测更一致的版本。
AI.result: 在Articulate-100及新基准HArt（60个PartNet-Mobility物体+8个机械手/夹爪的RGB-D视频，含真值部件与关节）上，物体场景的关节轴误差与部件运动误差较最强基线降低一半以上，机械手场景轴误差亦下降；并可在真实录制与生成视频上运行。
AI.conclusion: "生成隐藏几何并用视频观测验证"是可行范式：点轨迹+可见性感知关节拟合能把生成先验转化为结构正确的铰接模型，单一流水线可覆盖工具类物体与机械手，具备向真实操作场景迁移的潜力。

title: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Pursuit Game for Locomotor Agility Pretraining
summary: Agile humanoid locomotion requires controllers that can adapt to rapidly changing motion demands while remaining stable and robust. Recent locomotion controllers are typically designed with either a dense reward that is carefully shaped to encourage steps and penalize falling, or by using a reference tracking reward which teaches the controller to follow predetermined motions. Once a behavior that maximizes the reward is discovered, the controller ceases to learn. While generally stable, reference tracking methods focus on motor control separately from motion generation. Self-play has been proven as an effective technique for superhuman performance on several multiagent games like Go, Starcraft, hide-and-seek, and capture-the-flag. We train neural networks to play the game of multiagent tag in a physics simulator to study if new motion generation and control strategies can emerge through sparse feedback and competitive self-play. We present MJTag, a task suite for role-conditioned locomotion during competitive pursuit-evasion. Our model is a role-conditioned policy for a low-level locomotion controller and optional planar velocity commands. MJTag's league-based play with sparse feedback enables a locomotion controller to adopt new strategies, including dodging, sprinting, and tackling.

AI.tldr: 提出 MJTag：基于物理仿真器的多智能体追逐-逃跑（tag）自博弈任务族，训练角色条件（追/逃）的低层运动控制器，稀疏奖励下涌现出闪避、冲刺、擒抱等策略。
AI.motivation: 现有运动控制器要么依赖精心设计的稠密奖励（易早熟、奖励最大化后即停止学习），要么依赖参考动作跟踪（控制与运动生成解耦、只会复现预定动作）。作者希望借助自博弈+稀疏反馈，让运动生成与控制策略在角色条件化下共同涌现，以适应快速变化的运动需求。
AI.method: 构建 MJTag 任务套件：物理仿真中的人形多智能体 tag 游戏。策略为角色条件（pursuer/evader）的低层运动控制网络，可接收可选平面速度指令。采用联盟式（league-based）自博弈训练，奖励为稀疏的胜负反馈而非稠密塑形或参考跟踪。
AI.result: 稀疏反馈下的联赛自博弈使控制器自主习得新策略行为，包括闪避（dodging）、冲刺（sprinting）与擒抱/冲撞（tackling）；控制器在竞争中持续被对手驱动更新，不再在单点最优后停滞。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明自博弈+稀疏奖励是生成运动与控制的可行范式，可将运动生成与低层控制统一在单一角色条件策略中；但摘要未给出定量指标，实物验证与真实人形部署仍缺失。

title: A Semantics-First Approach to Multimodal Video Captioning with Frozen Encoders and Stabilized Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Preprint correcting minor typographical errors and clarifying baseline evaluation conditions from the SPIE Defense + Security 2026 proceedings
summary: We propose the Audio-Visual Query Transformer (AVQFormer), a highly efficient architecture built upon a 2.7B parameter LLM featuring a fixed-length $K=16$ semantic alignment module, stabilized via Adaptive Self-Critical Sequence Training (ASCST) with Entropy Regularization. Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) often rely on global audio representations to compensate for inefficient, frame-based visual encoders. While our Phase 1 prompted evaluations demonstrate that the Multimodal Base Model achieves strong deep semantic alignment (scoring 0.889 on BERTScore F1), optimizing this architecture for legacy metrics reveals a performance gap. We explore this gap as a hypothesis we term temporal alignment friction: a conflict where global audio representations disrupt the chronological sequence of visual frames, leading to penalties under visually-focused evaluation metrics. Consequently, by stripping away the audio, our Video-Only ablation conforms more closely to this rigid syntax, achieving 63.0 CIDEr. While trailing larger models such as Qwen2.5-VL (67.4 CIDEr), this establishes a strong baseline for sub-3B parameter LLM-based models. This indicates that CIDEr, as applied to datasets such as MSR-VTT, may exhibit a bias toward visually grounded syntax, limiting its ability to fully capture multimodal semantic richness.

AI.tldr: AVQFormer：在2.7B LLM上构建固定长度K=16的语义对齐模块，用ASCST+熵正则稳定训练；作者指出全局音频表示扰乱视觉帧时序（temporal alignment friction），去除音频后的Video-Only变体在MSR-VTT达63.0 CIDEr，暗示CIDEr对视觉化句法有偏差。
AI.motivation: 多模态LLM常用全局音频表示弥补帧级视觉编码器的低效，但面向传统视频字幕指标优化时出现性能落差；作者希望解释并量化该落差的来源。
AI.method: 2.7B参数LLM骨干 + 固定长度K=16的语义对齐模块；采用带熵正则的自适应自批判序列训练（ASCST）稳定优化；通过Phase 1提示评测与Video-Only消融对比音频全局表示的影响。
AI.result: 多模态基模型BERTScore F1=0.889，体现深层语义对齐良好；但去掉音频的Video-Only消融在MSR-VTT上达63.0 CIDEr，高于含音频配置，仍低于Qwen2.5-VL的67.4 CIDEr。
AI.conclusion: 提出"时序对齐摩擦"假说：全局音频表示破坏视觉帧的时间顺序，导致视觉导向指标被惩罚；因此CIDEr在MSR-VTT等数据集上可能偏向视觉化句法，限制其对多模态语义丰富度的刻画。

title: Beyond Random Starts: Amortized Initialization for Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language Models
summary: Gradient-based transferable adversarial attacks achieve state-of-the-art attack success rates against black-box vision-language models (VLMs). However, they require hundreds of costly optimization steps for each image pair. One possible reason is that these attacks typically start from random perturbations that contain no information about the source or target image. In this work, we study whether amortized adversarial generation can provide better initializations for gradient-based attacks. By learning across many image pairs, amortization allows a generator to produce adversarial perturbations for new inputs without optimizing each perturbation from scratch. We introduce SPARK, a lightweight looped perturbation generator conditioned on both the source and target images. SPARK repeatedly applies the same network to refine a perturbation, producing effective adversarial attacks in a few forward passes without requiring gradients through surrogate vision encoders at inference time. We show that these perturbations provide effective warm starts for existing gradient-based attacks, substantially improving attack success rates while reducing the number of optimization steps required. These improvements generalize across different attack methods, VLMs, and unseen image categories. SPARK also produces effective standalone attacks at a fraction of the computational cost of gradient-based optimization. Code and model weights are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SPARK：一种轻量级循环式扰动生成器，以源图和目标图为条件，通过摊还学习一次性生成对抗扰动，用作现有梯度攻击的热启动，也可独立攻击黑盒 VLM。
AI.motivation: 面向黑盒 VLM 的梯度可迁移对抗攻击虽成功率高，但每对图像需数百步昂贵优化；作者认为根源在于随机初始化不含源/目标图像信息，因此探索用摊还式对抗生成提供更好的初始化。
AI.method: 训练一个轻量循环（looped）生成器，条件为源图像与目标图像；同一网络被反复应用以迭代精炼扰动，推理时无需对代理视觉编码器求梯度，仅需少量前向传播即可输出扰动。生成结果既可作为现有梯度攻击的热启动，也可作为独立攻击。
AI.result: 热启动显著提升攻击成功率并大幅减少优化步数；改进在多种攻击方法、不同 VLM 与未见类别上均泛化；独立攻击在极低计算成本下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 摊还式生成可为对抗优化提供高效初始化，兼顾成功率与计算开销，并具备跨方法、跨模型的迁移性。

title: Anatomy-Aware Pseudo-Labels and Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff Supervision for Semi-Supervised Pancreas Segmentation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to WACV 2027 Workshops (FABRIC). \c{opyright} 2027 IEEE
summary: Confidence-gated co-training assumes that pseudo-label errors are uncertain and concentrated at organ boundaries. We argue that for pancreas CT, where the target organ is a single connected structure and detached fragments are anatomically implausible, the dominant failures arise at three levels: where the organ is, what its boundary should look like, and how a correct boundary is penalized. Anatomical Rectification relabels implausible fragments of a teacher prediction as confident background, without adding any loss or parameter; an audit confirms that its rejections are overwhelmingly detached hallucinations and that thin, tail-like slices are not eroded. Boundary Grafting transplants labelled surface regions with their annotation into unlabeled volumes, replacing unreliable boundary pseudo-labels with ground truth. The residual error is coherent surface displacement, weakly penalized by permutation-invariant Dice and cross-entropy losses. Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff (HAH) supervision anneals a distance-weighted penalty from an annotation-anchored objective that is convex in the prediction to a Hausdorff surrogate, admitting the prediction-dependent distance term only after the predicted surface becomes reliable. On NIH pancreas CT, under the standard semi-supervised split, the full method reaches 84.60% Dice and 4.97 voxels 95HD, improving all four metrics over compared methods; on MSD Task07, 78.90% Dice and 4.19 voxels 95HD. We further contribute PanTS-SSL, a semi-supervised evaluation protocol derived from the public 9,901-case PanTS corpus, with a curated 1,015-volume main pool, labelled tiers of 50, 100 and 250 volumes, an 80-case tumor track, shift probes for acquisition and anatomy change, and a fixed 901-volume test set. On it, the method exceeds the co-training baseline at 100 labels, scales to 85.29% Dice at 250 labels, and reaches 85.50% Dice at 100 labels with HAH.

AI.tldr: 针对胰腺CT半监督分割中伪标签的三类系统性失效（器官位置、边界形态、边界惩罚不足），提出解剖矫正重标注、边界移植真值、同伦退火Hausdorff监督三项免参数/轻量改进，并发布PanTS-SSL半监督评测协议。
AI.motivation: 置信度门控协同训练假设伪标签错误不确定且集中于器官边界，但胰腺为单一连通结构、碎片在解剖上不可能，因此主要错误源于"器官在哪、边界应长什么样、正确边界如何被惩罚"三个层级；同时缺乏大规模胰腺CT半监督分割的标准评测协议。
AI.method: (1) Anatomical Rectification：将教师预测中不合理的孤立碎片重标为高置信背景，不增加损失与参数；(2) Boundary Grafting：将带标注的表面区域连同标注移植进无标注体数据，用真值替换不可靠的边界伪标签；(3) Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff：从预测凸的、锚定标注的距离目标逐步退火至Hausdorff代理，仅在预测表面可靠后引入预测相关距离项。
AI.result: NIH胰腺CT标准半监督划分下达84.60% Dice、4.97体素95HD，四项指标全部优于对比方法；MSD Task07达78.90% Dice、4.19体素95HD。PanTS-SSL上100标签超过协同训练基线，250标签85.29% Dice，100标签加HAH达85.50% Dice。
AI.conclusion: 将半监督分割的失败分解为位置、形态与惩罚三个层级，并用解剖先验与梯度友好的退火Hausdorff监督分别对症处理，可在不增加模型复杂度的情况下稳定提升；配套的大规模PanTS-SSL协议为胰腺半监督研究提供可复现基准。

title: ViCARD: Visual Credit Assignment with Reward-Gated Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Visual reasoning requires models to identify relevant visual evidence and use it to derive correct answers. Outcomebased reinforcement learning (RL) faces two key challenges in this regime: it yields no learning signal when perceptual errors cause all sampled responses to fail, and it broadcasts a uniform advantage across every token within a response. Conversely, while visual self-distillation offers dense guidance from evidence-centered image crops, student learning from token distributions alone often fails to elicit correct final answers. Motivated by an audit of training rollouts that exposes these complementary failure modes, we introduce ViCARD (Visual Credit Assignment with RewardGated Distillation), which integrates per-token visual supervision with verified correctness rewards. For each rollout group, we leverage a teacher with its input image cropped to the relevant visual area, and use this to provide per-token supervision to the student while also valuing correctness. If all sampled rollouts fail, ViCARD samples an additional crop-teacher answer and activates on-policy distillation only if that answer is correct. Together, these mechanisms provide fine-grained visual credit within informative reward groups and a learning signal for otherwise uninformative all-fail groups. Extensive comparisons across model scales demonstrate that ViCARD improves fine-grained visual reasoning performance over RL and distillation baselines, while retaining broad visual reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: ViCARD 将逐 token 的视觉自蒸馏监督（教师以裁剪到相关视觉区域的图像为输入）与基于正确性的可验证奖励结合，并在全失败样本组中按需补充裁剪教师答案以生成有效学习信号。
AI.motivation: 纯结果型 RL 存在两个缺陷：感知错误导致所有采样回答全错时无学习信号；优势被均匀广播到每个 token。而视觉自蒸馏虽提供稠密监督，但仅靠 token 分布学习常无法引出正确最终答案。作者通过对训练 rollout 的审查，验证了这两种互补的失败模式。
AI.method: ViCARD（Visual Credit Assignment with Reward-Gated Distillation）：对每个 rollout 组，用输入图像裁剪到相关视觉区域的教师模型为学生提供逐 token 监督，同时以可验证的正确性奖励加权（reward-gated）。若组内全部 rollout 失败，则额外采样一个裁剪教师答案，仅当该答案正确时激活 on-policy 蒸馏。由此在信息丰富的奖励组内实现细粒度视觉信用分配，并为全失败组提供学习信号。
AI.result: 跨模型规模的广泛实验表明，ViCARD 在细粒度视觉推理性能上优于 RL 与蒸馏基线，同时保持广泛的通用视觉推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 以视觉证据为中心的裁剪教师蒸馏与正确性奖励门控相结合，可同时缓解稀疏奖励与粗粒度优势传播问题，为视觉推理提供更有效的训练范式。

title: OnCue: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios under Occlusion with Temporal Control
summary: Occluded hazards challenge autonomous driving because visibility timing determines available avoidance actions. Existing scenario generators control hazard motion without jointly specifying exposure and reference-contact times. We propose OnCue, a framework that generates safety-critical encounters in real driving logs with these temporal conditions. Scene geometry provides hidden starts and timed waypoints for pedestrian, cyclist, and vehicle trajectory generation. An offline response oracle labels encounters as Reactive (avoidable after exposure) or Anticipatory (avoidable only with earlier visibility) and stores safe maneuvers as training demonstrations. On the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 90.1-96.6% of valid trajectories meet both requested times within +/-0.2 s. OnCue matches the requested reaction window between them in 92.8% of shared vehicle requests versus at most 42.1% for adapted adversarial generators. Across matched cyclist encounters, longer windows lower PDM-Closed collision from 59.1% to 5.5%, while the learned planner LatentDriver shows the opposite trend. OnCue demonstrations reduce LatentDriver target collision by 54.8 points on held-out Reactive tests, but reduce overall no-target progress by 12.7 m. These results highlight the value of temporal control for evaluating and improving planners under occlusion.

AI.tldr: 提出 OnCue 框架，在真实驾驶日志中按"暴露时刻+参考接触时刻"双时间条件生成遮挡安全关键场景，并用离线 oracle 标注可反应/需预判两类遭遇及安全操纵演示。
AI.motivation: 现有场景生成器只控制危险物运动，不显式指定"何时可见（暴露时刻）"与"何时接触"，而可见性时序直接决定可用的避碰动作，因此难以针对性评测遮挡下的规划器反应窗口能力。
AI.method: 利用场景几何确定隐藏起点与定时路标，为行人/骑行者/车辆生成轨迹；离线响应 oracle 将遭遇标注为 Reactive（暴露后可避）或 Anticipatory（需更早可见才可避），并存储安全操纵作为训练演示；在 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上验证，与自适应对抗生成器对比，并用 PDM-Closed 与 LatentDriver 做反应窗口/演示学习实验。
AI.result: 90.1–96.6% 有效轨迹在 ±0.2 s 内同时满足两个请求时刻；共享车辆请求中 92.8% 匹配反应窗口（对比基线 ≤42.1%）；骑行者遭遇中窗口加长使 PDM-Closed 碰撞率由 59.1% 降至 5.5%，而 LatentDriver 呈相反趋势；OnCue 演示使 LatentDriver 目标碰撞降低 54.8 个百分点，但整体无目标进度减少 12.7 m。
AI.conclusion: 双时间条件的可控生成能精确刻画遮挡风险，并暴露现有规划器在时间理解上的缺陷（数据驱动模型对窗口长度呈反向响应），可用于评测与改进遮挡场景下的规划。

title: HumblePRM: Improving VLM Abstention in Ambiguous Situations through Process Reward Modeling
summary: Reliable deployment of Vision Language Models (VLMs) requires that a model's expressed confidence remain grounded in what it can actually see, and that it recognize when the visual evidence is too ambiguous to commit to a confident response. Standard post-training uses outcome reward models (ORMs) that supervise only the final decision, rewarding a confident answer regardless of whether the image supports one, while existing methods either tend to detect uncertainty post-hoc or assume an objective verdict always exists. We instead split multimodal reasoning into two stages: perception, where the model must factually describe the scene, and calibration, where it must judge whether that evidence is sufficient to commit to a conclusion. We introduce HumblePRM, a lightweight process reward model (PRM) that scores each stage independently, rewarding agreement between evidence and expressed confidence rather than outcome correctness alone. Training with HumblePRM increases abstention due to uncertainty on ambiguous inputs considerably while leaving accuracy on clear images roughly unchanged. We also find that the improvement transfers to Gemma 4 E4B, a larger, popular edge model. Our findings show that process reward supervision is a promising route to VLMs with better calibrated abstention, ensuring more reliability rather than unpredictable behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 HumblePRM，一个轻量过程奖励模型，将多模态推理拆为「感知（事实描述场景）」与「校准（判断证据是否足以定论）」两阶段分别打分；奖励证据与置信度的一致性而非单纯结果正确，从而在歧义输入上显著提升弃答率，清晰图像准确率基本不变，并可迁移到更大的 Gemma 4 E4B。
AI.motivation: VLM 可靠部署要求置信度须「有据可依」，并能在视觉证据不足时弃答。标准后训练使用结果奖励模型（ORM），只监督最终决策，无论图像是否支持都奖励自信作答；现有不确定性方法多为事后检测，或假设总存在客观答案，缺乏对证据充分性的过程化监督。
AI.method: 将多模态推理分为感知阶段（忠实描述场景）与校准阶段（判断证据是否足以支撑结论）；设计轻量 PRM（HumblePRM）对两阶段独立打分，奖励「证据—置信度一致性」而非仅结果正确性，并以该 PRM 信号进行训练。
AI.result: 在歧义输入上显著提高因不确定性而弃答的比例，同时在清晰图像上的准确率基本保持不变；该改进可迁移至更大规模的边缘模型 Gemma 4 E4B。
AI.conclusion: 过程奖励监督是获得更佳校准弃答能力的有效路径，可提升 VLM 可靠性而非引入不可预测行为。

title: Recovering What Matters, Transferring Only What Is Reliable: Toward Precise Reference-Based Super-Resolution
summary: Reference-based super-resolution (RefSR) aims to recover missing details from high-quality references. However, existing methods face two fundamental challenges. First, perceptual plausibility does not guarantee content fidelity. Existing methods often produce visually convincing details without faithfully recovering reference-specific information, such as text, codes, and identity cues. Second, faithful reference reading does not guarantee reliable information transfer. Increasing reference utilization also exposes the restoration process to misleading content, as global semantic relevance does not necessarily imply local correspondence consistency. To address these challenges, we propose PreciseRef, a reference-aware generative framework for faithful and reliable RefSR. At its core, Asymmetric Twin-Attention (ATA) allows target and reference images to participate in a unified attention space while the reference keeps its own shape. By letting their image tokens interact directly through joint attention, ATA facilitates fine-grained reference information retrieval without explicit image alignment. To ensure reliable information transfer, we introduce Dual-Scale Reference Gating (DRG), which combines Semantic Relevance Gating (SRG) to filter globally irrelevant reference context and Bidirectional Consistency Gating (BCG) to suppress unreliable local correspondences. Furthermore, we establish VeriRef, a benchmark evaluating exact reference-dependent content recovery and robustness to mismatched references. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves 85.6% character accuracy and 76.3% exact code decoding, compared with 17.4% and 0% for existing methods, while effectively suppressing erroneous reference transfer. It also achieves state-of-the-art perceptual quality on CUFED5 and WR-SR.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreciseRef，一个参考图感知的生成式 RefSR 框架，用非对称孪生注意力（ATA）实现无需显式对齐的细粒度参考信息检索，并用双尺度参考门控（DRG，含语义相关性门控 SRG 与双向一致性门控 BCG）抑制错误参考迁移；同时构建 VeriRef 基准，评测精确参考依赖内容恢复与错配参考鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 RefSR 存在两个根本问题：(1) 感知合理性不等于内容保真，生成细节看似逼真却未真正恢复参考图特有的文本、编码、身份线索；(2) 忠实读取参考不等于可靠信息传递，提升参考利用率会引入误导内容，因为全局语义相关不代表局部对应一致。因此需要兼顾"忠实恢复"与"可靠迁移"。
AI.method: 核心组件 Asymmetric Twin-Attention (ATA)：目标图与参考图共享统一注意力空间但参考图保持自身形状，图像 token 通过联合注意力直接交互，实现免显式对齐的细粒度参考检索。其次 Dual-Scale Reference Gating (DRG)：SRG 在全局层面过滤无关参考上下文，BCG 在局部层面抑制不可靠的对应关系。另构建 VeriRef 基准，专门评测参考依赖的精确内容恢复及错配参考下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 VeriRef 上达到 85.6% 字符准确率与 76.3% 精确编码解码率，现有方法仅为 17.4% 与 0%，并有效抑制错误参考迁移；在 CUFED5 与 WR-SR 上取得 SOTA 感知质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将 RefSR 的评价重心从"感知逼真"转向"参考忠实+迁移可靠"，通过无对齐的联合注意力与双层门控给出可行方案，并以 VeriRef 量化了现有方法的保真缺陷，为参考驱动超分的可靠性研究提供了基准与方法基线。

title: Playfulness as Feedback for Agentic Game Development
summary: Coding agents can generate runnable games from natural-language descriptions. However, a runnable game does not guarantee an excellent gameplay experience for players. In our view, a playful game should provide 1) reliable core functionality, 2) appealing visual design and assets, and 3) rich gameplay that supports exploration and progression. How agents can improve these aspects of playfulness remains underexplored. In our work, we propose Play2Evolve, a recursive game development framework with three stages: Initialization, Refinement, and Evolution. Using playfulness as feedback, agents playtest the game and diagnose issues in its functionality, visual presentation, and gameplay. Their feedback guides bug fixes and asset improvements. It also helps agents propose new gameplay and aesthetic goals for continued game evolution. To enrich game materials, we combine a video generation model with code to create appealing static and dynamic assets and integrate them into interactive gameplay. Finally, Play2Evolve achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods, scoring 60.05 on GameCraft-Bench compared with 50.81 after Game Initialization and 52.46 for Play2Code. Human overall-quality ratings reach 3.67, compared with 2.38 and 2.43, respectively. Our code will be released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Play2Evolve：以"可玩性"为反馈的三阶段递归游戏开发框架（初始化-精炼-演化），结合视频生成模型与代码构建静态/动态资产，在GameCraft-Bench上达60.05，优于Play2Code的52.46。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体已能由自然语言生成可运行游戏，但"可运行"≠"好玩"：需要可靠核心功能、吸引人的视觉设计与资产、以及支持探索与进程的丰富玩法。智能体如何提升这三方面可玩性尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 提出三阶段递归框架：1) Initialization 生成初始游戏；2) Refinement 以可玩性为反馈，智能体试玩并诊断功能、视觉、玩法问题，指导bug修复与资产改进；3) Evolution 基于反馈提出新玩法与美学目标持续演化。资产层面将视频生成模型与代码结合，产出静态与动态素材并接入交互玩法。
AI.result: 在GameCraft-Bench上取得被评测方法中的SOTA：60.05 vs. 初始化后50.81、Play2Code 52.46；人工整体质量评分3.67 vs. 2.38与2.43。
AI.conclusion: 以自试玩可玩性诊断驱动的闭环精炼+演化，配合生成式资产生成，可显著提升智能体生成游戏的质量；该"生成-评估-再生成"范式对智能体驱动的迭代式内容生成具有参考价值。

title: Fast Muscle-Driven Whole-Body Motion Tracking with a Differentiable World Model
summary: Tracking motion capture with a whole-body musculoskeletal model means coordinating hundreds of muscles through contact, and current controllers take hours to days of GPU time to train, so every tuning decision is expensive. SuperMimic trains a tracking policy by backpropagating through the rollouts of a learned world model. We extend it to MS-Human-700 (700 muscles) and MyoFullBody (354 muscles), with MuJoCo's activation dynamics inside the world model. To make its training fast, our recipe takes the speedups developed for the Unitree G1, replaces three of their settings that fail on muscles, and adds four changes of our own: observations without muscle geometry, data collection concurrent with the updates, Beta exploration noise that keeps every excitation in $[0,1]$, and 50 Hz control. On one RTX 5090 it trains MS-Human-700 in 6.3 minutes to the held-out return that SuperMimic's published hyperparameters reach in 3.9 hours, 37$\times$ sooner, and in 20 minutes to lower tracking errors than theirs after 10 hours. It trains MyoFullBody 34$\times$ sooner without retuning. Ablations show what is specific to muscles: a higher policy learning rate stalls half of the runs, and clipped Gaussian noise adds a tonic co-contraction that Beta noise avoids. Finally, refining the policy's actions through the world model at test time lowers the position error by a further 26% with no held-out clip failing, and reaches the same return after 5.1 instead of 6.3 minutes of training. Code, the training recipe and videos are on the project page this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出一套肌肉骨骼全身运动追踪训练加速方案：将SuperMimic（在世界模型rollout上反传）扩展到MS-Human-700与MyoFullBody，并把MuJoCo激活动力学嵌入世界模型；通过替换3项失效设置、新增4项改动（去除肌肉几何的观测、数据采集与更新并发、Beta探索噪声保证激励在[0,1]、50Hz控制），在单张RTX 5090上将训练时间缩短约34–37倍，并可在测试时用世界模型精修动作。
AI.motivation: 全身肌肉骨骼模型的运动跟踪需协调数百块肌肉并处理接触，现有控制器在GPU上需数小时到数天训练，导致每次调参代价极高，难以迭代。
AI.method: 基于SuperMimic的可学习世界模型：在模型rollout上反向传播训练跟踪策略，并在世界模型内部集成MuJoCo的肌肉激活动力学。工程加速配方：沿用为Unitree G1开发的加速技巧，替换其中3项在肌肉系统上失效的设置，并新增4项改动——(1)观测去除肌肉几何信息；(2)数据采集与策略更新并发；(3)采用Beta分布探索噪声，使激励恒在[0,1]；(4)控制频率50 Hz。测试时在世界模型中对策略动作做精修。
AI.result: 单RTX 5090上：MS-Human-700用6.3分钟达到SuperMimic公布超参3.9小时的held-out回报（快37倍），20分钟即取得优于其10小时后的更低跟踪误差；MyoFullBody无需重调即快34倍。消融显示：更高策略学习率会使一半运行停滞；裁剪高斯噪声引入持续的共收缩（tonic co-contraction），而Beta噪声可避免。测试时动作精修使位置误差再降26%，无held-out片段失败，达到同等回报仅需5.1分钟（原6.3分钟）。
AI.conclusion: 肌肉级全身运动追踪的训练成本可被大幅压缩至分钟级，且肌肉系统确实存在与刚体系统不同的调参敏感性（探索噪声分布、学习率）；世界模型既可用于训练加速，也可用于推理时的策略精修。

title: FoamSurf: A Voronoi-Surfel Representation for Differentiable Rendering
summary: Scenes inside a scattering medium contain solid surfaces, such as the seabed or rocks, and a semi-transparent medium, such as water, fog, or smoke. Recent Gaussian-based methods produce realistic images of scenes in scattering media, but traces of the medium can remain visible in surface-only renders. Neural fields separate surfaces and medium more accurately, but they are slow to train and difficult to edit. Both approaches evaluate the medium only along camera rays, so its effects along reflected and refracted rays are not modeled. These limitations prevent reliable surface recovery, independent editing of surfaces and the medium, and consistent rendering of inserted objects. We present FoamSurf, a hybrid representation that models surfaces with planar Gaussian surfels and the medium with space-filling Voronoi cells. A single differentiable ray tracer composites both along arbitrary rays, while training priors keep them separate without segmentation masks. Across real underwater scenes, synthetic scenes, and dense fog, FoamSurf achieves image quality on par with the state of the art and the most accurate surface-medium separation among the compared methods. The recovered components can be removed, edited, or stylized independently, and the same reconstruction supports inserted mesh objects with attenuation and scattering along both direct and reflected or refracted rays. Together, these capabilities enable scene restoration, editing, and composition within a single reconstructed model. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: FoamSurf 用平面高斯面元表示表面、Voronoi 胞元表示散射介质，单一可微光线追踪器在任意（含反射/折射）光线上联合合成，无需分割掩码即可实现表面与介质的分离、独立编辑及插入物体的散射一致性渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯泼溅法在仅渲染表面时仍残留介质痕迹，神经场方法分离更准但训练慢、难编辑；且两者都只沿相机光线评估介质，忽略反射/折射路径上的介质效应，导致表面重建不可靠、表面与介质无法独立编辑、插入物体渲染不一致。
AI.method: 混合表示：表面用平面高斯面元（planar Gaussian surfels），介质用空间填充的 Voronoi 胞元；单一可微光线追踪器沿任意光线对两者做合成；借助训练先验在无分割掩码条件下保持表面与介质分离。
AI.result: 在真实水下场景、合成场景与浓雾场景上，图像质量与 SOTA 持平，且表面-介质分离精度在对比方法中最高；恢复的各组件可独立删除、编辑、风格化，同一重建支持插入网格物体并在直射与反射/折射光线上正确建模衰减与散射。
AI.conclusion: 统一的重建模型可同时支持场景恢复、编辑与合成，弥合了高斯泼溅与神经场在散射介质场景中的各自局限。

title: OrdiHand-GS: Ordinal-Guided Tracking and Hand-Refined Gaussian Avatars for Digital Signers
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Digital signers, also known as signing avatars, convey sign language through animated virtual humans, where visual fidelity and linguistic intelligibility hinge primarily on the hands. When one hand crosses over the other, two failure modes dominate. First, monocular expressive-human tracking suffers from ordinal depth ambiguity: either hand can satisfy the same 2D landmarks, and the baseline tracker orders wrists at chance level on 365 annotated overlapping frames from How2Sign. Second, hand appearance remains blurred in neural rendering even after geometry is corrected. We propose OrdiHand-GS to address these errors separately. Relative depth from a video depth estimator and apparent hand size vote, with confidence weighting and abstention, for a front-back relation, which enters expressive-human tracking as a hinge on median hand-surface depth. A source-conditioned residual head then refines the local positions of hand-associated UV Gaussians with the avatar backbone and renderer frozen. We instantiate the framework with GUAVA. Against matched unconstrained refinement, wrist-order accuracy rises from 32.9% to 77.3% at a cost of 0.39 pixels of reprojection error, while a random-sign placebo gives no balanced-accuracy gain. A 2x2 factorial evaluation attributes most of the interaction-rendering improvement to tracking-stage refinement, with a smaller additional benefit from the residual.

AI.tldr: 提出 OrdiHand-GS，分别解决数字手语人两臂交叉时的手部遮挡错误：用视频深度估计与手部表观尺寸投票（带置信度与弃权）确定前后关系，作为中位手部表面深度的铰链约束；再用源条件残差头在冻结主干下精修手部相关 UV 高斯位置。
AI.motivation: 数字手语人（signing avatar）的视觉保真与语言可懂度主要取决于手部。单手跨越另一手时存在两类失败：(1) 单目表达性人体跟踪的序数深度歧义——同一组 2D landmark 可由任一手满足，基线跟踪器在 How2Sign 365 帧标注重叠帧上腕部前后顺序接近随机；(2) 几何修正后神经渲染中手部外观仍然模糊。
AI.method: 相对深度（视频深度估计器）+ 表观手部尺寸双线索投票，经置信度加权与弃权得到前后关系，以中位手部表面深度的铰链损失注入表达性人体跟踪；随后在 avatar 主干与渲染器冻结条件下，用源条件残差头精修手部关联 UV 高斯局部位置；框架以 GUAVA 实例化。
AI.result: 相比匹配的无约束精修，腕部顺序准确率由 32.9% 提升至 77.3%，代价为 0.39 像素重投影误差；随机符号安慰剂实验无平衡准确率收益。2×2 因子实验表明交互渲染改善主要来自跟踪阶段修正，残差头贡献较小增量。
AI.conclusion: 将序数深度歧义与外观模糊解耦、分阶段处理是有效策略；深度/尺寸投票约束可显著修复腕部前后顺序歧义，而渲染质量提升主要源于跟踪几何修正。工作聚焦手语 avatar 的单目重建与渲染，缺少手-物接触与开放代码/实时性证据。

title: SplatWAM: Splatting World Action Models for Real-Time 3D Imagination
summary: World models typically predict future observations in pixel or latent space, limiting their ability to directly represent true 3D scene evolution. We present SplatWAM (Splatting World Action Model), a generative world model that learns action-conditioned dynamics directly over compact 3D Gaussian primitives. A tokenizer SplatWAM-T first encodes a variable number of unposed views into a fixed budget of Gaussian tokens. A dynamics model SplatWAM-D then predicts future Gaussian states in a single forward pass per action, using log-Euclidean covariance coordinates and differentiable rendering supervision to facilitate learning in an explicit 3D space. Each predicted state can be rasterized from arbitrary viewpoints, enforcing a shared 3D representation across views by construction. On OGBench Scene, SplatWAM renders novel views 12x faster than video world models (~80 FPS on an RTX 5090) with up to 2.0 dB higher PSNR. We further introduce SplatWAM-P, a lightweight flow-matching policy head jointly trained with the dynamics model. Across 8 task suites, model-free Gaussian-token policies outperform pixel-based counterparts by up to 24.8 percentage points. SplatWAM-P improves over Latent Particle World Model (LPWM) by 12 percentage points and matches HIQL without a learned value function. On LIBERO, our ~1B model outperforms WorldVLA (~7B) and the robot-pretrained OpenVLA (~7B), while matching OpenVLA-OFT when both are trained without large-scale robot pretraining. Code and checkpoints will be released.

AI.tldr: SplatWAM：直接在3D高斯原语上学习动作条件动态的生成式世界模型，实现任意视角渲染与高斯token策略。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型在像素或隐空间预测未来观测，无法直接表征真实3D场景演化，跨视角一致性依赖隐式学习。
AI.method: SplatWAM-T将变数量无位姿视图编码为固定预算高斯token；SplatWAM-D单次前向预测未来高斯状态，采用对数欧氏协方差坐标与可微渲染监督；SplatWAM-P为与动态模型联合训练的轻量流匹配策略头。
AI.result: OGBench Scene上新视角渲染约80 FPS（较视频世界模型快12倍），PSNR最高提升2.0 dB；8个任务套件上高斯token策略较像素策略提升最多24.8个百分点，SplatWAM-P超LPWM 12个百分点且无需价值函数即匹配HIQL；LIBERO上~1B模型超过~7B的WorldVLA与OpenVLA，无大规模机器人预训练时与OpenVLA-OFT持平。
AI.conclusion: 显式3D高斯状态作为世界模型载体，兼具高效率渲染、跨视角3D一致性与强策略性能，验证了3D原语级动态建模在具身智能中的可行性。

title: Streaming Tax: Can Streaming VLMs Replace Their Offline Parents?
summary: Most vision-language models (VLMs) specialize in offline video understanding; in contrast, their post-trained versions, streaming VLMs, can perform live interactions. We investigate whether streaming VLMs can replace their offline parent models on offline tasks. Such replacement could reduce deployment costs and improve efficiency. We propose Streaming Tax to systematically evaluate streaming VLMs on offline tasks. Our exploration spans three core dimensions: understanding, trustworthiness, and generalization across 15 benchmarks. Our findings reveal a critical gap between offline capability preservation and practical replaceability. This gap emerges at two stages: streaming adaptation can alter trustworthy behavior even when offline understanding is largely preserved, while the native streaming protocol can introduce further performance losses. Our analyses show that some of these losses arise from restricted access to historical visual evidence and failures to deliver usable responses. Importantly, regarding safety, streaming models often leave both harmful and legitimate requests unanswered rather than genuinely refusing unsafe ones. We then propose Stream++, a training-free plugin to improve streaming VLMs on offline tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出"Streaming Tax"评测框架，从理解、可信度、泛化三个维度在15个基准上系统评估流式VLM能否替代其离线母模型执行离线任务，并提出免训练插件Stream++缓解性能损失。
AI.motivation: 流式VLM可实时交互且部署成本低，若能在离线任务上替代离线模型可降低开销、提升效率；但此前缺乏对"可替代性"的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建Streaming Tax评测体系，覆盖理解/可信度/泛化三维度共15个基准；分阶段分析流式适配与原生流式协议带来的损失来源（历史视觉证据受限、响应不可用）；提出免训练插件Stream++。
AI.result: 发现离线能力保持与实际可替代性之间存在关键鸿沟：流式适配在理解基本保持时仍会改变可信行为，流式协议进一步造成损失；安全场景下模型常对有害和合法请求均不作答而非真正拒答。
AI.conclusion: 流式VLM尚不能直接替代离线母模型，需关注协议与适配阶段的行为偏移；Stream++可免训练地部分改善离线任务表现。

title: Memory as the Backbone: A Dual-Store Associative Memory Architecture for Visual Recognition
summary: We investigate whether explicit memory can serve as the organizing principle of a general-purpose visual backbone. Inspired by the interaction between working and long-term memory in human cognition, we introduce DuSAM (Dual-Store Associative Memory), a hierarchical memory-native visual backbone coupling image-local working memory (WM) with a fixed-capacity persistent semantic memory (PM). WM organizes local visual evidence into compact, spatially anchored states that are updated and transported across stages, then read back to refine dense features. PM consolidates semantic evidence from training images and annotated regions into prototypes, whose retrieved content enriches the same working states. With these memory operations in place of self-attention or state-space blocks, DuSAM achieves competitive performance relative to representative, similarly sized backbones on ImageNet-1K classification, ADE20K semantic segmentation, and COCO object detection and instance segmentation. Ablations show contributions from both stores, with PM particularly benefiting class groups with fewer annotated training pixels. At $2048\times2048$, the complete DuSAM-based UPerNet segmentor achieves $2.36\times$ the throughput of the evaluated DeiT-S/16 counterpart while using $59.5\%$ less GPU memory, and $1.24\times$ the throughput of the linear-complexity VMamba-T. Memory analyses reveal spatially selective WM access and semantic associations between retrieved prototypes and training regions. Class-targeted removal and restoration further demonstrate that category-specific experience can be replenished through state updates without changing network parameters. These results establish explicit memory as a viable organizing principle for visual backbones and provide a foundation for jointly designing contextual computation and addressable semantic memory.

AI.tldr: 提出DuSAM双存储（工作记忆WM+持久语义记忆PM）视觉骨干，用记忆读写操作替代自注意力/状态空间模块，在分类、分割、检测上达到同规模骨干的竞争性能，并显著提升高分辨率吞吐与显存效率。
AI.motivation: 探究显式记忆能否作为通用视觉骨干的组织原则，借鉴人类认知中工作记忆与长时记忆的交互机制，替代主流的自注意力或状态空间结构。
AI.method: 构建分层记忆原生骨干：图像局部工作记忆将局部视觉证据组织为紧凑、空间锚定的状态，跨阶段更新与传输并回读以精化稠密特征；固定容量持久语义记忆将训练图像与标注区域的语义证据固化为原型，检索内容回馈工作状态。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K分类、ADE20K分割、COCO检测与实例分割上性能与同规模代表性骨干相当；消融显示两存储均有贡献，PM对标注像素较少的类别增益明显；2048×2048下UPerNet吞吐为DeiT-S/16的2.36倍且省59.5%显存，为VMamba-T的1.24倍；分析显示WM访问具空间选择性、原型与训练区域存在语义关联；类别定向移除与恢复表明无需改参数即可补充类别经验。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立显式记忆可作为视觉骨干的可行组织原则，为上下文计算与可寻址语义记忆的联合设计奠定基础；但属于通用视觉骨干层面的工作，未涉及具身/三维/物理仿真等场景验证。

title: EvOrderBench: When do sampled frames establish event order?
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are often asked which of two actions in a video happened first, given only a few sampled frames. Such frames can show that both actions occurred without showing which came first, so a reliable model should state an order only when the frames establish it. Forced-choice temporal benchmarks treat every input as answerable and reward lucky guesses, while answerability benchmarks do not separate frames that miss an action from frames that show both actions but not their order. We introduce EvOrderBench, a real-video benchmark of 579 event families. Each family fixes an episode and a question and varies only the frames: of two four-frame inputs, only one establishes the order, and two six-frame inputs extend the other one with either the frames that resolve the order or frames that do not. Every input is labeled for whether its frames establish each action and their order. Across sixteen open-weight configurations and three closed-source references, the best open models order nearly as accurately as the references when the frames establish the order, but withhold correctly on at most 83% of the inputs where they do not, against at least 90% for every reference; forced-choice accuracy cannot reveal this gap. Open models withhold mainly when the frames show neither action; once the frames show one or both, most of them commit to an order. Thinking narrows the gap, even when it is switched on within a single checkpoint, mainly by separating sufficient from insufficient evidence rather than by making models more cautious overall. Accurate ordering thus does not imply knowing when the frames fall short, and benchmarks should reward withholding alongside ordering.

AI.tldr: EvOrderBench：579个真实视频事件族的时序基准，每个事件族固定episode与问题、只变帧，检验VLM是否仅在帧能确立先后顺序时才给出顺序；结果显示开放权重模型哪怕排序准确率接近闭源参考，正确"拒答"率最高仅83%（参考≥90%），forced-choice精度无法暴露该缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有forced-choice时序基准把所有输入当作可回答，奖励瞎猜；而answerability基准未能区分"帧里根本没有某动作"与"两动作都有但顺序不可辨"这两种证据不足情形，导致VLMs"会排序"与"知道何时不该排序"被混为一谈，缺乏可诊断的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建EvOrderBench：579个真实视频事件族，每族固定episode+问题、仅改变采样帧。设计受控对照：两个4帧输入中只有一个能确立顺序；两个6帧输入在另一方基础上分别追加"能消歧的帧"或"不能消歧的帧"。每个输入均标注其帧是否确立了每个动作及其顺序。评测16个开放权重配置与3个闭源参考，并对比thinking开/关（含同一checkpoint内切换）。
AI.result: 帧足以确立顺序时，最佳开放模型排序准确率接近闭源参考；但证据不足时应拒答的输入上正确拒答率最高仅83%，所有参考模型≥90%。开放模型的正确拒答主要发生在"两动作均未出现"时，一旦出现一个或两个动作便倾向于强行给出顺序。开启thinking可缩小差距，且在同一checkpoint内切换亦有效。
AI.conclusion: 准确排序并不蕴含"知道自己何时证据不足"；thinking的收益主要来自区分充分证据与不充分证据，而非整体更保守。时序评测应同时奖励正确排序与正确保留（withholding），仅看forced-choice准确率会掩盖系统性过度自信。

title: A 3D Simulator for Passive SPAD Imaging
summary: Passive single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras provide short-exposure observations for low-light perception, but collecting task annotations for these sensors remains difficult, and annotated datasets are scarce. We present a 3D simulation pipeline that generates realistic photon detections together with camera-motion and semantic labels, enabling perception models to be trained on synthetic SPAD observations and applied directly to real-world data. The pipeline couples controllable scene geometry and motion with a sensor-informed observation model that accounts for photon shot noise, dark counts, and spatial crosstalk. We evaluate the pipeline through calibrated photon-count comparisons and zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across three downstream perception tasks. We show that classifiers trained only on synthetic SPAD data achieve high accuracy on real low-light recordings at illumination levels less than 2 lux, without real-data fine-tuning. Similarly, we apply models trained entirely on simulated camera sweeps to real-world camera-rotation estimation and achieve mean absolute rotation errors of less than 1 degree on real 20-degree and 30-degree sweeps at 0.5 and 5.0 lux, when deployed zero-shot. We additionally train semantic segmentation models on synthetic data with automatically generated dense labels and perform direct inference on real-world low-light recordings; the results further demonstrate the usefulness of synthetic dense supervision for real low-light perception. Our simulator thus provides a practical source of annotated training data for real SPAD perception.

AI.tldr: 提出耦合场景几何/运动与传感器物理（散粒噪声、暗计数、串扰）的被动SPAD相机3D仿真管线，同时生成光子探测与相机运动、语义稠密标签，实现三任务零样本sim-to-real。
AI.motivation: 被动SPAD相机可做低光短曝光感知，但真实标注采集困难、数据集稀缺，需可用的仿真标注数据源。
AI.method: 可控场景几何与运动的3D渲染，配合含光子散粒噪声、暗计数与空间串扰的传感器观测模型，联合输出相机运动与语义标签；用标定光子计数比对验证保真度。
AI.result: 仅用合成SPAD数据训练的分类器在<2 lux真实低光录制上高精度；零样本相机旋转估计在0.5和5.0 lux的20°/30°真实扫描上平均绝对误差<1°；合成稠密标签训练的语义分割可直接推理真实数据。
AI.conclusion: 该仿真器为真实SPAD低光感知提供实用标注训练数据源，验证了合成稠密监督与零样本迁移的有效性。

title: Separating Environment and Sensor Shift from Acquisition Protocol in Physical Vision Benchmarks
summary: In real-world deployments, vision systems must operate under varying environmental conditions, such as illumination changes. Recent work has explored adaptive sensing strategies that select camera parameters according to the current environment and downstream task to improve task performance. Reliable physical benchmarks are therefore essential for evaluating such strategies. We study ImageNet-ES-Diverse, a physical benchmark that evaluates the adaptive exposure control strategy Lens by recapturing printed ImageNet images under varying illumination conditions. We construct four controlled acquisition pipelines that vary printed-image scale and camera zoom, and conduct a pilot study with directly captured physical objects. We find that the acquisition choices substantially change benchmark difficulty on all downstream baselines. Moreover, the average classification-accuracy advantage of Lens over auto exposure observed on the original benchmark does not persist in either our collected pipelines or real-object pilot study. Oracle exposure selection nevertheless retains substantial gains, indicating remaining potential for sensor control. These findings highlight acquisition protocol as an important factor in physical benchmark evaluation and motivate explicit protocol reporting and evaluation across multiple acquisition setups when assessing adaptive-sensing benefits.

AI.tldr: 该文复现并扩展 ImageNet-ES-Diverse 物理基准，构建四种受控采集管线并用真实物体做试点研究，发现采集参数显著改变基准难度，且 Lens 相对自动曝光的精度优势在扩展设置下不复现，但 Oracle 曝光选择仍有显著增益。
AI.motivation: 现有面向自适应传感策略（按环境与下游任务选择相机参数）的物理基准，其采集协议本身可能影响评测结论，需要检验基准对采集条件的敏感性。
AI.method: 围绕自适应曝光控制策略 Lens，构建四种受控采集管线（变化打印图像尺度与相机变焦），并补充直接拍摄真实物体的试点实验，对比 Lens、auto exposure 与 Oracle 曝光选择在多种下游分类基线下的表现。
AI.result: 采集选择显著改变所有下游基线的基准难度；Lens 相对自动曝光的平均精度优势在四条新管线与真实物体试点中均未复现；Oracle 曝光选择仍保留可观增益。
AI.conclusion: 采集协议是物理基准评测的重要混杂因素，评估自适应传感收益时应显式报告协议并在多种采集设置下交叉验证；传感器控制仍有较大未挖掘潜力。

title: ArtLang-4D: Articulation-Aware Dynamic Language Fields from Monocular Videos
summary: Language that describes an articulated object is often about its state: the drawer pulled out the furthest, the door opened halfway, push the drawer all the way in. Existing 3D language fields attach one feature to each point and cannot tell these descriptions apart, and 4D language fields condition on video time, which has no kinematic meaning and cannot be set by a user. We present ArtLang-4D, which reconstructs an articulated object from a single monocular RGB-D video and equips it with a dynamic language field indexed by articulation time t, the normalized state of its joints, instead of video time. The geometry is a canonical triangle field whose triangles follow typed screw joints, discovered from the video without any joint initialization. The language field is supervised by a t-tagged caption bank that describes each part with comparative state phrases in a whitened open-vocabulary text space. A free-form query is answered by maximizing part relevance jointly over parts and states, which returns both the part and the articulation state it describes; a command is then executed by moving only that part along its recovered joint. On the 100 objects of Articulate-100, ArtLang-4D recovers more accurate joints and part geometry than reconstruction and articulation baselines, retrieves the queried state far more reliably than a state-agnostic language field, and executes language commands with lower motion error.

AI.tldr: ArtLang-4D 从单目 RGB-D 视频重建铰接物体，并用"关节铰接时间 t"（归一化关节状态）而非视频时间索引的动态语言场，支持以部件-状态联合检索回答自由查询并仅驱动被指部件的语言指令执行。
AI.motivation: 描述铰接物体的语言多涉及关节状态（"抽屉拉到最外""门开一半"），而现有 3D 语言场每点单特征无法区分状态，4D 语言场以视频时间为条件，既无运动学意义也无法由用户设定。因此需要以运动学量（铰接时间）为索引的状态感知语言场，并同时解决无关节初始化的关节发现问题。
AI.method: 几何为规范三角面片场，三角面片沿带类型（prismatic/revolute 等）的螺旋关节（screw joints）运动，关节由视频自动发现、无需初始化；语言场由带 t 标签的描述性 caption bank 监督，在 whiten 后的开放词表文本空间中用比较级状态短语描述各部件。查询时对部件与状态联合最大化相关性，同时输出所描述的部件与铰接状态；指令执行时仅沿该部件恢复出的关节运动。
AI.result: 在 Articulate-100 的 100 个物体上，关节与部件几何精度优于重建与铰接基线；状态检索可靠性显著优于状态无关的语言场；语言指令执行的运动误差更低。
AI.conclusion: 以运动学铰接时间替代视频时间作为语言场索引，是可分离"部件"与"状态"的有效方案，将语言定位、关节恢复与指令执行统一于单一表征；局限在于仍依赖单目 RGB-D 输入与带标签 caption bank 监督，规模与野外泛化尚待验证。

title: Model Predictive Control of a Multirotor UAV with a Cable-Suspended Payload: A Comparison of Shifted and Transformer-Based Warm Starts
summary: This study investigates model predictive control (MPC) of a multirotor drone (unmanned aerial vehicle, UAV) carrying a cable-suspended payload, comparing conventional shifted initialization with Transformer-based warm starting of a sequential convex programming (SCP) optimizer. The controller uses a coupled mechanical model with an elastic cable and a double-pendulum representation of the suspended load. Its formulation includes move-blocked control inputs, finite-difference sensitivities, constrained quadratic subproblems, and input-feasibility projection. A Transformer trained on expert SCP solutions predicts an initial control sequence, which is subsequently refined by the same optimizer used for the conventional methods. Numerical experiments compare zero, shifted, and Transformer initialization under identical controller settings. For independently solved MPC problems, Transformer initialization reduces computation time relative to zero initialization. In sequential closed-loop simulations, however, shifting the preceding optimized control sequence provides the lowest computation time, while all three methods produce similar tracking behavior. These findings emphasize the importance of comparing learned warm starts with conventional initialization methods that reuse previous MPC solutions. The measured optimization times exceed the control sampling period; consequently, real-time implementation is not demonstrated. Keywords: Model predictive control; sequential convex programming; Transformer; warm start; cable-suspended payload; multirotor drone.

AI.tldr: 该论文将 Transformer 学习型热启动与传统的平移（shifted）热启动在多旋翼吊挂载荷 MPC 中做对比，发现闭环序列场景下传统平移热启动计算时间最低，三者跟踪性能相近。
AI.motivation: 学习型热启动（warm start）常被宣称加速 MPC，但缺少与"复用上一时刻优化解"这类经典平移初始化在闭环序列条件下的公平对比；本文针对多旋翼吊挂弹性绳索+双摆载荷这一强耦合非线性系统检验这一问题。
AI.method: 控制器采用弹性绳索与双摆载荷的耦合力学模型，MPC 经由序列凸规划（SCP）求解，含 move-blocking 输入、有限差分灵敏度、约束二次子问题与输入可行性投影。用专家 SCP 解训练 Transformer 预测初始控制序列，再由同一 SCP 优化器精化，与零初始化、平移初始化在完全相同控制器设置下对比。
AI.result: 独立求解的 MPC 问题中，Transformer 初始化较零初始化缩短计算时间；但在顺序闭环仿真中，平移上一时刻最优解的计算时间最低，三种初始化的跟踪行为基本相同。实测优化时间超过控制采样周期，未实现实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 学习型热启动必须以复用前序 MPC 解的平移策略为基线进行评估；其价值受限于单步求解加速，而非闭环总耗时。

title: AVERT: Anomalous Value Erasure with Response Testing against Visual Prompt Injection
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are vulnerable to visual prompt injection, in which an adversarially perturbed image forces the model to respond with the attacker's chosen content, such as malicious tool calls, website links, or advertisements, sometimes regardless of the user's question. Existing defenses, such as diffusion-based purification and image-token masking, mitigate these attacks at a substantial cost to the model's utility on benign inputs. To address this challenge, we propose AVERT, which removes adversarial feature directions only when the model's answer depends on them. Our key procedures involve identifying anomalous value subspaces and detecting answer dependence. To identify the anomalous value subspace, we compare the statistics of each input's attention-head outputs with those of clean images and extract the directions along which the input deviates the most. We then project out these directions to remove the injected content. Because the same directions also carry benign visual information, we apply the removal only to answers that depend on them, namely answers whose likelihood collapses once the directions are removed or that are as likely under unrelated questions as under the user's question. Against white-box attacks on four VLMs (Qwen2-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, LLaVA, InternVL2.5) and four injection benchmarks, AVERT lowers average attack success from 86-90% to at most 0.6% while retaining at least 96% of undefended utility averaged over thirteen benchmarks. Its defense-utility F-score ($F_{DU}$), the harmonic mean of attacks stopped and utility retained, is 98.0-99.1 and the highest among all compared defenses on every model.

AI.tldr: AVERT：通过识别视觉提示注入导致的异常 value 子空间方向，并仅在模型答案依赖这些方向时才做方向剔除，从而在四类 VLM 与四个注入基准上将攻击成功率从 86–90% 降至 ≤0.6%，同时保留 ≥96% 的良性效用。
AI.motivation: VLM 易受视觉提示注入攻击：对抗扰动图像可迫使其输出攻击者指定内容（恶意工具调用、链接、广告），甚至无视用户问题。现有防御（扩散净化、图像 token 掩码）在良性输入上效用损失过大，需在防御与效用间取得更好平衡。
AI.method: 两步机制：(1) 异常 value 子空间识别——比较每个输入注意力头输出统计量与干净图像统计量，提取偏差最大的方向；(2) 答案依赖性检测——将输入在这些方向上的投影剔除，仅当答案依赖这些方向时才执行移除，判据为：移除后答案似然崩溃，或该答案在无关问题下的似然与在用户问题下相当。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2-VL、Qwen2.5-VL、LLaVA、InternVL2.5 四个模型与四个注入基准的白盒攻击下，平均攻击成功率由 86–90% 降至最高 0.6%；在 13 个基准上平均保留 ≥96% 未防御效用；防御-效用 F 分数 F_DU 达 98.0–99.1，在所有对比防御中于每个模型上均最高。
AI.conclusion: 基于条件化的特征方向剔除，可在几乎不损害良性效用的前提下高效消除视觉提示注入的影响，为 VLM 安全部署提供了一种轻量、模型通用的推理期防御方案。

title: Frame geometry, fascicle extrapolation and leaderboard overfitting in muscle ultrasound
comment: 38 pages (20 main text, 18 supplement), 13 figures, 21 tables. Code, trained weights, notebooks and derived data are public on Kaggle (user soheilkooklan) and in the ancillary files
summary: Automated readings of pennation angle, fascicle length and muscle thickness from B-mode ultrasound depend on the geometry of the stored frame and on how fascicles that leave the image are extended, and challenge entries add settings chosen on a small public leaderboard. This study measures all three in one entry of the UMUD Challenge, which scored 309 frames from six screen layouts, 103 on a public and 206 on a private leaderboard. The pipeline applies layout-specific values of scale and pixel aspect, resamples each frame to square pixels, segments aponeuroses and fascicle fragments with U-Nets and measures the three readings geometrically; the submitted entry blended its angle and length with public notebooks. Because the score is additive, 65 single-change contrasts from 13 base entries measured each decision on both splits. The primary selected entry scored 0.27608 on the private split, the 69th reported position of 690 teams. Reading every frame with square pixels cost 0.029 public and 0.037 private. Of 20 late-stage corrections, 9 kept the sign of their effect on the private split. An audit of the UMUD expert benchmark found that 26 of its 35 frames share their tissue with training images of both DL_Track_US and the challenge. On the 9 frames with no detected match in either set or orientation, the recipe scored 0.213, two experts against two others 0.218 and DL_Track_US 0.263 (0.209, 0.196 and 0.259 when both raters of a reference pair are required), with no difference established. Frame geometry and the extension rule moved readings as much as the choice of model, and small corrections tuned on about 100 public frames did not carry over.

AI.tldr: 该研究在UMUD Challenge中系统测量超声图像中羽状角、肌束长度和肌肉厚度的自动读数，量化了帧几何（像素纵横比、缩放）与几何扩展规则对结果的影响，并审计了专家基准的数据泄漏问题。
AI.motivation: 自动超声肌肉测量依赖存储帧的几何设定和对出框肌束的延伸规则，且挑战赛提交常依赖小规模公开榜单调参，缺乏对各决策实际贡献的可靠度量。
AI.method: 基于309帧（6种屏幕布局）构建U-Net分割顶/腱膜与肌束片段并几何测量三项指标的流程；通过13个基线条目产生65组单变量对比，在公开/私有榜单上分别评估每个设计选择；并对UMUD专家基准的35帧做与DL_Track_US及挑战训练集的匹配审计。
AI.result: 主选条目私有榜0.27608，排名69/690；全部帧统一方像素代价为公开0.029、私有0.037；20项后处理修正中仅9项在私有榜保持效应符号；无泄漏的9帧上方法0.213，专家间0.218，DL_Track_US 0.263，未确立显著性差异。
AI.conclusion: 帧几何与延伸规则的影响可与模型选择相当，基于约100张公开帧的少量调参无法泛化到私有榜；基准中存在显著训练集重叠，需谨慎解读排名。

title: Skeptic: Grounding Failure Diagnosis for Robot Skill Discovery
summary: Robot agents discover reusable skills by revising programs from execution feedback and retaining experience for later tasks. This process can fail when an agent treats an unsuccessful program as evidence that the task is physically impossible, ending exploration with revision budget remaining. We study this failure in Qwen3.8-27B and examine two decisions that shape skill discovery: I) how execution failures are diagnosed, and II) which lessons enter the shared skill library. Failure diagnosis requires the agent to reconstruct physical action effects from multimodal traces, while independent reproduction of a proposed repair does not require adequate task performance from its source program. We introduce Skeptic, a training-free protocol that uses measured action outcomes to guide repair and measured task success to govern skill admission. A grounded event log reports action effects and object end states from depth images and proprioception, separating sensor observations from inferred diagnoses. Verified promotion adds a development-success requirement on the source program to the existing independent reproduction check. Across 60 audited tasks, the mean number of tasks with false impossibility judgments decreases from 19.5 to 8.5 per campaign. On 80 LIBERO-Pro tasks and seven Robosuite tasks, Skeptic improves held-out success by 14.9 and 11.7 percentage points, with frozen model weights and the same program-revision budget.

AI.tldr: Skeptic：免训练协议，用"实测动作效果"诊断执行失败、用"实测任务成功+源程序开发成功"管控技能入库，减少智能体误判"物理不可能"而过早终止探索。
AI.motivation: 机器人智能体通过修改程序、利用执行反馈沉淀可复用技能，但常把一次失败的程序当作"任务物理不可行"的证据，在修订预算未耗尽时提前放弃；论文将这一失败归因于两个决策：I) 执行失败如何被诊断，II) 哪些经验进入共享技能库。
AI.method: 免训练协议 Skeptic：(1) 故障诊断需从多模态轨迹重建物理动作效应，引入基于深度图像与本体感知的 grounded event log，报告动作效果与物体终态，将传感器观测与推断性诊断分离；(2) 技能准入方面，在原有"独立复现"检查之上增加 Verified Promotion，要求源程序本身达到开发成功标准（因为独立复现修复项并不要求源程序任务表现合格）。模型权重冻结、程序修订预算不变。
AI.result: 60 个审计任务中，出现虚假不可能判断的任务数均值由 19.5 降至 8.5（每轮 campaign）；在 80 个 LIBERO-Pro 任务与 7 个 Robosuite 任务上，留出成功率分别提升 14.9 与 11.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将"诊断"锚定在实测动作效应、"准入"锚定在实测任务成功，可在不训练、不增加预算的条件下显著缓解过早放弃问题并提升技能迁移成功率；提示技能库治理（admission control）与失败归因是智能体技能发现的关键环节。

title: EgoCARBS: Egocentric Video Meets Active Acoustics for Kitchen Action Understanding
comment: 36 pages (12 main paper and references, 24 supplementary material). Project page: this https URL
summary: Egocentric video records what a person looks at, but often misses what their body does: the hands leave the frame, and arm motion goes unseen. An exocentric camera recovers this context, but it must be installed wherever the activity happens. Active acoustic sensing can recover it from the wearables themselves: a device's speaker emits inaudible chirps, and its microphone senses the motion of the hands, arms, and nearby objects from their echoes. Yet no public dataset pairs it with egocentric video. We present EgoCARBS, with two deliverables. The first is a multimodal dataset and benchmark: 15 participants cook unscripted meals in their own kitchens wearing camera glasses and an off-the-shelf smartwatch that both sense with active acoustics, synchronized with egocentric and exocentric video and the watch's audio and IMU, with 4,019 verb-noun action annotations in 11.4 hours. The second is a study of what the wearables add to egocentric video. On verb recognition, they add at least as much as an exocentric camera for participants seen in training, and even more for new participants, for whom the exocentric camera does not help. Active acoustics alone provides most of this gain, and helps most where the camera does not see the hands. Trimmed action recognition, detection, and anticipation remain open. We will release the data, our data collection and annotation tools, and pre-trained models.

AI.tldr: EgoCARBS数据集：15名参与者在自家厨房佩戴摄像眼镜与支持主动声学的智能手表做无脚本烹饪，采集同步的第一/第三人称视频、手表音频与IMU，共11.4小时、4,019条动宾动作标注；研究表明主动声学感知可为第一人称视频补充身体与手部运动信息。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频记录了"人看什么"，但手常出画面、手臂运动不可见；外置第三人称相机能补全该信息却需预先部署。主动声学传感可由可穿戴设备自身（扬声器发不可闻chirp、麦克风收回声）恢复手/臂及附近物体运动，但此前缺少与第一人称视频配对的公开数据。
AI.method: 构建EgoCARBS多模态数据集与基准：摄像眼镜+现成智能手表（均为主动声学收发）同步采集第一人称/第三人称视频、手表音频与IMU；提供采集与标注工具；在动词识别等任务上做消融/对比研究，分析可穿戴信号相对第一人称视频的增益，并考察对训练中未出现的新参与者的泛化。
AI.result: 动词识别上，可穿戴信号带来的增益至少相当于外置第三人称相机（对训练中见过的参与者）；对未见新参与者增益更大，而外置相机此时无帮助。该增益主要来自主动声学本身，且在相机看不到手的时段提升最明显。Trimmed动作识别、动作检测与动作预测仍为开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 主动声学可穿戴感知是低成本、免部署的第一人称视觉补全手段，文章以数据集+基准+开源工具与预训练模型推动该方向。

title: ProPolar: Progressive Polar Decomposition for Implicit Neural Representations
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) capture global low-frequency structure during the early stage of training and then refine localized high-frequency details, afterwards. However, standard optimizers are agnostic to the coarse-to-fine learning behavior of INRs. Such optimizers accumulate a gradient matrix in momentum buffer and retain components misaligned with the dominant low-frequency directions in the early stage. We propose a progressively growing rank scheduler and a rank-aware learning-rate scheduler for enhancing a subspace-based momentum optimization, where a momentum matrix is updated within a low-rank subspace. The rank schedule expands the subspace during training, and the scheduler holds the peak learning rate through rank growth so that the added subspace contributes to fine-detail recovery. Experiments on image fitting, single-image super-resolution (SISR), and neural radiance field optimization show that the proposed method improves convergence and peak reconstruction quality over competitive optimizers. The largest gains appear in the high-frequency refinement stage, mirroring the coarse-to-fine progression that the rank schedule targets. A significant study on hyperparameter optimization (HPO) on NeRF further confirms that these gains persist under matched search budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出针对隐式神经表示（INR）谱偏置的秩感知优化器：用子空间动量矩阵 + 渐进增长秩调度 + 秩感知学习率调度，加速粗到细收敛并提升高频细节重建质量。
AI.motivation: INR 训练天然呈现粗到细（先全局低频、后局部高频）的谱偏置，但标准优化器（Adam 等）对此无感知：动量缓冲区会累积并长期保留与早期主导低频方向不一致的梯度成分，从而拖慢后期高频细节的拟合。
AI.method: 在低秩子空间内维护动量矩阵（子空间式动量优化）；引入 progressively growing rank scheduler，随训练逐步扩展子空间秩以承接新的高频方向；配套 rank-aware learning-rate scheduler，在秩增长阶段维持峰值学习率，使新增子空间维度能有效贡献于细节恢复。
AI.result: 在图像拟合、单图超分（SISR）与 NeRF 优化三类任务上，收敛速度与峰值重建质量均优于竞争优化器；最大增益出现在高频精调阶段，与秩调度所针对的粗到细进程一致；NeRF 上等预算超参搜索（HPO）研究显示增益在同等搜索预算下依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 将 INR 的谱偏置显式编码进优化器设计（秩增长 + 学习率协同）是一种通用且即插即用的加速手段，可改善拟合、SISR 与 NeRF 的收敛与质量。

title: DoseSteer: Steering diffusion-based dose prediction models towards clinical targets via Dual-Response Guidance
summary: AI dose-prediction models generate patient-specific 3D dose distributions from patient anatomy. Yet these predictions can still miss structure-level clinical dose targets. Once deployed, most existing predictors offer no direct mechanism to correct such deviations, deferring target enforcement to downstream plan optimization. We introduce DoseSteer, an inference-time framework that steers frozen diffusion-based dose prediction models towards specified clinical targets without retraining. To meet clinical targets while preserving overall dose prediction quality, we propose Dual-Response Guidance (DRG), a structure-centric algorithm that probes the model's responses to perturbations in each structure's noisy dose and context and jointly solves for per-structure steering strengths. Across five dataset-model configurations spanning three diffusion architectures and three datasets, DRG outperforms 12 training-free baselines under identical reference-derived target proxies, removing at least 97% of the target error, reducing the official dose error by 7.8% on average, and improving dose fidelity outside the steered structures. DoseSteer reconciles learned anatomical dose priors with explicit structure-level targets at test time, establishing a principled, training-free mechanism to refine AI dose predictions prior to plan optimization. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: DoseSteer: 免训练推理时框架，用 Dual-Response Guidance 引导冻结的扩散式剂量预测模型满足结构级临床剂量目标。
AI.motivation: 扩散式 AI 剂量预测虽能生成患者特异 3D 剂量分布，但常在结构层面偏离临床剂量目标；现有预测器部署后缺乏直接纠偏机制，只能依赖下游计划优化兜底。
AI.method: 在推理阶段对冻结的扩散剂量预测模型施加结构中心的引导：Dual-Response Guidance 分别探测模型对每个结构"噪声剂量"扰动与"上下文（解剖条件）"扰动的响应，联合求解各结构的引导强度，从而在不重训练的前提下把预测推向目标。
AI.result: 在覆盖 3 种扩散架构、3 个数据集的 5 组配置上，相同目标代理下优于 12 个免训练基线：消除至少 97% 的目标误差，官方剂量误差平均降低 7.8%，并改善非被引导结构的剂量保真度。
AI.conclusion: DoseSteer 在测试时调和了学习到的解剖先验与显式结构级目标，为计划优化前精修 AI 剂量预测提供了有原则的免训练机制。

title: DexEngine: Scaling Human Demonstrations into Physically Executable Whole-Robot Data
comment: Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL Data: this https URL
summary: A growing body of recent work addresses the retargeting of human hand-object demonstrations to robotic hands. To train whole-robot policies, however, the retargeted motions must be kinematically feasible and physically executable, and be produced efficiently at scale. We present DexEngine, a simulation pipeline that turns human manipulation data into train-ready, physically executable arm-hand trajectories. DexEngine first places each clip's hand-object motion where the arms can reach it, finds an arm motion that follows the human hands, and then corrects the motion in physics simulation with residual reinforcement learning. From nine human hand-object datasets, we generate about 5,200 clips for each of four dexterous hands, augmented into 65,000 trajectories (116 h) and 325,000 episodes (578 h) in total. Even with arms attached, DexEngine tracks objects more accurately than prior floating-hand methods and runs over 10x faster than RL-based ones. Policies trained on our data far outperform those trained on the same clips without physics correction or with the arms attached after a floating-hand correction, showing that fine-tuning data need physics correction. Mid-training on our data further improves them at equal fine-tuning budget, in simulation and on a real robot.

AI.tldr: DexEngine 构建仿真流水线，将人手-物体演示数据自动转化为机械臂+灵巧手可执行轨迹：先做可达性放置与手臂运动求解，再用残差强化学习在物理仿真中校正，规模化生成约52万条训练轨迹。
AI.motivation: 已有工作多将人手动作重定向到"悬浮"灵巧手，缺乏手臂、且动力学不可行；要训练整机策略，必须有运动学可行、物理可执行且能大规模高效生成的臂-手轨迹数据。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：(1) 对每个clip进行手-物运动的可达性放置（base/object placement），使机械臂能够到；(2) 求解跟随人手轨迹的逆运动学手臂运动；(3) 在物理仿真中用残差强化学习对整体运动进行修正，保证接触与可执行性。覆盖9个人手-物体数据集、4种灵巧手。
AI.result: 每只手约5,200条clip，扩充为65,000条轨迹（116小时）、325,000个episode（578小时）。带上手臂后物体跟踪精度仍优于前置的floating-hand方法，速度比基于RL的方法快10倍以上。对比实验显示：未经物理校正、或先做floating-hand校正再挂手臂的数据，训练出的策略明显弱于DexEngine数据；等微调预算下做mid-training也能在仿真与真机上进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 物理校正是手-物重定向数据用于整机策略训练的必要环节，DexEngine 提供了高效、可扩展的数据生成方案，可直接服务VLA/整机策略的预训练与微调。

title: LLMVC: Large Language Model-Guided Generative Video Compression
summary: Recent generative video methods achieve strong perceptual compression by encoding videos into compact latent representations and reconstructing them with powerful generative decoders. However, visual encoders must compress both high-level semantics and dense visual details into a unified latent space, which complicates entropy coding and decoding and may cause semantic drift under aggressive compression. In this work, we propose Large Language Model-Guided Video Compression (LLMVC), which leverages the summarization capability of frozen video large language models (Video-LLMs) to generate compact semantic tokens aligned with temporal latent slices for guiding video compression. Specifically, Hybrid Bidirectional Bimodal Attention (HBBA) enables bidirectional interactions between visual and semantic features during encoding and decoding. Semantic-Conditioned Cross-Attention (SCCA) incorporates semantic features into probability modeling during entropy coding. These semantic features provide high-level guidance throughout the pipeline, improving representation quality and encouraging semantic consistency through a transmitted text side channel. Experiments on UVG, MCL-JCV, and HEVC show that LLMVC consistently improves compression performance over traditional and recent neural video compression methods in terms of LPIPS and DISTS, while also achieving better fidelity than recent perceptual codecs.

AI.tldr: LLMVC uses frozen Video-LLM-generated semantic tokens, temporally aligned with latent slices, to guide both encoding/decoding (via Hybrid Bidirectional Bimodal Attention) and entropy-coding probability modeling (via Semantic-Conditioned Cross-Attention), plus a text side channel for semantic consistency.
AI.motivation: Generative video codecs must pack high-level semantics and dense detail into one latent space, complicating entropy coding and degrading decoding under aggressive compression; the authors want explicit semantic guidance to stabilize representation quality and semantic consistency.
AI.method: Pipe dense visual tokens and compact semantic tokens from a frozen Video-LLM into a hybrid bidirectional bimodal attention module for joint visual–semantic interaction in the encoder and decoder, and inject the semantic features into entropy-coding probability models through semantic-conditioned cross-attention; semantic tokens are transmitted as a text side channel.
AI.result: On UVG, MCL-JCV and HEVC, LLMVC improves LPIPS and DISTS against traditional and recent neural video compression baselines, and beats recent perceptual codecs on fidelity.
AI.conclusion: Frozen Video-LLM semantic tokens are a cheap, effective prior for neural video compression, giving an interpretable textual side channel and better perceptual quality; applicability is limited to video coding, with no robotics/perception experiments.

title: DFLAT: Model-based Diffusion on Differentially Flat Spaces for Long-Horizon Trajectory Optimization
summary: Long-horizon diffusion-based planning for kinodynamically constrained systems requires both scalability and feasibility, yet existing diffusion planners typically sacrifice one for the other. We present DFLAT, a diffusion-based planning algorithm that operates directly on a differentially flat trajectory representation. Instead of diffusing over time-discretized controls, DFLAT denoises a compact set of Hermite curve parameters in the flat-output space, consisting of intermediate waypoints together with the endpoint tangents of each segment. Every denoised sample maps to a dynamically consistent trajectory, so feasibility holds by construction rather than being restored afterward. Experiments on challenging tractor-trailer planning benchmarks show that DFLAT matches or exceeds the success rates of existing baselines at consistently lower planning times, particularly on long-horizon problems requiring multiple forward-reverse maneuvers. In cases where kinodynamic RRT requires over 100 seconds, DFLAT plans in subsecond time, enabling practical deployment.

AI.tldr: DFLAT: 在微分平坦输出空间中扩散 Hermite 曲线参数（中间航点+各段端点切线）的轨迹规划器，每个采样天然满足运动学/动力学约束，无需事后修复可行性。
AI.motivation: 长时域、受运动学动力学（kinodynamic）约束系统的扩散规划需同时满足可扩展性与可行性，但现有扩散规划器往往二选一：在时间离散控制上扩散导致维度高、不可行样本需修复，或在简化空间扩散牺牲动力学一致性。
AI.method: 利用微分平坦性将轨迹表示为平坦输出空间中的分段 Hermite 曲线，仅对紧凑的曲线参数（各段端点及切线/中间航点）做扩散去噪；解码即映射为动态一致轨迹，可行性由构造保证。在 tractor-trailer 规划基准上验证。
AI.result: 在挑战性 tractor-trailer 基准上成功率匹配或超过现有基线，规划时间显著更低；在需要多次前进-倒车机动的长时域问题上优势明显，kinodynamic RRT 需 >100s 的场景 DFLAT 亚秒级完成。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散生成空间与微分平坦轨迹参数对齐是兼顾可扩展性与可行性的有效范式，可实现亚秒级长时域 kinodynamic 规划；但仅在单一非完整约束车辆仿真基准上验证，缺少实机部署与开源信息。

title: SEEL: Towards End-to-End 3D Sign Generation with Language Models
summary: 3D sign language generation aims to produce signing motion from written text. Motivated by the linguistic nature of sign language, recent methods combine a motion tokenizer with a language model to predict motion tokens from text. However, both components are optimized through a two-stage pipeline with mismatched objectives: the tokenizer minimizes reconstruction error in isolation, while the generator learns from rigid one-hot reference tokens. A straightforward end-to-end extension bridges discrete token selection with straight-through estimators (STE), suffering from biased gradients and codebook collapse. To address these limitations, we propose SEEL, an end-to-end framework that aligns tokenization and generation with motion quality through two complementary mechanisms. First, to overcome rigid one-hot supervision, reconstruction-aware generation decodes candidate tokens in context and converts their 3D motion errors into soft targets, guiding the generator with physical motion quality. Second, to propagate generation feedback without STE, generation-aware tokenization passes continuous codebook expectations through the frozen generator, routing generated-motion gradients to the tokenizer to prevent codebook collapse. Combining both mechanisms enables the tokenizer and generator to co-evolve, achieving state-of-the-art performance on CSL-Daily, How2Sign, and Phoenix-2014T. Code and models will be released to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: SEEL：端到端联合优化动作分词器与文本生成器，用重建误差构造软目标、用码本期望反向传递生成梯度，避免STE梯度偏差与码本塌缩，在三个手语数据集上SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有3D手语生成采用两阶段管线：分词器仅最小化重建误差，生成器从刚性one-hot参考token学习，二者目标不一致；简单端到端接入STE会带来有偏梯度和码本塌缩。
AI.method: 提出SEEL框架，含两个互补机制：(1) 重建感知生成——在上下文中解码候选token，将其3D动作误差转为软目标，用物理动作质量监督生成器；(2) 生成感知分词化——将连续码本期望通过冻结生成器前传，把生成动作梯度回流至分词器，替代STE以抑制码本塌缩。
AI.result: 两机制组合使分词器与生成器协同演化，在CSL-Daily、How2Sign、Phoenix-2014T上取得SOTA；代码与模型将开源。
AI.conclusion: 以重建质量作软监督、以生成梯度反哺分词器，可有效替代STE实现离散token化-生成任务的端到端联合训练，思路可迁移至其他离散token化生成范式。

title: VivaWorld: Long-Horizon Video World Model With Compositional 3D Priors
summary: Long-horizon video generation is key to interactive world modeling, physical intelligence, and spatial reasoning, yet maintaining geometric consistency and accurate camera control remains challenging without 3D grounding. We introduce \textbf{VivaWorld}, a framework for generating geometry- and view-consistent long videos from an image. We first construct a compositional hybrid 3D representation that combines reconstructed point clouds, which preserve observed scene geometry and appearance, with generated textured meshes, which provide complete object geometry across $360^\circ$ novel views. We also introduce a connected-region filter removing inconsistent floating components for robust cross-view reconstruction and propose a hybrid camera embedding that combines global and object-anchored Plücker rays to capture both scene-level camera motion and camera-object relationships, and inject it together with the visual guidance into a video generation model via a control adapter. Extensive experiments show VivaWorld achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and camera control, while supporting controllable novel-view synthesis, long-horizon scene exploration, and physical AI. Project page is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: VivaWorld 以图像为输入，构建"重建点云 + 生成纹理网格"的组合式混合 3D 表示，并配合连通域过滤与全局/物体锚定 Plücker 射线混合相机嵌入，通过控制适配器驱动视频生成模型，实现几何与视角一致的长时程新视角视频生成。
AI.motivation: 长时程视频生成在交互式世界建模、物理智能与空间推理中很关键，但缺乏 3D grounding 时难以保持几何一致性与精确相机控制；单目输入下重建点云又存在未见区域缺失与漂浮伪影问题。
AI.method: 1) 组合式混合 3D 表示：重建点云保留观测几何与外观，生成式纹理网格补全 360° 物体几何；2) 连通域过滤剔除不一致漂浮分量，提升跨视角重建鲁棒性；3) 混合相机嵌入：全局 + 物体锚定 Plücker 射线，刻画场景级相机运动与相机-物体关系；4) 将相机嵌入与视觉引导经 control adapter 注入视频扩散生成模型。
AI.result: 实验显示在视觉质量与相机控制上达到 SOTA，并支持可控新视角合成、长时程场景探索以及物理 AI 相关应用。
AI.conclusion: 将显式 3D 代理（点云+网格）与混合相机条件引入视频生成，是获得长时程几何一致性与精确视角控制的有效途径，可作为具身/世界模型中的场景推演与数据来源。

title: Learning from Natural Images Untangles Number Sense
summary: Numerical cognition is a simple yet fundamental ability that remains challenging for modern vision-language models. Meanwhile, number sense is already present in numerically naïve animals, suggesting that it can emerge without explicit numerical learning. Deep neural networks provide a related observation, with numerosity-selective units appearing after training on unrelated natural-image tasks and even before any training. However, these findings leave unresolved whether visual learning contributes beyond the spontaneous emergence of numerical selectivity. Human development provides a clue, as children become better at making judgments in which numerosity and proportion conflict. Here, we introduce a geometric framework to trace how representations of these two quantities change across learning. Although untrained and pretrained networks exhibited similar unit-level numerosity selectivity and basic comparison performance, natural-image pretraining increased the angle between numerosity and proportion subspaces while reducing their overlap, supporting more robust readout under conflict. Direct manipulation of these geometric properties further demonstrated their functional contributions to decoding accuracy and functional independence. Importantly, conventional supervised pretraining was not essential for quantity separation, which also emerged through self-supervised learning without category labels and synthetic-image training without natural-image exposure. Together, our findings suggest that structured visual learning can refine spontaneously emerging number sense into robust and functionally independent quantity representations without explicit numerical training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出几何框架，追踪视觉学习过程中“数量(numerosity)”与“比例(proportion)”两种表征的变化，发现自然图像预训练可增大两个子空间夹角、减少重叠，从而在冲突情境下实现更稳健的解码。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉-语言模型数值认知能力薄弱，而未经数值训练的网络已自发涌现出数量选择性单元，因此核心问题是：视觉学习本身是否在自发选择性之外还带来额外贡献。人类儿童在数量与比例冲突条件下的判断改善提供了线索。
AI.method: 构建几何分析框架，将数量与比例表征视为子空间并度量其间夹角与重叠度；比较未训练网络、自然图像预训练网络在单元级数量选择性与比较任务上的表现；通过在冲突刺激下的读出测试及对几何性质的直接干预（操纵）验证其功能作用；并检验自监督学习与合成图像训练是否同样产生数量分离。
AI.result: 未训练与预训练网络的单元级数量选择性和基础比较能力相近；但自然图像预训练显著增大数量子空间与比例子空间的夹角并降低重叠，使冲突条件下的读出更稳健；直接操纵几何性质可因果性地改变解码精度与功能独立性；监督预训练并非必需，自监督学习与合成图像训练亦能产生数量-比例分离。
AI.conclusion: 结构化视觉学习可将自发涌现的数字感精炼为稳健且功能独立的分量表征，无需显式数值训练；子空间几何（夹角与重叠）是刻画数量表征功能独立性的有效解释量，对VLM数值能力提升具有启发意义。

title: Greedy Decoding Hides Good Plans: Sample-and-Verify Planning for Vision-Language Driving Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly adopted for end-to-end driving planning, yet their performance is typically evaluated based on a single greedily decoded trajectory. However, greedy decoding may overlook better trajectories within the model's output distribution. Experiments on WOD-E2E and NAVSIM reveal a consistent performance gap between greedily decoded trajectories and the best sampled candidates, showing that planning errors can arise from trajectory selection, rather than trajectory generation alone. On WOD-E2E, when the ego vehicle should start moving, the model often assigns probability to different possible start times, causing greedy decoding to repeatedly favor waiting and produce a stationary plan even though moving trajectories are available. Motivated by these findings, we propose Sample-and-Verify (SaV), which keeps the VLM planner frozen and samples multiple candidate trajectories. A lightweight verifier is trained from ground-truth futures to estimate the relative quality of these candidates. It uses trajectory kinematics, candidate-set agreement and likelihood, and ego-motion features to select the final trajectory. On WOD-E2E, SaV reduces ADE and FDE by approximately 15% across three VLM planners on the validation set. Changes in RFS are smaller: two planners show slight decreases on val-456, while Alpamayo-1.5 improves from 7.74 to 7.81 RFS on the official test set as ADE@5s decreases by 11%. On NAVSIM, SaV reduces ADE@4s by 10-24% across three VLM planners, while PDMS changes are less consistent. These results show that trajectory selection can substantially improve displacement accuracy without additional planner training. The code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 针对VLM端到端驾驶规划的贪心解码选择偏差问题，提出Sample-and-Verify (SaV)：冻结规划器采样多条候选轨迹，用由真值未来训练的轻量verifier（轨迹运动学、候选集一致性/似然、自车运动特征）择优。
AI.motivation: VLM驾驶规划通常只按单条贪心解码轨迹评估与部署，但贪心解码可能忽略输出分布中的更优轨迹；实验显示贪心轨迹与最优采样候选间存在稳定差距，说明规划误差部分源于"轨迹选择"而非"轨迹生成"（如起步时刻概率分散导致贪心偏向静止等待）。
AI.method: SaV框架：VLM规划器完全冻结，从中采样多条候选轨迹；从ground-truth futures监督训练一个轻量verifier，估计候选相对质量；输入特征包括轨迹运动学、候选集一致性（agreement）与似然、自车运动特征，据此选出最终轨迹。无需额外规划器训练。在WOD-E2E与NAVSIM上以三种VLM规划器验证。
AI.result: WOD-E2E验证集上ADE/FDE相对三款VLM规划器下降约15%；RFS变化较小（val-456上两款略降），Alpamayo-1.5在官方测试集RFS由7.74升至7.81，同时ADE@5s下降11%。NAVSIM上ADE@4s下降10–24%，但PDMS变化不一致。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹选择后处理即可显著提升位移精度且无需重训规划器，但RFS/PDMS等综合安全指标收益不稳定，说明verifier偏向平均位移而非安全性/舒适性；后续需将安全与因果一致性纳入verifier目标。

title: Interpreting Speckle Effects Through Neuron Interventions
summary: Speckle, the multiplicative noise inherent to synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging, reduces the performance of pretrained SAR models. We use interpretability methods to examine its effects inside pretrained vision models. We identify neurons that respond selectively to speckle and test whether correcting their activations improves reconstruction. We study SARMAE, an Earth observation model pretrained on a million-scale SAR dataset. Synthetic scenes with known reflectivity allow us to measure recovery precisely. The model contains 38 speckle-selective neurons that track speckle's value distribution. Restoring these neurons to their clean values does not improve reconstruction. Activation patching across layers shows that the first MLP has the largest restoration and injection effects. Within this layer, a different set of 64 neurons recovers 44.1\% of the correlation loss on held-out scenes. When the speckle-selective neurons are held at their noisy values, 96.5\% of this gain remains, while holding the values of three decoder heads removes 37.4\%. In an ImageNet-pretrained MAE, restoration is most effective in the third MLP block. On manipulated Sentinel-1 and Capella images, the same 64 neurons also improve reconstruction, whereas for land-cover classification, only restoring the entire first MLP yields a clear gain. The neurons that respond most to speckle are therefore not the ones the model uses to recover the scene.

AI.tldr: 用可解释性方法（神经元识别+激活替换）分析SAR预训练模型中的斑点噪声效应，发现"斑点选择性神经元"并非重建所用神经元，真正的重建功能集中在首个MLP的64个其他神经元中。
