AI.motivation: 斑点（乘性噪声）会损害预训练SAR模型性能，但模型内部如何处理斑点噪声缺乏机制层面的理解，作者希望借助可解释性工具定位噪声影响的具体位置。
AI.method: 以百万级SAR数据预训练的SARMAE为对象，在反射率已知的合成场景上做可控实验。步骤：(1)识别对斑点敏感的神经元（38个）；(2)将其激活替换为无噪值；(3)跨层activation patching衡量恢复效应与注入效应；(4)在ImageNet预训练MAE上做对照；(5)在真实Sentinel-1/Capella图像及土地覆盖分类任务上验证迁移性。
AI.result: 38个斑点选择性神经元忠实追踪斑点分布，但恢复其干净值并不能改善重建。首个MLP的恢复/注入效应最大；该层内另一组64个神经元可挽回留出场景44.1%的相关性损失。冻结斑点神经元的噪声值时该增益仍保留96.5%，而冻结三个解码头的值则损失37.4%。ImageNet-MAE中最有效的是第三个MLP块。真实SAR图像和分类任务上效应不同：64神经元能改善重建，分类仅在整体恢复首个MLP时才有明确增益。
AI.conclusion: "对斑点响应最强的神经元"与"模型实际用于场景恢复的神经元"并不重合，说明特征显著性不等同于因果功能位置；首层MLP的少数（64个）神经元承载主要去噪-重建功能，为SAR模型修补与选择性微调提供了靶点。

title: FreshVLA: Frequency-Regularized Time Scale Hierarchical Latent Actions for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Learning reusable latent actions from action-free videos offers an effective route to improving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies. However, reconstruction-oriented latent actions do not necessarily benefit policy learning: as they may encode task-irrelevant static appearance with scene identity, or entangle slowly varying task progress with fine-grained execution dynamics in limited discrete code. We propose FreshVLA, a VLA framework built on a frequency-guided, dynamics-sensitive learning paradigm for acquiring temporally hierarchical continuous latent actions. FreshVLA uses a high-pass prior to guide visual transition encoding toward dynamical regions, thereby reducing reliance on static appearance cues. It further organizes latent actions into coarse-grained task progress and fine-grained execution dynamics through cross-timescale sampling and frequency-domain regularization, enhancing their capacity to represent long-horizon behaviors. During policy training, we freeze the pretrained latent action encoder and transfer its representations to robot control through joint flow-matching of latent and robot actions. FreshVLA achieves 98.2% average success on LIBERO and 98.0% on LIBERO-Long, exceeding GR00T-N1.6 on the latter by 3.6%. It also reaches an average sequence length of 4.52 on CALVIN and strong overall success rate of 80.4% in the zero-shot LIBERO-PLUS evaluation. Furthermore, FreshVLA exhibits greater robustness to visual perturbations and a more distinct division of roles between two branches in modeling low- and high-frequency motion, respectively. In 35-step action regression, it achieves a 51.3-percentage-point higher relative error reduction than its hierarchical discrete counterpart. Real-world experiments demonstrate that FreshVLA improves the average success rate over $\pi_{0.5}$ by 7.5%. The FreshVLA project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: FreshVLA: 用高通先验引导的视觉变化编码 + 跨时间尺度采样与频域正则，从无动作视频中学习分层连续隐动作，冻结编码器后联合流匹配迁移到机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 面向重建目标的隐动作往往编码任务无关的静态外观（场景身份），且在有限离散码本中把缓慢变化的任务进度与细粒度执行动态纠缠在一起，因此对策略学习帮助有限。作者希望获得"动态敏感、时间分层"的连续隐动作表示。
AI.method: 1) 高通先验引导视觉转场编码，把表征聚焦到动态区域、抑制静态外观；2) 跨时间尺度采样 + 频域正则，将隐动作解耦为粗粒度任务进度与细粒度执行动态，形成分层连续隐动作；3) 策略训练时冻结隐动作编码器，通过隐动作与机器人动作的联合 flow matching 完成迁移；4) 分析显示两支路分别建模低频与高频运动，角色分工清晰。
AI.result: LIBERO 平均成功率 98.2%，LIBERO-Long 98.0%（比 GR00T-N1.6 高 3.6%）；CALVIN 平均序列长度 4.52；零样本 LIBERO-PLUS 80.4%；对视觉扰动更鲁棒；35 步动作回归中相对误差下降比分层离散版本高 51.3 个百分点；真机较 π0.5 平均成功率提升 7.5%。
AI.conclusion: 频率引导与动态敏感的隐动作学习可显著提升隐动作的可用性与可迁移性，且连续分层表示优于分层离散量化；在仿真基准与真机上均验证有效。

title: What Is Redundant at High Resolution? Efficient Attention and Feed-Forward Design for All-in-One Image Restoration
summary: Multi-scale architectures are widely adopted in all-in-one image restoration (AIO-IR) to capture larger-scale context at low-resolution stages and refine details at high-resolution (HR) stages. However, processing spatially large feature maps at HR stages incurs substantial computational costs and memory traffic, making efficient HR processing challenging. To address this challenge, we propose High-resolution Global-Local Restoration (HiGLR), an efficient multi-scale AIO-IR network grounded in an analysis of spatial redundancy in self-attention and convolutional feed-forward networks (ConvFFNs). Specifically, this analysis identifies three key redundancies: per-query readout at the finest-scale stage, key routing across neighboring queries at intermediate stages, and spatial mixing in the expanded feature spaces of ConvFFNs. Accordingly, HiGLR replaces costly self-attention at the finest-scale stage with a learned input-independent kernel. At intermediate stages, we propose a Block-Routed Hybrid Attention, which combines coarse-scale dense attention with fine-scale block-sparse attention over value residuals relative to coarse summaries, and shares routing indices across neighboring queries. We further introduce a Dual-Space FFN that performs spatial mixing in a compact space and pointwise nonlinear transformation in an expanded space, enabling efficient kernel fusion. Combining these designs, HiGLR achieves state-of-the-art performance while delivering up to a $4.24\times$ inference speedup over existing methods.

AI.tldr: Multi-scale all-in-one图像复原网络HiGLR，通过分析自注意力与ConvFFN的空间冗余，用学习式输入无关核、块路由混合注意力和双空间FFN替换高分辨率阶段的高开销算子，实现SOTA且最高4.24倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 多尺度AIO-IR在高分辨率阶段处理大尺寸特征图时计算与显存开销巨大，高效HR处理困难；需从空间冗余角度重新设计算子。
AI.method: 识别三类冗余：(1) 最细尺度阶段的逐query读出，(2) 中间阶段相邻query间的key路由重复，(3) ConvFFN扩展特征空间中的空间混合。对应设计：用输入无关的学习核替代最细尺度自注意力；中间阶段提出Block-Routed Hybrid Attention，将粗尺度稠密注意力与基于value残差的细尺度块稀疏注意力结合并跨相邻query共享路由索引；Dual-Space FFN在紧凑空间做空间混合、在扩展空间做逐点非线性，便于算子融合。
AI.result: 在AIO-IR任务上达到SOTA性能，相较现有方法推理加速最高4.24倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于冗余分析的高效多尺度设计可在不损失复原质量下显著降低HR阶段开销，为高效图像复原提供可复用范式；属通用低层视觉效率优化。

title: CariesBench: A Hierarchical Multi-view Benchmark for Dental Caries Screening and Diagnostic Reasoning from 3D Intraoral Scans
summary: Dental caries assessment is a structured clinical process requiring lesion localization, identification of the affected tooth and surface, and severity grading rather than simple image-level recognition. 3D intraoral scans (IOS) preserve detailed dental geometry and surface morphology and support standardized rendering from complementary viewpoints, enabling fine-grained visual assessment while introducing a distinct need for anatomically grounded multi-view reasoning. Despite recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and dental vision-language benchmarks, existing evaluations do not jointly assess hierarchical arch-to-tooth-to-surface reasoning, cross-view evidence integration, and surface-level caries assessment. To address this gap, we introduce CariesBench, a hierarchical benchmark constructed from 5,932 3D IOS, comprising 85,455 standardized multi-view renderings and 133,994 clinically grounded visual question answering instances with expert quality control. CariesBench comprises three complementary task families: Arch-level Clinical Screening (ACS), Tooth-level Diagnostic Reasoning (TDR), and Structured Clinical Decision-Making (SCD). Using the CariesBench training set, we further fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct to obtain IntraoralGPT. Extensive evaluation of 24 representative baseline MLLMs reveals a substantial benchmark-level performance disparity between arch-level screening and tooth-level diagnostic reasoning, with higher accuracy on ACS than on TDR. CariesBench-specific supervision substantially improves the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct baseline, increasing the 19-task macro-average clinical accuracy from 52.7% to 69.5% and TDR Overall from 34.4% to 44.7%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CariesBench——基于5,932例3D口内扫描（IOS）、85,455张标准化多视角渲染图和133,994条经专家质控的临床VQA实例构建的分层牙科龋病评测基准，含Arch级筛查（ACS）、牙级诊断推理（TDR）与结构化临床决策（SCD）三类任务；并用其训练集微调 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 得到 IntraoralGPT。
AI.motivation: 龋病评估是需定位病灶、识别患牙与牙面、并对严重程度分级的结构化临床流程，而非简单图像级识别。3D IOS 保留精细牙体几何与表面形态，并支持互补视角的标准化渲染，从而引入"解剖学基础上多视角推理"的需求。现有牙科多模态基准未联合考察 牙弓–牙–牙面 的层级推理、跨视角证据整合与牙面级龋病评估。
AI.method: 构建 CariesBench：5,932 例 3D IOS → 85,455 张标准化多视角渲染 → 133,994 条临床落地的 VQA 实例，专家质控；划分 ACS（牙弓级临床筛查）、TDR（牙级诊断推理）、SCD（结构化临床决策）三个互补任务族，共19项子任务。再用训练集微调 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 得到 IntraoralGPT。
AI.result: 评测24个代表性 MLLM 基线，发现牙弓级筛查与牙级诊断推理之间存在显著的基准级性能落差（ACS 准确率明显高于 TDR）。基准专属监督使 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的19任务宏平均临床准确率由 52.7% 提升至 69.5%，TDR Overall 由 34.4% 提升至 44.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是面向牙科垂直领域的层级化多视角 VQA 基准与监督微调方案，揭示当前 MLLM 在细粒度、解剖接地推理上的系统性短板；对通用具身智能/物理AI方向无直接方法贡献，属领域专用基准类工作。

title: Structure-Aware Multimodal Retrieval Under Data Scarcity, Privacy Constraints and Out-of-Domain Content
summary: Purpose: Figure retrieval from reference atlases in expert domains like forensic pathology, dentistry and geology must work without labels or training pairs, on content that often cannot leave local hardware, and on images outside the training data of image-text encoders. This work proposes a structure-aware pipeline that satisfies all three, retrieving figures through the page structure recovered by layout geometry and a local open-weight 8B VLM. Methods: A geometry-based pairing method is introduced, in which the model receives a schematic of the detected boxes and selects each picture's caption without access to pixels or text. Caption retrieval is evaluated on three private corpora (29 books, 10,421 figures, 218 queries) with blind human grading, against a lexical baseline, generated descriptions and five image-text encoders. Results: Geometric pairing was correct for 96%, 92% and 77% of pictures in the three domains, against 76%, 45% and 53% for the better of two document parsers. A hosted model given the schematic was equally accurate, while coordinates as text lost 22 points. Caption retrieval obtained an nDCG@5 of 0.85, 0.87 and 0.76, against 0.54, 0.51 and 0.27 for the best cross-modal encoder and 0.41, 0.28 and 0.30 for generated descriptions. Pairing errors carried over to retrieval. Conclusion: The proposed pipeline achieves accurate figure retrieval with small local models and no in-domain training, where general and biomedical image-text encoders fall far behind. Its geometry-only pairing is the most accurate of five methods and exposes no content, even to a hosted model. Code and prompts are released.

AI.tldr: 提出无标签、无需训练对、本地部署的"结构感知"图表检索管线：用版式几何构造box示意图，由本地8B VLM选择图注完成图文配对，再做图注检索。
AI.motivation: 法医病理、牙科、地质等专家领域的图谱检索缺少标注与训练对，内容不能离开本地硬件，且图像常落在图像-文本编码器的训练分布之外，现成跨模态编码器失效。
AI.method: 几何配对：将检测框渲染为示意图（不含像素与文字）输入本地开源8B VLM，令其选择每张图的对应caption；在此基础上由VLM生成/检索描述完成图注检索。在3个私有语料（29本书、10,421图、218查询）上以盲评方式与词法基线、生成式描述、5种图像-文本编码器及两种文档解析器对比；并检验坐标以文本形式输入的影响。
AI.result: 几何配对正确率达96%/92%/77%，优于两种文档解析器中较好者的76%/45%/53%；托管模型输入示意图精度相当，而坐标文本输入掉22个点。检索nDCG@5为0.85/0.87/0.76，最佳跨模态编码器仅0.54/0.51/0.27，生成式描述0.41/0.28/0.30；配对误差会传导到检索。
AI.conclusion: 小规模本地模型、无域内训练即可实现高精度图表检索；纯几何配对无需暴露任何图像内容，且为五种方法中最准确。代码与提示词开源。

title: Linear-Time Online Visual Geometry Transformer with Hybrid Architecture
summary: Transformer-based 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT and $\pi^3$ predict cameras, depth and point maps directly from many input views. Causal attention models such as StreamVGGT extend them to online video but cache all past tokens, so their total compute grows quadratically with the stream length. Recurrent models such as CUT3R and TTT3R keep a fixed-size state at constant cost, but they progressively forget early geometry. We present LinearVGGT, a hybrid model distilled from StreamVGGT, which uses Mamba2 layers for efficient sequence modeling in three of every four global layers. The remaining layers use register-guided sparse attention to retrieve a few relevant past frames, compensating for the limited exact long-range recall of Mamba2. Our distillation needs only 9\% of the GPU hours and 31\% of the training frames that StreamVGGT uses to learn from VGGT. LinearVGGT keeps an almost constant latency of 27 ms per frame over 1,024 frames and is on average $12 \times$ faster than StreamVGGT. It outperforms its teacher and is competitive with the state-of-the-art streaming model LingBot-Map, while running $2.5\times$ faster and using $2.7\times$ less memory.

AI.tldr: LinearVGGT通过将StreamVGGT四分之三的全局层替换为Mamba2、其余层用寄存器引导稀疏注意力检索少量历史帧，实现在线流式3D重建的近似恒定延迟与内存。
AI.motivation: 因果注意力流式模型（StreamVGGT）缓存全部历史token，计算随流长度二次增长；循环模型（CUT3R、TTT3R）虽恒定开销但会渐进遗忘早期几何。需同时兼顾长序列效率与精确长程召回。
AI.method: 混合架构：每四个全局层中三层用Mamba2做线性复杂度序列建模，剩余一层采用register-guided稀疏注意力，从过去帧中检索少量相关帧以补偿Mamba2有限的精确长程记忆。模型由StreamVGGT蒸馏得到，仅需后者从VGGT学习时9%的GPU小时与31%的训练帧。
AI.result: 1,024帧内延迟几乎恒定（27 ms/帧），平均比StreamVGGT快12×；性能超过教师模型，与SOTA流式模型LingBot-Map相当，同时速度快2.5×、内存少2.7×。
AI.conclusion: 混合Mamba2+稀疏检索注意力是兼顾流式3D重建效率与长程几何保持的可行路线，蒸馏成本低、可实际部署于长视频在线重建。

title: Fine-Grained Ego-Vehicle Action Recognition from Driving Video
summary: Fine-grained ego-vehicle action recognition turns large-scale driving video into structured, searchable driving scenarios, providing a foundation for discovering critical maneuvers and systematically developing and evaluating autonomous driving models. However, large-scale driving videos often lack explicit ego-action labels, and existing datasets vary in action definitions, annotation granularity, and available supervision. We introduce EgoManeuver, a unified benchmark of 16 lateral and 6 longitudinal actions constructed from seven public driving datasets. Our multi-source labeling system leverages existing annotations and complementary evidence available in each source dataset, including vehicle signals, ego poses, HD-map topology, and captions, to assign labels under a unified fine-grained action taxonomy. We further standardize temporal action boundaries across datasets and validate the resulting labels through kinematic consistency checks and targeted human review. The resulting benchmark contains 86.6K segments spanning 190.8 h across 26 countries and provides a long-tail-aware evaluation protocol. We also introduce DenseEgo, a video-based baseline that combines spatially aware representations with dense per-step action supervision. On the EgoManeuver, DenseEgo achieves 82.7 lateral and 83.5 longitudinal mAP, outperforming the strongest existing video model by 1.5 and 5.0 points, respectively. Finally, we demonstrate one way to integrate DenseEgo with a language-model agent for retrieving driving videos that match user-specified actions and scenarios. All code, datasets, and model weights will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: EgoManeuver: 一个统一的自车细粒度动作识别基准（16类横向+6类纵向动作，来自7个公开驾驶数据集，86.6K片段/190.8小时/26国），并配套提出DenseEgo视频baseline（空间感知表示+逐步稠密动作监督）与长尾评估协议。
AI.motivation: 大规模驾驶视频缺乏显式自车动作标签，且现有数据集在动作定义、标注粒度与可用监督形式（车辆信号、位姿、HD地图拓扑、文本描述）上高度不一致，阻碍了动作级检索与自动驾驶模型的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建多源标注系统：利用各源数据集已有的互补证据（CAN车辆信号、自车位姿、HD-map拓扑、caption）在统一细粒度动作分类体系下赋标；标准化跨数据集的时序动作边界；通过运动学一致性检查与定向人工复核验证标签。提出DenseEgo baseline：将空间感知表示与每步稠密动作监督结合的纯视频模型，并集成LLM agent做动作/场景检索。
AI.result: 基准含86.6K片段、190.8小时、覆盖26国，提供长尾感知评估协议；DenseEgo在横向/纵向动作上分别达82.7/83.5 mAP，较最强现有视频模型提升1.5/5.0点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作主要贡献是统一基准与标注流程，方法层面为驾驶视频动作识别提供稠密监督基线及agent式检索示例，属自动驾驶感知/数据侧成果，与具身导航、VLA、世界模型等核心方向关联有限。

title: Recall4D: Forgetting, Not Misalignment, Limits Long-Horizon Feed-Forward 4D Reconstruction
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Feed-forward 4D trackers recover camera motion, depth, and point trajectories from short video clips, but chaining windows over long videos degrades their accuracy. We find that replacing inter-window alignment with ground-truth transforms leaves tracking error essentially unchanged. Static-point error instead grows with time since last observation: repeatedly predicting a static point from windows that no longer observe it corrupts previously recovered geometry. We call this failure forgetting. Merely retaining the last observed positions of unseen points reduces error by 26% on PointOdyssey without modifying the tracker. We introduce Recall4D, a training-free framework that augments a frozen tracker with a persistent world state and sparse motion anchors. Static points retain their world-space positions outside the camera view and are refined by averaging observations decoded at sparse keyframes while in view. For dynamic objects, the tracker decodes sparse representative anchors, while geometric skinning propagates their displacements to dense queries. Across two long-horizon benchmarks, Recall4D improves the accuracy of its backbone while running 7.6-9.0$\times$ faster, and its accuracy gains carry over to five further backbones and three other long-sequence tasks, demonstrating its generality.

AI.tldr: 提出 Recall4D：为冻结的前馈 4D 跟踪器外挂持久世界状态与稀疏运动锚点的免训练框架，解决长视频链式推理中的"遗忘"问题，精度提升且加速 7.6-9.0×。
AI.motivation: 前馈 4D 跟踪器（相机运动、深度、点轨迹）在短视频窗口上表现好，但长视频中逐窗口串联会精度下降。作者诊断出关键原因不是跨窗口对齐（换成 GT 变换误差几乎不变），而是"遗忘"：对已离开当前窗口视野的静态点反复预测，会破坏已恢复的几何。
AI.method: 免训练框架 Recall4D：给冻结跟踪器加持久世界状态 + 稀疏运动锚点。静态点在视野外保留其世界坐标，仅在可见的稀疏关键帧上解码并平均观测以精化；动态物体由跟踪器解码稀疏代表锚点，再用几何蒙皮（geometric skinning）把位移传播到稠密查询。基线仅保留未见点最后观测位置即可降 26% 误差。
AI.result: PointOdyssey 上仅保留最后观测位置即降误差 26%；两个长时序基准上较骨干精度提升，同时快 7.6-9.0×；增益可迁移到另外 5 个骨干与 3 种长序列任务。
AI.conclusion: 将"遗忘"识别为长视频 4D 跟踪的核心失效模式，用持久状态+稀疏锚点+蒙皮传播给出免训练、通用、高效的修复方案，具备良好可移植性。

title: Look at What Matters: Learning Lesion Prototypes from Severity Labels for Domain-Generalized Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
summary: Deep learning models for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading often generalize poorly to unseen imaging domains, in part because predictions may exploit correlations specific to source datasets rather than retinal pathology. We address this challenge by constructing grading decisions from lesion evidence learned using only image severity labels. Clinical implications of DR grades provide multiple instance constraints that guide competitive learning of lesion and background prototypes at multiple scales. An additive ordinal scoring model then predicts severity exclusively from individual lesion prototype responses, explicitly connecting learned evidence with grading decisions without a global feature classification pathway. To improve the reliability of this evidence, we introduce teacher guided preservation under image degradations and spatial regularization against persistent coordinate preferences. Across six public DR datasets under a leave one domain out protocol, our method attains a mean quadratic weighted kappa of 0.761, outperforming the strongest competing method by 0.036. Localization and prototype removal analyses show that the learned responses align with retinal lesions and contribute to grading decisions. Experiments across five other prototype architectures and under image degradations further demonstrate the generality and robustness of the approach.

AI.tldr: 提出基于病灶证据的原型竞争学习与加性序数评分模型，仅用图像分级标签实现糖尿病视网膜病变分级，跨六个公开数据集留一域外推平均QWK达0.761。
AI.motivation: 深度学习DR分级模型常利用源域数据集的伪相关而非视网膜病理特征，导致跨域泛化差；作者希望让分级决策直接由病灶证据构成而非全局特征分类。
AI.method: 利用DR分级标签隐含的多示例约束，在多尺度上竞争性学习病灶与背景原型；采用加性序数评分模型，仅由单病灶原型响应预测严重度，去除全局特征分类通路；引入图像退化下的教师引导保持与抑制坐标偏好的空间正则化。
AI.result: 在六个公开DR数据集留一域协议下平均二次加权Kappa为0.761，比最强对比方法高0.036；定位与原型移除分析表明学习响应与视网膜病灶对齐并参与分级决策；另在五种其他原型架构及图像退化条件下验证了通用性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 可解释原型证据驱动的加性评分结构能提升DR分级的跨域泛化与鲁棒性，且解释性与决策一致；但属于医学影像领域CV工作，对物理AI/机器人类研究仅有方法论借鉴价值。

title: MOVR-SAR: A Multi-resolution SAR Registration Dataset under Orbit-crossing and View-variant Imaging Differences
summary: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) image registration under varying acquisition geometries is challenging because orbit direction, look side, and incidence angle affect backscatter, terrain-induced distortion, and feature visibility. However, large-scale geometry-aware benchmarks remain scarce. This paper presents MOVR-SAR, a multi-resolution dataset of 450,845 registered and quality-screened tile pairs derived from 2774 scene pairs from Capella, Umbra, Sentinel-1, and NISAR. It covers X, C, and L bands, ground sampling distances of 0.25-20 m, and diverse regions and land-cover types. A unified framework defines four imaging-geometry pair categories from orbit direction and look side, plus viewing-angle-separation labels for Capella and Umbra, enabling stratified evaluation under same- and opposite-direction illumination. Systematic evaluation of representative matching methods shows that official and cross-modal pretrained weights perform poorly on high-resolution X-band imagery. Fine-tuning on MOVR-SAR improves accuracy and reduces disparities across platforms, imaging-geometry pair categories, and viewing-angle separations. For example, fine-tuning increases FlexGlue AUC@5 from 3.06% to 89.79% on Capella and from 1.79% to 89.03% on Umbra, reaching 93.41% and 94.77% on Sentinel-1 and NISAR, respectively. Fine-tuning substantially reduces the official-weight same-orbit, same-look-side advantage and reverses the three-method average category ranking on Capella, suggesting that this bias reflects training-data coverage rather than an invariant limitation of cross-geometry matching. Land-cover effects remain platform- and method-dependent. MOVR-SAR provides a training resource and geometry-aware benchmark for robust SAR-SAR registration. The dataset and model weights will be released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出MOVR-SAR多分辨率SAR图像配准数据集（来自Capella、Umbra、Sentinel-1、NISAR，450,845对配准瓦片，X/C/L波段，0.25-20 m GSD），并建立几何感知的统一评测框架与基线。
AI.motivation: 不同观测几何（轨道方向、侧视方向、入射角）会改变SAR后向散射、地形畸变与特征可见性，使跨几何SAR-SAR配准困难，而大规模、几何标注完备的基准数据集仍然稀缺。
AI.method: 构建2774个场景对、质量筛选后450,845个配准瓦片对的数据集；按轨道方向与侧视方向定义四类成像几何对，并为Capella/Umbra提供视角间隔标签；在此框架下分层评测代表性匹配方法，并进行微调实验以消除平台、几何类别与视角间隔间的性能差异。
AI.result: 官方权重及跨模态预训练权重在高分辨率X波段上表现很差；在MOVR-SAR上微调后FlexGlue AUC@5由3.06%提升至89.79%（Capella）、由1.79%提升至89.03%（Umbra），Sentinel-1与NISAR分别达93.41%与94.77%；微调显著削弱"同轨道、同侧视"的官方权重优势，并反转Capella上三方法平均类别排序。
AI.conclusion: 跨几何性能差异主要源于训练数据覆盖不足而非匹配方法的固有限制；MOVR-SAR提供了鲁棒SAR-SAR配准的训练资源与几何感知基准。

title: WorldUAV: Scaling UAV Data Synthesis via World Models
summary: UAV detection and tracking remain constrained by the scarcity of high-quality training data. Existing game-engine-based synthetic UAV data suffer from a substantial synthetic-to-real gap, while the high cost of manually collected real-world UAV data limits dataset scale. Therefore, we introduce WorldUAV, a high-quality UAV dataset constructed through an efficient framework powered by world models. Specifically, WorldUAV directly integrates UAVs into readily available real-world videos, naturally preserving realistic backgrounds, illumination, and scene dynamics. Leveraging the spatiotemporal priors of world models, it generates UAV videos with plausible motion, pose variations, and cross-frame consistency, effectively narrowing the gap between synthetic and real data. We further develop an agentic pipeline orchestrated by a multimodal large language model that acquires sources, plans UAV trajectories, invokes synthesis, and verifies generated videos, enabling fully automated dataset construction. WorldUAV comprises 6,878 UAV videos and 205,778 UAV images. Experiments show that WorldUAV significantly improves the performance of UAV detectors. Moreover, it substantially reduces dataset construction costs, requiring only 15 seconds and USD 0.0005 API cost per high-quality UAV image. Our work offers both a high-quality dataset and a scalable data generation paradigm for UAV detection and tracking.

AI.tldr: WorldUAV用世界模型把无人机直接合成进真实视频，并借MLLM智能体流水线自动构建大规模无人机检测/跟踪数据集，单张图像约15秒、0.0005美元。
AI.motivation: 无人机检测与跟踪受限于高质量训练数据稀缺：游戏引擎合成数据存在明显sim-to-real鸿沟，而真实无人机数据人工采集成本过高、规模受限。
AI.method: 提出基于世界模型的高效数据构建框架：将UAV无缝合成进现成真实视频以保留真实背景、光照与场景动态；利用世界模型的时空先验生成具有合理运动、姿态变化与跨帧一致的UAV视频；并构建由多模态大模型编排的智能体流水线，自动完成数据源获取、轨迹规划、合成调用与生成结果校验。
AI.result: 构建WorldUAV数据集，含6,878段UAV视频与205,778张UAV图像；实验显示显著提升UAV检测器性能，且每张高质量图像仅需约15秒与0.0005美元API成本。
AI.conclusion: 工作同时提供了高质量数据集与可扩展的数据生成范式，为UAV检测与跟踪研究提供低成本、自动化的合成数据方案。

title: Read Before You Use: Improving Visual Memory Utilization in Vision-Language Models
summary: Multimodal memory enables long-horizon vision-language agents to preserve and retrieve past experiences. While prior research has focused on memory construction and retrieval, effectively using the provided memory remains a challenge for vision-language models (VLMs). We find that VLMs often fail to answer downstream questions even when sufficient multimodal evidence is provided. To investigate why VLMs struggle, we replace memory images with reference captions and observe substantial performance gains, suggesting difficulties in reading visual evidence directly. However, model-generated captions may omit critical information, limiting this approach in practice. These limitations motivate a closer examination of memory utilization, revealing failures in both evidence reading and downstream question answering. Building on this distinction, we propose \textbf{MemRU}, a two-stage training framework that improves evidence reading through supervised fine-tuning (Read SFT) and downstream evidence utilization through Group Relative Policy Optimization (Use GRPO). Experimental results demonstrate that our 8B model generalizes across three unseen multimodal memory systems, outperforming Qwen3-VL-32B and approaching GPT-5-mini.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多模态记忆型VLM在证据已充分提供时仍答错，根源分为"读不懂视觉证据"与"不会用证据答题"两类失败，并提出两阶段训练框架MemRU：先用Read SFT提升证据阅读能力，再用GRPO提升下游证据利用能力，8B模型可跨三个未见多模态记忆系统泛化。
AI.motivation: 长程视觉语言智能体依赖多模态记忆保存和检索过往经验，但现有研究偏重记忆构建与检索，忽略了模型对已提供记忆的有效利用；实验显示即使给出充分多模态证据，VLM仍常无法正确回答下游问题。用参考描述替换记忆图像可显著涨点，说明瓶颈在于直接阅读视觉证据的能力不足，但模型自生成描述可能漏关键信息，故需从机制上区分并分别解决两类失败。
AI.method: 将记忆利用失败解耦为证据阅读与下游问答两个阶段；Read SFT用监督微调提升对图像证据的读取；Use GRPO用组相对策略优化提升在回答阶段对证据的使用；替换图像为参考描述的对照实验用于定位瓶颈。
AI.result: 8B模型在三个未见过的多模态记忆系统上取得跨系统泛化，性能超过Qwen3-VL-32B，并接近GPT-5-mini。
AI.conclusion: 记忆利用是可分解、可分别训练的能力维度，两阶段强化学习式训练能显著提升小模型的多模态记忆利用并具备跨系统泛化性。

title: GeoTex: Geometry-as-Texture Encoding and History-Grounded 4D Occupancy Forecasting
summary: 4D occupancy forecasting models 3D scene evolution to support future prediction and scenario generation in autonomous-driving world models. Semantic occupancy abstracts image color and texture into discrete labels, leaving 3D voxel arrangements as the primary cues for distinguishing local shapes within each class. Existing methods borrow image-encoding frameworks to obtain compact latent representations through height channelization or plane factorization, but do not sufficiently model within-column height patterns and cross-column relations jointly before compression, weakening these geometric cues. Forecasting also underutilizes complementary history and struggles to retain reliable observation evidence. We therefore propose GeoTex, an occupancy world model combining geometry-as-texture encoding with history-grounded forecasting. GeoTex Representation jointly encodes within-column height patterns and cross-column relations into compact continuous latent representations and restores 3D structure through content-dependent height unfolding and geometric interaction. GeoTex Prediction retains initial evidence throughout rollout in fixed cross-observation relational memory and incorporates complementary recent history through target-referenced residual updates. After prediction training, decoder-only adaptation improves semantic decoding of predicted states. GeoTex improves average forecasting mIoU and IoU by 9.79% and 11.91% relative to GenieDrive while reducing parameters from 3.47M to 2.33M, with gains increasing at longer horizons. Code is included in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: GeoTex：以“几何即纹理”编码+历史锚定预测的4D语义占据世界模型，先在压缩前联合建模列内高度模式与列间关系，并在滚动预测中用固定跨观测关系记忆保留初始证据，mIoU/IoU相对GenieDrive提升9.79%/11.91%，参数3.47M→2.33M。
AI.motivation: 4D占据预测需支撑自动驾驶世界模型的未来预测与场景生成。语义占据把颜色纹理离散为标签后，3D体素排布成为区分类内局部形状的主线索；但现有方法沿用图像编码框架，靠高度通道化或平面分解获得紧凑隐表示，在压缩前未充分联合建模列内高度模式与列间关系，削弱几何线索。预测端也未充分利用互补历史，难以保留可靠观测证据。
AI.method: 表示端：GeoTex Representation将列内高度模式与列间关系联合编码为紧凑连续隐表示，并以内容依赖的高度展开（content-dependent height unfolding）与几何交互恢复3D结构。预测端：GeoTex Prediction在固定跨观测关系记忆中全程保留初始证据，并通过目标参照的残差更新引入近期互补历史；预测训练后再用decoder-only适配提升预测状态的语义解码。
AI.result: 相对GenieDrive，平均预测mIoU提升9.79%、IoU提升11.91%，参数由3.47M降至2.33M，且长时域增益更明显。
AI.conclusion: 以几何结构为压缩前的首要建模对象、以历史证据为预测的锚点，可在更小参数下显著提升4D占据预测精度，且优势随预测时域延长而扩大，适合作为自动驾驶世界模型的高效几何表征与预测骨架。

title: Efficient Scene-Distribution-Aware Second-Order Optimization for 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to ACCV 2026
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) optimization updates the Gaussian parameters one training view at a time, tens of thousands of times. Unlike such single-view updates, multi-view batches reduce dependence on individual training views, and second-order optimization reduces the number of updates with larger, structured parameter changes. Because fewer updates leave fewer chances to correct a change that fits only the views used in one update, scene coverage becomes more important for each second-order update. Multi-view second-order updates, however, are expensive. Pixel sampling reduces this cost, but two issues remain. First, selecting views without considering overlap leaves some views redundant. To address this, we propose a view selection strategy that reduces this redundancy. Second, existing work processes the sampled pixels of each view in a separate pass and recomputes alpha compositing for these pixels from scratch. We introduce two implementation strategies that reduce both overheads by processing the sampled pixels of multiple views in joint passes and reusing the transmittance and accumulated color cached during rendering. On three datasets, our method reaches higher PSNR than the sampled second-order baseline in less than half its optimization time, with competitive SSIM and LPIPS.

AI.tldr: 提出多视图二阶优化的3DGS加速方案：基于视图重叠的选取策略减少冗余视图，并通过联合pass处理多视图采样像素、复用alpha合成过程中的透射率与累计颜色缓存，在三个数据集上以不到一半时间取得高于采样二阶基线的PSNR。
AI.motivation: 3DGS逐视图参数更新次数极多；多视图批处理+二阶优化可减少更新次数、利用更大结构化步长，但单次更新覆盖视图少导致纠错机会减少，故每次二阶更新需更好场景覆盖，而多视图二阶更新代价高昂，像素采样虽降本但存在视图冗余与逐视图重复计算的低效问题。
AI.method: 1) 考虑视图间重叠的视图选择策略，降低采样视图冗余；2) 两种实现策略：将多视图采样像素合并到联合pass中处理，并复用渲染阶段缓存的透射率(transmittance)与累计颜色，避免从头重算alpha合成。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，PSNR高于采样式二阶基线，优化时间不足其一半，SSIM与LPIPS具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过视图选择与联合像素处理、缓存复用，可在显著降低多视图二阶3DGS优化成本的同时提升重建质量，说明高效二阶更新对3DGS训练有实用价值。

title: Systematic study of the performance of small robots on controlled laboratory substrates
summary: The design of robots able to locomote effectively over a diversity of terrain requires detailed ground interaction models; unfortunately such models are lacking due to the complicated response of real world substrates which can yield and flow in response to loading. To advance our understanding of the relevant modeling and design issues, we conduct a comparative study of the performance of DASH and RoACH, two small, biologically inspired, six legged, lightweight (10 cm, 20 g) robots fabricated using the smart composite microstructure (SCM) process. We systematically examine performance of both robots on rigid and flowing substrates. Varying both ground properties and limb stride frequency, we investigate average speed, mean mechanical power and cost of transport, and stability. We find that robot performance and stability is sensitive to the physics of ground interaction: on hard ground kinetic energy must be managed to prevent yaw, pitch, and roll instability to maintain high performance, while on sand the fluidizing interaction leads to increased cost of transport and lower running speeds. We also observe that the characteristic limb morphology and kinematics of each robot result in distinct differences in their abilities to traverse different terrains. Our systematic studies are the first step toward developing models of interaction of limbs with complex terrain as well as developing improved limb morphologies and control strategies.

AI.tldr: 对比研究两款小型仿生六足机器人（DASH 与 RoACH，10 cm、20 g，SCM 工艺）在刚性地面与可流动沙地（颗粒基质）上的运动性能，揭示足-地相互作用物理特性对速度、机械功率、运输代价与稳定性的影响。
AI.motivation: 机器人要在多样地形上高效运动，需要精确的地面相互作用模型；但真实基质在受载时会屈服与流动，缺乏可用模型。为此需要通过对比实验厘清足-地相互作用的建模与设计问题。
AI.method: 构建/选用两款基于智能复合微结构（SCM）工艺制造的轻量六足机器人，在刚性与流动基底上系统扫描地面性质与步频两个自变量；测量平均速度、平均机械功率、运输代价（cost of transport）与稳定性（偏航/俯仰/滚转），并比较两机器人肢体形态与运动学差异带来的影响。
AI.result: 机器人性能与稳定性对地面相互作用物理高度敏感：硬地面上需管理动能以抑制偏航、俯仰、滚转失稳以维持高性能；沙地上流化式相互作用导致运输代价升高、奔跑速度下降。两机器人因肢体形态与步态运动学不同，跨越不同地形的能力存在明显差别。
AI.conclusion: 该系统性对比研究是对“足-复杂地形相互作用模型”以及改进肢体形态与控制策略研究的第一步；尚属定性经验规律层面，未提出可用的定量接触模型。

title: Lab2Sim: Agentic Generation of Interactive Laboratory Equipment from Operation Videos
summary: Generating laboratory assets that faithfully reproduce the appearance, structure, and joint motions of real equipment remains challenging. Existing asset generation methods struggle to directly generate simulation assets for all equipment observed in operation videos and to faithfully reproduce the appearance, joint motions, and internal cavities of the real equipment. To address the challenge, we present Lab2Sim, an agentic framework that generates editable, simulation-ready laboratory equipment assets from egocentric or multi-view operation videos. Lab2Sim comprises four specialized agents. The Evidence Agent combines video observations with laboratory knowledge to specify equipment parts, materials, and functional requirements, which guide the Asset Agent in constructing editable Blender assets. The independent Verifier checks the generated geometry and appearance against the evidence and requirements, providing targeted feedback for revision. The Simulation Integration Agent converts verified Blender assets into simulation instances with physical properties and articulated mechanisms, using execution feedback to refine their behavior. Experiments on human and robot laboratory scenes show that Lab2Sim achieves higher visual fidelity and stronger interaction capability than coding-agent and real-to-sim baselines, including a Codex baseline using the same underlying model. We further demonstrate valve-controlled drainage and use the generated asset library to reproduce laboratory scenes and operations in RoboTwin, supporting reusable simulation environments for robotic laboratory tasks.

AI.tldr: Lab2Sim: 一个由四个专用智能体（Evidence / Asset / Verifier / Simulation Integration）组成的框架，从第一人称或多视角操作视频生成可编辑、可直接仿真的实验室器材资产（Blender 资产 + 关节机构 + 物理属性）。
AI.motivation: 现有资产生成方法难以从操作视频直接为所有器材生成仿真资产，且难以忠实还原真实器材的外观、关节运动与内部空腔；而机器人实验室任务需要可复用、可交互的仿真环境与资产库。
AI.method: Lab2Sim 四智能体流水线：(1) Evidence Agent 结合视频观测与实验室知识，明确部件、材料与功能需求；(2) Asset Agent 依据需求构建可编辑 Blender 资产；(3) 独立 Verifier 对照证据与需求检查几何与外观，给出定向反馈用于迭代修正；(4) Simulation Integration Agent 将已验证资产转为带物理属性与铰接机构的仿真实例，并利用执行反馈精修行为。属于"多步规划—工具调用—迭代评估修正"的智能体驱动资产生成范式。
AI.result: 在人类与机器人实验室场景的实验中，Lab2Sim 在视觉保真度与交互能力上优于 coding-agent 与 real-to-sim 基线（含使用同一底层模型的 Codex 基线）；进一步演示了阀门控制排水任务，并用生成的资产库在 RoboTwin 中复现实验室场景与操作流程。
AI.conclusion: 智能体式、带验证闭环的视频到仿真资产生成可产出可编辑、可铰接、可复用的仿真资产库，支撑机器人实验室任务的可复用仿真环境构建；但评测主要停留在仿真内复现，尚缺真实机器人闭环部署验证。

title: $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM: Efficient Hierarchical Memory Across Modalities and Timescales for World-Action Models
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires historical context, yet retaining extensive visual histories incurs growing storage and retrieval costs, while aggressive compression risks losing fine-grained information needed for subsequent decisions. Moreover, executed action histories capture intermediate behaviors that sparse visual observations may miss. Preserving this complementary context efficiently calls for modality-specific memory mechanisms that balance recent detail with long-term retention. To this end, we introduce $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM, a world-action model equipped with hierarchical visual and interaction memories. $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM preserves recent visual observations in dense short-term memory while consolidating entries evicted from this window into fixed-size associative long-term memory through gated delta updates. Within the same short- and long-term hierarchy, interaction memory encodes executed action prefixes into compact temporal representations, complementing visual observations with behavioral context. These complementary memories are integrated into world-action modeling through layer-wise retrieval, enabling memory-augmented action generation with a bounded online memory footprint independent of episode length. On the memory-dependent simulation benchmarks MIKASA-Robo and RMBench, $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM achieves +53.2% and +61.2% absolute improvements in average success rates over Fast-WAM, respectively. These gains extend to real-world manipulation, where $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM achieves a +29.3% absolute improvement over LingBot-VA in average success across three tasks. These results suggest that $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM offers a promising approach to efficient memory-augmented world-action modeling.

AI.tldr: M²-WAM：为长时程机器人操作的世界-动作模型引入分层视觉与交互记忆（稠密短期帧窗口+门控delta更新的定长联想长期记忆，动作前缀编码为时序表征），逐层检索融入建模，在线内存占用与回合长度无关；仿真与真机成功率大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 长时程操作需要历史上下文，但保留完整视觉历史带来存储与检索成本，激进压缩又会丢失细粒度信息；此外仅靠稀疏视觉观测难以捕捉已执行动作序列中的中间行为，因此需要模态特异、兼顾近期细节与长期保留的记忆机制。
AI.method: 分层记忆设计：近期视觉观测存于稠密短期记忆，被逐出窗口的条目通过门控delta更新整合进固定容量联想长期记忆；交互记忆在同一短/长期层级内将已执行动作前缀编码为紧凑时序表征；两类互补记忆通过逐层检索注入世界-动作模型，实现有界内存的在线动作生成。
AI.result: MIKASA-Robo与RMBench上相对Fast-WAM平均成功率绝对提升+53.2%与+61.2%；真机三任务平均成功率较LingBot-VA绝对提升+29.3%。
AI.conclusion: 模态特异的记忆层级可显著提升长时程世界-动作建模效率与性能，且真机迁移有效，为内存高效的记忆增强VLA/WAM提供可行路径；缺点在于未开展内存开销与消融的量化讨论。

title: Nepali Currency Denomination Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and MobileNetV2: An Experimental Comparison
summary: Automated currency denomination recognition is a computer vision task with applications in cash handling, financial technology, and assistive systems. This study classifies seven Nepali currency denominations (Rs. 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, and 1,000) using three configurations: a conventional convolutional neural network (CNN), MobileNetV2 with transfer learning, and MobileNetV2 with hyperparameter tuning. A compiled dataset of 16,249 images was used, comprising 10,500 training, 3,500 validation, and 2,249 independent test images. Images were resized to 128 x 128 pixels, normalized, and augmented to vary orientation, scale, illumination, and appearance. Models were evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and precision-recall and ROC analysis. The hyperparameter-tuned MobileNetV2 achieved the highest validation accuracy (95\%), with precision, recall, and F1-score of 0.93, 0.91, and 0.92, but reached only 84\% accuracy on the held-out test set. MobileNetV2 with transfer learning but no additional tuning achieved 89\% test accuracy, and the conventional CNN achieved 85\%. Transfer learning therefore provided a competitive approach under the evaluated conditions, while higher validation accuracy from tuning did not yield higher test accuracy. To demonstrate practical deployment, a Flask-based web prototype using TensorFlow Lite was developed, supporting image upload and live webcam recognition with both visual and voice output. The study shows the feasibility of combining lightweight deep learning with a voice-assisted web interface for Nepali currency recognition, and highlights the need for more diverse datasets, greater robustness under uncontrolled imaging conditions, and broader real-world evaluation.

AI.tldr: 用常规CNN、MobileNetV2迁移学习与MobileNetV2超参调优三种配置对七种尼泊尔纸币做分类，调优模型验证集95%但测试集仅84%，迁移学习版测试89%，并开发了基于Flask+TensorFlow Lite的语音辅助网页原型。
AI.motivation: 自动货币面额识别在现金处理、金融科技与辅具系统中有应用需求；作者希望验证轻量级深度学习配合语音网页界面对尼泊尔纸币识别的可行性。
AI.method: 构建16,249张（10,500训练/3,500验证/2,249独立测试）数据集，图像缩放至128×128并归一化，做旋转、尺度、光照与外观增强；对比传统CNN、MobileNetV2迁移学习、MobileNetV2超参调优三种配置；用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1及PR/ROC曲线评估；以Flask+TensorFlow Lite部署支持上传与摄像头实时识别、视觉与语音输出。
AI.result: 超参调优MobileNetV2验证准确率最高（95%，P=0.93、R=0.91、F1=0.92），但留出测试集仅84%；未调优的迁移学习版测试准确率89%，常规CNN为85%。验证集优势未转化为测试集优势，提示过拟合/分布差异。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习在本文条件下是具竞争力的方案；验证了轻量深度学习加语音辅助Web界面的可行性，但需更丰富多样的数据、更强的不受控成像鲁棒性以及更广泛的真实场景评测。

title: A general-purpose safe manipulator planning framework for diverse environments without retraining
comment: 46 pages, 7 figures; main text and supplementary materials
summary: Nowadays, robots need to be retrained whenever their operating environment changes, and this prohibitive training cost keeps them far from daily use. The community is calling for innovations that bestow on a robot the ability to safely grasp different objects under different conditions without excessive training data and computing power. In response to this call, we present a general-purpose manipulator mission-planning framework, allowing a robot to safely perform manipulation tasks, such as grasping objects that fit in its gripper, across different operating environments without retraining its controllers. The framework rests on two innovations: a finite-state abstracted model, bisimilar to the original system dynamics, that describes accessibility of the space in front of the robot under its given arm and gripper, and a block-conservative specification generation method that turns each manipulation task under any specific operational environment into specifications about state accessibility of the abstracted model. A task proven feasible and safe on the abstracted model is guaranteed to be safe and achievable by the robot. Real-world case studies conducted on a Unitree G1 U1 humanoid show that manipulation tasks commonly encountered in daily life, such as grasping an object, pressing an elevator button or picking up a berry, can be handled within this framework, where an abstracted model of the G1 U1 robot is built only once to avoid costly model reconstructions, and different tasks are simply captured by specific block-conservative specifications, achievable by a generic mission planner with vision-based feedback control.

AI.tldr: 提出通用机械臂任务规划框架：用与原系统动力学双相似的有限状态抽象模型描述可达性，并通过"块保守"规格生成将各类抓取任务转化为状态可达性约束，使机器人无需重训练即可在不同环境中安全完成任务。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作环境变化即需重新训练控制器，训练成本过高阻碍日常部署；需要无需大量数据与算力即可在不同环境下安全抓取不同物体的通用方法。
AI.method: 两项核心创新：(1) 与原始动力学双相似(bisimilar)的有限状态抽象模型，刻画给定臂与夹爪下机器人前方空间的可达性；(2) 块保守(block-conservative)规格生成方法，将任意操作环境下的操作任务转化为抽象模型的状态可达性规格。在抽象模型上证明可行且安全的任务，可保证真实机器人安全可达。抽象模型仅构建一次，配合视觉反馈的通用任务规划器执行。
AI.result: 在 Unitree G1 U1 人形机器人上开展真实案例研究：抓取物体、按电梯按钮、拾取浆果等日常操作任务均可由同一抽象模型 + 不同块保守规格完成，无需重建模型或重训练，验证了跨环境免重训练的安全性。
AI.conclusion: 通过双相似抽象与规格自动生成，将环境相关的控制器重训练问题转化为任务规格重写问题，为通用机械臂任务规划提供了保证安全性的形式化路径；真实人形平台验证了其实用性。

title: Practice Makes Fluent: Learning to Use Earlier Predictions in Looped Models
summary: People become faster at a task through practice, but models that improve with experience do not necessarily learn to use less computation. We train looped models, whose intermediate predictions allow earlier exits, to perform tasks with fewer iterations through practice. This is difficult because shared-weight updates can degrade the final-loop prediction while improving early ones, and the exit gate must track early predictions as their quality changes. We propose FLUENT, which requires no additional task labels or rewards: it distills the initial model's final-loop prediction into early predictions, anchors the current final-loop prediction to the same frozen teacher, and trains the exit gate to balance disagreement with the current final-loop prediction against computation cost. FLUENT improves performance at shallower depth in new Crafter worlds, raises LIBERO success with fewer action-head iterations, and maintains language-model accuracy at lower selected depth. On a real robot, success rises from 62.3\% to 74.6\% while mean time over successful episodes falls from 69\,s to 31\,s. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: FLUENT：无需额外标签或奖励，通过蒸馏冻结教师的末层预测 + 门控损失，使循环（looped）模型经"练习"学会用更少迭代/更浅深度完成任务，并在真实机器人上同时提升成功率与降低耗时。
AI.motivation: 人类通过练习会变得更快，但"随经验改进"的模型并不必然学会减少计算。循环模型天然带有中间预测、可提前退出，然而联合训练共享权重时，改善早期预测可能损害末层预测，且退出门控需随早期预测质量漂移而动态跟踪——这是把"推理效率随练习提升"落地的两个核心障碍。
AI.method: 训练循环模型以减少迭代次数：(1) 将初始（未适应）模型的末层预测蒸馏到早期迭代的预测中，作为稳定目标；(2) 将模型当前末层预测锚定到同一冻结教师，防止共享权重更新破坏终点质量；(3) 将退出门控的训练目标设为"与当前末层预测的分歧"与"计算成本"之间的权衡，使门控随早期预测质量变化自动对齐。整个流程不依赖额外任务标签或奖励信号。
AI.result: 在新的 Crafter 世界中浅层深度性能提升；LIBERO 中在更少动作头迭代下成功率上升；语言模型在更低选中深度下保持精度；真实机器人上成功率由 62.3% 提升至 74.6%，同时成功回合平均耗时从 69 s 降至 31 s。
AI.conclusion: 自适应计算在循环架构中可通过自蒸馏 + 门控一致性约束实现"自适应加速"，兼顾精度与推理代价，且不依赖额外监督；在仿真操控与真机部署上均验证了效率—成功率双赢，为机器人策略的运行时计算分配提供了通用且可直接迁移的训练范式。

title: VTK-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Distinguishing Language Priors and Text Modal Bias in Visual Language Models
summary: Visual language models (VLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities across various multimodal tasks, but they remain susceptible to hallucinations, undermining their reliability. Existing hallucination benchmarks primarily focus on identifying hallucinations and describing their manifestations, often neglecting their underlying causes. Specifically, multimodal hallucinations can stem from two distinct failure modes: text modality bias (TMB), reflecting an over-reliance on misleading text input; and language prior (LP), reflecting a reliance on previously learned knowledge. To differentiate these failure modes, we propose VTK-Bench, a benchmark that explicitly separates three information sources: visual information (V), textual information (T), and prior knowledge (K). By establishing mutually exclusive answers corresponding to V, T, and K, VTK-Bench enables fine-grained attribution analysis of model responses. Furthermore, we introduce discrete attribution and soft attribution metrics to characterize information source preferences. Extensive experiments on 11 representative open-source VLMs show that LP is more prevalent than TMB in most evaluated models. Notably, TMB decreases substantially with model scaling, whereas LP exhibits relatively limited improvement and remains the dominant failure mode. These findings highlight the importance of different information source preferences for a deeper understanding of multimodal hallucinations.

AI.tldr: 提出VTK-Bench基准，通过分离视觉(V)、文本(T)、先验知识(K)三类信息源并设置互斥答案，对VLM多模态幻觉做细粒度归因；在11个开源VLM上发现语言先验(LP)比文本模态偏置(TMB)更普遍，且随模型规模扩大改善有限。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态幻觉基准多停留在"识别幻觉及表现形式"，缺乏对幻觉成因的归因分析。作者将失败模式区分为文本模态偏置(TMB，过度依赖误导性文本输入)与语言先验(LP，依赖已学知识)两类，希望定量区分二者。
AI.method: 构建VTK-Bench：显式分离视觉信息V、文本信息T、先验知识K三源，并为三者设计互斥的候选答案，使模型回答可被精确归因到某一信息源；同时提出离散归因(discrete attribution)与软归因(soft attribution)两种指标刻画模型的信息源偏好。在11个代表性开源VLM上进行实验，并按模型规模做缩放分析。
AI.result: 多数被评估模型中LP比TMB更普遍；随模型规模增大，TMB显著下降，而LP改善有限并持续成为主导失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了VLM幻觉中不同信息源偏好的差异性，强调理解信息源偏好对深入解释多模态幻觉的重要性；同时指出仅靠扩大参数规模难以消除语言先验导致的幻觉。

title: RoboJackVR: Turning Robot Tasks into VR Games for Scalable Demonstration Collection
summary: Scaling robot demonstration datasets requires collection systems that accommodate more participants and diverse tasks, yet teleoperation barriers and task-adaptation effort limit this expansion. We present RoboJackVR, a standalone virtual reality (VR) game in which players manipulate simulated robots to execute combat skills and contribute demonstrations. MuJoCo simulation and demonstration recording run locally on the headset, removing the need for an external PC or simulation server during collection. Tutorials, skill selection, combat consequences, and character progression organize repeated task attempts within a continuing game. Task contracts declare assets, controls, resets, success criteria, and recording semantics; separate game configurations specify guidance, attempt groups, skill effects, and course placement. Shared bindings connect these declarations to task execution, outcome handling, and recording, allowing tasks to reuse the game flow while retaining their control and success semantics. Batch tools package supported resources and generate configurations, with manual adaptation and review for new interfaces and unsupported predicates. We instantiate the approach with SO101-Nexus-derived and LIBERO tasks. On the 66 LIBERO-90 tasks covered by the collected data, ACT policies trained solely on VR demonstrations retain approximately 91% of the full-standard simulation-demonstration baseline's success rate on held-out initial states, averaged over four training seeds. These results support the utility of play-collected VR demonstrations for policy learning in this setting.

AI.tldr: RoboJackVR 是一个独立运行的 VR 游戏，玩家在头显端本地 MuJoCo 中操控模拟机器人执行战斗技能并贡献演示数据；通过任务契约/游戏配置/共享绑定的双层抽象，任务可复用同一游戏流程；在 66 个 LIBERO-90 任务上，仅用 VR 演示训练的 ACT 策略达到全量标准仿真演示基线的约 91% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 规模化机器人演示数据需要更多参与者和更丰富的任务，但遥操作门槛高、任务适配成本大，限制了数据采集的扩展；同时采集系统通常依赖外部 PC 与仿真服务器，进一步抑制参与规模。
AI.method: 构建独立 VR 游戏 RoboJackVR：MuJoCo 仿真与演示录制在头显本地运行，无需外部 PC/服务器；以教程、技能选择、战斗后果与角色成长组织重复尝试，形成持续游玩循环；设计任务契约（资产、控制、重置、成功判据、录制语义）与游戏配置（引导、尝试分组、技能效果、关卡布置）分离的声明式结构，并用共享绑定连接任务执行、结果处理与录制，使不同任务复用游戏流程同时保留各自控制与成功语义；提供批处理工具打包资源并生成配置，对新接口和不支持的谓词辅以人工适配与审核。
AI.result: 在基于 SO101-Nexus 与 LIBERO 的任务实例化中，覆盖 LIBERO-90 的 66 个任务；仅用 VR 演示训练的 ACT 策略在留出初始状态上、四个训练种子的平均成功率约为全标准仿真演示基线的 91%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"游戏化 VR 游玩采集"作为策略学习演示来源的有效性，为低门槛、可扩展的机器人数据采集提供了可复用架构。

title: PROVE: Predict-to-Specify and Observe-to-Verify for Human-Aligned Evaluation of Mobile Manipulation
summary: Judging open-world robot manipulation is hard because layouts, articulated fixtures, and valid goal configurations vary widely. On RoboCasa365, simulator predicates agree with human judgments on only 69.09\% of rollouts, and a frontier VLM judge on 86.12\%. We present \textbf{PROVE} (Predict-to-Specify, Observe-to-Verify), which first specifies what success should look like and then checks the outcome. PROVE refines success conditions from the instruction, the initial scene, a target-object reference image, and a generated goal image. The goal image only sharpens the conditions and never serves as evidence. On 6,500 human-annotated rollouts over 65 atomic actions, PROVE reaches \textbf{96.83\%} agreement. Applied to open-source policies, it reports far lower success than native checks and changes their ranking. To reduce evaluation overhead in policy learning, we distill PROVE into \textbf{PROVE-Lite}, a 4B evaluator that needs no reference images. In one forward pass, PROVE-Lite predicts the outcome and the terminal state of each task condition. It reaches \textbf{91.20\%} agreement while running about 38$\times$ faster than PROVE. Mapped to a severity-aware reward, its diagnoses improve PPO post-training over both simulator and binary rewards.

AI.tldr: PROVE：先用指令、初始场景、目标物体参考图与生成的目标图"预测"成功条件，再"观察"验证结果；目标图只用于细化条件、不作为证据。在6500条人工标注rollout上达96.83%一致率，并蒸馏出无需参考图的4B评估器PROVE-Lite（91.20%，约38倍加速），其严重度感知奖励可改善PPO后训练。
AI.motivation: 开放世界机器人操作的成功判定困难：布局、铰接装置、合法目标构型变化大。在RoboCasa365上模拟器谓词与人类判断仅69.09%一致，前沿VLM裁判也只有86.12%，说明现有自动评估不可靠，进而污染策略学习的奖励信号。
AI.method: 提出Predict-to-Specify, Observe-to-Verify框架：①给定指令、初始场景、目标物体参考图和生成的目标图，由模型先显式写出可验证的成功条件，目标图仅用于锐化条件而非判定依据；②在观测到的终态上逐条核查条件得出判定。进一步将PROVE蒸馏为PROVE-Lite：4B评估器，无需参考图，单次前向同时预测结果与每个任务条件的终态状态；并将判定结果映射为严重度感知奖励用于PPO。
AI.result: 65个原子动作、6500条人工标注rollout上PROVE达96.83%一致率，显著优于模拟器谓词（69.09%）与前沿VLM裁判（86.12%）。应用于开源策略时报告的成功率远低于原生检查且改变策略排序。PROVE-Lite达91.20%一致率，比PROVE快约38倍；其严重度奖励使PPO后训练优于模拟器奖励与二值奖励。
AI.conclusion: 将"成功判定"重构为"先规格化条件、后证据核验"，可有效抑制VLM裁判的幻觉与目标图泄漏式作弊；蒸馏后的轻量评估器在可接受的精度损失下满足策略训练的效率需求，并提供可用的稠密严重度信号。该工作属于评估/奖励建模方向，对开放世界操作的真实落地具有直接价值。

title: DualCast: Dual-Image Conditioned Diffusion Transformers for Digital Human E-Commerce Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in world models for game interaction and control have increased the demand for large-scale gameplay videos paired with camera trajectories. However, capturing synchronized camera trajectories often requires game-specific pipelines, limiting scalability. We therefore propose GameWeaver, a unified diffusion framework that automatically produces paired video--camera data through three complementary tasks: camera pose estimation from observed video, video generation along a prescribed camera trajectory, and joint video--camera generation from a reference image and text. First, each tipxel stores the normalized 3D coordinates of a pixel ray's endpoint in a reference coordinate frame. The resulting three-channel tipxel fields and RGB frames share the pretrained video model's VAE. Next, a fully trainable dual-stream Transformer exchanges appearance and geometry features through bidirectional gated attention and conditions both streams on shared text features. Finally, deterministic fitting recovers camera intrinsics and normalized trajectories from generated tipxel fields. In our evaluation tasks, GameWeaver achieves a normalized translation MSE of 0.0029 for camera control; for joint generation, it scores 85.48 out of 100 on instruction adherence versus 64.71 for the best cascade on that metric, validating the feasibility of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: GameWeaver：统一扩散框架，用"tipxel"（像素射线端点归一化3D坐标）三通道场作为几何表示，与RGB共享VAE，双流Transformer双向门控注意力交互外观与几何，统一实现相机位姿估计、轨迹条件视频生成、图像+文本联合生成视频-相机数据。
AI.motivation: 世界模型与游戏交互训练需要大规模视频-相机轨迹配对数据，但现采集依赖游戏专用管线，难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出tipxel表示（每像素射线端点在参考坐标系下的归一化3D坐标），构成三通道字段并与RGB共用预训练视频VAE；完全可训练双流Transformer，通过双向门控注意力交换外观/几何特征，并以共享文本特征调制两流；生成后确定性拟合恢复内参与归一化轨迹。三任务互补：位姿估计、轨迹条件生成、参考图+文本联合生成。
AI.result: 相机控制归一化平移MSE 0.0029；联合生成指令遵循度85.48/100，优于最佳级联方案64.71。
AI.conclusion: 验证了以tipxel几何场+双流扩散统一建模视频与相机轨迹的可行性，可规模化生成配对视频-相机数据，服务世界模型训练。

title: RegHarness: Regulating What Code-as-Policy Agents Keep from Steps to Skills
summary: Code-as-Policy agents generate, execute, and revise robot programs, but often lack explicit mechanisms to govern what persists across executions: which actions are retained within a trial and which code modifications carry over to subsequent runs. This leaves two critical aspects of agent behavior insufficiently controlled: step-level execution and cross-run adaptation. We present RegHarness, a two-level harness that governs both forms of persistence for the RATs agent team, without relying on a vision-language-action (VLA) policy or demonstrations. Within each trial, run-time governance evaluates each proposed step from a reset scene, replaying the committed steps, while a fixed-rule controller commits the step only when both RATs' verifier and a task-long LLM auditor approve it. Between runs, a coding agent uses logged failures to develop and test revisions to skills, primitives, and rules, which remain disabled by default until explicitly enabled by the authors. Using a single low-cost model across all run-time roles, RegHarness achieves an 87.8% success rate (158/180) on paired LIBERO-PRO trials, compared with 39.4% for RATs, and a 72.0% success rate on MolmoSpaces trials. A $2\times2$ ablation study of RegHarness's two levels shows that its skill refinement alone increases RATs' successful trials from 71 to 135, whereas run-time governance alone achieves 105 and RATs' native stepwise reset-and-replay mode achieves only 46. These findings suggest that, for Code-as-Policy agents operating with low-cost models, task success depends not only on how generated programs are executed, but also on the quality of the reusable skills they invoke and how those skills evolve across runs.

AI.tldr: RegHarness 提出一个"双层治理"框架，显式控制 Code-as-Policy 智能体在单次试验内的步骤持久化（step-level commit）与跨运行的代码/技能持久化（skill evolution），仅用低成本 LLM 即在 LIBERO-PRO 上达 87.8%（RATs 39.4%）。
AI.motivation: Code-as-Policy 智能体（如 RATs）虽能生成、执行、修改机器人程序，但缺乏显式机制决定"哪些动作在试验内被保留""哪些代码改动带入后续运行"，导致步骤级执行与跨运行自适应都失控；且通常依赖 VLA 策略或专家演示，成本高。
AI.method: 1) 试验内 run-time governance：从重置场景出发，逐步回放已提交步骤，由固定规则控制器把关，仅当 RATs 验证器与任务级 LLM auditor 同时通过才 commit 该步；2) 运行间 skill refinement：编码智能体依据日志中的失败开发并测试对 skills/primitives/rules 的修订，默认禁用，需显式启用；3) 全运行期角色共用单一低成本模型，不使用 VLA 或演示。作者还做了 2×2 消融分离两层贡献。
AI.result: LIBERO-PRO 配对试验成功率 87.8%（158/180）vs RATs 39.4%；MolmoSpaces 72.0%。消融：仅技能精炼使成功试验 71→135；仅运行时治理 105；RATs 原生逐步 reset-and-replay 仅 46。
AI.conclusion: 对低成本模型驱动的 Code-as-Policy 智能体，任务成功率不仅取决于程序如何被执行（步骤级校验/回放），还取决于所调用可复用技能的质量及其跨运行演化；两层机制互补，缺一不可。

title: Teaching Students to Stand on Their Own: Distilling Vision Foundation Models for Fine-Grained Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Fine-grained few-shot class-incremental learning (FG-FSCIL) aims to incrementally learn visually similar new classes from limited images without catastrophic forgetting. Prior work typically learns strong representations on base classes or leverages vision foundation models (VFMs) directly as backbones or via knowledge distillation. However, VFM backbones incur high computational costs and do not guarantee fine-grained recognition. Although knowledge distillation reduces inference cost, our preliminary experiments reveal that distilled students still lag substantially behind their VFM teachers, particularly on new classes. To address this limitation, we propose STAND, a systematic VFM-to-student distillation design tailored for FG-FSCIL. Specifically, STAND connects the teacher and student by equipping the student with a fixed copy of the teacher's classifier, aligning their outputs via projectors, and feeding both models composite images that combine different training images. On these composite images, relation distillation matches how the teacher and the student relate each image to other images, while difference distillation matches how this relation changes between two composite images. Finally, we freeze the student and classify new classes using length-calibrated prototypes, which restore the reduced similarity of few-shot prototypes. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that STAND achieves state-of-the-art performance across FG-FSCIL datasets at low computational cost, while generalizing across student backbones and broader datasets.

AI.tldr: STAND 提出面向细粒度小样本类增量学习（FG-FSCIL）的系统性 VFM-to-学生蒸馏框架：让学生共享教师分类器、用投影器对齐输出、在合成图像上做关系蒸馏与差异蒸馏，并用长度校准原型分类新类，实现低成本 SOTA。
AI.motivation: FG-FSCIL 中直接用视觉基础模型（VFM）做骨干计算开销大且不保证细粒度识别；仅靠知识蒸馏降本后，学生在新类上仍显著落后教师。因此需要一套针对 FG-FSCIL 的完整 VFM→学生蒸馏设计，在低成本推理下缩小师生差距。
AI.method: 1) 学生共享教师分类器的固定副本，并用投影器对齐师生输出；2) 输入由不同训练图像合成（composite images）的样本；3) 关系蒸馏对齐教师/学生对“该图与其他图”的关系结构，差异蒸馏对齐两个合成图像之间关系的变化；4) 冻结学生，用长度校准（length-calibrated）原型对少样本新类分类，修正原型相似度偏低问题。
AI.result: 大量实验显示 STAND 在多个 FG-FSCIL 数据集上以低计算成本取得 SOTA，并可跨学生骨干与更广数据集泛化。
AI.conclusion: 将 VFM 能力以关系/差异蒸馏方式迁移到轻量学生，并结合校准原型的原型分类，是兼顾精度与效率的 FG-FSCIL 有效范式。

title: Spectral Colorimetry Based on GMoE for Temperature Measurement in Explosion Fields
summary: Spectroscopic thermometry in explosion fields has attracted considerable attention in related engineering domains, primarily because it can mitigate the interference of traditional contact methods with temperature distributions and address the limitations of high-temperature measurement scenarios. However, existing physics-model-driven methods typically rely on regressing a single radiance-ratio pair, which limits their adaptability to wide-range temperature estimation. This limitation arises from notable variations in the mapping between grayscale ratios and radiance ratios at different temperatures. In contrast, existing data-driven methods often suffer from limited performance due to the scarcity of training data, a challenge exacerbated by the sensitivity of explosion fields. In this work, we propose a gated mixture of experts (GMoE) framework that integrates a divide-and-conquer strategy in deep learning with physical prior knowledge for temperature estimation, thereby decomposing the complex task into multiple expert-specific subtasks. Specifically, each expert is developed using physically calibrated polynomial functions to model the relationship between grayscale ratios and radiance ratios for a given pair of spectral bands, with temperature then estimated using a physical model incorporating the corresponding parameters. Additionally, a gating network is designed to adaptively weight the outputs of different experts and generate the final temperature estimate. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves the best performance when implemented with the Transformer-based gating network, yielding a mean RMSE of $12.70 \pm 1.32$ K and a mean MAE of $7.96 \pm 0.86$ K. Compared with conventional spectral colorimetry, the proposed framework reduces the mean RMSE and MAE by 63.4\% and 70.8\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出门控专家混合(GMoE)框架，将爆炸场光谱测温任务分解为多专家子任务，每个专家用物理标定多项式建模灰度比-辐射度比映射并由物理模型反演温度，门控网络自适应加权融合，Transformer门控实现RMSE 12.70±1.32 K、MAE 7.96±0.86 K，较传统光谱比色法降低63.4%和70.8%。
AI.motivation: 爆炸场光谱测温中，物理模型驱动方法仅回归单一辐射度比配对，因不同温度下灰度比-辐射度比映射关系差异显著而难以覆盖宽温域；数据驱动方法则受爆炸场数据稀缺限制，性能不足。
AI.method: 分治式门控专家混合框架：每个专家针对特定光谱波段对，用物理标定的多项式函数建模灰度比到辐射度比的映射，再以含该参数的物理模型反演温度；门控网络自适应地对各专家输出加权，生成最终温度估计，并比较了Transformer等不同门控结构。
AI.result: 采用Transformer门控时效果最佳，平均RMSE 12.70±1.32 K、平均MAE 7.96±0.86 K；相对传统光谱比色法，RMSE与MAE分别下降63.4%与70.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将物理先验与深度学习分治策略结合的GMoE框架，可在小样本条件下实现宽温域爆炸场高精度非接触测温，验证了物理模型与专家混合结构融合的有效性。

title: VAPOR: Improving Multimodal Reasoning with Sparse Visual Updates
comment: 19 pages, including appendix. Code: this https URL
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in visual reasoning, but extended generation over large visual contexts remains computationally expensive. During autoregressive decoding, visual attention is recomputed for every generated token, even when consecutive tokens rely on similar visual evidence. We introduce VAPOR (Visual Attention Persistence with On-demand Refresh), a training-free framework that reduces this redundancy by reusing visual attention outputs across decoding steps and refreshing them when needed. VAPOR caches the visual attention output while continuing to update textual attention at every step, helping reduce visual grounding drift during extended reasoning. To decide when to reuse cached outputs, VAPOR estimates visual attention mass using a low-rank approximation. It also uses prefill-based attention consistency and cache age to make independent Persist and Refresh decisions for each attention head. VAPOR retains the full visual key-value (KV) cache, so all visual tokens remain available when new evidence is needed. Experiments on eight image and four video reasoning benchmarks across two MLLM families show that VAPOR improves accuracy over dense attention on nearly all benchmarks while achieving 1.11-1.21x decoding speedups. Compared with the strongest state-of-the-art acceleration baseline in each setting, VAPOR further improves accuracy by 0.35-2.15 percentage points while achieving comparable or lower decoding latency. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: VAPOR：一种免训练的多模态大模型解码加速框架，跨解码步复用视觉注意力输出并按需刷新，配合低秩注意力质量估计、prefill一致性判据与缓存年龄，逐注意力头独立决策，实现1.11–1.21×解码加速且精度普遍提升。
AI.motivation: MLLM在大视觉上下文下自回归解码时，每个token都要重算视觉注意力，即便相邻token依赖的视觉证据高度相似，造成显著冗余计算；现有加速方法易导致视觉 grounding 漂移或丢弃视觉KV。
AI.method: 训练无关框架：缓存视觉注意力输出并每步继续更新文本注意力；用低秩近似估计视觉注意力质量以判断何时复用；结合prefill阶段注意力一致性与缓存年龄，为每个注意力头独立给出Persist/Refresh决策；保留完整视觉KV缓存以保证新证据可用。
AI.result: 在2个MLLM系列、8个图像与4个视频推理基准上，VAPOR几乎全部基准精度优于dense attention，解码加速1.11–1.21×；相对各设定最强加速基线精度提升0.35–2.15个百分点，延迟相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过在注意力头粒度上按需复用视觉注意力输出，可在不训练、不损失视觉证据的前提下同时获得解码加速与精度增益，为长视觉上下文推理的高效部署提供实用方案。

title: Show Me the Change You Want: Visual Example-Guided Change Detection
summary: Change detection identifies where images differ, but in practice users often seek only a particular kind of change. Existing referring change detection methods rely on predefined categories, textual descriptions, or annotated masks, limiting flexibility or requiring additional annotation. In this paper, we propose a new way to perform change detection, where an unannotated before-and-after image pair serves as a visual example to guide change localization in another pair. Our framework, Visual Example-Guided Change Detection (VECD), learns comparable attribute states from single images and introduces an example-conditioned readout to match changes across different objects and scenes. The example itself defines the request, without text, example masks, or test-time fine-tuning. We evaluate VECD on four datasets spanning rendered scenes and natural image edits: EditCLEVR, MagicBrush, HumanEdit, and MaskEdit. Experiments demonstrate cross-dataset generalization without fine-tuning: a single fixed example pair guides change detection across multiple scenes, even when examples and queries originate from different datasets. VECD selects matching changes in scenes with multiple simultaneous changes and returns an empty mask when the requested change is absent. It further generalizes to attribute families withheld from paired training, achieving 74.54\% to 93.38\% mIoU across four holdout settings. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出视觉示例引导的变化检测（VECD）：用一对"前后"图像作为示例，引导另一对图像中同类变化的分割定位，无需文本、示例掩码或测试时微调。
AI.motivation: 现有指称式变化检测依赖预定义类别、文本描述或标注掩码，灵活性受限且需要额外标注；用户往往只关心某一"特定类型"的变化。
AI.method: 框架从单张图像学习可比较的属性状态表示，并引入"示例条件读出"（example-conditioned readout）模块，将示例对中蕴含的变化语义与查询对的特征进行匹配，实现跨物体、跨场景的变化定位；示例本身即定义查询意图。
AI.result: 在 EditCLEVR、MagicBrush、HumanEdit、MaskEdit 四个数据集上验证：无需微调即可跨数据集泛化，单一固定示例对可引导多场景检测；能在多变化共存场景中选出目标变化，请求变化不存在时输出空掩码；对配对训练中未出现的属性族亦泛化，四种留出设置 mIoU 达 74.54%–93.38%。
AI.conclusion: 示例驱动的条件化变化检测是一种灵活、免标注、免微调的新范式，具备跨数据集与跨属性族泛化能力；属于视觉感知/编辑分析类工具，与具身、3D 或机器人核心方向关联较弱。

title: GlassGround: GUI Grounding Beyond Native Screenshots with Egocentric Wearable Vision
summary: Wearable assistants must localize interface elements from camera observations when direct screenshot access is unavailable, yet existing GUI grounding benchmarks primarily evaluate native screenshots. We introduce GlassGround, a new benchmark that pairs native screenshots with wearable camera observations while holding GUI states, instructions, and targets fixed. GlassGround contains 3,250 tasks across Android and iOS, captured using four wearable devices under four viewing conditions. Across ten open-source models, mean grounding accuracy drops from 94.8% on screenshots to 48.5% on camera images. Further analysis reveals that changes in target scale, screen geometry, and background cannot fully explain this performance degradation. We then study two ways to narrow this gap. At inference time, local zooming and screen rectification help but leave most of the gap. For training-time adaptation, we build on GlassGround's paired-view design and introduce PairDistill, a baseline that aligns target representations across views alongside coordinate supervision. Trained on independently collected data and using no screenshots at inference, it improves camera-image accuracy by 9.4 and 12.2 points on two backbones and transfers to unseen devices and operating systems. Combined with local zooming, it reaches 69.6% and 64.4%, but does not close the gap. The GlassGround dataset and code are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: GlassGround: 配对「原生截图 vs 可穿戴相机拍摄」的 GUI grounding 基准，揭示 grounding 精度从 94.8% 暴跌至 48.5%；提出 PairDistill 跨视图表征对齐基线，相机图像精度提升 9.4/12.2 点。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴助手在无法直接截屏时必须从相机画面定位 GUI 元素，但现有 GUI grounding 基准只评原生截图，导致真实部署中的域差异被严重低估。
AI.method: 构建 GlassGround 基准：3,250 个 Android/iOS 任务，固定 GUI 状态、指令与目标，用 4 种可穿戴设备在 4 种视角条件下采集配对视图；系统评估 10 个开源模型的截图 vs 相机图像精度，并排除目标尺度、屏幕几何、背景等因素；对比推理期方案（局部放大、屏幕矫正）与训练期方案 PairDistill——利用配对视图设计做跨视图目标表征对齐并配合坐标监督，推理时不使用截图。
AI.result: 10 个开源模型平均精度由截图 94.8% 降至相机图像 48.5%；局部放大与屏幕矫正仅缩小部分差距；PairDistill 在两个骨干网络上分别提升 9.4、12.2 点，并可泛化到未见设备与操作系统；与局部放大结合达 69.6%/64.4%，仍未闭合差距。
AI.conclusion: 相机观测下的 GUI grounding 是独立于截图设置的新问题域，现有模型与推理期修补不足；配对视图监督是有效但尚非充分的解决路径，差距本质未被完全揭示。

title: ScanAR: Parallel Row-Scan Decoding for Efficient Image Generation in Unified Autoregressive Models
summary: Unified multimodal autoregressive (AR) models represent text and images in one token sequence and generate all modalities with a shared next-token prediction head. Their image generation, however, decodes an $H\times W$ visual grid token by token in raster order, which takes $HW$ sequential steps and dominates inference time. Existing acceleration methods for visual AR generation either change the tokenizer, the prediction head, or the model interface, or keep the model but cannot reach high parallelism without losing quality, so they do not carry over to unified AR models. We propose ScanAR, a row-scan parallel decoding method that only redefines the predecessors of visual tokens. The first visual row is generated from left to right as usual, and each later row is generated in a single parallel step, with every token predicted from the vertically aligned token of the previous row. Nonvisual tokens keep the standard autoregressive rule. ScanAR reduces the visual decoding depth from $HW$ to $H+W$ without changing the backbone, vocabulary, or output head and without adding parameters, and it supports both training from scratch and lightweight post-training. On Emu3.5-Image-34B, ScanAR post-training reaches a GenEval score of 82.36, the best among post-training acceleration methods trained on the same data, and generates $512\times512$ images $13.8\times$ faster than raster decoding under the same inference setting. On ImageNet, ScanAR trained from scratch has the highest throughput at every model size with FID comparable to raster LlamaGen. On the 34B Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 model, ScanAR preserves the overall quality of embodied scene generation, interleaved image-text generation, and video generation.

AI.tldr: ScanAR replaces raster-order visual token decoding in unified multimodal AR models with row-scan parallel decoding, cutting visual decoding depth from HW to H+W and yielding 13.8x faster 512x512 image generation at matched quality.
AI.motivation: Unified multimodal autoregressive models share one next-token head across modalities, but their image branch decodes an H×W grid token by token in raster order, requiring HW sequential steps that dominate inference cost. Prior acceleration methods either alter the tokenizer/head/interface or trade off parallelism against quality, and none transfer cleanly to unified AR models.
AI.method: ScanAR keeps the backbone, vocabulary, and output head unchanged and adds no parameters; it only redefines visual token predecessors. The first visual row is decoded left-to-right autoregressively, while every subsequent row is produced in one parallel step, with each token conditioned on the vertically aligned token of the previous row. Non-visual tokens retain the standard AR rule. The scheme supports both training from scratch and lightweight post-training, with a defined dependency structure that admits block-parallel inference.
AI.result: On Emu3.5-Image-34B, ScanAR post-training achieves GenEval 82.36, the best among post-training acceleration methods using identical data, and makes 512×512 generation 13.8× faster than raster decoding under identical inference settings. On ImageNet, from-scratch ScanAR attains the highest throughput at all model sizes with FID comparable to raster LlamaGen. On Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 (34B), it preserves overall quality of embodied scene generation, interleaved image-text generation, and video generation.
AI.conclusion: A minimal dependency-graph redefinition of visual token prediction enables substantial parallel decoding speedup in unified multimodal AR models at essentially no architectural cost. Primary value here is inference-efficiency tooling for vision-language generative backbones; embodied relevance is indirect, limited to reported preservation of generation quality on a large robotics-oriented model rather than any manipulation or policy evaluation.

title: FailPoint-X: A Policy-Matched, Failure-Anchored Benchmark for Offline VLA Post-Training from Human Takeovers
comment: 34 pages (8-page main paper, references, and 24-page supplementary material), 9 figures, 20 tables. Zirui Li and Yujie Yan contributed equally. Project page: this https URL ; Code: this https URL
summary: Human takeovers offer corrective supervision for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but their contribution to offline post-training must be separated from that of continued optimization. We introduce FailPoint-X, a benchmark for offline VLA post-training with human takeovers. To represent uncertainty in failure onset, an annotator marks an interval for each failure, and training takeovers start at seeded frames sampled within it. From one fixed $\pi_{0.5}$ checkpoint, which also initializes post-training, we assemble 629 natural failures across 10 LIBERO-X task families at up to five difficulty levels. All 2,823 takeover attempts are logged; 2,400 are accepted recoveries, of which 2,320 are used for post-training. Evaluation restarts every method from the fixed midpoints of 384 held-out failure intervals. Under matched actor-update counts, we compare behavior cloning of recoveries, value-based offline learning on recoveries and failed rollouts, and continued training on existing demonstrations. Within 1,200 steps on the 240 L1-L3 held-out failures, cloning improves recovery by 29.4 percentage points (pp) over the demonstration-only control; the value-based learner does not establish a further gain (1.5 pp). In exploratory evaluation from L1-L5 nominal starts at the same horizon, cloning loses 30.0 pp of success relative to the base policy; mixing in demonstrations reduces the loss to 16.5 pp, a reduction that shrinks under a stricter, pre-specified horizon. Restorable failure states and a shared evaluator let all methods be compared from identical starts.

AI.tldr: 提出 FailPoint-X 基准：从固定 π0.5 检查点在 LIBERO-X 10 个任务族、5 个难度上收集 629 次自然失败与 2823 次人工接管尝试（2400 次成功恢复，2320 用于离线后训练），并在 384 个留出失败区间的固定中点统一起点、匹配 actor 更新步数下比较三种离线后训练方法。
AI.motivation: 人工接管能提供纠正性监督，但其对离线后训练的贡献需与"持续优化"本身的收益解耦；现有工作缺乏可控、可复现的评测协议来区分二者。
AI.method: 构造 FailPoint-X：每个失败由标注者标出失败起点时间区间，接管从区间内采样的种子帧开始；所有方法从同一固定 π0.5 检查点初始化。评测从 384 个留出失败区间的固定中点重启，在匹配 actor 更新次数条件下对比：(1) 恢复轨迹行为克隆，(2) 在恢复轨迹与失败 rollout 上的值函数式离线学习，(3) 在已有示教上的继续训练（对照）。
AI.result: 240 个 L1–L3 留出失败上，1200 步内克隆较仅示教对照提升恢复率 29.4 pp，值函数学习器无额外增益（1.5 pp）。探索性评估中（L1–L5 标称起点、同时长），克隆相对基座策略损失 30.0 pp 成功率，混入示教将损失降至 16.5 pp，但在更严格预设时长下该缓解效果减弱。
AI.conclusion: 人工接管数据对恢复能力有显著增益，但存在标称分布上的性能退化（灾难性遗忘）风险；本工作提供了可复现的失败状态与共享评测器，使各方法可从相同起点公平比较。

title: Triage Before Fine-Tuning: Feasibility-Gated Selection and Monitored Adaptation of Embodied Foundation Models for a Fixed Physical Platform
summary: Embodied foundation models are increasingly deployed by selection: a practitioner picks a public checkpoint by benchmark rank and fine-tunes it on local data. The platform is fixed before the model is chosen, with little or no local data. We ask what such a checkpoint loses on a fixed platform and which part of the loss local data can buy back. We split the gap by what can repair it. A sensing gap, information the sensors do not capture, cannot be closed with their data; a latency gap, output arriving after the control loop needs it, belongs to the loop, not the weights; only a distribution gap is fine-tuning's to repair. TRIAGE turns this into feasibility-gated selection and monitored adaptation in five stages: gates on the sensor contract and on end-to-end latency that no score can override, probes on ten minutes of local logs, a ranking by target-relevant score among the candidates that pass, and fine-tuning that is monitored and checked in closed loop before release. On driving benchmarks, a deadline below a leading closed-loop model's latency makes it collide on 80 to 90% of routes, and losing field of view moves plans 2.2 to 5.7 times more than losing resolution at equal pixels. Local frames close 75% of a stability gap but raise perturbation sensitivity at small budgets, and picking by score violates a gate in two of four deployment profiles. On a full-scale vehicle, the factory camera failed the sensing gate and an added camera repaired it. The latency gate removed the two highest-scoring candidates, neither of which completed a closed-loop trip. The selected model passed acceptance in 4 of 5 closed-loop trips, and the closed-loop check withheld a fine-tuned model that had improved offline. TRIAGE lets organizations that cannot train foundation models from scratch find out whether a public checkpoint can run on the robot or vehicle they own, and what to fix if not.

AI.tldr: TRIAGE: 将"选公开检查点→本地微调"的部署流程拆为感知/延迟/分布三类差距，用可行性门控（传感器契约、端到端延迟）先否决不达标模型，再用10分钟本地日志探针排序，最后闭环监控微调；实车与驾驶基准验证。
AI.motivation: 具身基础模型的部署是"选择式"的：实践者在固定平台、极少本地数据的前提下按榜单排名选公开检查点再微调。此时不清楚该检查点在特定平台上会损失什么、本地数据能补回哪一部分，导致高分模型可能在真机上无法闭环运行。
AI.method: 把性能差距按可修复性分解为：感知差距（传感器捕捉不到的信息，数据无法弥补）、延迟差距（输出晚于控制回路，属回路而非权重）、分布差距（微调可修复）。据此构建五阶段流程：1) 传感器契约门控；2) 端到端延迟门控（任何分数不可覆盖）；3) 基于约十分钟本地日志的探针评估；4) 在通过门控的候选中按目标相关得分排序；5) 微调并在闭环中监控、验收后才发布。
AI.result: 驾驶基准上：低于某领先闭环模型延迟的截止时间使其在80–90%路线上发生碰撞；等像素下损失视野使规划偏移达到损失分辨率的2.2–5.7倍。本地帧可弥合75%的稳定性差距，但小预算下提高扰动敏感性；仅按分数选择在4个部署配置中的2个违反门控。全尺寸实车：出厂相机未通过感知门控，加装相机后修复；延迟门控剔除两个最高分候选（均未能完成闭环行程）；最终模型5次闭环行程中4次通过验收；闭环检查还拦截了一个离线指标提升的微调模型。
AI.conclusion: TRIAGE 为无法从零训练基础模型的组织提供可操作的可行性判定：先判断公开检查点能否在其机器人/车辆上运行，不能则指出应修复哪一环；强调可行性门控与闭环验收不可被榜单分数替代。

title: CHD-Bench: Diagnosing Congenital Heart Disease through Interactive Examination
comment: 21 pages (8 main + references + appendix), 9 figures, 11 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Diagnosis of congenital heart disease (CHD) requires understanding the spatial relationships between cardiac structures, which clinicians assess by scrolling through CT or cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) slices and rotating 3D reconstructions. Although automated methods have advanced cardiac segmentation, identifying congenital heart defects from volumetric scans remains an open challenge. The two existing approaches rely on handcrafted diagnostic rules limited to static anatomical abnormalities. We introduce CHD-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive CHD diagnosis, defining a multi-label task and evaluation protocol over 247 CT and MRI scans from three cohorts covering 38 CHD types. We also present CHD-Harness, open-source software that runs a VLM in a 3D Slicer environment through 22 tools, manages each examination, and records the resulting diagnosis and supporting views. We evaluate off-the-shelf medical, open weight, and closed weight VLMs and compare them with a 3D CNN classifier and published rule-based results. Gemini 4 Argon with CHD-Harness achieves the highest macro F1 across all three cohorts (0.63, 0.63, and 0.43). Allowing for interactive examination raises its macro F1 by up to 20 points over static views. These results establish CHD-Bench and CHD-Harness as a foundation for developing and evaluating VLMs for interactive CHD diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出CHD-Bench（首个交互式先天性心脏病诊断基准，含3个队列247例CT/MRI、38类病变的多标签评测协议）与CHD-Harness（在3D Slicer中通过22个工具驱动VLM的开源软件），Gemini 4 Argon配合Harness取得最高macro F1（0.63/0.63/0.43），交互式检查较静态视图提升最多20个点。
AI.motivation: 先心病诊断依赖对心脏结构空间关系的理解，临床需滚动CT/MRI切片并旋转3D重建；现有自动化方法仅靠手工诊断规则，只能覆盖静态解剖异常，缺少针对体数据扫描的交互式诊断评测手段。
AI.method: 构建CHD-Bench多标签基准与评测协议（3个队列、247例CT/MRI、38类先心病）；实现CHD-Harness开源框架，在3D Slicer环境中以22个工具接口驱动VLM完成检查管理与支持视图记录；评测现成医疗、开源权重与闭源权重VLM，并与3D CNN分类器及已发表规则方法对比。
AI.result: Gemini 4 Argon + CHD-Harness在三个队列上取得最高macro F1（0.63、0.63、0.43）；允许交互式检查后其macro F1较静态视图最高提升约20个点。
AI.conclusion: CHD-Bench与CHD-Harness为交互式先心病诊断中VLM的开发与评测建立了基础，表明工具驱动的主动探索式影像检查优于静态视图判别。

title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Immediate and Prospective Credit Assignment for Medical Visual Reasoning
summary: Medical visual question answering (VQA) requires acquiring useful evidence and deciding where to look next. Yet final-answer rewards do not reveal which observations support answering or guide subsequent inspection. We introduce MedPACT, an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns selective observation policies through immediate answer support and prospective guidance. Our content-controlled estimator compares next actions induced by real and matched alternative observations under a shared real-observation history, isolating how observed content improves subsequent decisions. We combine both forms of credit within GRPO, assigning observation credit to the corresponding tool-call tokens alongside trajectory-level outcome supervision. MedPACT uses a single vision-language model and image-question-answer supervision, with credit estimation confined to training. Experiments with 4B and 8B backbones on six medical VQA benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy, strong out-of-distribution generalization, and substantially lower inference costs. Case studies further illustrate how MedPACT avoids repeated observations and uses acquired evidence to guide subsequent inspection, demonstrating real-world practice potential.

AI.tldr: MedPACT：基于GRPO的智能体式强化学习框架，用"即时答案支持"与"前瞻性引导"两种内容可控信用估计，为医学VQA中的选择性观察（工具调用）策略提供观察级信用分配。
AI.motivation: 医学VQA需要获取有用证据并决定下一步看哪里，但最终答案奖励无法揭示哪些观察支持作答，也无法引导后续检查；仅靠轨迹级结果监督存在信用分配盲区。
AI.method: 在共享真实观察历史下，比较"真实观察"与"匹配的替代观察"所诱导的下一动作差异，从而隔离观测内容的贡献（内容可控估计器）；将该观察信用与前瞻引导信用结合进GRPO，把观察信用分配到对应的工具调用token上，同时保留轨迹级结果监督。单一VLM，仅用图像-问题-答案监督，信用估计仅限训练阶段。
AI.result: 在6个医学VQA基准上，4B与8B骨干模型均取得更高准确率、较强分布外泛化及显著更低的推理成本；案例显示其能避免重复观察并用已获证据指导后续检查。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度的观察级信用分配可作为结果奖励的有效补充，使智能体在推理时更高效、更有目的地选择观察；方法不增加推理开销，具备实用潜力。
