title: DuoWM:Integrating Dual 6-DoF Visual Flows into Action-Conditioned Drone World Model
summary: Action-conditioned video world models generate future observations from an initial frame and a camera trajectory, but often fail to align camera commands with visual dynamics or represent full 6-DoF scene transformations. We present DuoWM, a first-person drone video world model with two complementary visual conditions. Action flow projects future camera positions and orientations into each target frame, while Object flow forward-warps the initial observation and overlays local 6-DoF transformations to ground the induced scene motion. We further introduce transform-aware pretraining, which pairs object appearance with explicit transformation axes before standard RGB video training. On Sekai-drone dataset, DuoWM achieves the best results across video quality, 3D consistency, and trajectory following. Compared with Captain Safari, the state-of-the-art method, our approach reduces real-domain FVD and LPIPS by 17.2\% and 21.6\%, respectively, while improving game-domain AUC@30 from 0.5003 to 0.5719 and AUC@15 from 0.3088 to 0.3747.

AI.tldr: DuoWM：面向第一人称无人机视频的动作条件世界模型，用「动作流」（未来相机位姿投影）与「物体流」（初始观测前向 warp + 局部 6-DoF 变换叠加）双视觉条件，并配合变换感知预训练，显著提升相机指令对齐与 6-DoF 场景建模。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频世界模型难以将相机指令与视觉动态对齐，且缺少完整 6-DoF 场景变换的显式表征，导致轨迹跟随与 3D 一致性不足。
AI.method: 双流条件：Action flow 将未来相机位置与朝向投影到每个目标帧；Object flow 对初始观测做前向 warp 并叠加局部 6-DoF 变换以锚定场景运动。训练上引入 transform-aware pretraining，先用物体外观与显式变换轴配对预训练，再进行标准 RGB 视频训练。
AI.result: Sekai-drone 数据集上视频质量、3D 一致性、轨迹跟随均最佳；相比 SOTA Captain Safari，实域 FVD 降低 17.2%、LPIPS 降低 21.6%，游戏域 AUC@30 由 0.5003 升至 0.5719、AUC@15 由 0.3088 升至 0.3747。
AI.conclusion: 以几何投影条件替代纯隐式动作编码，可有效提升世界模型的相机可控性与几何一致性；方法面向无人机视角合成，尚未验证机器人操作闭环应用。

title: Bridging Transferability and Discriminability via Positive-Unlabeled Domain Adaptation for Building Damage Mapping Across Disaster Events
summary: Mapping the damage to buildings following natural and human-caused disasters is essential for disaster response and humanitarian assistance. However, differences in hazard types, geographic environments, building characteristics, and imaging conditions cause cross-event distribution shifts that limit the generalization of deep learning models to new disaster events, even for geospatial foundation models (GFMs) pretrained on extensive Earth observation data. Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) can mitigate these shifts, but adaptation remains challenging when damage-proportion and damage-appearance shifts coexist and interact. We identify enhancing target-domain discriminability as key to addressing this challenge. To this end, inspired by positive-unlabeled (PU) learning, we introduce positive-unlabeled domain adaptation, a paradigm that incorporates PU weak supervision to enhance target-domain discriminability, requiring only a few labeled damaged buildings in the target domain. Building upon this straightforward intuition, we develop Positive-ANchored Domain Adaptation (PANDA), comprising two complementary and mutually reinforcing components: Pairwise Alignment with Intra-class Robustness (PAIR) for discriminative representation learning and Refine Gate and Verifier (RAV) for supervision refinement. On a global-scale multi-disaster benchmark, PANDA generally outperforms representative domain adaptation and PU learning methods. Results on the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires show its effectiveness in new disaster scenarios with few labeled damaged buildings. Further experiments demonstrate the potential of integrating PANDA with GFMs for cross-event adaptation. These findings highlight PANDA's practical potential for rapid, reliable, and cross-event building damage mapping.

AI.tldr: 提出"正-未标注域适应"（PUDA）范式与PANDA方法，仅用目标域少量受损建筑标注即可提升跨灾种建筑损毁制图的域适应能力，在全球多灾害基准上优于代表性DA与PU方法。
AI.motivation: 灾害类型、地理环境、建筑属性与成像条件差异导致跨事件分布漂移，即使大规模地球观测预训练的地理空间基础模型（GFM）也难以泛化到新灾害事件；现有无监督域适应在"损坏比例漂移"与"损坏外观漂移"共存并相互耦合时失效。作者判断增强目标域判别性是关键。
AI.method: 借鉴正-未标注（PU）学习，引入PU弱监督（仅需目标域少量已标注受损建筑）构建PUDA范式；具体方法PANDA含两个互补模块：PAIR（成对对齐+类内鲁棒性，用于判别性表征学习）与RAV（Refine Gate与Verifier，用于监督信号精炼）。
AI.result: 在全球尺度多灾害基准上总体优于代表性域适应和PU学习方法；2025年洛杉矶山火案例验证在仅少量标注受损建筑的新灾种场景下有效；进一步实验显示PANDA可与GFM结合用于跨事件适应。
AI.conclusion: 通过PU弱监督提升目标域判别性是可落地的跨事件建筑损毁制图方案，具备快速、可靠、跨灾种部署的实用潜力。

title: Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology via Topology-Informed Graph Attention and Gene-Semantics Conditioning
comment: Accepted by WACV2027: this https URL
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) profiles gene expression with spatial context but remains costly, motivating models that infer expression from H&E images. Existing approaches face three key limitations: (i) a single patch embedding is often insufficient: morphologically similar regions can exhibit distinct expression due to spatial context, while naive neighborhood aggregation can over-smooth boundaries; (ii) conventional fixed, gene-indexed output heads treat genes independently and cannot directly support strict zero-shot prediction for unseen genes; and (iii) common metrics under-measure spatial pattern fidelity and boundary resolution. To address these challenges, we propose TIGEM, a topology-informed, gene-conditioned framework for histology-to-ST inference. TIGEM learns topology-aware spot representations by regularizing graph attention with tissue-level topology and morphology cues to avoid cross-compartment smoothing, and uses gene semantic modulation to replace gene-indexed heads, enabling zero-shot prediction for unseen genes. We also introduce Graph Spectral Correlation (GSC) to evaluate spatial pattern fidelity and boundary resolution complement to PCC/MSE. Across three large-scale ST datasets, TIGEM achieves overall state-of-the-art performance and significantly improved boundary prediction resolution, and further demonstrates the ability to predict expression patterns for genes unseen during training, extending prior zero-shot histology-to-ST efforts with topology-aware spatial propagation and PLM-based gene conditioning.

AI.tldr: TIGEM：面向H&E图像到空间转录组推断的拓扑感知、基因条件化框架，含图注意力拓扑正则、基因语义调制实现未见基因零样本预测，并提出图谱相关性(GSC)指标。
AI.motivation: ST测量昂贵，需从H&E图像推断表达；现有方法存在三问题：单一patch嵌入不足且邻域聚合易过度平滑边界、固定基因索引输出头无法支持未见基因零样本、常用指标难以衡量空间模式保真度与边界分辨率。
AI.method: 以组织级拓扑与形态线索正则化图注意力学习拓扑感知spot表示，避免跨区室平滑；用基因语义调制（PLM基因嵌入）替代基因索引输出头；提出Graph Spectral Correlation (GSC)评价空间模式保真度与边界分辨率。
AI.result: 在三个大规模ST数据集上取得整体SOTA，边界预测分辨率显著提升，并能在训练中未见基因上预测表达模式。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑感知空间传播+PLM基因条件化将零样本组织学→ST推断推进到更优性能，并补充了更贴合空间结构的评价指标。

title: LSRP*-LA: Scalable and Anytime Multi-Agent Path Finding for Large Agents with Asynchronous Actions
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) seeks collision-free paths for multiple agents from their start locations to their goal locations while minimizing path costs. Most MAPF algorithms assume that each agent occupies a single vertex and that the actions of all agents are synchronized. These assumptions may limit the use of MAPF planners in practice. Existing planners that get rid of both assumptions either handle only a few agents or cannot improve their solutions. Recently, a planner called LSRP* was proposed, which is scalable and anytime with asynchronous actions, but still limited by that each agent occupies a single vertex. This paper develops a new planner called LSRP*-LA for MAPF for large agents with asynchronous actions (LA-MAPF-AA), where an agent can occupy several cells. LSRP*-LA is scalable and complete, and it keeps improving solution quality after the initial solution is obtained until the runtime budget depletes. We analyze the properties of LSRP*-LA and test it against several baselines with up to 800 agents on various maps. LSRP*-LA can handle twice as many agents as baseline methods and its solution cost is about half that of recent synchronous planners for large agents.

AI.tldr: LSRP*-LA 将可扩展、anytime 的异步动作多智能体路径规划器 LSRP* 扩展到"大体积智能体"设定（LA-MAPF-AA，智能体可占据多个格子），保持可扩展性与完备性，并在运行预算内持续优化解质量。
AI.motivation: 主流 MAPF 算法假设智能体仅占单顶点且所有智能体动作同步，这两条假设限制了实际部署；已有同时摆脱两条假设的规划器要么只能处理少量智能体，要么无法继续改进解。LSRP* 虽可扩展且 anytime、支持异步动作，但仍受单顶点占用限制。
AI.method: 提出 LSRP*-LA：在 LSRP* 框架上引入大体积智能体的多格子占用建模与相应冲突/碰撞检测，保留 anytime 的迭代改进机制（获得初始解后持续优化直到时间预算耗尽），并给出算法性质分析。
AI.result: 在多种地图上与多个基线对比，最多 800 个智能体；可处理的智能体数量为基线方法的两倍，解代价约为近期面向大体积智能体的同步规划器的一半。
AI.conclusion: LSRP*-LA 在 LA-MAPF-AA 设定下兼顾可扩展性、完备性与 anytime 质量改进，显著优于现有大体积智能体与大规划器基线，为多机器人协同路径规划提供更实用的方案。

title: Keep or Roll Back? Out-of-Loop Judges for Self-Improving VLA and End-to-End Embodied Policies
summary: Self-improvement is now a practical recipe for embodied policies: a policy collects experience, is retrained, and is kept when a judge rates it higher. However, the judge is usually trained or chosen inside the same loop, so its evidence is not independent of the policy. We introduce SealedLoop, an evaluation framework that adds a sealed judge: an evaluator outside the loop that the improver cannot see or optimize against. A new policy is kept only when a sequential test on the sealed judge confirms the gain, with a bounded probability of keeping a worse one. Running the same loop under each judge, we separate two sources of a false gain, which we call judge error (the loop's judge is wrong on its own data) and transfer gap (a real gain there does not carry over to unseen conditions). We evaluate on LIBERO manipulation, NAVSIM driving, and a full-scale real vehicle. In manipulation, a success classifier accepted 65 of 196 failures in one generation. In driving, policies that gain on the loop's own frames lose in an unseen city, so even an exact in-loop judge would keep 8/15 of them. When the sealed test decides, a driving loop built to improve ends with a better policy than under its own critic (0.674 against 0.649 PDMS, from 0.638), and on driving pairs with known sealed gain the test accepted 11 of 12 real gains and none of 59 losses. In a real-world field experiment on a published improvement step, the reinforced version drove further into a curve than the version it started from in all 6 blind pairs, though neither completed it. These results show that evidence from inside the loop, however accurate, is not enough to decide whether a policy has improved. SealedLoop offers a foundation for trustworthy self-improvement of embodied policies, in which progress is judged by evidence the improving system cannot influence.

AI.tldr: 提出 SealedLoop 评测框架：引入"封闭评审"(sealed judge)——改进系统不可见、不可优化的外部评审器，并用序贯检验确认增益才保留新策略；在 LIBERO、NAVSIM 与实车实验中区分"评审误差"与"迁移缺口"两类虚假增益。
AI.motivation: 具身策略自改进(collect-retrain-judge)已成为实用范式，但评审器通常在同一闭环内训练或选取，其证据与策略不独立，导致虚假增益被误判为进步；需要外部、不可被优化的证据来源来判断策略是否真正改进。
AI.method: 构建 SealedLoop 框架：在自改进闭环之外设置封闭评审器，改进器无法观测、无法对其优化；新策略仅当封闭评审器上的序贯统计检验确认增益时才被接受，并给出接受更差策略的概率上界。将误判来源形式化分解为 judge error（闭环内评审在其自身数据上判错）与 transfer gap（该处真实增益不迁移到未见条件）。在 LIBERO 操作、NAVSIM 驾驶和一辆全尺寸真实车辆上，分别更换不同评审器运行同一闭环进行对照。
AI.result: 操作任务中，成功分类器在一代内把 196 个失败误判为通过 65 个；驾驶任务中，在闭环自身帧上增益的策略在未见城市中失效，即使使用精确的闭环内评审仍会保留 8/15；封闭检验决策时，驾驶闭环得到更优策略（PDMS 0.674 vs 0.649，起点 0.638），在已知封闭增益的配对上接受 12 个真实增益中的 11 个、拒绝 59 个损失中的全部 59 个；真实车辆盲测 6 组配对中，强化版本全部更深入弯道（双方均未完成）。
AI.conclusion: 闭环内部的证据无论多么准确，都不足以判定策略是否改进；需要来自改进系统无法施加影响的外部证据。SealedLoop 为具身策略的可信自改进提供了以封闭评审为核心的评测基础。

title: SprintGS: Eliminating Redundancy for Fast 3D Gaussian Splatting Training
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders photorealistic novel views in real time, but its per-scene training (optimization) remains slow. Recent fast training methods such as FastGS shorten training to a few minutes by reducing the number of Gaussians. Profiling FastGS, we find two costs that remain even in its compact model. First, rasterization is still the largest cost, and redundant work remains in it. Second, the loss computation does not shrink with the number of Gaussians, so its share of the training time grows as the model becomes compact. We present SprintGS, a training framework built on FastGS that keeps the model compact and reduces both costs. For rasterization, scheduled tile culling limits each Gaussian to the tiles where it matters, using a coarse footprint that is annealed to the exact one before training ends; convergence-aware pruning removes converged, nearly transparent Gaussians; and a shuffle-efficient backward pass reduces the data exchanged between GPU threads. For the loss, a fused loss computes the loss and its image gradient in the forward pass without a loss map, removing most of its cost. SprintGS trains 2.15x faster than FastGS at comparable quality, and 1.81x faster in its high-quality setting. It also accelerates other fast training methods and dynamic, sparse-view, and surface reconstruction.

AI.tldr: SprintGS 在 FastGS 基础上加速 3DGS 训练：通过调度式 tile 剔除、收敛感知剪枝、shuffle 高效反向传播降低光栅化开销，并用融合损失消除损失图计算，实现约 2.15 倍加速且质量相当。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 虽可实时渲染，但逐场景优化训练仍慢。FastGS 等快速训练方法通过减少高斯数量把训练压缩到数分钟，但作者分析发现其紧凑模型下仍有两大残余开销：光栅化仍是最大开销且存在冗余计算；损失计算不随高斯数量缩减，占时比例随模型紧凑而上升。
AI.method: 基于 FastGS 的训练框架，保持模型紧凑并同时削减两类开销。光栅化侧：(1) 调度式 tile 剔除，用粗粒度足迹将每个高斯限制在真正有贡献的 tile 上，并在训练结束前退火至精确足迹；(2) 收敛感知剪枝，删除已收敛且近乎透明的高斯；(3) shuffle 高效反向传播，减少 GPU 线程间数据交换。损失侧：融合损失在前向中直接计算损失及图像梯度，无需生成损失图。
AI.result: 在可比质量下训练速度比 FastGS 快 2.15 倍，高质量设置下快 1.81 倍；同时可加速其他快速训练方法，并适用于动态场景、稀疏视角重建与表面重建。
AI.conclusion: SprintGS 表明，在紧凑高斯模型下，光栅化冗余与不随规模缩减的损失计算是加速 3DGS 训练的关键瓶颈；针对性的工程与算法优化可在不牺牲质量的前提下取得显著加速，并具备良好的通用性。

title: DriftWAM: Faster World-Action Models via Action-Aware Video Drifting
summary: World-action models (WAMs) unify future video prediction and action generation for robotic control, but their reliance on iterative denoising incurs substantial inference costs. Distilling these models into few-step generators offers a promising route to efficient deployment, yet maintaining task performance under aggressive step reduction remains challenging. Existing methods rely on point-wise trajectory consistency distillation, which pursues high visual fidelity while leaving downstream action information unexploited in optimizing video generation, and also lacks explicit distribution-level alignment. To address this, we propose DriftWAM, a few-step WAM distillation framework that incorporates the actions induced by predicted videos into video learning. Specifically, DriftWAM integrates action-aware video drifting, which performs video distribution matching through a joint visual--action similarity kernel to steer sample evolution under the guidance of these induced actions, with action-guided video regularization, which leverages the compatible teacher--student matches identified by the joint kernel to backpropagate action-level gradients directly into the video generator. Evaluations on the RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO benchmarks, as well as in real-world robotic manipulation tasks, show that DriftWAM consistently outperforms prior consistency distillation methods across few-step settings at the same inference speed.

AI.tldr: DriftWAM：面向世界-动作模型（WAM）的少步蒸馏框架，通过联合视觉-动作相似度核做视频分布匹配（action-aware video drifting），并利用该核匹配的师生样本将动作级梯度回传到视频生成器（action-guided video regularization），在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 及真机操作任务上以同等推理速度优于现有一致性蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: WAM 统一视频预测与动作生成，但迭代去噪推理成本高；少步蒸馏虽可加速，但激进降步下性能难以保持。现有轨迹一致性蒸馏为逐点约束，仅追求视觉保真度，未在视频生成优化中利用下游动作信息，且缺乏分布级对齐。
AI.method: 提出 DriftWAM 少步蒸馏框架：1) action-aware video drifting，用联合视觉-动作相似度核进行视频分布匹配，以预测视频诱导的动作指导样本演化；2) action-guided video regularization，借助联合核识别兼容的师生匹配对，将动作级梯度直接反传至视频生成器。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 基准及真实机器人操作任务上，DriftWAM 在同等推理速度下于多种少步设置中稳定优于先前的一致性蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 将动作信息引入 WAM 的视频蒸馏目标（分布级匹配 + 动作梯度回传）可在少步推理下保持任务性能，验证了动作感知的蒸馏监督优于纯视觉一致性约束，便于高效部署。

title: Dynamic Forcing: Learning Action-Grounded Sparse Dynamic Representations with Dense Future Guidance for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) support robot control through visual prediction, but dense future modeling repeatedly encodes static context already available in the current observation, while action-relevant changes are often spatially sparse. We study sparse dynamic representation learning, retaining the current observation as a contextual anchor and using a small set of compact dynamic tokens to represent anticipated changes. We develop CompactWAM, a sparse-dense joint predictive framework that enables sparse representation learning within a video-supervised shared backbone, without requiring a reconstruction objective for the sparse pathway. Since a limited token budget alone does not specify which information to retain, we introduce Dynamic Forcing, which pairs direct action supervision with privileged dense future guidance to promote action relevance and dynamic fidelity. While action prediction gradients directly drive compact tokens to capture control-relevant cues, dense future guidance further shapes them via action functional guidance that matches sparse and dense contributions to the action expert, and dynamics-aware distribution matching, which aligns temporal relational changes relative to a static reference. At inference, a single visual forward pass encodes current observations and compact dynamic tokens for action generation, eliminating dense future modeling. CompactWAM achieves 98.4\% success on LIBERO and 77.9\% on LIBERO-Plus, retaining respective success rates of 98.3\% and 76.6\% with only 9.2\% of the dense future token budget. Evaluations on RoboTwin~2.0 and real-world manipulation further demonstrate the effectiveness of the learned sparse predictive representations.

AI.tldr: CompactWAM: 在共享视频监督骨干中用少量紧凑动态token表示未来变化，通过Dynamic Forcing（动作监督+稠密未来引导）学习稀疏动态表示，推理时仅单次视觉前向生成动作；LIBERO 98.4%、LIBERO-Plus 77.9%。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）依赖稠密未来视觉预测来支撑机器人控制，但稠密未来建模会重复编码当前观测中已有的静态上下文，而真正与动作相关的变化往往在空间上稀疏，导致冗余计算。
AI.method: 提出稀疏-稠密联合预测框架CompactWAM：以当前观测为上下文锚点，用一小组紧凑动态token表征预期变化，在视频监督的共享骨干中做稀疏表示学习且稀疏通路无需重建目标。用Dynamic Forcing训练：直接动作监督梯度驱动动态token捕捉控制相关线索，并以特权稠密未来作引导，包括动作功能引导（使稀疏与稠密贡献对齐动作专家）和动力学感知分布匹配（相对静态参考对齐时序关系变化）。推理时单次视觉前向编码当前观测与动态token直接生成动作，省去稠密未来建模。
AI.result: LIBERO成功率98.4%，LIBERO-Plus 77.9%；仅用9.2%的稠密未来token预算仍保持98.3%与76.6%。RoboTwin 2.0与真实机器人操作实验进一步验证稀疏预测表示的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 稠密未来建模存在大量静态冗余，稀疏动态token加动作导向的蒸馏式引导即可在极低token预算下保持高性能，并能直接去除推理期未来视频生成开销。

title: Explicit covers and rigid obstructions for simplicial complexity: from spheres to surfaces
comment: 22 pages, 6 tables, 1 algorithm. Code: this https URL ; certificates: this https URL (tag arxiv-v1)
summary: The strict simplicial complexity $SC_{\rm strict}(K)$, González's simplicial complexity at subdivision level zero, is one less than the least number of contiguity domains covering the ordered product $K\times K$. We bound it from both sides. For upper bounds, every product of two vertex stars is a domain, which gives $SC_{\rm strict}(K)\le\rho(K)-1$ for an exactly computable set-cover number $\rho(K)$; the bound is sharp on every even-dimensional simplex boundary. A GPU annealer that evolves whole systems of contiguity chains finds three-domain covers of $\partial\Delta^3,\dots,\partial\Delta^7$ and of the cube boundary. Seeded by star covers, it descends from $24$ to $5$ domains on the icosahedron boundary, and an exact SAT completion of its stalled state gives $SC_{\rm strict}\le3$ there. For lower bounds, a subcomplex of $K\times K$ is rigid if its two projections are joined by no contiguity chain of any length; $k$ domains can cover $K\times K$ only if $k$ classes of facets avoid every rigid subcomplex, a finite SAT problem. Rigid subcomplexes arise from hollow triangles over essential empty triangles and, on complexes without dominated vertices, from the graph of every order-preserving simplicial self-map other than the identity. The resultingchain-length-free bounds give $SC_{\rm strict}(\partial\Delta^{n+1})=2>1=TC(S^n)$ for $n=3,5,7,9$, $SC_{\rm strict}=2>1$ for the five-vertex Möbius band, $SC_{\rm strict}\ge3>2$ for the seven-vertex torus, and $4\le SC_{\rm strict}\le5$ and $4\le SC_{\rm strict}\le6$ for two triangulations of $\mathbb{RP}^2$. They also sort the annealer's stalls: on these two triangulations of $\mathbb{RP}^2$, the Klein bottle and $\partial\Delta^4$, almost every uncovered facet closes a rigid subcomplex in every domain, while the icosahedron stall was a search failure.

AI.tldr: 用“邻接链覆盖”给出严格单纯复形复杂度SC_strict(K)的上下界：上界经顶点星乘积给出可精确计算的集覆盖数ρ(K)-1，下界用刚性子复形构造有限SAT问题。
AI.motivation: SC_strict(K)（González 在细分零层的单纯复杂度）等于覆盖有序积K×K所需最少邻接域数减一，但此前缺乏可计算的双向界，且与拓扑复杂度TC的关系不清楚。
AI.method: 上界：任意两个顶点星之积是邻接域，故SC_strict(K)≤ρ(K)-1；用GPU退火器演化整组邻接链求小覆盖，并以精确SAT补全停滞状态。下界：定义刚性子复形（两投影间不存在任意长度邻接链），k个域覆盖要求k类小面避开所有刚性子复形，化为有限SAT；刚性子复形来自本质空三角形上的hollow triangle，以及无被支配顶点复形上任意非恒等保序自映射的图。
AI.result: 上界在偶数维单形边界上是紧的；退火得到∂Δ^3–∂Δ^7与立方体边界的三域覆盖，二十面体边界从24降到5域并精确到≤3。下界给出SC_strict(∂Δ^{n+1})=2>1=TC(S^n)（n=3,5,7,9）、五顶点Möbius带=2、七顶点环面≥3、两处RP²三角剖分分别落在[4,5]与[4,6]；并据此诊断退火停滞原因（多数为刚性障碍，二十面体为搜索失败）。
AI.conclusion: 建立了SC_strict与TC之间的首个系统性分离，并给出可计算的组合上下界与启发式-精确混合求解流程。

title: SpiderSkel: Sub-Pixel Multi-Tangent 2D Skeletonization from Inscribed-Disc Geometry
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables, plus 6 pages of supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
summary: Skeletonization reduces a binary shape to a compact medial representation, but pixel-grid discretization perturbs the boundary-contact geometry underlying the medial axis, creating tension among connectivity, reconstruction fidelity, and skeleton compactness. SpiderSkel is a family of training-free two-dimensional skeletonization methods built on multi-tangent inscribed-disc geometry. A tie-aware exact Euclidean distance transform retains tied nearest boundary sites rather than collapsing them to a single label; medial candidates are localised to sub-pixel positions from the inscribed disc's tangent contacts, filtered by the angular span of those contacts, and completed by connectivity-aware refinement. Across nineteen public benchmarks comprising 11,323 images of shapes, retinal vessels, cracks and roads, and document images, a single operating point fixed across datasets yields skeletons that, on every image, have exact skeleton topology under the component/hole certificate, remain fully connected, and have exact per-object reconstruction topology. The three SpiderSkel variants are the only evaluated methods to satisfy all three properties across every category; within each category, every variant is Pareto-optimal with respect to all twenty-two baselines in strict sub-pixel reconstruction Dice versus reduction rate. Incremental engines for all three variants reproduce the skeleton of a complete recomputation exactly across 23,040 verified edit steps, with median update latencies of 15.4-18.1 ms per foreground edit and 4.3-4.4 ms per canvas edit, and speedups reaching 33.0-fold on canvas edits.

AI.tldr: SpiderSkel：基于多切线内切圆几何的无训练二维骨架化方法，用保留并列最近边界点的精确欧氏距离变换在亚像素位置定位中轴候选，按切线接触角跨度过滤并做连通性细化，在19个基准11323幅图上同时保证骨架拓扑、连通性与重建拓扑精确。
AI.motivation: 像素网格离散化会破坏中轴所依赖的边界接触几何，导致连通性、重建保真度与骨架紧凑性三者相互冲突；现有骨架化方法难以在同一操作点上同时满足拓扑正确、完全连通和重建精确。
AI.method: 多切线内切圆几何框架：(1) tie-aware精确欧氏距离变换保留并列最近边界站点而非塌缩为单一标签；(2) 由内切圆切线接触点将中轴候选定位到亚像素坐标；(3) 以接触点的角跨度进行候选过滤；(4) 连通性感知的细化补全；另提供三种变体的增量更新引擎。
AI.result: 在19个公开基准（形状、视网膜血管、裂缝、道路、文档图像，共11323幅）上，单一固定操作点下每幅图的骨架均满足组件/孔洞证书下的精确拓扑、完全连通、逐对象精确重建拓扑，是唯一同时满足三性质的方法；各子类中所有变体在严格亚像素重建Dice—缩减率上对22个基线均Pareto最优。增量引擎在23040步编辑中精确复现全量重算骨架，中位延迟15.4–18.1 ms（前景编辑）与4.3–4.4 ms（画布编辑），画布编辑最高33.0倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出无需训练的几何精确骨架化方案，在拓扑保证与重建保真度上确立新基准，并提供低延迟增量计算能力；但属于二维形状分析/经典几何视觉贡献，与具身智能、三维重建或世界模型方向关联较弱。

title: EvoVAU: Tool Evolution for Video Anomaly Understanding
summary: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) requires reasoning about event progression, interactions, and the contextual conditions that distinguish abnormal behavior from common activity across diverse scenes. Although video agents enable multi-round analysis, the predefined analytical operations may not adequately satisfy these diverse reasoning demands. In this paper, we present EvoVAU, a framework that evolves a reusable tool library for a frozen video solver. Guided by task outcomes and execution trajectories, an external proposer identifies potential limitations in the library and refines it, retaining task experience as analytical operations that can be reused across questions. Specifically, Cross-Version Contrastive Feedback guides tool refinement by combining current errors with paired execution trajectories from historical corrections and regressions. Adoption-Aware Selection accepts a candidate library only when overall development-set accuracy improves and corrections outnumber regressions among questions on which the solver invokes new or modified tools. Using a small development set, EvoVAU alternates tool refinement with candidate evaluation and selection. At test time, the evolved library remains fixed, with no further involvement from the proposer. Experiments on several VAU benchmarks demonstrate strong performance and the flexibility of the evolved library across anomaly domains.

AI.tldr: EvoVAU 面向视频异常理解（VAU），为冻结的视频求解器进化一个可复用工具库：外部 proposer 依据任务结果与执行轨迹找出工具库短板并精炼，测试时工具库固定、proposer 不再参与。
AI.motivation: VAU 需要推理事件演进、交互与上下文条件，而现有视频 agent 的分析操作是预定义的、单一固定的，难以覆盖跨场景多样化的推理需求；因此需要一种能"学到"并复用分析方法、又不必训练求解器本身的机制。
AI.method: 框架由三部分构成：(1) Cross-Version Contrastive Feedback：将当前错误与历史"纠正/回退"配对的执行轨迹对比，指导工具精炼；(2) Adoption-Aware Selection：仅在开发集总体准确率提升、且求解器实际调用新/改工具的题目中纠正数多于回退数时才接纳候选库；(3) 在小型开发集上交替进行"工具精炼—候选评估—选择"，求解器权重冻结，测试阶段工具库固定。本质是把工具库当作可进化的外部记忆/技能库，以验证集门控做保守更新。
AI.result: 在多个 VAU 基准上取得较强表现，并显示进化所得工具库能跨不同异常域复用。摘要仅给出定性结论，未报告具体数值、基线对比幅度、工具库演化轮数或消融细节。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把"工具库进化"作为无需训练求解器的可迁移能力增强路径，强调经验复用与门控式选择以控制回退风险；其思路可借鉴到需要多步推理与工具调用的 agent 系统，但证据限于 VAU 基准，缺乏真实部署与跨任务类型的泛化验证。

title: Probabilistic Monocular Biomechanical Reconstruction via Guided Flow Matching
summary: Reconstructing 3D joint kinematics from a single video is ill-posed due to depth and stature ambiguity, limb occlusion, and missing uncertainty estimates. We introduce the Biomechanical Flow Model (BFM), a continuous-time flow-matching prior over subject anthropometry, anatomical joint-angle trajectories, and virtual markers, trained on multi-camera clinical recordings from 565 participants and steered toward monocular 2D keypoints at test time without paired video training. In a head-to-head comparison on the same clinical trials against a state-of-the-art deterministic trajectory optimizer fitting the identical skeleton, BFM achieves comparable joint-angle accuracy across walking and timed-up-and-go (TUG). Across held-out control, prosthetic, and neurologic participants, BFM reaches 3.91 deg and 4.97 deg mean absolute joint-angle error on walking and TUG while providing credible intervals that bridge temporal and whole-limb occlusions. Where keypoints are hidden, the intervals widen with the error and keep their coverage near nominal. Supplying individual anthropometric calibration removes most monocular pelvis depth error, whereas testing on out-of-distribution pediatric crouch gait produces biased, overconfident extension predictions, highlighting the need for pathologically diverse movement priors.

AI.tldr: BFM：以多机位临床数据训练、测试时用单目2D关键点引导的连续时间流匹配先验（人体测量+关节角轨迹+虚拟标记），输出带可信区间的人体3D关节运动学重建。
AI.motivation: 单目视频重建3D关节运动学存在深度/身高歧义、肢体遮挡与缺失不确定性估计的问题；确定性轨迹优化器无法给出不确定性，且在遮挡处失效。
AI.method: 构建Biomechanical Flow Model：在565名受试者的多机位临床录像上训练流匹配（flow matching）先验，联合建模受试者人体测量参数、解剖学关节角轨迹与虚拟标记；测试时以单目2D关键点为引导（无需配对视频训练）；同骨架下与SOTA确定性轨迹优化器做同试验对比。
AI.result: 步行与TUG上关节角精度与确定性优化器相当；留出的对照、假肢、神经科受试者上MAE为3.91°/4.97°；可信区间能跨越时间与整肢遮挡，遮挡处区间随误差增大并保持近似名义覆盖率；个体人体测量标定可消除大部分单目骨盆深度误差；在小儿蹲伏步态（分布外）上出现有偏且过度自信的伸展预测。
AI.conclusion: 概率式、解剖学约束的人体运动先验能在单目条件下给出可比精度且带覆盖良好的不确定性，但需更病理多样的运动先验以泛化到OOD步态。

title: FlipVLA: Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action(VLA) Models Only Through Bit Flips
comment: 14 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions in real-world environments, making malicious model tampering a potential threat to physical safety. We study whether object-triggered backdoors can be implanted through a small, fixed set of parameter bit flips without retraining. The central challenge is to make persistent weight modifications disrupt trigger-present behavior while preserving performance on non-trigger inputs. We propose FlipVLA, a two-stage selector-amplifier method that exploits existing visual features within an FC-GELU-FC structure. The selector constructs a trigger-dependent response in a selected channel, using GELU to attenuate background activity. The amplifier modifies a connected downstream weight to convert this response into an action-relevant perturbation. Channel screening and discrete bit search construct both components under a limited modification budget. Experiments on OpenVLA-OFT and GR00T N1.7 across four LIBERO suites achieve attack success rates of 90.22% to 100%, with task success decreasing by at most 1.5 percentage points on clean scenes.

AI.tldr: FlipVLA：通过少量固定参数位翻转（无需重训练）在VLA模型中植入物体触发后门，采用"选择器-放大器"两阶段方法利用FC-GELU-FC结构现有视觉特征，在OpenVLA-OFT与GR00T N1.7上攻击成功率达90.22%–100%，干净场景任务成功率仅下降≤1.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: VLA模型直接从视觉观测与语言指令生成真实世界机器人动作，模型被恶意篡改会直接威胁物理安全。作者探究在有限修改预算下，能否通过极少量、固定的权重位翻转（不重训练）植入物体触发的后门攻击，核心难点在于：持久的权重修改需在触发输入上扰乱行为，同时在非触发输入上保持性能。
AI.method: 提出FlipVLA两阶段"选择器-放大器"方法：(1) 选择器在选定通道中构造对触发器敏感的响应，借助GELU抑制背景激活；(2) 放大器修改相连的下游权重，将该响应转化为与动作相关的扰动。整体通过通道筛选与离散位搜索，在有限位翻转预算内联合构造两个部件，利用FC-GELU-FC结构中的既有视觉特征实现无重训练后门注入。
AI.result: 在OpenVLA-OFT与GR00T N1.7两个模型、四个LIBERO任务套件上，攻击成功率达90.22%–100%，且干净场景下任务成功率下降不超过1.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 少量固定位翻转即可在VLA模型中植入高效且隐蔽的物体触发后门，揭示具身模型权重完整性面临的实际安全风险，为VLA鲁棒性与防御研究提供攻击基准与警示。

title: $\widetilde{\varepsilon}$: Does Initial Noise Induce Directional Bias in Vision-Language-Action Models?
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have widely adopted diffusion-based action generation for continuous robot motions, enabling fine-grained control across diverse tasks. However, recent studies have shown that their performance is highly sensitive to initial noise, with resulting action errors that make recovery difficult during execution. Existing approaches search for favorable noise initializations to improve performance, yet the action expert itself remains sensitive to noise. In this work, we reveal that initial noise induces a consistent directional bias in action space that closely aligns with the noise's temporal mean. We thus introduce a simple yet effective framework that improves robustness to initial noise through interventions during both training and inference. During training, we enforce consistent action predictions from antithetic noise pairs $(\epsilon, -\epsilon)$ and, at inference, remove the noise's temporal mean. Our method substantially reduces action deviation and improves task performance across simulation benchmarks. In real-robot experiments, our method increases the average task success rate of $\pi_{0.5}$ from 40% to 68%, with more stable and consistent execution.

AI.tldr: 揭示扩散式VLA对初始噪声敏感的根源是噪声时间均值诱导的动作空间方向偏置，通过训练时对反对称噪声对(ε,-ε)施加一致性约束、推理时去除噪声时间均值，显著提升动作稳定性与实机成功率。
AI.motivation: 扩散式VLA动作生成对初始噪声高度敏感，动作误差在执行中难以纠正；现有做法只是搜索"好噪声"，而动作专家本身仍对噪声敏感，未触及根本机制。
AI.method: 发现初始噪声会在动作空间引起与噪声时间均值高度对齐的一致方向偏置；训练阶段强制反对称噪声对(ε, -ε)产生一致的动作预测，推理阶段直接减去噪声时间均值，形成训练+推理双侧干预的轻量框架。
AI.result: 仿真基准上动作偏差大幅降低、任务性能提升；真机实验中π0.5平均成功率从40%提升至68%，执行更稳定一致。
AI.conclusion: 初始噪声的鲁棒性问题可从"噪声时间均值偏置"这一简洁机制层面解决，无需复杂的噪声搜索或额外采样预算，具备较强的可移植性与实机价值。

title: Spectral Optimal Transport for Dynamics-Aware Sign Language Generation
summary: Sign language generation (SLG) translates spoken-language text into pose sequences that convey its meaning. Recently, flow-based models with optimal transport (OT) have become a strong SLG baseline by handling the one-to-many nature of text-to-sign. While classifier-free guidance (CFG) could be applied to further strengthen the semantic alignment theoretically, its training involves conditional and unconditional training, which may contradict the pose-space OT, thus reducing the generation quality. Under the condition dropout, one noise sample can be paired with target motions exhibiting incompatible motion dynamics, interfering with the semantic guidance when the text condition is present. To address this issue, we propose Spectral Optimal Transport (SOT), which augments the pose-space cost with a spectral feature distance, reweighting the coupling toward the temporal-frequency structure of the target motions, thereby improving the performance when using CFG. The quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spectral Optimal Transport (SOT)，在姿态空间的 OT 代价中加入频谱特征距离，使耦合更倾向目标动作的时频结构，从而缓解 CFG 的 dropout 训练与姿态空间 OT 冲突的问题，提升 SLG 下 CFG 的效果。
AI.motivation: Flow-matching + optimal transport 是手语生成 (SLG) 的强基线，但引入 classifier-free guidance (CFG) 时，条件/无条件联合训练（condition dropout）会导致一个噪声样本与运动动态不相容的多个目标配对，破坏姿态空间 OT 的耦合质量，进而削弱语义引导效果。
AI.method: SOT：在原有姿态空间代价基础上增加一个频谱域（时频）特征距离项，用其重新加权源-目标耦合矩阵，使匹配偏好目标运动的时间-频率结构，与 CE 结合用于 flow 模型训练、推理时启用 CFG。
AI.result: 定量与定性实验均验证所提方法有效性（摘要仅给出概括性结论，未提供具体指标）。
AI.conclusion: 通过频谱感知的 OT 代价改进耦合质量，可在使用 CFG 时同时保持语义对齐与生成质量，为 SLG 中的条件生成提供插件式改进。

title: MMotion: Collaborative Cross-Scale Memory for Text-to-Motion Generation
summary: Text-to-motion generation aims to synthesize realistic human motions from natural-language descriptions, enabling applications in animation, virtual avatars, and embodied agents. Despite recent progress, existing methods either retrieve motion exemplars or retain long-range context, but rarely exploit memory to jointly reason about semantics, dynamics, and generation history. In this paper, we propose MMotion, a collaborative multi-scale memory framework that unifies scale-conditioned semantic retrieval, latent dynamics modeling, and causal working memory. Specifically, semantic memory provides motion priors at different generation scales, dynamics memory captures latent state transitions, and working memory preserves causal context from previously generated motions. A collaborative fusion mechanism integrates these complementary memories to determine what motion to generate, how it should evolve, and how it should remain consistent with its history. MMotion is architecture-agnostic and can be readily integrated into both diffusion-based and next scale autoregressive models. Extensive experiments across standard benchmarks and diverse backbones demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: MMotion 提出协作式多尺度记忆框架，用于文本到动作生成：语义记忆提供不同生成尺度上的动作先验，动力学记忆建模隐状态转移，工作记忆保存已生成动作的因果上下文，并通过协作融合机制整合三类记忆。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动动作生成方法要么检索动作样例，要么保留长程上下文，但很少利用显式记忆来联合推理语义、动力学与生成历史这三类信息，导致生成的动作在语义对齐、时序演化和历史一致性上难以兼顾。
AI.method: 构建三类互补记忆：1）语义记忆——按生成尺度条件化检索动作先验；2）动力学记忆——建模潜空间状态转移；3）工作记忆——保存先前生成动作的因果上下文。再用协作融合机制决定“生成什么动作、如何演化、如何与历史保持一致”。方法架构无关，可嵌入扩散模型与下一尺度自回归模型。
AI.result: 在标准基准和多种骨干网络上实验，一致优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度记忆与协作融合是提升文本到动作生成的有效通用设计，具备跨架构的可移植性；但摘要未给出量化指标与物理/机器人层面的验证。

title: Revisiting Monocular In-Hand Object Scanning: Dataset, Pose Estimation, and Surface Reconstruction
summary: In-Hand Object Scanning (IHOS) from monocular video captured by a commodity smartphone holds immense potential to democratize 3D digitization for non-expert users, facilitating applications in digital archiving, augmented reality, and custom fabrication. Yet, IHOS remains largely understudied due to a lack of realistic datasets and systematic benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we introduce ToysRUs, a high-quality dataset featuring diverse figurines captured by 4K Ultra High-Definition (UHD) monocular videos. Studying IHOS from first principles, we examine structure-from-motion (SfM) for camera pose estimation, which is key to IHOS. We identify two key challenges: small baselines between consecutive frames, and sparse feature matches across large-view, long-range frames, further exacerbated by dynamic hand occlusions. Guided by these insights, we propose performing SfM on video sub-sequences sampled at sufficient angular intervals, and iteratively stitches the corresponding sub-trajectories into a unified global trajectory. Furthermore, for high-fidelity surface reconstruction, we introduce occlusion-aware 2D Gaussian Splatting, which incorporates opacity rendering and omits the opacity loss on hand regions. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms existing approaches, including neural implicit representations and 3D foundation models, in both geometric accuracy and photometric fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出 ToysRUs 数据集与一套手持物体扫描（IHOS）框架：对按角度间隔采样的视频子序列分别做 SfM 并迭代拼接为全局轨迹，再用遮挡感知的 2D Gaussian Splatting（opacity rendering + 手部区域不施加 opacity loss）进行高保真表面重建。
AI.motivation: 单目手机视频的 in-hand 物体扫描有望让非专家用户实现 3D 数字化，但缺乏真实数据集与系统基准；IHOS 的核心难点在于相机位姿估计：帧间基线过小、大视角长程帧间特征匹配稀疏，且被动态手部遮挡进一步放大。
AI.method: (1) 构建 4K UHD 单目视频的多样摆件数据集 ToysRUs；(2) 从第一性原理分析 SfM 失效因素，采用按足够角度间隔采样的子序列做局部 SfM，再迭代拼接子轨迹得到统一全局轨迹；(3) 提出遮挡感知 2D Gaussian Splatting，引入 opacity rendering 并在手部区域省略 opacity loss。
AI.result: 定量与定性实验表明该框架在几何精度与光度保真度上显著优于现有方法，包括神经隐式表示与 3D 基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 以轨迹分治+拼接解决手持扫描中的位姿估计问题、以遮挡感知 2DGS 处理手部遮挡，是提升手持物体高保真重建的有效范式，并提供了可供后续研究的真实数据集与基准。

title: MotionODE: Enhancing Autoregressive Text-to-Motion Generation with Continuous-Depth Modeling
summary: Autoregressive text-to-motion generation requires local motion predictions to reconcile cross-temporal textual requirements with the available motion context. While existing methods primarily improve motion representations and generation order, the internal formation of conditioned motion representations remains less explored. We introduce MotionODE, a continuous-depth post-training framework that refines hidden-state evolution in pretrained autoregressive generators. MotionODE reinterprets selected Transformer residual branches as local vector fields and replaces their original updates with midpoint Runge--Kutta (RK2) integration, while preserving the motion representation and outer generation mechanism. To address the mismatch between pretrained update paths and newly introduced intermediate states, we propose mixed one-step/two-step RK2 post-training under motion-token supervision, with optional distillation and update-map constraints to preserve pretrained behavior. This minimally invasive framework supports both next-token and next-scale generation without training the generator from scratch. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D demonstrate consistent improvements in text--motion alignment across MoScale, BAMM and LMR, highlighting internal representation updates as a complementary direction for improving autoregressive motion generation.

AI.tldr: MotionODE 将预训练自回归文本到动作生成器中部分 Transformer 残差分支视为局部向量场，用中点 Runge–Kutta (RK2) 积分替换原更新，并通过混合单步/两步 RK2 后训练与动作 token 监督来适配预训练路径，实现最小侵入式的隐状态演化精化。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归文本到动作生成方法主要改进动作表示与生成顺序，而对条件动作表示的内部形成过程（局部预测如何在跨时序文本需求与可用动作上下文间协调）探索不足。
AI.method: 连续深度后训练框架：把选定 Transformer 残差分支重解释为局部向量场，以 RK2 中点积分替代原始残差更新，同时保持动作表示与外层生成机制不变；提出混合一步/两步 RK2 后训练配合动作 token 监督，解决预训练更新路径与新引入中间状态之间的不匹配，并可选加入蒸馏与更新映射约束以保持预训练行为；支持 next-token 与 next-scale 两种生成范式，无需从头训练。
AI.result: 在 HumanML3D 上，于 MoScale、BAMM 和 LMR 三种生成器上均获得文本–动作对齐指标的一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 内部表示更新的精化是提升自回归动作生成的一个互补方向；该框架轻量、通用、可插拔，可跨不同自回归骨干与生成顺序复用。

title: Learning a Whole-Body Pivot-Walking Gait for Heavy-Box Transport with a Humanoid
comment: Accepted to IEEE-RAS Humanoids 2026. 8 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Project page: this https URL Video: this https URL
summary: Through pivot walking, humans can transport objects that are too heavy to lift. Previous humanoid studies have relied on planned sequences in which object manipulation and stepping are executed separately and the object is brought to rest between successive rotations. However, few studies have developed a single learned controller for humanoid pivot walking. In this paper, we propose a single reinforcement-learning policy that jointly coordinates stepping, balance control, and object manipulation. The policy is trained using rewards that promote alternating pivot motions and a phase reference that progresses according to the displacement of the object. In simulation, we confirmed that the humanoid can pivot a box. For deployment, we fine-tuned the policy into an object-blind version that follows a periodic clock instead of the progress reference. On the real robot, the deployed policy transported the box forward by more than 1 m in all five trials; each trial ended at a base-tilt safety stop. These results demonstrate that coordinated humanoid pivot walking can be learned with reinforcement learning and transferred to a physical humanoid robot without direct object-state sensing.

AI.tldr: 提出单一强化学习策略，联合协调类人机器人的迈步、平衡与物体操作，实现"支点行走"推动重箱；并微调为盲物版本（按时钟相位而非物体位移参考）后在真实类人机器人上成功将箱子前推超过1米。
AI.motivation: 人类可通过支点行走（pivot walking）搬运太重而无法举起/抱起物体。此前类人研究多采用"操作与迈步分离、每次旋转间让物体静止"的规划式序列，缺乏单一学习式控制器来实现连续、协调的支点行走。
AI.method: 设计单一RL策略同时输出迈步、平衡控制与手臂操作动作；奖励项鼓励交替支点（alternating pivot）运动；引入随物体位移推进的相位参考（phase reference）作为观测/条件信号。部署前将策略微调为object-blind版本，改用周期性时钟信号替代物体会进展参考，从而摆脱直接的物体状态传感；仿真训练后迁移到真实类人机器人。
AI.result: 仿真中类人机器人可成功支点推动箱子。真实机器人上，5次试验全部将箱子前推超过1 m；每次试验最终均以基座倾角安全停止（base-tilt safety stop）结束，说明策略偏激进或触发安全保护。
AI.conclusion: 类人支点行走可通过强化学习学到并迁移到真实硬件，且无需直接的物体状态感知，即可实现协调迈步-平衡-操作的重物搬运；同时暴露出稳定性/安全边界仍需改进。

title: 3D CoCa v3: Contrastive Learners with Scene Graphs for Urban Scene Understanding
summary: Understanding large-scale 3D urban scenes requires representations that capture both multi-scale geometric structures and complex spatial relationships. However, existing 3D vision-language methods primarily emphasize global semantic alignment or object-level representations, leaving structured relational modeling underexplored within unified contrastive and generative frameworks. In this paper, we present 3D CoCa v3, a scene-graph-enhanced contrastive and generative framework for urban 3D scene understanding. Our framework features a Pyramid Vision Encoder for multi-scale geometric representation learning and a language-model-based decoder with question-guided caption retrieval and visual cross-attention. We further introduce MSG-based relational descriptions to enrich contrastive 3D-language alignment with structured spatial relationships. To support semantic and relational supervision, we construct City3D-9.6K, a multi-view urban vision-language dataset with aligned visual-geometric observations, scene captions, and scene graphs. Extensive experiments on City-3DQA demonstrate that 3D CoCa v3 achieves 88.35% and 64.79% overall top-1 accuracy on the sentence-wise and city-wise splits, surpassing 3D CoCa v2 by 20.88 and 3.57 percentage points, respectively. Furthermore, 3D CoCa v3 achieves the best performance on GeoEval3D, demonstrating its effectiveness in urban spatial reasoning and geometric understanding. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 3D CoCa v3：用场景图增强的对比+生成框架做城市3D场景理解，含金字塔视觉编码器、问题引导字幕检索解码器、MSG关系描述，并发布City3D-9.6K数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有3D视觉-语言方法偏重全局语义对齐或物体级表示，缺乏在多尺度几何结构与结构化空间关系上的统一对比/生成建模。
AI.method: Pyramid Vision Encoder 做多尺度几何表示；语言模型解码器结合问题引导的字幕检索与视觉交叉注意力；引入基于MSG（最小生成树）的关系描述以结构化空间关系增强3D-语言对比对齐；构建City3D-9.6K多视角城市视觉-语言数据集（对齐视觉-几何观测、场景字幕、场景图）。
AI.result: City-3DQA上句级/城市级split总体top-1分别为88.35%和64.79%，较3D CoCa v2提升20.88与3.57个百分点；GeoEval3D上取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 场景图增强的多尺度对比-生成统一框架可有效提升城市3D空间推理与几何理解，并提供相应数据与代码支持后续研究。

title: PRISM: Perceptual Rate-Controllable Extreme Image Compression with Visual State-Space Models
summary: Generative codecs built on pretrained diffusion priors achieve high perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates (below 0.05 bpp). However, most methods still require a separate model for each bitrate, and offer no control over the amount of detail synthesized. Their rate efficiency also depends on the entropy model, where Mamba-based state-space models (SSMs) have recently improved autoregressive context modeling. However, conventional SSM scans are not aligned with the decoding order, and each decoding pass restarts from an empty state, discarding context accumulated in previous passes. We propose PRISM, an extreme image compression method that addresses these limitations. A single model provides two continuous controls: a rate knob that traverses the rate-distortion curve and a realism knob that adjusts the level of detail synthesized. Its visual state-space (VSS) context model introduces a decode-order-aligned (DOA) scan, which predicts each latent from a state that summarizes all decoded context, and cross-tap state carry, which initializes each tap with a summary of the previous one. Experiments show that PRISM outperforms both variable-rate and fixed-rate codecs, requiring on average 22% less bitrate than the strongest baseline at equal FID while also achieving higher PSNR.

AI.tldr: PRISM：单一生成式图像压缩模型，提供"码率旋钮"与"真实感旋钮"两个连续控制，并引入解码顺序对齐(DOA)扫描与跨tap状态传递的VSS上下文模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散先验的生成式编解码器虽在极低码率(<0.05 bpp)下感知质量高，但通常每个码率需单独训练模型，且无法控制合成细节量；Mamba类SSM熵模型的扫描顺序与解码顺序不一致，且每次解码都从空状态重启，丢弃已有上下文。
AI.method: 提出PRISM极端图像压缩方法：1) 单模型双连续控制——码率旋钮遍历RD曲线、真实感旋钮调节合成细节；2) 视觉状态空间(VSS)上下文模型，含解码顺序对齐(DOA)扫描（用汇总全部已解码上下文的状态预测每个latent）与cross-tap状态传递（用前一个tap的摘要初始化下一个tap）。
AI.result: 实验显示PRISM优于变码率与固定码率编解码器，在相同FID下平均比最强基线节省22%码率，同时PSNR更高。
AI.conclusion: PRISM以单模型实现可控码率与可控真实感的极端压缩，并通过解码对齐的SSM上下文建模提升率效率，验证了扫描对齐与状态复用对生成式编解码器熵建模的有效性。

title: The Missing Root: Geometric Imagination Without Images in Large Language Models
summary: This paper proposes a new paradigm and method for giving large language models spatial understanding. Standard language models operate exclusively over discrete words (secondary representations of things rather than continuous space itself), forcing them to guess geometry verbally. Whereas most multimodal approaches equate spatial grounding with camera images or video frames, spatial structure itself is not a picture: it consists of coordinate frames, solid boundaries, and how objects move and relate to each other in continuous space. Motivated by this distinction, we place continuous object tokens combining pose (position, orientation, and scale) and signed-distance shape embeddings alongside word tokens inside a single uninterrupted transformer sequence, allowing language and geometry to attend to each other as object scenes are built and updated step by step. Control tokens switch output automatically between natural-language words and continuous object state updates to a persistent object workspace, while an attention mask blocks earlier prose when generating the answer, so responses must be read directly from settled geometry. To prove this method works, we attach a narrow parallel spatial stream (+4.4% weights) alongside unfrozen Qwen3-1.7B layers. In our two-dimensional tests, the model spawns and transforms multi-object scenes from English descriptions, transfers shapes to held-out nouns, and relies causally on the workspace to answer spatial questions.

AI.tldr: 提出将连续物体token（姿态+有向距离场形状嵌入）与词token放入同一transformer序列的空间理解范式，在冻结的Qwen3-1.7B旁挂窄平行空间流（+4.4%参数），实现语言描述→多物体2D场景构建与更新，并因果依赖工作区回答空间问题。
AI.motivation: 标准语言模型仅在离散词上运算，几何只能靠"口头猜测"；而主流多模态方法把空间接地等同于相机图像/视频帧，但空间结构本身不是图片，而是坐标系、实体边界与物体在连续空间中的运动关系。因此需要一种直接在连续空间中表示并操作几何的架构。
AI.method: 在单一不间断的transformer序列中混排词token与连续物体token（位姿：位置/朝向/尺度 + SDF形状嵌入），使语言与几何可互相注意力；控制token切换输出为自然语言或对持久化物体工作区的连续状态更新；用attention mask屏蔽生成答案时的前序文本，迫使回答直接读取已收敛几何。实现上在未冻结的Qwen3-1.7B层旁并联窄空间流（仅增4.4%权重）。
AI.result: 2D实验显示：可由英文描述生成并变换多物体场景、将形状迁移到未见名词、并以因果方式依赖工作区回答空间问题。
AI.conclusion: 将几何作为一等公民、与语言共用序列上下文，是可让LLM获得可验证空间理解的有效路径；但验证限于2D合成环境，尚缺3D、真实感知输入与机器人/具身闭环证据。

title: SPiXSeg: Rethinking MLLM-based Image Segmentation as Superpixel Classification
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely used for image segmentation. However, existing methods either use a decoder or use patch-based approach which trades boundary precision against the number of decisions as coarse grid cells mix foreground and background pixels, while finer grids require many more predictions, and autoregressive mask generation adds sequential decoding overhead. We propose SPiXSeg, which shifts the output from per-patch to per-superpixel label assignment, using superpixel tokens formed by aggregating patch-level visual features. An off-the-shelf model partitions each image into task-agnostic superpixels, so the partition is computed once and reused across tasks. A Spix-to-Mask (S2M) module scores each superpixel token in a single MLLM forward pass by directly comparing the MLLM's hidden representations, without autoregressive generation or a separate scoring network, and the selected superpixels are mapped directly to pixels without refinement. Without any trainable decoder head or post-hoc refinement, SPiXSeg achieves an average cIoU of 80.5 with LLaVA-1.5-7B and 81.9 with InternVL2.5-8B on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+ and RefCOCOg and, when trained only on COCO-Stuff, extends to open-vocabulary semantic segmentation with mIoU of 29.0, 59.5 and 95.4 on ADE20K, PASCAL Context and PASCAL VOC, outperforming several SoTA MLLM baselines. Our results suggest that a fixed, query-agnostic superpixel partition is enough for accurate language-guided segmentation.

AI.tldr: SPiXSeg 将 MLLM 分割输出从逐 patch 转为逐超像素标签分配：用现成模型做一次性、任务无关的超像素划分并复用，通过 S2M 模块在单次前向中直接比较 MLLM 隐表示给超像素 token 打分，无需自回归生成、可训练解码头或后处理精修。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 分割方法要么依赖额外解码器，要么采用 patch 级预测：粗网格会混合前景/背景导致边界精度差，细网格使预测数量剧增，自回归掩码生成又带来串行解码开销。作者希望找到一种既保边界精度、又控制决策数量与推理开销的输出表示。
AI.method: 1) 使用现成超像素分割模型将图像划分为任务无关超像素，划分只需计算一次并可跨任务复用；2) 聚合 patch 级视觉特征形成超像素 token；3) Spix-to-Mask (S2M) 模块在单次 MLLM 前向中直接比较 MLLM 隐表示完成超像素打分，不使用自回归生成，也不引入独立打分网络；4) 选中的超像素直接映射回像素，无精修。
AI.result: 在 RefCOCO/RefCOCO+/RefCOCOg 上，LLaVA-1.5-7B 平均 cIoU 80.5、InternVL2.5-8B 为 81.9；仅用 COCO-Stuff 训练即可迁移到开放词表语义分割，ADE20K/PASCAL Context/PASCAL VOC 的 mIoU 分别为 29.0/59.5/95.4，优于多个 SoTA MLLM 基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明固定且与查询无关的超像素划分足以支撑精准的语言引导分割；去掉可训练解码头与后处理精修仍具竞争力，为高效多模态分割提供了轻量输出范式。

title: Continuous Foundation-Guided Pseudo-Label Weighting for Breast Ultrasound Domain Adaptation
summary: Breast ultrasound segmentation models often generalize poorly across scanners, institutions, and patient populations. We investigate continuous foundation-guided pseudo-label weighting for unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA). An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher generates target-domain pseudo-labels, while a frozen ultrasound segmentation model (AutoSAMUS) modulates their contribution using a bounded weight that combines the prior's certainty with its probabilistic agreement with the teacher. In contrast to our earlier selective BiRP rule, the proposed formulation supervises every target pixel with a weight in [0.5, 1] and requires no foundation-model inference at test time. We evaluate the method on five public breast ultrasound datasets, spanning three source domains and eleven source-target directions. Under the TransUNet protocol, continuous weighting outperforms both all-pixel EMA and original BiRP on all four BUSI-source targets, and achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest HD95 among the compared methods on all four BUS-BRA-source targets. Results with BrEaST as the source are mixed: continuous weighting performs best on BUSI and comparably to original BiRP on OASBUD, whereas none of the adaptation methods surpasses source-only training on BUS-UCLM. In a separate U-Net pipeline, agreement-only weighting performs comparably to the full formulation, leaving the incremental value of prior certainty unresolved. Because the weighting rule was developed after some target-test results had been examined, we treat the study as exploratory and report adverse as well as favorable outcomes.

AI.tldr: 用冻结的超声分割基础模型（AutoSAMUS）为EMA教师生成的目标域伪标签提供连续、有界（[0.5,1]）的置信权重，实现无监督域适应的乳腺超声分割。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声分割模型在跨设备、跨机构、跨人群时泛化性差；已有选择性BiRP规则仅监督部分目标像素且需测试期基础模型推理，作者希望用连续加权覆盖全部像素并去掉推理开销。
AI.method: EMA教师生成伪标签；冻结的AutoSAMUS同时提供先验置信度及与教师的概率一致性，二者组合成一个位于[0.5,1]的有界像素级权重；在TransUNet与U-Net两条管线上评估，覆盖5个公开BUS数据集、3个源域、11个源-目标方向，对比全像素EMA、原BiRP与仅源域训练。
AI.result: TransUNet下，连续加权在BUSI为源的4个目标上均优于全像素EMA与原BiRP；BUS-BRA为源的4个目标上取得最高平均Dice与最低HD95。BrEaST为源结果混杂：BUSI最佳、OASBUD与原BiRP相当、BUS-UCLM上所有适应方法均不敌源域单训。U-Net管线中仅一致性加权与完整公式相当，先验置信度的增量价值未证实。
AI.conclusion: 连续基础模型引导的伪标签加权在多数源-目标方向上有效且推理零额外开销，但收益依赖源域与骨干网络，先验置信度项作用不明；由于加权规则在看过后部分目标测试结果后才提出，作者将研究定位为探索性并同时报告不利结果。

title: Hybrid Reinforcement Learning for One-step Degraded Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Infrared and visible image fusion (IVIF) is essential for robust perception, yet existing methods remain limited under complex degradations. While diffusion models (DMs) offer powerful modeling capabilities to combat such degradations, their iterative process incurs high computational cost. One-step distillation effectively accelerates inference but typically leads to over-smoothed results. To resolve these limitations, we propose a one-step fusion framework with hybrid reinforcement learning, termed OneHRL. We treat degraded inputs as intermediate noisy states along a generative trajectory, enabling a distilled one-step generator to rectify them directly to the clean fusion results. Concurrently, to mitigate the over-smoothed results in distillation, we incorporate the Flow-GRPO paradigm to introduce stochasticity into the deterministic one-step generation. This restores the stochastic exploration necessary for sampling-based reinforcement learning. Furthermore, we design a coarse-to-fine reward that integrates a global semantic reward with an object-level reward. This hybrid reward ensures that the generator captures both naturalness and fine-grained texture. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior fusion quality and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出单步蒸馏扩散融合框架 OneHRL，借 Flow-GRPO 注入随机性并用由粗到细的混合奖励（全局语义+目标级）缓解蒸馏过平滑，实现高效高质量红外-可见光融合。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型能应对复杂退化，但迭代采样计算开销大；单步蒸馏虽加速推理却导致结果过度平滑、丢失细节纹理，需在效率与融合质量间取得平衡。
AI.method: 将退化输入视为生成轨迹上的中间噪声状态，用蒸馏单步生成器直接映射到干净融合结果；引入 Flow-GRPO 范式为确定性单步生成加入随机性，恢复采样式强化学习所需的随机探索；设计由粗到细的混合奖励，融合全局语义奖励与目标级奖励。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在融合质量与计算效率上均优于现有方法，缓解了蒸馏导致的过平滑问题。
AI.conclusion: 单步扩散+强化学习微调是兼顾红外-可见光融合效率与细粒度质量的有效路线，混合奖励设计提升了自然度与纹理保真。

title: Structured Noise Diffusion for Echocardiography Haze Removal
summary: Echocardiographic images are frequently degraded by spatially structured haze artifacts that obscure anatomical boundaries and hinder clinical analysis. Conventional diffusion models typically employ pixel-independent Gaussian noise, limiting their ability to represent localized ultrasound haze. In this study, we propose a structure-informed diffusion framework that explicitly models ultrasound haze as an accumulation of localized Gaussian components constrained by the ultrasound fan geometry. The forward process generates spatially correlated corruption by sampling component locations and scales, providing a formulation that better reflects the spatial characteristics of real echo artifacts. During reverse restoration, a dual-head network predicts an anchor probability map and Gaussian scale parameters to progressively remove structured artifacts while reducing the center bias associated with direct coordinate regression. We evaluated the framework on the public DehazingEcho2025 benchmark and two private clinical datasets, without retraining or fine-tuning on either private cohort. Our method achieved the highest mean generalized contrast-to-noise ratio across all three datasets, reaching $0.715 \pm 0.090$ on the public benchmark while preserving tissue edges.

AI.tldr: 提出结构感知扩散框架，将超声雾霾建模为受扇形几何约束的局部高斯分量累积，前向加噪采样分量位置/尺度生成空间相关退化，反向用双头网络预测锚点概率图与高斯尺度参数逐步去噪。
AI.motivation: 传统扩散模型使用像素独立高斯噪声，无法刻画超声图像中空间结构化的局部雾霾伪影；同时直接坐标回归存在中心偏置问题。
AI.method: 以超声扇形几何约束的局部高斯分量为退化算子构建前向过程；反向恢复采用双头网络，分别预测锚点概率图（热图式，缓解中心偏置）和高斯尺度参数，实现结构化伪影的渐进去除。
AI.result: 在公开 DehazingEcho2025 基准及两个私有临床数据集上（后两者零样本，未重训/微调），三数据集平均 gCNR 均最优；公开基准达 0.715±0.090，且组织边缘保持良好。
AI.conclusion: 将退化建模为符合物理成像几何的结构化噪声可提升扩散式超声去雾效果；但评测集中于图像质量指标，未涉及下游临床任务、真实临床部署或跨设备验证。

title: OmniMeld: Enhancing Audio-Visual Understanding via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Audio-visual understanding requires perceptual grounding, temporal understanding, and semantic inference. Multi-teacher distillation can consolidate these capabilities, but direct probability matching does not explicitly capture teacher prediction changes across audio-visual conditions. We introduce OmniMeld, a multi-teacher on-policy distillation method that integrates domain expertise through modality-response-guided distribution matching. We train four teachers covering grounding and correspondence, temporal dynamics and event structure, causal and inferential reasoning, and contextual and holistic understanding. Each sample is routed to its corresponding teacher for supervision conditioned on student-generated answer prefixes. We derive transport costs from teacher prediction changes over shared candidate tokens across audio-visual conditions, using optimal transport to match student predictions to those of the teacher under complete audio-visual input. We also construct OmniMeld-20K for domain-specialized teacher training. The dataset spans four capability domains, with responses structured into evidence, reasoning, and answer sections and verified through consistency checks and media-based review. Experiments on audio-visual and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate competitive teacher performance among similarly sized open-source models. The student improves over its base model across all evaluated benchmarks and surpasses the teachers' base model on several benchmarks.

AI.tldr: OmniMeld：以模态-响应引导的最优传输分布匹配进行多教师on-policy蒸馏，将四类能力教师（感知grounding、时序、因果推理、上下文）整合进音视频理解学生模型，并构建OmniMeld-20K教师训练数据集。
AI.motivation: 音视频理解需同时具备感知grounding、时序理解与语义推理能力。多教师蒸馏可整合这些能力，但直接的概率匹配无法显式捕捉教师预测在有无音频等模态条件下的变化，导致模态敏感的知识未被传递。
AI.method: 四教师分工：grounding与音画对应、时序动态与事件结构、因果与推理、上下文整体理解；训练数据OmniMeld-20K按四领域构建，响应拆分为证据/推理/答案并做一致性校验与媒体复核。蒸馏时依据学生生成的答案前缀将样本路由到对应教师；利用共享候选token上教师预测在完整音视频输入与消融模态条件下的变化构造传输代价，用最优传输（OT）将学生分布对齐到完整音视频条件下的教师分布。
AI.result: 四个教师在同规模开源模型中表现具竞争力；学生在所有评测基准上优于基线模型，并在若干基准上超过教师的基座模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于模态响应差异的OT式多教师on-policy蒸馏可有效聚合异构能力，但验证局限于音视频与通用视频理解基准，未涉及具身/机器人任务或现实部署证据。

title: Measuring the Value of One Shared Image at Robot Handoffs in Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: When the lead robot cannot continue, what should it send the teammate that must finish the route? We replay a frozen receiver at each contact under alternative messages. Across 3,920 autonomous departures in 106 environments, adding the view before the lead's last action block to its executed actions raised success by 7.51 percentage points (pp) per RxR handoff and 8.54 pp per SAGE handoff. Per departure the gains were 2.23 and 1.44 pp, respectively. The lead continuing in simulation defines the empirical full-history ceiling (Solo). At contact, the lead had accumulated a median of 41 frames. Sending one frame when available recovered 24% of the full-history advantage over actions alone in SAGE and 30% in RxR. Over an estimated progress cue in SAGE, the image rescued 100 routes and reversed 54 successes. Near-goal receivers finished outside less often (63.1% to 51.7%, post hoc). In secondary comparisons the earlier view outperformed the contact view by 6-7 pp per handoff. Exact-route specificity and image gains at controlled starts with mostly unknown progress or outside the goal region remained unresolved. Gains were detectable from about 7 kB per handoff. Random transmission matched within size bins nearly equaled the learned sender's team success. At a required handoff, a view of the approach to the last maneuver helps the receiver finish.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多机器人交接时的通信内容问题：当领航机器人无法继续时，向接收者发送什么消息最有效。通过回放冻结接收者、对比不同消息（仅动作 vs 动作+视图），在106个环境3920次自主发车中证明发送"最后动作前视图"能显著提升交接成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人团队任务中常需交接（handoff），但通信带宽有限，缺少对"该传什么"的系统性量化。作者希望回答：在有限信息下，发送视图是否比仅发送执行动作更有利于接收者完成路线，以及需要多少信息量。
AI.method: 采用冻结接收者的受控回放实验：在每次接触点用不同消息替换输入，对比仅动作、动作+最后动作块前视图、接触视角、单帧图像、估进度线索等条件。跨106个环境、3920次自主发车，在RxR与SAGE两个导航数据集上统计成功率，并以领航者继续运行的Solo模式作为全历史上界；同时比较学习型发送者与随机发送、以及不同字节量级下的增益。
AI.result: 在领航者最后动作块前加入视图，使每次交接成功率提升7.51 pp（RxR）与8.54 pp（SAGE），按发车计为2.23与1.44 pp。接触时领航者已积累中位41帧；单帧可恢复全历史上界优势的24%（SAGE）与30%（RxR）。相较进度线索，图像挽救100条路线、反转54次成功。近目标接收者落结局外比例由63.1%降至51.7%。更早期视图比接触时刻视图每交接高6-7 pp。约7 kB/交接即可检出增益，随机发送在学习发送者尺寸分箱内几乎等效。
AI.conclusion: 在必要交接时，发送领航者最后机动前接近段的一视图即可显著帮助接收者完成路线；增益信息量门槛低、对发送者学习程度不敏感。但精确路线特异性和受控起点下图像增益（进度未知或目标区域外）仍未解决。

title: MAFNet-UR$^3$: Mask-Aware Fusion Network for Unified Raindrop and Reflection Removal
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 LoViF Workshop. Received the Outstanding Challenge Paper Runner-Up Award
summary: Raindrops and reflections frequently co-occur on windshields and jointly obscure scene content, making their unified removal, referred to as UR$^3$, a highly ill-posed problem. Existing approaches are mainly based on diffusion models and thus can produce visually plausible restorations. However, they may generate scene-inconsistent structures in severely corrupted regions. To address this limitation, we propose MAFNet-UR$^3$, which adopts a three-stage framework to exploit multiple observations for scene-consistent unified raindrop and reflection removal. Specifically, Stage I suppresses raindrops while preserving the reflection layer, and Stage II performs prior-guided reflection removal followed by image-space refinement. Stage III estimates degradation masks from intermediate restoration results to provide degradation cues and performs mask-aware multi-scale fusion across observations to preserve scene structure and fine details. As a result, our proposed MAFNet-UR$^3$-L achieves state-of-the-art performance on the RDRF-testing benchmark, outperforming DiffUR$^3$ by 2.33 dB in PSNR and 2.7634 in the challenge score. Our method ranked third in the LoViF 2026 UR$^3$ Challenge, achieving a final score of 41.1416.

AI.tldr: MAFNet-UR³ 用三阶段框架利用多观测实现雨滴与反射的统一去除：先抑雨保反射，再先验引导去反射并图像域精修，最后估计退化掩膜并做掩膜感知的多尺度跨观测融合，以保证结构一致。
AI.motivation: 雨滴与反射在挡风玻璃上常同时出现并共同遮挡场景，统一去除（UR³）高度病态。现有扩散模型方法虽视觉合理，但在严重退化区域易生成与场景不一致的虚构结构。
AI.method: 三阶段流程：(I) 抑制雨滴同时保留反射层；(II) 先验引导的反射去除 + 图像空间精修；(III) 从中间修复结果估计退化掩膜作为退化线索，并在多观测间做掩膜感知的多尺度融合，以保持场景结构与细节。大模型版本命名为 MAFNet-UR³-L。
AI.result: 在 RDRF-testing 基准上取得 SOTA，PSNR 比 DiffUR³ 高 2.33 dB，challenge score 高 2.7634；在 LoViF 2026 UR³ Challenge 中排名第三，最终得分 41.1416。
AI.conclusion: 多观测 + 退化掩膜引导的融合是缓解扩散式修复结构漂移的有效手段，在联合雨滴-反射去除任务上刷新了 SOTA；但属于车载成像增强类工作，与核心关注领域关联较弱。

title: Concept Generalization in Visual Brain Decoding via Encoder-Generated fMRI
summary: Visual brain decoders are typically trained and evaluated on stimuli drawn from similar semantic distributions, leaving their ability to reconstruct unseen concepts poorly understood. We study this concept generalization problem by withholding semantic concepts from a target subject's training data. We find that three recent fMRI-to-image decoders degrade substantially for the held-out concepts, even when the concept remains available for multi-subject models. In contrast, brain encoders that map a pretrained visual representation directly to voxels are markedly more robust to the same semantic holdout. Motivated by this asymmetry, we use such an encoder to generate synthetic fMRI responses for new images and add the resulting image-fMRI pairs to decoder training. Across three decoders, four subjects, and twelve semantic concepts, synthetic data recovers a substantial fraction of the performance lost on unseen concepts without requiring additional, time-consuming fMRI acquisition. We further show that the same approach improves general decoding performance across a wide range of data budgets. Analyses of encoder training conditions, encoder designs, and synthetic-data controls show that the gains depend on both encoder generalization and the semantic content of the synthetic supervision, rather than merely increasing the amount of training data. Together, our results show that encoder-generated fMRI can transfer semantic generalization to decoders.

AI.tldr: 论文研究fMRI-to-image解码器对未见语义概念的泛化问题，发现编码器(encoder)比解码器(decoder)对语义留出更鲁棒，并用编码器生成合成fMRI数据增强解码器训练，显著恢复未见概念上的性能损失。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉脑解码器通常在相似语义分布上训练与评测，对未见概念的泛化能力缺乏认识；同时获取fMRI数据耗时昂贵，难以通过新增采集覆盖新概念。
AI.method: 在目标被试训练数据中系统性留出若干语义概念以构造概念泛化测试；对比三种fMRI-to-image解码器与直接将预训练视觉表征映射到体素的脑编码器在相同留出下的表现；再用该编码器为新图像生成合成fMRI响应，将合成图像-fMRI对加入解码器训练；并做编码器训练条件、编码器设计与合成数据对照的消融分析。
AI.result: 三种解码器在留出概念上性能显著下降（即使多被试模型仍可见该概念）；编码器对同一语义留出明显更鲁棒；合成数据在3种解码器、4名被试、12个概念上恢复了大量损失性能，且在不同数据规模下均提升通用解码表现；增益来源是编码器的泛化能力与合成监督中的语义内容，而非单纯增加数据量。
AI.conclusion: 编码器生成的fMRI可作为语义泛化能力的迁移媒介，把编码器的泛化性转移到解码器上，无需额外昂贵采集即可提升对未见概念的重建。

title: X-Matte: VAE-Free Pixel-Space Flow Matching for Single-Step Image Matting
summary: Pre-trained generative models offer rich visual priors for image matting, but their adaptation often relies on variational autoencoders (VAEs), whose spatial compression can degrade fine alpha details and introduce additional inference overhead. To address these limitations, we propose X-Matte, a VAE-free pixel-space flow matching framework for single-step image matting. By eliminating latent compression, X-Matte formulates the RGB-to-alpha transition as a continuous flow directly in pixel space. We adopt trajectory-wide x-prediction with transition-aware alpha supervision, enabling the model to learn from intermediate states while directly predicting the target alpha matte in a single forward pass. This design avoids both VAE encoding and decoding and iterative sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate performance competitive with state-of-the-art trimap-free matting methods on P3M benchmarks, together with promising zero-shot generalization to RWP-636 and AIM-500. Moreover, X-Matte achieves up to a 9.4x inference speedup over a constructed single-step latent counterpart at high resolution, demonstrating the effectiveness of VAE-free pixel-space modeling for accurate and efficient image matting.

AI.tldr: X-Matte：无 VAE 的像素空间 flow matching 单步抠像框架，通过轨迹级 x-prediction 一次前向直接预测 alpha，去掉潜空间压缩与迭代采样。
AI.motivation: 预训练生成模型用于抠像时多依赖 VAE 潜空间，空间压缩会损失 alpha 细节细粒度并带来额外编解码开销。
AI.method: 在像素空间构建 RGB→alpha 的连续流，采用 trajectory-wide x-prediction 与 transition-aware alpha 监督，使模型从中间状态学习并单步前向输出目标 matte；无需 VAE 编码/解码与迭代采样。另构建单步潜空间对照模型用于效率对比。
AI.result: 在 P3M 基准上与 SOTA trimap-free 方法竞争；零样本泛化至 RWP-636 与 AIM-500 有希望表现；高分辨率下相较潜空间单步对照最高 9.4x 推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 验证了无 VAE 像素空间建模在抠像任务上兼顾精度与效率的可行性，为单步生成式抠像提供了新范式。

title: Off the Driven Path: Transferable Road Understanding in Driving VLAs
summary: End-to-end driving policies increasingly operate without explicit HD maps at inference, raising the question of what road knowledge they actually internalize. To probe this knowledge through model outputs, we introduce Road-KSU, a framework that automatically converts HD maps and actor annotations into a road-centric scene graph. From this, we derive road-focused question answering and reasoning targets, complemented by map-based trajectory compliance metrics. Pairing Road-KSU with geographically disjoint splits yields a $2 \times 2$ evaluation crossing output modality (language vs. action) with place familiarity (seen vs. unseen roads). On NAVSIM, 95% of test samples lie within 10m of a training sample, and scores of 13 published planners on turns rise steeply with the number of training drives through the test location, pointing to memorized road geometry. Retraining on geographically disjoint splits and probing with Road-KSU confirm that action-space performance degrades most on unfamiliar turns, with failures dominated by geometric compliance. Language accuracy, however, drops on road-centric VQA on straight and curved roads alike, and remains stable on dynamic scene content. Scaling the training data further reveals a double dissociation: more drives through the same places improve driving on unseen roads but leave road question answering unchanged, whereas spreading a fixed data budget over more places increases road question answering with little change in driving performance. These findings show that improved driving scores need not imply broader road understanding on unseen roads, and identify geographic diversity as key to transferable road knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出 Road-KSU 框架，将 HD 地图与参与者标注自动转为道路中心场景图，生成道路问答/推理任务与地图约束的轨迹合规指标；结合地理不相交划分，将输出模态（语言 vs 动作）与地点熟悉度交叉评估，揭示端到端驾驶策略在未见道路上"得分提升≠道路理解提升"。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶策略推理时不再依赖显式 HD 地图，但其究竟内化了多少道路知识尚不清楚；现有 NAVSIM 基准存在严重地理重叠（95% 测试样本落在训练样本 10m 内），导致高分可能源于记忆而非理解。
AI.method: Road-KSU：由 HD 地图+actor 标注自动构建道路中心场景图，派生道路相关 VQA/推理目标与基于地图的轨迹合规指标；配合地理不相交（seen/unseen 道路）划分，形成 2×2 评估（输出模态×地点熟悉度）；对 13 个已发表 planner 做训练驱动次数与转弯性能的关联分析，并在不同数据规模/多样性配置下重训练。
AI.result: NAVSIM 上 95% 测试样本距训练样本≤10m，13 个 planner 转弯得分随测试地点训练趟数急升，表明存在几何记忆；地理不相交重训练后动作性能在陌路转弯下降最多，失败以几何合规为主；语言在直线与曲线道路 VQA 上均下降，对动态场景内容保持稳定；数据扩展呈现双重解离：同地点更多趟数改善陌生道路驾驶但不改变道路问答，固定预算铺开到更多地点则提升道路问答而驾驶性能几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 驾驶分数提升不必然意味着对未见道路的更广道路理解；地理多样性是获得可迁移道路知识的关键，建议将地理不相交划分与道路中心探针纳入端到端驾驶评测标准。

title: Integration of Vision-Language-Action Control for Autonomous Forklift Unloading with Limited Real-World Data
summary: Forklifts play a critical role in warehousing and distribution, but existing automation systems remain limited in handling complex tasks that require sequential decision-making. Recently, vision--language--action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for multi-step decision-making by directly generating control actions from visual observations and language prompts. Although VLA-based control has been extensively researched for manipulators, to the best of our knowledge, its application to forklifts remains unexplored. Therefore, this study demonstrates the integration of VLA control for an autonomous forklift unloading task with limited real-world data. Moreover, training VLA models typically requires large-scale datasets. As there is currently no public dataset for forklift operations, we use a VLA model pretrained primarily on robotic manipulator data and construct a training dataset via simulation, which can be scaled up at low cost. We then adapt the pretrained VLA model to forklift control using 9.38 h of simulation data and 0.8 h of real-world demonstrations, with the latter accounting for approximately 8% of the collected forklift data by duration. The integrated system was validated through 72 real-world trials across four model variants. The results show that the proposed system can accomplish an unloading task even with limited real-world data.

AI.tldr: 首次将视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型用于自主叉车卸货任务，用仿真数据(9.38 h)+少量真实示教(0.8 h)微调，经72次真机试验验证可行。
AI.motivation: 叉车在仓储物流中关键，但现有自动化难以处理需序贯决策的复杂任务；VLA模型在机械臂上已被广泛研究，但尚无面向叉车的研究，且缺少公开叉车数据集。
AI.method: 以主要在机械臂数据上预训练的VLA模型为基座，低成本构建仿真训练数据（9.38 h），再结合0.8 h真实示教（约占叉车数据时长的8%）做微调适配叉车控制；在4种模型变体上共做72次真机试验。
AI.result: 72次真机试验表明，在真实数据有限条件下系统仍可完成卸货任务；真实数据仅占约8%仍是有效适配的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: VLA控制可迁移到叉车类非抓取式移动操作平台，仿真为主+少量真机的数据配方是低成本落地路径；但缺乏成功率等定量指标与基线对比。

title: LayoutRecall: Preserving Appearance in Multi-Round 3D Layout-Controlled Image Editing
summary: 3D layout-controlled image editing gives users explicit control over object placement and camera viewpoint. In a sequence of edits, however, the latest image can lose the appearance of an object when it is occluded or leaves view. The target layout specifies where the object should reappear, while its appearance must be recovered from earlier observations. We introduce LayoutRecall, a multi-round editor that stores and reuses appearance in the local coordinate systems of 3D boxes. Box-Surface Latent Memory retains image latents on box faces and retrieves them along rays in the target view. Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning supplies the retrieved tokens to a FLUX.2 editor using target-view positions, shared box-local embeddings, and object-wise attention. A correspondence loss encourages the editor to attend to matching observations during denoising. We also introduce LayoutLoop, a multi-round 3D layout-controlled image editing benchmark with calibrated layouts and designed revisits. We conduct extensive experiments on LayoutLoop and real-scene data to verify the ability of our method. The project page is at this https URL .

AI.tldr: LayoutRecall：多轮3D布局受控图像编辑中，将物体外观以3D box局部坐标存储（Box-Surface Latent Memory），按目标视线射线检索并注入FLUX.2编辑器，实现被遮挡/移出视野物体的外观回忆。
AI.motivation: 多轮布局受控编辑中，物体被遮挡或离开视野后外观信息丢失；目标布局只给出物体应出现的位置，而外观须从早期观测中恢复，现有编辑器缺乏跨轮次外观记忆机制。
AI.method: (1) Box-Surface Latent Memory：把图像latent存于3D box表面，在目标视角沿射线检索；(2) Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning：用目标视角位置、共享box局部嵌入与object-wise attention将检索token送入FLUX.2；(3) correspondence loss促使去噪时关注匹配观测；(4) 提出LayoutLoop多轮基准，含标定布局与设计的重访场景。
AI.result: 在LayoutLoop与真实场景数据上开展大量实验，验证方法的有效性（摘要未给具体指标）。
AI.conclusion: 将外观以3D box局部坐标系持久化并按几何对齐检索，是解决多轮布局编辑外观记忆的一种可行方案，并提供了对应评测基准。

title: DeltaRAE: Derivative Tokenization for Long Video Generation
summary: Latent video generators are trained on clips of a few seconds, and much of this limit lies in their tokenizers, which spend as many tokens on a static frame as on a moving one and need future frames that do not exist during generation. We introduce DeltaRAE, a causal representation autoencoder for video. Its derivative tokenization encodes periodic anchor frames in full and all remaining frames with a few tokens each, and its causal encoder and decoder read a frozen pretrained image encoder. On UCF-101 and Kinetics-600, a standard diffusion transformer trained on DeltaRAE latents is competitive with state-of-the-art video tokenizers. DeltaRAE halves the tokenizer GFLOPs on 16-frame clips relative to keeping the same number of patch tokens for every frame, and it represents a minute of video with 18.8x fewer tokens. The tokenizer trains end to end on one-minute videos, and in video prediction a generator on its latents produces a full minute of video. The same generator collapses within 15 seconds in most videos when the tokenizer has the same token budget but no pretrained encoder.

AI.tldr: DeltaRAE：面向视频的因果表征自编码器，采用“导数分词”——周期性锚帧全量编码、其余帧仅用少量 token，形成级联残差结构；编码器/解码器读取冻结图像编码器。UCF-101/Kinetics-600 上与 SOTA 视频分词器相当，16 帧 tokenizer GFLOPs 约减半，一分钟视频 token 数减少 18.8×，并可直接用于长视频预测。
AI.motivation: 现有潜空间视频生成器受限于分词器：(1) 静态帧与运动帧消耗同样多 token，冗余严重；(2) 非因果分词器在生成时需要尚不存在的未来帧，难以支撑长时自回归生成。因此需要一种因果、低冗余、可长时训练的视频分词方案。
AI.method:
- 导数分词（derivative tokenization）：周期性锚帧（anchor frame）用完整 patch token 编码，其余帧仅用少量 token 编码相对锚帧的“差值/残差”。
- 因果编码器与解码器，均以大模型冻结预训练图像编码器（如 DINO/SigLIP 类）为视觉先验输入。
- 端到端训练于一分钟长视频，tokenizer 与重建目标联合优化。
- 在潜空间上训练标准扩散 Transformer（DiT）做生成/预测验证。
AI.result: 在 UCF-101 与 Kinetics-600 上，基于 DeltaRAE 潜变量的扩散 Transformer 与 SOTA 视频分词器表现相当；16 帧片段下 tokenizer GFLOPs 减半；一分钟视频 token 数减少 18.8×；生成器可在其潜空间上自回归生成长达一分钟的视频。消融显示：同等 token 预算但无冻结预训练编码器时，同一生成器在多数视频中 15 秒内即崩塌，说明冻结图像先验对长时稳定性关键。
AI.conclusion: DeltaRAE 通过因果、锚帧+差值的派生式分词，将视频 token 冗余大幅压缩并消除未来帧依赖，使长时（分钟级）视频分词与生成成为可能，且冻结图像编码器先验是维持长时生成稳定性的关键。对长时序世界模型/视频预测的状态表征设计有直接参考价值。

title: SIA: Selective Image Analogy
comment: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (Conference Papers). 28 pages including supplementary material. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL Dataset: this https URL
summary: Image analogy transfers a demonstrated transformation from a before/after pair (A, A') to a new query image B. Existing methods assume all changes in (A, A') should be fully transferred, limiting flexibility when users want only a subset of the demonstrated edits. We introduce Selective Image Analogy (SIA), a new setting where a single demonstration pair encodes multiple edits, and the user selects at inference time which edits to apply to B. To support this, we curate a multi-edit analogy dataset with full-edit and partial-edit targets. We then train a model that first learns to transfer the complete demonstrated transformation, and then gains selective control through a mask-aligned suppression mechanism: a token-gated LoRA that restricts adapter updates to suppressed edit tokens during denoising, paired with a concept suppression vector that weakens the selected tokens in the text embeddings before denoising. Together, these components allow SIA to suppress unwanted edits that remain visible in A', while preserving the user-selected ones, all without requiring a new demonstration pair for each edit combination. We perform extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations along with user studies to demonstrate the efficacy of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出选择性图像类比（SIA）：一对演示图像编码多种编辑，用户推理时选择要迁移的子集；构建多编辑类比数据集，用token门控LoRA+概念抑制向量实现编辑抑制。
AI.motivation: 现有图像类比假设(A,A')中所有变化必须被完整迁移，无法在推理时只应用部分编辑，导致每换一种编辑组合就需新的演示对。
AI.method: 两阶段：先训练模型完整迁移演示变换，再通过掩码对齐抑制机制获得选择控制——去噪阶段用token门控LoRA将adapter更新限制在被抑制的编辑token上，同时在文本嵌入中用概念抑制向量削弱选定token。
AI.result: 在新构建的多编辑类比数据集（含全编辑与部分编辑目标）上进行了定量、定性评估及用户研究，验证方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 单演示对即可支持推理时灵活选择编辑子集，无需为每种编辑组合重新提供演示对。

title: TWIST: Teacher-Weighted Initial-Noise Spherical Transform for Quality-Preserving Diversity in Distilled Diffusion Models
summary: Timestep-distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images in one or a few steps, but often suffer from reduced mode coverage and limited diversity. Recent methods improve diversity by optimizing the initial noise at inference time, requiring costly backpropagation through the denoiser. Moreover, their diversity objectives typically repel generated samples without accounting for how the corresponding teacher model distributes its outputs. We introduce Teacher-Weighted Initial-noise Spherical Transform (TWIST), a lightweight network that transforms the low-frequency components of initial noise to improve diversity without inference-time optimization. TWIST uses a teacher-guided determinantal point process (DPP) objective to align the feature-space diversity of student samples with that of the teacher. By amortizing noise optimization into a single network, TWIST eliminates inference-time backpropagation while preserving the efficiency of few-step generation. On SDXL-Turbo, TWIST matches the diversity of MoNO at less than 25% of its inference cost, while achieving higher recall and better PickScore, ImageReward, and CLIPScore under matched compute budgets. On SDXL-Lightning, it achieves comparable recall at lower cost without the ImageReward degradation observed with MoNO.

AI.tldr: TWIST：用轻量网络变换初始噪声的低频分量，以教师引导的DPP目标对齐师生特征多样性，免推理期反传地提升少步蒸馏扩散模型的多样性。
AI.motivation: 时间步蒸馏扩散模型（如SDXL-Turbo/Lightning）少步生成质量高，但模式覆盖与多样性下降。现有方法在推理时优化初始噪声以提升多样性，需对去噪器反传，代价高；且多样性目标只是互相排斥样本，未考虑教师模型的输出分布。
AI.method: 提出TWIST网络：仅变换初始噪声的低频成分（球面变换），将噪声优化摊销为前馈网络，消除推理期反传。训练目标为教师引导的确定性点过程（DPP），使学生在特征空间的多样性与教师样本分布对齐，而非简单排斥。
AI.result: SDXL-Turbo上，TWIST在不到MoNO 25%的推理成本下达到与其相当的多样性，且在同等算力预算下recall、PickScore、ImageReward、CLIPScore均更高；SDXL-Lightning上以更低成本获得可比recall，且无MoNO出现的ImageReward下降。
AI.conclusion: 通过将噪声优化摊销进单个轻量网络并以教师DPP分布对齐为多样性目标，可在保持少步生成效率的同时显著改善多样性-保真度权衡。

title: RelPRM: Grounding Visual Process Reward Models in Relational Evidence
summary: Visual process reward models (PRMs) can detect calculation errors yet assign high scores to steps that misread visual relations. Supervision based on subsequent answer success does not directly establish whether a step's relational claim holds. To strengthen visual-relation verification, we first build an automated pipeline that programmatically verifies each claim and identifies the required objects, relations, and image regions. It produces RelProcessTrain and RelProcessBench (RPB), which tests whether scores respond appropriately to relational evidence through controlled image edits and step rephrasings. Building on this pipeline, we further introduce RelPRM, a visual-relation-oriented method for process reward modeling with two training mechanisms. Relation-evidence self-distillation constructs views preserving necessary objects, relations, and dependencies, reducing the burden of finding decisive evidence in complex scenes and transferring reliable evidence-assisted judgments to full images. Relation-evidence-driven consistency training encourages appropriate score changes when relation edits reverse a step's truth, stability under irrelevant edits, and similar score changes across paraphrases. At inference, RelPRM directly scores the current step using only the original image and reasoning context. RelPRM achieves 66.2% on VisualProcessBench (VPB) and 68.4% on RPB, gains of 4.2 and 9.9 percentage points over VisualPRM-8B. These results show that training for visual relations improves both relational verification and step assessment across broader multimodal reasoning tasks.
