AI.tldr: 提出面向视觉关系的过程奖励模型 RelPRM：先用自动化管线验证每步的关系主张并构建 RelProcessTrain/RelProcessBench，再以关系证据自蒸馏与关系证据驱动一致性训练提升视觉关系验证，VPB 66.2%、RPB 68.4%，分别超 VisualPRM-8B 4.2/9.9 个点。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 PRM 能发现计算错误，却会对"误读视觉关系"的步骤给出高分；以最终答案正确性为监督信号无法直接判定单步的关系主张是否成立，因此需要专门强化视觉关系验证能力。
AI.method: 1) 自动化管线：程序化验证每条关系主张，标注所需对象、关系与图像区域，产出 RelProcessTrain 与 RelProcessBench（通过受控图像编辑与步骤改写检验分数是否对关系证据敏感）；2) RelPRM 训练机制：关系证据自蒸馏——构造保留必要对象/关系/依赖的视图，降低复杂场景中定位决定性证据的难度，并把证据辅助判断迁移到全图；关系证据驱动一致性训练——要求关系反转时分数合理变化、无关编辑下分数稳定、同义改写间分数变化一致；3) 推理时仅用原图与推理上下文直接打分，无需额外证据检索。
AI.result: 在 VisualProcessBench 上达 66.2%、自建 RPB 上达 68.4%，相较 VisualPRM-8B 分别提升 4.2 与 9.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 针对视觉关系的过程监督可同时改善关系验证与步骤评估，并可迁移到更广泛的多模态推理任务；但其贡献限于奖励建模与基准评测，未涉及具身/机器人闭环验证。

title: Tortho-Gaussian++: Suppressing Geometric Drift and Floaters for Robust Gravity-Aligned TDOM Generation in Large-Scale Aerial Scenes
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable performance in aerial scene reconstruction, motivating its recent extension to true digital orthophoto maps (TDOMs) generation. We propose Tortho-Gaussian++, a novel 3DGS training framework that suppresses geometric drift and floaters and automatically prunes unreliable peripheral regions, coupled with a robust gravity-aligned TDOM rendering solution. First, we explore geometric support via viewing-ray-based geometric observability analysis, quantitatively characterizing the reliability for each Gaussian and subsequently pruning peripheral regions with particularly weak geometric support. Second, the optimizer state initialization is refined for newly created Gaussians during densification, intrinsically suppressing drift and floaters without external priors. Lastly, a robust gravity direction estimation solution is designed, combining image-derived gravity cues, camera-distribution priors and nadir views, to achieve a gravity-aligned orthogonal projection reference for TDOM rendering. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) datasets demonstrate that our Tortho-Gaussian++ outperforms vanilla 3DGS by 0.5-3.5 dB in average PSNR and yields comparable or superior performance to prior-guided 3DGS methods. Notably, it reduces the training time, VRAM and Gaussian number by 45.5%, 47.2%, and 58.6%, respectively. Qualitative evaluations confirm that our method effectively suppresses drift and floaters, while robust gravity direction estimation reduces tilt-induced facade artifacts in TDOMs.

AI.tldr: Tortho-Gaussian++ 提出一种 3DGS 训练框架，通过基于视线的几何可观测性分析剪除边缘弱支撑高斯、改进致密化时优化器状态初始化以抑制漂移与漂移体（floaters），并结合图像重力线索、相机分布先验与正射视角的鲁棒重力方向估计，实现重力对齐的 TDOM 正交投影渲染。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 在航拍场景重建中表现优异，扩展至真正射影像图（TDOM）生成时仍受几何漂移、漂移体以及重力方向不准导致立面伪影影响；作者希望在不依赖外部先验的前提下提升 TDOM 质量与训练效率。
AI.method: 三点设计：(1) 基于视线的几何可观测性分析，定量刻画每个高斯的几何支撑可靠性，据此剪除周边弱支撑区域；(2) 在致密化新生成高斯时精化优化器状态初始化，从机制上抑制漂移与 floaters；(3) 融合图像重力线索、相机分布先验与近垂直视角的鲁棒重力方向估计，构建重力对齐的正交投影参考用于 TDOM 渲染。
AI.result: 在多组大规模无人机数据集上，相较原始 3DGS 平均 PSNR 提升 0.5–3.5 dB，与使用先验的 3DGS 方法相当或更优；训练时间、显存与高斯数量分别减少 45.5%、47.2%、58.6%；定性结果确认有效抑制漂移与 floaters、减少倾斜引起的立面伪影。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明几何可观测性与优化器状态初始化是航拍 3DGS 稳定性的关键，且稳健重力估计对 TDOM 质量至关重要，可作为高效、先验无关的航拍场景重建与正射产品生成方案。

title: CoTAMP: Cooperative Task and Motion Planning for Quadruped Robots with Large Language Models
summary: Some environments cannot be traversed by a single quadruped robot, for example a ledge that one robot can climb only from its partner's back or a gap that must be bridged with boxes. Solving them requires cooperative task and motion planning (TAMP). Previous works are limited to the motions of a single robot or only select actions from a predefined set of skills. We propose a framework with two parts: task planning that invents motions not defined in advance, and motion generation that realizes the invented motions. Both parts consist of large language model (LLM)-based modules and code-based modules. Task planning divides the trajectory of the whole task into steps and fixes the robot poses at the step boundaries. Motion generation produces keyframes that describe the motion of each step and turns them into a continuous trajectory through kinematic synthesis. The code-based modules check every plan and motion and return failures to the LLM-based modules for correction. The whole trajectory is then refined by trajectory optimization to satisfy the dynamics. On three simulated courses with two RAIBO2 robot models, our framework produced kinematically valid references in all 30 trials, all of which converged in trajectory optimization. Compared with several baselines, our framework showed advantages in success rate, dynamic feasibility, execution time, and generation time and cost. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM的协同任务与运动规划(TAMP)框架：任务规划模块"发明"未预定义的动作并确定步边界位姿，运动生成模块生成关键帧并经运动学综合转为连续轨迹，代码模块校验失败回馈LLM修正，最后经轨迹优化满足动力学。在两条RAIBO2机器人的三个仿真课程中30/30生成运动学有效参考并全部优化收敛。
AI.motivation: 单台四足机器人无法通过某些地形（需踩同伴背部翻越的台阶、需要用箱子架桥的间隙），需多机协同TAMP。已有工作局限于单机运动，或仅从预定义技能集中选动作；本文希望突破"预先给定动作库"的限制，直接发明新运动。
AI.method: LLM+代码混合的两段式框架。任务规划将整体轨迹切分为若干步，并在步边界固定机器人位姿；运动生成对每步产出关键帧描述，再通过kinematic synthesis（正/逆运动学综合）连接成连续轨迹；每步计划与运动由代码模块校验，失败结果返回LLM模块迭代修正；整体轨迹再用轨迹优化满足动力学约束。
AI.result: 三个仿真课程、两种RAIBO2模型、共30次试验均生成运动学有效参考，且全部在轨迹优化中收敛；与多个基线相比在成功率、动力学可行性、执行时间、生成时间与成本上均占优。
AI.conclusion: LLM可用于发明而非仅选择动作，配合代码化校验与运动学/动力学后处理可形成可用的多机协同TAMP管线；证据限于仿真，跨机型与真实机器人迁移性未验证。

title: X-World: Transferring Video Priors to Cross-Embodiment Robot Control
summary: Language-instructed manipulation requires robust closedloop policies, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are costly and limited in coverage. Human and robot videos provide complementary spatiotemporal priors for crossembodiment control. We propose X-World, which adapts pretrained video diffusion to variable views. A Q-Former compresses hidden states into tokens for a shared flowmatching expert that predicts action chunks. Datasetspecific projections map native states and actions. We adapt the backbone on large-scale robot and human videos, freeze it for action-only pretraining of the Q-Former and action expert, then post-train on the target platform. At inference, X-World responds at 20 Hz and overlaps updates with execution via asynchronous real-time chunking. X-World performs strongly on LIBERO and under zero-shot shifts on LIBERO-Plus. On hardware, it averages 81.7% success across six bimanual tasks on the side-mounted dual-arm UR5e, one of three real-robot configurations presented.

AI.tldr: X-World 将预训练视频扩散模型适配为可变视角的世界模型，用 Q-Former 压缩隐状态为 token 输入共享 flow-matching 动作专家预测动作块；在大规模机器人与人类视频上适配骨干后冻结，仅对 Q-Former 和动作专家做动作预训练，再在目标平台后训练；异步实时分块实现 20 Hz 推理。
AI.motivation: 语言指令操作需要鲁棒的闭环策略，但带动作标注的机器人轨迹昂贵且覆盖有限；人类视频与机器人视频可提供互补的时空先验以支持跨本体控制。
AI.method: 基于预训练视频扩散模型构建世界模型，支持可变视角；Q-Former 将视频骨干隐状态压缩为 token，输入共享 flow-matching 专家输出动作块；数据集相关投影层映射原生状态与动作；训练分三阶段（视频适配 → 冻结骨干的动作预训练 → 目标平台后训练）；推理时异步实时分块，与执行重叠更新。
AI.result: LIBERO 上表现强劲，LIBERO-Plus 零样本迁移下稳健；真实硬件侧装双臂 UR5e 上六个双臂任务平均成功率 81.7%（三种真机配置之一）。
AI.conclusion: 视频扩散世界模型 + 轻量动作头 + 分阶段跨本体预训练 + 异步实时分块，是构建跨本体闭环操作策略的有效路线，兼顾先验迁移与实时性。

title: SEEK: Self-Evolution through Execution Knowledge for Agentic Robot Manipulation
summary: General-purpose multimodal foundation models enable robots to adapt during deployment from observations and execution feedback, without task-specific demonstrations or training. However, the robot retains what it learns only in the model's working context. Once the task ends, it loses this execution knowledge, such as how to carry a bowl between two grippers. On the next attempt at the task, the robot may take just as long and repeat the same mistakes. To avoid this repetition, robots must retain execution knowledge across attempts. Yet replaying past actions is insufficient, because their effects depend on the current conditions. Procedures that determine actions from the current scene address this, but when they meet conditions that earlier attempts did not cover, revising them requires the measured effects of earlier actions. We therefore propose SEEK, an agentic framework that retains both, enabling robots to improve across attempts while keeping the underlying model fixed. To adapt retained knowledge to the current scene, SEEK adopts a Self-Evolving Programmatic Policy (SEPP) that encodes manipulation as executable procedures and determines each action from current observations. As the robot executes these procedures, SEEK records the measured effects of its actions, including those from failed attempts, in a Persistent Action-Effect Bank (PAEB). Where a retained procedure applies, it acts without a model request; where it meets a condition it does not cover, this evidence guides its revision. On RoboDojo, knowledge retained over ten attempts raises SEEK's average task score from 27.0 to 54.4 and its success rate from 19.7% to 48.0% across all 42 tasks. On 34 of these tasks with GPT-6.2 Astra, SEEK reaches 80.1 after five attempts, against 49.6 for the same model acting directly, and uses 77.6% fewer model requests. this https URL

AI.tldr: SEEK: 一个 agentic 框架，让通用多模态基础模型驱动的机器人在多次尝试间保留执行知识（自演化程序化策略 SEPP + 持久动作-效果库 PAEB），在 RoboDojo 42 任务上把平均分从 27.0 提升到 54.4，成功率 19.7%→48.0%，模型请求减少 77.6%。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态基础模型能让机器人零样本自适应，但学到的执行知识只存在于工作上下文，任务结束即丢失，下次尝试重复犯错、重走老路。简单回放历史动作不可行（效果依赖当前条件）；仅用"由当前场景决定动作"的程序也可行但遇到未覆盖条件时无据修订，因此需要同时保留"过程"与"实测效果"。
AI.method: 提出 SEEK agentic 框架，固定底层模型参数。1) Self-Evolving Programmatic Policy (SEPP)：将操作编码为可执行程序，每步动作由当前观测确定；2) Persistent Action-Effect Bank (PAEB)：执行时记录动作的实测效果，包括失败尝试；3) 程序适用时直接执行而无需模型请求，遇未覆盖条件时用实测证据指导程序修订。
AI.result: RoboDojo 全部 42 任务、10 次尝试积累知识后：平均任务分 27.0→54.4，成功率 19.7%→48.0%。其中 34 个任务使用 GPT-6.2 Astra，5 次尝试达 80.1（同模型直接执行 49.6），模型请求减少 77.6%。
AI.conclusion: 在保持基础模型固定的前提下，通过程序化策略记忆加动作-效果记忆，可实现跨尝试的经验累积与效率提升，避免了记忆回放或纯上下文学习的局限。

title: Event-WAM: Learning to Act with Event-Derived Futures
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage future visual modeling for robotic action learning, with recent studies exploring alternative or complementary objectives beyond conventional RGB prediction. We introduce Event-WAM, which incorporates event-derived visual changes as auxiliary future supervision alongside RGB. Event-WAM constructs temporally structured event representations from RGB demonstrations and encodes them using a frozen pretrained RGB video VAE, without training an event-specific VAE. Joint RGB--Event latent flow matching provides appearance- and change-oriented supervision without requiring event observations or explicit future generation at inference. Across simulated benchmarks, Event-WAM maintains comparable performance under standard conditions, while robustness gains under perturbations are benchmark-dependent, including improvements on LIBERO-Plus. Real-world evaluations further demonstrate improved manipulation success under both standard and unseen perturbation conditions. Further analyses show that policy improvements are not consistently accompanied by higher future prediction fidelity, suggesting the potential of change-oriented supervision for action learning.

AI.tldr: Event-WAM 用RGB演示构造事件表征，借冻结的RGB视频VAE编码，做RGB-事件联合潜空间流匹配，为机器人动作学习提供"变化导向"的辅助未来监督；推理时无需事件观测或显式未来生成。
AI.motivation: 现有World Action Models通常只以RGB未来预测作为监督目标，而RGB预测侧重外观重建，未必直接编码对控制有用的"视觉变化"信息；同时希望在不引入额外事件相机传感、推理阶段不加负担的前提下，获得互补的未来监督信号。
AI.method: 从RGB演示中合成时间结构化的类事件表征（event-derived visual changes），用冻结的预训练RGB视频VAE（不训练事件专用VAE）编码，与RGB潜变量一起进行联合流匹配（joint RGB–Event latent flow matching），实现外观与变化双方向监督；策略推理时不需事件输入也不生成未来帧。
AI.result: 仿真基准上标准条件性能相当；扰动鲁棒性提升依赖基准（LIBERO-Plus 上有改善）；真机实验在标准与未见扰动条件下操作成功率均提升。分析显示策略提升并不总伴随更高的未来预测保真度。
AI.conclusion: 变化导向的辅助监督可能比单纯RGB未来预测保真度更贴合动作学习需求，且可零推理开销地嵌入现有WAM框架；但鲁棒性收益不一致，需更多基准验证。

title: UPP-Gauss: Ultrasound Propagation Physics-informed Gaussian Splatting for B-mode Novel-View Synthesis
summary: Accurate novel-view synthesis of B-mode ultrasound images requires modeling acoustic propagation through tissue and the resulting appearance variations across probe poses. We propose Ultrasound Propagation Physics-informed Gaussian Splatting (UPP-Gauss), which integrates these acoustic interactions into an explicit Gaussian representation. UPP-Gauss constructs acoustic maps by sampling three 3D Gaussian fields using the probe pose and acoustic beam propagation direction, then combines these maps according to ultrasound propagation to synthesize B-mode images. Across three acoustically diverse datasets, UPP-Gauss achieves the best reconstruction quality with efficient rendering, improving PSNR over the best baseline on each dataset by 1.43 dB on average. These results demonstrate accurate and efficient B-mode novel-view synthesis through explicit Gaussian modeling of ultrasound propagation.

AI.tldr: UPP-Gauss 用三个 3D 高斯场按探头位姿与声束方向采样生成声学图，再依超声传播物理合成 B-mode 图像，三数据集 PSNR 平均超基线 1.43 dB。
AI.motivation: B 超 B-mode 图像的新视角合成需同时建模组织内的声学传播过程以及随探头位姿变化的外观变化，现有方法未显式刻画声学物理交互，导致重建质量受限。
AI.method: 提出 UPP-Gauss：将声学交互显式嵌入 3D 高斯表示。依据探头位姿与声束传播方向，从三个 3D 高斯场中采样构建声学图（acoustic maps），再按超声传播规律组合这些图以合成 B-mode 图像。
AI.result: 在三个声学特性差异明显的数据集上取得最佳重建质量，渲染高效，PSNR 平均较最佳基线提升 1.43 dB。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式高斯建模超声传播，实现了准确且高效的 B-mode 新视角合成；属医学成像领域的可微渲染方法，与通用 3D 重建/具身智能方向关联有限。

title: iMFPO: Improving Mean Flow Policy Optimization with Drift-Aware Velocity Alignment for Embodied Control
summary: Flow-based generative policies offer expressive action modeling for embodied control, yet achieving efficient one-step generation under reward-driven policy optimization remains challenging. In particular, evolving action distributions during online reinforcement learning may introduce inconsistencies between instantaneous-velocity learning and interval-averaged action generation. To address this challenge, we propose iMFPO, a one-step generative policy optimization framework with decoupled velocity learning and drift-aware velocity alignment. A shared interval-conditioned actor supports instantaneous-velocity supervision and interval-averaged action generation. JVP-corrected velocity regression is jointly optimized with reward-driven policy objectives, with action-level guidance from a frozen PPO teacher during training. At inference, iMFPO directly generates actions through interval-averaged velocity prediction, achieving one-step control without iterative flow integration. Across Go2, G1, H1, and Spot, zero-latent evaluation yields mean returns of 35.69, 34.44, 416.23, and 29.86. On Go2, action-generation latency drops from 15.57 ms to 0.41 ms relative to 64-step RFPO. Code: this https URL . Website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: iMFPO：解耦速度学习与漂移感知速度对齐的一步式流生成策略优化框架，在四足与类人机器人上实现零潜变量一步动作生成，显著降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 基于流的生成策略表达力强，但在奖励驱动在线RL下，动作分布持续演化，导致瞬时速度学习与区间平均动作生成之间出现不一致，使得高效的一步生成难以实现。
AI.method: 提出iMFPO：共享的区间条件actor同时支持瞬时速度监督与区间平均动作生成；采用JVP修正的速度回归与奖励驱动策略目标联合优化，训练时引入冻结PPO教师的动作级引导；推理端直接通过区间平均速度预测出动作，无需迭代流积分，实现一步控制。
AI.result: 在Go2、G1、H1、Spot上零潜变量评测平均回报分别为35.69、34.44、416.23、29.86；Go2上动作生成延迟由64步RFPO的15.57 ms降至0.41 ms（约38倍加速）。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦速度学习与漂移感知对齐，可在保持生成策略表达力的同时实现高效一步推理，为流式生成策略的在线RL训练与实际部署提供可行路径；已开源。

title: Beyond the Happy Path: Generalizing Robot World Models from Simulated Failures
summary: Robot world models are increasingly used to evaluate and plan policies, yet robot training data are dominated by successful demonstrations. Off the happy path, when a grasp is misaligned or mistimed and the object is pushed, tilted, or slips, their predictions break down. Across five pretrained action-conditioned models, object-motion error is at most 10.4% lower than that of a static baseline that copies the first frame, and two models are worse than this baseline. We present WorldReforge, which teaches world models what happens when manipulation goes wrong. We construct the Reforge dataset of 62k simulated trajectories by perturbing reference grasps in position, orientation, and closure timing, recording each resulting push, slip, or failed pickup with ground-truth object pose, contact, and surface points. WorldReforge turns this ground truth into two training signals without additional inference cost. Interaction Alignment focuses reconstruction on the small object and contact regions that a global loss underweights, and Surface Correspondence trains backbone features to follow the same physical surface points across frames. On Cosmos3 Nano, WorldReforge reduces object trajectory error by 28.2% overall and by 35.0% on unseen objects, and it lowers the error in predicting how two actions' outcomes diverge by 43.3%. Although trained only in simulation, it also improves reconstruction on DROID and on real failure videos. Controlled data studies show that failed contact and successful holding teach complementary physics: failed contact teaches how objects respond, and holding teaches how a grasped state persists. Our code, data, and models are available at this http URL .

AI.tldr: 提出WorldReforge，用扰动抓取产生的失败/接触轨迹（Reforge数据集，62k）训练动作条件世界模型，通过Interaction Alignment与Surface Correspondence两种信号提升失配场景下的物体运动预测。
AI.motivation: 机器人训练数据以成功示范为主，世界模型在抓取错位/时机错误导致推挤、倾斜、滑落等"非理想路径"上预测失效；实测五个预训练动作条件模型相对"复制首帧"静态基线的物体运动误差仅至多低10.4%，其中两个还不如该基线。
AI.method: 构造Reforge数据集：对参考抓取在位置、姿态、闭合时机上施加扰动，仿真得到62k轨迹，记录物体真值位姿、接触与表面点。两种无额外推理开销的训练信号：(1) Interaction Alignment，将重建损失聚焦于被全局损失低估的小物体与接触区域；(2) Surface Correspondence，训练主干特征在帧间跟踪同一物理表面点。
AI.result: 在Cosmos3 Nano上，物体轨迹误差整体降低28.2%，未见物体上降低35.0%，两动作结果差异预测误差降低43.3%；仅用仿真训练，也在DROID与真实失败视频上改善重建。控制实验显示失败接触教会物体如何响应，成功持握教会抓取状态如何保持，二者互补。
AI.conclusion: 失败与接触数据是世界模型的关键补充监督来源，可作为成功示范主导数据的有益补充；方法具有仿真到真实迁移迹象且代码、数据、模型开放。

title: Towards 360$^\circ$ Embodied UAV Tracking Without Turning
summary: Conventional embodied UAV tracking couples target observability with heading control because targets may leave the field of view of forward-facing cameras. We investigate a complementary paradigm that uses full-spherical perception to follow designated targets without active heading adjustment. To support this setting, we introduce 360UAV-ETrack, a simulation benchmark comprising 2,652 sequences, over 1.73 million synchronized observations, eight tracking tasks, and 150 held-out closed-loop scenarios. We propose 360UAV-TVLA, a panoramic vision--language--action (VLA) framework integrating persistent visual referring (PVR), compressed temporal memory (CTM), and geometry-aligned trajectory supervision (GTS) for instance identification, motion reasoning, and three-dimensional control. Experiments across two VLA backbones show consistent gains over standard fine-tuning, with normalized average tracking frames increasing from 22.56\% to 35.28\% for $\pi_0$ and from 25.68\% to 33.64\% for $\pi_{0.5}$. Our benchmark further reveals a substantial gap between offline imitation accuracy and closed-loop tracking reliability, establishing a challenging testbed for future research this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出全景（360°）感知下无需主动调整航向的无人机目标跟随新范式，构建360UAV-ETrack仿真基准（2,652序列、173万+同步观测、8类跟踪任务、150个留出闭环场景），并提出360UAV-TVLA全景视觉-语言-动作框架（PVR持久视觉指代、CTM压缩时序记忆、GTS几何对齐轨迹监督）。
AI.motivation: 传统具身无人机跟踪将目标可观测性与航向控制耦合，目标易离开前视相机视场；若采用全景感知，则可解耦二者，实现不依赖主动转向的稳定跟随，但缺乏相应基准与方法。
AI.method: 1) 360UAV-ETrack仿真基准，覆盖多任务全景跟踪与闭环评测；2) 360UAV-TVLA框架：持久视觉指代（PVR）用于实例识别、压缩时序记忆（CTM）用于运动推理、几何对齐轨迹监督（GTS）输出三维控制；在两类VLA骨干（π0、π0.5）上验证。
AI.result: 相较标准微调，归一化平均跟踪帧数由22.56%提升至35.28%（π0）、由25.68%提升至33.64%（π0.5）；基准揭示离线模仿精度与闭环跟踪可靠性间存在显著鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 全景感知+无需航向调节的跟踪范式可行且互补于常规方案；360UAV-ETrack提供了包含闭环可靠性要求的挑战性测试平台，指出离线指标无法代表真实闭环性能。

title: BayesPath: Reliability-Aware Bayesian Reasoning for Whole-Slide Pathology Agents
summary: Diagnosing whole-slide images (WSIs) requires hypothesis-driven reasoning: pathologists form a differential diagnosis, seek discriminative evidence, weigh its reliability, and stop once it suffices. However, existing training-free WSI agents lack an explicit framework for such reasoning. They typically use a large language model (LLM) to aggregate the region descriptions of a multimodal LLM (MLLM), without a belief over the candidates or regard for the descriptions' reliability. Consequently, a repeated model error counts as independent evidence for an incorrect diagnosis. We introduce BayesPath, a training-free WSI agent that casts the pathologist's Scan-Look-Weigh-Decide process as reliability-aware Bayesian reasoning. An explicit belief over the candidates is updated with each observation through a reliability-aware likelihood and guides where to look next and when to stop. This likelihood corrects for the models' answer bias, discounts correlated observations, and captures diagnostic confusions estimated without labels. The updates form an interpretable evidence trail of how each observation shapes the belief. On five MultiPathQA tasks spanning slide classification and slide VQA, BayesPath achieves the highest average accuracy among training-free agents, 58.6% against 34.1% for the next best, with large gains on slide classification. On identical observations, Bayesian updating outperforms LLM aggregation on average, even with a larger LLM. BayesPath's belief is also better calibrated than naive Bayes, so uncertain cases can be deferred to pathologists. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: BayesPath：免训练的全切片图像（WSI）智能体，将病理医生的"扫描—观察—权衡—决策"流程形式化为可靠性感知的贝叶斯推理，用显式信念分布指导下一步观察位置与停止时机。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练WSI智能体仅用LLM汇总MLLM的区域描述，缺乏对候选诊断的显式信念，也不考虑描述可靠性，导致模型重复出错被误当作独立证据，从而强化错误诊断。作者希望引入符合病理医生假设驱动推理的显式框架。
AI.method: 免训练智能体框架：维护候选诊断上的显式信念；每次观察通过"可靠性感知似然"更新信念，该似然（1）校正模型的答案偏差，（2）对相关/重复观察降权，（3）使用无标签方式估计的诊断混淆矩阵；信念引导下一处观察区域的选择与停止判据，并形成可解释的证据链。
AI.result: 在MultiPathQA的5个任务（切片分类与切片VQA）上，免训练智能体平均准确率58.6%，次优方法仅34.1%，切片分类提升尤为显著；在相同观察序列下，贝叶斯更新优于LLM聚合（即使后者用更大LLM）；信念校准优于朴素贝叶斯，可将不确定样本转交病理医生。
AI.conclusion: 显式、可靠性感知的贝叶斯信念更新是替代朴素LLM聚合的有效范式，兼具准确性、可解释性与校准性；但由于面向医学WSI诊断，与物理AI/机器人/3D重建核心方向关联较弱，属领域CV应用。

title: TAT-Det: A Dataset for Testicular Appendage Torsion Detection and Segmentation in Ultrasound Images
summary: Background: Testicular appendage torsion (TAT) is the leading cause of acute scrotal pain in prepubertal children. Yet, its diagnosis remains challenging due to nonspecific clinical manifestations and the absence of standardized datasets for pediatric acute scrotal emergencies. Results: We present TAT-Det, an expert-annotated ultrasound dataset specifically designed for TAT. TAT-Det comprises 2,600 ultrasound images from 1,203 patients collected at the Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine. Each TAT-positive image is accompanied by lesion-level bounding boxes for detection and pixel-level segmentation masks for fine-grained delineation. Annotations were produced through a multi-stage workflow involving independent annotation by board-certified pediatric sonographers, consensus review, and refinement. Baseline benchmarks for object detection and semantic segmentation using representative deep learning models are further provided, with YOLO11m achieving the best detection performance and RWKV-UNet the best segmentation performance. Conclusions: TAT-Det addresses the lack of publicly available resources for pediatric emergency ultrasound and establishes a foundation for developing and evaluating artificial intelligence methods for automated TAT analysis.

AI.tldr: TAT-Det: 儿童睾丸附件扭转超声数据集，2600张图/1203例，含检测框与分割掩码，附YOLO11m与RWKV-UNet基线。
AI.motivation: 儿童急性阴囊疼痛首要病因为睾丸附件扭转，临床表现非特异、缺乏标准化公开数据集，诊断困难。
AI.method: 构建专家标注超声数据集（病灶级边界框+像素级掩码），采用认证儿科超声医师独立标注、共识复核与精修的多阶段流程；用代表性深度学习模型建立检测与语义分割基线。
AI.result: YOLO11m检测最优，RWKV-UNet分割最优。
AI.conclusion: 填补儿科急诊超声公开资源空白，为自动化TAT分析AI方法奠定评测基础。

title: A Computational Model of Continuous Recognition Memory for Natural Images
summary: Recognizing an image we have seen before is a basic function of human visual memory. Understanding human continuous recognition memory (CRM) can help machine vision systems predict which images people are likely to remember and generate more memorable images. It can also inform the diagnosis of memory impairments and the development of interventions to improve memory. This paper proposes the first computational model for CRM. The model captures three key components of continuous recognition memory (CRM): image encoding, memory decay, and decision making. It encodes each image as a distinct random variable in a perceptual space. As the memory of an image fades, the distribution of its random variable drifts within that space. To decide whether the current image has been seen before, the observer retrieves samples from the distributions associated with previously encoded images and compares them with the current image. Our model predicts human observers' trial-by-trial responses in CRM tasks within the variability observed across human participants. Our model is parameter efficient, requiring only four shared parameters and two parameters per observer. It can accurately predict the memorability of an image no worse than prior methods that require millions of parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出首个连续识别记忆（CRM）的计算模型，将图像编码、记忆衰减、决策三部分统一为感知空间中的随机变量漂移与采样比较过程，仅需少量参数即可逐试次预测人类反应并预测图像可记忆性。
AI.motivation: 理解人类连续识别记忆有助于机器视觉系统预测哪些图像易被记住、生成更易记忆的图像，并辅助记忆障碍诊断与干预；但此前缺乏CRM的计算模型。
AI.method: 将每张图像编码为感知空间中一个独立的随机变量；记忆衰减表现为该随机变量的分布在空间中漂移；判定"是否见过"时，从已编码图像的分布中采样并与当前图像比较，从而完成决策。
AI.result: 模型能在人类被试个体差异范围内逐试次预测CRM任务反应；仅需4个共享参数与每人2个参数，图像可记忆性预测精度不逊于需数百万参数的先验方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了首个参数高效、可解释的连续识别记忆计算模型，兼具认知建模价值与机器视觉（可记忆性预测/生成）应用潜力。

title: Where to Approximate: Understanding and Accelerating Looped Multi-View Reconstruction
summary: Looped multi-view reconstruction refines scene features by repeatedly applying a shared transformer block. Making these updates cheaper requires knowing how an approximation at one step affects the rest of the refinement. We study this with paired interventions in Déjà View and stacked reconstruction transformers, separating the error an approximation injects, how that error propagates, and how it affects the output. In Déjà View, approximation errors are attenuated more strongly than matched random perturbations under a scale-adjusted state-error measure, and a local Jacobian decomposition separates the contribution of channel gating from the response to spatial error structure. Spatial approximations made early benefit from subsequent refinement, whereas cross-step reuse depends on which quantity is cached and how reuse steps are spaced. At equal final norm, approximation errors change the predicted rotations 1.55 times as much as random errors. These findings guide our proposed method, which reduces spatial resolution and pools keys and values early in refinement, then interleaves attention-output reuse with full attention, and is adapted through lightweight self-distillation. Across five reconstruction benchmarks, the balanced configuration runs $1.63\times$ faster than the official 16-step Déjà View model with a 1.86-point reduction in average pose AUC@$3^\circ$. At matched latency, it exceeds the interpolated curve of a trained baseline using full refinement blocks by 4.73 points in AUC@$3^\circ$ and improves the corresponding geometry metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文用成对干预实验分析循环多视图重建中近似误差的注入、传播与输出影响，据此提出降分辨率+早期KV池化+注意力输出复用交错+自蒸馏的加速方案，取得1.63倍加速。
AI.motivation: Looped multi-view reconstruction（如Déjà View）反复应用共享transformer块提升特征，但每步计算昂贵；要降低单步开销，需先理解某一步的近似如何影响后续整体精炼过程及最终输出，此前缺乏对误差注入、传播、输出敏感性的分离性分析。
AI.method: 在Déjà View与堆叠重建transformer中做成对干预实验：对比近似误差与匹配随机扰动在尺度校正状态误差度量下的衰减，用局部Jacobian分解分离通道门控贡献与对空间误差结构的响应；分析早期空间近似与跨步复用（缓存对象、复用步间隔）的影响。据此提出联合近似：精炼早期降低空间分辨率并池化keys/values，交织注意力输出复用与完整注意力，并用轻量自蒸馏适配。
AI.result: 等最终norm下，近似误差对预测旋转的影响是随机误差的1.55倍；Déjà View对近似误差的衰减强于匹配随机扰动；五個重建基准上，平衡配置比官方16步Déjà View快1.63倍，平均pose AUC@3°仅下降1.86；等延迟下比"全精炼块基线"的插值曲线高4.73点AUC@3°并改善几何指标。
AI.conclusion: 误差机制分析可指导循环式重建transformer的高效近似设计：早期空间近似可由后续精炼修正，而跨步复用需谨慎选择缓存量与步间隔；组合式近似配合自蒸馏可在同延迟下超越全块基线。

title: RefMix: Expanding Endpoint Proposals for Diversity-Preserving Reward Fine-Tuning
summary: Online forward matching aligns flow-based generative models by repeatedly generating, rewarding, and fitting model-produced endpoints. However, this behavior creates an on-policy feedback loop: as high-reward modes become increasingly favored, alternative modes become less likely to appear in subsequent training pools, progressively reducing visual diversity. We introduce RefMix, a reference-assisted endpoint proposal strategy that addresses this limitation by injecting alternative candidates into the training pool while retaining the original task reward and forward matching objective. In particular, RefMix uses a reference model during early high-noise steps to expose alternative visual modes, followed by the current reward-tuned model for endpoint completion. Across state-of-the-art online forward matching methods, RefMix consistently improves visual diversity while preserving task reward performance. Controlled inference experiments further demonstrate that training-time endpoint exposure is critical to improve reward--diversity trade-offs, beyond the impact of reference-assisted inference. By rethinking how training endpoints are proposed, RefMix achieves up to 44% higher diversity over forward matching baselines at comparable reward levels.

AI.tldr: RefMix proposes a reference-assisted endpoint proposal strategy for online forward matching in flow-based generative models, injecting reference-model-produced alternative candidates at early high-noise steps to break the on-policy feedback loop and improve reward-diversity trade-off.
AI.motivation: Online forward matching suffers from an on-policy feedback loop: high-reward modes dominate the training pool, and alternative modes become rarer over training, degrading visual diversity.
AI.method: RefMix mixes endpoints: early high-noise denoising steps are guided by a reference model (exposing alternative visual modes), then the reward-tuned model completes the endpoint. The original task reward and forward matching objective are kept unchanged; only endpoint proposal changes. Also runs controlled inference experiments isolating training-time exposure vs. inference-time reference assistance.
AI.result: Consistently improves visual diversity across SOTA online forward matching methods while preserving task reward; up to 44% higher diversity than baselines at comparable reward. Ablation of inference-only reference assistance shows gains stem from training-time endpoint exposure.
AI.conclusion: Rethinking how training endpoints are proposed (rather than only the reward or loss) is a simple, effective lever for the reward–diversity trade-off in reward-tuned generative models.

title: Where Does Free-Text 3D Grounding Fail? An Error Analysis of Report-Sentence Segmentation in Chest CT
summary: Free-text 3D grounding, segmenting in a CT volume the region described by one sentence of the radiology report, could link reports to images at scale, but it is unclear where current models fail. We analyse the publicly released VoxTell model on all 381 findings of the 200-scan ReXGroundingCT validation set, where it grounds 53.5% of findings. Its failures are rarely about which lesion or side is meant. No miss lies on the side opposite to the one named, and findings are almost never confused with one another. Instead, predictions are too large, land on a neighbouring lesion on the correct side, or are missing for small findings, and diffuse findings are rarely grounded. Removing location words halves performance, to the level of label-only prompting, and anatomical rules derived from the sentence never improve the full-sentence output. The same pattern holds on the hidden 300-scan test set. Further progress therefore depends on extent estimation and small-lesion sensitivity rather than on anatomical post-processing.

AI.tldr: 分析 VoxTell 在 ReXGroundingCT 验证集全部 381 条 finding 上的失败模式：53.5% 成功定位，错误主要源于范围过大、小病灶漏检与弥漫性描述，而非左右/病灶混淆，解剖学后处理无效。
AI.motivation: 自由文本 3D grounding 有望在规模化层面将放射报告与 CT 影像关联，但现有模型的失效模式尚不清楚，难以指导后续改进方向。
AI.method: 对公开 VoxTell 模型在 ReXGroundingCT 验证集（200 例扫描、381 条 finding）上进行全量失败分析，并在隐藏的 300 例测试集上验证；同时进行消融实验：移除位置词、以及用句子推导的解剖规则做后处理。
AI.result: 成功率为 53.5%；无一条漏检落在描述的对侧，findings 之间几乎不混淆；主要错误是预测范围过大、落在同侧相邻病灶、小病灶漏检，弥漫性病灶极少能定位。移除位置词使性能减半至仅标签提示的水平；由句子推导的解剖规则从未改善全句输出；隐藏测试集上结论一致。
AI.conclusion: 后续进展应着眼于范围（extent）估计与小病灶敏感性，而非解剖学后处理。

title: Targeted Adaptation of World-Action Models via Interaction and Motion Heads
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) are a promising new paradigm of robot manipulation policies that jointly generate future video and actions. Successful manipulation requires both identifying where to interact and modeling how the robot and objects move. Yet standard adaptation methods, such as full fine-tuning and LoRA, do not explicitly select parameters aligned with these manipulation-specific capabilities. Motivated by this challenge, we discover two functionally specialized families of attention heads: Next-Interaction Heads, which localize upcoming grasp-and-release targets, and Motion Heads, which track movement across frames. Furthermore, we introduce HeadLight, a parameter-efficient refinement method that jointly adapts Next-Interaction Heads and Motion Heads. On RoboTwin tasks unseen during fine-tuning, HeadLight achieves 62.28% success, compared with 57.89% for full fine-tuning and 58.66% for LoRA, while updating only 1.1% of parameters. Inference-time ablations further validate the functional importance of these heads: ablating Motion Heads reduces manipulation success from 57.89% to 0.94%, while ablating Next-Interaction Heads lowers it to 40.61%, both substantially more than ablating equally many random heads. Finally, we show that our approach is effective across multiple WAM architectures and real-robot manipulation settings.

AI.tldr: 发现世界-动作模型(WAM)中两类功能特化的注意力头(Next-Interaction Head与Motion Head),并提出仅更新1.1%参数的头级微调方法HeadLight,在未见RoboTwin任务上达62.28%成功率,超过全量微调(57.89%)与LoRA(58.66%)。
AI.motivation: WAM类机器人操作策略需同时具备"定位交互位置"与"建模运动"两种能力,但全量微调与LoRA等标准适配方式并不针对这些操作特化能力选择参数,存在适配低效问题。
AI.method: 先通过功能分析定位两类特化注意力头:Next-Interaction Heads(定位待抓取/释放目标)与Motion Heads(跨帧跟踪运动);据此提出HeadLight,一种参数高效精修方法,联合适配这两类头。
AI.result: 未见RoboTwin任务上62.28%成功率 vs 全量微调57.89%、LoRA 58.66%,仅更新1.1%参数;推理时消融Motion Heads使成功率从57.89%降至0.94%,消融Next-Interaction Heads降至40.61%,均显著强于消融等量随机头;在多种WAM架构与真机场景下同样有效。
AI.conclusion: WAM中的操作能力可由特定注意力头承载,基于功能归因的选择性微调是高效且可解释的适配范式,具备跨架构与真机泛化性。

title: Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction
summary: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement. Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC) builds on Scal3R's global context memory and uses relative scale references derived from predicted ground geometry to regularize test-time memory updates, encouraging cross-chunk consistency while limiting changes to reliable local geometry. Superpoint Alignment (SA) and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) jointly address the robust establishment and preservation of geometric relationships. SA balances ground and non-ground evidence across spatial regions to estimate inter-chunk translation. CL uses geometric and motion consistency across interleaved windows to select coherent chunk groups, each receiving a shared Sim(3) correction that preserves its internal relative transformations during global optimization. Experiments on five public driving benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements in long sequence reconstruction. On KITTI Odometry, Embodied-VGGT achieves a mean absolute trajectory error of 7.30 m and a Chamfer distance of 2.67 m, reducing these errors by 46.8% and 23.3% compared with the state-of-the-art baseline under same evaluation protocol. To facilitate reproducibility, we released our code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: Embodied-VGGT 利用具身采集中的地面几何尺度参考与运动一致性，在长序列 3D 重建中建立并选择性保留可靠的局部几何关系，显著降低 KITTI 上的轨迹误差与 Chamfer 距离。
AI.motivation: 长序列重建需要同时纠正累积漂移和保持局部几何一致性；在机器人与自动驾驶的具身采集中，平台-环境几何与重复观测可作为天然约束，但现有全局 refine 方法易破坏可靠的局部结构。
AI.method: 提出 Embodied-VGGT，含三个模块：MAGC（在 Scal3R 全局上下文记忆上用预测地面几何导出的相对尺度参考正则化测试时记忆更新，控制跨块一致性并限制对可靠局部几何的改动）；Superpoint Alignment（SA，跨空间区域平衡地面与非地面证据估计块间平移）；Cross-Loop Optimization（CL，利用交错窗口的几何与运动一致性筛选相干块组，每组共享一个 Sim(3) 校正以在全局优化中保持内部相对变换）。
AI.result: 在五个公开驾驶基准上长序列重建稳定提升；KITTI Odometry 上平均绝对轨迹误差 7.30 m、Chamfer 距离 2.67 m，较 SOTA 基线在同一评测协议下分别降低 46.8% 与 23.3%；已开源代码。
AI.conclusion: 将具身先验（地面几何尺度、运动一致性）显式引入分块式前馈重建的记忆更新与全局对齐，可兼顾漂移校正与局部几何保真，是长序列前馈 3D 重建的有效方向。

title: FasterGRN: Reducing the Refinement Redundancy for Accelerating Generative Refinement Networks
summary: Departing from the paradigm of diffusion and autoregressive models, Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) enables high-quality image generation through iterative refinements. However, this repeated processing over the entire visual representations results in substantial computation overhead. Furthermore, the binary representations and global refinement mechanism in GRN disable the direct application of acceleration strategies developed for other generative models. To accelerate GRN model, we first observe several key properties by analyzing the entire generative process. That includes the stage characteristic, dual branch similarity and more importantly, the $\textbf{refinement redundancy}$. Motivated by the observations, we present $\textbf{FasterGRN}$, a training-free acceleration method for the Generative Refinement Network. $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ first divides the GRN into the semantic establishment stage and detail refinement stage according to its semantic establishment. For alleviating the refinement redundancy mainly resulting from the detail refinement stage, we propose Adaptive Retention Expansion ($\textbf{ARE}$) and Selective Token Freezing ($\textbf{STF}$) to shrink refinement steps and reduce token computations, respectively. In the experiments on GenEval and DPG-Bench benchmarks, our method $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ achieves a $2.03\times$ sampling speedup while largely preserving image generation performance. Our evaluation on COCO datasets additionally demonstrates that $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ even outperforms the original GRN in image fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的FasterGRN加速方法，通过阶段划分、自适应保留扩展(ARE)与选择性Token冻结(STF)压缩细化步骤与token计算，实现约2倍采样加速并保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: Generative Refinement Networks(GRN)以迭代细化实现高质量图像生成，但对全体视觉表示反复处理带来巨大计算开销；且其二值表示与全局细化机制使扩散/自回归模型的加速策略无法直接迁移，因此需要针对GRN自身特性设计加速方案。
AI.method: 先分析完整生成过程，发现阶段特性、双分支相似性以及关键的"细化冗余"等性质；据此将GRN划分为语义建立阶段与细节细化阶段。针对细节细化阶段的冗余，提出自适应保留扩展(ARE)缩短细化步数，以及选择性Token冻结(STF)减少token计算，整体为无需训练的推理期加速。
AI.result: 在GenEval与DPG-Bench上实现2.03倍采样加速且大幅保持生成性能；在COCO上的评测显示图像保真度甚至优于原始GRN。
AI.conclusion: GRN存在可利用的阶段结构性与细化冗余，训练无关的步数与token级加速即可在几乎不损质量的前提下显著提速，为这一新生成范式的实用化提供了有效路径。

title: geo-eval-harness: An Evaluation Harness for Geospatial Foundation Models
summary: Geospatial foundation model (GFM) research papers are plagued by inconsistent evaluation settings (e.g., different pre-processing and probes), making it difficult to separate performance from evaluation choices. We propose geo-eval-harness}, an open-source framework for controlled model comparisons. We use this harness to evaluate 100 GFMs and general vision models on 6 classification and 14 segmentation datasets, using multiple probes on frozen or low-rank-adapted encoders. We show that under controlled evaluation, general vision backbones are competitive on RGB classification and high-resolution segmentation, but GFMs shine on multispectral tasks. When we compare any two of the top-ten classification models on a single dataset, their 95% confidence intervals overlap 73% of the time. We show that bigger models are not always better: inference FLOPs correlate weakly with segmentation performance. Moreover, translating inference compute into large-area mapping workloads shows how small accuracy differences have outsized deployment cost differences: with frozen encoders on SpaceNet2, a 0.9-point mIoU difference corresponds to 5.9x the compute and days of additional projected GPU time. Our findings stress the importance of comparing models under explicit and fixed settings, and reporting uncertainty and deployment compute alongside accuracy. Our geo-eval-harness makes controlled experiments easy, fast, and fully reproducible. We release the code, configurations, and results at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出开源评测框架 geo-eval-harness，在固定预处理与探针设置下对比 100 个地理空间基础模型与通用视觉模型（6 个分类、14 个分割数据集），揭示泛化视觉骨干在 RGB 分类与高分辨率分割上具竞争力、地理基础模型优势主要在多光谱任务，并强调需报告不确定性区间与部署算力。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型（GFM）研究长期受评测设置不一致（预处理、探针各异）困扰，性能差异与评测选择混杂，难以公平比较模型真实能力，也缺乏对精度差异在真实部署算力成本上影响的量化认识。
AI.method: 开源可控评测框架 geo-eval-harness；统一预处理与探针（冻结编码器 + 低秩适配），在 6 个分类与 14 个分割数据集上评测 100 个 GFM 与通用视觉模型；统计 top-10 模型 95% 置信区间重叠率；分析推理 FLOPs 与精度的相关性；将推理算力折算为大范围制图工作负载的 GPU 时间成本。
AI.result: 受控评测下通用视觉骨干在 RGB 分类与高分辨率分割上具竞争力，GFM 在多光谱任务上占优；单数据集上 top-10 分类模型两两比较时置信区间重叠率约 73%；模型规模与性能弱相关，FLOPs 与分割性能相关性弱；SpaceNet2 冻结编码器上 0.9 点 mIoU 差异对应约 5.9 倍算力与数天额外 GPU 时间。
AI.conclusion: 模型比较必须在显式、固定且可复现的设置下进行，并同时报告不确定性与部署算力；geo-eval-harness 使受控实验简便、快速且完全可复现，代码、配置与结果均开源。

title: QK-Bench: Benchmarking Quantitative Kinematic Understanding for Dynamic Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence concerns both scene structure and its temporal evolution. Yet a semantically correct description can conceal a quantitative error: recognizing that objects are approaching does not determine their closing speed or whether they will meet. Such errors are critical in collision avoidance, trajectory tracking, and reactive grasping, where actions depend on motion magnitude, timing, and relative geometry. We study quantitative kinematic understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs): resolving motion magnitude, rate, reference-frame dependence, and future spatial evolution from visual evidence. We introduce the Quantitative Kinematics Benchmark (QK-Bench), comprising 2,341 multiple-choice QA pairs from 379 videos and 17 tasks spanning Object-Centric Kinematics, Camera Ego-Motion Kinematics, and Multi-Object Kinematic Relations. Hidden geometric and temporal signals support trajectory construction and filtering, while fixed kinematic rules map physical quantities to verifiable answers, including categorical labels. Trajectory and question validation ensure target reliability and sufficient visual support in the sampled frames. All models receive a unified monocular RGB input. Evaluations of proprietary, open-source, and spatial MLLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model achieves only 41.2\% overall accuracy, and spatial MLLMs show no consistent advantage. These findings indicate that current advances in spatial intelligence do not reliably transfer to quantitative kinematic understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出QK-Bench，一个评估多模态大模型定量运动学理解能力（运动幅度、速率、参考系依赖、未来空间演化）的基准，含2341道多选题、379个视频、17个任务，最强模型仅41.2%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有空间智能研究侧重语义正确性，但"物体在接近"这类描述掩盖了速度、时间、相对几何等定量信息；而碰撞规避、轨迹跟踪、反应式抓取等任务恰恰依赖运动幅度与时序的定量推理，因此需要专门测量MLLM的定量运动学理解能力。
AI.method: 构建QK-Bench：从379个视频采集2,341道多选题，覆盖17个任务，分为物体中心运动学、相机自运动运动学、多物体运动学关系三大类；利用隐藏的几何与时序信号进行轨迹构建与过滤，用固定运动学规则将物理量映射为可验证答案（含类别标签）；通过轨迹与题目校验保证标注可靠性和采样帧的视觉支撑充分；所有模型统一使用单目RGB输入。
AI.result: 评估闭源、开源及空间专用MLLM，表现普遍较差：最强模型总体准确率仅41.2%，空间专用MLLM未表现出一致优势。
AI.conclusion: 当前空间智能的进展并不能可靠迁移到定量运动学理解；语义层面的空间推理与定量运动学推理之间存在显著能力缺口。

title: Aegis-VLA: Reliability-Gated Action Refinement via a Trajectory World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
summary: Dynamic object manipulation requires maintaining spatial and temporal alignment with targets that continue to move during inference and execution. Although future prediction can inform action correction, an accurate forecast does not establish whether modifying an existing action would be beneficial. We present Aegis-VLA, a world-model-guided vision-language-action (VLA) framework that generates predictive action corrections and separately determines whether and how strongly to apply them. A Trajectory World Model combines kinematic extrapolation with learned residual dynamics to predict object motion and estimate positional uncertainty. Discrepancy-Guided Action Refinement uses differences between history-only and base-action-conditioned end-effector forecasts to propose bounded arm corrections. A Reliability Gate learns when to admit corrections based on demonstration-relative improvements over base actions, and regulates their application during inference using predictive uncertainty and anticipated object--end-effector proximity. Rejected corrections preserve the corresponding base actions. Aegis-VLA introduces only approximately 2.45M trainable parameters. On the simulated Dynamic Object Manipulation (DOM) benchmark, Aegis-VLA achieves 56.72\% success over 1,800 evaluation trials, exceeding our reproduced DynamicVLA baseline of 45.44\% by 11.28 percentage points.

AI.tldr: Aegis-VLA 提出世界模型引导的 VLA 框架：用轨迹世界模型预测物体运动与位置不确定性，用 Discrepancy-Guided Action Refinement 生成有界机械臂修正动作，再用 Reliability Gate 学习"是否/多强地"采用修正。
AI.motivation: 动态目标操作要求智能体在推理与执行期间持续与运动目标保持时空对齐；虽然未来预测可指导动作修正，但准确的预测本身并不能判定"修改现有动作是否有益"。因此需要把"生成修正"与"决定是否采纳修正"解耦。
AI.method: 三模块：(1) Trajectory World Model 结合运动学外推与学习式残差动力学预测物体运动并估计位置不确定性；(2) Discrepancy-Guided Action Refinement 通过"仅历史"与"以基础动作为条件"两种末端执行器预测之间的差异提出有界修正；(3) Reliability Gate 依据相对专家示范的改进幅度学习何时接受修正，并在推理时用预测不确定性与预期物体-末端接近度调节修正强度，修正被拒则回退基础动作。仅约 2.45M 可训练参数。
AI.result: 在仿真 DOM（Dynamic Object Manipulation）基准的 1,800 次评测中成功率 56.72%，比其复现的 DynamicVLA 基线 45.44% 高 11.28 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将"修正生成"与"修正采纳"分开并由可靠性门控调节，是提升动态操作 VLA 性能的高参数效率方案；但目前仅为仿真基准验证，缺少真机演示与代码/部署证据。

title: ScaleCurve: From Constant Scale to Consistent Motion for World-Space Human Mesh Recovery
summary: World-space human mesh recovery can lose spatial consistency even when camera-space body estimates are accurate. A single sequence-wide scale resolves global scale ambiguity but cannot correct local scale distortion along a reconstructed camera path. We present ScaleCurve, a framework that estimates time-varying metric corrections from human-ground geometry. We construct scale observations by comparing predicted foot geometry with locally fitted ground planes. Joint temporal optimization downweights inconsistent observations and couples neighboring scale estimates, allowing calibration to adapt along the camera path without freely following measurement noise. We scale camera translation increments and integrate them into a calibrated trajectory. With this camera fixed, we refine the lifted body motion using 2D image evidence and pretrained 3D dynamics, while restricting global trajectory rescaling. ScaleCurve achieves state-of-the-art performance on most evaluated metrics on both EMDB-2 and SLOPER4D. Consistent gains across three HMR backbones demonstrate its compatibility with diverse body estimates without retraining. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: ScaleCurve：用人体-地面几何估计随相机路径变化的局部尺度修正，解决世界坐标人体网格恢复中的空间一致性/局部尺度失真问题。
AI.motivation: 相机空间人体估计准确时，世界坐标（world-space）人体网格仍可能失去空间一致性。单一序列全局尺度只能消除整体尺度歧义，无法修正沿重建相机路径的局部尺度畸变（如脚滑、轨迹漂移造成的局部缩放不一致）。
AI.method: 1) 由预测脚部几何与局部拟合地面平面比较，构造尺度观测；2) 联合时序优化：对不一致观测降权，并对相邻尺度估计做耦合平滑，使标定能随相机路径自适应而不盲从测量噪声；3) 用标定尺度缩放相机平移增量并积分成校正轨迹；4) 固定该相机，利用2D图像证据与预训练3D运动先验精修抬升后的人体运动，同时限制全局轨迹重缩放。
AI.result: 在EMDB-2与SLOPER4D上多数指标达SOTA；在三种不同HMR骨干上均获得一致增益，说明无需重训练即可兼容多种身体估计器。
AI.conclusion: 将局部尺度校正与相机轨迹、人体运动精修联合，是一种有效的世界坐标人体网格一致性提升方案，具备骨干无关的通用性。

title: Manga Page Parser: Comprehensive Visual Parsing through Local Story Understanding
summary: Understanding manga requires connecting who appears and who speaks with the events, character states, and relationships that unfold across panels. We study manga visual parsing through local story understanding: analyzing each double-page spread independently to capture and organize its story information in a reusable structured representation. We propose MangaParser, an agentic reading framework that jointly performs character clustering, speaker diarization, and speaker-to-character binding within a shared multimodal conversation, without additional training or fine-tuning. The agent uses structured story memory to guide character and speaker identification, inspecting relevant image regions when uncertain and refining its predictions and story records together as evidence accumulates. Quantitative evaluations show that our parser substantially outperforms manga-specific models across multiple backbones. Parsing examples illustrate how a unified representation links the character and speaker predictions with narrative content and supporting evidence. We further test reusability through story question answering using outputs generated before the questions are provided. The results confirm output reusability, offering a foundation for manga translation, content retrieval, and question answering.

AI.tldr: MangaParser：免训练的智能体式漫画阅读框架，在共享的多模态对话中联合完成角色聚类、说话人日志化与说话人-角色绑定，并用结构化故事记忆引导识别与证据驱动的迭代修正。
AI.motivation: 漫画理解需跨分镜关联"谁出现、谁说话"与事件、角色状态及关系；现有漫画专用模型难以在统一的、可复用的表示中同时处理角色与说话人信息。
AI.method: 提出 agentic reading 框架，对每个双页展开独立解析：在单一多模态对话中联合执行角色聚类、说话人分离（speaker diarization）与说话人到角色的绑定；借助结构化 story memory 指导身份判定，在不确定时调用工具检视相关图像区域，随证据累积协同精化预测与故事记录，无需额外训练或微调。
AI.result: 在多个 backbone 上定量评估显著优于漫画专用模型；解析示例显示统一表示可将角色/说话人预测与叙事内容及支撑证据关联；用事前生成的解析输出做故事问答，验证输出的可复用性。
AI.conclusion: MangaParser 提供可复用的结构化漫画解析基础，可支撑机器翻译、内容检索与问答；但其价值局限于漫画领域，与具身/3D/机器人方向关联弱。

title: Hetero-Associative Visuomotor Memory: Soft Recall as a Base for Learned Residuals in Few-Demonstration Imitation
summary: Retrieve-and-correct policies typically refine the nearest retrieved demonstration chunk, the readout that works best when executed directly. We study what a demonstration memory should supply to the corrector instead and find that a smooth, softmax-weighted recall over the whole memory is a much better base. On ALOHA cube transfer (40 human demonstrations), soft recall is no better to execute alone than the nearest chunk; however, with keys, candidates, and training fixed, correcting it raises success by 22.4 points on fresh resets with new encoders and by 7.4 against a closed-loop-tuned top-1 corrector. On robomimic Square, it leads by 7.9 points with the two better operators and by 6.7 on a label-free draw of equal size. This gain holds on sparse, varied demonstrations under an action-aware key and leave-one-demonstration-out training, and fades or slightly reverses on dense, scripted, or generated data. Building on this finding, our hetero-associative visuomotor memory (HAVM, 14M parameters) trains offline in about five minutes, including a learned retrieval temperature $\beta$, and runs in 1.1 ms. Across six fresh ALOHA encoders, it reaches 76.4% within 24 s, comparable to a 264M Diffusion Policy trained for 6.7 h (78.8%) and ahead of ACT (71.7%) and fine-tuned VLAs (65.2-75.2%), while leading every 40-demonstration baseline within the benchmark's 8 s limit (74.6%; +6.5 over Diffusion Policy, +15.1 over ACT). On LIBERO, one 40-task memory reaches 92.2% and loses far less than SmolVLA to rewording; on a real SO-101 arm, it sustains 30 Hz control without stalling. Unlike pretrained foundation policies aimed at zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks and workspaces, HAVM trades broad out-of-distribution generalization for rapid adaptation to the available demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出异源联想视觉运动记忆HAVM（14M参数，5分钟离线训练，1.1ms推理）：证明对整段演示记忆做softmax软召回（而非最近邻chunk）作为纠错基底更优，并学习检索温度β，在多基准与真实机械臂上达强性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 retrieve-and-correct 策略只精修最近邻检索到的演示块（top-1 chunk），而 top-1 适合直接执行、未必适合作为纠错器输入；论文探究"演示记忆应向纠错器提供什么"这一设计问题。
AI.method: 控制变量对比：保持 key、候选与训练不变，将 top-1 检索替换为对全记忆的 softmax 加权软召回，并与闭环微调的 top-1 纠错器比较；进一步用 action-aware key 与 leave-one-demonstration-out 训练验证。据此构建 hetero-associative visuomotor memory（HAVM），离线训练含可学习检索温度 β。
AI.result: ALOHA cube transfer（40个人类演示）：软召回归错在新encoder/新复位上提升22.4点，对抗闭环调优top-1纠错器提升7.4点；robomimic Square 领先7.9点，等规模无标签抽样领先6.7点；在稀疏多样演示下增益保持，在密集/脚本化/生成数据上衰减或反转。HAVM在6个新ALOHA encoder上24s内达76.4%，接近264M Diffusion Policy（78.8%，6.7h）并超ACT（71.7%）与微调VLA（65.2–75.2%）；8s限制下74.6%（+6.5 vs DP，+15.1 vs ACT）；LIBERO 40任务记忆92.2%且对改述鲁棒；真实SO-101机械臂维持30Hz控制。
AI.conclusion: 演示记忆的价值在于提供稠密软加权的纠错信号而非单一最近邻；HAVM以极小参数与训练成本实现快速适应到可用演示，但以牺牲零样本/分布外泛化为代价（与预训练基座策略定位互补）。

title: Ask to Land: Learning a Mask-Conditioned Open-Vocabulary Landing Policy via Differentiable Physics
summary: Existing drone landing systems, whether model-based or learning-based, typically rely on predefined visual markers (e.g., ArUco tags) or are trained for specific platform categories, and often assume structured target motion. Recent open-vocabulary studies enable text-prompted target selection, but integrating this capability with learned closed-loop landing control remains underexplored. To this end, we present \textit{Ask to Land}, a mask-conditioned framework that enables a quadrotor to land on various platforms described by a user in natural language, including randomly moving platforms. The core of our approach is the integration of a frozen state-of-the-art open-vocabulary perception frontend (YOLO-World with MobileSAM) and a control policy learned by differentiable physics. By providing real-time, task-agnostic semantic segmentation masks as policy inputs, our framework enables the drone to land on prompt-selected targets without target-specific fine-tuning while continuously tracking dynamic target motion during descent. The frozen frontend processes the prompt, while the policy receives the mask without text embeddings or category labels. To efficiently optimize the control policy, we leverage differentiable physics learning via Backpropagation-Through-Time (BPTT), and employ a carefully designed reward that enforces visual alignment with the landing target and altitude-adaptive descent speed, together with stable control. Real-world deployments validate that our approach achieves landings on diverse user-specified objects, including static and moving platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出了"Ask to Land"框架：将冻结的开放词汇感知前端（YOLO-World + MobileSAM）与可微物理训练的控制策略结合，用语言提示选定的目标掩码驱动机器人降落，实现对任意用户描述目标的着陆（含随机移动平台），无需目标特定微调。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机降落系统依赖预定义视觉标记或特定平台类别训练，并假设目标运动结构化；开放词汇感知虽有文本提示选目标的能力，但与学习式闭环降落控制的结合尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 架构上采用"掩码条件"策略：冻结的 YOLO-World+MobileSAM 前端将文本提示解析为实时语义分割掩码，作为任务无关的视觉输入传给控制策略（策略不使用文本嵌入或类别标签）；策略通过可微物理的 BPTT 训练，奖励函数包含视觉对齐、随高度自适应的下降速度与稳定控制项。
AI.result: 真实世界部署验证了该方案能对多种用户指定物体实现着陆，包括静态平台与随机移动平台，且无需针对目标微调，下降过程中可持续跟踪动态目标。
AI.conclusion: 将冻结的开放词汇感知与可微物理学习的控制策略解耦并结合，是获取通用、提示可选目标的闭环降落能力的一种有效且实用路径；掩码作为任务无关接口是保持泛化性的关键。

title: Rethinking Unsupervised Cross-Modal Homography Estimation:Spatially Aware Representations and Geometric Consistency Learning
summary: Unsupervised cross-modal homography estimation is challenging because appearance differences obscure shared geometric structures. Separating modality transfer from homography estimation helps reduce these differences, but accurate alignment still requires effective geometric representations and consistency constraints on the two subtasks. We propose GeoCo (Geometry-Aware and Consistency-Constrained Homography Estimation), a framework that addresses these two requirements without cross-modal transformation labels. Its homography estimator, RVHomo, adapts hierarchical features from a frozen vision foundation model (VFM) and fuses them with local CNN features to capture structural context and spatial detail. Two geometric consistency constraints encourage modality transfer to preserve geometry and homography predictions to remain consistent under synthetic geometric transformations. Through two-stage progressive distillation, we further obtain GeoCo-D, which uses the lightweight RVHomo-D estimator. An intermediate model first learns to perform cross-modal matching without modality transfer, then transfers prediction and feature knowledge to the student, eliminating online VFM extraction. Experiments on GoogleMap, OPT-SAR, FSD, and VIS-IR show that GeoCo reduces mean average corner error by 17.4-46.7% relative to the best-performing baseline on each dataset. GeoCo-D also outperforms all compared baselines while using 98.5% fewer parameters and 70.4% fewer FLOPs than the complete GeoCo teacher.

AI.tldr: GeoCo：利用冻结视觉基础模型层次特征+局部CNN特征构建RVHomo单应估计器，并施加两项几何一致性约束（模态迁移保持几何、合成几何变换下单应预测一致），再经两阶段渐进蒸馏得到轻量GeoCo-D，无需跨模态变换标签。
AI.motivation: 无监督跨模态单应估计中，外观差异掩盖共享几何结构；将模态迁移与单应估计解耦虽能缓解差异，但仍需有效几何表征与两子任务间的一致性约束，且缺少跨模态变换标签。
AI.method: RVHomo估计器：适配冻结VFM的分层特征并与局部CNN特征融合，兼顾结构上下文与空间细节；引入几何一致性约束——(1)约束模态迁移保持几何结构，(2)约束单应预测在合成几何变换下保持一致；两阶段渐进蒸馏：中间模型先在不做模态迁移条件下学习跨模态匹配，再将预测与特征知识蒸馏给学生RVHomo-D，从而移除在线VFM特征提取。
AI.result: 在GoogleMap、OPT-SAR、FSD、VIS-IR四个数据集上，GeoCo相较各数据集最优基线将平均角误差(mACE)降低17.4%–46.7%；GeoCo-D性能超越所有对比基线，且参数量减少98.5%、FLOPs减少70.4%（相对完整GeoCo教师）。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知特征融合与一致性约束可在无跨模态标签下显著提升跨模态单应估计精度，两阶段蒸馏能在大幅压缩模型规模的同时保持甚至超越性能，适合部署导向的跨模态配准。

title: MoSk: A Unified Motion-Skeleton Foundation Model for Human Motion Understanding and Generation
comment: Please visit our project page at this https URL
summary: Foundation models (FMs) have advanced visual understanding and generation by providing semantically rich representations. However, this role of FMs remains underexplored in human motion. Large motion datasets offer diverse movements at scale, but often lack action labels for systematically evaluating learned representations on understanding tasks. Skeleton datasets enable such evaluation through established recognition protocols, yet are typically smaller and focus on predefined actions captured in controlled environments. To combine these strengths, we present MoSk, to the best of our knowledge, the first Motion-Skeleton foundation model to integrate motion and skeleton datasets. MoSk learns shared representations through self-supervised masked motion modeling. We incorporate joint-name embeddings to provide a common anatomical reference across various skeleton formats. A cross-attention decoder reconstructs masked motion from the encoder's features, with joint-name embeddings specifying the target joints. Experiments demonstrate strong action-recognition performance across diverse settings, including linear evaluation and fine-tuning. MoSk also substantially improves motion generation across multiple backbones through representation alignment, reducing FID on MotionMillion by up to 9.75 for unconditional generation and 3.83 for text-to-motion generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoSk，首个融合大规� motion 数据与 skeleton 数据的运动基础模型，通过自监督掩码运动建模学习共享表征，并借助关节名嵌入统一不同骨架格式，在动作识别与运动生成上均取得提升。
AI.motivation: 人形运动领域缺乏类似视觉/语言的基础模型；大规模运动数据有规模但缺动作标签，骨架数据有标准化识别协议但规模小且局限于受控环境。二者互补但此前未被统一利用。
AI.method: 自监督掩码运动建模（masked motion modeling）；引入 joint-name embeddings 为不同骨架格式提供统一解剖参考；cross-attention 解码器依据关节名嵌入指定的目标关节，从编码器特征重建被掩码的运动；预训练表征用于线性评估/微调的动作识别，并作为生成模型的对齐目标。
AI.result: 在线性评估与微调等多种设定下动作识别表现强；通过表征对齐在多个生成骨干上显著改进运动生成，MotionMillion 上无条件生成 FID 最多降低 9.75，文本到运动生成降低 3.83。
AI.conclusion: MoSk 表明运动与骨架数据可以在统一的自监督框架下互为补充，关节名嵌入是跨骨架格式迁移的有效设计；学到的表征既能支撑理解任务也能反哺生成任务。

title: Incorporating the Knowledge Distillation to Improve the EfficientNet Transfer Learning Capability
summary: Due to the Deep Learning requirement for a large training dataset, Transfer Learning has become a central method in the field of Computer Vision, which heavily used Deep Learning. Since the adoption of transfer learning in the field, the performance of the models in computer vision is significantly upgraded. The common transfer learning practice in computer vision research is to use state-of-the-art architectures in the ImageNet dataset as the backbone network. The best performing architecture in ImageNet is currently held by EfficientNet, which is a set of architectures that were progressively grown from a baseline architecture. By observing the EfficientNet development approach, it is natural to hypothesize that the smaller EfficientNet architecture is capable to contain the knowledge of the larger architecture. This hypothesis comes from the fact that the larger EfficientNet architecture was grown from the smaller architecture. Therefore, in this study, we experimented if it is beneficial to transfer the knowledge from the larger architecture to the smaller architecture of the EfficientNet. To achieve this goal, we proposed a transfer learning method that uses Knowledge Distillation as the knowledge transfer mechanism from the larger to smaller architecture. We found that the proposed method is able to upgrade the performance of each of the EfficientNet architecture. Several smaller architectures are even able to outperform the larger architecture that was trained using the standard transfer learning method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以知识蒸馏为迁移机制，将较大 EfficientNet 模型的知识迁移到较小 EfficientNet 架构上，从而提升小模型性能，部分小模型甚至超过用标准迁移学习训练的更大模型。
AI.motivation: EfficientNet 系列架构由小到大逐步 grow（复合缩放），因此作者假设较小的 EfficientNet 能够容纳更大架构的知识；而计算机视觉迁移学习的常规做法仅使用 ImageNet 预训练骨干，未利用同族架构间的这种衍生关系。
AI.method: 从大 EfficientNet 模型向小模型进行知识蒸馏，把蒸馏损失与下游任务监督损失结合，作为迁移学习机制替代/补充常规 ImageNet 权重初始化；在多个 EfficientNet 规模上对比标准迁移学习。
AI.result: 所提方法对每个 EfficientNet 架构均有性能提升；若干较小架构甚至优于使用标准迁移学习训练的更大架构。
AI.conclusion: 沿 EfficientNet 缩放链的“大→小”知识蒸馏是有效的迁移学习策略，可低成本提升小模型精度，为计算机视觉下游任务提供了一种不依赖更大模型的实用方案。

title: ContextHands: Completing Hand Motion with Learned Context and Joint-Specific Body Kinematics
summary: Detailed hand motion contributes to the realism and expressiveness of generated human motion. Completing these details from body motion and language requires connecting the context of an action to the articulation of the hands. We introduce ContextHands, which completes hand motion from an observed body sequence and text descriptions assigned to hands and time intervals. Our approach learns probabilistic hand features from the descriptions and body motion, using auxiliary hand prediction to connect these features to hand articulation. A body encoder preserves joint and body-part features across multiple temporal scales, allowing each hand joint to query these features for joint-specific body information. The diffusion generator combines this joint-specific body information with the learned hand context. Both encoders and the generator are trained jointly, so the final generation objective also shapes the context features. Experiments on the OakInk2 dataset show that ContextHands generates more accurate hand motion and achieves lower Fréchet Hand Distance than existing hand-motion and general human-motion generation methods adapted to the task. In qualitative examples of grasping and tool use, ContextHands more closely reproduces the detailed hand poses in the reference motion. We will release our code and pretrained models to support further research.

AI.tldr: ContextHands 从身体运动序列与手部/时段文本描述中补全手部动作：学出概率化的手部特征、经辅助手部预测连接到关节，并用多尺度身体编码器提供逐关节查询的身体信息，与扩散生成器联合训练。
AI.motivation: 身体动作难以体现手部细节，而手部细化需要把动作语境与手部关节articulation联系起来；已有方法缺少从语言+身体到手部的显式上下文建模。
AI.method: 文本与身体运动编码出概率化手部特征，辅助手部预测任务做特征到articulation的桥接；多尺度身体编码器保留关节与身体部位特征供每个手关节query；扩散生成器融合关节特化身体信息与手部上下文；编码器与生成器端到端联合训练。
AI.result: OakInk2 上手部动作更准确，Fréchet Hand Distance 低于适配该任务的手部动作生成与通用人体动作生成基线；抓取与工具使用定性示例中更接近参考手部姿态。
AI.conclusion: 以身体+文本上下文驱动的条件扩散可有效生成细粒度手部动作；将开源代码与预训练模型。

title: Counter-DECEIVR: Counterfactual Explanations for Deepfake Detectors using Detector-Guided Rectified Flow Inversion
summary: Deep-learning-generated media are increasingly passed off as real, driving an arms race between image generators and deepfake detectors. Trust in the latter is limited by their often black-box nature; and, while region-based explanations can sometimes be extracted, these become less useful as generation quality improves. Counterfactual examples, which show the minimal change that flips a detector's decision, reveal what evidence drives a verdict, helping analysts decide whether to trust it. This work introduces Counter-DECEIVR (DEtector-guided reCtifiEd flow InVeRsion for counterfactuals), a novel training-free framework that generates counterfactual examples. Counter-DECEIVR steers latents in the velocity field of a rectified flow model using gradients from off-the-shelf deepfake detectors, without training a generator or adapting the detector; unlike prior methods, it requires no per-instance or per-detector fitting and no diffusion training on the target data. It also leverages the detector's explanation maps to concentrate editing to salient regions, turning low-level feature importance into localised counterfactual edits. A single parameter controls the strength of the edits. Across two deepfake detectors and two widely used forensics datasets, Counter-DECEIVR outperforms prior counterfactual generation methods, including training-based ones. Code will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: Counter-DECEIVR：无需训练的框架，利用现成深伪检测器梯度在rectified flow速度场中引导潜变量，并结合检测器解释图聚焦显著区域，生成反事实样本以解释检测决策。
AI.motivation: 深伪检测器黑箱性强，区域解释随生成质量提升而失效；反事实样本能揭示决定判决的最小证据变化，帮助分析者判断是否信任检测结果。
AI.method: 基于rectified flow速度场做潜变量反演与引导，用现成检测器梯度驱动编辑；利用检测器解释图将编辑集中到显著区域，将低层特征重要性转为局部化反事实编辑；单一参数控制编辑强度，无需训练生成器、不改动检测器、无需逐样本/逐检测器拟合或扩散模型训练。
AI.result: 在两个深伪检测器和两个主流取证数据集上，优于此前反事实生成方法（包括基于训练的方法）。
AI.conclusion: 提出免训练、即插即用的检测器引导反事实生成框架，为深伪检测提供可解释证据，且具跨检测器与数据集的通用性。

title: WISER-RL: A Wake-Sleep Learning Mechanism for Robot Reinforcement Learning from One Demonstration
summary: A robot learning from one human demonstration may rarely succeed on its own, leaving reinforcement learning (RL) with little reward feedback. We introduce WISER-RL ({W}ake--sleep policy improvement loop, {I}mitation, and {S}elective {E}xperience {R}eplay), a composite reinforcement learning framework that turns assisted practice into autonomous control. During wake, GPTDAgger monitors disagreement among actions sampled by a diffusion policy. When disagreement crosses a threshold, a frozen GPT controller uses retrieved experience to continue the episode. During sleep, Conflict-Aware Experience Reweighting (CAER) compares visually matched successful trajectories and downweights conflicting action windows with more steps remaining to success. The policy imitates the reweighted successes and learns from both successes and failures through offline advantage-guided RL before collecting the next round. After final online PPO refinement, the autonomous policy succeeded in 100% evaluations on each of six LIBERO tasks and 100% trials on each of two real-robot tasks.

AI.tldr: WISER-RL 提出"清醒-睡眠"复合强化学习框架：清醒时用 GPTDAgger 监控扩散策略动作分歧并在超阈值时由冻结 GPT 控制器接管，睡眠时用 CAER 对视觉匹配的成功轨迹做冲突感知重加权，再结合模仿与离线优势引导 RL 迭代，最终 PPO 在线精调，在 6 个 LIBERO 任务和 2 个真机任务上均达 100% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 单次人类演示难以让机器人自主成功，失败率高导致 RL 几乎拿不到奖励反馈；需要在"辅助练习"与"自主控制"之间搭桥，且要能同时利用成功与失败数据。
AI.method: (1) 清醒阶段 GPTDAgger：对扩散策略采样动作的分歧度监控，超阈值时由冻结 GPT 控制器（借助检索经验）接管剩余回合；(2) 睡眠阶段 CAER：对比视觉匹配的成功轨迹，对"距成功剩余步数更多"的冲突动作窗口降权；(3) 策略对重加权成功样本做模仿学习，并通过离线优势引导 RL 同时利用成功/失败；(4) 多轮迭代后做在线 PPO 精调。
AI.result: 六个 LIBERO 任务评估成功率 100%，两个真机任务试验成功率 100%。
AI.conclusion: 将 VLM 辅助接管与冲突感知数据重加权结合，可在极少人类演示下把辅助数据转化为自主策略；核心价值在于数据工程（经验检索+重加权）而非新策略架构。真机验证是一大亮点，但 100% 成功率数字需更多任务与多次运行统计支撑。

title: End-to-End Image-Goal Navigation for Agile Quadrotors via Recurrent State Distillation
summary: Image-goal navigation asks a robot to reach the viewpoint of a target photograph without a map or goal pose. In three dimensions, this requires not only recognizing the goal but also estimating 3D displacement and generating continuous control actions to approach and settle at the target view. This is difficult because the same visual difference between current and goal image can require very different actions depending on the robot's velocity, yet monocular images alone reveal neither metric scale nor body motion. As a result, existing image-goal policies are limited to planar action spaces and rely on a state estimator for flight control. Policies that map directly from images to low-level control commands have been demonstrated for agile flight, but not toward goal images in unseen environments. We present the first image-goal navigation policy that directly commands thrust and angular rates for agile quadrotor flight in unseen 3D environments, without relying on state estimation (e.g., SLAM, VO, or SfM) or a separate velocity controller. We train a recurrent vision-based policy through a four-stage pipeline that combines geometric and motion supervision with privileged-teacher distillation and end-to-end reinforcement learning fine-tuning. On 1000 held-out flights in unseen environments, the policy achieves an 82.3% success rate with a mean terminal position error of 0.10m across successful flights. Deployed zero-shot on a real quadrotor, the policy reaches an 84% success rate over 25 trials in an unseen indoor environment.

AI.tldr: 首个无需状态估计、直接从单目图像端到端输出推力与角速率指令的四旋翼图像目标导航策略，在未知3D环境中实现敏捷飞行。
AI.motivation: 现有图像目标策略受限于平面动作空间且依赖SLAM/VO/SfM等状态估计器进行飞行控制；而图像到低层控制的端到端策略仅在敏捷飞行中验证过，未用于未知环境中的目标图像导航。单目图像既不提供度量尺度也不提供本体运动，相同视觉差异因速度不同需不同动作，这是核心难点。
AI.method: 提出四阶段训练流水线训练循环视觉策略：(1) 几何与运动监督；(2) 特权教师蒸馏；(3) 端到端强化学习微调（共四阶段组合），策略直接输出推力和角速率，不依赖SLAM/VO/SfM或独立速度控制器。
AI.result: 在未知环境1000条留出飞行测试中成功率达82.3%，成功飞行平均终点位置误差0.10m；零样本部署于真实四旋翼，在未知室内环境25次试验中成功率84%。
AI.conclusion: 证明无需状态估计的图像目标导航在真实四旋翼敏捷3D飞行中可行，实现了从图像到低层控制指令的端到端迁移，且泛化到未见环境。

title: xFORM: Accelerating Fixed-Lag LiDAR Odometry with Exact Factor Compression
summary: Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensors are increasingly popular for state estimation because of their precision, long range, and high measurement rate. Unfortunately, LiDAR Odometry (LO) systems incur substantial computational cost when processing large point clouds, particularly those that jointly refine a window of scan poses. While our prior LO work FORM is real-time, the costs of feature extraction, correspondence search, and the evaluation and linearization of residuals during pose optimization can introduce significant latency. This latency makes downstream tasks such as control and path planning difficult. To overcome this, we present xFORM, which accelerates the three stages of FORM. xFORM uses factor compression to reduce an optimization problem involving hundreds of thousands of feature matches to 34 scalar residuals per scan pair, while preserving the original objective and Gauss-Newton system in exact arithmetic. We integrate this optimizer into two variants: xFORM-CPU, which additionally parallelizes feature extraction on the CPU, and xFORM-GPU, which accelerates feature processing, correspondence search, and factor compression on the GPU. Across fifteen complete sequences from three datasets, xFORM-CPU and xFORM-GPU achieve overall speedups of 1.1-1.4$\times$ and 2.0-4.0$\times$ over FORM, respectively, with no numerically significant differences to the original implementation.

AI.tldr: xFORM 通过因子压缩把每对扫描数十万级特征匹配的优化问题精确压缩为 34 个标量残差，并给出 CPU 并行与 GPU 加速两个版本，相比 FORM 提速 1.1–1.4×（CPU）与 2.0–4.0×（GPU），数值结果与原始实现无显著差异。
AI.motivation: LiDAR 里程计（LO）虽精度高、量程远，但处理大点云、尤其是联合优化窗口内位姿时计算开销大；即便实时版 FORM，其特征提取、对应搜索与残差线性化仍带来明显延迟，影响下游控制与路径规划。
AI.method: 提出 xFORM 加速 FORM 的三个阶段：(1) 因子压缩（factor compression），在精确算术下保持原目标函数与高斯-牛顿系统不变，将数十万特征匹配的优化降为每扫描对 34 个标量残差；(2) xFORM-CPU 在 CPU 上并行特征提取；(3) xFORM-GPU 在 GPU 上加速特征处理、对应搜索与因子压缩。
AI.result: 在三个数据集共 15 条完整序列上，xFORM-CPU 相对 FORM 总体提速 1.1–1.4×，xFORM-GPU 提速 2.0–4.0×，且与原始实现相比无数值显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 因子压缩可在不损失精度与目标一致性的前提下大幅削减 LO 优化规模，配合并行/GPU 实现可显著降低时延，提升 LO 对实时下游任务的可用性。

title: CARE-WM: Same-Horizon Self-Conditioning with Constraint-Adaptive Regularization for Latent World Models
summary: Planning with latent world models requires both accurate multi-step predictions and latent distances that reflect physical proximity to the goal. However, models are typically trained on ground-truth observations but must rely on their own imaginations during planning, while closer latent distances do not necessarily correspond to better task outcomes. Existing methods resort to auxiliary training objectives or additional task-cost readouts, which respectively incur extra training overhead or leave the latent geometry itself misaligned with task cost. We introduce CARE-WM, a drop-in training method that meets both requirements without additional supervision, a separate cost model, or any change to LeWM's architecture and Euclidean-cost planner. CARE-WM trains the predictor on its own predictions and adaptively calibrates the strength of latent regularization. With a single hyperparameter configuration, CARE-WM improves mean planning success over LeWM across all evaluated continuous-control tasks and matches or exceeds the best results of other LeWM-family methods on most tasks. Further analyses show lower open-loop latent prediction error and closer agreement between latent-cost rankings and physical task costs.

AI.tldr: CARE-WM：一种即插即用的训练方法，通过让预测器在自己生成的预测上训练，并自适应校准潜空间正则化强度，使潜空间距离更贴合物理任务代价，无需额外监督、独立代价模型或改动架构与规划器。
AI.motivation: 潜世界模型规划需要两点：准确的多步预测，以及能反映接近目标物理距离的潜空间度量。但训练用真值观测、规划用自身想象，存在分布错配；且潜距离近不一定任务结局好。现有做法靠辅助训练目标（增加开销）或额外代价读出（潜几何仍与任务代价不对齐）。
AI.method: CARE-WM（针对 LeWM）：①在预测器自身的想象轨迹上训练预测器，缓解训练-规划分布错配；②自适应调节潜空间正则化强度，使潜几何与任务代价对齐；仅单个超参数配置，不改 LeWM 架构与欧氏代价规划器。
AI.result: 单一超参配置下，在全部评测的连续控制任务上平均规划成功率优于 LeWM，并在多数任务上达到或超过 LeWM 系列其他方法的最佳结果；开环潜预测误差更低，潜代价排序与物理任务代价的一致性更高。
AI.conclusion: 轻量、无需额外监督的潜世界模型训练改进可同时提升多步预测精度与潜空间代价对齐度，是可迁移到 LeWM 系列的通用训练范式。

title: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration: Methods, Trade-Offs, and Open Questions
summary: Diffusion and flow-based generative models support high-quality image, audio, and video synthesis. Sampling can require dozens to hundreds of denoiser evaluations, with each pass becoming more expensive as resolution, video length, or model size increases. This cost affects latency and energy use in interactive and edge applications. We examine four approaches to accelerating inference: distillation, consistency training, sampling methods, and denoiser design. We express training objectives, transition maps, and numerical updates in a common notation to compare changes to the learning target, the sampling trajectory, and the work performed within each denoiser pass. Published image and video benchmarks illustrate the quality--cost trade-offs of one- and few-step generation, the interaction between solvers and timestep schedules, the effect of feature caching, and the difference between first-frame latency and sustained streaming throughput. We close with open problems in visual-native architectures and post-compression distillation, solver-aware few-step training, and semantic trajectory alignment with factorized distribution matching.

AI.tldr: 综述扩散/流生成模型推理加速的四条路线：蒸馏、一致性训练、采样器与去噪器设计，用统一记号比较学习目标、采样轨迹与单次前向开销。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流匹配采样需数十至数百次去噪器评估，随分辨率、视频长度与模型规模增长而开销激增，影响交互与边缘场景的延迟与能耗，因此需要系统梳理加速手段与质量-成本权衡。
AI.method: 综述性框架：将蒸馏、一致性训练、数值采样/时间步调度、去噪器结构改进四类方法统一表述为"训练目标—转移映射—数值更新"三段式记号，并借助已发表的图像/视频基准（含特征缓存、流式吞吐与首帧延迟分析）进行横向对照。
AI.result: 给出一步/少步生成的质量-成本权衡、求解器与时间步调度的相互作用、特征缓存效果，以及首帧延迟与持续流式吞吐之间的差异；最后列出视觉原生架构、压缩后蒸馏、求解器感知的少步训练、语义轨迹对齐与因子化分布匹配等开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 该文是推理加速的整合性综述，提供统一分析视角与问题清单，但未提出可落地的机器人或3D新方法。

title: Surf-Style: Surface-Based Scene Stylization
summary: Consistent and controllable 3D stylization is critical for visual computing applications such as immersive visualization, augmented and virtual reality content creation, and artistic scene rendering. While 2D image stylization has advanced significantly, extending these methods to 3D remains challenging due to the need for cross-view consistency, where stylized renderings must align across all viewpoints. Applying 2D stylization independently to each rendered view often results in inconsistencies across perspectives. Existing methods attempt to improve consistency by leveraging implicit radiance field representations, which model scene appearance as a function of spatial locations. However, these methods struggle with ambiguity in updating colors, as the indirect dependence between pixel appearance and learnable scene parameters makes it difficult to enforce consistent stylization during optimization. This work presents Surface-based Scene Stylization (Surf-Style), which reconstructs object surfaces in a 3D scene and uses these surfaces to achieve geometric consistency and localized stylization. Surf-Style defines a learnable appearance model over 3D space, which is modified to replicate the visual style of a reference image. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, our method achieves superior consistency and offers greater flexibility in controllable stylization, including the ability to target specific surface regions and combine different styles.

AI.tldr: Surf-Style 通过重建场景物体表面并定义3D空间上的可学习外观模型，将参考图风格迁移到表面，实现跨视角一致且可局部控制、可混合多种风格的3D风格化。
AI.motivation: 2D风格化独立应用于各渲染视角会导致跨视角不一致；基于隐式辐射场的方法因像素外观与场景参数之间间接依赖导致颜色更新歧义，难以在优化中强制一致性与可控性。
AI.method: 先在3D场景中重建物体表面，再在3D空间上定义可学习外观模型（绑定于表面），通过匹配参考图像风格优化该外观模型，从而借助表面几何获得几何一致性并支持区域级局部风格化与多风格组合。
AI.result: 相比现有SOTA方法，跨视角一致性更优，并在可控风格化上更灵活——可针对特定表面区域施加风格并组合不同风格。
AI.conclusion: 以显式表面约束替代隐式辐射场作为风格化载体，是提升3D风格化一致性与可控性的有效途径。

title: SPARC: Geometry-Guided Attention Pruning for Long-Horizon Camera-Controlled Video Generation
summary: We present SPARC, a geometry-guided attention pruning framework that turns the native self-attention of pretrained video diffusion transformers into a unified mechanism for camera control and persistent scene memory. Our key insight is that attention connectivity can simultaneously serve as geometric conditioning for camera control and spatial addressing for historical memory retrieval. Motivated by the asymmetric contextual requirements of reconstructing observed content and synthesizing novel regions, SPARC restricts observed tokens to geometrically corresponding historical tokens and local spatiotemporal context, while preserving dense attention for unobserved regions. Correspondence-aware attention biasing and order-invariant historical positioning further enable stable retrieval across long temporal gaps. Without introducing additional learnable control or memory modules, SPARC achieves precise camera adherence and faithful scene revisitation while substantially reducing attention computation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of aggressive attention pruning in improving camera adherence, revisit consistency, and visual fidelity, with an inference speedup of over 50x when combined with four-step distillation. Project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SPARC：将预训练视频扩散Transformer的自注意力重构为统一机制，同时实现相机控制与场景记忆检索。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型的注意力是稠密的，计算昂贵，且相机控制与长时记忆通常需额外可学习模块。作者认为注意力连通性本身既可作相机控制的几何条件，也可作历史记忆的空间寻址。
AI.method: 基于几何引导的注意力剪枝框架：将已观测token的注意力限制在与几何对应的历史token及局部时空邻域内，对未观测区域保留稠密注意力；引入对应感知的注意力偏置（correspondence-aware attention biasing）与顺序无关的历史定位（order-invariant historical positioning），以支撑跨长时序间隔的稳定检索。不新增可学习的控制或记忆模块。
AI.result: 实现精确的相机跟随与忠实的场景重访，大幅降低注意力计算；实验表明激进的注意力剪枝反而提升相机一致性、重访一致性与视觉保真度；结合四步蒸馏获得超过50倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 注意力剪枝既可提速又可提升几何与记忆一致性，为视频扩散世界模型提供无需额外模块的统一相机控制与长程记忆方案。

title: When to Respond, Where to Ground: Streaming 3D Affordance Grounding
summary: Given a continuous RGB-D stream and a language request, streaming 3D affordance grounding requires an agent to decide when to respond and where to locate the requested functional part using only observations available so far. Existing 3D affordance grounding methods typically assume complete scene observations, while streaming vision-language models lack fine-grained 3D functional grounding. Our goal is to jointly determine response timing and functional-part localization during continuous scene observation. We propose StreamAff, an evidence-guided response strategy that makes both decisions from the grounding model's own visual evidence. The model scores the visual patches of the frames it reads: their combined support, weighed against a wait option, decides when to respond, and the highest-scoring patch selects the frame to ground in. A conditional look-back policy lets the model answer from an earlier observation at the moment of the request or wait for new evidence, and zoom-and-refine grounding segments the part named in the answer on the 3D points of the selected frame. We further introduce StreamFun3D, a benchmark derived from real-world 3D scenes that evaluates response timing and grounding across four evidence settings: Current, History, Future, and Unobserved, together with StreamIoU, a metric that credits a mask only when the response is timely and grounded in a valid source frame. We adapt offline 3D affordance grounding methods and build external-decider baselines that pair vision-language models with our mask decoder.
