StreamAff achieves 30.14% StreamIoU on 15-second streams, a 40.6% relative improvement over the strongest of these baselines.

AI.tldr: StreamAff 提出证据引导的响应策略，用 grounding 模型自身的 patch 证据分数（与"等待"选项比较）决定何时响应、在哪一帧定位，并配合条件回溯策略与 zoom-and-refine 分割；同时发布 StreamFun3D 基准与 StreamIoU 指标，15 秒流上达 30.14% StreamIoU，较最强基线相对提升 40.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D affordance grounding 方法假设完整场景观测，而流式 VLM 缺乏细粒度 3D 功能部件 grounding；需要在连续观测中同时解决"何时答"与"答在哪"两个问题。
AI.method: StreamAff：对读入帧的视觉 patch 打分，将 patch 支撑度与 wait 选项比较以决定响应时机，最高分 patch 选定 grounding 帧；条件 look-back 策略允许在请求时刻用早期观测作答或等待新证据；zoom-and-refine 在选定帧的 3D 点上分割答案所指部件。另构建 StreamFun3D 基准（Current/History/Future/Unobserved 四种证据设定）与 StreamIoU 指标（仅当响应及时且源自有效帧时才计入掩码）。
AI.result: 15 秒流上 StreamIoU 为 30.14%，相较最强基线（离线 3D affordance 方法与 VLM+掩码解码器的外部决策器）相对提升 40.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将响应时机与 3D 功能部件定位统一在单一 grounding 模型的证据分数上，是可行且有效的流式 3D affordance grounding 方案；StreamFun3D 与 StreamIoU 为时序感知的 3D grounding 提供了可量化评测。

title: Hijacking 3D Generation: Targeted Adversarial Attacks against Image-to-3D Models via Prefix Trajectory Alignment
summary: Online services that deploy Image-to-3D models enable users to generate high-quality 3D assets from a single image. However, the generated 3D geometry can violate content policies and cause broader security risks. To prevent such content, these services typically use policy-restricted inspectors to examine uploaded images before generation. Since the inspector examines only the visible content of the input, a visually benign image can still induce the generation of policy-restricted 3D geometry. However, turning this vulnerability into an effective attack is non-trivial in the black-box setting: global backpropagation through the long DiT generation trajectory is difficult to fit, while different image preprocessing pipelines across services can substantially reduce transferability. In this paper, we present PTA3D, a targeted adversarial attack against Image-to-3D models that addresses these challenges through Prefix Trajectory Alignment (PTA) and Preprocessing Aware Optimization (PAO). PTA progressively aligns the prefix DiT outputs of the adversarial trajectory with those of the target trajectory, where the core geometric structure is formed, allowing the final geometry to be controlled without optimizing through the complete generation trajectory. PAO exposes adversarial optimization to diverse image transformations rather than a single preprocessing pipeline, reducing sensitivity to the mismatch between surrogate and target services. We establish a prefix-to-output bound and a preprocessing-aware transfer bound to theoretically characterize the effectiveness of the two designs. Experiments on three open-source Image-to-3D models and three online services show that PTA3D achieves 41.5%-88.5% ASR on online services and 90.8%-94.6% ASR in white box settings, substantially outperforming existing attacks.

AI.tldr: PTA3D：针对Image-to-3D模型的定向对抗攻击，通过前缀轨迹对齐与预处理感知优化，在仅需良性输入图像的情况下诱导生成违规3D几何，黑盒在线服务ASR 41.5%-88.5%。
AI.motivation: 在线Image-to-3D服务仅用策略受限的检查器检测输入图像的可见内容，若生成的3D几何违规而输入图像视觉良性，则可绕过审查并带来安全风险。但黑盒场景下攻击难度大：DiT长生成轨迹的全局反传难以拟合，且各服务图像预处理流程不同导致迁移性差。
AI.method: 提出PTA3D，含两个组件：(1) Prefix Trajectory Alignment (PTA)——逐步将对抗轨迹的前缀DiT输出与目标轨迹对齐，在几何结构形成阶段即施加控制，避免反传整条生成轨迹；(2) Preprocessing Aware Optimization (PAO)——在多样化图像变换上优化对抗样本，而非单一预处理管线，缓解代理与目标服务之间的失配。并给出prefix-to-output界与预处理感知迁移界进行理论刻画。
AI.result: 在3个开源Image-to-3D模型与3个在线服务上，黑盒在线服务ASR达41.5%-88.5%，白盒ASR达90.8%-94.6%，显著优于既有攻击方法。
AI.conclusion: Image-to-3D服务存在"输入良性、输出违规"的审查盲区，可通过前缀轨迹对齐与预处理感知优化高效利用；该工作亦提示需对生成轨迹层面而非仅输入端进行内容安全检测。

title: Projector Subspace Optimization for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet adapting them to sequential tasks requires Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). Existing replay-free methods expand prompts or routed LoRA experts across multi-layer decoders, incurring heavy parameter and routing overhead while shifting internal feature distributions. Instead, we identify the final linear layer of the vision-language projector as a high-capacity, coordinate-stationary bridge, where sequential updates easily induce interface drift by displacing historical visual tokens. While low-rank subspace adaptation offers a compact remedy, selecting directions solely from historical statistics or task gradients sacrifices plasticity or stability, and unconstrained multi-step updates still accumulate large drift. To resolve both issues, we propose Projector Refinement through Optimized Update Directions (PROUD), a continual subspace optimization framework for the terminal projector layer. At task onset, PROUD combines retained input statistics with initial gradients to analytically extract a metric-orthonormal subspace maximizing first-order task gain under a drift budget. During training, it regularizes updates within this fixed subspace via an exact Frobenius penalty before losslessly merging them with zero inference or routing overhead. Experiments on UCIT and CoIN across MLLM backbones show that PROUD outperforms recent replay-free baselines in continual accuracy while curbing forgetting with a fraction of trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: PROUD针对多模态大模型持续指令微调(MCIT)中的接口漂移问题，提出仅优化视觉-语言投影器末层线性层，在任务开始时利用保留的输入统计量与初始梯度解析构造度量正交子空间，并在其内施加精确Frobenius正则更新后无损合并，实现零推理/路由开销的免回放持续学习。
AI.motivation: 现有免回放MCIT方法通过扩展prompt或跨多层解码器路由LoRA专家，带来参数量与路由开销，并扰动内部特征分布；作者识别出投影器末层线性层是高容量且坐标稳定的"桥梁"，顺序更新会造成接口漂移（历史视觉token被位移）。低秩子空间适配虽紧凑，但仅依赖历史统计或任务梯度会在可塑性与稳定性间二选一，且无约束多步更新仍累积漂移。
AI.method: 定位视觉-语言投影器最后一层线性层为持续子空间优化目标。任务开始时，联合保留的输入协方差统计与初始梯度，在漂移预算约束下解析求解最大化一阶任务增益的度量正交子空间；训练中在该固定子空间内用精确Frobenius惩罚正则化更新，训练后无损合并进原权重，推理与路由零额外开销。
AI.result: 在UCIT与CoIN两个持续指令微调基准、多个MLLM骨干上，PROUD在持续准确率上优于近期免回放基线，同时以极少可训练参数抑制遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 将持续学习的作用点收敛到投影器接口层并结合带漂移预算的子空间解析选择，是兼顾稳定-可塑性与部署效率的有效路线；但实验限于MLLM指令微调基准，尚无具身/VLA任务或真实机器人验证。

title: WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation
summary: Generating coherent and explorable 3D worlds from scattered images with little or no visual overlap is a fundamental and long-standing challenge in computer vision, which existing geometry-aware methods fail to address. Meanwhile, existing image- and video-based methods may generate unseen regions but produce inconsistent geometry across views. To bridge this gap, we present WorldBridge, a framework for coherent and controllable 3D world generation under scattered images with little or no visual overlap. WorldBridge encodes scattered references into a global scene context to guide geometry and appearance generation across views. Our temporal and spatial reference attention mechanism further enhances the fidelity of temporal references along the target trajectory and supports flexible spatial references outside it. A plug-and-play latent-reference consistency strategy improves reference fidelity through reprojection-guided test-time optimization. We also introduce the WorldBridge benchmark suite to evaluate 3D world generation from scattered, low-overlap references, which is rarely explored by current benchmarks. Both qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate that our method enables controllable and coherent 3D world generation, surpassing the existing state-of-the-art solutions. Our project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: WorldBridge：以稀疏（几乎无重叠）参考图像生成连贯、可控的三维世界，通过全局场景上下文编码 + 时/空间参考注意力 + 可插拔潜空间参考一致性（重投影引导测试时优化），并配套新基准。
AI.motivation: 稀疏、无视觉重叠的多视角参考下生成连贯且可探索的三维世界是长期难题：几何先验方法无法处理缺重叠，图像/视频生成方法虽可补全未见区域但跨视角几何不一致。
AI.method: 将分散参考编码为全局场景上下文以引导跨视角几何与外观生成；提出时序与空间参考注意力机制，增强目标轨迹上时序参考的保真度并支持轨迹外的灵活空间参考；引入即插即用的潜空间参考一致性策略，通过重投影引导的测试时优化提升参考保真度；构建 WorldBridge 基准用于评估低重叠稀疏参考下的三维世界生成。
AI.result: 定性与定量实验均表明方法可实现可控且连贯的三维世界生成，优于现有 SOTA；并填补了低重叠稀疏参考评测基准的空白。
AI.conclusion: 以全局上下文+参考注意力+测试时一致性强化的组合方案，有效缓解跨视角几何不一致，为稀疏参考驱动的三维世界生成提供了方法与评测基础。

title: MulCLIP: A Multi-level Alignment Framework for Enhancing Fine-grained Long-context CLIP
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP excel at image-text alignment but struggle with long, detailed descriptions due to training on short captions. Recent methods address this limitation using region proposals to align visual regions with sentences, but at substantial deployment cost. We present MulCLIP, an end-to-end multi-level alignment framework that directly exploits natural long-text structure without region proposals. Instead of simply stacking objectives, MulCLIP aligns different textual granularities through compatible training signals: global contrastive alignment for long captions and short summaries, Word-Patch Reconstruction over locally calibrated features for within-sample word-patch semantics, and Subcaption-Aggregated Patch alignment for context-rich subcaption grounding. Experiments on benchmarks spanning varying caption lengths show consistent gains, and ablations confirm that the proposed objectives are complementary and jointly improve the overall framework. Code will be released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MulCLIP：无需区域提议的端到端多级视觉-语言对齐框架，利用长文本自身结构，通过全局对比、Word-Patch重建、子标题-聚合Patch对齐三个兼容目标实现多粒度对齐。
AI.motivation: CLIP等VLM因短标题预训练而难以处理长而细的图文描述；现有基于region proposal对齐句子的方法部署成本高。
AI.method: 直接在无region proposal的情况下挖掘长文本层级结构：1）长标题与短摘要的全局对比对齐；2）在局部校准特征上做Word-Patch重构（样本内词-块语义）；3）子标题聚合Patch对齐以提供上下文丰富的短语接地。三目标作为互补训练信号联合优化。
AI.result: 在覆盖不同标题长度的多个基准上取得一致提升；消融实验表明三个目标互补，联合使用优于单独或简单堆叠。
AI.conclusion: 多级对齐可作为低成本替代region proposal的可行方案，提升长描述场景下的图文对齐能力；代码将开源。

title: TaCo: Rethinking Correlation for Visual Tracking on Edge Devices
summary: Lightweight trackers have replaced cross-correlation with attention, and on low-power edge hardware they pay for it, since memory-bound softmax, normalization and reshaping operators of attention cost far more time than their arithmetic suggests. Benchmarking efficient trackers on an edge Neural Processing Unit (NPU) and an Arm CPU under one numerically validated protocol, we find that correlation trackers are the fast ones, but they lag in accuracy unless they adopt a ViT backbone, which brings attention back. We revisit what correlation lacks. Template--search interaction serves two roles: conditioning the search features on the target and matching them against it spatially. Attention does both, whereas correlation only matches, and does so on features extracted without knowledge of the target. We present TaCo (Target-aligned Correlation), which supplies the missing conditioning without attention by letting the template enter the per-frame network only as operands computed once per video. A descriptor of the target scales and shifts the search features channel by channel inside the backbone, and kernels aligned with the target box, each with a weight predicted from the template, correlate with them in one matrix product. With the backbone fixed, our correlation remains essential while incurring negligible NPU overhead, offering a better speed-accuracy trade-off than the attention-based interactions we tested. TaCo-T achieves 62.3% LaSOT AUC at 184 FPS on the Rockchip RV1126B NPU and 96 FPS on a Raspberry Pi 5 CPU, 3.0x and 3.5x the NPU speed of HiT-Tiny and AsymTrack-T at higher accuracy. TaCo-B reaches 65.6% at 50 FPS on the NPU, more than twice the speed of HiT-Base, AsymTrack-B and LightFC-vit, again at higher accuracy. Code and models are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TaCo用"目标对齐相关"替代注意力：模板仅以每视频计算一次的算子(通道级调制描述子+目标框对齐核)注入主干，在边缘NPU/CPU上实现更高精度与3倍以上速度。
AI.motivation: 边缘硬件上注意力中的softmax、归一化与reshape等访存密集算子实际开销远超FLOPs所示；相关类跟踪器快但精度不足，除非改用ViT主干从而又把注意力带回。作者指出相关操作缺少"条件化"能力，仅做空间匹配。
AI.method: 统一数值验证协议下在NPU与Arm CPU上基准测试现有高效跟踪器；提出TaCo：模板以每视频一次计算的算子形式进入逐帧网络——(1)目标描述子对主干内搜索特征做逐通道scale-shift调制；(2)目标框对齐的核(权重由模板预测)与搜索特征在一次矩阵乘法中完成相关匹配；主干固定，模块引入的NPU开销可忽略。
AI.result: TaCo-T：LaSOT AUC 62.3%，RV1126B NPU 184 FPS、Raspberry Pi 5 CPU 96 FPS，NPU速度为HiT-Tiny/AsymTrack-T的3.0x/3.5x且精度更高；TaCo-B：65.6% @ 50 FPS NPU，速度超HiT-Base、AsymTrack-B、LightFC-vit两倍以上且精度更优。
AI.conclusion: 将模板到搜索的"条件化"与"匹配"解耦并用轻量相关算子实现，可在无注意力条件下兼顾精度与边缘实时性，提供优于注意力交互的速度-精度折中。

title: From Diagnosing Alignment to Joint Supervision in Multimodal Draft Training
summary: Multimodal drafts learn from multimodal (MM) and text-only (TXT) supervision, yet their effects on alignment and how to combine them remain unclear. We diagnose draft-target alignment through paired predictions with and without visual input, decomposing distributional error into text-conditioned and visual-response components. Drafts with similar text-conditioned alignment can still differ markedly in visual-response risk and acceptance. Controlled continuation training shows that high-risk groups outperform random and low-risk groups, and visual-response risk guides MM training more effectively than aggregate risk. Building on these diagnostics, we propose MNRS-Joint, which configures joint supervision from a given draft's component-risk distributions, using modality-specific mean risks to determine the MM:TXT mixture. Across three warm-ups, its distinct mixtures fall in high-performing regions of the ratio sweeps. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, MNRS-Joint improves mean accepted length from 3.35 to 3.53 and mean speedup from $2.04\times$ to $2.16\times$ over composition-matched random training under greedy tree decoding. The gains also hold under stochastic chain decoding.

AI.tldr: 通过成对（含/不含视觉输入）预测诊断多模态草稿的目标对齐，将分布误差分解为文本条件与视觉响应两部分，并用组件风险配置多模态:纯文本联合监督（MNRS-Joint），提升投机解码接受长度与加速比。
AI.motivation: 多模态草稿模型同时接受多模态与纯文本监督，但两种监督对对齐的影响及如何混合并不清楚，现有做法依赖聚合风险指标，无法区分文本条件对齐与视觉响应风险。
AI.method: 用含视觉与不含视觉输入的成对预测来诊断草稿-目标对齐，将分布误差分解为文本条件分量与视觉响应分量；受控续训实验验证高风险组优于随机组与低风险组，且视觉响应风险比聚合风险更能指导多模态训练；据此提出 MNRS-Joint，按组件风险分布配置联合监督，用模态特定平均风险决定 MM:TXT 混合比例。
AI.result: 三次 warm-up 中，其不同混合比例均落在比例扫描的高性能区间；在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，贪心树解码下平均接受长度由 3.35 提升至 3.53，平均加速比由 2.04× 提升至 2.16×（相对同组成随机训练），随机链式解码下增益同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度分解对齐风险（文本条件 vs 视觉响应）比聚合风险更能指导多模态监督配比，按组件风险自适应设置 MM:TXT 比例可稳定提升多模态投机解码效率。

title: Exploring the Design Factors of Pixel-space Diffusion
summary: In this paper, we introduce EiT by exploring the key design factors of pixel-space diffusion from three perspectives: model architecture, representation, and frequency domain. Inspired by Denoising Autoencoders (DAE) which perform denoising through a bottleneck, we construct a U-shaped pixel diffusion transformer that performs explicit compression along the channel dimension. In terms of representation, we find that both pixel and latent diffusion transformers exhibit a three-stage representation dynamics across layers and timesteps: denoising/local feature expansion, basis lift-up, and posterior projection. Moreover, earlier denoising and a longer basis lift-up stage are associated with better generation, which EiT naturally achieves through its channel bottleneck and increased network depth. From the frequency perspective, we establish the equivalence between pixel-space and frequency-space diffusion when keeping the network operating in pixel space. On ImageNet $256\times256$ and $512\times512$, EiT consistently outperforms JiT (Just image Transformers) in generation quality. Specifically, our EiT achieves better FID than JiT: 1.61 vs. 1.85 at $256\times256$, and 1.73 vs. 1.99 at $512\times512$. Remarkably, EiT can be seamlessly applied to video pixel diffusion by simply extending the patch size to temporal dimension and outperforms video latent diffusion in FVD evaluated on Kinetics-600 (resolution 256), under comparable total network parameters. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出EiT像素空间扩散Transformer，从架构、表征动力学与频域三视角剖析像素扩散关键设计：U形通道瓶颈压缩+加深网络使去噪更早、基抬升阶段更长；在ImageNet 256/512上FID优于JiT，并可零改动迁移至视频像素扩散。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散（pixel-space diffusion）相比潜空间扩散避免VAE/VFM的域偏移与信息损失，但生成质量仍逊，缺少对"像素扩散为什么有效/如何设计"的系统性理解。作者希望回答：模型架构、内部表征演化与频域特性哪些因素决定像素扩散的生成表现。
AI.method: 受去噪自编码器（DAE）通过瓶颈去噪的启发，构建U形像素扩散Transformer（EiT），在通道维度做显式压缩。第一，用逐层/逐时间步的表征探测发现像素与潜空间扩散共同的三阶段表征动力学（局部特征扩展→基抬升→后验投影），并据此论证通道瓶颈+更深网络可提前去噪并延长基抬升阶段。第二，在频域上证明：只要网络保持在像素空间运算，像素空间扩散与频率空间扩散等价。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256与512×512上均优于JiT：FID 1.61 vs 1.85，1.73 vs 1.99；将patch扩展到时间维即可无缝用于视频像素扩散，在Kinetics-600（256）上同等总参数下FVD优于视频潜扩散。
AI.conclusion: 像素扩散的性能瓶颈可由"去噪时机"与"基抬升深度"解释，通道瓶颈加深度是本位最有效的设计杠杆；像素空间与频率空间等价，且像素扩散可推广至视频，挑战潜扩散的默认地位。

title: FoMNet: Adaptive Kernels Meet Contextual Matching for Cross-Modal Homography Estimation
summary: Cross-modal homography estimation requires reliable correspondences despite appearance differences between sensing modalities. Multi-scale refinement progressively reduces the search range, but its accuracy remains limited by the ability of matching features to distinguish nearby candidates. The vision foundation model (VFM) provides complementary representations, yet integrating these features through fixed interpolation leaves their spatial aggregation independent of image content and the correspondence objective. We propose the Foundation Model-Enhanced Matching Network (FoMNet), which combines learned spatial adaptation of VFM features with contextual correspondence estimation. Patch Feature Upsampling (PFU) progressively predicts location-specific kernels to aggregate neighboring features on upsampled grids, preparing VFM representations for fusion with CNN features at different matching scales. Contextual Correlation Refinement (CCR) then jointly processes source descriptors and local correlations with spatial context to refine candidate scores before each homography update. To reduce upsampling overhead, we develop FoMNet-D, which replaces PFU with bicubic interpolation and uses multi-scale feature-relation distillation to recover accuracy. Experiments on five cross-modal datasets show that FoMNet achieves the lowest mean average corner error (MACE) among the evaluated methods, reducing MACE by 10.6%-72.7% relative to MCNet. FoMNet-D retains competitive accuracy while reducing inference latency by 34.0% relative to FoMNet.

AI.tldr: FoMNet：用可学习的 Patch Feature Upsampling（PFU）对 VFM 特征做内容自适应的空间聚合，与 CNN 特征在多尺度融合；再用 Contextual Correlation Refinement（CCR）联合处理描述子与局部相关性以精化候选得分，用于跨模态单应估计。FoMNet-D 用双三次插值替代 PFU 并借助多尺度特征关系蒸馏恢复精度，推理延迟降 34%。
AI.motivation: 跨模态单应估计需在模态外观差异下获得可靠对应；多尺度精化的精度受限于匹配特征对邻近候选的区分能力。VFM 特征有互补表征能力，但以往用固定插值融合，空间聚合与图像内容和对应目标无关。
AI.method: PFU：逐级预测位置特定的上采样卷积核，在上采样网格上聚合邻域特征，为与 CNN 特征在不同匹配尺度上融合做准备；CCR：结合空间上下文联合处理源描述子与局部相关性，在每次单应更新前精化候选得分。轻量版 FoMNet-D 以双三次插值替代 PFU，并用多尺度特征关系蒸馏补偿精度损失。
AI.result: 在五个跨模态数据集上，FoMNet 取得所评估方法中最低的平均角点误差（MACE），相对 MCNet 降低 10.6%–72.7%；FoMNet-D 精度具竞争力，推理延迟相对 FoMNet 降低 34.0%。
AI.conclusion: 将 VFM 特征的内容自适应上采样与上下文相关性精化结合，可有效提升跨模态单应估计精度，并可通过蒸馏+插值换取效率。

title: When Position Favors the Wrong Part: Evaluating Left-Right Discrimination in Semantic Correspondence
summary: Overall part-discrimination accuracy can conceal failures when image position favors the wrong bilateral part. We examine whether dense descriptors distinguish the correct part under this conflict and whether their discrimination scores help select matching coordinates. We evaluate position agreement and conflict within the same target images and annotated part pairs, using a bounding-box-side score to define the conditions. We compare the original descriptors with their even and odd components under horizontal reflection, examine feature upsampling with the backbone and adapters fixed, and test candidate-selection rules based on odd scores. On SPair-71k, odd discrimination accuracy falls from 86.66% under agreement to 19.63% under conflict for frozen DINOv2, compared with 95.27% to 86.16% for MARCO. With MARCO's input geometry fixed, odd accuracy in box-side conflict was 34.12% on the native grid and 88.84% after learned upsampling and pooling back to that grid. Odd-score rules improve on the original hard-peak matchers overall for DINOv2 and DINOv3 and on conflict queries for MARCO. With MARCO's soft decoder fixed, reranking the cosine peaks changes mean per-pair PCK by +0.47 pp. For supervised GeoAware-SC, using the odd score to select the localization window center yields only 15 net additional correct matches, with 330 corrections and 315 introduced errors. Evaluating discrimination under position conflict reveals failures hidden by aggregate accuracy. Reporting corrections and introduced errors separately also shows whether a discriminative score produces useful matching decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"位置冲突"诊断协议：在同一目标图像与部件标注对上，用bounding-box-side分数定义"位置一致/位置冲突"两种条件，检验稠密描述子在冲突下能否区分正确部件，并比较原始描述子与其水平反射下的偶/奇分量、固定骨干的learned upsampling，以及基于奇分量的候选选择规则。
AI.motivation: 整体部件判别准确率会掩盖失败：当图像位置偏向错误的对侧部件时，聚合指标无法反映描述子是否真正依赖部件语义而非空间位置先验，从而高估匹配器的可靠性。
AI.method: 在SPair-71k上构造位置一致与位置冲突的同图同标注对，以box-side分数为条件；将描述子按水平反射分解为偶分量（位置对称不变）与奇分量（方向/位置敏感），对比DINOv2、DINOv3与MARCO；在骨干与adapter固定下测试learned upsampling及pool回原网格；设计基于奇分数的候选选取/重排序规则，并把修正数与被引入错误分开统计。
AI.result: 冻结DINOv2的奇判别准确率由一致时86.66%骤降至冲突时19.63%，MARCO为95.27%→86.16%；MARCO固定输入几何下，box-side冲突奇准确率原网格34.12%，learned upsampling并pool回原网格后达88.84%；奇分数规则整体优于原始hard-peak匹配器（DINOv2、DINOv3）；MARCO软解码器固定下对余弦峰值重排序使mean per-pair PCK +0.47 pp；监督GeoAware-SC以奇分数选窗中心仅净增15个正确匹配（330修正/315新增错误）。
AI.conclusion: 位置冲突下的判别评估揭示了聚合准确率所隐藏的失败模式；分别报告修正与引入错误能量化判别分数对匹配决策的真实收益（此处收益有限），提示位置先验仍是DINO类描述子的重要混杂因素。

title: What Makes a Gavagai? Learning Visual Concepts from One Positive and Few Negatives
summary: Humans can recognize novel concepts from only a few observations by identifying defining visual attributes and eliminating alternative interpretations. However, a single observation is consistent with multiple possible concepts, and accurate visual perception alone is insufficient to determine the intended interpretation. Negative evidence can reduce this ambiguity by eliminating competing hypotheses. Inspired by Quine's gavagai problem, we introduce the Gavagai Benchmark to evaluate whether vision-language models can identify the attributes defining a novel concept from positive and negative examples. The benchmark consists of synthetic images depicting novel combinations of visual attributes and real images of newly described species. Using these datasets, we examine how models use negative examples to identify novel concepts and analyze the respective roles of visual perception and reasoning. Several models struggle even when correct attributes are provided, while others show large gaps when ground-truth attributes are replaced with model predictions. These diagnostic comparisons highlight challenges in both attribute perception and inference from limited evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出Gavagai Benchmark，用合成属性组合与真实新物种图像，评估视觉-语言模型能否从正负样例中识别定义新概念的属性，并区分感知与推理的作用。
AI.motivation: 单一正例与多个可能概念相容，仅靠准确视觉感知不足以确定意图解释；负例可消歧（受Quine gavagai问题启发），需诊断VLM的少样本新概念归纳能力。
AI.method: 构建诊断性基准：合成图像覆盖新属性组合，真实图像覆盖新描述物种；在提供/替换真值属性（换为模型预测）两种条件下比较模型表现，分离属性感知与推理环节的瓶颈。
AI.result: 多个模型即使给定正确属性仍表现不佳，另一些在真值属性被模型预测替换后出现显著性能下降，表明属性感知与有限证据推理两方面均存在挑战。
AI.conclusion: 负例对消歧有效，但当前VLM在新概念定义属性的感知与归纳推理上均不足；该基准可作为诊断工具，但未提出可操作方法改进。

title: Detectable by Design: Learning a Continuous 3D Saliency Field from 2D Detector Responses
summary: The 3D points kept in a map decide whether a camera can be localized against it, and this choice matters more as the map becomes sparser. Existing 3D keypoint detectors usually define saliency by semantics, repeatability, reconstruction or descriptor matchability. None of these definitions asks whether a point will actually be detected in an image, and as a result most of the points they select are not detected again in images. In this paper, we define 3D saliency as image detectability: the response of a 2D interest-point detector at a surface point, aggregated over all views in which the point is visible. We propose DetField, a continuous field over 3D space that takes a point cloud as input and predicts detectability at any location around it. The supervision is the response of a 2D detector, back-projected from images onto the point cloud. Multi-scale curvature invariants are passed to the decoder at every query point, bypassing the voxel pooling of the encoder. In a localization benchmark that isolates the choice of 3D points, DetField outperforms Harris-3D and five learned 3D keypoint methods on objects and on real indoor scenes. On unseen rooms, it improves localization success by 7.4 points over Harris-3D, the strongest baseline. On objects, it also leads under a 2D detector not used in training. On sparse maps, it stays ahead of Harris-3D on both objects and real scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出DetField：将3D显著性定义为"图像可检测性"，即2D兴趣点检测器响应在可见视角上的聚合，用连续神经场预测任意3D点的可检测性，并以反投影的2D检测器响应作为监督。
AI.motivation: 地图中保留哪些3D点决定了相机能否在其中定位，稀疏地图下尤甚。现有3D关键点检测器以语义、可重复性、重建质量或描述子可匹配性定义显著性，都不考察该点是否会在图像中被真正检测到，导致所选点大多无法在图像中再次被检出。
AI.method: 以点云为输入构建连续隐式场，对任意空间位置查询预测可检测性；监督信号为2D检测器响应从图像反投影到点云。解码器在每个查询点直接接收多尺度曲率不变量，绕过编码器的体素池化以保留几何细节。
AI.result: 在隔离"3D点选择"变量的定位基准上，于物体与真实室内场景均优于Harris-3D及五种学习型3D关键点方法；未见房间上定位成功率较最强基线Harris-3D提升7.4个点；在训练未使用的2D检测器下物体上仍领先；稀疏地图上于物体和真实场景均保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 将3D显著性重新表述为图像可检测性，是一种有效且可迁移的选点准则；连续场+逐点几何特征的建模方式提升了地图对定位的支撑能力，尤其在稀疏与跨场景条件下。

title: A Simple Yet Effective Agent for Open-World Aerial Object Search
summary: Open-world aerial object search methods often rely on persistent spatial maps, learned world models, or task-specific policy training. To examine how far a minimal, training-free design can go, we introduce SimpleUAV, an agent built around a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM). SimpleUAV separates current-view target assessment from history-conditioned action selection, combining fresh candidate evidence with lightweight search context. Local geometry converts visual selections into bounded straight-line movements, depth-based checks halt blocked segments, and measured execution feedback guides subsequent decisions. This closed loop sustains search without persistent spatial maps or task-specific training. SimpleUAV achieves 41.61% Success Rate (SR) on UAV-ON and 11.98% on AerialDojo-200K, compared with 23.80% and 3.20% for the strongest prior baselines, respectively. With limited benchmark-specific adaptation, the same core agent transfers to aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) on TravelUAV, improving Full SR by at least 19.66% across all three splits under L1 assistance. These results establish a strong baseline for evaluating when additional architectural complexity benefits aerial search.

AI.tldr: SimpleUAV：用冻结的现成VLM构建免训练空中目标搜索智能体，将当前视角目标评估与历史条件动作选择分离，配合局部几何、深度校验与执行反馈闭环，在UAV-ON与AerialDojo-200K上大幅超越基线，并迁移至空中VLN。
AI.motivation: 现有开放世界空中目标搜索依赖持久空间地图、学习式世界模型或任务特定策略训练，结构复杂且成本高。作者希望探究一个极简、免训练设计的上限，从而为是否需要更多架构复杂度提供对照基线。
AI.method: 以冻结的现成VLM为唯一感知-推理核心，解耦为"当前视角目标判定"与"历史条件动作选择"两模块，融合新鲜候选证据与轻量搜索上下文。局部几何将视觉选点转换为有界直线运动，基于深度的碰撞检查中止受阻航段，实测执行反馈驱动后续决策，形成闭环，无需持久地图与任务训练。
AI.result: UAV-ON成功率41.61%（基线23.80%），AerialDojo-200K为11.98%（基线3.20%）；经有限基准适配后迁移至TravelUAV空中VLN，在L1辅助下三个split的Full SR均提升至少19.66%。
AI.conclusion: 一个无训练、无地图的极简VLM+几何反馈闭环即可在开放世界空中搜索中显著超越既有方法，为评估后续架构复杂度收益提供了强基线。

title: CoTacWAM: Joint Modeling of Vision and Touch for Robotic Manipulation
summary: We present CoTacWAM, a world-action model that learns shared contact semantics between wrist vision and touch, achieving the best observed performance in our nominal manipulation and missing-input evaluations. The two modalities observe the same local interaction through different signals: wrist images reveal nearby geometry, while touch records physical contact. Our approach connects their common contact meaning while preserving the evidence unique to each modality, giving the policy a joint description of interaction across available input combinations. This representation supports predictive action learning alongside head-view scene context and conditions corrections after an independent detector confirms a failed attempt. Experiments across four real-world tasks demonstrate improved manipulation performance over the evaluated baselines, robustness to missing local observations, and further gains from autonomous retries.

AI.tldr: CoTacWAM：融合腕部视觉与触觉共享接触语义的世界-动作模型，在标称操作与缺失输入评估中取得最佳表现，并支持失败检测后的自主重试。
AI.motivation: 腕部图像提供邻近几何信息，触觉记录物理接触，两者以不同信号观测同一局部交互；如何在同一表示中共享"接触含义"同时保留各模态独有证据，以支撑策略在任意输入组合下工作，是核心问题。
AI.method: 构建共享接触语义的联合表示以连接两模态并保留模态特有证据；结合头视图场景上下文进行预测式动作学习；由独立失败检测器触发动作条件化修正，实现自主重试。
AI.result: 四项真实机器人任务上操作性能优于所评估基线，对局部观测缺失具鲁棒性，自主重试带来额外增益。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态共享接触语义的表征可有效提升接触丰富操作任务的策略表现与输入缺失鲁棒性。

title: WAtcher: Watching Ahead for Safe Robotic Manipulation with Efficient World-Action Models
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple future imagination with action generation, but they execute every action chunk while ignoring the potential risk. To fill this gap, we present WAtcher, a safety-aware world-action framework in which the policy imagines the outcome of the candidate chunk before execution. For fast future preview, WAtcher builds on a compact WAM whose video expert imagines the visual outcome in only two denoising steps. In addition, we propose Safe-Guard, a lightweight module kept outside the WAM that scores each candidate chunk from its imagined outcome and triggers a bounded retreat when the risk is high. Safe-Guard is detachable and can be applied to other WAMs. To train Safe-Guard, we build an autonomous pipeline to collect hazard data from RoboTwin, LIBERO, and a real robot. Specifically, the pipeline perturbs expert demonstrations and labels each candidate chunk from the physical events recorded when it is executed, such as contacts and losses of support. Using the ~25,000 labeled windows from this pipeline, Safe-Guard reaches 92.1% balanced accuracy on a blind set, and cuts hazardous closed-loop trials on training tasks from 27.0% to 10.8% without lowering task success. On a held-out 300-question benchmark, it scores 94.2%, against 72.5% and 63.3% for zero-shot GPT-6-Astra and Claude Opus 5.5. WAtcher also reaches 90.4% and 82.4% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 and ManiSkill3, on par with or above leading WAMs, and 74.0% on five real-world tasks with Safe-Guard on, against 59.5% for $\pi_{0.5}$. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 WAtcher 安全感知世界-动作模型框架：用两步去噪的紧凑 WAM 快速预演候选动作块的视觉后果，再由外挂轻量模块 Safe-Guard 基于想象结果打分并在高风险时触发有界回退。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAM）执行每个动作块时忽略潜在风险，缺少执行前的安全性预判能力。
AI.method: 紧凑 WAM 仅用两次去噪步骤生成未来视觉预演；Safe-Guard 为独立可插拔打分模块，从想象结果评估风险并触发有界撤退；并构建自动流水线在 RoboTwin、LIBERO 和真机上扰动专家示范、依据执行中记录的物理事件（接触、失去支撑）自动标注候选块，得到约 25,000 个标注窗口用于训练。
AI.result: Safe-Guard 在盲测集上平衡准确率 92.1%；训练任务闭环危险试验率从 27.0% 降至 10.8% 且不降成功率；300 题留出基准得分 94.2%（对比零样本 GPT-6-Astra 72.5%、Claude Opus 5.5 63.3%）；WAtcher 在 RoboTwin 2.0 与 ManiSkill3 上平均成功率 90.4%/82.4%，与领先 WAM 持平或更优；真机五任务开 Safe-Guard 时 74.0%，对比 π0.5 的 59.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将安全性从 WAM 本体解耦为可插拔外挂模块，配合自动危险数据标注流水线，可在保持任务成功率的同时显著降低危险执行，并具备向其他 WAM 迁移的通用性。

title: Out of Sight, Not Out of Clues: Can Video LLMs Guess from Partial Evidence?
comment: 27 pages, 21 figures, 23 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: In real-world applications like egocentric recording, visual accessibility, and surveillance review, visual evidence for Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) is often only partially captured. A reliable model should match its response to the evidence: answering when sufficient, guessing from visible clues when partial, and abstaining when absent. Yet existing benchmarks enforce a binary answerable-or-unanswerable split, leaving partial evidence unmeasured and obscuring whether failures arise from missing evidence or misjudging sufficiency. We introduce ClueProbe, a diagnostic benchmark to (1) separate perceiving evidence from judging sufficiency, and (2) validate our diagnosis via targeted fine-tuning. ClueProbe comprises 1,721 human-annotated questions across 598 natural videos, labeled Answerable, Guessable, or Unanswerable, alongside controlled perturbations altering wording or visual input. Evaluating 10 open-source and proprietary Video LLMs reveals that failures stem from judgment rather than perception: models perceive the evidence yet lack graded sufficiency awareness, answering or refusing outright while rarely guessing from partial clues. Targeted fine-tuning shows that this reflects missing supervision rather than insufficient capacity: supervising the guess level lifts appropriate guessing from 1.6% to 40.4% without extra false refusals, whereas conventional refusal tuning rejects 92% of guessable questions. Data and code will be released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 ClueProbe 诊断基准（598 个自然视频、1,721 个人工标注问题，三档标签 Answerable/Guessable/Unanswerable），分离视频 LLM 的“感知证据”与“判定证据充分性”两种能力，并通过定向微调验证失败根因是缺乏分级充分性监督。
AI.motivation: 真实场景（第一视角录制、视觉无障碍、监控回看）中视频证据常只被部分捕获，模型应能按证据充分程度分别作答、推测或拒答；但现有基准只有“可答/不可答”二分，部分证据未被度量，也无法区分失败来自“没看到”还是“误判充分性”。
AI.method: 构建三档标注诊断基准 ClueProbe，并配套控制扰动（改写措辞、修改视觉输入）以隔离感知与判断；评测 10 个开源与闭源 Video LLM；再通过针对 Guessable 层级的定向微调检验诊断结论。
AI.result: 模型普遍能感知证据但缺乏分级充分性意识，很少从部分线索推测，多为直接作答或直接拒答；监督推测层级可将恰当猜测率从 1.6% 提升至 40.4% 且不增加错误拒答，而常规拒答微调会拒答 92% 的可推测问题。
AI.conclusion: 视频 LLM 的失败源于充分性判断缺失而非感知能力不足，本质是缺少分级监督而非容量不够；需引入三档证据充分性标注与训练范式。

title: FoundSurface: Feedforward Ray-Based 3D Scene Surface Reconstruction from Unposed Images
comment: NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Accurate 3D surface reconstruction from unposed images remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Recent feed-forward pointmap methods eliminate the need for camera poses but inherently produce discrete, sparse representations. In this paper, we present a generalizable pipeline that directly recovers continuous, high-fidelity 3D surfaces from unposed images by seamlessly integrating pointmap- and ray-based representations. Our approach first extracts explicit geometric priors using a pre-trained pointmap model. A query-view-centric selection module then identifies geometrically relevant reference views via a robust surfel voting mechanism. Next, a cross-attention regressor bridges target query rays with reference features to estimate a continuous coarse surface. Lastly, a raylet-based module aggregates local 3D features to carve out high-frequency details and analytical normals. Trained as a single foundation model on 9 diverse datasets, our method demonstrates exceptional zero-shot generalization on 6 unseen datasets, clearly surpassing state-of-the-art baselines in geometric accuracy and detail preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出融合pointmap与ray表示的通用前馈管线，从无位姿图像直接重建连续高精度三维表面。
AI.motivation: 前馈pointmap方法虽免去相机位姿需求，但输出离散稀疏表示，难以获得连续高质量表面。
AI.method: 先用预训练pointmap模型提取显式几何先验；查询视角中心的选择模块通过surfel投票机制筛选几何相关参考视图；跨注意力回归器将目标查询射线与参考特征对齐，估计连续粗表面；raylet模块聚合局部3D特征雕刻高频细节并解析法向。单一基础模型在9个数据集上训练。
AI.result: 在6个未见数据集上展现优异零样本泛化，几何精度与细节保留均显著超越SOTA基线。
AI.conclusion: pointmap几何先验与ray式连续表示的结合是可行的统一前馈重建框架，具备强跨数据集泛化能力。

title: WorldPhy: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Physical Plausibility of World Models in Robotics
summary: World models are increasingly used in robotics to improve the performance of embodied models. Compared with general-purpose video generation, robotics places more stringent requirements on world models. Generated videos must satisfy fine-grained physical constraints on robot motion and object interactions. However, existing world model benchmarks can overlook robotics specific physical details and struggle to assess them accurately. To address this problem, we introduce WorldPhy, a world model benchmark for accurate, fine-grained evaluation of physical plausibility in robotics. Our benchmark contains 300 tasks, each consisting of an initial-frame image and a task instruction, covering diverse robotics scenes, task categories, viewpoints, and robot configurations. We further collect over 12K high-quality human annotations, and use them to train WorldPhyReward to accurately provide scores and reasons across six fine-grained physical dimensions and an instruction-following dimension. Comparisons with general VLMs and existing reward models show that WorldPhyReward better aligns with human ratings. We system- atically evaluate 13 frontier open and closed-source world models. The results reveal that current world models struggle to consistently maintain fine-grained physical plausibility across different robotics scenarios. Our code is available at this https URL WorldPhy.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorldPhy，一个面向机器人世界模型的细粒度物理合理性评测基准（300 个任务、12K+ 人工标注），并训练 WorldPhyReward 奖励模型在 6 个物理维度与指令遵循维度上打分；对 13 个前沿世界模型的评测显示其在细粒度物理一致性上普遍不足。
AI.motivation: 机器人世界模型要求生成视频满足机器人运动与物体交互的细粒度物理约束，但现有世界模型基准往往忽略机器人特有的物理细节，且难以准确评估。
AI.method: 构建 300 个任务（初始帧图像 + 任务指令），覆盖多样场景、任务类别、视角与机器人构型；收集 12K+ 高质量人工标注，训练 WorldPhyReward 奖励模型，在六个细粒度物理维度及一个指令遵循维度上给出分数与理由。
AI.result: WorldPhyReward 相较通用 VLM 与现有奖励模型更贴合人类评分；对 13 个开源/闭源前沿世界模型的系统评测表明，它们难以在不同机器人场景下稳定保持细粒度物理合理性。
AI.conclusion: 为机器人世界模型提供了更准确的物理合理性评测工具，并揭示当前世界模型的物理一致性瓶颈；开源代码。

title: A Calibration-Referenced Protocol for Measuring Decision Stability under Reference Bank Compression
comment: 54 pages, including supplementary material (Tables S1-S11 and Figures S1-S4). Interval summaries and probe-sensitivity CSV files are included as ancillary material
summary: Reference banks used for industrial image inspection can be compressed to fit a deployment budget, but the resulting anomaly decisions depend on both the compressed scores and the operating threshold. We present a four-step protocol that compares compression methods at matched deployment sizes, establishes a reference distribution from 200 recalibrations, evaluates disagreement against two calibration benchmarks, and measures changes by distance from the full-bank threshold. With WideResNet-50, budget-matched product quantization (PQ) at the 10% budget has the lowest decision disagreement among five matched methods, including int8 scalar quantization, on VisA and MVTec AD at both operating levels. Int8 scalar quantization gives lower disagreement than PQ at the other four budgets. On MVTec AD at the lower operating level, PQ meets the calibration median in 34/39 cells and the upper quantile in 39/39 cells. Category-equally weighted image-level AUROC loss at this budget ranges from 0.0003 to 0.0037 across the evaluated configurations. On VisA at the 1% budget and a 1% operating level, disagreement reaches 28.12% (95% CI 23.25--33.58%) among near-threshold anomalies and 1.30% (0.79--2.14%) across the normal holdout. The 10% budget-matched PQ setting retains the lowest disagreement among four compared methods with ResNet-18, with clean reference banks, and when thresholds are estimated from normal-directory probes. The protocol connects deployment size to a calibration-referenced decision measure and identifies the evaluation populations most informative for inspection.

AI.tldr: 提出四步评估协议，在匹配部署预算下比较参考库压缩方法（PQ vs int8等）对异常检测"决策"一致性的影响，以校准参考分布（200次重校准）与阈值距离衡量分歧。
AI.motivation: 工业图像异常检测常压缩参考库（memory bank）以满足部署预算，但现有比较通常只看分数/AUROC，忽略了压缩分数与工作阈值的联合作用如何改变最终异常判定，缺少把部署规模与"校准-参考"决策度量联系起来的评测方法。
AI.method: 四步协议：①在匹配的部署尺寸下比较压缩方法；②用200次重校准构建参考分布；③以两个校准基准（中位数、上分位数）评估分歧；④按距全库阈值的距离度量决策变化。在WideResNet-50与ResNet-18上，比较PQ、int8标量量化等五种方法，跨VisA与MVTec AD、多个预算（1%/10%等）与两个工作水平，并检验干净参考库与normal-directory探针估计阈值等变体。
AI.result: 10%预算下PQ在五种匹配方法中决策分歧最低（VisA与MVTec AD、两个工作水平）；其余四个预算int8标量量化分歧更低。MVTec AD较低工作水平下PQ在34/39单元达到校准中位数、39/39达到上分位数；该类等权图像级AUROC损失仅0.0003–0.0037。VisA 1%预算、1%工作水平下，近阈值异常分歧达28.12%（95% CI 23.25–33.58%），正常留出集为1.30%（0.79–2.14%）。ResNet-18、干净参考库及normal-directory探针阈值下，10%预算PQ仍最低。
AI.conclusion: 该协议将部署规模、校准参考与决策级一致性显式关联，表明AUROC类指标会严重低估压缩带来的判定偏移，并指出近阈值异常样本是最具信息量的评估人群，为工业检测中选择压缩方案与阈值校准策略提供可复现的评估框架。

title: An Image Detectability Field as a Viewpoint Utility for 2D-3D Localization in Sparse Maps
summary: In 2D-3D localization, a camera estimates its pose by matching an image to a 3D map. A camera held in a hand or mounted on a robot can often choose its viewpoint before it takes the image. In this work, we ask whether an image detectability field is a useful viewpoint utility when the planner reads only the geometry of the map. The field can be queried at any 3D point near a surface. From the local geometry around the point, it predicts how likely a 2D image detector is to fire at the projection of the point. We use the trained field as it is, without fine-tuning it for view selection. A fixed SuperPoint and EPnP-RANSAC localizer then estimates the pose from the chosen view. We answer in two settings, each with a test registered before the runs. On synthetic ShapeNet objects with sparse point maps, summing the field over the visible landmarks beats counting them by +2.0 points of localization success rate (object-clustered 95% interval [+0.7, +3.2]). It also beats summing Harris-3D ranks by +2.2 [+0.8, +3.5]. On real indoor scenes from SceneFun3D, our adaptation of the learned view scorer LWL falls below counting on the test rooms. We therefore add the field to a learned per-landmark planner. On the test rooms with sparse maps whose landmarks the field also selects, the planner with the field beats the same planner without it by +1.8 points. It beats the planner with Harris-3D or curvature in its place by +1.0 and +0.8 points. All three room-clustered intervals lie above zero. In both settings, the field helps in sparse maps and is on par with Harris-3D in dense maps.

AI.tldr: 提出"图像可检测性场"(image detectability field)：仅由3D地图局部几何预测2D检测器在点上投影处响应的概率，作为next-best-view规划器的视点效用，在稀疏点云下提升2D-3D定位成功率。
AI.motivation: 手持相机或机器人可在拍摄前选择视点。作者希望验证：一个仅依赖地图几何、可查询任意表面附近3D点、预测2D检测器命中概率的"可检测性场"，能否作为免微调、与具体特征检测器解耦的视点效用函数。
AI.method: 训练一个几何到可检测性的场（输入表面点邻域局部几何，回归SuperPoint在该点投影处响应的概率）；直接使用该场，不做视点选择微调。规划器以对可见地标的场值求和为效用，后接固定SuperPoint + EPnP-RANSAC定位器。合成ShapeNet稀疏点图与真实SceneFun3D室内场景两套设置，均预注册测试；并与地标计数、Harris-3D秩、曲率及学习型逐地标规划器LWL对比，报告簇级bootstrap置信区间。
AI.result: ShapeNet稀疏图：场求和比计数高+2.0个定位成功率百分点[+0.7,+3.2]，比Harris-3D秩求和高+2.2[+0.8,+3.5]。真实SceneFun3D上，直接改编的学习型视点评分器LWL在测试房间低于计数；将场接入学习型逐地标规划器后，在稀疏且场同时筛选地标的测试房间上，比无场版本+1.8，比以Harris-3D或曲率替代+1.0/+0.8，三个房间簇区间均不含零。密集地图下场与Harris-3D持平。
AI.conclusion: 纯几何的可检测性场在稀疏地图中是有用的视点效用，带来稳定但幅度较小（约1-3点）的定位成功率提升；在密集地图中与手工几何先验（Harris-3D）相当。学习型端到端视点评分（LWL）在跨场景泛化上不如简单计数，说明显式建模检测器响应的场更可迁移。

title: Benefit of Structured Representations: When Equivariance Helps in Image Classification
summary: Equivariant neural networks promise improved representation learning through structural guarantees. However, mainstream vision encoders rarely incorporate equivariance for most geometric symmetries. Images are a particularly interesting modality with many such symmetries and extensive datasets from which to learn this structure. In this work, we investigate when vision encoders benefit from geometric inductive biases. We study the discrete rotation group of quarter-turns (C4) which acts losslessly without interpolation or boundary artifacts. Combined with image classification as a controlled invariant objective, this allows for a principled empirical investigation into the role of structural guarantees. We introduce ConvNeXt-C4 as a rotation equivariant ConvNeXt with dimension-equivalent yet orientation-structured representations. Training from scratch, our experiments show, that the C4 variant outperforms its base model across all tasks while operating with 6x fewer parameters and 1.6x fewer FLOPs. Its performance advantage increases log-linearly with decreasing training set size, with pre-training providing a similar improvement across both model variants. Analyzing the classifier head reveals that orientation information from the representations' structure is actively used, improving performance by 4.90% across all datasets. Our results highlight the sample-efficiency benefits of equivariance and the value of retained orientation information, motivating further investigation beyond image classification. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ConvNeXt-C4，一种旋转等变的 ConvNeXt 视觉编码器，系统研究 C4（90°整转）离散旋转对称性作为几何归纳偏置在图像分类中的收益。
AI.motivation: 主流视觉编码器很少引入几何等变性，而图像具有丰富对称结构；作者希望以无插值、无边界伪影的 C4 旋转群与可控的不变目标（图像分类），原则性地经验性考察结构保证何时带来收益。
AI.method: 将 ConvNeXt 改造为 C4 等变版本，采用维度等价但带方向结构的表示（orientation-structured representations），从零训练，在多个分类任务上与基线对比，并分析分类头的使用方式与训练集规模的影响。
AI.result: C4 变体在所有任务上优于基线，参数少 6 倍、FLOPs 少 1.6 倍；性能优势随训练集规模减小呈对数线性增长；预训练对两种变体提升相近；分类头主动利用表示中的方向信息，平均提升 4.90%。
AI.conclusion: 等变性带来显著的样本效率收益，保留方向信息具有价值，值得推广至分类之外的视觉任务。

title: Spe3DUp: Faithful Trajectory Distillation for Fast Image-to-3D Generation
summary: Recent 3D generative models can produce high-quality meshes with complex structures and fine geometric details, with broad applications in games, film, and digital design. However, high-quality generation typically relies on long multi-step sampling processes that repeatedly evaluate large networks, leading to long inference times. At the same time, reference-driven tasks such as game-asset reconstruction and product digitization demand close correspondence to the input image: generated geometry must faithfully reconstruct the specific reference object. Acceleration must therefore reduce sampling computation while preserving the model's ability to reconstruct that object. To enable fast and faithful 3D generation, we introduce Spe3DUp, a coarse-to-fine framework based on Faithful Trajectory Distillation (FTD). FTD directly supervises few-step students with the teacher's input-conditioned denoising trajectories to preserve its generation behavior. We apply FTD separately to coarse geometry generation and geometric refinement, compressing both sampling processes while maintaining correspondence to the reference input. We further accelerate the complete mesh-generation pipeline with efficient geometry decoding and parallel remeshing. Experiments show that Spe3DUp maintains geometric quality and input correspondence close to those of the teacher, accelerates the coarse and refinement DiTs by 10.0x and 19.9x, respectively, and achieves a 7.7x end-to-end speedup over the original teacher pipeline.

AI.tldr: Spe3DUp：基于忠实轨迹蒸馏（FTD）的粗到细3D生成加速框架，将粗几何生成与几何精化的采样过程分别压缩10.0x与19.9x，并配合高效几何解码与并行重网格化，端到端提速7.7x。
AI.motivation: 高质量3D生成依赖长多步采样、大网络重复评估，推理缓慢；而游戏资产生成、产品数字化等参考驱动任务要求生成几何与输入图像高度对应，因此加速必须在减少采样计算的同时保持对参考对象的忠实重建能力。
AI.method: 提出Faithful Trajectory Distillation (FTD)，直接用教师模型以输入为条件的去噪轨迹监督少步学生模型以保留生成行为；该蒸馏分别应用于粗几何生成与几何精化两个阶段；整条mesh生成流水线进一步通过高效几何解码与并行remeshing加速。
AI.result: 几何质量与输入对应性接近教师模型；粗生成DiT加速10.0x，精化DiT加速19.9x，端到端较原始教师流水线提速7.7x。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级蒸馏是参考驱动3D生成中兼顾少步采样与输入忠实度的有效加速方案，可级联应用于多阶段生成流水线。

title: Non-Linear Motion from Two Frames: Cubic Hermite Trajectories for Video Frame Interpolation
summary: Two-frame video frame interpolation commonly resamples endpoint optical flow by the query time, which selects a constant-velocity straight-line path even though the same endpoint displacement is compatible with many intermediate trajectories. We present HermiteVFI, which replaces independent query-time motion prediction with one explicit continuous trajectory per pixel. The measured endpoint displacement fixes the two trajectory positions, while two latent endpoint derivatives learned from the frame pair control the interior path. A cubic Hermite curve is the minimum-degree polynomial that can independently satisfy these two position and two derivative boundary quantities. Its residual form contains linear motion exactly, structurally preserves the measured displacement endpoints for any network output, and has coefficients that are predicted once per frame pair and evaluated in closed form at arbitrary t. We further show that one interior query time gives a rank-deficient constraint on the two free trajectory coefficients, whereas any two distinct interior times are full rank at the representation level, motivating multi-time supervision. Appearance-derived directional cues help infer the latent derivatives that endpoint displacement alone cannot identify. On X4K1000FPS, SNU-FILM, and Vimeo90K-Septuplet, the largest gains occur for difficult non-uniform motion and high interpolation ratios. The amortization applies to trajectory-coefficient prediction; downstream reversal, refinement, and synthesis remain query dependent.

AI.tldr: 提出HermiteVFI，用显式连续轨迹（三次Hermite曲线）替代端点光流按查询时间重采样，每像素学习两个隐式端点导数，实现任意t的闭式求值，在非均匀运动与高插帧比场景取得最大增益。
AI.motivation: 两帧插帧常用端点光流按时间线性重采样，等价于强制恒定速度直线路径；但同一端点位移可对应众多中间轨迹，模型缺乏对运动路径的显式建模，在非均匀/加速运动时失效。
AI.method: 为每像素引入一条连续轨迹：两端点位移固定两个位置边界，从帧对学习两个隐式端点导数作为边界导数；采用最低阶（三次）Hermite多项式独立满足2位置+2导数约束。残差形式精确包含线性运动，结构上对任意网络输出都保持端点位移，系数每对帧预测一次并在任意t闭式求值；理论上证明单个内部查询时刻对两个自由系数仅构成秩亏约束，两个不同内部时刻则满秩，从而引入多时刻监督；并利用外观导出的方向线索推断端点位移无法确定的隐式导数。反演、细化与合成仍依赖查询时刻。
AI.result: 在X4K1000FPS、SNU-FILM与Vimeo90K-Septuplet上，增益集中于困难非均匀运动情形与高插帧倍率，验证轨迹级建模优于独立查询时刻运动预测。
AI.conclusion: 以显式Hermite轨迹替代常速重采样是有效的插帧建模范式，其端点保真与多时刻可辨识性带来非均匀运动鲁棒性；代价是仅系数预测可摊销。

title: Ground Your Steps: Optimizing Sampling Schedules in Flow Matching Robot Policies
summary: Flow matching robot policies generate action chunks by integrating a learned velocity field at inference. However, under a fixed budget of neural function evaluations (NFEs), the integration result depends on the sampling schedule. This motivates optimizing the schedule to bring the generated action distribution closer to the demonstrations and improve task success. We propose Ground Your Steps (GYS), a training-free method that optimizes the sampling schedule by matching the generated and demonstrated chunk distributions at each observation. GYS applies truncated fractional differencing along each arm joint's action sequence and compares two types of pairwise differences between action chunks at each observation: differences of a generated chunk against a demonstration, and differences of two independent generated chunks against each other. After fractional differencing, these two pairwise-difference distributions coincide exactly when the distributions of generated and demonstrated action chunks match. GYS minimizes the energy distance between these distributions to obtain an improved schedule for each task and NFE budget. Compared with the uniform grid, GYS brings the generated chunk distribution closer to the demonstrated distribution and raises the success rate through the sampling schedule alone. On RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks, GYS improves success rates at nearly every budget, with gains of 2.8 percentage points for both $\pi_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7. The gains also transfer to three real-world manipulation tasks, reaching up to 3.3 percentage points. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: GYS 提出免训练的采样调度优化方法，用截断分数阶差分构造两类动作块两两差分布，以能量距离匹配生成与示教动作块分布，在固定 NFE 预算下提升流匹配策略成功率。
AI.motivation: 流匹配机器人策略推理时需在固定 NFE 预算下做数值积分，采样调度直接决定积分结果与生成动作分布与示教分布的偏差；已有调度（如均匀网格）未针对动作分布匹配优化。
AI.method: 免训练方法：对每条机械臂关节动作序列做截断分数阶差分；在每个观测下比较"生成块-示教块"与"独立生成块-生成块"两类两两差的分布；分数阶差分后二者分布相等当且仅当生成与示教动作块分布一致，故用能量距离最小化求每个任务与 NFE 预算下的改进调度。
AI.result: RoboTwin 2.0 上几乎所有预算均提升成功率，π0.5 与 GR00T N1.7 均提升 2.8 个百分点；三个真实机器人操作任务上增益迁移，最高 3.3 个百分点；已开源代码。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过调整采样调度即可拉近生成动作分布与示教分布并提升任务成功率，属于推理端低成本、策略无关的增益手段；但增益幅度有限，且需逐任务逐预算离线优化调度。

title: Lost in the Grid: Where Multimodal LLMs Fail Between Seeing and Planning
comment: 31 pages, 32 figures, 29 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at static visual understanding and are increasingly applied to spatial planning, where a model interprets a visual layout and outputs an action sequence to reach a goal. Grid games are a common testbed for this ability because their rules are explicit and a solver can verify every move. Yet existing benchmarks mostly report end-to-end success rates, which hide whether a failure stems from visual perception, rule application, or multi-step planning. We introduce GridProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that 1) locates the failing stage between visual perception and planning and 2) verifies the diagnosis by targeted fine-tuning. On Sokoban, GridProbe pairs end-to-end solving with four probes (recognition, localization, single-step prediction, and state tracking) and gives every board both as an image and as an equivalent text grid. Evaluating seven MLLMs on Sokoban and a maze game reveals distinct bottlenecks behind similar success rates: proprietary models are limited by multi-step planning, whereas open-source models are limited by rule application or by visual grid indexing, i.e., counting rows and columns. Planning failures also hide perception failures: when planning is easier, the visual cost of the same model grows from 7.6 to 37.7 points. The diagnosis identifies what to train: fine-tuning only the vision module of the perception-limited model on board reading raises its interactive Sokoban success 3.5-fold (5.8% to 20.4%) and transfers zero-shot to the unseen maze game (single-turn success 13.8% to 67.1%), whereas the same data does not help a rule-limited model and training on solver solutions brings no gain. We will release the benchmark and code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: GridProbe：面向MLLM空间规划的诊断式基准，用识别/定位/单步预测/状态跟踪四类探针分离视觉感知与规划失败，并通过定向微调验证诊断，在Sokoban与迷宫上给出可操作的训练处方。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM空间规划基准只报告端到端成功率，无法区分失败源自视觉感知、规则应用还是多步规划，因而难以指导改进方向。
AI.method: 构建GridProbe诊断基准：每块棋盘同时提供图像与等价文本网格，端到端求解搭配四项探针（识别、定位、单步预测、状态跟踪）定位失败阶段；在Sokoban与迷宫游戏上评测7个MLLM；再用仅微调视觉模块的定向实验检验诊断结论（含规则受限模型的对照与求解器解数据的对照）。
AI.result: 相似成功率背后瓶颈不同：闭源模型受限于多步规划，开源模型受限于规则应用或视觉网格索引（行列计数）；规划变易时同一模型的视觉劣势从7.6分放大到37.7分，说明规划失败掩盖了感知失败；仅微调感知受限模型的视觉模块，交互式Sokoban成功率提升3.5倍（5.8%→20.4%），并零样本迁移到未见迷宫（单轮13.8%→67.1%）；该方法对规则受限模型无效，用求解器解训练无增益。
AI.conclusion: 基准化诊断+定向微调验证是一种可信的失败归因范式，能明确指出"该训练什么"；但评测域限于网格游戏这一类规则显式的简化环境，与真实3D/机器人场景的迁移尚未验证。

title: HSTTA: Hierarchical Selective Test-Time Adaptation for Label-Free Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Retrieval
summary: Cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval suffers from substantial performance degradation on new subjects due to subject shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this shift by adapting pretrained models with unlabeled target-subject EEG. However, most existing TTA methods struggle to match supervision granularity to each query's prediction confidence, leaving many queries without reliable pseudo-labels. To address this, we propose a novel framework named Hierarchical Selective Test-Time Adaptation (HSTTA). HSTTA builds a hierarchy over gallery image embeddings, uses hierarchical selective prediction to assign each EEG query a supervision granularity matching its current prediction confidence, and constructs adaptation objectives accordingly. We further propose Cross-Session Consistency Calibration (CSCC), an unsupervised method that calibrates the global confidence threshold to target a predefined accuracy level for hierarchical predictions. Moreover, we introduce Reciprocal Hierarchical Backoff (RHB), which moves queries lacking reverse-matching support to coarser nodes to mitigate error reinforcement. Experiments on two public benchmarks and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of HSTTA and its key components. On THINGS-EEG2, HSTTA outperforms the strongest EEG-specific TTA baseline by 17.9 (13.4) and 8.9 (3.7) percentage points in Top-1/Top-5 accuracy, respectively, under cosine (CSLS) ranking. Further analyses show that HSTTA yields more accurate pseudo-labels during adaptation, supporting more reliable model updates.

AI.tldr: 提出分层选择性测试时自适应框架 HSTTA，用于跨被试 EEG-to-image 检索：在图像库嵌入上构建层级，按每个 EEG 查询的预测置信度分配匹配粒度的伪标签，并用跨会话一致性校准（CSCC）自适应全局置信阈值、用互惠分层回退（RHB）抑制错误强化。
AI.motivation: 跨被试 EEG-to-image 检索受被试漂移影响显著，在新被试上性能大幅下降。现有 TTA 方法难以让监督粒度与每个查询的预测置信度匹配，导致大量查询缺乏可靠伪标签，自适应效果受限。
AI.method: 1) 在 gallery 图像嵌入上构建语义层级；2) 分层选择性预测：为每个查询在层级中选出与其当前置信度匹配的监督粒度（细/粗节点）并据此构造自适应目标；3) CSCC：无监督地校准全局置信阈值，使分层预测达到预设目标准确率；4) RHB：将缺乏反向匹配支持的查询回退到更粗节点，缓解误差强化。两个公开基准 + 消融实验。
AI.result: 在 THINGS-EEG2 上，cosine 排序下 Top-1/Top-5 较最强 EEG 专用 TTA 基线提升 17.9/13.4 个百分点，CSLS 排序下提升 8.9/3.7 个百分点；分析显示自适应过程中伪标签更准确，模型更新更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 分层选择性监督粒度 + 阈值校准 + 反向匹配回退能有效缓解跨被试漂移下的伪标签不可靠问题，为脑电解码类跨域 TTA 提供了可迁移的思路，但任务限于图像检索，与具身/3D 主线距离较远。

title: OceanFix: Reference-Guided Diffusion for Sparse-View Underwater 3D Reconstruction
summary: Recent advances in Gaussian splatting have enabled efficient underwater reconstruction, but sparse observations, light attenuation, and backscatter still leave scene regions underconstrained and cause novel-view artifacts. We present OceanFix, a reference-guided framework for sparse-view underwater 3D reconstruction that combines diffusion-based view repair with Gaussian scene refinement. Our repair model follows a two-stage training strategy that separates underwater appearance adaptation from geometric refinement. The first stage learns underwater appearance from reference observations and estimated medium features. The second uses camera poses and reference depth to align reference features, with relative-depth supervision guiding structural repair without requiring target-view depth at inference. We further propose medium-aware distillation that transfers repaired views into the 3D scene according to geometric repair demand and channel-specific optical observability. Through iterative rendering, repair, and distillation, OceanFix refines underconstrained regions while retaining supervision from the observed views. Experiments on underwater datasets demonstrate that OceanFix improves rendering quality in sparse-view 3D reconstruction, reducing visible artifacts and recovering finer scene details.

AI.tldr: OceanFix: 参考引导的稀疏视角水下3D重建框架，结合两阶段扩散视图修复（水下外观适应 + 几何精修）与介质感知蒸馏，将修复视图按几何需求与通道光学可观测性回灌到高斯场景中迭代优化。
AI.motivation: 水下高斯溅射重建受稀疏视角、光衰减与后向散射影响，场景区域欠约束并产生新视角伪影；需要在不依赖目标视角深度的前提下引入参考视图先验来补足约束。
AI.method: 两阶段训练的扩散修复模型：第一阶段从参考观测与估计的介质特征学习水下外观；第二阶段利用相机位姿与参考深度对齐参考特征，并以相对深度监督引导结构修复（推理时无需目标视角深度）。随后提出介质感知蒸馏，依据几何修复需求与通道相关光学可观测性将修复视图迁移至3D场景，通过渲染—修复—蒸馏迭代精修欠约束区域，同时保留观测视角监督。
AI.result: 在水下数据集上提升稀疏视角3D重建的渲染质量，减少可见伪影并恢复更精细的场景细节。摘要未给出定量指标、运行时间或泛化评测细节。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式视图修复与高斯场景优化耦合、并以介质物理特性加权蒸馏，是缓解稀疏视角欠约束的合理方案；但属特定领域（水下）逐场景重建，缺少跨场景泛化、实时性与代码/部署证据。

title: Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding for Temporally Grounded Audio-Visual Understanding
summary: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) are designed to represent the temporal structure of audio and video, yet it remains unclear how effectively they use this temporal information to relate sounds to visual events. To examine this, we probe an AV-LLM on an audio-visual synchronization task by shifting the audio so that the queried sound overlaps a different visual event. We observe that the model still favors the originally aligned event over the newly aligned one, indicating limited sensitivity to changes in audio-visual temporal alignment. To address this, we propose Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding (MSCD), a training-free decoding method that emphasizes audio-visual temporal alignment in model predictions. MSCD contrasts logits under preserved and disrupted temporal alignment to favor predictions supported by aligned audio and video. We disrupt this alignment by temporally shifting either the audio or the video, while keeping the other modality fixed. Extensive evaluations with two AV-LLMs across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MSCD for temporally grounded audio-visual understanding. In particular, MSCD improves accuracy over the base models on Daily-Omni by 2.2 and 2.8 percentage points for OmniVinci and video-SALMONN 2+, respectively, suggesting that emphasizing temporal alignment can also benefit broader audio-visual understanding.

AI.tldr: AV-LLM对音视频时间对齐的敏感度有限；提出免训练的解码方法MSCD，通过对比时间对齐/扰动下的logits提升时间对齐敏感性与理解性能。
AI.motivation: AV-LLM虽被设计用于表征音视频时间结构，但在"声音—视觉事件"关联上是否真正利用时间信息不清楚。作者通过音频平移的同步探针发现：即便查询声音已与新视觉事件重叠，模型仍偏向原始对齐事件，说明时间对齐敏感度低。
AI.method: 探针实验：平移音频使查询声音覆盖不同视觉事件，测模型对原对齐/新对齐事件的选择偏好。方法MSCD为免训练对比解码：分别在对齐保持与对齐被破坏（时间平移音频或视频，另一模态固定）的条件下计算logits，做对比以放大受对齐支持的预测。
AI.result: 在两个AV-LLM（OmniVinci、video-SALMONN 2+）与三个基准上验证有效；在Daily-Omni上分别较基模型提升2.2与2.8个百分点准确率，表明强调时间对齐还能惠及更广义的音视频理解。
AI.conclusion: AV-LLM存在时间对齐利用不足的缺陷，可通过推理期对比解码（无需训练）显著缓解；该思路可作为提升时间定位型音视频理解的通用插件。

title: Admoab-DETR: Resolution-Tiered Fusion for Infrared-Visible Object Detection with Missing Modalities
summary: Infrared and visible images offer complementary cues for all-weather object detection, yet real-world sensor dropouts can leave one stream unavailable and degrade paired-input detectors. Meanwhile, existing modality-adaptive methods apply heavy cross-modal attention uniformly across scales, incurring prohibitive token overhead on high-resolution maps. We propose Admoab-DETR, a unified real-time detector supporting infrared-only, visible-only, and paired inputs with a single set of weights. Specifically, \emph{Resolution-Tiered Fusion} (RTF) allocates fusion capacity by spatial token density and feature granularity: a lightweight Spatial Modality Gate governs fine local fusion at the highest-resolution scale with zero-cost single-view pass-through, while channel-compressed deformable Admoab necks capture cross-modal correspondence at coarser semantic scales. Furthermore, \emph{Mode-Matched Feature Distillation} (MMFD) aligns multi-scale encoder features with an availability-synchronized full-fusion teacher, avoiding ill-posed cross-modal hallucination while cutting parameters by 18.1\% and paired latency by 39.6\% at zero inference overhead. We also construct Admoab, a strictly registered 20,000-pair infrared--visible benchmark across diverse scenes. Experiments show Admoab-DETR achieves state-of-the-art accuracy--efficiency trade-offs across missing-modality and paired benchmarks. Our code will be available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Admoab-DETR：统一实时检测器，单套权重支持红外/可见光/成对输入；提出分辨率分层融合RTF与模式匹配特征蒸馏MMFD，并构建2万对严格配准基准Admoab。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中红外或可见光传感器可能失效导致单模态缺失，使成对输入检测器性能下降；同时现有模态自适应方法在高分辨率特征图上统一施加跨模态注意力，token开销过大。
AI.method: 分辨率分层融合（RTF）：依据空间token密度与特征粒度分配融合能力——最高分辨率层用轻量Spatial Modality Gate做细粒度局部融合并支持零成本单视图直通；较粗语义层用通道压缩的可变形Admoab neck建模跨模态对应。模式匹配特征蒸馏（MMFD）：以可用性同步的全融合教师对齐多尺度编码器特征，避免跨模态幻觉。另构建严格配准的2万对红外-可见光基准Admoab。
AI.result: 在缺失模态与成对基准上取得state-of-the-art的精度-效率折中；参数减少18.1%，成对推理延迟降低39.6%，零额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 按分辨率分层分配融合容量并配合可用性同步蒸馏，可在单一权重下稳健支持三种输入配置，兼顾实时性与精度。

title: Agentic-Level Adversarial Purification: Revisiting Diffusion Purifiers on Native-Resolution Agentic Inputs
summary: Vision-language agents act on native-resolution renders of multi-element pages, where one perturbed photo or a few altered text strokes can redirect the decision. Any content provider can craft such a perturbation on the open model behind the agent, so a plug-in purifier is the natural first line of defense. Yet diffusion purifiers were designed and evaluated at the fixed resolution of the diffusion model on classifier or natural-image benchmarks, and defense evaluations for agents test JPEG, blur and noise but no diffusion purifier. We present the first study of adversarial purification at the agentic level, for an agent built on Qwen3-VL-8B: purifiers run at native resolution on multi-element inputs, face grey-box attackers who know the agent's model but not the defense, and are compared at matched clean cost. We show that treating agentic inputs as classifier inputs misleads both evaluation and design. Resizing the input to the resolution of the diffusion model, as existing purifiers do, raises the TextVQA clean cost of the Divide-and-Conquer purifier (DC) from 4.0 to 35.7 points. On web-shop pages, DC keeps 85.0% grey-box robust accuracy against web-hardened perturbations, where cheap input transformations at matched clean cost keep at most 40.0%, and this robustness comes from the global noise level: input-estimated masks and noise levels add none. These findings hold on a disjoint held-out set and on a second VLM and yield three requirements for defenses, we release the protocol.

AI.tldr: 首个在"智能体层面"研究对抗净化的论文：以Qwen3-VL-8B视觉-语言智能体为目标，让扩散净化器在多元素页面原分辨率上运行，面对知晓模型的灰盒攻击，并在同等干净代价下对比；发现按分类器范式缩放输入会严重误导评估与设计。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言智能体直接作用于原分辨率多元素页面渲染图，一张被扰动的图片或几笔被改动的文字笔画即可改变决策，且开放模型使任何内容提供者都能构造此类扰动。扩散净化器本是自然的第一道防线，但既有净化器都是按扩散模型固定分辨率、在分类器或自然图像基准上设计与评估的；而智能体防务评估只测JPEG、模糊、噪声，从未评测扩散净化器，存在明显评估空白。
AI.method: 构建基于Qwen3-VL-8B的智能体灰盒威胁模型（攻击者知道智能体模型但不知道防御）；净化器在原分辨率的多元素输入上运行；与廉价输入变换在"同等干净代价"下对比；分析鲁棒性来源，通过消融检验输入估计掩码与噪声水平的作用；在独立的held-out集合与第二个VLM上复现，并发布协议。
AI.result: 将输入缩放到扩散模型分辨率（现有净化器做法）会使Divide-and-Conquer净化器（DC）在TextVQA上的干净代价从4.0点升至35.7点，说明把智能体输入当成分类器输入处理会误导评估与设计。在web-shop页面上，DC对web-hardened扰动的灰盒鲁棒准确率达85.0%，而同等干净代价下的廉价输入变换最多只有40.0%；该鲁棒性来源于全局噪声水平，输入估计的掩码与噪声水平毫无增益。结论在独立held-out集与第二个VLM上成立，并提炼出防御的三项需求。
AI.conclusion: 应把智能体输入视为与原图等尺寸的多元素页面并原分辨率净化，成本与干净精度须在同代价下报告，而非沿用分类器基准的分辨率归一化范式；提出三项防御设计需求并公开评估协议，为VLA/多模态智能体安全提供可复用的基准。

title: Loop4D: Embodied World Modeling with 4D VAEs and Looped Diffusion Transformers
summary: Predicting the outcomes of robotic manipulation requires modeling both visual appearance and evolving 3D geometry. This poses two challenges: video compression can obscure fine-grained robot motion, while jointly predicting RGB and geometry demands sufficient generative capacity. We introduce Loop4D, a framework that addresses these challenges through motion-preserving 4D representations and recurrent generative refinement. Our 4D VAE encodes RGB and pointmap sequences into compact spatiotemporal latents while preserving motion details and geometric structure. Our RGB VAE combines geometry-guided supervision with predictive reconstruction to reduce compression-induced motion artifacts. Our geometry VAE uses lightweight adapters to adapt pretrained RGB representations while preserving their priors. Building on these representations, our Dual-Stream Looped Diffusion Transformer maintains separate appearance and geometry streams with shared Transformer weights and cross-modal connections. By reusing Transformer blocks across loops, we increase effective depth without replicating backbone parameters, enabling models with fewer parameters to improve joint RGB-geometry prediction through additional computation. Experiments demonstrate high-quality 4D generation and validate Loop4D in simulated robotic manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: Loop4D通过运动保持的4D VAE（RGB+点图）与双流循环扩散Transformer，联合预测机械臂操作的RGB与几何序列，参数更少但计算更深。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作结果预测需同时建模视觉外观与演化3D几何；视频压缩易模糊细粒度机器人运动，而RGB与几何联合预测需要足够生成容量。
AI.method: 4D VAE将RGB与点图序列编码为紧凑时空潜变量；RGB VAE引入几何引导监督与可预测重建以减小压缩引起的运动伪影；几何VAE用轻量适配器复用预训练RGB先验。其上构建Dual-Stream Looped Diffusion Transformer，外观流与几何流分开、共享Transformer权重并带跨模态连接；循环复用Transformer块以在不增加主干参数的情况下提升有效深度。
AI.result: 实现高质量4D生成，并在仿真机器人操作任务中验证了Loop4D的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以运动保持的4D表征加循环生成式精化，可在参数精简条件下获得更强的RGB-几何联合预测能力，适用于机器人操作结果预测。

title: Beyond Logits: Coherent Hallucination Mitigation via Attention Contrastive Decoding
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate impressive multimodal capabilities, yet suffer from hallucination - generating factually inaccurate content. Contrastive Decoding (CD) mitigates this by contrasting amateur and expert branches at the logit level. However, our investigation reveals that such logit-level interventions fundamentally compromise generation coherence, necessitating restrictive penalty constraints unrelated to hallucination suppression. We introduce Attention Contrastive Decoding (ACD), a training-free plug-in that complements logit-level CD by relocating part of the contrastive operations to the attention mechanism. Operating at an earlier stage of the forward pass, ACD performs smooth semantic-preserving interventions through an Adaptive Subtraction Strategy (ASS), which attenuates hallucination-associated attention patterns while amplifying critical visual information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that combining ACD with existing CD methods (e.g., VCD+ACD) produces substantially more coherent outputs with further reduced hallucinations, eliminating restrictive penalties while enabling trustworthy multimodal generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attention Contrastive Decoding (ACD)，一种免训练即插即用方法，将部分对比解码操作从 logit 层迁移到注意力机制层，通过自适应减法策略 (ASS) 平滑抑制幻觉相关注意力模式并增强关键视觉信息，与 VCD 等现有 CD 方法结合可提升生成连贯性并进一步降低幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有对比解码 (CD) 在 logit 层干预虽能缓解 LVLM 幻觉，但作者发现这类干预会破坏生成连贯性，必须引入与幻觉抑制无关的强惩罚约束（如对短序列施加过度惩罚），因此需要在不损害连贯性的前提下做更早、更平滑的干预。
AI.method: 在注意力层而非仅 logit 层执行对比操作：构造业余/专家注意力模式的对比，通过 Adaptive Subtraction Strategy (ASS) 自适应地从注意力权重中减去幻觉相关模式、同时放大关键视觉 token 的注意力，实现语义保持的平滑干预；方法免训练、可插拔，与 VCD 等 logit 级 CD 互补叠加使用（如 VCD+ACD）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 ACD 与现有 CD 方法组合（VCD+ACD）显著提升输出连贯性，并进一步降低幻觉水平，同时可去除限制性惩罚项，使多模态生成更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 将对比干预前移至注意力阶段是缓解 LVLM 幻觉的更优切入点，注意力级与 logit 级 CD 具有互补性；ACD 作为免训练插件可即插即用于现有解码策略。

title: GeoCAM: Self-Supervised Sonar-Optical Representation Learning via Geographic Overlap Supervision
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems (AVSS 2026)
summary: Cross-modal self-supervised learning for paired side-scan sonar and underwater optical imagery is a promising direction for benthic habitat understanding, but it remains underexplored because existing methods do not fully exploit the one-to-many correspondences and geographic metadata available in real opti-acoustic surveys. This limits the ability to learn representations that are both semantically meaningful and geometrically consistent from abundant unlabeled marine data. To address this problem, we present GeoCAM, a geography-guided framework that learns a shared embedding space for sonar tiles and their associated optical views without semantic annotations. GeoCAM achieves its goal by combining three components: (i) a Set Attention Aggregator that adaptively summarizes multiple optical observations into a single tile-level representation; (ii) a geometry-weighted InfoNCE objective that converts GPS-derived footprint overlap into soft positive supervision; and (iii) an optional cross-modal masked reconstruction branch that encourages physically grounded cross-modal alignment. Experiments on the BenthiCat SSS-CAM dataset show that GeoCAM can be effectively exploited to learn which sonar and camera samples describe the same seabed patch, improving cross-modal retrieval and alignment over strong contrastive baselines. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: GeoCAM 提出地理引导的跨模态自监督框架，在无语义标注下学习侧扫声呐瓦片与光学图像的共享嵌入空间。
AI.motivation: 现有方法未充分利用实测中获得的一对多对应关系与 GPS 地理元数据，难以从海量无标签海洋数据中学到语义有意义且几何一致的表示。
AI.method: 三个组件：(i) Set Attention Aggregator 将同一瓦片的多张光学观测自适应聚合为单一瓦片级表示；(ii) 几何加权 InfoNCE，将 GPS 推导的足印重叠度转化为软正样本监督；(iii) 可选跨模态掩码重建分支，促进物理对齐。
AI.result: 在 BenthiCat SSS-CAM 数据集上有效学习同海底斑块的声呐-相机匹配关系，跨模态检索与对齐优于强对比学习基线；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 地理元数据可替代语义标签作为跨模态自监督信号，为海洋生境理解提供实用表示学习方案，但属特定水下遥感场景，缺乏机器人平台闭环或通用性证据。

title: Variation-aware Temporal Correspondence for Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning
summary: Self-supervised video representation learning has achieved remarkable progress by leveraging large-scale unlabeled video data. Recent methods commonly extend Masked Image Modeling (MIM) to Masked Video Modeling (MVM), where video representations are learned by capturing semantic information from temporal contexts during masked content recovery. Unlike static images, videos exhibit inherent temporal variation, as visual objects continuously change their positions, appearances, and motion states across frames. Therefore, MVM needs to preserve semantic consistency while capturing temporal changes of corresponding regions, which raises two central challenges: 1) how to establish reliable temporal correspondence across frames, and 2) how to formulate an appropriate representation learning objective for modeling both semantic consistency and temporal variation. To address these challenges, we propose Variation-aware Temporal Correspondence for video Representation learning (VT-CoRe) framework. For challenge 1), VT-CoRe introduces a sandwich sampling strategy to construct two-sided temporal references and a Patch Registration Module (PRM) to establish reliable patch-level correspondence. For challenge 2), VT-CoRe imposes latent-space semantic alignment on registered representations through a self-distillation architecture and further proposes temporal variation modeling to constrain representation trajectories over time. Experiments on 8 downstream tasks across 16 benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of VT-CoRe across pixel-level, frame-level, video-level, and vision-based robotic learning scenarios. Complementary representation analysis shows that VT-CoRe learns a more structured latent space for variation-aware temporal correspondence learning.

AI.tldr: VT-CoRe：用三明治采样+图像块配准建立可靠帧间时序对应，并通过潜空间自蒸馏语义对齐与时序变化建模，实现同时捕捉语义一致性与时序变化的视频自监督表征学习。
AI.motivation: 视频中物体位置、外观、运动状态持续变化，MVM在掩码重建时既要保持语义一致又要捕捉时序变化，因而面临两个核心问题：1) 如何建立可靠的跨帧时序对应；2) 如何设计兼顾语义一致性与时序变化的学习目标。
AI.method: 提出VT-CoRe框架。挑战1：引入三明治采样策略构建双侧时序参考，并用Patch Registration Module(PRM)建立块级可靠对应。挑战2：对配准后的表征施加潜空间语义对齐（基于自蒸馏架构），并提出时序变化建模以约束表征随时间的轨迹。
AI.result: 在16个基准、8类下游任务上验证有效性，覆盖像素级、帧级、视频级及视觉机器人学习场景；表征分析显示其学到更具结构化的潜空间。
AI.conclusion: VT-CoRe通过变化感知的时序对应为视频自监督表征学习提供了统一框架，兼顾语义一致与时序变化建模，具备跨任务适用性。

title: AnyCam4D: Ray-Based 4D Gaussian Rendering for Arbitrary Camera Models
summary: Real cameras are not pinholes, yet most dynamic Gaussian splatting assumes they are. Footage is therefore undistorted first, losing field of view or detail, especially with wide-angle and fisheye cameras. Static Gaussian splatting has largely solved this with ray-based rendering, which suits any camera. Native 4D Gaussians, which model motion in space-time, cannot use it directly: each Gaussian's orientation and size cannot be recovered reliably from its covariance. We present AnyCam4D, which trains native 4D Gaussians on original footage by ray-based rasterization, preserving field of view and resolution at about the per-step cost of standard projection. Our key contribution is a numerically stable way to obtain orientation and size: we condition a square root of the 4D covariance. Trained models render through other cameras, with rolling shutter, depth of field or chromatic aberration. With a synthetic 170-degree fisheye camera, training on original images improves peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) by 3.0-8.1 dB. On real footage, AnyCam4D has lower perceptual error than the standard projection adapted to each camera, at comparable PSNR and without camera-specific derivations. With the synthetic camera rotated 60-80 degrees away from the capture rig's view, it leads by 6.2 dB against ground truth.

AI.tldr: AnyCam4D 提出基于光线栅格化的原生 4D 高斯泼溅训练框架，用数值稳定的 4D 协方差平方根分解恢复高斯朝向与尺度，从而直接在未去畸变的原始（含鱼眼/滚动快门/景深/色差）视频上训练与渲染。
AI.motivation: 主流动态高斯泼溅假设针孔相机，需先对素材去畸变，导致视场丢失与细节损失，尤其广角/鱼眼严重。静态高斯已用光线渲染解决，但原生 4D 高斯无法直接套用：其朝向与尺寸难以从协方差稳定恢复。
AI.method: 提出 AnyCam4D：直接在原始素材上训练原生 4D 高斯，采用光线式栅格化，视场/分辨率不损失，单步开销与标准投影相当。核心贡献是对 4D 协方差做条件化的平方根分解（数值稳定），从而得到高斯朝向与尺度。学到的模型可通过其他相机参数渲染，并支持滚动快门、景深、色差等效应。
AI.result: 合成 170° 鱼眼相机上，用原始图像训练使 PSNR 提升 3.0–8.1 dB；真实素材上感知误差低于按各相机适配的标准投影，PSNR 相当且无需相机专属推导；相机相对采集视角旋转 60–80° 时，相对真值领先 6.2 dB。
AI.conclusion: 将光线渲染与原生 4D 高斯结合可在无需去畸变的前提下保持视场与细节，并具备跨相机、含真实镜头效应渲染的泛化能力，为多相机/鱼眼动态重建提供了通用且低开销的方案。

title: EgoMyo: Physical Hand State Estimation from Egocentric Video and Wrist Electromyography
summary: Physical hand interaction depends on configuration, contact, and force, yet nearly identical appearances can conceal different contact states and exerted forces. We therefore formulate physical hand state estimation from egocentric video and wrist surface electromyography (sEMG), combining visual geometry with neuromuscular evidence to jointly recover these coupled components. To support this task, we introduce EgoMyo, a benchmark spanning 5.75M video frames, 50 participants, 34 contact configurations, and repeated donnings, synchronizing these inputs with 3D hand pose and with contact and normal force registered onto the hand surface from bare-hand pressure. Controlled analysis reveals that vision resolves spatial structure while sEMG better estimates force magnitude, that sEMG's gains concentrate in regions where vision is least reliable, and that contact localization limits force accuracy. Guided by these findings, we propose MyoBridge, which makes the hand region the unit of vision-sEMG fusion, lets each region gate its own share of sEMG, and distributes regional force magnitudes only over predicted contact vertices at inference. On held-out trials, MyoBridge reduces pose and force error by 39.8% and 18.5% over the strongest baseline and achieves the lowest pose error on unseen sessions and subjects.

AI.tldr: 提出从第一人称视频+腕部sEMG联合估计物理手状态（位姿、接触、法向力），构建EgoMyo基准，并提出以手部区域为融合单元的MyoBridge方法。
AI.motivation: 外观相同的手部姿态可能隐藏不同的接触状态与施力，仅靠视觉无法解耦配置、接触与力三者的耦合关系，需要引入神经肌肉证据（sEMG）补充视觉难以判定的力信息。
AI.method: 构建EgoMyo基准：5.75M帧视频、50名被试、34种接触构型、多次佩戴，同步3D手部位姿与裸手压力标定的接触/法向力；通过对照分析揭示视觉负责空间结构、sEMG负责力幅值、二者互补且接触定位是力精度瓶颈；据此提出MyoBridge：以手部区域作为视觉-sEMG融合单元，各区域自适应门控sEMG权重，推理时仅将区域力幅值分配到预测的接触顶点上。
AI.result: 在留出试验上，位姿与力误差分别比最强基线降低39.8%和18.5%，并在未见过的session与被试上取得最低位姿误差；消融分析支持区域级门控与接触约束分配的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 视觉与sEMG在手状态估计中高度互补，区域级融合与接触先验约束是恢复耦合物理手状态的有效范式，EgoMyo为后续多模态手-物交互研究提供基准。

title: LiveRelight: Sub-Second Global Illumination Editing for Gaussian Interiors
summary: Relighting reconstructed 3D scenes remains challenging due to the complex nature of light transport: slow or approximate visual feedback restricts the editor's ability to fine-tune the results to satisfaction. We present a hybrid relighting approach that enables interactive, high-fidelity updates of direct and indirect indoor illumination without per-edit optimization. Our approach permits the editor to make a wide range of relighting edits at room-scale, with near-instant feedback. Our key insight is to precompute geometric light exchange rather than illumination responses, retaining an inexpensive transport solve that accommodates changes in emission and surface reflectance. We evaluate direct illumination on reconstructed 2D Gaussians using visibility-aware sampling of one-sided emitters, while propagating diffuse interreflection through sparse radiosity on a triangle proxy. A sparse projection fitted through Gaussian alpha compositing transfers the proxy solution to the reconstruction. Our formulation further supports fast fixture transformations and emitter insertion by recomputing light source injection. Across eight relighting conditions of our synthetic test suite, our sub-second edits improve relighting fidelity over prior path-traced editing by an average of 5\,dB PSNR, while reducing editing latency by up to three orders of magnitude. Qualitative results further demonstrate realistic, interactive relighting of real-world captures.

AI.tldr: 提出混合重光照方法：预计算几何光交换而非光照响应，用2D Gaussian可见性采样做直接光、三角网格稀疏辐射度做漫反射间接光，再经alpha合成投影回重建结果，实现亚秒级、无需逐次优化的室内重光照编辑。
AI.motivation: 重建3D场景的重光照中，光传输复杂导致反馈慢或近似粗糙，编辑者难以实时微调至满意效果；需要交互式、高保真的直接与间接光照更新。
AI.method: 关键思路是预计算几何层面的光交换（visibility/exchange）而非光照响应，保留可随发射与反射率变化的廉价传输求解：直接光在重建2D Gaussian上做单面发射体的可见性感知采样；漫反射互反射在三角代理上用稀疏辐射度传播；通过拟合Gaussian alpha合成的稀疏投影把代理解迁移到重建场景；支持快速灯具变换与发射体插入（重算光源注入）。
AI.result: 在合成测试集8种重光照条件下，亚秒级编辑相比先前路径追踪编辑平均提升约5 dB PSNR，编辑延迟最多降低三个数量级；定性结果展示真实采集场景的交互式真实感重光照。
AI.conclusion: 预计算几何光交换+混合表示（Gaussian直接光+网格代理间接光）是交互式高保真重光照的有效范式，兼顾编辑灵活性与实时性。

title: Weakly Conditioned Diffusion Model Augmentation for Prostate Segmentation
summary: Deep learning models for prostate MRI segmentation often struggle to generalize when trained on limited heterogeneous data, leading to boundary errors and over-segmentation. We present an augmentation framework using mask-conditioned synthetic and diverse T2-weighted MRI volumes to improve boundary precision and reduce over-segmentation. We employ a 2.5D weakly mask-conditioned denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) via channel concatenation. The diffusion model conditions on stacks of adjacent binary masks from training folds. The model generates T2 volumes consistent with the conditioning anatomy while diversifying tissue appearance. We evaluate the proposed approach on two cohorts of data: (i) the LUND probe cohort (n=432) for strategy selection and training nnU-Net from scratch with a 23% synthetic data mix, and (ii) the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) prostate cohort (n=32) evaluated with a 20% synthetic data mix. For the LUND cohort, we found that training an nnU-Net model from scratch with a 23% synthetic data mix reduced the mean false-positive voxels per case from 11,102 (baseline) to 10,757. On the MSD cohort, the augmented model with a 20% synthetic mix achieved a mean cross-validated Dice of 0.9094, improving over the baseline (0.8935) by 1.59 percentage points and reducing mean false-positive voxels by 23.1% (4,201 to 3,229). Experimental results on both these cohorts suggest that mask-conditioned DDPM augmentation can reduce over-segmentation errors and improve boundary adherence in data-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 用2.5D弱掩码条件DDPM生成与解剖掩码一致的T2前列腺MRI合成体数据，混入nnU-Net训练以减少过分割、提升边界精度。
