AI.motivation: 前列腺MRI分割在异构小数据上泛化差，边界误差与过分割严重，需通过数据增广缓解。
AI.method: 通道拼接实现2.5D弱掩码条件去噪扩散模型，以相邻二值掩码堆为条件生成外观多样化但解剖一致的T2体积；训练nnU-Net时混入23%（LUND）或20%（MSD）合成数据。
AI.conclusion: 掩码条件DDPM增广可降低数据受限场景下的过分割错误并改善边界贴合，但增益有限、局限于医学影像域。

title: OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms
summary: Computer-using agents are increasingly expected to complete realistic user goals rather than isolated GUI actions. However, existing benchmarks typically isolate web, mobile, or desktop environments, leaving it unclear whether a single generalist agent can execute long-horizon workflows that span multiple operating systems and persistent application states. We introduce OS-Omni, a live cross-platform benchmark and execution environment for evaluating computer-using agents across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web environments. OS-Omni is released in versioned waves of 300 tasks each; this paper focuses on the first release, v1, which contains 48 tasks per platform and 12 cross-platform workflows that pair a desktop with an Android phone. OS-Omni provides reproducible initialization, platform-specific adapters, trajectory logging, and executable final-state evaluators, and includes controlled service-backed applications for workflows involving account, cart, budget, calendar, message, and other persistent state. Human studies show that OS-Omni tasks require 67.54 interaction steps, substantially exceeding OSWorld references of 15.0 steps. On v1, the strongest evaluated agent, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches 68.5% average success, trailing the 77.3% human reference by 8.8 points; the gap is uneven across platforms, with frontier models exceeding humans on Linux but trailing them by more than 25 points on iOS and macOS. These results indicate that current agents remain far from platform-robust, long-horizon computer use, especially when success requires sustained state tracking and durable final-state changes.

AI.tldr: OS-Omni v1：跨 Windows/Ubuntu/macOS/iOS/Android/Web 的可复现实时基准与执行环境，每平台48任务+12个桌面×Android跨端工作流，平均需67.54步；最强 agent Claude Opus 5.5 达68.5%，人类77.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准将 Web、移动端与桌面环境割裂评估，无法判断单一通用 agent 能否完成跨操作系统、跨持久化应用状态的长时程工作流。
AI.method: 构建跨六平台（Windows、Ubuntu、macOS、iOS、Android、Web）的实时基准与执行环境；分版本波次发布（每波300任务），v1 每平台48任务、12条桌面+Android 配对工作流；提供可复现初始化、平台适配器、轨迹日志与可执行终态评测器，并接入账号、购物车、预算、日历、消息等有状态服务型应用。
AI.result: 任务需约67.54交互步（显著高于 OSWorld 的15步）；Claude Opus 5.5 平均成功率68.5%，低于人类77.3%（差8.8点）；平台间差距不均：Linux 上超人类，iOS/macOS 落后逾25点。
AI.conclusion: 当前 agent 距离平台鲁棒的长时程计算机使用仍有显著差距，尤其在需持续状态跟踪和终态持久变更时；尚无单一通用 agent 达到人类水平。

title: VibeVideoAgent: Closing the Perceptual Loop for Code-Driven Video Generation
summary: Code-driven video generation asks a coding agent to write and run rendering programs. This gives exact control over typography, data visualizations, synchronized audio, and multi-shot scenes, and it leaves an editable project behind. A program that exits cleanly can still render overlapping labels, a camera aimed away from its subject, broken object interactions, or narration that drifts out of sync, and none of these raise a runtime error. Feeding rendered frames and audio back into the coding session bloats its long-horizon context, while critiquing only the finished full-resolution render turns early design mistakes into costly rewrites. We introduce VibeVideoAgent, a training-free framework that lets coding agents inspect their drafts throughout production. Multimodal perception runs in short-lived contexts kept apart from the coder and returns compact, grounded Findings. Seven primitives operate on a unified multi-clock representation of assets and drafts: they explore media from coarse to fine, verify quoted requirements with evidence from every required modality, compare a draft with a reference or an earlier revision on separate clocks, and measure stream signals locally. A lightweight staged protocol has the agent test its riskiest decision on a minimal preview first. On all 239 VibeVideoBench tasks, with matched agent runtimes and a fixed perception model, VibeVideoAgent improves holistic audiovisual quality (L3) for Claude Opus 5.5 (4.03 -> 4.43, while L2 rubric compliance rises from 98.87% to 99.35%), GPT-6 Astra (4.03 -> 4.27), and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (3.97 -> 4.10), with the largest gains in audio-visual synchronization (up to +0.56). Controlled ablations show that each component contributes, and trajectory audits show that the granularity of code edits governs the trade-off between rubric adherence and perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 VibeVideoAgent，让代码驱动视频生成中的 coding agent 在生产过程中通过隔离的多模态感知上下文获得紧凑的 grounded Findings，并用七个原语在统一多时钟表示上探索、核验、对比与测量，配合分阶段协议先在最小编预览上验证高风险决策。
AI.motivation: 代码驱动视频生成中，程序正常退出不代表渲染结果正确：标签重叠、镜头偏离主体、物体交互错误、音画不同步均不触发运行时错误；而把渲染帧与音频回灌 coding 会话会膨胀长程上下文，仅对最终全分辨率成片做批评则使早期设计错误变成昂贵重写。
AI.method: VibeVideoAgent（免训练）：1) 多模态感知运行在与 coder 分离的短生命周期上下文中，返回紧凑且可溯源的 Findings；2) 七个原语作用于资产与草稿的统一多时钟表示，支持由粗到细的媒体探索、对引用需求做全模态证据核验、在分离时钟上与参考或历史版本对比、局部测量流信号；3) 轻量分阶段协议，先在最小编预览上测试最高风险决策。
AI.result: 在全部 239 个 VibeVideoBench 任务上（匹配 agent 运行时、固定感知模型）：Claude Opus 5.5 整体音视频质量 L3 由 4.03 升至 4.43，L2 rubric 合规率由 98.87% 升至 99.35%；GPT-6 Astra 4.03→4.27；Claude Sonnet 5.5 3.97→4.10；音画同步子项最大提升 +0.56。消融显示各组件均有贡献；轨迹审计表明代码编辑粒度决定 rubric 遵循与感知质量之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将多模态批评与代码编辑解耦、以结构化原语和多时钟表示提供过程性视觉反馈，可在不训练的情况下显著提升代码驱动视频生成的感知质量与音画同步；编辑粒度是质量与规范遵循权衡的关键控制点。

title: Analemma $\infty$: A Temporal Benchmark for Geospatial Foundation Models
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 17 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Satellite time series capture how land surfaces change over time. Pixel-wise temporal foundation models read a year of satellite observations per pixel, yet public benchmarks lack a temporal axis or subsample it to a few dates. We introduce Analemma, a temporal benchmark of six datasets that carry every 10 and 20 m Sentinel-2 band and a time series spanning a growing season, completed where their releases omit geometry, dates, or cloud masks. One frozen-encoder protocol evaluates all models across label ratios and three seeds, with two baselines without pretraining. The TESSERA model ranks first overall. A from-scratch model on monthly composites outranks every foundation model except OlmoEarth v1.3-Base, suggesting that temporal input explains most of the performance. Three evaluation choices left unstated by the source publications each shift TESSERA v1 by 7.6 to 18.6 mIoU, against top-two gaps of 0.6 to 2.8. Data, harness and leaderboard will be publicly released soon.

AI.tldr: Analemma：一个含六个数据集、保留全部10/20米Sentinel-2波段与完整生长季时序的遥感时序基准；统一冻结编码器协议显示TESSERA总体第一，而月度合成上从头训练的模型优于除OlmoEarth v1.3-Base外的所有基础模型，说明时序输入本身贡献主要性能。
AI.motivation: 像素级遥感时序基础模型逐年读取卫星观测，但公开基准缺乏时间轴，或仅抽稀到少数日期，导致"时序"能力无法被真正评测；同时原始数据集发布常缺失几何、日期或云掩膜，难以直接用于统一评测。作者因此构建补全后的全时序基准。
AI.method: 构建Analemma基准：六个数据集，包含全部10 m与20 m Sentinel-2波段及覆盖整个生长季的时间序列，并补齐缺失的几何信息、日期与云掩膜。采用单一冻结编码器协议（frozen-encoder），在不同标签比例与三个随机种子下评测所有模型，另设两个无预训练基线；并做消融以量化评估设定本身的影响。
AI.result: TESSERA总体排名第一；在月度合成上从零训练的模型超过除OlmoEarth v1.3-Base外的所有基础模型。源文献未说明的三项评估选择各自使TESSERA v1的mIoU变动7.6–18.6，而排名前二模型之间的差距仅0.6–2.8，即评估细节的影响远大于模型间差距。数据、评测框架与排行榜将公开。
AI.conclusion: 当前遥感时序基础模型的性能差异很大程度上可由时序输入与评估协议选择解释，而非预训练表征本身；该基准强调需要标准化协议才能可靠比较模型。

title: Autonomous Vineyard Exploration using LiDAR Sensing: A Field Evaluation on Legged-Wheeled Quadruped Robot
summary: Autonomous navigation in vineyards presents significant challenges due to uneven terrain, sparse vegetation, and the repetitive geometric nature of vineyard rows. This paper evaluates a LiDAR-based autonomous exploration system deployed on a Unitree Go2 Wheeled quadruped robot. Our approach utilizes an iterative RANSAC-based line detection pipeline to identify vineyard rows and a finite-state navigation strategy to govern row selection and traversal. Field evaluations conducted at Denbies Vineyard (UK) demonstrate the system's ability to perform sustained autonomous row following, completing a 370m up-and-down traversal without intervention. We analyze the failure modes encountered, specifically focusing on line detection instability in sparse vegetation and the trade-offs of spatial filtering. The results suggest that, while RANSAC provides a robust geometric primitive, additional temporal filtering and adaptive perception are required for reliable lane-to-lane transitions in commercial vineyard environments. A video of the experimental results is available at: this http URL

AI.tldr: 在Unitree Go2轮足机器人上部署LiDAR自主探索系统，用迭代RANSAC直线检测识别葡萄园行并配合有限状态机做行选择与遍历，在Denbies葡萄园完成370m无干预往返自动驾驶，并分析失效模式。
AI.motivation: 葡萄园地形不平、植被稀疏、行间几何高度重复，传统视觉/导航方案难以稳定识别行车道；作者希望验证LiDAR几何基元在真实农业非结构化环境中的可行性与可扩展性。
AI.method: LiDAR感知+迭代RANSAC直线拟合提取葡萄园行边界；有限状态机控制行选择、进入与穿行；对比空间滤波等预处理策略；在真实葡萄园中做场地实验并做失效模式归因分析（稀疏植被下直线检测不稳定、滤波引起的权衡）。
AI.result: 真实场地实现持续自主行跟随，完成370m往返无人工干预；同时暴露出稀疏植被段行检测抖动、行间切换困难的问题，指出仅靠RANSAC几何基元不足以支撑商业化果园的全流程自主。
AI.conclusion: 几何基元+状态机方案在结构化行种植环境中可行，但需引入时序滤波与自适应感知才能可靠完成行间转换；属工程验证型工作，方法新意有限。

title: Detector Operating Behavior Inference via Data-Space Sampling
summary: A detector scores candidate detections, but the recall and false alarms at a given confidence threshold depend on the input distribution. We introduce Detector Operating Behavior Inference (DOBI), a second-level inference task: estimating a fixed detector's threshold-dependent, distribution-level operating response from the internal evidence of a single unlabeled image. DOBI treats the detector's threshold response, i.e. recall, false positives, and precision across thresholds, as a latent behavioral state under the current data condition. Controlled data-space sampling probes this state space offline, and a lightweight monitor learns the inverse map from one image to this state, whose single functional output supports multiple operating policies. In a controlled proof of concept with a fixed YOLOv10-Nano person detector and COCO-derived degradations, predicted PR behavior reduces mean absolute deviation from 0.128 for an image-independent mean-behavior prior to 0.054, and predicted functional distances track empirical regime distances (Spearman 0.96). From one unlabeled image, the inferred behavior selects operating points as well as a non-deployable lookup that knows the true regime (macro-regime $F_1$ 0.6604 for both, versus 0.6407 under pristine calibration; oracle 0.6620). On this discrete benchmark, regime-supervised curve lookups are strong controls. Pre-specified continuous and compositional probing shows where functional inference matters: on unseen combinations, the functional decoder has a lower mean curve error than a template lookup, increasingly with distance from the training conditions, whereas the lookup is more accurate for interpolation. These results establish the feasibility of single-image inference of distribution-level detector behavior over the probed conditions. Source code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 该文提出DOBI二级推断任务：仅凭单张无标注图像推断固定检测器在当前数据分布下的阈值响应曲线（召回、误报、精度随阈值变化），用离线受控采样构建状态空间并训练轻量监控器做逆向映射。
AI.motivation: 检测器在给定置信度阈值下的召回与误报强烈依赖输入分布，部署时缺乏分布级行为先验；希望无需标签即可在线估计当前条件下的运行行为，以便自适应选择工作点。
AI.method: 将检测器的阈值响应视作潜在行为状态，在数据空间做受控采样探针离线生成状态样本，训练轻量monitor学习从单张图像到该状态的逆映射；并做连续的、组合式的探针实验检验函数式推断在外推与插值上的差异；基线包括图像无关均值先验、真值regime查表和oracle。
AI.result: 固定YOLOv10-Nano人检测器+COCO退化数据的概念验证中，PR行为预测的MAD从0.128降到0.054，预测函数距离与经验regime距离Spearman 0.96；所选工作点达到与知道真值regime的查表相当的效果（macro-regime F1均为0.6604，原始校准0.6407，oracle 0.6620）；但在未见条件组合上函数解码器曲线误差低于模板查表且随距离增加而优势扩大，插值场景查表更准。
AI.conclusion: 单图推断分布级检测器行为在被探测条件下是可行的，但在离散benchmark上查表类强baseline仍具竞争力，函数推断主要在外推组合条件下体现价值。

title: CamAct: Learning Robotic Manipulation from In-the-Wild Videos via Camera Motion
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models benefit from large, diverse datasets for robotic manipulation, yet collecting robot demonstrations remains costly. Recent work has explored egocentric videos as a source of supervision, primarily drawing on demonstrations of human-object interaction. We show that in-the-wild videos can improve robotic manipulation even when they contain no demonstrations of object manipulation. Specifically, camera motion recovered from these videos provides an additional source of motion supervision that complements robot demonstrations. Building on this finding, we introduce CamAct, which incorporates this camera-motion supervision into VLA policies alongside robot demonstrations, extending the use of human videos for manipulation learning beyond object interactions. Experiments show that incorporating this video supervision during fine-tuning improves success rates from 96.40% to 98.10% on LIBERO and from 22.96% to 29.32% on RoboCasa 365. The resulting policy also demonstrates strong results in out-of-distribution generalization on LIBERO-Plus and real-world manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出CamAct：将野外视频中恢复的相机运动作为额外运动监督信号，与机器人示范联合微调VLA策略，即使视频不含物体操作示范也能提升操作性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人示范数据采集成本高；已有工作仅把人类操作视频当作监督来源，忽略了不含操作示范的野外视频仍含有可迁移的相机/自运动信息。
AI.method: 从in-the-wild视频中恢复相机运动轨迹，将其作为辅助监督目标注入VLA策略（动作头同时预测相机运动与机器人动作），与机器人示范数据共同微调，从而扩展人类视频用于操作学习的范围至物体交互之外。
AI.result: LIBERO成功率96.40%→98.10%，RoboCasa 365 22.96%→29.32%；在LIBERO-Plus与真实机器人任务上表现出较强的分布外泛化。
AI.conclusion: 相机运动是可低成本获得的通用运动监督，可作为示范增强手段补充机器人数据，显著改善VLA微调效果与OOD泛化。

title: TORE: Token-Wise Taylor Order Selection via Decomposed Residual Error Estimation for Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Diffusion models excel at image and video generation, but iterative denoising incurs substantial inference latency. Recent token-adaptive acceleration methods select Taylor prediction orders for the full-model residual using shallow-layer proxy scores. However, candidate orders are evaluated on these proxy features but used to predict the full-model residual, creating a proxy--target mismatch: the proxy-preferred order may not minimize residual prediction error. To address this mismatch, we propose \textbf{TORE} (\textbf{T}aylor \textbf{O}rder selection via \textbf{R}esidual \textbf{E}rror estimation), which selects token-wise Taylor orders based on estimated prediction errors for the full-model residual. Yet direct error evaluation requires future ground-truth residuals, which are unavailable during order selection. TORE therefore estimates prediction error by analyzing how errors arise in Taylor extrapolation. Specifically, it decomposes prediction error into truncation error and finite-difference derivative error, then estimates both contributions from cached residuals to preselect token-wise orders for upcoming skip steps. Extensive experiments show that TORE achieves $4.31\times$ speedup on FLUX.1-dev and $4.18\times$ on Wan2.1 while maintaining high generation quality and fidelity.

AI.tldr: TORE: 针对 token 自适应扩散加速中"代理特征评估、全模型残差预测"的错配问题,用截断误差+有限差分导数误差分解估计真实残差预测误差,为每个 token 选择 Taylor 阶数;FLUX.1-dev 4.31x、Wan2.1 4.18x 加速且质量保持。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型迭代去噪推理延迟高。已有 token 自适应方法用浅层特征作为代理分数挑选 Taylor 预测阶数,但这些阶数被用于预测全模型残差,造成代理—目标错配:代理偏好的阶数未必使全模型残差预测误差最小。
AI.method: 无法在选阶时获得未来真值残差,故从误差产生机理出发,将预测误差解析分解为截断误差与有限差分导数误差两部分,利用已缓存的残差对两者进行估计,从而在即将到来的跳步之前按 token 预选阶数。
AI.result: FLUX.1-dev 上取得 4.31x 加速,Wan2.1 上 4.18x 加速,生成质量与保真度保持较高水平。
AI.conclusion: 以残差预测误差估计替代浅层代理选阶,是消除错配、提升 token 自适应扩散加速效率与质量的有效思路;误差可分解估计使未来监督信息缺失问题得到绕行。

title: Semantic State Reading for Joint Image-Semantic Diffusion Transformers
summary: Pretrained visual representations improve diffusion-transformer training, yet exploiting both global context and local spatial structure requires deciding which semantic states to model and how to access them. We introduce Semantic State Reading (SSR), which jointly denoises image latents, a global CLS token encoding image-level context, and a compact patch state preserving spatial correspondence. SSR couples this global-local modeling with distinct reading paths: local states are fused with corresponding image tokens at the input, while independent projections inject the current global state into every transformer block. Both semantic scopes thus remain accessible throughout denoising. Ablations show complementary benefits from local-state modeling and repeated global reading, and semantic-trajectory interventions alter image layout under a fixed class label. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, SiT-XL/2 with SSR reaches or surpasses the reference FIDs of SiT, REPA, and Representation Entanglement for Generation (REG) with $100\times$, $40\times$, and $2\times$ fewer training iterations, respectively. SSR achieves unguided FID 1.78 at 2M iterations and FID 1.34 with classifier-free guidance alone. Combining classifier-free guidance with autoguidance yields FID 1.31 at 1M iterations, achieving the best FID in our main comparison table.

AI.tldr: 提出语义状态读取（SSR）：在扩散Transformer中联合去噪图像latent、全局CLS token与紧凑patch状态，实现全局-局部语义建模，大幅加速ImageNet 256训练并刷新FID。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉表征虽能提升扩散Transformer训练，但需明确"建模哪些语义状态"以及"如何在去噪全过程中访问它们"，才能同时利用全局上下文与局部空间结构。
AI.method: SSR在SiT类扩散Transformer中额外去噪全局CLS token与保留空间对应性的紧凑patch状态；两条读取路径：局部状态在输入端与对应图像token融合，独立投影将当前全局状态注入每个Transformer block，使两种语义尺度在去噪中持续可访问。消融验证局部状态建模与重复全局读取的互补性，并通过语义轨迹干预实验分析布局控制。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256上SiT-XL/2+SSR以比SiT、REPA、REG少100×、40×、2×的训练迭代达到或超过其参考FID；2M迭代无引导FID 1.78，仅CFG为1.34；CFG+autoguidance在1M迭代达FID 1.31，为主对比表中最佳。
AI.conclusion: 结构化全局-局部语义状态的持续读取是提升扩散Transformer训练效率与生成质量的有效手段，且语义轨迹可解释地影响图像布局。

title: Escapingthe instruction blackhole of vision-language-action policies via optimal-transport wormholes
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are trained to follow a fixed instruction, yet people change their minds while the robot acts. We identify the instruction black hole: once a VLA policy commits to a task, new instructions are absorbed and the robot completes the old task or freezes. We quantify it with a transmission ratio and an event horizon and prove it is a blind spot of static imitation, which cannot distinguish a policy that listens from a deaf one once the execution state reveals the task. We propose Wormhole, a training-free plug-in that relocates the robot instead of re-instructing it: optimal transport selects an approach-phase state of the new task, a rate-limited traversal carries the robot there, and the unmodified policy takes over. On LIBERO,Wormhole raises committed-switch success of pi to and pi0.5 from at most 1.2% to 93.1%, matching or exceeding scripted retreat-and-restart with one fifth of its action discontinuity.

AI.tldr: 提出VLA策略的"指令黑洞"问题：策略一旦承诺任务，新指令被吸收，机器人完成旧任务或冻结；用transmission ratio与event horizon量化，证明静态模仿学习无法区分"会听"与"聋"的策略。提出无需训练的插件Wormhole，用最优传输选取新任务的接近阶段状态、限速轨迹迁移机器人，再由原策略接管。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略按固定指令训练，人类却在机器人执行中改变指令；作者发现并形式化"指令黑洞"现象，并指出静态模仿学习存在原理性盲区——执行状态一旦暴露任务，策略是否响应新指令不可辨别，因此需要一种不改策略即可实现指令切换的手段。
AI.method: Wormhole为training-free plug-in：以最优传输从新任务数据中挑选一个approach-phase状态，通过受限速率的traversal把机器人迁移到该状态，随后由未修改的原VLA策略接管完成新任务。理论侧定义transmission ratio与event horizon指标，并给出静态模仿无法辨别"倾听/失聪"策略的论证。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上，committed-switch成功率将π₀与π₀.5从最高1.2%提升至93.1%，达到或超过脚本化"retreat-and-restart"基线，且action discontinuity仅为其五分之一。
AI.conclusion: 指令切换失败是VLA范式层面的结构性问题而非单纯数据不足；通过在状态空间中重定位（而非重新指令）可低成本、免训练地大幅恢复切换能力，代价是动作连续性显著更好。局限在于仅仿真基准验证、最优传输依赖新任务状态数据。

title: ReMeDi: Single-Image PBR Material Estimation via Reparameterization between Metal and Dielectric Hypotheses
comment: 27 pages, 16 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Physically based rendering (PBR) material estimation facilitates relighting, material editing, and 3D content creation. As the reflectance of a surface heavily depends on whether it is a metal or a dielectric, producing any map that determines albedo involves a decision on metalness, which we call the "intended metalness" of the map. Rendering maps with mismatched intended metalness yields physically implausible or misinterpreted materials. The metallic--roughness workflow makes metalness explicit and thus encourages base color to match it, but does not enforce this match, especially for automated methods directly predicting each map. Therefore, we propose ReMeDi, which enforces the match through two components. First, we reparameterize base color as a metalness-weighted blend of its two variants, estimated under the all-metal and all-dielectric hypothesis, respectively. Second, as available supervision cannot teach a single network both hypotheses at every pixel, we restrict each of two separate networks to one hypothesis, so that each variant is ensured to follow its hypothesis. Besides enforcing the match, this also improves each estimated material map. Experiments show that ReMeDi outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both material accuracy and relighting fidelity.

AI.tldr: ReMeDi通过金属度加权混合重参数化基色，并用两个分别限定于全金属/全介电假设的网络分支来强制贴图金属度一致性，提升PBR材质估计与重光照质量。
AI.motivation: 逆渲染得到的反射率贴图强依赖表面是金属还是介电体，即贴图的"intended metalness"。若基色（base color）与其假定的金属度不匹配，渲染会出现物理上不合理或被误解的材质。金属-粗糙度工作流虽显式给出金属度，但并不强制基色与之匹配，尤其在逐图独立预测的自动化方法中更易失配。
AI.method: 两点设计：(1) 将基色重参数化为"全金属假设基色"与"全介电假设基色"的金属度加权混合；(2) 由于现有监督无法让单一网络在每个像素上同时学会两种假设，改用两个独立网络各负责一种假设，保证每个基色变体严格遵循其假设所对应的反射率行为。
AI.result: 实验表明ReMeDi在材质估计精度与重光照保真度上均优于现有SOTA方法；强制匹配的同时还改善各张材质贴图的估计质量。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并强制基色与金属度假设的一致性，是提升PBR材质估计物理合理性与下游重光照效果的有效途径，且可通过双网络分假设设计在现有监督下实现。

title: DataForgeVLA: Fully Synthetic Manipulation Demonstrations for Vision-Language-Action Training
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Dataset available at this https URL
summary: We present a dataset of 340 fully synthetic manipulation demonstrations generated from real seed data for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) training. The corpus contains 32,340 frames with synchronized RGB and actions across eight object categories, represented as LeRobot v2.1 episodes with H.264 video, per-frame robot states and pose-valued action labels, language task annotations, summary statistics and quality decisions. Each synthetic demonstration is produced without additional teleoperation: a LoRA-fine-tuned Cosmos-3 model generates a manipulation video, and RoboHaMeR recovers the corresponding robot trajectory from RGB. Quality screening accepted 300 of 340 episodes for policy fine-tuning. As preliminary evidence of feasibility, a pretrained GR00T N1.6 policy fine-tuned exclusively on the 300 accepted episodes reaches 16/20 (80%) real-world pick-and-place success on the Oreo-package task. A policy fine-tuned on 105 real teleoperated episodes achieved 18/20 (90%) under the same protocol. These results are based on one object and 20 trials per policy and are therefore reported as preliminary evidence rather than a general performance claim.

AI.tldr: Synthetic VLA dataset: LoRA-fine-tuned Cosmos-3 generates manipulation videos from real seed data; RoboHaMeR recovers trajectories from RGB; 300/340 episodes accepted; GR00T N1.6 fine-tuned only on synthetic data reaches 16/20 real pick-and-place success vs 18/20 with real teleop.
AI.motivation: 真实遥操作VLA数据采集成本高、规模受限，现有视频生成增强方法缺少可直接用于策略微调的完整"视频+动作+语言"对齐数据与轨迹恢复闭环。
AI.method: 基于真实种子数据，用LoRA微调的Cosmos-3生成操作视频，再用RoboHaMeR从RGB视频中恢复机器人轨迹；以LeRobot v2.1格式（H.264视频、逐帧状态、位姿动作标签、语言标注）构建340段合成演示（32,340帧，8类物体）；经质量筛查保留300段用于策略微调。
AI.result: 仅用300段合成数据微调的GR00T N1.6在Oreo包装拾取放置真实任务上达16/20（80%）；同一协议下用105段真实遥操作数据微调为18/20（90%）；仅单物体、每策略20次试验。
AI.conclusion: 合成演示可直接支撑VLA策略微调并接近真实遥操作性能，验证了"生成视频→轨迹恢复→策略微调"管线的可行性；但证据限于单任务小样本，属初步结果，需多物体、多任务、大规模评测支撑泛化性结论。

title: Rehearse in 3D, Render in 2D: Physically Consistent and Editable Robot World Models
summary: Embodied world models aim to predict future interactions that are both visually realistic and physically consistent. Yet explicit 3D motion prediction alone does not guarantee that object structure and contact relationships are preserved. Beyond motion prediction, 3D representations provide an explicit state space for imposing structural and physical constraints. Building on this insight, we introduce RehearsalWorld, an editable robot world model driven by 3D Interaction Rehearsal (3DIR). Given an initial RGB-D observation and robot actions, Interaction-Consistent Rehearsal (ICR) uses a pretrained 3D point-flow model as a motion prior. It refines the predicted trajectories through response-aware object grouping, persistent grasp memory, and contact structure refiner, preserving scene stability, object structure, and grasp attachments. Rehearsal-Aligned Video Generation (RAVG) then uses geometric projections of the rehearsal as temporal conditioning. We fine-tune a video generator on projection-video pairs to synthesize realistic interaction videos. Thanks to the decoupling of physical response from visual synthesis, RehearsalWorld also supports independent editing of material properties and camera viewpoints. Compared with PointWorld on real DROID grasping sequences, RehearsalWorld reduces gripper-relative offset by approximately 79% to 84% across deformable, articulated, and rigid objects and lowers reference motion error. For video prediction, it achieves a PSNR of 23.92 dB and an FVD of 149.

AI.tldr: RehearsalWorld：先做3D交互演练（3DIR）再生成视频的可编辑机器人世界模型。以预训练3D点流模型为运动先验，通过ICR（响应感知物体分组、持久抓取记忆、接触结构精修）保证结构与接触一致，再用几何投影作为时序条件微调视频生成器，实现物理响应与视觉合成解耦。
AI.motivation: 显式3D运动预测本身不足以保证物体结构与接触关系（抓取附着、关节/可变形结构）在长时预测中保持稳定；且视频世界模型难以在生成中独立控制物理响应与外观。3D表示可作为施加结构与物理约束的显式状态空间。
AI.method: Interaction-Consistent Rehearsal：以预训练3D点流模型为运动先验，经响应感知物体分组、持久抓取记忆与接触结构refiner 修正轨迹；Rehearsal-Aligned Video Generation：将演练结果几何投影为时序条件，在投影-视频对上微调视频生成器，从而解耦物理响应与视觉合成，并支持材质与视角的独立编辑。
AI.result: 在真实DROID抓取序列上，相较PointWorld，可变形/铰接/刚体目标的夹爪相对偏移降低约79%–84%，参考运动误差下降；视频预测PSNR 23.92 dB、FVD 149。
AI.conclusion: 在3D显式空间做接触与结构约束式演练、再条件化视频生成，是提升具身世界模型物理一致性的有效解耦范式；不足在于评测主要限于抓取序列，缺代码/规模与长时开放场景验证信息。

title: StateWeaver: Multi-Agent Coordination of Story-State Transitions for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Modern video foundation models generate high-quality short clips, but preserving long-video consistency and correctly depicting event-driven state changes remain challenging. Existing agentic workflows face these challenges because continual planning and repair accumulate context, while reference updates remain limited. We introduce StateWeaver, which combines Active States and Hierarchical Collaboration to connect review-driven visual reference updates with cross-shot state inheritance. Active States translate state discrepancies identified during review into concrete visual asset requirements that guide reference construction, validation, and regeneration, preserving identity and already-correct content while repairing target attributes. Confirmed generation results are linked to the corresponding asset states, story time, and reference versions for verification and reuse by subsequent shots. Hierarchical Collaboration isolates execution contexts by task, clip, and repair round, and uses hierarchical memory to organize this process across multiple sets. Across multiple benchmarks, StateWeaver outperforms existing methods and produces long videos with sustained cross-shot consistency under predefined and autonomously planned storyboards.

AI.tldr: StateWeaver：用"主动状态(Active States)"把评审中发现的状态偏差转化为具体视觉资产需求，配合按任务/片段/修复轮次隔离上下文的层级协作与层级记忆，实现跨镜头状态继承的长视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频基础模型只能生成高质量短视频，长视频的跨镜头一致性与事件驱动的状态变化(如物体被移动、破坏、改变属性)难以正确刻画。现有 agentic 流水线因持续规划与修复导致上下文累积膨胀，且参考帧更新机制有限，无法维护随时间演进的状态。
AI.method: 提出 Active States：将 review 阶段检测到的状态差异显式化为视觉资产需求，驱动参考构建、验证与定点重生成，在修复目标属性的同时保留身份与已正确内容；确认后的生成结果与资产状态、故事时间、参考版本绑定，供后续镜头校验与复用。Hierarchical Collaboration 按任务、片段、修复轮次隔离执行上下文，并用层级记忆跨多个镜头/场景集组织流程。
AI.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法，在预定义与自主规划的故事板下均生成具有持续跨镜头一致性的长视频。
AI.conclusion: 将"状态"作为一等公民显式建模并配合上下文隔离与层级记忆，是缓解长视频 agentic 生成上下文膨胀与状态漂移的可行路线；但摘要缺乏定量指标、真实基准细节与开源信息。

title: WebVibe: Multimodal Interactive Website Generation via Reverse Synthesis and Visual Self-Distillation
summary: Although multimodal large language models translate single screenshots into static HTML, generating interactive functional websites from design specifications still struggles with multi-page routing and stateful widget transitions. Examining existing training pipelines reveals two bottlenecks: (1) in forward data synthesis (X -> Y), writing the specification X before code execution leaves unimplemented or altered requirements in X as supervision noise; and (2) in reinforcement learning, scalar rewards discard the rich state transitions observed during replay. Based on these findings, we introduce WebVibe and Interactive-SDPO to train InteractiveCoder. WebVibe reverses synthesis into Y -> X by verifying cross-page and in-page interactions in the browser before deriving multimodal inputs from replay-confirmed states to build the 31,542-site WebVibe-32K corpus with reusable execution contracts. Interactive-SDPO then conditions a weight-sharing self-teacher on the replay trace and a 2x2 state-transition montage to provide token-level supervision at zero inference-time overhead. On the public Vision2Web L2, one-shot InteractiveCoder-9B nearly 3x its base model's functional score (20.2 to 55.2 FS) and matches a 1T-parameter coding agent in a single pass with 111x fewer total parameters and 78x fewer tokens. On our WebVibeBench, InteractiveCoder-4B and 9B further outperform all evaluated baselines by over 23 points.

AI.tldr: WebVibe 将前端代码合成数据管线反转为 Y→X：先在浏览器中验证跨页与页内交互，再由回放确认的状态反向生成多模态输入，构建 31,542 站点语料 WebVibe-32K；并配合 Interactive-SDPO，用回放轨迹与 2×2 状态迁移拼图为权重共享自教师提供 token 级监督，训练 InteractiveCoder。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型已能把单张截图转成静态 HTML，但从设计规范生成"可交互、带多页路由和有状态控件"的网站仍困难。现有训练管线有两个瓶颈：(1) 前向数据合成 X→Y 中，规范 X 先于代码执行写定，未被实现或被改动的需求会成为监督噪声；(2) 强化学习只给标量奖励，丢弃了回放过程中丰富的状态迁移信息。
AI.method: ① WebVibe：将合成方向反转为 Y→X，先在浏览器中验证跨页面路由与页内交互，再从"回放确认（replay-confirmed）"的状态派生多模态输入，并携带可复用的执行契约（execution contracts），得到 WebVibe-32K（31,542 个站点）。② Interactive-SDPO：以回放轨迹 + 2×2 状态迁移拼图条件化一个权重共享的 self-teacher，做自蒸馏式 token 级监督，推理时零开销。
AI.result: 在公开 Vision2Web L2 上，单样本（one-shot）InteractiveCoder-9B 的功能分（FS）从基座 20.2 提升到 55.2，约 3 倍，单次推理即匹敌 1T 参数编码智能体，总参数量少 111×、token 少 78×。自建 WebVibeBench 上，4B 与 9B 版本均超出全部评测基线 23 分以上。
AI.conclusion: 把"规范先行"的数据合成反转为"执行验证后再生成规范"，并把标量奖励替换为基于回放状态迁移的 token 级自蒸馏信号，是提升交互式网站生成的有效路径；小模型可在单次推理下逼近大智能体的功能性表现。

title: BOT-Scale: A Traceable Evaluation Methodology for Robotic Manipulation
summary: A successful manipulation rollout can still involve a mid-task object drop or a placement deviation. Existing evaluators reduce such deviations to a single score or attach explanations computed separately; the score itself explains neither its basis nor what to fix. We show that a manipulation score becomes traceable when defined as the sum of outcome-conditioned penalties over retained behavioral-factor records. Explanation and score share the same computation, so each factor-level deduction names an inspectable deviation. BOT-Scale applies this principle by adapting behavioral assessment scales from medicine. It organizes twelve candidate factors into four assessment layers; each factor is tied to observable evidence and an explicit decision criterion. Reference calibration fixes a penalty per factor, and a closed-form rule aggregates the factor records into a score with per-factor contributions. We developed BOTScorer, an automatic scoring system based on the seven factors retained by data-driven screening, to validate this methodology. We provide BOT-Events, a dataset with eight-rater quality scores and factor-event annotations, alongside the traceable, interpretable score. The code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出BOT-Scale可追溯机器人操作评测框架：将医学行为量表范式迁移到操作评测，12个候选因子组织为4层评估结构，每因子绑定可观测证据与显式判定标准，校准后以闭式规则聚合为带逐因子贡献的可解释分数；并给出BOTScorer自动评分系统与BOT-Events数据集（8人评分+因子事件标注）。
AI.motivation: 现有操作评测把中途掉物、放置偏移等偏差压缩成单一分数，或另算解释，分数本身既不能说明依据也无法指出该修什么；作者希望分数与解释同源可溯。
AI.method: 借鉴医学行为评定量表，构建BOT-Scale：四层评估层×12候选因子，因子对应可观测证据与判定准则；参考校准为每因子设定罚分，闭式聚合规则生成含逐因子贡献的总分；数据驱动筛选保留7个因子实现自动评分器BOTScorer。
AI.result: 给出带8名评分者质量分与因子级事件标注的BOT-Events数据集，以及可追溯、可解释的评分；验证BOTScorer自动化评分与所提方法一致。
AI.conclusion: 将操作评分定义为“保留行为因子记录上的结果条件罚分求和”，可使分数与解释共享同一计算路径，偏离可直接定位到因子级扣分；代码将开源。该工作属评测学而非操作方法，对VLA/操作策略本身无直接方法洞见。

title: Co-World Model for Human-Video-to-Robot Transfer via Co-Constructed Shared Latent Dynamics
summary: Human videos are abundant and cheap to obtain, whereas robot trajectories remain scarce and costly, making zero-shot skill transfer from a single human demonstration an appealing route to scalable robot learning. Existing methods, however, either retarget human-specific geometry or match only static visual goals, and thus stumble over the cross-embodiment dynamics mismatch and the ungrounded action execution. We present the Co-World Model (CoWM), a predictive framework jointly optimized from paired yet unsynchronized human and robot streams. To bridge the cross-embodiment dynamics gap, CoWM disentangles each observation into a shared object-relation state and embodiment-specific context. It aligns latent actions across embodiments using effect-swap and action-sensitivity objectives,such that actions are matched by their predicted effects on the manipulated objects rather than by embodimentdependent kinematics. For grounded execution, a phase-aware receding-horizon controller estimates demonstration progress, projects the inferred human action prior onto the robot action-support density, and translates the resulting latent dynamics into executable robot commands. Extensive experiments in simulation and on two physical robot platforms demonstrate the effectiveness of CoWM, its cross-platform generalizability, and the contribution of each component. See the demo video in the supporting information for details.

AI.tldr: CoWM：从成对但不同步的人-机器人视频中联合优化世界模型，将观测解耦为共享物体关系状态与本体特有上下文，用效果替换与动作敏感性目标对齐跨本体潜动作，并用相位感知滚动时域控制器实现可执行落地，实现单次人类演示的零样本技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 人体视频廉价海量而机器人轨迹稀缺昂贵，单次人类演示的零样本技能迁移是走向可扩展机器人学习的诱人路径。但现有方法要么重定向人类特有几何，要么只匹配静态视觉目标，因而受困于跨本体动力学失配与动作不可落地（ungrounded action execution）两大问题。
AI.method: 核心为预测式Co-World Model：1) 表示解耦——将每个观测分解为共享的物体-关系状态与本体特有上下文，以弥合跨本体动力学差；2) 潜动作对齐——采用effect-swap与action-sensitivity两类目标，使动作按对被动对象的预测效果而非本体相关运动学来匹配；3) 落地执行——相位感知滚动时域控制器估计演示进度，将推断的人类动作先验投影到机器人动作支撑密度上，再把潜动力学翻译为可执行机器人指令。训练使用成对但时间不同步的人-机器人数据流联合优化。
AI.result: 在仿真环境及两个真实机器人平台上进行大量实验，验证了CoWM的有效性、跨平台泛化能力，并通过消融说明各组件（解耦表示、效果对齐目标、相位感知控制器）的贡献；论文附带演示视频。
AI.conclusion: 通过"效果对齐"替代"运动学对齐"、并把潜动作投影到机器人动作支撑密度上执行，CoWM为单次人类演示到机器人的零样本技能迁移提供了可行范式，说明世界模型可作为跨本体动作抽象的桥梁。

title: PostMesh: Self-Rewarded Preference Post-Training for Flow-Based Artist Mesh Generation
summary: Artistic mesh generators turn a dense 3D object into an artist mesh: a compact, quad-dominant mesh that is easy to edit. Most of current models are auto-regressive methods which decode a mesh token by token, take tens to hundreds of seconds per mesh. Diffusion- and flow-based generators are much faster, but their meshes still fall short of artist quality. To our knowledge, PostMesh is the first post-training method for a diffusion- or flow-based artist mesh generator, and it needs no expensive artist-made ground truth: the generator is trained on its own samples, scored by a reward computed from the dense input and the output. We propose an artistic mesh reward that keeps the output consistent with the dense input while making the mesh structure into artistic. We also propose a multi-negative flow preference optimisation that transfers the reward to the generator. After a short LoRA post-training, PostMesh is comparable to or better than slow autoregressive generators on most artist-mesh quality metrics and in a blind VLM preference test, at a fraction of their time.

AI.tldr: PostMesh 是首个面向扩散/流式"艺术家网格"生成器的后训练方法：以稠密输入+输出构造艺术网格奖励，用多负样本流偏好优化把奖励回传，无需人工 GT，短时 LoRA 后训练即可在多数质量指标与 VLM 盲测上比肩/超越慢速自回归生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有艺术家网格（紧凑、四边主导、易编辑）生成多依赖逐 token 自回归解码，单网格需数十至数百秒；扩散/流式方法虽快，但网格质量达不到艺术家水准，且缺少廉价可用的质量信号（人工艺术家 GT 昂贵）。
AI.method: 提出 PostMesh 后训练框架，直接在生成器自身采样上训练，奖励由稠密输入与输出共同计算：保持与稠密输入的一致性，同时将网格结构推向艺术化（紧凑、四边主导等）。将奖励通过"多负样本流偏好优化"（multi-negative flow preference optimisation）迁移到生成器，仅需短时间 LoRA 后训练。
AI.result: 在多数艺术家网格质量指标以及 VLM 盲测偏好对比中，PostMesh 与慢速自回归生成器相当或更优，而推理时间仅为后者的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 表明基于自采样奖励的偏好后训练可在无需专家标注的前提下显著提升快速扩散/流式网格生成器的艺术质量，为高质量、实时的三维资产生成提供了可行路径。

title: LUDIUS: A Benchmark for Embodied Social Intelligence in Everyday Human-Robot Interactions
summary: Social intelligence in a robot requires interpreting a situation from the perspectives of the people involved and using that understanding to decide when and how to act. We introduce LUDIUS, a benchmark for evaluating how vision-language models exercise this judgment through a robot's verbal responses and actions, organized around 15 social intelligence skills drawn from social psychology, sociology, and cognitive science. LUDIUS comprises six editions, each a collection of episodes spanning one simulated week. Three editions each cover all 15 skills in a different household. The other three focus on interactions involving multiple people, safety, and context-specific norms, respectively. We evaluate frontier models and a smaller model finetuned on social-interaction data we generated, using a common evaluation harness. The harness supplies each model with the robot's camera views and residents' reactions, retrieves relevant interaction history, and converts the model's tool calls into robot verbal responses and actions. Models tend to perform worse when they must reason about what a resident saw or heard earlier, reconcile competing interests, or fulfill a request within safety constraints and household rules. Beyond the home setting, LUDIUS's design pipeline offers a way to construct social intelligence benchmarks by translating social intelligence skills into context-specific judgments and observable robot behavior.

AI.tldr: LUDIUS：基于社会心理学/社会学/认知科学的15项社会智能技能，构建家庭机器人视角下的VLM判断力评测基准（6个版本、每版覆盖模拟一周的episode），并配套统一评测框架把模型工具调用转为机器人语言回应与动作。
AI.motivation: 机器人社会智能要求在多人情境、他人知识与利益冲突、安全与家规约束下判断"何时如何行动"，而现有VLM评测缺乏对此类判断的体系化测量。
AI.method: 将15项社会智能技能翻译为情境特定判断与可观测机器人行为；6个edition中3个在不同家庭覆盖全部技能，另3个分别聚焦多人交互、安全、情境规范。统一harness提供相机视角与住户反应、检索交互历史、将工具调用映射为语言回应与动作；评测前沿模型及在其自生成社交数据上微调的小模型。
AI.result: 模型在需推断住户此前所见所闻（视角/知识归因）、调和多方利益冲突、以及在安全约束与家规下完成请求时表现明显下降。
AI.conclusion: LUDIUS提供可复用的社会智能基准构建流程（技能→情境判断→可观测行为），可推广到家庭以外场景；本质为基准/评测工作，未提供机器人策略方法层面的新洞察。

title: SPARC: Semantic Calibration with Latent Multimodal Knowledge for Robust Image-Text Retrieval
summary: Robust image-text retrieval aims to maintain accurate cross-modal matching when image or text queries are incomplete, supporting reliable information access in real-world applications. However, existing methods typically focus on adapting to distribution shifts, without adequately addressing candidate discrimination for incomplete queries and ranking instability. To this end, we propose semantic projection and alignment with relational constraints (SPARC), which elicits latent multimodal knowledge from frozen encoders to improve candidate discrimination and ranking stability. Specifically, we first devise a semantic calibration module on a product of spheres that refines incomplete visual and textual features through tangent-space updates, maintaining the unit-sphere structure used for cosine similarity. Second, we introduce a robust semantic guidance module that combines latent multimodal knowledge encoded in complete image-text features with cross-modal semantic anchors to promote semantic alignment of the calibrated features. Finally, we introduce a matching relation constraint module that fuses original query features with their calibrated counterparts and applies a soft ranking constraint to penalize reductions in initially positive matching margins, thereby limiting ranking perturbations. Extensive experiments on Flickr30K and COCO demonstrate that SPARC outperforms competing methods under various image occlusion and word deletion settings, while achieving consistent gains across different pretrained backbones.

AI.tldr: SPARC：在冻结编码器输出的球面特征上做切空间语义校准、潜多模态知识引导对齐与软排序约束，提升不完整图文查询下的检索判别力与排序稳定性。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒图文检索需在查询缺失（图像遮挡、词删除）时保持匹配精度，但现有方法主要应对分布偏移，未充分解决不完整查询下的候选判别力不足与排序不稳定问题。
AI.method: 基于冻结编码器：1）球面乘积上的语义校准模块，用切空间更新精炼不完整视觉/文本特征并保持单位球结构以兼容余弦相似度；2）鲁棒语义引导模块，将完整图文特征中的潜多模态知识与跨模态语义锚点结合，促进校准特征对齐；3）匹配关系约束模块，融合原始与校准特征并施加软排序约束，惩罚初始正匹配间隔的缩减以抑制排序扰动。
AI.result: Flickr30K 与 COCO 上，在多种图像遮挡与词删除设置下优于对比方法，且在不同预训练骨干上均取得一致性增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过切空间校准+潜知识引导+排序约束的组合，可在不微调编码器的情况下显著提升不完整查询的检索鲁棒性，且方法具骨干无关的可迁移性；局限在于未涉及真实具身或机器人场景验证。

title: AIRIS: Benchmarking Social Embodied Intelligence in Egocentric Streaming Videos
summary: Embodied agents operating around people must not only recognize social cues, but also decide when the available evidence is sufficient, whether to intervene, and how to respond without violating social norms. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these abilities in isolation or with access to completed videos, obscuring where an online social decision fails. We introduce AIRIS, a causal streaming benchmark that formulates social embodied intelligence as a time-anchored chain of Attention, Intention, Reaction, and Interaction (A-I-R-I). AIRIS contains 8,000 expert-curated questions grounded in 357 egocentric clips across 11 context categories and 36 capability dimensions. At each query, models receive only the observation prefix available at that time; decision-aware metrics reward calibrated waiting and complete reactions while penalizing premature commitment. Evaluating 45 proprietary and open-source general-purpose, embodied, streaming-video, and omni-modal models reveals fragmented and temporally miscalibrated competence. General-purpose VLMs excel at passive cue grounding and intent recognition, whereas embodied specialists lead on isolated reaction sub-decisions; yet across all families, models frequently guess intents before sufficient evidence emerges and fail to jointly align intervention timing, action domain, and concrete execution within the same episode. AIRIS thus provides a diagnostic foundation for bridging the gap between passive social perception and reliable embodied interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出 AIRIS 因果流式基准，将社交具身智能建模为时间锚定的 Attention-Intention-Reaction-Interaction 链，基于 357 段第一视角视频构建 8,000 道专家问题，仅在查询时刻可用的观测前缀上评测，并用决策感知指标奖励校准等待、惩罚过早表态。
AI.motivation: 现有基准将社交线索识别、是否需要干预、如何回应等能力割裂评估，或依赖完整视频（离线）输入，掩盖了在线社交决策何时失败的环节，缺乏对"证据是否充分"这一时机构建决策能力的诊断。
AI.method: 构建 AIRIS 因果流式基准：(1) 将社交具身智能分解为时间锚定的 A-I-R-I 四阶段链；(2) 357 段第一视角片段、11 类情境、36 个能力维度，8,000 道专家标注问题；(3) 每次查询仅提供该时刻可获得的观测前缀，禁止未来信息；(4) 设计决策感知指标，评估等待时机的校准度与反应完整性，惩罚过早承诺。
AI.result: 评测 45 个专有与开源模型（通用、具身、流式视频、全模态）。通用 VLM 在被动线索定位与意图识别上更强，具身专用模型在孤立反应子决策上领先；但所有模型族普遍在证据充分前猜测意图，且无法在同一次交互中同时对齐干预时机、动作域与具体执行。
AI.conclusion: AIRIS 揭示了当前模型在社交具身决策上能力碎片化、时间校准差的问题，为从被动社交感知走向可靠具身交互提供诊断基础。

title: Beyond Natural-Language Instructions: Temporal Logic as a Task Language for VLA Models with Visual-Logical Fusion
summary: Robotic tasks combine object relations, logical dependencies, and temporal requirements, which robot planning and industrial control commonly specify in temporal logic (TL). We introduce TL-VLA, a vision--language--action framework that replaces natural-language task instructions with temporal logic, making this spatiotemporal structure explicit. A typed graph encoder and visual--logical fusion condition continuous actions on the task specification and the current observations. To prepare a general vision--language backbone for this interface, we develop TL-aware robot pretraining with separate semantic and structural readouts: a frozen language teacher aligns task semantics, the structural readout encodes TL syntax to support complex, long-horizon tasks, and autoregressive action prediction connects the graph representation to robot behavior. Downstream policies inherit the pretrained backbone and TL encoder and learn new fusion and action modules. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, our TL-aware initializer reaches \textbf{3.800} average chain length and \textbf{62.3\%} five-task success, compared with 3.578 and 54.5\% for a FAST initializer pretrained on the same data and 3.485 average chain length for a Qwen+NL baseline. On LIBERO-10, TL-aware initialization improves success from \textbf{91.2\% to 95.8\%}. On LIBERO-Mem, our policy reaches \textbf{65.0\%} success without observation history, compared with 45.0\% for a Qwen+NL reference. On held-out Panda planning specifications, it reaches \textbf{59.6\%} at Success@256 over three generation seeds, versus 48.4\% for Qwen+TL and 37.0\% for Qwen+NL. These results support explicit logical task conditioning and transferable TL-aware representations for robot action learning.

AI.tldr: TL-VLA用时间逻辑(TL)替代自然语言作为VLA任务指令，显式表达时空结构；通过类型化图编码器与视觉-逻辑融合条件化连续动作，并设计了语义/结构双读出的TL感知预训练。CALVIN ABC→D平均链长3.800、五任务成功率62.3%；LIBERO-10从91.2%提升至95.8%；LIBERO-Mem无历史观测下65.0%；Panda规划规格Success@256达59.6%。
AI.motivation: 机器人任务天然耦合物体关系、逻辑依赖与时间约束，而主流VLA以自然语言指令驱动，语义歧义且不显式携带时序逻辑结构，难以支撑复杂长时程任务。作者希望把工业/机器人规划中常用的时间逻辑作为任务接口，使任务规范可组合、可验证，并让策略显式条件化于逻辑结构。
AI.method: 提出TL-VLA框架：以时间逻辑公式替代NL指令，用类型化图编码器将TL语法结构（原子命题、时序算子、子公式依赖）编码为图表示；视觉-逻辑融合模块将图表示与当前观测对齐并条件化扩散/连续动作解码器。预训练阶段采用语义与结构分离的双读出：冻结语言教师对齐任务语义，结构读出学习TL语法，自回归动作预测把图表示连接到机器人行为。下游策略继承预训练骨干与TL编码器，仅重训融合与动作模块。
AI.result: CALVIN ABC→D：3.800平均链长、62.3%五任务成功（同数据FAST初始化3.578/54.5%；Qwen+NL基线3.485）；LIBERO-10：91.2%→95.8%；LIBERO-Mem：无观测历史65.0%（Qwen+NL 45.0%）；留出Panda规划规格Success@256为59.6%（Qwen+TL 48.4%，Qwen+NL 37.0%），三随机种子。
AI.conclusion: 显式逻辑任务条件化优于自然语言指令，且TL感知的结构化表征可迁移至未见规划规格；该工作为可组合、可验证的机器人任务接口提供了可行路径，但主要在仿真基准验证，缺乏真实机器人部署与开放世界泛化评估。

title: One Patch, Many Policies: Object-Associated Physical Patch Attacks on Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Models (WAMs) are vulnerable to adversarial visual interference, motivating the study of universal and transferable physical patch attacks. We propose Object-Associated Patch Attack (OAPA), a universal and transferable physical patch framework that enables an attacker to select which task object's manipulation to disrupt through patch placement, without re-optimizing the patch. Our framework combines object-associated placement, differentiable physical compositing, and final action-expert representation divergence. Physical compositing accounts for perspective and occlusion across camera views, while representation divergence guides patch optimization using either relative RMS or cosine distance. Experimental results demonstrate strong attack transferability across task suites and policies, together with the ability to selectively disrupt manipulation of an attacker-chosen task object through patch placement.

AI.tldr: 提出OAPA：一种通用、可迁移的物理补丁攻击框架，通过补丁放置位置选择要干扰的任务物体，无需重新优化补丁；结合物体关联放置、可微物理合成（透视与遮挡）与动作专家表征发散损失。
AI.motivation: VLA与WAM模型对对抗性视觉干扰脆弱，现有物理补丁攻击缺乏通用性与可迁移性，且无法由攻击者指定被干扰的目标物体。
AI.method: 物体关联放置策略 + 可微物理合成（跨相机视角建模透视与遮挡）+ 最终动作专家表征发散损失（相对RMS或余弦距离）引导补丁优化。
AI.result: 在多个任务套件与策略上展现较强的攻击迁移性，并能仅通过补丁位置选择性地破坏攻击者指定物体的操作。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了VLA/WAM在物理世界中的对抗脆弱性，选择性攻击能力提示需关注部署安全性与鲁棒性防御。

title: MoCA4D: Monocular 3D Bounding Box Lifting and Tracking with Camera and Object Motion
summary: Monocular 3D bounding box tracking must account for both object motion and changes in camera viewpoint. Framewise box lifting with temporal filtering leaves these motion components implicit, while static-scene fusion assumes stationary objects. We introduce MoCA4D, a framework for 3D box lifting and tracking from monocular video, associated 2D box prompts, and camera intrinsics. An observation branch estimates per-frame geometry, while a dynamic branch predicts a camera transformation shared across objects and a separate rigid transformation for each object. We propose Star Optimization to refine current depth and orientation using the observation and historical boxes propagated through these transformations. The refined box then guides subsequent propagation. Across all evaluated objects in Argoverse 2 and ADT, Star Optimization reduces center motion error by 38.1% and 38.7%, respectively, relative to Kalman filtering of the same observations. On MOVi-F, the dynamic branch achieves the lowest corner and rotation errors and the highest IoU among the evaluated methods over eight-transition motion windows. Real-data camera-only controls further link predicted object motion to improved localization on dynamic-object tracks.

AI.tldr: MoCA4D: 单目视频 3D 框提升与跟踪框架。观测分支估计单帧几何，动态分支解耦估计共享相机变换与逐目标刚体变换；提出 Star Optimization，用观测框与经变换传播的历史框迭代精修深度与朝向，精修结果反过来指导后续传播。
AI.motivation: 逐帧框提升+时序滤波把物体运动与相机视角变化混为隐性残差，而静态场景融合假设物体静止，两者都无法显式建模两类运动分量。
AI.method: 统一框架：per-frame observation branch（几何估计）+ dynamic branch（全局相机变换 + 每物体刚体变换）；Star Optimization 结合观测与历史框进行当前深度/朝向精修并与传播交替迭代。
AI.result: Argoverse 2 / ADT 上相对 Kalman 滤波降低中心运动误差 38.1%/38.7%；MOVi-F 八段转移窗口下取得最低角点误差与旋转误差、最高 IoU；真实数据 camera-only 对照显示预测物体运动与动态轨迹定位提升相关。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦相机运动与物体运动的传播-精修交替机制是单目 3D 跟踪的有效范式，优于隐式滤波。

title: Plausible Is Not Proven: Testing Failure Explanations in Monocular Depth Estimation
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Code, ratings and results: this https URL
summary: Failure analyses of monocular depth models often name a cause for each error, such as an occluding boundary, a thin object or a reflective surface, but such labels are rarely tested. We present the Vision Error Observatory (VEO), an audit that finds regions failing the $\delta_1$ criterion on sensor-measured pixels, labels each with a likely cause or abstains, and then subjects the labels to four tests: agreement with object annotations on data the label model never saw, agreement with blinded human raters, response to targeted image edits, and value as a training signal. We apply it to eight models on NYU Depth V2, DIODE and iBims-1, with labels also checked on Hypersim, and fix most decision rules before their results. The occluding-boundary label agrees with annotations (AUROC 0.85 on NYU, 0.81 on Hypersim, 0.69 on iBims-1), but a single depth-edge cue does as well, and most boundary failures of the strongest model vanish under a 2-pixel tolerance. The reflection label does not transfer to synthetic data, the textureless label is near chance against annotations, and only one of four edit tests, an exploratory one, supports its label. Evaluated against five blinded raters, VEO's labels matched the human consensus only at chance level (Cohen's $\kappa$ = 0.05). In addition, an increase in the weight on the diagnosed regions during fine-tuning led to an increase in the error on targeted pixels at every weight tested. The architecture-specific failure fingerprint claimed by an earlier version of this project also failed to replicate across the datasets. Plausible failure explanations, in short, need to be tested before they are trusted; we release the protocol, code, ratings and every result file.

AI.tldr: 提出 VEO 审计协议：在传感器测得像素上定位单目深度失败区域，给出可能成因标签，并用四种检验（与未见数据的标注一致性、盲评人类一致性、定向图像编辑响应、作为训练信号的价值）验证标签有效性；对 8 个模型在 NYU/DIODE/iBims-1 上检验，发现多数成因标签不成立。
AI.motivation: 单目深度模型失败分析普遍为每个错误指定成因（遮挡边界、细长物体、反射面等），但这些标签几乎从未被实证检验，存在"看似合理即被信任"的问题。
AI.method: 构建 Vision Error Observatory 审计流程：以 δ1 准则在实测像素上标记失败区域，由标签模型赋予成因或弃权；决策规则先行固定，再用四项测试评估：(1) 在标签模型未见数据上与物体标注的一致性；(2) 盲评人类标注者一致性；(3) 针对性图像编辑的响应；(4) 作为微调加权训练信号的效果。覆盖 8 个模型、NYU Depth V2/DIODE/iBims-1，标签另在 Hypersim 上复核。
AI.result: 遮挡边界标签与标注一致性较好（NYU AUROC 0.85、Hypersim 0.81、iBims-1 0.69），但单一深度边缘线索即可达到同等水平，且最强模型多数边界失败在 2 像素容差下消失；反射标签不能迁移到合成数据；无纹理标签与标注接近随机；四项编辑检验中仅一项探索性检验支持其标签；与五位盲评者的一致率仅为随机水平（Cohen's κ = 0.05）；按诊断区域加权微调在所有测试权重下均使目标像素误差上升；此前声称的架构特定失败指纹无法跨数据集复现。
AI.conclusion: 直观的失败成因解释在未经检验前不应被采信；本文开源协议、代码、评分与全部结果文件，为深度模型误差归因提供了可复现的审计范式。

title: Strong Starts, Simple Recipes: Unified Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation from Multimodal Specialists
comment: Project page, code, and model weights: this https URL
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates separately trained domain specialists into a single unified model. Existing methods focus on refining the distillation procedure while initializing the student from a base model or a multi-domain SFT checkpoint, which leaves capability integration largely to distillation itself. Instead, we treat the starting point as a design variable and propose Unified MOPD (Uni-MOPD), which pairs a strong start with a simple recipe: a training-free uniform merge of specialists from the same base model initializes the student, and short MOPD with uniform domain sampling and full-vocabulary reverse KL refines it. Across five multimodal domains and 19 benchmarks, our study establishes three findings. (1) The starting point matters more than subsequent training choices: before any training, the uniform merge already matches the score that the base model reaches after 200 MOPD updates, and after short distillation it matches higher-scoring, search-based starts. (2) Short MOPD recovers most of the capabilities the merge leaves unintegrated; it improves every domain, with the largest gains where the domain teacher still leads. (3) From a strong start, uniform domain sampling and full-vocabulary reverse KL match or exceed every evaluated sampling strategy and divergence, without schedules, per-token weighting, or truncation hyperparameters. Uni-MOPD outperforms Open-MOPD at the same training budget while training 3.3 times faster than its released code. We will release the training framework, specialist checkpoints, and unified student.

AI.tldr: Uni-MOPD 将多教师蒸馏的"起点"视为设计变量：用同一基座模型的专家权重做免训练均匀合并来初始化学生，再用短程 MOPD（均匀域采样 + 全词表 reverse KL）微调，在五个多模态域、19 个基准上取得更好且 3.3 倍更快的训练。
AI.motivation: 现有多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（MOPD）只在蒸馏流程上做改进，学生一律从 base 模型或多域 SFT checkpoint 初始化，把能力整合完全交给蒸馏本身；作者希望显式优化"初始学生"这一未被利用的自由度。
AI.method: 提出 Uni-MOPD：1）训练-free 的权重均匀合并（uniform merge）将来自同一 base 模型的领域专家合成为学生初始化；2）在此起点上做短程 MOPD，采用均匀域采样与全词表 reverse KL 作为目标，不使用调度、per-token 加权或截断超参。
AI.result: 三个发现：(1) 起点比后续训练选择更重要——未训练前均匀合并已达基线模型 200 步 MOPD 后的分数，短程蒸馏后追平更强的基于搜索的起点；(2) 短程 MOPD 补回合并未整合的能力，提升全部域，且在领域教师仍领先处增益最大；(3) 强起点下均匀域采样 + 全词表 reverse KL 匹配或超过所有已评估的采样策略与散度。同预算下优于 Open-MOPD，训练速度为其官方代码的 3.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 模型合并可作为多教师蒸馏的高质量初始学生，使蒸馏配方趋于极简化；作者将开源训练框架、专家 checkpoint 与统一学生模型。

title: Recoverability policy editing for closed-loop safety in autonomous driving
summary: Autonomous driving powered by neural network models lacks safety guarantees. We propose a state-level policy editing technique that guarantees closed-loop safety under recoverable disturbances while reusing the model's existing driving capabilities. Closed-loop safety means that the vehicle remains free of collisions at all future times. We introduce the concept of policy recoverability to characterize whether a vehicle can safely return to the original policy's feasible set in finite time. Our method identifies states that are unsafe in the long term under the original policy but recoverable, and selectively edits policy outputs within this region. The vehicle corrects its actions upon entering this region and resumes the original policy upon recovery. Closed-loop simulations on nuPlan urban driving scenarios show a 48% reduction in safety incidents under the original policy while largely preserving its driving performance.

AI.tldr: 提出“策略可恢复性”概念与状态级策略编辑方法：识别原策略下长期不安全但可恢复的状态区域，进入时修正动作、恢复后切回原策略，从而在可恢复扰动下保证闭环无碰撞。
AI.motivation: 神经网络自动驾驶模型缺乏安全保证，现有方法要么重训、要么保守减速，难以在保性能前提下提供闭环安全约束。
AI.method: 形式化定义闭环安全（未来所有时刻无碰撞）与策略可恢复性（有限时间内可安全回到原策略可行集）；基于该准则划分出“不可逆不安全”与“可恢复不安全”状态，仅在可恢复不安全区域内对模型输出做选择性编辑（动作修正），离开该区域后交还原策略。属运行时安全滤波/可恢复集构造式的策略修补。
AI.result: nuPlan 城市驾驶闭环仿真中安全事件减少48%，驾驶性能基本保持。
AI.conclusion: 以“可恢复性”为界的安全编辑能在复用现有驾驶能力的同时提供闭环安全保证，是策略修补与安全滤波方向可借鉴的范式；局限在于保证依赖扰动可恢复假设，且仅在仿真验证。

title: Embodied Lower-limb Exoskeleton Assistance: Survey, Challenges, and Perspectives
summary: Over the past decade, artificial intelligence (AI) has enabled lower-limb exoskeletons to adapt to complex tasks and assist diverse users. Existing reviews, however, are organized around mechanical design, control strategies, or individual AI algorithms, and provide little systematic coverage of embodied lower-limb exoskeletons and their enabling technologies. This review defines embodied lower-limb exoskeletons and organizes the literature around four dimensions: structural self-adaptation, task adaptation, user-specific adaptation, and control self-regulation. In each dimension, state-of-the-art and representative studies are classified and discussed in terms of the associated challenges, including lightweight and compliant design, data acquisition and fusion, optimization of complex policies, and robust, compliant control. The review then identifies the principal limitations of current research and outlines future directions along these dimensions. From an embodied perspective, this review sets out the closed-loop relationship among mechanical structure, sensing, and control as a framework for analyzing lower-limb exoskeleton performance and for research on human-robot interaction. The directions it identifies point toward lightweight, comfortable, and practical physical assistance.

AI.tldr: 综述具身下肢外骨骼，按结构自适应、任务自适应、用户自适应、控制自调节四个维度组织文献。
AI.motivation: 现有综述按机械设计、控制策略或单一AI算法组织，缺乏对具身下肢外骨骼及其使能技术的系统梳理。
AI.method: 文献综述：从四个维度分类讨论代表性研究，并围绕轻量化柔顺设计、数据采集与融合、复杂策略优化、鲁棒柔顺控制等挑战展开；提出机械结构—感知—控制闭环框架。
AI.result: 给出各维度代表性方法分类、关键挑战总结，并识别当前研究的主要局限。
AI.conclusion: 从具身视角建立机械结构、感知与控制的闭环分析框架，指明轻量、舒适、实用的物理辅助方向。

title: SemProxy: Semantic 3D Proxies for Controllable Agentic 3D Modeling
summary: Coding agents are increasingly capable of generating 3D models, yet enabling users to effectively control the modeling process remains challenging. Existing workflows rely primarily on text prompts and reference images, which often struggle to convey precise spatial intentions and require iterative corrections. We introduce SemProxy, a lightweight intermediate representation that bridges intuitive human interaction and agentic 3D modeling. Instantiated as labeled 3D bounding boxes, semantic 3D proxies allow users to directly specify object parts and spatial arrangements while leaving geometric details to coding agents. These proxies can be serialized into structured text and rendered as images, making them directly accessible to existing coding agents without additional training or modifications. We further develop ProxyStudio, a user interface that integrates text, image references, and interactive 3D proxy editing into agentic modeling workflows. We demonstrate the versatility of SemProxy across object- and scene-level modeling tasks with different coding agents, and evaluate its effectiveness in supporting controllable human-agent collaborative 3D modeling through a user study.

AI.tldr: SemProxy：以带标签的3D边界框作为轻量中间表示（语义3D代理），让用户直接指定部件与空间布局，几何细节交由编码智能体生成；代理可序列化为结构化文本或渲染为图像，无需训练即可接入现有编码智能体。配套ProxyStudio界面整合文本、参考图与交互式代理编辑，并在对象级与场景级任务及用户研究中验证可控人机协同3D建模。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体驱动的3D建模主要依赖文本提示与参考图像，难以表达精确空间意图，导致频繁迭代修正，人机交互可控性不足。
AI.method: 提出SemProxy中间表示：实例化为带标签的3D包围盒语义代理，用户指定对象部件与空间排布；代理可序列化为结构化文本并行渲染为图像，直接作为编码智能体的输入（无需额外训练或模型修改）。构建ProxyStudio交互界面，融合文本、图像参考与3D代理编辑，形成智能体建模工作流。
AI.result: 在多个编码智能体上覆盖对象级与场景级建模任务展示了SemProxy的通用性；用户研究评估了其在支持可控人机协同3D建模方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以可序列化的语义3D代理作为人在回路中的稀疏空间约束，是衔接直观交互与智能体3D生成的有效轻量方案，可提升空间意图表达精度并减少迭代成本。

title: CHASE: Curiosity-Guided Skill Acquisition for Embodied Task Execution
summary: Robots executing tasks in partially observed environments must resolve uncertainty while operating with incomplete skills. Inspired by human curiosity, we investigate how robots can formulate task-relevant hypotheses, seek evidence, and acquire missing skills during task execution. We propose CHASE, a Curiosity-guided Harness for Acquiring Skills from Evidence, which operationalizes curiosity as selecting investigations that resolve task uncertainty and expand executable capabilities. Four modules connect dynamic scene understanding, hypothesis-driven planning, on-demand skill acquisition, and verified execution. The planner balances information value, skill reuse, and acquisition/execution cost. Missing skills trigger bounded exploration, learning from verified segments, and held-out admission during acquisition; separate checks verify physical effects and acquired evidence. Newly admitted skills expand the executable investigation set, closing the loop between resolving uncertainty and acquiring capabilities. Simulation and real-robot experiments evaluate investigation, skill acquisition, and task execution. CHASE achieves 50-80% task success under combined information and capability gaps, with 70-90% evidence resolution.

AI.tldr: CHASE将好奇心操作化为"选择能消解任务不确定性并扩展可执行能力的研究行为"，用四模块闭环（场景理解、假设驱动规划、按需技能获取、验证执行）在部分可观测环境下同时解决信息缺口与能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 机器人常在部分可观测且技能不全的条件下执行任务，现有方法要么只做主动感知/信息获取，要么只做技能学习，未将"消解不确定性"与"补齐技能"统一在同一个任务执行闭环中。
AI.method: CHASE框架含四模块：动态场景理解；假设驱动规划器（权衡信息价值、技能复用与获取/执行代价）；按需技能获取（缺失技能触发有界探索、从验证成功的片段学习、获取期采用留出验证准入）；双重校验执行（分别核实物理效果与所获证据）。新准入技能扩充可执行调查集合，形成闭环。
AI.result: 在信息缺口与能力缺口并存的设定下，任务成功率达50–80%，证据消解率达70–90%，并在仿真与真机实验中评估了调查行为、技能获取与任务执行。
AI.conclusion: 把好奇心定义为"任务相关的信息获取+能力扩展"可有效指导机器人决策；验证门控的学习准入与闭环技能扩充是提升部分可观测任务鲁棒性的关键。

title: SPGSR: A Small Pixel-Space Generator for One-Step Super-Resolution
summary: In one-step super-resolution (SR), vision-only models extract semantic cues directly from the low-resolution (LR) image, keeping those cues spatially aligned with the structures they help restore. Recent models achieve high restoration quality with generators of up to 1.4 billion parameters. Given how much structure the LR image already provides, could a much smaller generator achieve comparable quality? We introduce SPGSR, a vision-only framework that adds a learned RGB correction to the LR image. A frozen DINOv2 guides prediction, and a lightweight block refines the correction locally. SPGSR achieves higher PSNR/SSIM and lower LPIPS/DISTS than VOSR, a leading vision-only SR method, across three benchmarks. Its $31.8\mathrm{M}$-parameter generator is just $6.5\%$ the size of VOSR-0.5B's. SPGSR also achieves competitive quality against T2I-based SR methods. SPGSR's generator uses only $0.60\%$ of the HR pixels used to train and distill VOSR's generator. For $512\times512$ outputs, SPGSR achieves $2.80\times$ and $3.35\times$ GPU-pipeline speedups over VOSR-0.5B and VOSR-1.4B, respectively.

AI.tldr: SPGSR：仅视觉的单步超分框架，在LR图上预测学习到的RGB残差（correction），用冻结DINOv2提供引导、轻量模块局部精修，仅31.8M参数（VOSR-0.5B的6.5%）即在三个benchmark上超越VOSR，512²输出取得2.8–3.35× GPU流水线加速。
AI.motivation: 现有单步超分中视觉专用模型直接从LR图提取语义线索，但生成器规模膨胀至1.4B参数；作者质疑：既然LR图已提供大量结构信息，是否可用远小得多的生成器达到同等质量。
AI.method: SPGSR：以LR图为基座，网络仅预测加性RGB correction；冻结的DINOv2特征作为引导，一个轻量block在局部范围内精修该correction；训练数据/蒸馏成本极低（仅用VOSR训练所需HR像素的0.60%）。
AI.result: 三个基准上PSNR/SSIM更高、LPIPS/DISTS更低，优于视觉专用SOTA VOSR；与T2I-based超分方法质量相当；生成器31.8M（VOSR-0.5B的6.5%）；512×512输出相对VOSR-0.5B/1.4B分别有2.80×/3.35× GPU流水线加速。
AI.conclusion: 将超分重构为"LR+小幅残差修正"的范式可大幅压缩生成器容量与训练开销，同时保持甚至提升保真度与感知质量，说明基座特征引导+轻量局部精修是高性价比的视觉SR路线。

title: DocSEAM: Bidirectional Cross-Page Encoding for Multi-Page Document Understanding
summary: Multi-page document vision-language models encode each page independently, creating a feature-level discontinuity at page boundaries: visual tokens are formed without access to content on adjacent pages, and the language model must reason over these page representations formed in isolation. We introduce DocSEAM (Document Selective Enrichment via Anchored Masking), a lightweight module inserted between a pretrained vision encoder and the language model that injects the inductive bias of local cross-page context into visual representations. For each page, DocSEAM forms a local triplet with its two neighbors, applies center-anchored masked self-attention with directional salience gates to fuse information from neighbor pages, and returns only the enriched center-page tokens, leaving the visual token count unchanged. After a supervised cross-page warm-up and multi-page fine-tuning with DocSEAM frozen, our 9B-parameter model achieves state-of-the-art results among the evaluated open-weight models of up to 10B parameters on five multi-page document VQA benchmarks. We further show that under controlled re-pagination, DocSEAM reduces sensitivity to boundary placement and improves cross-page span localization

AI.tldr: DocSEAM 是插入视觉编码器与 LLM 之间的轻量模块，通过对相邻三页做中心锚定的掩码自注意力与方向显著性门控，将跨页局部上下文注入中心页视觉 token，token 数不变；9B 模型在五个多页文档 VQA 基准上取得 ≤10B 开源模型 SOTA，并降低对分页边界的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有多页文档 VLM 逐页独立编码，页边界处视觉 token 缺乏邻页信息，形成特征层面的不连续，迫使语言模型在不完整页表示上推理。
AI.method: 构建每页与其前后邻页的局部三元组；采用 center-anchored masked self-attention 配合 directional salience gates 融合邻页信息；仅输出增强后的中心页 token，保持视觉 token 数量不变。训练流程为跨页监督预热 + 冻结 DocSEAM 的多页微调；并通过受控重排版实验检验边界鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在五个多页文档 VQA 基准上，9B 参数模型于 ≤10B 开源模型中取得 SOTA；重排版实验显示对页边界位置敏感性下降，跨页片段定位能力提升。
AI.conclusion: 以极轻量的邻页融合模块即可消除页级独立编码带来的特征断裂，为多页文档理解提供可插拔、token 预算不变的方案，但结论限于文档 VQA，与 Physical AI/机器人/3D 方向无直接关联。

title: Can Visual World Models See Force?
summary: World models and vision-language-action policy models are increasingly proposed as foundations for robot manipulation. They predict how scenes evolve and which actions to take, yet successful manipulation depends not solely on following observable trajectories but also on the hidden variable of interaction force. Neurophysiology has shown that humans possess a visual prior for this hidden variable, motivating us to ask the question: Do the representations of visual foundation models also capture the forces involved in an interaction? We define force awareness as the ability of representations to (1) indicate when contact force is applied, (2) track how it changes during an interaction, and (3) reflect how large it is. We probe frozen image, video, world- and policy model representations with a lightweight readout trained on synchronized video and force measurements from two manipulation datasets. Our experiments show that most models capture when contact occurs but not how much force is being applied. Surprisingly, robot post-training does not improve this either, highlighting an important gap in current models capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文定义"力感知"（何时接触、力如何变化、力有多大），用轻量readout探针冻结的图像/视频/world model/VLA策略模型表征，发现多数模型只能判断接触发生，却无法表征力的大小，且机器人后训练也无法改善。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型被用作机器人操作的基础，但其表征是否隐含交互力这一不可见变量尚不清楚；神经生理学表明人类具有对力的视觉先验，因此有必要检验模型表征的力感知能力。
AI.method: 在两个操作数据集的同步视频-力测量数据上训练轻量线性/轻量readout探针，对冻结的图像、视频、world model与policy model表征进行探测，分别评估接触检测、力变化跟踪与力幅值估计三项能力。
AI.result: 多数模型能较好判断接触是否发生，但无法反映施加力的大小；机器人后训练（policy post-training）并未改善这一缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉基础模型在世界模型与VLA框架下存在力感知表征缺口，提示需要显式引入力/触觉监督或接触物理表征以支撑力敏感的操作策略。

title: Calibration of Neuromusculoskeletal Models Using Differentiable Physics: Recommendations for Improving Model Accuracy
summary: Differentiable physics has shown potential to usher in a new paradigm in human neuromusculoskeletal (NMS) model calibration. Early results from pioneering works have demonstrated that auto-differentiable NMS models can greatly reduce NMS model calibration time while achieving comparable accuracy compared to traditional calibration methods. The efficient gradient-based optimizers have enabled calibration of increasingly sophisticated human models with a large number of parameters, which seek to narrow the gap between simulation and reality. Several modules have been evaluated separately in different studies, but have never been directly compared within the same study. In this work, these modules are compared on the same differentiable upper limb model with a 3-DoF shoulder, a 2-DoF elbow, and 11 superficial and 5 deep muscles in the calibration to find an optimal pipeline for improving model accuracy. The considered modules include muscle synergy, learnable bone parameters, optimizable geometry of wrap objects, and constraint torque of the differentiable arm model. To evaluate the effect and interplay between the modules on calibration accuracy, one or more modules were used in each of 16 calibration configurations, which were compared in terms of the error between two joint torques calculated by the forward and inverse dynamics with the calibrated model on 9 distinctive testing movements across 4 subjects. Results showed that torque loss was reduced by 23.6% on average using muscle synergy extrapolation to estimate deep muscle activities, and by 10.9% on average through bone dynamic parameter optimization, which are both recommended to be incorporated in the calibration.

AI.tldr: 在同一可微上肢肌骨模型上，系统对比肌肉协同、可学习骨骼参数、包裹几何可优化、约束力矩四个模块在16种校准配置下的效果，最优组合显著降低力矩误差。
AI.motivation: 可微物理已显著加速神经肌骨（NMS）模型标定，但各改进模块此前分散在不同研究中、缺乏公平同条件比较，难以判断哪些模块应纳入最优标定流程。
AI.method: 构建可微上肢模型（3自由度肩+2自由度肘，11块浅层+5块深层肌肉），在16种校准配置中分别启用肌肉协同、可学习骨骼动力学参数、wrap物体几何可优化、约束力矩等模块；在4名受试者、9个测试动作上，以前向与逆向动力学计算的关节力矩之差作为精度指标进行对比。
AI.result: 肌肉协同外推估计深层肌肉活动平均降低力矩损失23.6%，骨骼动力学参数优化平均降低10.9%；其余模块（包裹几何、约束力矩）收益相对有限。
AI.conclusion: 建议将肌肉协同外推与骨骼动力学参数优化纳入可微NMS模型标定流程，可在同等精度水平下提升仿真-现实一致性。

title: One Representation to Rule Them All -- Open-Vocabulary Change Detection from Text or Visual Examples
summary: Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) aims to localise user-specified changes without retraining for predefined categories. Existing approaches typically rely on textual descriptions and combine separate models for region proposal, semantic recognition, and temporal comparison. This limits how target concepts can be expressed and makes detection dependent on several intermediate predictions. We introduce OVTSID3, a training-free framework that unifies region grouping, concept identification, and temporal comparison in the representation space of DINOv3. OVTSID3 supports two complementary modes of concept specification: zero-shot textual queries or one-shot visual prompting through a masked reference pair. OVTSID3 outperforms all prior training-free OVCD methods on two building and two natural-disaster benchmarks, raising the average F1 by 8.9 points. OVTSID3 also supports semantic change detection and achieves state-of-the-art on SECOND. These results demonstrate the flexibility of a unified representation for text- or example-guided change detection without task-specific model training.

AI.tldr: OVTSID3：免训练开放词汇变化检测框架，在DINOv3表征空间中统一图像分组、概念识别与时相比较，支持零样本文本查询或单样本掩码参考对视觉提示。
AI.motivation: 现有OVCD方法依赖文本描述，并把区域提议、语义识别与时相比较拆成多个模型串联，导致概念表达受限、检测误差沿中间预测累积。
AI.method: 免训练框架，在DINOv3深度特征空间内完成区域分组、概念匹配与时相比较；概念指定支持零样本文本查询与单样本掩码参考图像的视觉提示两种互补模式。
AI.result: 在2个建筑与2个自然灾害基准上超越所有免训练OVCD方法，平均F1提升8.9点；同时支持语义变化检测并在SECOND数据集上取得SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 统一表征可灵活支撑文本或示例引导的变化检测，无需任务特定训练；但属遥感变化检测，与具身/3D核心方向关联有限。

title: Most of the Way There: Turning a Strong Video Prior into an Action-Conditioned World Model
summary: Modern video generators excel at producing visually plausible futures guided by text and image prompts. Yet their emphasis on semantic plausibility does not guarantee fidelity to the physical consequences of specific actions. Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs), in contrast, aim to simulate how the world responds to robot actions, enabling scalable policy evaluation and improvement without costly real-world rollouts. The challenge is not merely to generate a plausible future, but to predict what follows from a specific physical action. As video priors grow stronger, we ask how little adaptation is truly needed to bridge this gap. We introduce Dianjing, a minimal recipe that preserves and unlocks the capabilities of strong video priors through unified physical action conditioning, training concentrated at the high noise levels where motion and layout, and thus the consequences of actions, are decided, and native history conditioning. Built upon MiniMax H3, a 33B video foundation model, Dianjing freezes the pretrained backbone and trains only 0.34% of its parameters using approximately 65 hours of robot video across two embodiments, without additional robot-specific pretraining or camera calibration. Controlled ablations show that where training is allocated across noise levels matters more than how actions enter the network. On WorldOracle, which evaluates predictions against paired real-world executions, Dianjing achieves the best scores on four of the five evaluation tracks and ranks second on AgiBot-Long. Our findings suggest that strong video priors already bring us most of the way to world modeling; lightweight physical action grounding can unlock their potential for real-world prediction.

AI.tldr: Dianjing：在33B视频基础模型MiniMax H3上冻结主干、仅训练0.34%参数，通过统一的物理动作条件化、在高噪声（决定运动与布局）层集中训练、原生历史条件化，将视频先验解锁为动作条件世界模型。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型只追求语义合理，无法保证对具体动作物理后果的保真；而动作条件世界模型（ACWM）需要预测"某动作导致什么"，用于可扩展的策略评估。作者追问：在视频先验足够强时，弥合这一差距所需的最少适配是多少。
AI.method: 基于MiniMax H3（33B）冻结骨干，仅训练0.34%参数；采用统一动作条件注入、将训练集中在高噪声时间步（运动/布局/动作后果形成处）、原生历史帧条件化；数据仅约65小时、两个具身形态的机器人视频，无需机器人特定预训练或相机标定。包含控制消融。
AI.result: 消融显示"训练在哪些噪声层级分配"比"动作如何进入网络"更关键；在对照真实执行的世界模型基准WorldOracle上，五个评测赛道中四项第一，AgiBot-Long第二。
AI.conclusion: 强视频先验已完成世界建模的大部分工作，轻量物理动作接地即可释放其真实世界预测潜力；极低参数适配+噪声层级选择是高效ACWM关键配方。

title: PreserveReward: Reliable Consistency Reward Modeling for Image Editing via Dual-Teacher On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Instruction-guided image editing has a wide range of applications, yet existing models may inadvertently alter content that should remain unchanged. Reliable consistency evaluation is therefore essential for assessing content preservation and providing reward signals for Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, existing reward models may overlook subtle visual changes or fail to distinguish necessary modifications from unintended alterations, limiting the reliability of consistency assessment. To address this challenge, we propose PreserveReward, a consistency reward model for image editing that integrates visual On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) to enhance fine-grained visual perception and consistency assessment. PreserveReward learns from reference preservation scores through a regression-based scoring loss and employs two complementary teacher views for self-distillation. The local teacher uses matched crops to identify subtle visual changes, while the joint teacher combines local details with global context to determine whether these changes align with the editing intent. To improve the reliability of distillation supervision, we calibrate teacher score distributions via minimum-KL projection under reference-score error constraints and adaptively select teacher process supervision based on gradient alignment with the scoring objective, mitigating scoring bias and optimization conflicts. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that PreserveReward achieves strong alignment with human preference on non-edited content preservation and generalizes well across diverse editing scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreserveReward：一个用于指令图像编辑的"保持一致性"奖励模型，结合 On-Policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）的局部/联合双教师视角，提升对未编辑内容保持性的细粒度评估，可作为 RL 奖励信号。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑模型易误改应保持不变的内容；已有奖励模型难以察觉细微视觉变化，或无法区分"必要修改"与"意外改动"，导致一致性评估不可靠，也削弱了 RL 奖励信号质量。
AI.method: 以回归方式学习参考保持性分数（scoring loss）；引入视觉 On-Policy 自蒸馏，两个互补教师：局部教师用匹配裁剪捕捉细微变化，联合教师融合局部细节与全局上下文判断改动是否符合编辑意图；用最小 KL 投影在参考分数误差约束下校准教师分数分布，并基于与评分目标的梯度对齐自适应选择教师过程监督。
AI.result: 多基准实验中，PreserveReward 在非编辑内容保持上与人偏好的对齐度较强，并在多种编辑场景下具备良好泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 通过自蒸馏增强细粒度视觉感知并校准蒸馏监督，可显著提升编辑一致性奖励的可靠性，为图像编辑的 RL 训练提供更可信的奖励信号。

title: HoloBrain-0.5 Technical Report
comment: Technical report. 23 pages, 13 figures, 9 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: We present HoloBrain-0.5, a family of vision-language-action (VLA) models for manipulation across robot embodiments. The policies plan in a shared action space using robot state, kinematic structure, and calibrated camera observations. We standardize joint axes, coordinate frames, and tool-center points in robot descriptions (URDFs) and encode their kinematic graphs in a shared 3D representation. HoloBrain-0.5-Continuous generates action chunks by diffusion, while HoloBrain-0.5-Discrete uses residual finite scalar quantization (FSQ) and delayed autoregression. We pretrain both policies on over 10,000 hours of real-robot, simulation, and human-manipulation data spanning 15 embodiment categories. Across six closed-loop simulation settings, the discrete policy converges faster and reaches a higher mean success rate than the continuous policy (56.77% vs. 49.71%). On seven real-robot tasks, it achieves a mean progress score of 87.76% without task-specific post-training. After post-training, the continuous policy outperforms $\pi_{0.5}$ on the seven-task benchmark (94.52% vs. 86.25%) and an 11-task dual-arm benchmark (79.07% vs. 69.41%). The discrete-initialized continuous policy transfers five tasks zero-shot from Piper to Piper-X, scoring 63.28% on average. With target-robot demonstrations, the continuous policy scores 89.2% on Franka Panda and 92.94% on a mobile dual-arm platform. Although pretraining includes no Unitree G1 data, post-training with limited G1 demonstrations yields a mean progress score of 70.24% across three humanoid tasks, compared with 11.00% for $\pi_{0.5}$.

AI.tldr: HoloBrain-0.5：跨本体操作的VLA模型族，统一动作空间与运动学3D表示，预训练10000+小时多源数据，对比扩散与离散FSQ策略，连续策略后训练后超越π0.5。
AI.motivation: 跨机器人本体（embodiment）操作需要统一的状态/动作表示，且需厘清离散自回归与扩散两类动作生成范式在预训练规模下的优劣。
AI.method: 在URDF中标准化关节轴、坐标系与TCP，并把运动学图编码进共享3D表示；策略以机器人状态、运动学结构和标定相机输入在共享动作空间中规划。两变体：Continuous用扩散生成动作块；Discrete用残差FSQ+延迟自回归。在15类本体、1万+小时真机/仿真/人类操作数据上预训练。
AI.result: 六个闭环仿真中离散策略收敛更快、平均成功率56.77% vs 49.71%；七项真机任务无任务后训练达87.76%。后训练后连续策略优于π0.5：七任务94.52% vs 86.25%，11任务双臂79.07% vs 69.41%；离散初始化连续策略Piper→Piper-X五任务零样本63.28%；有目标本体演示时Franka Panda 89.2%、移动双臂92.94%；Unitree G1少样本后训练三任务70.24% vs π0.5的11.00%。
AI.conclusion: 统一动作空间+运动学3D表示的大规模预训练可实现强跨本体迁移；离散FSQ利于快速收敛，连续扩散在后训练后上限更高，二者可互补初始化。

title: DynaRC: Dynamics-Robust 4-D Radar Relocalization with Rate-Adaptive Sequence Matching
summary: Four-dimensional millimeter-wave radar measures radial velocity within a single scan and remains resilient under adverse weather and visibility. Yet sparse directional returns, moving objects and occlusion make place matching ambiguous. We propose DynaRC, a dynamics-robust framework encompassing single-frame retrieval and sequence relocalization. Doppler evidence separates static returns and masks motion-affected cells in a polar descriptor; median ring keys retrieve candidates. Its sequence variant, Seq_DynaRC, couples endpoint-anchored rate alignment and candidate-index voting with ordered verification to associate the latest scan under unequal map/query advancement, without odometry or cloud accumulation. Across four indoor and outdoor map--query pairs, Seq_DynaRC achieves the highest conditional localization success within 2m among tested methods. On a campus-road revisit under changing traffic, success reaches 91.8%, exceeding descriptor-matched SeqSLAM by 55.0 percentage points when each method retains all its published outputs; output availability is reported separately. Code and indoor/outdoor dynamic 4D radar data are available.

AI.tldr: DynaRC：基于4D毫米波雷达多普勒信息的动态鲁棒地点检索与序列重定位框架（含Seq_DynaRC）
AI.motivation: 4D毫米波雷达单帧可测径向速度、全天候鲁棒，但方向性回波稀疏、动态物体与遮挡导致地点匹配歧义，现有地点识别/重定位方法难以应对动态环境。
AI.method: DynaRC：利用多普勒证据区分静态回波，在极坐标描述子中屏蔽受运动影响的栅格；用中值环键（median ring keys）检索候选。Seq_DynaRC：端点锚定的速率对齐 + 候选索引投票 + 有序校验，在无里程计、无点云累积条件下，处理地图/查询推进速率不均时的最新帧关联。
AI.result: 在4组室内外地图—查询对上，Seq_DynaRC 在2m条件定位成功率上为对比方法最高；校园道路重访（交通变化）场景成功率91.8%，在各自保留全部已发表输出时比描述子匹配版SeqSLAM高55.0个百分点（输出可用性另行报告）。
AI.conclusion: 多普勒驱动的动态抑制与序列级速率对齐可有效提升4D雷达地点识别/重定位在动态环境下的鲁棒性；开源代码与室内外动态4D雷达数据。

title: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
summary: Recent video generators produce realistic videos, yet controlling how scenes unfold remains challenging. Structural proxies, such as animated 3D blockouts, guide generation by specifying scene layout, motion, camera behavior, and event order. However, these coarse inputs leave details unspecified and may contain artifacts that should not be reproduced. Successful proxy-guided generation must therefore Preserve intended structure, Complete missing content and correct proxy artifacts, and Bind text, image, and audio conditions to the right entities and events. We introduce ProxyGenBench to study these interacting requirements, with 312 evaluation cases from 60 scenes across three scene tasks and controlled variations in proxy fidelity, text detail, and multimodal inputs. We evaluate five video generators using verified, case-specific checklists. Experiments show that proxies improve spatiotemporal control, but greater proxy detail can coincide with poorer completion, while strong structural adherence does not ensure correct binding.

AI.tldr: 提出 ProxyGenBench 基准（60 场景、312 用例），系统考察结构代理（3D blockout）引导视频生成时的三大交互需求：保持结构、补全缺失并修正代理伪影、多模态条件绑定。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型虽能产出逼真视频，但场景演化过程难以控制；3D blockout 等结构代理可给出布局、运动、相机与事件顺序，却细节缺失且自带伪影，需要明确"保真—补全—绑定"三个冲突性要求并加以量化。
AI.method: 构建 ProxyGenBench：覆盖三类场景任务，并受控变化代理保真度、文本详细程度与多模态输入（文本/图像/音频）；用经人工核验的、逐用例定制的检查表评估 5 个视频生成器。
