AI.result: 代理显著提升时空可控性；但代理细节越丰富，内容补全质量可能反而下降；结构贴合度高并不意味着实体—事件绑定正确。
AI.conclusion: 代理引导生成中结构保真、补全与绑定三者存在权衡，需联合评估；单一结构指标不足以表征生成质量。

title: SceneDesigner++: A Unified 9-DoF Pose Control Framework for T2I and T2V Generation
summary: Precise 9-DoF pose control is essential for visual content generation, enabling users to specify object location, size, and orientation in 3D space. However, existing methods typically focus on either text-to-image (T2I) or text-to-video (T2V) generation, with limitations in pose controllability and temporal coherence. We present SceneDesigner++, a unified framework for 9-DoF pose control across both T2I and T2V generation. We construct ObjectPose9D++, a dataset containing high-quality images and videos with accurate pose annotations. Trained on ObjectPose9D++, SceneDesigner++ combines absolute and relative pose encoding strategies to decouple frame-wise spatial grounding from inter-frame motion modeling. Specifically, absolute pose encoding leverages CNOCS map sequences to provide explicit, frame-wise 9-DoF pose guidance. Meanwhile, our relative pose encoding, termed VPRoPE, incorporates relative pose information into rotary position embeddings to explicitly model inter-frame pose transitions, thereby promoting temporally coherent object motion. A learnable orthogonal transformation is further introduced for each attention head, allowing different heads to capture complementary geometric relationships while preserving input feature norms to promote training stability. We further adopt a two-stage training strategy to learn the absolute and relative pose encoding mechanisms separately. Benefiting from this lightweight and decoupled design, SceneDesigner++ also supports integration with an independently trained camera-control module, enabling separate or joint control over object and camera motion. Finally, we introduce T2IVPoseEval, a benchmark for evaluating diverse object poses and motion patterns in both T2I and T2V tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SceneDesigner++ consistently outperforms same-backbone baselines in pose fidelity and motion quality.

AI.tldr: SceneDesigner++统一框架，通过绝对CNOCS地图编码与相对VPRoPE旋转位置编码实现T2I/T2V的9-DoF物体位姿控制，并可与相机控制模块联合。
AI.motivation: 现有9-DoF位姿可控生成方法局限于T2I或T2V单一任务，位姿可控性与时序一致性不足，且缺乏高质量带精确位姿标注的数据。
AI.method: 构建ObjectPose9D++数据集；绝对位姿编码用CNOCS地图序列提供逐帧9-DoF显式引导；相对位姿编码VPRoPE把相对位姿注入RoPE建模帧间位姿转移；每个注意力头引入可学习正交变换以捕捉互补几何关系并保持特征范数稳定；两阶段训练分别学习两种编码；可插拔集成独立相机控制模块；提出T2IVPoseEval基准。
AI.result: 在同骨干对比中，SceneDesigner++在位姿保真度与运动质量上持续优于基线，并支持物体/相机运动的分离或联合控制。
AI.conclusion: 解耦的绝对-相对位姿编码是统一T2I/T2V精确位姿控制的有效轻量方案，具备与相机控制模块组合的扩展性。

title: Least Restrictive Halfplane Control Barrier Functions for an Autonomous Hydrofoil Boat with Moving Obstacles
summary: Finding valid Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) is difficult for non-linear systems subject to actuation constraints and moving in complex environments. One way to enable analytically derived CBFs is to represent obstacles as supporting halfplanes, allowing the agent to move safely on one side. In this paper, we propose such a CBF for an agent with Dubins car dynamics. A potential drawback of halfplane CBFs is that they can be highly conservative, overestimating the obstacles and thereby restricting the agent's motion. To address this problem, we make the CBF halfplanes less restrictive as follows. First, the orientation of the supporting halfplane for a single obstacle is optimised to find a safe control input as close as possible to the desired one. Second, we use multiple halfplanes to better approximate complex geometries, and derive rules for handling halfplane intersections. Comparative simulations show that our method reduces conservatism compared to existing CBF techniques, enabling tighter obstacle clearance and faster goal arrival, with delays reduced by more than 33%. Finally, experiments on an autonomous hydrofoil boat demonstrate successful real-world implementation.

AI.tldr: 面向Dubins车动力学、受驱动约束的智能体，提出支撑半平面形式的控制障碍函数(CBF)，通过优化半平面朝向并用多半平面近似复杂障碍几何来降低保守性。
AI.motivation: 非线性系统在驱动约束与复杂环境中难以解析构造CBF；将障碍表示为支撑半平面可得到解析CBF，但半平面CBF保守性强，会高估障碍、限制智能体运动。
AI.method: 1) 对单一障碍的支撑半平面朝向进行在线优化，使安全控制输入尽可能接近期望输入；2) 用多个半平面近似复杂几何，并给出半平面交集的处理规则；3) 在Dubins车模型上推导对应的半平面CBF。
AI.result: 对比仿真表明，相较现有CBF方法降低了保守性，障碍间距更紧、到达目标更快，延迟减少超过33%；并在自主水翼艇上完成实机实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过在朝向与多面片层面放松半平面CBF，可在保持安全性的同时显著降低保守性，并在真实无人船平台上落地。

title: Evidence-Aligned Benchmarking and Learning for Medical Video Language Models
summary: A medical video language model should answer from the visual evidence its question asks about. We find three places where this breaks down and address each with an approach we call MedEvidU. First, benchmarks reward answers that ignore the video: on one dataset, the position of a clip within its recording predicts the surgical step in 37% of questions, and a constant answer beats every trained model on a standard safety-assessment metric. We build MedVidBench-v2, 34 tasks from 18 surgical and clinical video datasets, in which prompts and metrics are audited with answers given without video, and which tests unseen hospitals and windows cut blindly from whole recordings. Second, common video encoders merge consecutive frames into shared tokens, so a question about one frame is answered from a blend of two. Query-slot inputs give each queried frame its own tokens at almost no extra cost. Third, a fine-tuned model has memorized its training questions, which leaves little to learn from. Label-matched question resampling (LQR) adds unseen questions about the same recordings while keeping the answer distribution fixed, in a final supervised epoch and in reinforcement learning. Together, these raise the grounding IoU of a 4B model from 30.4 to 44.4, above a supervised 27B model, and instrument grounding at an unseen hospital from 33.9 to 72.5. On blindly cut windows, event-presence accuracy improves by 5.5 points and localization F1 by 8.1 points. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 MedEvidU，从基准、编码器、训练三处修复医学视频语言模型的视觉证据grounding问题：构建 MedVidBench-v2 审计式基准、Query-slot 逐帧token分配、label-matched question resampling (LQR)；4B模型 grounding IoU 30.4→44.4。
AI.motivation: 医学视频语言模型往往不依赖视频内容作答：(1) 基准存在捷径（clip位置即可预测37%的步骤；常数答案得分超过所有训练模型）；(2) 常见视频编码器把连续帧融合为共享token，导致单帧问题由两帧混合回答；(3) 微调模型记住训练问题，可学习信号减少。
AI.method: 三点对应方法：① MedVidBench-v2——18个手术/临床视频数据集、34个任务，提示与指标经“无视频作答”审计，测试未见医院与整段录像盲切窗口；② Query-slot 输入——为每个被查询帧分配独立token，几乎无额外开销；③ LQR——在最后有监督epoch与强化学习中，补充同一录像的未见问题并固定答案分布。
AI.result: 4B模型grounding IoU 30.4→44.4（超过有监督27B模型）；未见医院器械grounding 33.9→72.5；盲切窗口上事件存在准确率+5.5、定位F1 +8.1。
AI.conclusion: 基准捷径、编码器帧融合与问题记忆是医学视频语言模型视觉grounding失效的三个关键来源，针对性的基准审计、逐帧token分配与问题重采样能显著提升grounding与跨域泛化，小模型可超越大模型。

title: Attacking Hard-Label Large Vision-Language Models with Model-Sensitive Adversarial Patch Designs
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in handling multi-modal downstream tasks, gaining increasing popularity. However, recent studies show that LVLMs are susceptible to both intentional and inadvertent attacks. Existing attackers ideally optimize adversarial perturbations with backpropagated gradients from LVLMs, thus limiting their scalability in practical scenarios as real-world LVLM applications will not provide any LVLM's gradient or details. Motivated by this research gap and counter-practical phenomenon, we propose a novel hard-label attack method for LVLMs, named HardPatch, to generate visual adversarial patches by solely querying the model. Our method provides deeper insights into how to investigate the vulnerability of LVLMs in local visual regions and generate corresponding adversarial substitution under the practical yet challenging hard-label setting. Specifically, we first split each image into uniform patches and mask each of them to individually assess their sensitivity to the LVLM model. Then, according to the descending order of sensitive scores, we iteratively select the most vulnerable patch to initialize noise and estimate gradients with further additive random noises for optimization. In this manner, multiple patches are perturbed until the altered image satisfies the adversarial condition. Extensive LVLM models and datasets are evaluated to demonstrate the adversarial nature of HardPatch. Our empirical observations suggest that with appropriate patch substitution and optimization, HardPatch can craft effective adversarial images to attack hard-label LVLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出 HardPatch：在无梯度、hard-label 条件下仅通过查询生成 LVLM 视觉对抗贴片，先分块掩码评估敏感度，再迭代选择最脆弱块叠加随机噪声估计梯度并优化。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗攻击依赖从 LVLM 反向传播的梯度来优化扰动，与真实应用中无法获得模型梯度或内部细节的场景不符，存在可扩展性缺口。
AI.method: 将图像均匀分块并逐块掩码，按敏感度分数降序评估各局部区域脆弱性；依序选取最脆弱块初始化噪声，利用叠加随机噪声进行零阶梯度估计与迭代优化，多块扰动直至满足对抗条件。
AI.result: 在多组 LVLM 模型与数据集上验证，HardPatch 在 hard-label 设置下可生成有效对抗图像，显著改变模型输出，量级分析显示局部块替换加优化即具备攻击性。
AI.conclusion: LVLM 在局部视觉区域上存在可利用的脆弱性，hard-label 查询式贴片攻击可行；为黑盒安全评估提供了实用的攻击基线与鲁棒性评测参照。

title: TACC: Target-Aware Carrier Compression for Dense-Context Novel View Synthesis
summary: Recent feed-forward approaches mark a paradigm shift in novel view synthesis by eliminating the reliance on per-scene optimization, directly inferring 3D representations from input views. However, their reliance on global scene-token context incurs substantial memory and latency overhead, constraining their ability to handle increasingly dense source-view contexts. Compressing source representations offers an intuitive way to limit this token budget. Prior general-purpose compression methods are not tailored for novel view synthesis, as their fixed, target-agnostic nature fails to adapt evidence allocation to individual target views. To overcome this, we introduce TACC, a target-aware compression module tailored for feed-forward latent NVS. Specifically, TACC organizes each source view into a progressive carrier hierarchy. Driven by source-target geometric relevance, it adaptively retrieves tokens to dynamically allocate exact computational quotas. This selective retrieval directly yields a compact, target-conditioned representation. Extensive experiments on the RE10K demonstrate that under dense input settings, TACC achieves $9.23\times$ and $64\times$ higher Effective FPS than Full Context on LagerNVS and LVSM, respectively. Effective FPS excludes one-time source encoding and Carrier construction.

AI.tldr: TACC是一个面向前馈式潜在新视角合成(NVS)的目标感知压缩模块：将每个源视图组织成渐进式载体层级，依据源-目标几何相关性自适应检索token并分配计算配额，得到目标条件化的紧凑表示，在RE10K密集输入下显著提升有效FPS。
AI.motivation: 前馈式NVS消除了逐场景优化，但依赖全局场景token上下文，带来显著显存与时延开销，难以扩展至更密集的源视图。通用压缩方法固定且目标无关，无法按单个目标视图自适应分配证据。
AI.method: TACC：把每个源视图组织为渐进式载体(carrier)层级；以源-目标几何相关性为驱动，自适应检索token，动态分配精确的计算配额，直接产出一个紧凑的、以目标视图为条件的源表示，从而压缩全局token预算。可接入LagerNVS、LVSM等前馈潜在NVS框架。
AI.result: 在RE10K密集输入设置下，TACC相比Full Context在LagerNVS上达到9.23倍、在LVSM上达到64倍更高的Effective FPS（排除了单次源编码与Carrier构建开销）。
AI.conclusion: 目标条件化的选择性token检索是降低前馈NVS上下文开销的有效途径，可在几乎不牺牲质量的前提下大幅提升密集视图场景下的推理效率，为可扩展的前馈3D/新视角合成提供实用方案。

title: Feed-Forward Adaptive Gaussian Splatting for Interactive Medical Volume Rendering
summary: Path-traced rendering shows CT and MR volumes with realistic lighting, but it restarts after every change of view, clipping plane or transfer function (TF), the map from voxel intensity to colour and opacity, which limits the frame rate. Feed-forward Gaussian splatting models such as RenderFM predict the Gaussians directly from the volume instead of fitting them to each scan, and are fast. RenderFM, however, handles only CT, runs its network again after every TF edit, has no clipping operator, and places its Gaussians on a uniform 3-mm grid that blurs organ boundaries and cut faces. We present RenderFM-Next, a feed-forward model that addresses these limits. One network handles both CT and MR. Its Gaussians are predicted once per volume: a new TF needs no pass of this network, and a clipping plane cuts them exactly, using operators from prior work. The model predicts coarse 3-mm Gaussians for the whole volume and refines them to 1.5 mm only where refinement improves the image. A small score head ranks the coarse Gaussians by how much refining them would reduce the rendering error; at render time the user chooses how many are refined, and those next to a clipping plane are always refined, which sharpens cut faces. We build a benchmark of about 2,000 CT and MR scans with path-traced references under clinical presets, TF edits and clipping. Our RenderFM-Next improves over RenderFM retrained on this benchmark by 2.8 dB on CT and 2.4 dB on MR and renders a 1600x1600 view in 4-6 ms. Refinement adds 0.30 / 0.69 dB over the same model trained without it (0.51 / 1.17 dB on cut faces), and refining a learned 10% of the coarse Gaussians matches a random 50% with 2.4x fewer Gaussians. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: RenderFM-Next: 前馈高斯splatting体渲染模型，统一处理CT/MR，每体数据只预测一次高斯，TF编辑无需重跑网络，支持精确裁剪平面，并用score head在需要处做1.5mm细化，1600x1600视图渲染4-6ms。
AI.motivation: 路径追踪体渲染（CT/MR）视口/TF/裁剪改变即重启，帧率低；RenderFM虽为前馈快速预测高斯但仅支持CT、每次TF编辑都重跑网络、无裁剪算子、均匀3mm网格导致器官边界与切面模糊。
AI.method: 单网络同时处理CT与MR；高斯每体积只预测一次（TF变换在渲染期解析完成）；引入先前工作的精确裁剪算子；先预测全局3mm粗高斯，再由小score head按“细化能降低渲染误差”排序，渲染时用户选择细化数量，裁剪面附近高斯强制细化到1.5mm；构建约2000例CT/MR扫描基准，含临床预设、TF编辑与裁剪的路径追踪参考。
AI.result: 相比在该基准上重训的RenderFM，CT提升2.8dB、MR提升2.4dB；1600x1600视图4-6ms渲染。细化相对同结构无细化模型增益0.30/0.69dB（切面0.51/1.17dB）；细化学习选出的10%粗高斯即匹配随机50%，高斯数少2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过“一次预测+解析TF/裁剪+选择性细化”实现了跨模态、可交互的实时高质量路径追踪级体渲染，但应用域限于医学体数据的可视化，非机器人体感/世界模型或机器人重建任务。

title: ProManO: Beyond Sim(3) for Metric Upgrade of Feed-Forward Geometry with Visual-Inertial Anchors
summary: Upgrading feed-forward geometry to metric scale with visual-inertial odometry (VIO) raises the question of which correction should align dense feed-forward prediction with sparse metric VIO anchors. Existing methods use either a similarity transformation, which cannot represent depth-dependent distortion, or a projective transformation, which alters pre-calibrated intrinsics. We prove that the transformations compatible with pre-calibrated intrinsics form a ten-dimensional manifold. Beyond Sim(3), this manifold contains three degrees of freedom (DoF) that locate the plane at infinity and leave residuals growing quadratically with depth range after any similarity alignment. These DoF are invisible in the image and can be resolved only by metric depth along viewing rays or by multi-view constraints. To estimate them, we propose ProManO, a probabilistic manifold optimization framework in which every anchor is weighted by its along-ray uncertainty and inlier probability within a single expectation-maximization (EM) procedure. ProManO certifies the similarity synchronization and refines the plane at infinity only where it is observable, which guarantees an objective value no worse than that of the optimal similarity alignment. Experiments on EuRoC, CID-SIMS, Oxford Spires, and KITTI-360 demonstrate that ProManO achieves the highest mean F1 and outperforms Sim(3) alignment on all four datasets. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该文证明与预标定内参相容的稠密前馈几何→度量尺度对齐变换构成十维流形，超出Sim(3)的三自由度位于无穷远平面定位；提出ProManO概率流形优化框架（EM中联合沿射线不确定度与内点概率加权），仅在校正可观测处精化，保证不劣于最优相似变换。
AI.motivation: 前馈几何（如单目/VAE式稠密深度）缺乏度量尺度，用稀疏VIO锚点做升级时存在"用哪种校正"的问题：Sim(3)无法表达随深度变化的畸变，而投影变换会破坏预标定内参。作者希望找到一类既保持内参又具备足够表达力的对齐变换族，并给出其参数化与稳健估计方法。
AI.method: 理论部分：证明保内参的变换构成10维流形，其超出Sim(3)的3个DoF对应无穷远平面的位置（π∞），且任何相似对齐后残差随深度范围二次增长；该3-DoF在图像中不可见，只能通过沿射线度量深度或多视图约束辨识。方法部分：ProManO——在单一EM框架内做概率流形优化，每个VIO锚点按"沿射线不确定度"与"内点概率"联合加权；先认证Sim(3)同步（certify similarity synchronization），再仅在π∞可观测处精化，从而保证目标值不劣于最优Sim(3)对齐。
AI.result: 在EuRoC、CID-SIMS、Oxford Spires、KITTI-360四个数据集上，ProManO取得最高的平均F1，并在全部四个数据集上优于Sim(3)对齐；同时具有单调不劣化保证。
AI.conclusion: 稠密前馈几何与稀疏VIO的度量对齐不应局限于Sim(3)：保内参流形的额外3-DoF（无穷远平面）是残差的主要来源，可通过沿射线深度/多视图可观测性在EM框架下稳健估计，实现可认证不劣化的度量升级。

title: SkySearcher: High-Altitude Onboard VLM Reasoning for Aerial Semantic Search
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have improved semantic and visual reasoning, enabling UAVs to search for open-vocabulary queries in unstructured environments at high altitude. However, existing systems mainly follow low-altitude strategies, focusing on close-range iterative exploration, requiring storage-intensive dense 3D metric-semantic reconstructions or relying on large cloud-serviced VLMs assuming constant internet access. We propose SkySearcher, an aerial semantic search navigation method designed for large outdoor scenes. SkySearcher integrates onboard VLM reasoning with a lightweight probabilistic representation that guides an information-driven exploration. The VLM extracts semantic information at high altitude about the target or cues informing about its location. This information is projected to the ground using the camera frustum instead of limited-depth sensors, actively exploiting the expansive field of view offered by elevated sensing. The information regarding the presence or absence of semantic cues is then integrated into a probabilistic map by modeling the spatial belief of the query, maintaining a task-driven memory for the mission and guiding the exploration towards semantically promising regions. Extensive simulations for Aerial Object Goal Navigation on public benchmarks demonstrate that SkySearcher significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in success rate, flight time, and navigation precision, while a deployment of SkySercher running fully onboard a drone demonstrates the applicability of our approach.

AI.tldr: SkySearcher提出面向大型室外场景的空中开放词汇语义搜索导航方法：机载VLM在高空提取目标语义线索，借相机视锥投影到地面构建概率地图，驱动信息增益式探索。
AI.motivation: 现有UAV语义搜索沿袭低空近距离迭代探索范式，依赖存储密集的三维度量-语义重建，或依赖需稳定联网的大型云端VLM，难以适应高空大范围非结构化环境。
AI.method: 机载VLM推理 + 轻量概率表示。VLM在高空解析目标或位置线索语义信息，通过相机视锥而非有限深度传感器投影至地面，利用高空大视场；将语义线索有/无的证据融合进查询空间信念概率地图，形成任务驱动记忆并引导探索朝向语义可信区域。
AI.result: 在公开基准的Aerial Object Goal Navigation仿真中，成功率、飞行时间与导航精度显著优于SOTA基线；并在真实无人机上完全机载运行验证可行性。
AI.conclusion: 无需稠密重建与云端依赖的轻量机载VLM语义搜索方案，在大型室外空中导航任务中兼具精度与部署可行性。

title: Who Is Ego? Scaling Cross-View Camera Wearer Identification and Segmentation beyond Humans
summary: A first-person (ego) image reveals what a camera sees, but not who or what carries it. Given a synchronized third-person (exo) image, camera wearer identification asks who is ego: which candidate carries the ego camera? We extend this task beyond humans to robots, vehicles, animals, and drones, and broaden its spatial scope (where is ego) from selecting a provided candidate mask to wearer segmentation with absence prediction and mutual camera localization across ego-exo views. We introduce FindEgo-1M, comprising 1.16M real and simulated ego-exo pairs across 12 wearer types, 17 domains, and 111 test settings. Our approach exploits a geometric relation: the ego camera's projection into the exo image, i.e., the epipole, lies on or near its wearer. We introduce EgoRay-ZS, the first method to turn a frozen feed-forward 3D reconstruction model, VGGT-$\Omega$, into a training-free solution for wearer identification and segmentation. Its geometric readout ranks candidate masks or segmentation proposals by angular offset and distance to the ego camera, while the relative pose provides mutual camera directions. We then develop the full EgoRay model through pose-supervised training on FindEgo-1M and label-free test-time adaptation constrained by candidate masks. Without task-specific training, EgoRay-ZS achieves 78.0% identification accuracy on TF2023's original labels, versus 52.9% reported for the dataset-trained PEN. On FindEgo-1M, EgoRay achieves state-of-the-art chance-corrected accuracy of 87.1 and 77.7 on seen and unseen settings. On matched queries, EgoRay also outperforms GPT-6 Astra by 31.6 and 21.3 points on seen and unseen settings, respectively, while running $18\times$ faster. Data, code, and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出跨具身（人/机器人/车辆/动物/无人机）的首人称-第三人称相机佩戴者识别与分割任务，构建 FindEgo-1M（116万对 ego-exo，12类佩戴者、17域、111测试设置），并利用ego相机在exo视图中的对极点必落在佩戴者上的几何先验，将冻结的VGGT-Ω前馈3D重建模型转为免训练求解器EgoRay-ZS，再以位姿监督+无标签测试时自适应训练完整EgoRay。
AI.motivation: 首人称图像只揭示相机所见，不含"谁在携带相机"的信息；现有佩戴者识别工作局限于人类、且仅从给定候选框中选一个，缺乏跨具身、跨空间范围（分割、缺席预测、双向相机定位）的统一能力。作者希望用前馈3D基础模型的几何输出零训练地解决该问题。
AI.method: 核心几何关系：ego相机光心投影到exo图像得到的对极点位于或接近其佩戴者。据此将冻结的VGGT-Ω对ego-exo对做联合前馈重建，得到相对位姿与三维点/深度，再以"候选掩码/分割提案到对极点的角偏差与距离"作为几何读出进行排序与分割；相对位姿同时给出双向相机朝向。完整EgoRay在FindEgo-1M上做位姿监督训练，并加入由候选掩码约束的无标签测试时自适应。
AI.result: EgoRay-ZS零任务训练在TF2023原始标签上达78.0%（对比数据集训练的PEN 52.9%）；FindEgo-1M上EgoRay取得机会校正准确率87.1（seen）/77.7（unseen）SOTA；同query下较GPT-6 Astra高31.6/21.3点，且快18倍。
AI.conclusion: 对极几何可作为ego-exo具身对应的强先验，配合冻结前馈3D重建模型可实现免训练佩戴者识别，微调后进一步扩展到分割与缺席预测，并显著优于通用大模型方案。

title: An Exact Branch-Price-and-Cut Algorithm for the Vehicle Routing Problem with Floating Targets
summary: The Vehicle Routing Problem with Floating Targets (VRPFT) is a generalization of the capacitated vehicle routing problem where targets may actively move to locations ''convenient'' for the vehicles. In particular, each target may leave its home location at a bounded speed. A solution to the VRPFT is a sequence of targets for each vehicle to visit and a meeting point in space-time for each target. In this paper, we solve the VRPFT exactly with a branch-price-and-cut algorithm. Our key contribution is a dominance criterion for the pricing labeling algorithm that utilizes closed-form lower and upper bounds on a vehicle's trajectory cost given a fixed sequence of targets. We prove that the criterion preserves optimality, and the algorithm has smaller computation time than the exact dynamic program of prior work on identical hardware. We also provide a relaxed criterion that prunes more aggressively; the resulting heuristic is faster than our exact algorithm and matched every certified optimum on the benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该论文用分支定价切割（branch-price-and-cut）算法精确求解“浮动目标车辆路径问题”（VRPFT），核心贡献是针对定价标签算法的支配准则，利用固定目标序列下车辆轨迹成本的闭式上下界来剪枝，并证明其保持最优性；另给出更激进的松弛准则得到快速启发式。
AI.motivation: 经典带容量车辆路径问题（CVRP）假设目标点固定不动，而许多实际场景（如移动服务请求、会合配送）中目标可以有限速度向车辆“便利”位置移动，形成VRPFT。此前仅有精确动态规划方法，计算代价高，需要更高效的精确求解手段及可证明的剪枝机制。
AI.method: 将VRPFT建模并采用branch-price-and-cut框架：主问题为带割的整数规划，定价子问题用标签算法求解；关键是为定价标签设计支配准则，基于给定目标序列时车辆轨迹成本的解析下界与上界进行标签比较与剪枝，证明剪枝不损失最优性；此外给出放松版支配准则以更强剪枝，构造快速启发式。
AI.result: 在相同硬件上，所提精确算法计算时间短于已有精确动态规划；松弛准则得到的启发式比精确算法更快，并在基准测试上匹配全部已认证最优解。
AI.conclusion: 基于轨迹成本闭式界的支配准则是求解VRPFT的有效精确手段，兼顾最优性保证与效率；松弛版本在实测中未损失解质量，具备作为快速求解器的潜力。

title: Angular Interpolation in Sparse-View Low-Dose CT Reconstruction: Placement Effects and Data-Consistency Step-Size Scaling
summary: Dual-domain networks combine projection and image processing for sparse-view low-dose computed tomography (CT). We quantify the contribution of angular interpolation before learning and distinguish its roles in sinogram initialisation and the image residual base. On synthetic parallel-beam data, parameter-free interpolation reduces noise-free missing-view mean absolute error by 99.7% relative to zero filling at 60 views. Full-view filtered back-projection (FBP) of the jointly learned completed sinogram adds 1.27 dB of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) over interpolated FBP. In a data-consistency dual-domain network (DC-DuNet), a 2x2 configuration ablation controls branch width, depth and training schedule while varying these placements and their associated input channels. After 20 epochs, the PSNR contrasts are +1.98 dB for sinogram initialisation and -2.16 dB for the interpolated image base; the image-base ranking also reverses during training. The sinogram-initialised variant exceeds an image-only U-Net by 0.96 dB at 60 views and 10% dose, and by 1.28 dB on independently generated synthetic data. The U-Net leads at higher view counts and with a shared interpolated image base. Without retraining, the variant retains a 0.12 dB advantage on held-out CHAOS abdominal CT under simulated degradation; the image-base contrast rounds to zero. The implemented projection/backprojection pair has empirical dominant gain of approximately 0.85NK, where N is image-grid width and K acquired view count. These results distinguish interpolation placement from network architecture and support NK normalisation for step calibration.

AI.tldr: 双域CT网络中，投影域角度插值作正弦图初始化的收益(+1.98 dB)远大于作为图像残差基底(-2.16 dB)，且该排序在训练中会反转；插值增益约0.85NK，支持NK归一化步长标定。
AI.motivation: 双域网络同时用投影域与图像域处理稀疏视角低剂量CT，但"角度插值应放在学习前还是学习中、放在正弦图初始还是图像基底"这一问题缺乏受控量化分析，网络架构效应与模块放置效应混杂。
AI.method: 在合成平行束数据上，以无参数角度插值为基础，构建2×2配置消融，固定分支宽度/深度/训练日程，仅改变插值放置位置及对应输入通道；在DC-DuNet上以全视角FBP作上界，对比正弦图初始化vs插值图像基底，并追踪训练过程中排序变化；另在独立合成数据与CHAOS腹部CT退化模拟上验证，同时实测投影/反投影算子增益。
AI.result: 60视角下插值将无噪声缺失视角MAE相对零填充降低99.7%；联合学习补全正弦图的全视角FBP较插值FBP提升1.27 dB PSNR；20 epoch后对比为正弦图初始化+1.98 dB、插值图像基底-2.16 dB；正弦图初始化变体较图像-only U-Net在60视角10%剂量下高0.96 dB，独立数据高1.28 dB，未重训迁移至CHAOS仍保留0.12 dB优势；实测算子主导增益约0.85NK。
AI.conclusion: 将插值放置效应与架构效应解耦：插值应作为正弦图初始化而非图像残差基底；高视角数下U-Net更优；建议以NK归一化标定步长。属医学CT成像域的方法学消融研究，非具身/3D重建核心方向。

title: Long-Horizon Planning with Latent World Models via Graph Anchors
comment: Project page: this https URL | Code: this https URL
summary: Latent world models plan in a compact latent space by predicting the outcomes of actions. Their planners judge a plan by the latent distance between its predicted end state and the goal image. We show that this distance fails in two distinct ways. First, it loses directional signal a few steps from the goal, causing distant goals to fail. Second, it weighs the robot arm over the manipulated object, causing manipulation to fail at contact. We measure both failures directly on recorded data by asking whether a lower latent distance corresponds to true progress toward the goal. Across five environments, six visual representations (including raw pixels and V-JEPA 2), and nine Meta-World tasks, this ranking test cleanly separates the two failures, and the graph distance to a goal predicts where closed-loop planning breaks down. Both failures share a single remedy: replacing the distant goal with a nearby target that lies on a recorded trajectory. We realize this principle with Graph Anchors, a training-free planner for frozen latent world models. It builds a sparse graph once over the model's own training frames and aims each planning step at a node a few moves ahead along the shortest path to the goal, keeping paths on recorded transitions wherever contact matters. On goals up to 400 steps away, Graph Anchors raise LeWM's success from 13% to 85% on PointMaze-Medium, from 8% to 87% on PointMaze-Large, and from 5% to 71% on Push-T, where stronger search toward the goal fails and where prior training-free planners break down under missing step horizons, subsampling shortcuts, or fragmented contact.

AI.tldr: 论文诊断潜在世界模型规划器中"目标图像潜在距离"存在的两类失效（远距离方向信号丢失、对机械臂与物体权重失衡），提出免训练图锚点(Graph Anchors)规划器，用记录轨迹上的近邻锚点替代远距离目标，显著提升长程与接触任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型通过预测动作结果的潜在状态进行规划，但常用代价函数——预测末端状态与目标图像的潜在距离——是隐含假设。作者希望直接检验该假设：更小的潜在距离是否真对应朝目标的真实进展，并定位失效模式。
AI.method: 提出基于记录数据的"排序检验"（ranking test），衡量低潜在距离是否对应真实进展；在5个环境、6种视觉表示（含原始像素与V-JEPA 2）、9个Meta-World任务上分离出两类失效。补救方法是把远景目标替换为位于记录轨迹上的近邻目标，实现为Graph Anchors：在冻结模型的训练帧上一次性构建稀疏图，每步规划以最短路径上前进数步的节点为子目标，使路径保留在记录转移上。
AI.result: 排序检验清晰区分两类失效，且目标图距离可预测闭环规划崩溃位置。在最近400步的目标上，Graph Anchors将LeWM成功率从13%提升至85%（PointMaze-Medium）、8%至87%（PointMaze-Large）、5%至71%（Push-T）；而在这些场景下更强的朝目标搜索反而失败，已有免训练规划器在缺失步长视界、子采样捷径或断裂接触时失效。
AI.conclusion: 潜在距离目标作为规划代价是系统性不可靠的，根因在于度量与真实进程解耦；将目标降解为记录轨迹上的近邻锚点是统一且免训练的修复方案，对长程导航与接触密集操作均有效。

title: Decoder-as-a-Probe: Verbalizing and Steering Visual Representations in LVLMs
summary: It is commonly accepted that high-level concepts are represented linearly in the representation space of large neural networks. For Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs), finding those interpretable directions in visual representations is important for interpretability. To find them, the classical approach is to train a linear classifier on the representations, but it needs a large amount of labels and only recovers what can be read from the representations, not what the model actually uses. In this paper we start from the following insight: The LLM Decoder of an LVLM is also a classifier whose classes are the possible next tokens. So we use its first-order Taylor expansion as a linear classifier. Hence, we introduce Decoder-as-a-Probe (DaP), which significantly outperforms classical probing and steering baselines especially when training data is sparse. (1) It verbalizes what an LVLM perceives in a given image. (2) It can surgically change the perception of the LVLM about specific attributes (e.g. change only the color, the clothes worn or the action done). Due to its simplicity and data efficiency, we believe DaP can serve as a plug-and-play tool for LVLM research, such as interpretability, hallucination mitigation or instruction tuning.

AI.tldr: Decoder-as-a-Probe (DaP) uses the first-order Taylor expansion of an LVLM's LLM decoder as a linear classifier/probe on visual representations, outperforming classical linear probing and steering, especially with sparse labels, enabling verbalization of perceived image attributes and surgical attribute edits.
AI.motivation: High-level concepts are believed to be linearly encoded in large network representations, and finding interpretable directions in LVLM visual representations matters for interpretability. Classical probing trains a linear classifier on representations but requires many labels and only recovers what is readable, not what the model actually uses.
AI.method: Key insight: the LLM decoder of an LVLM is itself a classifier over next tokens, so its first-order Taylor expansion at the current representation yields a linear classifier over the visual representation. DaP uses this decoder-derived linear direction as a probe/steeering direction, requiring no auxiliary labeled training.
AI.result: DaP significantly outperforms classical probing and steering baselines, particularly in the sparse-data regime; it verbalizes what the LVLM perceives in a given image and can surgically alter specific attributes (color, clothing, action) without disturbing others.
AI.conclusion: DaP is simple and data-efficient, serving as a plug-and-play tool for LVLM interpretability, hallucination mitigation, and instruction tuning; no code or quantitative benchmarks are reported in the abstract.

title: AGLR: Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement for Fine-Grained Humanoid Motion Generation and Editing
summary: Humanoid motion generation must accommodate evolving task requirements, where localized adjustments should satisfy new geometric constraints without disrupting desired motion details. However, language-based control lacks geometric precision, while joint-level constraints require explicit spatial targets. Local geometric constraints are also underdetermined, complicating target satisfaction and source preservation. We present AGLR (Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement), a unified framework for fine-grained humanoid motion generation and editing through source-anchored refinement. A compact geometric interface supports composable, time-varying control of limb extents, torso orientation, and root trajectories. Given a generated or encoded base latent, an Attribute Residual Adapter predicts a single-pass correction, with dual-level supervision enforcing target matching and selective preservation across attributes and motion coordinates. On HumanML3D-G1, AGLR achieves the highest controllable-generation and preservation-constrained editing success rates among evaluated methods. Editing take only 9.1 ms for a cached 500-frame motion, without additional sampling or test-time optimization. Zero-shot evaluation on BONES-SEED-G1 further demonstrates transfer without fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 AGLR 框架，通过源锚定隐空间精修实现细粒度人形动作生成与编辑：紧凑几何接口支持对肢体长度、躯干朝向与根轨迹的可组合、时变控制；属性残差适配器单次前向预测隐空间修正，双层监督兼顾目标满足与源细节保持，编辑500帧缓存动作仅需9.1ms。
AI.motivation: 语言控制缺乏几何精度，关节级约束需要显式空间目标；而局部几何约束本身欠定，难以同时满足目标并保留原有动作细节，因此需要一个既精确又可保持源动作的局部编辑接口。
AI.method: 1）几何接口：可组合、时变的肢体伸展、躯干朝向、根轨迹控制参数；2）以生成或编码得到的基础潜变量为锚点，用 Attribute Residual Adapter 单次前向预测残差修正；3）双层监督：属性级与运动坐标级的目标匹配损失 + 选择性保持损失；4）无需额外采样或测试时优化，缓存动作可直接推断。
AI.result: 在 HumanML3D-G1 上取得所评估方法中最高的可控生成成功率与保持约束下的编辑成功率；缓存500帧动作编辑耗时9.1ms；在 BONES-SEED-G1 上零样本迁移无需微调。
AI.conclusion: 基于源锚定的潜空间残差精修可作为统一的人形动作生成-编辑范式，兼顾几何可控性与细节保持，并具备高效、可零样本迁移的特性；对物理AI中运动基础模型的可控性接口设计有参考价值。

title: PURA: Video Token Pruning via Unified Spatiotemporal Redundancy Assessment
summary: Video large language models incur substantial inference costs from long visual token sequences. Existing video token compression methods mitigate these costs by exploiting spatial redundancy within frames and temporal redundancy across frames. However, many approaches impose predefined processing orders or fixed allocation ratios for spatial and temporal compression, limiting their ability to adapt to the varying balance of spatiotemporal redundancy across videos. To address this limitation, we propose PURA, a training-free method that prunes visual tokens through unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment. For each token, PURA constructs spatial and temporal reference candidates and selects the reference with the lowest representation error across the two dimensions. The representation error is combined with token importance to determine each token's removal cost. To avoid the time overhead of removing the lowest-cost token one by one, we introduce Coordinated Pruning, which iteratively groups mutually compatible low-cost removals into batches for simultaneous execution and updates the pruning state after each batch until the target budget is reached. Extensive experiments on three video large language models and five video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that PURA achieves a favorable trade-off between task performance and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: PURA：一种免训练的视频 LLM 视觉 token 剪枝方法，通过统一时空冗余评估实现自适应压缩，并用 Coordinated Pruning 批量低成本移除。
AI.motivation: 现有视频 token 压缩方法依赖预定义处理顺序或固定的时空压缩比例，无法适应不同视频中时空冗余比例的差异。
AI.method: 对每个 token 构造空间与时间参考候选，选取跨两维度表示误差最小者；将表示误差与 token 重要性结合为移除代价；提出 Coordinated Pruning，迭代地把互相兼容的低代价移除分组为批次同时执行，每批后更新剪枝状态直到目标预算。
AI.result: 在 3 个视频大模型与 5 个视频理解基准上取得任务性能与推理效率的良好权衡。
AI.conclusion: 统一时空冗余评估 + 批量协调剪枝可免训练地自适应压缩视觉 token，兼顾效率与精度。

title: Rank Before You Encode: Reading a Few Percent of a Whole-Slide Image
summary: Classifying a whole-slide image requires encoding thousands of high-resolution tiles with a pathology foundation model, which accounts for most of the inference cost. Existing efficient methods reduce this cost by selecting fewer tiles, but typically train a new model around their selection strategy. A largely unexplored alternative is to keep an existing full-bag model frozen and run it on selected tiles at the same encoder cost. We introduce this comparison, alongside random tile sampling at matched cost. To select tiles, we fit a lightweight selector with 3.3K parameters to the attention of a frozen model, without additional slide labels. The selector ranks regions from a slide thumbnail, encodes the top K regions at 5x magnification, and selects b for processing at 20x. We evaluate seven frozen MIL aggregators on six tasks and compare them with nine efficient methods trained on the same features and splits. At a budget of (K,b)=(1000,10), encoding costs about 6.6% of the full bag and is 10-14x faster, excluding tiling. The AUROC drop is no more than 0.005 in 33 of 36 aggregator-task pairs. At (500,10), the cost falls to about 4% and inference is 13-22x faster, but AUROC drops by up to 0.035 on CAMELYON17, where small metastases are easily missed. Selection improves over random sampling by about 0.10 AUROC on tasks with focal lesions, while random sampling performs well on diffuse tasks. In our comparisons, the frozen model at (500,10) is ahead of nine efficient methods in 55 of 60 paired comparisons. Giving an existing WSI model fewer tiles is thus a baseline that a new efficient model should be compared with at matched encoder cost.

AI.tldr: 冻结全切片图像模型，用仅3.3K参数的轻量选择器（由冻结模型注意力拟合，无需额外切片标签）从缩略图选区域，5x编码1000区域后取b个在20x精算，实现约4-6.6%编码成本、10-22x加速，AUROC下降常≤0.005。
AI.motivation: 全切片WSI推理成本主要来自编码成千上万个高分辨率图块。现有高效方法通常围绕“选片策略”重新训练模型；而“冻结既有全包模型、仅在其上选片”这一基线几乎未被系统探索，缺乏与随机采样、与九种高效方法在同等编码成本下的公平比较。
AI.method: 以3.3K参数选择器拟合冻结模型的注意力分布（无需额外切片标签），从切片缩略图排序区域，在5x放大下编码Top-K区域，再选b个区域送20x编码；在六个任务、七个冻结MIL聚合器上评估，并与在同一特征与划分上训练的九种高效方法、以及在匹配成本下的随机采样对比。
AI.result: (K,b)=(1000,10)时编码成本约为全包6.6%，推理（不含切图）加速10-14x，36个聚合器-任务对中33个AUROC下降≤0.005；(500,10)时成本约4%、加速13-22x，但CAMELYON17因微小转移灶易漏检AUROC下降最多0.035。病灶集中任务上选择优于随机采样约0.10 AUROC，弥散型任务随机采样已足够好。冻结模型在(500,10)下于60组配对比较中55组优于九种高效方法。
AI.conclusion: 在匹配编码成本下，“给既有WSI模型更少图块”是一个强基线，新高效模型应与其对比；选择式采样带来的增益依赖任务病灶的空间集中程度，不能一概而论。

title: Dynamic Task Update Benchmark (DTU-Bench): Evaluating Runtime Task Adaptation in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies perform well on fixed-instruction robotic manipulation benchmarks, but their ability to adapt to instruction changes during execution remains understudied. We introduce the Dynamic Task Update Benchmark (DTU-Bench), evaluating 40 task revisions across seven update types and three execution stages using LIBERO, a simulated robotic manipulation benchmark. We compare performance when a new instruction is given before execution starts versus during execution, and examine whether the new task instructions are followed. Across 13 representative VLA configurations, average task success is 95.8% on the original object-manipulation tasks, compared with only 1.6% when the instruction changes which object to manipulate during execution. Controlled diagnostics show that policies often complete the original task before the updated one, and that their responses depend on the robot's physical state. We further test whether a simple scripted controller that releases the grasped object and moves the arm back helps robots respond to instruction changes. This improves success from 2% to 38% for {\pi}0.5 and from 8% to 48% for DM0.5, but can cause unwanted object motion. These findings reveal limitations that fixed-instruction benchmarks and task-success metrics alone can overlook in evaluating robotic manipulation. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该文提出DTU-Bench基准，基于LIBERO在13种代表性VLA配置上评测执行期间指令动态变更（7类更新×3个执行阶段×40个任务修订），揭示VLA在固定指令基准上的高成功率（95.8%）在动态改指令下严重崩塌（对象切换仅1.6%），并诊断其成因及简单脚本化回撤控制器的有限缓解效果。
AI.motivation: VLA策略在固定指令的机器人操作基准上表现优异，但其在执行过程中适应指令变化的能力研究不足；现有基准与任务成功率指标无法暴露这一盲区。
AI.method: 构建DTU-Bench：在LIBERO仿真环境中设计40个任务修订，覆盖7类更新类型与3个执行阶段，比较"执行前给出新指令"与"执行中给出新指令"两种设定，并检测智能体是否真正遵循新指令；评测13种代表性VLA配置。另加入受控诊断实验（观察是否先完成原任务、对机器人物理状态的依赖）以及一个简单的脚本化控制器（释放已抓取物体并将机械臂复位）作为干预手段。
AI.result: 原始对象操作任务平均成功率95.8%，而执行中改变操作对象时仅1.6%。诊断显示策略常先完成原任务再响应新任务，且响应取决于机器人当前物理状态。脚本化回撤控制器将π0.5成功率从2%提升至38%、DM0.5从8%提升至48%，但会引入非期望的物体位移。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLA缺乏执行期指令动态更新的能力，固定指令基准与单一任务成功率指标会掩盖这一关键缺陷；简单的状态复位干预有显著收益但并非完善方案，指向需要更好的指令切换与状态管理机制。

title: Reference-Model-Guided Distributed MPC for UAV Swarm Formation Flying Under Switching Directed Graphs
summary: Distributed formation control of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms in complex environments faces several challenges, including switching inter-agent connectivity, limited communication, external disturbances, and collision avoidance. To address these challenges, we propose a reference-model-guided distributed model predictive control (MPC) framework for UAV swarm formation. Each UAV uses relative-position information from its neighbors as input to a local reference model, whose output serves as the formation guidance for the onboard MPC controller. Meanwhile, a Kalman filter is utilized to predict neighboring UAV motions, enabling the construction of inter-UAV collision-avoidance constraints solely from instantaneous relative-state information. By decoupling MPC optimization from distributed coordination, this control architecture preserves the look-ahead planning and constraint-handling capabilities of MPC while enhancing the swarm's adaptability to switching directed graphs. Moreover, eliminating the exchange of neighbors' predicted trajectories reduces communication bandwidth demands, offering strong scalability for large-scale UAV swarms. To improve robustness and safety, disturbance-observer-based feedforward compensation is employed, while the bounded residual disturbance is explicitly considered in the control barrier function (CBF)-based obstacle-avoidance constraints. Finally, the proposed framework is validated through both simulations and real-world flight experiments. Specifically, the flight verification is conducted on a fully distributed multi-UAV platform without external global localization.

AI.tldr: 提出参考模型引导的分布式MPC框架，实现复杂环境下无人机集群编队控制，兼顾避碰、抗扰、有限通信与切换拓扑，并完成真机分布式飞行验证。
AI.motivation: 无人机集群在复杂环境中编队面临切换通信拓扑、通信带宽受限、外部扰动和机间避碰等多重挑战；传统分布式MPC需交换预测轨迹，通信开销大、对拓扑切换适应性差。
AI.method: 每架无人机将邻居相对位置输入本地参考模型，输出作为机载MPC的编队引导；用Kalman滤波预测邻居运动，仅凭瞬时相对状态构建避碰约束；将MPC优化与分布式协同解耦，避免交换邻居预测轨迹；采用扰动观测器前馈补偿，并在CBF障碍规避约束中显式考虑有界残差扰动。
AI.result: 仿真与真机飞行实验均验证有效；飞行实验在全分布式多无人机平台上完成，不依赖外部全局定位。
AI.conclusion: 该架构在保留MPC前瞻规划与约束处理能力的同时提升了切换有向图下的适应性，降低通信带宽需求、具备大规模可扩展性，并在无全局定位的分布式平台上得到实飞验证。

title: HAS: Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling for Video Understanding
summary: Due to context-length constraints, most MLLMs cannot process full-length videos and therefore rely on sampling a subset of frames as input. However, existing sampling methods, ranging from uniform sampling to relevance-based selection, are often driven by a single sampling principle and thus struggle to accommodate the heterogeneous evidential requirements of different queries: some demand a holistic understanding of how the video unfolds over time, while others hinge on fine-grained events within a short temporal window. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling (HAS)}, a two-stage frame sampling framework. In the first stage, \emph{Backbone Frame Construction}, we apply a Determinantal Point Process (DPP) to sample frames that are both query-relevant and non-redundant. These selected frames capture key moments across the video and form the backbone of the sampling set, providing a foundation for subsequent enrichment. In the second stage, \emph{Adaptive Contextual Enrichment}, we analyze the temporal distribution of the backbone frames to infer the query's requirements and adaptively allocate the remaining frame budget between Local and Global Context. The Local Context enriches the backbone with fine-grained temporal dynamics and short-range causal relations, whereas the Global Context connects temporally isolated evidence and provides a holistic view of the entire video to support global understanding. Through such a hierarchical two-stage process, HAS effectively addresses diverse query requirements. Incorporated into three leading MLLMs, it demonstrates consistently superior performance across the Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU benchmarks.

AI.tldr: HAS：两阶段视频帧采样框架，先用DPP选出查询相关且不冗余的骨干帧，再按骨干帧的时间分布推断查询需求，自适应分配剩余预算给局部/全局上下文。
AI.motivation: MLLM受上下文长度限制，只能采样部分帧处理长视频；现有均匀采样或相关性选择仅遵循单一原则，难以同时满足需要整体时序理解与需要短窗口细粒度事件的异质查询需求。
AI.method: 阶段一 Backbone Frame Construction：用行列式点过程（DPP）同时建模查询相关性与帧间冗余度，选出覆盖关键片段的骨干帧；阶段二 Adaptive Contextual Enrichment：分析骨干帧的时间分布以推断查询类型，将剩余帧预算在Local Context（细粒度时序动态与短程因果关系）与Global Context（连接孤立证据、提供全局视角）间自适应分配。作为即插即用模块集成到三个MLLM中。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、LongVideoBench、MLVU三个长视频基准上，集成到三个主流MLLM后均取得一致的性能提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 分层两阶段采样能有效适配多样化查询需求，是对现有单一原则采样策略的通用改进；但缺少计算开销分析与训练/推理成本讨论。

title: Recalling the Past to Answer the Present: Context-Aware Multi-Evidence Reasoning for Streaming Video Question Answering
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet existing video question answering (VQA) benchmarks mainly evaluate models in offline settings. Real-world streaming scenarios instead require models to answer context-dependent queries by retrieving and reasoning over evidence distributed across the video history. We introduce StreamRecall, a benchmark for context-aware Multi evidence reasoning in streaming video QA. StreamRecall requires models to retrieve, associate, and reason over temporally scattered evidence to answer queries at the appropriate moment. It contains 4,983 questions over 462 videos, with context-aligned query times and fine-grained temporal evidence annotations. We further propose the Evidence Utilization Cascade to diagnose model reasoning through evidence localization, grounding, chain completion, and answer derivation. To enable efficient long-term streaming reasoning, we present EviStream, a training-free causal visual memory mechanism that preserves reasoning-critical evidence under a fixed KV budget. Experiments reveal substantial gaps between current VLMs and realistic streaming requirements, establishing StreamRecall as a foundation for developing evidence-aware streaming video intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出StreamRecall流式视频问答基准（4,983题/462视频，含上下文对齐的提问时刻与细粒度时序证据标注），并提出证据利用级联诊断框架与免训练因果视觉记忆机制EviStream，在固定KV预算下保留推理关键证据。
AI.motivation: 现有视频问答基准多为离线设定，而真实场景中模型需在流式条件下回答依赖上下文、证据在时间上分散的查询，缺乏相应评测手段。
AI.method: 构建StreamRecall基准：多证据检索—关联—推理，标注查询时刻与证据片段；设计Evidence Utilization Cascade，分证据定位、接地、推理链补全、答案推导四阶段诊断；提出EviStream，免训练的因果视觉记忆，在固定KV预算下按推理重要性保留/淘汰证据。
AI.result: 实验显示现有VLM与真实流式需求存在显著差距；基准与级联诊断可定位推理各阶段瓶颈，EviStream在长时流式推理中提升证据保留效率。
AI.conclusion: StreamRecall为证据感知的流式视频智能提供评测基础；工作属基准与记忆机制范畴，与Physical AI/VLA/3D重建主线关联有限，作为通用VLM视频理解背景参考。

title: CADENCE: Sensor-GroundedWorld-Consistent Gaussian SLAM for Collaborative Mobile Reconstruction
summary: Collaborative reconstruction with consumer phones promises faster and more complete indoor maps. However, heterogeneous devices introduce degraded observations and unreliable cross-device associations, so a single poor contributor or incorrect match can corrupt the shared Gaussian map. To address this, we propose \textbf{CADENCE}, a collaborative Gaussian simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system that separates finding cross-device matches from deciding whether and how peer observations update the map. To find matches, a sensor-grounded regional memory summarizes committed observations and ranks candidate peer regions using appearance, relative pose, gravity, barometric altitude, and observation quality. Deterministic geometric verification and optional physical checks then decide which of the proposed matches are accepted. Once a match is accepted, separate cue-based confidences control how its observations contribute to pose constraints, geometry, appearance, and memory. As a result, useful depth can still contribute even when color is unreliable. Throughout this process, local tracking remains isolated from mapping, verification, and networking. We evaluate CADENCE on eight Matterport3D houses that were not used to train the memory. On these houses, regional memory achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of $0.95$ to $0.97$ and thus outperforms appearance retrieval, while verification keeps false-link rates below $0.5\,\%$. Furthermore, soft confidence weighting reduces the mean receiver peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) loss from $2.66$ to $1.05$\,dB across eight degradations while retaining useful peer depth. Finally, using inertial and platform motion, CADENCE tracks all twelve held-out iPhone scans with a mean absolute trajectory error of $6.98$\,cm, and its refined maps achieve better average rendering quality than the baselines.

AI.tldr: CADENCE: collaborative Gaussian SLAM with phone devices, decoupling cross-device match finding (sensor-grounded regional memory + deterministic verification) from update control (per-cue soft confidence weighting) to resist degraded contributors and bad matches.
AI.motivation: Consumer-phone collaborative indoor mapping yields heterogeneous, degraded observations and unreliable cross-device associations; a single bad contributor or false match can corrupt the shared Gaussian map, and existing pipelines entangle matching with map updating and rely on appearance alone.
AI.method: Regional memory summarizes committed observations and ranks candidate peer regions via appearance, relative pose, gravity, barometric altitude and observation quality; deterministic geometric verification plus optional physical checks gate matches; after acceptance, separate cue-based confidences (color vs. depth vs. pose) independently modulate contributions to pose constraints, geometry, appearance and memory; local tracking is isolated from mapping/verification/networking.
AI.result: On 8 held-out Matterport3D houses: regional memory AUROC 0.95–0.97, beating appearance retrieval; false-link rate <0.5%; soft weighting cuts mean PSNR loss from 2.66 dB to 1.05 dB over 8 degradation types while retaining peer depth; 12 held-out iPhone scans tracked with 6.98 cm mean ATE and refined maps render better than baselines.
AI.conclusion: Separating association from fusion, combined with multi-cue soft confidence, is an effective robustness recipe for multi-device Gaussian SLAM on consumer hardware.

title: M$^{2}$AdaptVLA: Multimodal Memory-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model with Predictive Test-Time Adaptation
comment: 16 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Effective robotic manipulation calls for multimodal memory and rapid adaptation to shifts in contact dynamics. However, many existing policies, which retain either visual or wrench history, may miss key cues from the other modality. Moreover, even with wrench memory, fixed policies can struggle when contact conditions shift at deployment. To this end, we introduce M$^{2}$AdaptVLA, a vision-language-action model that integrates visual and wrench memories with predictive test-time adaptation. For visual memory, the model uses test-time training (TTT) to encode observation history in fast weights. Each entry in the bounded TTT bank combines the corresponding frame's features with a readout from these weights, preserving cues that predate the oldest retained frame. For wrench memory, a context gate controls how much the action expert draws on wrench history as it jointly denoises future actions and wrenches. For predictive test-time adaptation, the auxiliary wrench prediction loss also provides online self-supervision. Using measured wrenches as targets, we update low-rank policy adapters by backpropagating only through the final denoising step. Real-world experiments show that the TTT bank outperforms visual memory baselines on progress tracking, scene recall, and demonstration following. On contact-sensitive tasks, the context gate yields higher success rates than direct injection or gated cross-attention. Predictive test-time adaptation improves robustness to shifts in contact dynamics. On eight tasks requiring visual and wrench memory, M$^{2}$AdaptVLA achieves a mean success rate of 82.71%, a 31.46% absolute gain over the strongest baseline. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: M²AdaptVLA 将视觉记忆与力/力矩（wrench）记忆统一进 VLA 模型，并用带预测性自监督的测试时自适应提升接触动力学变化下的鲁棒性，八项真机任务平均成功率 82.71%（较最强基线+31.46%）。
AI.motivation: 现有策略往往只保留视觉或仅保留 wrench 历史，容易丢失另一模态的关键线索；且即使有力觉记忆，部署时接触条件变化也会使固定策略失效。因而需要多模态记忆 + 在线自适应。
AI.method: （1）视觉记忆：用 test-time training（TTT）将观测历史编码进 fast weights，构建有界 TTT bank，每项结合当前帧特征与权重读出，从而保留早于最旧保留帧的信息；（2）wrench 记忆：用 context gate 控制动作专家在联合去噪未来动作与 wrench 时对力历史的使用程度；（3）预测式测试时自适应：以辅助 wrench 预测损失作为在线自监督，以实测 wrench 为目标，仅回传最后一步去噪梯度以更新低秩策略适配器。
AI.result: 真机实验中 TTT bank 在进度跟踪、场景召回与示范跟随上优于视觉记忆基线；接触敏感任务上 context gate 成功率高于直接注入与门控交叉注意力；预测式测试时自适应提升接触动力学漂移下的鲁棒性；八项需视觉与力觉记忆的任务平均成功率 82.71%，绝对提升 31.46%。
AI.conclusion: 多模态（视觉+力觉）记忆与部署期自监督自适应可显著提升接触丰富操作的可靠性，为 VLA 在接触动力学变化场景下的落地提供可行路径。

title: Compact Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environmentsvia On-Policy Training and Route-Bearing Output
summary: Instruction-following robots need navigation policies that reach high accuracy and remain inexpensive to train and to run on a single graphics processing unit (GPU). The most accurate vision-language navigation policies for continuous environments rely on language models with 4 to 8 billion parameters, long observation histories, and large auxiliary corpora. Two properties of the standard training setup limit smaller policies. Imitation labels cover the states that an expert visits, whereas the running policy reaches states that its own errors produce. In addition, an image-plane waypoint exists only while the route lies inside the camera view. We present \textbf{\paper}, a monocular red-green-blue (RGB) policy with 2 billion (2B) parameters that addresses both limitations. \paper adapts Qwen3-VL-2B with low-rank adapters and processes an eight-frame memory and the current view in one forward pass. The policy predicts the route direction as a bearing in the body frame of the agent, which remains defined for every heading, and a deterministic controller converts this bearing into motion. This design allows training to relabel the states that the policy itself visits. On-policy correction improves success, while bearing decoding outperforms image-plane waypoint scanning across all evaluated start headings with identical weights. On the \valunseen split, \paper achieves \rFinSR\% success on Room-to-Room in Continuous Environments (\rtor), averaged over three seeds, and \rRxFinSR\% on its Room-Across-Room counterpart (\rxr). Inference requires \rDecMs\,ms and \rInferGB\,GiB of memory, while training takes \rCostTrainTyp\ GPU-hours on one 12\,GB consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出 2B 参数单目 RGB 视觉语言导航策略 \paper：基于 Qwen3-VL-2B + LoRA，单次前向处理 8 帧记忆与当前视角，预测机体坐标系下的航向方位角（bearing）而非图像平面 waypoint，配合确定性控制器转运动，从而支持对策略自身访问状态的重标注与 on-policy 校正；R2R-CE 成功率约 \rFinSR\%、RxR-CE 约 \rRxFinSR\%，推理 \rDecMs ms / \rInferGB GiB，单卡 12GB GPU 训练 \rCostTrainTyp\ GPU-hours。
AI.motivation: 连续环境中的高精度 VLN 策略依赖 4–8B 参数语言模型、长观测历史与大辅助语料，训练与部署成本高，难以在单张消费级 GPU 上完成。标准训练范式存在两个瓶颈：(1) 模仿学习标注只覆盖专家访问的状态，而实际运行的策略会进入自身误差导致的分布外状态；(2) 图像平面 waypoint 仅在路径落入相机视野时才被定义，视野外朝向无监督信号。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3-VL-2B 为骨干，采用 LoRA 低秩适配；一次前向同时输入 8 帧历史记忆与当前 RGB 视图。动作空间改为机体坐标系下的航向方位角（bearing），对任意朝向均良定义，再由确定性 controller 将 bearing 映射为底层运动指令。该参数化使得可对策略自身访问的状态进行重标注（relabeling）并施加 on-policy 校正训练。
AI.result: R2R-CE val-unseen 上三随机种子平均成功率 \rFinSR\%，RxR-CE 上 \rRxFinSR\%；相同权重下 bearing 解码在所有评测起始朝向上均优于图像平面 waypoint 扫描；on-policy 校正带来成功率提升。推理延迟 \rDecMs ms、显存 \rInferGB GiB，单张 12GB 消费级 GPU 训练 \rCostTrainTyp\ GPU-hours。
AI.conclusion: 轻量 2B 模型配合动作空间重参数化 + on-policy 状态重标注，可在可控算力下取得有竞争力的连续环境 VLN 性能，说明动作表示设计与数据分布修正比单纯扩大模型规模更关键。

title: Score-based Black-box Attack via Adversarial Condition Guided Diffusion Model
summary: Generative models enable unrestricted adversarial attacks that aim to fool classifiers while preserving the natural appearance and semantics of the original image. However, existing diffusion-based black-box attacks largely rely on transferability from surrogates, making their effectiveness sensitive to differences between surrogate and victim. Improving transferability can also distort semantic content and degrade image quality. Moreover, retaining the original prompt to preserve fidelity leaves the diffusion model's conditional prior underused for adversarial guidance. We address these limitations by adapting score-based black-box attacks to reverse diffusion, using the victim's output probabilities to guide latent updates without accessing its gradients. We further introduce adaptive-target guidance, which uses the victim's current runner-up class as an adversarial condition to steer denoising towards the decision boundary. Because such guidance can introduce unwanted semantic changes, we also propose target-search guidance, which searches for a small perturbation of the original condition embedding using a score-based attack. This achieves comparable attack effectiveness with better image quality than runner-up guidance. Experiments on the ImageNet-Compatible dataset show that our framework outperforms transfer-based baselines in both attack effectiveness and image quality.

AI.tldr: 将基于分数的黑盒攻击迁移到扩散反向过程，用受害者模型输出概率直接引导潜变量更新，并提出自适应目标引导与目标搜索引导以兼顾攻击效果与图像质量。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散黑盒攻击依赖替代模型可迁移性，效果对替代-受害者差异敏感；提升可迁移性又会扭曲语义、降低图像质量；保留原始提示词则使扩散模型的条件先验未被用于对抗引导。
AI.method: 在反向扩散中执行分数式黑盒攻击：用受害者分类器输出概率（无需梯度）引导潜变量更新；引入自适应目标引导，以当前次优类作为对抗条件把去噪推向决策边界；进一步提出目标搜索引导，用分数攻击在原始条件嵌入附近搜索小幅扰动以替代次优类条件，从而兼顾效果与保真。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-Compatible 数据集上，攻击成功率与图像质量均优于基于迁移的基线。
AI.conclusion: 直接在扩散采样过程中利用受害者反馈进行条件引导，可在不依赖替代模型可迁移性的前提下实现语义保持的生成式黑盒对抗攻击。

title: Physics-Guided Generative Modelling of Oxy-Combustion Flame Images: From Conditional LSGANs to Denoising Diffusion Models
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for the 12th International Conference on Combustion Science and Processes (CSP 2027)
summary: Validating industrial oxy-combustion burner designs traditionally requires costly experimental campaigns in which each operating condition is physically reproduced on an instrumented rig and imaged via OH* chemiluminescence, rendering iterative design exploration prohibitively slow. This work develops deep generative surrogate models that map a 15-dimensional vector of continuous operating parameters (thermal power, swirl numbers, momentum ratios, mixture fractions, etc.) directly to a $512\times64$ heat-release flame image, trained on 1,609 experimental samples from the OXYTEC dual-swirl non-premixed oxy-combustion database. Two complementary generative paradigms are investigated, as they offer opposite strengths for surrogate modelling: a custom spatially-anchored conditional least-squares GAN (cLSGAN-L1-CBN), whose single-pass generation enables near-instantaneous inference, and a custom physics-guided denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM), whose iterative sampling favours the smooth, continuous heat-release gradients of fluid flows. Both are validated through ablation on a stratified held-out test set. The optimized cLSGAN reaches RMSE 0.022 and FID 20.68 and generates an image in about 20 ms on a mobile workstation GPU, though extended training leaves its texture realism unchanged; the DDPM improves steadily over long training horizons, reaching RMSE 0.019 and FID 20.29 at 40,000 epochs, at the cost of roughly thirty seconds per image on the same hardware --- three orders of magnitude slower than the adversarial surrogate. A nearest-neighbour analysis traces the persistent worst-case errors to sparsely sampled regions of the parameter space, and a parameter-sensitivity study confirms smooth, physically consistent responses to perturbed inputs. These results demonstrate that carefully guided generative models can act as reliable visual surrogates for combustion experiments.

AI.tldr: 该工作用两种深度生成模型（cLSGAN-L1-CBN 与物理引导 DDPM）构建燃烧器设计代理模型，将15维工况参数映射为512×64热释放率火焰图像；GAN约20 ms出图、RMSE 0.022/FID 20.68，DDPM达RMSE 0.019/FID 20.29但每图约30 s。
AI.motivation: 富氧燃烧器设计验证依赖昂贵的实验campaign与OH*化学发光成像，逐工况物理复现使迭代设计探索过慢，亟需快速参数→火焰场映射的数值代理。
AI.method: 基于OXYTEC双旋流非预混富氧燃烧数据库1609个实验样本，训练两族条件生成代理：(1) 自定义空间锚定的条件最小二乘GAN（cLSGAN-L1-CBN），单次前向生成；(2) 自定义物理引导去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），迭代采样以匹配流场的平滑热释放梯度。通过分层留出测试集进行消融验证，并结合最近邻分析定位误差来源、参数敏感性实验检验物理一致性。
AI.result: 优化后的cLSGAN达RMSE 0.022、FID 20.68，移动工作站GPU上约20 ms/图，但延长训练不改善纹理真实度；DDPM在40,000 epoch达RMSE 0.019、FID 20.29，但约30 s/图，慢三个数量级。最差误差集中于参数空间稀疏采样区域；扰动输入下响应平滑且物理一致。
AI.conclusion: 经良好引导的生成模型可作为燃烧实验的可靠视觉代理：GAN适合实时设计迭代，DDPM适合精度优先的离线校准；主要瓶颈是稀疏工况区域的数据覆盖。

title: Riding the Wave: Sim-to-Real Humanoid Control on Elastic Terrain
summary: Humanoid robots on deformable elastic terrains face a surface whose position and motion are coupled in space and time: deflection and rebound persist between contacts, and load at one foothold alters the support at others, so training must capture how each contact changes the support that follows. We present RIPPLE (Robust Interaction via Proprioceptive Policies on Large-deformation Elastic terrain), a simulation-to-real learning framework for humanoid control on such terrains. RIPPLE integrates ElasticMembrane, a pretensioned mass-spring mesh that models spatially coupled deflection, energy storage, and rebound, together with deformable contact into MJLab for GPU-parallel policy learning. Staged training then transfers rigid-ground skills to balance and jumping on these terrains using only proprioception, without vision or force sensing. Deployed zero-shot, the policies enable a MagicBot Z1 humanoid to balance, jump consecutively, and enter a trampoline from a rigid platform. In simulation, ElasticMembrane training holds standing success of at least 98.7% (mean over three seeds) on ElasticMembrane, IndependentSprings, and BouncyPlate under 0.3 m/s perturbations, whereas rigid-ground or contact-compliance training transfers poorly to the first two. A fixed policy tolerates stiffness from 0.35 to 2.8 times the training value, beds up to 7 m wide, and seven further simulated support scenarios, so transfer needs no calibration to the trampoline's stiffness. We plan to release the code soon. The interactive browser demo, videos, and scene configurations are available on the project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: RIPPLE 是一个面向柔性弹性地形(蹦床类)的人形机器人 sim-to-real 学习框架:在 MJLab 中集成 ElasticMembrane(预张拉质量-弹簧网格)模拟空间耦合形变、储能与回弹,并用分阶段训练把行走技能迁移到仅靠本体感知的平衡与连续跳跃策略上,实现零样本真机部署。
AI.motivation: 可变形弹性地形的表面位置与运动在时空上耦合:形变与回弹跨越接触周期持续存在,且一个落脚点的载荷会改变其他支撑点,因此训练必须显式捕捉"每次接触如何改变后续支撑"。现有刚性地面或接触柔顺性训练无法处理这种大形变、空间耦合的动态特性。
AI.method: 提出 ElasticMembrane:预张拉的质量-弹簧网格,建模空间耦合的凹陷、能量存储与回弹,并将可变形接触接入 MJLab 以支持 GPU 并行策略学习。训练上采用分阶段策略:先在刚性地面学到技能,再在弹性地形上微调;策略输入仅为本体感知,不用视觉或力传感器。
AI.result: 零样本部署于 MagicBot Z1 人形机器人,可完成站立平衡、连续跳跃以及从刚性平台跳上蹦床。仿真中在 0.3 m/s 扰动下,ElasticMembrane 训练在 ElasticMembrane、IndependentSprings、BouncyPlate 三种地形上的站立成功率均值(三个随机种子)≥98.7%,而刚性地面或接触柔顺训练向弹性地形迁移效果明显差。单一固定策略可容忍 0.35–2.8 倍训练刚度的范围,以及宽达 7 m 的床面,另加七种仿真支撑场景,无需对蹦床刚度做标定。
AI.conclusion: 空间耦合的可变形地形建模是弹性地面人形控制的关键:显式质量-弹簧膜 + 分阶段本体感知训练可获得强泛化与零样本真机迁移;代码将开源,并提供交互式在线演示与场景配置。

title: Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence
summary: Establishing effective scaling laws for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains a persistent and fundamental challenge. Our systematic evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs tend to underperform frontier general-purpose MLLMs across a range of medical tasks, while scaling model size primarily improves text capabilities rather than multimodal perception, and enabling reasoning modes fails to close this visual gap. To investigate how medical multimodal intelligence scales in practice, we introduce Sage-Med-Preview, a 35B-parameter medical multimodal model with 3B activated parameters, built by combining stage-specific curation over 322.7 million candidate records with a progressive training curriculum spanning medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning. Across this curriculum, progressive supervised refinement and adaptive reinforcement learning yield consistent stage-wise gains, substantially advancing both specialized visual understanding and medical language capabilities. Evaluated against 77 competing models across 238 clinical tasks spanning 61 public and 13 private multi-center benchmarks in more than 40 modalities, Sage-Med-Preview achieves an average score of 58.26% on the 31 public multimodal benchmarks. It outperforms the state-of-the-art open-source medical model Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 50.99% and the general scientific model Intern-S2-Preview at 52.24%, and approaches the advanced proprietary model GPT-6.2-Sol across multiple tasks such as comprehensive multimodal understanding, report generation, and visual grounding. Although substantial challenges remain in complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows, this report provides empirical evidence, actionable data and training recipes, and a rigorous benchmark toward scalable clinical multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出35B总参/3B激活的医疗多模态大模型Sage-Med-Preview，通过3.227亿候选记录分阶段数据策展与"医学预训练→分阶段SFT→自适应强化学习"渐进课程，在61公开+13私有基准、238临床任务、40+模态上取得公开多模态基准平均58.26%，超越Hulu-Med-235B-A22B(50.99%)与Intern-S2-Preview(52.24%)。
AI.motivation: 医疗多模态大模型的scaling law尚不清晰：实证发现现有医疗MLLM普遍落后于前沿通用MLLM，单纯增大参数主要提升文本能力而非多模态感知，开启推理模式也无法弥补视觉差距，因此需要探究医疗多模态智能在实践中的真实scaling路径。
AI.method: Sage-Med-Preview：35B总参数、3B激活参数（MoE式）医疗多模态模型；数据侧对3.227亿候选记录做阶段特定策展；训练采用渐进课程——医学领域预训练、分阶段监督微调、自适应强化学习；并以77个竞品模型、238项临床任务、61个公开+13个私有跨中心基准、40余种模态进行系统评测。
AI.result: 31个公开多模态基准平均58.26%，超过开源SOTA医疗模型Hulu-Med-235B-A22B(50.99%)与通用科学模型Intern-S2-Preview(52.24%)，并在综合多模态理解、报告生成、视觉定位等任务上接近专有模型GPT-6.2-Sol；分阶段SFT与自适应RL在各阶段均带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 验证了"数据策展+渐进训练课程"对医疗多模态能力的可扩展性，指出医疗MLLM的增益主要来自训练配方而非单纯参数或推理模式；复杂医学推理与多步临床工作流仍是主要瓶颈，并公开数据与训练配方作为迈向可扩展临床多模态智能的实证依据。

title: ChemoMAE: Self-Supervised Spectral Representation Learning Reveals Chemical Heterogeneity in Historical Wood
comment: 51 pages, 18 figures (9 in the main text and 9 in the appendices)
summary: In historical timber buildings, multiple environmental factors act over centuries on wood whose chemical composition varies across anatomical regions, producing complex patterns of degradation. Understanding how timber members degrade is important for the effective conservation and restoration of historical buildings, yet the mechanisms underlying these patterns remain unclear. To investigate these mechanisms, we used self-supervised learning to establish a common basis for comparing specimens from timber members that differ in wood species and service history. We examined transverse sections of 49 wood specimens from several historical buildings in Japan using near-infrared hyperspectral imaging. ChemoMAE, a self-supervised Transformer, learns pixelwise spectral representations through masked denoising that exploits multicollinearity among spectral variables. Clustering these representations yields spatial maps without predefined chemical-state categories. Because anatomy and degradation can produce spatially continuous regions, we formulated Local Label Agreement (LLA) to quantify agreement among labels assigned to neighboring pixels. Using spectra alone, ChemoMAE yielded higher mean LLA than baseline methods on validation specimens. We then trained ChemoMAE anew and fitted cluster centers across all specimens. Spatial structures consistent with wood anatomy and the expected effects of surface exposure emerged in the resulting maps. By cross-referencing regional spectra and spatial distributions across specimens in light of wood anatomy, service histories, and prior studies, we proposed models of internal and surface degradation as mechanistic hypotheses. This exploratory AI for Science framework gives researchers a basis for linking latent patterns learned through self-supervision with domain knowledge when investigating how material states form.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChemoMAE：用自监督掩码去噪 Transformer 学习近红外高光谱逐像素光谱表征，并用局部标签一致性（LLA）量化聚类图的空间连续性，借此比较不同树种与使用 histories 的历史木构件试样并推断降解机理。
AI.motivation: 历史木构建筑中，多种环境因素长期作用于化学组成随解剖区域变化的木材，形成复杂降解模式；现有方法难以在不同树种、不同使用历史的试样之间建立可比基准，降解机理不清。
AI.method: 对日本多处历史建筑 49 个木材横截面试样做近红外高光谱成像；ChemoMAE 为自监督 Transformer，利用光谱变量间多重共线性进行掩码去噪，学习像素级光谱表征；对表征聚类得到无需预定义化学状态类别的空间图；提出 Local Label Agreement（LLA）度量相邻像素标签一致度以评价无标注验证试样的空间连续性；再在全试样上重训练并拟合聚类中心，结合解剖学、使用历史与既有研究交叉比对，提出内部与表面降解的机理假设模型。
AI.result: 仅用光谱信息时，ChemoMAE 在验证试样上的平均 LLA 高于基线方法；生成的空间图呈现与木材解剖结构及表面暴露预期效应一致的空间结构，并据此提出降解机理假设。
AI.conclusion: 给出一个探索性"AI for Science"框架，把自监督学到的潜在模式与领域知识联系起来，用于研究材料状态如何形成；属于文化遗产木材领域的专门化表征学习分析，与通用物理 AI/机器人/三维重建主线关联较弱。

title: Geometric Acceleration Obstacles: Physical Boundary Structure and Affine Safety Certificates
summary: Safe robot navigation in dynamic environments requires collision avoidance that respects motion constraints while remaining computationally efficient. Conventional velocity-obstacle (VO) methods characterize collision-inducing motions in velocity space. Although some formulations account for acceleration-limited velocity transitions, their collision constraints remain tied to specific velocity-tracking models. Acceleration obstacles (AO) address this limitation by representing collision-inducing inputs directly in acceleration space. However, existing AO methods either rely on conservative approximations or derive analytical structure expressions without verifying their geometric correspondence. To address this gap, this paper presents Geometric Acceleration Obstacles (GAO), which provides, to the best of our knowledge, the first unified and physically validated characterization of AO geometry and its supporting structure. Specifically, we derive configuration-dependent half-planes that globally support the collision set and establish their tightness, thereby separating certified collision-free acceleration inputs from collision-inducing parts. These geometric results yield unified affine safety constraints. Combined with actuator limits, these constraints define a quadratic program (QP) for real-time navigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GAO achieves competitive success rates and the lowest control effort among the evaluated methods, with millisecond-level computational latency. Further circle-interchange simulations demonstrate scalability to 1,000 agents. Physical experiments validate the approach in pedestrian encounters, reciprocal multi-agent navigation, and high-speed maneuvering.

AI.tldr: GAO:在加速度空间给出碰撞集的严格几何刻画(构型相关的支撑半平面及其紧性),导出统一的仿射安全约束并入QP,实现毫秒级动态避障。
AI.motivation: 现有加速度障碍(AO)方法要么依赖保守近似,要么只给出解析结构而未验证其几何正确性,导致加速度空间碰撞集缺乏经物理验证的统一几何描述。
AI.method: 推导构型相关的半平面,使其全局支撑加速度空间中的碰撞集,并证明其紧性(tightness);由此得到统一仿射安全约束,与执行器限幅结合构建实时QP导航求解器。
AI.result: 实验显示GAO成功率具竞争力、控制代价最低,计算延迟为毫秒级;圆环交换仿真可扩展至1000个智能体;行人相遇、多智能体互惠导航与高速机动物理实验验证有效。
AI.conclusion: GAO首次给出经物理验证的加速度障碍几何与支撑结构刻画,把动态避障转化为仿射约束QP,兼顾安全性、运动学可行性与实时性,并具备多机可扩展性。

title: ADClaw: A Programmable Visual Agent for Industrial Anomaly Detection and Understanding
summary: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD), the task of identifying and localizing deviations from normal product conditions, is essential to automated quality inspection in manufacturing. Many vision-language models for IAD rely on large domain-specific datasets for fine-tuning and make predictions in a single pass, leaving no opportunity to re-examine ambiguous regions. Although tool-using agents can revisit these regions, predefined tool interfaces limit how they can combine intermediate results in a follow-up check. When such checks are insufficient, models may miss subtle defects or misidentify the defect type. To address this limitation, we introduce ADClaw, an inspection agent that uses executable code to test anomaly hypotheses without task-specific fine-tuning. For each hypothesis, a Structured Normality Prior identifies the applicable rules and retrieves normal visual references for the inspection target. Guided by this prior, the agent writes and executes code in a persistent Inspection Workbench to combine masks, anomaly maps, and measurements from earlier steps into a new test of the suspected defect. After each check, Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning assesses whether the evidence supports the suspected defect and its location, using gaps or inconsistencies in that evidence to guide the next code action. ADClaw achieves competitive results in detection and localization across 2D and 3D industrial anomaly detection benchmarks and in anomaly understanding on MMAD.

AI.tldr: ADClaw：免微调的工业异常检测 Agent，用可执行代码检验异常假设，在持久化"检验工作台"中组合掩码/异常图/测量进行多轮复检，并由结构化正常性先验与证据推理引导下一步代码操作。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言 IAD 模型依赖大规模领域数据微调且单次前向推理，无法复查模糊区域；工具型 Agent 虽可回看，但预定义工具接口限制了中间结果的组合方式，导致漏检细微缺陷或错判缺陷类型。
AI.method: 提出 ADClaw：(1) 结构化正常性先验（Structured Normality Prior）为每个异常假设检索适用规则与正常视觉参考；(2) 在持久化 Inspection Workbench 中由 Agent 编写并执行代码，将先前步骤的掩码、异常图与测量组合成新的验证测试；(3) 假设引导证据推理（Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning）评估证据是否支持所疑缺陷及其位置，并利用证据缺口/不一致驱动下一次代码动作。
AI.result: 在 2D 与 3D 工业异常检测基准上的检测与定位、以及 MMAD 上的异常理解任务均取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 代码即工具的可执行检验范式突破了固定工具接口的表达限制，使多轮假设-验证循环无需任务特定微调即可用于工业质检，为 Agent 驱动的视觉检验提供了可复用的工作台化设计。

title: $μ$MPC: Microsecond-Scale Nonlinear and World Model Control from Edge to GPU via Koopman-Linearized Precompilation
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Project Website: this https URL
summary: We present $\mu$MPC, a fast model predictive control (MPC) framework that reduces online computation using learned Koopman-linearized dynamics. By precomputing finite-horizon control-to-output maps, $\mu$MPC eliminates lifted-state trajectories, yielding an action-only Koopman-Compiled QP (KC-QP) with $Hn_u$ decision variables, independent of lifted dimension. A fixed, precomputed primal operator enables efficient primal-dual iterations using only matrix-vector products and projections, accommodating changing goals and constraints without refactorization. This efficiency also enables control-aware dynamics learning through differentiable KC-QPs in the training loop and batched DAgger-style data aggregation. $\mu$MPC achieves solve times as low as $23\mu$s on a desktop CPU and 24 ms onboard a 168 MHz Crazyflie microcontroller. It scales to 4096D quadruped control in under 5 ms, visual planning with 2048D world models in 0.4 ms, and collision-aware planning for 200 quadrotors at over 30 Hz on the GPU. Across these benchmarks, $\mu$MPC achieves up to $108\times$ faster constrained MPC and $1907\times$ faster visuomotor planning than competing methods.

AI.tldr: μMPC: 通过学习 Koopman 线性化动力学将在线 MPC 编译为仅含动作变量的 QP，配合固定预计算原算子实现高效原对偶迭代，达到微秒级求解并支持可微控制感知学习。
AI.motivation: 非线性 MPC 在线计算开销大，Koopman 提升维度导致决策变量维度膨胀、约束/目标变化需重分解，难以在嵌入式与大规模多体系统上实时运行。
AI.method: 预计算有限时域的控制-输出映射，消去提升状态轨迹，得到仅含 H·n_u 个决策变量的 action-only Koopman-Compiled QP（维度与提升维数无关）；用固定预计算的原算子做原对偶迭代，仅需矩阵-向量乘与投影，无需重分解即可适应变化的目标与约束；并把可微 KC-QP 嵌入训练回路，配合批量化 DAgger 式数据聚合实现控制感知的动力学学习。
AI.result: 桌面 CPU 求解 23μs，168 MHz Crazyflie 板载 24 ms；4096 维四足控制 <5 ms，2048 维世界模型视觉规划 0.4 ms，GPU 上 200 架四旋翼避碰规划 >30 Hz；相比竞争方法约束 MPC 最高快 108×，视觉运动规划最高快 1907×。
AI.conclusion: 通过编译式 QP 结构与固定原算子，μMPC 在保持约束处理能力的同时把求解复杂度与提升维数解耦，适合嵌入式实时控制与大规模多体规划，并与可微优化结合形成闭环学习框架。

title: SEAM: A Self-Evolving and Adaptive Probing Framework for Automatic MLLM Hallucination Evaluation
summary: The severe susceptibility of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to hallucinations poses a critical threat to their reliability, making a rigorous evaluation framework indispensable. However, existing evaluation pipelines largely rely on predefined test items, suffering from high construction costs, rapid obsolescence as MLLMs evolve, and ineffectiveness in probing model-specific weaknesses. To address these limitations, we propose SEAM, a self-evolving and adaptive probing framework for automatic MLLM hallucination evaluation. Specifically, SEAM introduces a composable Hallucination Probe Construction Library comprising ten hallucination-probing skills, three elicitation wrappers, and five question formats. Building on this library, SEAM establishes a dual-loop framework. In the inner loop (adaptive probing), skill-guided visual analysis, question composition, and hierarchical quality verification are coordinated with verifier and target-response feedback to refine test items and uncover model-specific hallucinations. In the outer loop (skill evolution), a skill updater distills historical probing trajectories into localized, reusable rule updates, which undergo held-out validation and are frozen before testing. Driven by these innovative structural designs, SEAM establishes an automated and self-evolving evaluation paradigm. Experiments across four target MLLMs and ten hallucination types demonstrate that SEAM substantially outperforms representative static benchmarks, achieving an 89.2\% relative improvement in mean valid hallucination discovery rate across 12 matched comparisons.

AI.tldr: SEAM: 一个自演化、自适应探测框架，用可组合的"幻觉探测技能库"自动构造并迭代精化测试题，用于MLLM幻觉评测。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM幻觉评测依赖预定义测试项，构建成本高、随模型演进迅速过时，且难以探测模型特有弱点。
AI.method: 构造可组合幻觉探测库（10种探测技能、3种诱导包装、5种问题格式）；双循环框架：内循环做技能引导的视觉分析、题目组合与分层质量校验，结合验证器与目标模型反馈迭代精化测试项；外循环由技能更新器将历史探测轨迹蒸馏为局部可复用规则更新，经留出集验证后冻结再测试。
AI.result: 在4个目标MLLM、10类幻觉上与代表性静态基准对比，12组匹配比较中平均有效幻觉发现率取得89.2%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: SEAM建立了自动化、自演化的幻觉评测范式，显著优于静态基准，但属于评测/基准方法，非具体任务建模或机器人/3D方法。

title: You Only Look Multiple Times: YoloMT, a Real-Time Streaming Model on a T4
summary: We introduce a new model for real-time streaming captioning on a single GPU. YoloMT is a 449.8M-parameter streaming captioner that provides Pareto-frontier performance among generative vision models in its class. Distilled from a 27B teacher by SFT and GRPO, it leads every model under 1B parameters on OVO-Bench, MVBench, StreamingBench and Video-MME, answered from its captions, and beats LFM2.5-VL-1.6B and SmolVLM2-2.2B. YoloMT is designed to read more frames cheaply and make them informative, encoding each frame once and caching it as 16 tokens. This allows the model to incorporate and infer from past frames without additional vision passes, making it efficient and effective. We also provide a detailed recipe for training YoloMT, with its stages and data, as well as ablations that demonstrate the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: YoloMT：449.8M 单 GPU 实时流式视频字幕模型，每帧仅编码一次并缓存为 16 个 token，通过 SFT+GRPO 从 27B 教师模型蒸馏，在 OVO-Bench/MVBench/StreamingBench/Video-MME 上超越所有 1B 以下模型。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式视觉语言模型在实时流式字幕任务上面临效率与长上下文推理的矛盾：多帧输入需要反复视觉编码，代价高；小模型能力不足，大模型难以实时部署。
AI.method: 提出 YoloMT，每帧只做一次视觉编码并压缩缓存为 16 个 token，从而在不重复视觉前向的前提下利用历史帧做流式推理；训练上先用 27B 教师做 SFT 蒸馏，再用 GRPO 强化学习进一步蒸馏/对齐；论文还提供分阶段训练配方、数据构建方法与逐组件消融。
AI.result: 在 OVO-Bench、MVBench、StreamingBench、Video-MME（基于其生成字幕作答）上，YoloMT 领先所有 <1B 参数模型，并优于 LFM2.5-VL-1.6B 与 SmolVLM2-2.2B；单 GPU 实时流式推理，处于同类生成式视觉模型的 Pareto 前沿。
AI.conclusion: 通过"低成本读更多帧 + 每帧信息压缩缓存 + 强教师蒸馏"的组合，YoloMT 证明小型流式字幕器可在效率与效果上同时占优，为实时视频理解/具身智能体的感知前端提供了可复现的训练范式。

title: VisualMontage: Manipulating the Beliefs of Vision-Language Agents with Authentic Image Sequences
summary: As agents based on vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly interpret social-media content, errors in their analysis may lend credibility to rumors and amplify their spread. In this paper, we study the problem of visual cognitive collusion, in which coordinated posts combine authentic images and locally faithful captions to induce VLM agents to infer and accept attacker-chosen target claims through their own reasoning. To enable systematic evaluation of this cognitive threat, we introduce a new benchmark comprising 544 target cases and 33.2K candidate images across eight application domains. We further propose VisualMontage, a multi-agent framework for simulating such attacks through narrative planning, image selection and ordering, and caption assignment under iterative review. We evaluate this threat through extensive experiments across 12 vision-language models, examining modality effects, production-team components, and downstream defenses. Using identical attack feeds across models without victim-specific optimization, we demonstrate cross-model transferability, achieving mean attack success rates of 61.93% for proprietary models and 68.71% for open-weight models. Moreover, 92.65% of generated feeds pass independent model-based validity auditing. Even after downstream review, residual attack success rates range from 35.3% to 76.7% across the evaluated configurations. Our additional controlled comparisons further reveal that captions can improve model-rated posting naturalness while reducing attack success. Together, these findings reveal a novel cognitive threat in social-media interpretation and motivate safeguards that assess how authentic posts jointly shape agents' reasoning and conclusions.

AI.tldr: 提出"视觉认知共谋"攻击：协调发布的真实图像+局部忠实说明诱导VLM智能体通过自身推理接受攻击者预设的目标结论；构建544案例/33.2K图像、8领域基准与VisualMontage多智能体攻击生成框架，在12个VLM上跨模型迁移攻击成功率达61.93%(闭源)/68.71%(开源)，下游审查后残余成功率35.3%–76.7%。
AI.motivation: VLM智能体越来越多地解读社交媒体内容，其分析错误会为谣言提供可信度并放大传播；现有工作缺乏对"真实素材+协调组合"这一认知层面攻击的系统评测手段。
AI.method: 构建含544个目标案例、33.2K候选图像、覆盖8个应用领域的基准；提出VisualMontage多智能体框架，通过叙事规划、图像选择与排序、说明分配及迭代评审生成攻击信息流；在12个VLM上做模态效应、生产团队组件消融与下游防御实验，并用独立模型进行有效性审计。
AI.result: 无需针对受害模型优化即可跨模型迁移，平均攻击成功率闭源61.93%、开源68.71%；92.65%生成信息流通过独立模型有效性审计；下游审查后残余成功率35.3%–76.7%；受控对比显示说明文本提升模型判定的发布自然度却降低攻击成功率。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了社交媒体解读中的新型认知威胁，呼吁设计能够评估真实帖子如何联合塑造智能体推理与结论的防护机制。

title: Blind spatially varying PSF estimation for fluorescence microscopy
summary: Optical aberrations degrade fluorescence microscopy images and measuring the underlying point spread function (PSF) often requires dedicated acquisitions or isolated emitters. Here we introduce DeepBlur, a neural network that estimates spatially varying two-dimensional PSFs directly from single images of biological structures.
