Trained entirely on physical simulations spanning aberrations, illumination and noise, it adapts to diverse imaging conditions without requiring user-supplied optical parameters. Using a deformable mirror, we acquire 1,290 images and assess blind PSF estimates against independent references. DeepBlur estimates agree closely with these references and improve deconvolution of experimentally aberrated images. Local PSF estimation also enables correction of spatially varying defocus and improves random-illumination super-resolution reconstruction in biological tissue. Available through DeepInv, a napari plugin and a web demonstration, DeepBlur can be readily integrated into computational microscopy workflows.

AI.tldr: DeepBlur: 用纯物理仿真训练的神经网络，从单张生物结构图像中盲估计空间变化二维PSF，并提升去卷积与超分辨重建。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微成像中光学像差会退化图像，而测量底层点扩散函数(PSF)通常需要专门采集或孤立点光源，难以在实际生物样本上实现。
AI.method: 训练完全基于物理仿真（覆盖像差、照明与噪声）的神经网络，直接从单张图像预测空间变化的二维PSF，无需用户提供光学参数；用可变形镜采集1,290张图像，与独立参考PSF对比评估，并接入DeepInv、napari插件与网页演示。
AI.result: 盲估计PSF与独立参考高度一致，改善实验像差图像的去卷积；局部PSF估计可校正空间变化离焦，并提升生物组织中随机照明超分辨重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 仿真训练的盲PSF估计可作为通用、易集成的计算显微模块，替代专用采集流程。

title: DuCo: Exploiting Dual Cross-Layer Consistency for Sparse Geometric Attention
summary: Dense global attention is crucial for capturing cross-view geometry in visual geometry foundation models, yet its quadratic complexity limits efficient inference on long image sequences. Existing sparse attention methods primarily select entries of the global attention matrix based on attention probabilities and construct masks independently across layers, overlooking value redundancy and cross-layer information reuse. By analyzing attention distributions and clustering value representations across layers, we reveal two forms of \emph{cross-layer consistency}, characterized by highly similar attention probability distributions and localized changes in value redundancy structures. Building on these observations, we propose \textbf{DuCo}, a training-free sparse attention framework that exploits historical attention information and value redundancy for efficient geometric inference. Specifically, DuCo leverages historical attention information to estimate current-layer dense attention probabilities and introduces value clustering to exploit redundancy, with clusters efficiently refined through local updates across layers. Both factors are integrated through probability-weighted value distortion to jointly optimize four cluster representation states under an attention budget for sparse mask construction. Experiments across three visual geometry foundation models and five benchmarks demonstrate favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练稀疏注意力框架DuCo，利用跨层注意力分布相似性与value冗余结构局部变化这两类跨层一致性，用历史注意力估计当前层概率并做value聚类，经概率加权value失真联合优化四种簇状态以构造稀疏mask。
AI.motivation: 视觉几何基础模型需要稠密全局注意力来刻画跨视角几何，但其平方复杂度限制长图像序列上的高效推理。现有稀疏注意力仅依据注意力概率选条目、且逐层独立建mask，忽略了value冗余与跨层信息复用。
AI.method: 先实证分析注意力分布与value表示的跨层聚类规律：注意力概率分布高度相似、value冗余结构仅局部变化。据此设计DuCo：用历史层的注意力信息估计当前层稠密注意力概率；引入value聚类刻画冗余，并通过跨层局部更新高效精化簇；以概率加权value失真统一两类因素，在注意力预算约束下联合优化四个簇表示状态来生成稀疏mask；全流程免训练。
AI.result: 在三个视觉几何基础模型、五个基准上取得较好的精度—效率折中。
AI.conclusion: 跨层一致性是可复用的结构先验，将历史注意力估计与value冗余聚类联合建模，可在不重新训练的前提下把稠密全局注意力稀疏化，适配几何基础模型的长序列推理。

title: Commit2Drive: Perception-Grounded Language Decisions as Commitments for Trajectory Planning in Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
comment: 28 pages, 9 figures, 19 tables. Includes supplementary material. Code will be released soon
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models introduce language reasoning into end-to-end autonomous driving. They output a language decision together with a trajectory, which makes the planner more interpretable. However, in existing methods the language decision is either an independent output or an index that selects among similar candidate trajectories, and its annotations are not verified against the trajectory. As a result, the language decision and the trajectory are often inconsistent in closed-loop driving. To address this, we propose Commit2Drive, a framework that imposes the language decision as a consistency constraint on trajectory planning. The decision is a commitment, a maneuver class with a continuous parameter that one deterministic rule reads from any trajectory, and it is grounded in facts reported by the perception of the model itself. A Maneuver Bank maps the commitment to a code with a kinematic meaning, and consistency losses train the planner to execute every admissible decision of a scene, so that the trajectory follows the decision. An automatic data pipeline supplies the supervision. Decisions are labeled from the future motion of the expert, counterfactual executions train the decision and the trajectory together, and rule-based functions with a Vision-Language Model (VLM) generate, review and refine the language annotations. The code is a lookup that involves no hidden state of the language model, so Commit2Drive is extensible to rule-based decisions, which the same planner executes without retraining. Commit2Drive uses a 0.5B language model and runs closed-loop inference online on a single consumer graphics card. On Bench2Drive, Commit2Drive reaches a Driving Score (DS) of 78.50 and a Success Rate (SR) of 55.91% with a lightweight model, which is competitive with the state of the art, and greatly reduces the language-action inconsistency. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: Commit2Drive 将语言决策作为轨迹规划的一致性约束：决策被定义为可从任意轨迹确定性读出的"弯道类+连续参数"承诺，配合 Maneuver Bank 与一致性损失，使轨迹必须执行该决策，并用自动数据流水线生成监督。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 自动驾驶方法中，语言决策要么是独立输出、要么只作为相似候选轨迹的索引，且决策标注未与轨迹校验，导致闭环驾驶中语言与轨迹不一致（可解释性名不副实）。
AI.method: 提出 Commit2Drive：1) 决策定义为"承诺"——一个机动类加一个连续参数，由确定性规则从任意轨迹读出，并以自车感知事实为依据；2) Maneuver Bank 将承诺映射为具运动学含义的编码；3) 一致性损失训练规划器执行场景内所有可行决策；4) 自动数据流水线：由专家未来运动标注决策、反事实执行联合训练决策与轨迹、规则函数+VLM 生成/审阅/精修语言标注；5) 编码为查表，不含语言模型隐状态，故可扩展到规则型决策而无需重训。
AI.result: 使用 0.5B 语言模型，单张消费级显卡在线闭环推理；Bench2Drive 上 DS 78.50、SR 55.91%，与 SOTA 相当，并大幅降低语言–动作不一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过对决策施加一致性约束并将语言决策落地为可验证的运动学编码，VLA 驾驶模型可在轻量模型与单卡条件下实现可解释且执行一致的闭环规划，且框架具备向规则型决策扩展的潜力。

title: Beyond Pose Control: Anatomically Consistent Ultrasound Video Generation
summary: Camera-controlled video generation anticipates how a scene appears from new viewpoints by relying on a prior learned implicitly from large-scale data. Ultrasound poses the same problem, with the probe pose as the viewpoint, but under opposite conditions: anatomy offers an explicit prior that every sonographer relies on, whereas tracked scans are too scarce to learn it implicitly. As a result, pose control alone is not enough, and pose-conditioned ultrasound generators produce implausible anatomy in unscanned regions and inconsistent anatomy on revisits. We go beyond pose control and give the generator the two kinds of knowledge that make up a sonographer's mental model. An anatomical prior, built from a population of subjects, guides generation where nothing has been scanned, and is refined online by every generated chunk towards the scanned subject. A 3D latent memory, designed around the cross-sectional physics of ultrasound, compounds the generated slices into a volume of the patient and reslices it at new poses, keeping revisited anatomy consistent. The fine-grained memory enters the generator at the input, while the coarse anatomy prior guides the layout across transformer blocks. Experiments on thyroid, kidney, and lumbar spine show improved visual fidelity, pose following, and anatomical consistency over pose-conditioned and memory-augmented baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出解剖先验+3D潜记忆双重知识驱动的位姿条件超声视频生成框架，提升未扫描区域合理性与重访一致性。
AI.motivation: 超声与相机可控视频生成共享"位姿作为视角"的问题，但条件相反：解剖学提供显式先验，而带追踪的超声扫描数据稀少难以隐式学到先验。仅靠位姿控制会导致未扫描区域解剖不合理、重访问区域不一致。
AI.method: 给生成器注入模拟超声技师心智模型的两种知识：(1) 基于人群受试者构建的解剖先验，在无扫描区域引导生成，并由每个生成块在线精化以趋向被扫描受试者；(2) 针对超声截面物理设计的3D潜记忆，将生成切片累积为患者体数据并在新位姿处重切片。细粒度记忆在输入端注入，粗粒度解剖先验在各Transformer层引导布局。
AI.result: 在甲状腺、肾脏、腰椎三组实验中，视觉保真度、位姿跟随性和解剖一致性均优于位姿条件基线及记忆增强基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式解剖先验与3D潜记忆相结合的生成框架可作为超声自由视角生成的有效范式，弥补追踪数据稀缺下隐式先验的不足。

title: Carrying Feature Ablations Across Sparse Autoencoder Seeds
summary: A vision encoder turns an image into one vector per patch, refined layer by layer. A sparse autoencoder (SAE) writes each vector of one layer as a sum of learned directions, most with a coefficient of zero. Researchers call each direction a feature and edit the encoder by removing one feature. An SAE trained from another random seed learns different features. Earlier work matches the two SAEs' features one to one by how closely their directions agree. Matched features can point alike yet respond to different image parts, so removing them may change the encoder differently. We remove a feature and, separately, its match, then compare the changes in the encoder's output on the same held out images. When the second change nearly reproduces the first, we say the removal carries across seeds. A setting fixes a DINOv2 or SigLIP layer and its SAE feature count. At our tolerance, the removal carries for 12% to 70% of matched pairs across three settings. The share is 0% in two controls: an SAE whose directions stay random and, post hoc, matches shuffled among trained features. Post hoc, predicting which removals carry is more accurate with layer contributions than with directions. Some incorrect predictions remain. One persists on independent images. So pairs can be screened at the layer. Measuring the output detects errors this screen misses.

AI.tldr: 该文提出“移除可迁移性”（removal carries across seeds）判据：独立训练的两个SAE中方向高度一致的配对特征，其对编码器输出的移除效应常不一致（仅12%–70%成立），且用层贡献预测优于用方向预测，但仍存在残差误差。
AI.motivation: 现有工作仅按方向余弦相似度对两个随机种子训练的SAE特征做一对一匹配，但方向相似不等于功能相似（可能响应不同图像区域），因此特征匹配的可靠性存疑，缺少对“匹配是否等价于可互换干预”的验证。
AI.method: 固定DINOv2或SigLIP某层及其SAE特征数，构成三种设置。对每个匹配对，分别移除一个特征与其匹配特征，在相同留出图像上比较编码器输出的变化，变化几乎重合即视为“removal carries”。设置两项对照：方向随机的SAE、以及对训练后特征做打乱的匹配。并比较用层贡献与用方向做移除可迁移性的后验预测。
AI.result: 在容差下，三种设置中12%–70%的匹配对满足移除可迁移；两个对照均为0%。用层贡献预测可迁移性比用方向更准确，但仍存在错误预测，且其中一项错误在独立图像上依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 配对特征可在层级别被筛除（screen at the layer），但仅靠筛选仍不足，测量输出变化能检出该筛选遗漏的错误；即特征匹配需以干预效应而非仅方向一致性判定。

title: PRAM: Activating Latent Multimodal Knowledge through Partwise Reasoning
comment: 36 pages, 8 figures. Project page: this https URL ; Code: this https URL ; Features: this https URL
summary: Emergent cross-modal classification and retrieval enable transfer between modalities without direct paired supervision. However, existing methods often prioritize sample-level alignment, overlooking local discriminative information and partwise statistical relations. To this end, we propose partwise reasoning across modalities (PRAM), which activates latent multimodal knowledge in frozen encoders by composing partwise statistical relations through a shared pivot modality. Specifically, we first present a multi-granularity covariance regularization module that estimates covariances from global and local vectors in two collections of modality-pivot pairs, stabilizing local estimates through adaptive blending with their cross-part means. Second, we devise a pivot-based spectral relational reasoning module that infers global and partwise statistical relations between target modalities through regularized covariance composition and extracts paired projection directions and their correlation strengths via whitening and spectral decomposition. Finally, we introduce a multi-granularity score fusion module that standardizes and fuses matching scores from global and local relations, incorporating task-specific information on pivot associations and class semantics for class prediction and candidate ranking. Extensive experiments across ten datasets demonstrate that PRAM achieves state-of-the-art performance in 16 classification settings and 19 retrieval settings, while exhibiting highly competitive performance in three sensing scenarios.

AI.tldr: PRAM通过共享枢轴模态组合部件级统计关系，在冻结编码器上实现跨模态分类与检索中的涌现式对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有涌现式跨模态方法偏重样本级对齐，忽视局部判别信息与部件间统计关系，需在无配对监督下挖掘更细粒度的结构关系。
AI.method: 提出PRAM框架，含三模块：(1)多粒度协方差正则化，从两条模态-枢轴对集合的全局与局部向量估计协方差，并用跨部件均值自适应混合稳定局部估计；(2)基于枢轴的谱关系推理，通过正则化协方差组合推断目标模态间全局与部件级统计关系，经白化与谱分解提取成对投影方向及相关强度；(3)多粒度分数融合，标准化并融合全局/局部匹配分数，融入枢轴关联与类语义的先验（任务特定信息）用于分类与候选排序。
AI.result: 在十个数据集上，于16个分类设置与19个检索设置达到SOTA，并在三种感知场景中表现极具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以枢轴模态为中介的部件级统计关系组合能有效激活冻结编码器中的潜在多模态知识，为无配对监督的跨模态分类与检索提供细粒度对齐方案。

title: Motion Beyond Pixels: Learning Future Visual Representations for Object-Centric Dynamics
summary: Many embodied world models predict future states in latent spaces optimized for RGB reconstruction, which do not explicitly prioritize object-level semantics and geometry relevant to motion generation. We present MotionRep, a visual representation world model that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow, coupling semantic and geometric information with object-centric dynamics. To make high-dimensional DINO features amenable to generative modeling, we introduce DINO-VAE, which combines temporal and channel compression with latent regularization to produce compact latents while preserving semantic and geometric information. Conditioned on an initial observation, object query points, and a language instruction, a unified diffusion transformer predicts future visual representations and 3D object flow through joint attention. MotionRep employs asymmetric modality-specific noise schedules to keep the visual stream ahead of 3D object flow during joint denoising, allowing progressively refined future visual representations to guide flow generation. Experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MotionRep outperforms pixel-based baselines in 3D object flow accuracy and generalization to unseen scenes, while requiring only three denoising steps for inference. These results support predictive visual representations as an effective future-state space for object-centric dynamics modeling.

AI.tldr: MotionRep：以生成式框架在潜空间同时预测未来DINO语义表征与3D物体流，作为面向物体中心动力学的具身世界模型未来状态空间。
AI.motivation: 现有具身世界模型多在为RGB重建优化的潜空间中预测未来，未显式强调与运动生成相关的物体级语义与几何；作者希望构建同时耦合语义与几何的物体中心未来状态表征。
AI.method: 提出DINO-VAE对高维DINO特征做时间与通道压缩加潜变量正则，得到紧凑潜码并保留语义几何；以初始观测、物体查询点与语言指令为条件，用统一扩散Transformer通过联合注意力同时预测未来视觉表征与3D物体流；采用非对称模态噪声调度，使视觉流在联合去噪中领先于3D流，以渐进细化的未来表征引导流生成。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实操作基准上，3D物体流精度与对未见场景的泛化均优于像素基线，推理仅需3步去噪。
AI.conclusion: 预测性视觉表征可作为物体中心动力学建模的有效未来状态空间，优于像素空间建模。

title: A Hard Background Pairing Transfers across Classifiers and Images
summary: An image classifier names the object in an image, and its accuracy is the share of images named correctly. A classifier that names a car on a road may miss the same car pasted onto clouds. Composite benchmarks measure such failures by pasting objects cut from photographs onto backgrounds from other photographs. A pairing puts every object label on a different background label, such as truck on sea. The pairing on which some classifiers do worst, their hardest pairing, makes a strict test, but may be hard only for them or only on the photographs used to choose it. We show that the hardest pairing of some classifiers stays hard for others and on new photographs. We split 40 ImageNet classifiers into halves balanced by reported ImageNet accuracy. One half picks its hardest pairing of 8 object and 8 background labels from Common Objects in Context (COCO). The other half, held out of the choice, compares that pairing with random pairings of the same objects and backgrounds. For the 14 held-out classifiers with little net accuracy change after pasting objects back onto their own backgrounds, mean accuracy on composites from new photographs falls from 50.3% over random pairings to 43.7% on the hardest pairing, 6.6 percentage points lower. A benchmark using these composites can compare this pool's held-out classifiers on the fixed and random pairings.

AI.tldr: 将COCO物体粘贴到异类背景上构成"复合分类"基准；实验证明某些分类器选出的"最难标签配对"能迁移到其他留出分类器和新图像，使准确率从50.3%降到43.7%。
AI.motivation: 复合基准（物体贴到异源背景）可暴露分类器对上下文/背景的依赖，但"最难配对"可能只对被选出的分类器或在用于挑选的照片上才难，缺乏可迁移性证据。
AI.method: 把40个ImageNet分类器按报告精度均衡分成两半：一半在COCO的8个物体标签×8个背景标签上挑选最难配对；另一半（14个在"物体贴回原背景"后精度变化很小的分类器）作为留出集，在新照片上比较该最难配对与同标签组合的随机配对。
AI.result: 留出分类器在新照片上，随机配对平均准确率50.3%，最难配对43.7%，下降6.6个百分点；说明最难配对可跨模型、跨图像迁移。
AI.conclusion: 固定最难配对可构建可复用的复合基准，用于比较该分类器池中的留出模型，并提供选定配对与随机配对两种对照设定。

title: Atunda: Building an Afrogenic Dance Movement Dataset for AI-Driven Classification
summary: This paper introduces Atunda, the first systematically collected video dataset of Afrogenic dance moves, designed for training and evaluating deep learning models for movement classification. The first phase of the dataset includes nearly 400 videos covering 13 distinct dance moves from African and African Diaspora performative culture, making it the first AI-ready resource of its kind. Using this dataset, we train and evaluate various configurations of temporal convolutional neural networks, achieving a classification accuracy exceeding 95%. The baseline results provide a benchmark for future studies in movement classification, especially in the understudied area of Afrogenic performative culture and tradition. This work lays the foundation for developing in the future digital metrics of similarity, automated attribution systems, and tools that preserve and promote the cultural heritage of Afrogenic dances.

AI.tldr: Atunda数据集：首个系统采集的非洲裔舞蹈动作视频数据集（约400个视频，13类动作），用TCN分类达95%+准确率。
AI.motivation: 非洲与非洲侨民表演文化中的舞动数据在AI研究中长期缺位，缺少可供深度学习训练与评测的标准化视频资源。
AI.method: 构建首个AI可用的Afrogenic舞蹈视频数据集（近400段视频、13类动作）；用多种配置的时间卷积网络（TCN）做动作分类训练与评测，给出baseline。
AI.result: 分类准确率超过95%，为后续动作分类研究提供benchmark基线。
AI.conclusion: 为相似性度量、自动归属系统和文化遗产保护工具奠定数据与基线基础。

title: Nav4Manip: From Navigation to Dexterous Mobile Manipulation through Co-Evolution
summary: Dexterous mobile manipulation is essential for robots to perform useful tasks in complex, unstructured environments. However, existing systems face two challenges. First, navigation remains too coarse for downstream manipulation, which often requires a precise base position and approach orientation rather than merely reaching a meter-scale goal region. Second, navigation and manipulation are commonly trained in isolation, lacking a feedback loop that enables the two capabilities to co-evolve. These limitations prevent current systems from reliably executing long-horizon dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks in real-world environments. To address them, we introduce Nav4Manip, a bidirectionally coupled co-evolution system for long-horizon dexterous mobile manipulation. It comprises two complementary architectures: Nav4Manip-N learns long-horizon navigation and refines its policy through manipulation feedback, while Nav4Manip-M trains a world-action model (WAM) for downstream dexterous manipulation. We train Nav4Manip-N in three stages: multi-task co-tuning learns navigation behavior and manipulation-aware affordance prediction; rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) rejects low-quality policy-generated paths and fine-tunes the model on retained trajectories; and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) uses counterfactual preferences to further improve navigation decisions. To support this framework, we establish the Nav-N-Manip benchmark and construct Nav4Manip-Pairs from benchmark rollouts, providing large-scale paired navigation--manipulation trajectories and affordance supervision. Extensive experiments on public vision-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks and Nav-N-Manip demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while real-world evaluations show that Nav4Manip completes diverse dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: Nav4Manip: 双向耦合的协同进化系统，用于长程灵巧移动操作。N 分支学长程导航并经操作反馈精修（三阶段：多任务协同微调+affordance 预测、RFT 拒绝采样、RLAIF 反事实偏好）；M 分支训练 world-action model 做下游灵巧操作；并构建 Nav-N-Manip 基准与 Nav4Manip-Pairs 配对轨迹数据。
AI.motivation: 现有灵巧移动操作存在两点不足：(1) 导航粒度太粗，只追求米级目标区域，无法为下游操作提供精确基座位姿与接近朝向；(2) 导航与操作孤立训练，缺乏相互反馈、无法协同进化，导致长程任务在真实环境中难以可靠执行。
AI.method: Nav4Manip-N：多任务协同微调（导航行为+操作感知 affordance 预测）→ 拒绝采样微调 RFT（剔除低质量策略生成轨迹）→ RLAIF（反事实偏好优化导航决策）；Nav4Manip-M：训练 world-action model（WAM）做灵巧操作；两分支构成双向耦合反馈闭环。数据侧构建 Nav-N-Manip 基准与 Nav4Manip-Pairs 配对导航-操作轨迹及 affordance 监督。
AI.result: 在公开 VLN 基准与 Nav-N-Manip 上取得 SOTA；真实世界实验完成多种灵巧移动操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过操作反馈驱动导航精化、并以导航质量提升反哺操作的协同进化范式，可有效提升长程灵巧移动操作的可执行性与可靠性；配套基准与配对数据为该方向提供评测与训练基础。

title: Counting Beyond Frames: Codec Motion Tells Frozen Diffusion VLMs How Many
summary: Counting how many times something happens is among the simplest questions about a video and among the hardest for video-language models, autoregressive and diffusion alike. The difficulty lies between the frames: a model samples only a few of them, while each repetition unfolds as movement in between. Video codecs already record this movement densely as block displacements, and codec-based video models use it to shape their visual input. We are the first to show that this motion provides direct evidence for the count: a candidate count is a testable motion hypothesis, and unwinding the cycles it implies measures how strongly the observed directions support it. We present CoDiCount, a unified training-free framework that turns this test into a count potential and applies it while a frozen diffusion vision-language model (dVLM) denoises its answer. At every denoising step, structured count messages map each option letter, or each grammar-valid edit of an open integer, to the count it expresses and reweight the model's own probabilities within that set. Consistent gains over the official decoders on MotionBench, TOMATO, and SVCBench demonstrate the broad generalization of CoDiCount across diffusion models, datasets, and diverse counting tasks. With CoDiCount, a 7B dVLM outperforms GPT-5.1 and Gemini-2.5-Pro on MotionBench, surpasses GPT-4o and much larger open models on TOMATO, and matches GPT-5.4 on SVCBench.

AI.tldr: CoDiCount：训练-free框架，用视频编解码器的块位移运动信号构造"计数势能"，在冻结的扩散视觉语言模型（dVLM）去噪过程中逐步重加权候选计数，实现视频计数。
AI.motivation: 视频计数是视频-语言模型的难点：自回归与扩散模型都只采样少量帧，而重复性动作发生在帧间。作者观察到编解码器已稠密记录了块位移运动，可将候选计数视为可检验的运动假设——对候选计数解缠绕循环，即可测量观测运动方向对其的支持强度。
AI.method: 提出CoDiCount，无需训练的通用框架：(1) 从视频编解码块的位移场中提取运动方向，按候选计数的周期性假设进行"解缠绕"（cycle unwinding），计算一致性得到计数势能；(2) 将计数势能转化为结构化计数消息，把每个选项字母或语法合法的整数编辑映射到其表达的计数值，在该集合内对冻结dVLM自身概率做重加权；(3) 在扩散模型每个去噪步注入该重加权，不修改模型参数。
AI.result: 在MotionBench、TOMATO、SVCBench上相对官方解码器一致提升，跨扩散模型、数据集与多类计数任务泛化；7B dVLM在MotionBench上优于GPT-5.1与Gemini-2.5-Pro，在TOMATO上超过GPT-4o及更大开源模型，在SVCBench上与GPT-5.4持平。
AI.conclusion: 帧间运动（编解码器块位移）是可用的计数证据，将其作为去噪期的概率重加权信号，能在不训练的情况下显著提升扩散VLM的计数能力，并展示出跨模型、跨数据集的通用性。

title: FeaXDrive2: Body-Scene Spatial Grounding for Feasibility-Aware Generative Driving
summary: Generative driving planners may produce trajectories that appear feasible at their reference points but violate environmental constraints over the full vehicle body. We propose FeaXDrive2, an end-to-end generative planning framework that enhances vehicle-embodied spatial feasibility (VESF) through body-scene spatial grounding. The proposed method constructs spatial queries from actual vehicle-body corners and dynamically updates visual sampling locations using evolving trajectory estimates across Flow steps. Retrieved local visual features condition subsequent Action Flow-DiT velocity predictions, allowing trajectory generation to guide spatial information retrieval. Rollout-Consistent Safety Fine-Tuning (RC-F) combines high-risk trajectory supervision with reference behavior preservation, followed by planning-supervised VLM-Action Alignment. Vehicle-geometry counterfactual analysis reveals safety differences under identical trajectories but varying vehicle geometry. On NAVSIM, FeaXDrive2 reduces at-fault collisions by 36.5% relative to the base planner and improves PDMS from 87.0 to 88.8. Under NAVSIM v2 evaluation, EPDMS increases from 86.5 to 88.3. Ablation and body-clearance analyses further demonstrate the safety benefits of body-scene spatial grounding.

AI.tldr: FeaXDrive2：以车体角点为空间查询、随Action Flow步动态更新采样位置，将体-场景空间接地注入生成式规划，再经Rollout-Consistent安全微调与VLM-Action对齐，NAVSIM上自车责任碰撞降36.5%，PDMS 87.0→88.8。
AI.motivation: 生成式规划器仅保证参考点处的轨迹可行性，忽略完整车体在环境中是否发生碰撞/越界，导致"点可行、体不可行"的隐性安全风险；且现有视觉采样位置与生成轨迹演化脱节。作者提出车体具身空间可行性(VESF)概念，并强调车辆几何的反事实敏感性。
AI.method: 端到端生成式规划框架：(1) 由真实车体角点构造空间查询，替代单点参考；(2) 在Action Flow-DiT的Flow步间用演化中的轨迹估计动态更新视觉采样位置，使轨迹生成反向引导空间信息检索；(3) 检索到的局部视觉特征条件化速度预测；(4) Rollout-Consistent Safety Fine-Tuning (RC-F) 联合高风险轨迹监督与参考行为保持；(5) 规划监督下的VLM-Action对齐；辅以车辆几何反事实分析。
AI.result: NAVSIM上自车责任碰撞相对基线降低36.5%，PDMS 87.0→88.8；NAVSIM v2 EPDMS 86.5→88.3。消融与车体间隙分析验证体-场景空间接地的安全收益；几何反事实显示同一轨迹在车体尺寸不同时安全结论不同。
AI.conclusion: 将"点级"可行性提升为"体级"可行性，并通过轨迹-采样闭环耦合是提升生成式驾驶规划安全性的有效手段；RC-F与VLM-Action对齐在提升安全的同时保持参考行为。局限在于仅于NAVSIM仿真基准验证，缺真实车部署证据。

title: Autonomous Ergodic Robotic Palpation for Elastic Mapping of Curved Soft Tissues
summary: Autonomous robotic palpation offers repeatable, quantitative estimates of tissue properties for stiff inclusion localization. However, existing methods often rely on prior mesh models or planar surface assumptions that do not generalize to complex human anatomy. We propose an ergodic palpation framework that operates directly on curved soft surfaces using point cloud data. Central to our approach is the Laplace--Beltrami operator, which grounds both online estimation and exploration in the surface intrinsic geometry. We estimate local viscoelastic parameters using an Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) and fuse them into a surface-aware Gaussian Process (GP). This probabilistic model drives a diffusion-based ergodic motion planner, generating a continuous exploration trajectory that feeds the new informative samples back to the GP in a closed loop. Throughout this process, a hybrid force-impedance controller regulates interaction forces to maintain contact. We evaluate the approach against existing methods in simulation and validate it in physical experiments on tissue-mimicking silicone phantoms with varying geometries and viscoelastic properties, demonstrating geometry-consistent mapping and stiff inclusion localization under contact-rich conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出基于曲面点云的"遍历式(ergodic)机器人触诊"框架：用Laplace–Beltrami算子刻画曲面内蕴几何，UKF在线估计局部粘弹性参数并融合进曲面感知高斯过程，由扩散式遍历运动规划器生成连续探索轨迹闭环采样，配合力-阻抗混合控制维持接触，在硅胶仿体上实现几何一致映射与硬质包块定位。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人触诊可给出可重复、定量的组织属性估计，但现有方法依赖先验网格模型或平面表面假设，难以泛化到复杂曲面解剖结构；因此希望在无先验网格、直接作用于曲面点云的条件下同时完成参数估计与主动探索。
AI.method: 以Laplace–Beltrami算子作为曲面内蕴几何的统一基础：用UKF估计局部粘弹性参数，并以曲面感知GP进行概率融合；GP驱动基于扩散的遍历(ergodic)运动规划生成连续探索轨迹，形成"采样—估计—再规划"闭环，全过程由力-阻抗混合控制器调节接触力。
AI.result: 在仿真中与现有方法对比，并在具有不同几何与粘弹性特性的硅胶仿体上开展物理实验，验证了与几何一致的属性映射，以及在富接触条件下对硬质包块的定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 将曲面内蕴几何(LBO)与概率估计、遍历式主动探索及混合力控统一，可在无先验网格的曲面软组织上实现闭环触诊与硬质包块定位，具备向复杂解剖表面推广的潜力。

title: DemoFoundry: Toward Scalable Photorealistic Robot Data with Coding Agents and Generative Rendering
summary: Scaling robot learning requires demonstrations that combine realistic visual observations with reliable action supervision. Simulation-based synthesis faces a substantial visual gap relative to real environments, while video-only generation struggles to maintain physically consistent interactions and provide aligned action labels. We present DemoFoundry, an automated framework that couples coding agents with generative rendering to synthesize photorealistic and physically grounded robot demonstrations. Coding agents both construct aligned real--proxy video pairs from existing robot episodes to train a video renderer and write executable interaction programs to generate new demonstrations. Given a scene reference and task instruction, an agent reconstructs task-relevant geometry and writes a control program without requiring target-task human demonstrations. Program execution in a physics simulator produces proxy videos with aligned robot states and actions. The video renderer translates these proxy videos into scene-consistent, photorealistic observations, reducing the need for detailed appearance modeling in each scene. Automated task-execution checks select successful trajectories for rendering and policy learning. Experiments show improved visual quality and action--video consistency. Policies trained on the generated demonstrations outperform raw-simulation training and approach the performance of training on an equal number of real demonstrations.

AI.tldr: DemoFoundry：用编码智能体+生成式渲染，从场景参考自动生成照片级真实、动作对齐的机器人演示数据。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习需要"真实视觉+可靠动作监督"的演示。仿真合成存在视觉域差，纯视频生成难以保证物理一致性与动作标签对齐。
AI.method: 编码智能体（coding agents）双线工作：其一，从已有机器人episode构造对齐的real–proxy视频对，训练视频渲染器；其二，给定场景参考与任务指令，智能体重建任务相关几何并编写可执行交互程序，无需目标任务人类演示。程序在物理仿真器中执行，产出带对齐机器人状态与动作的proxy视频，再由渲染器转为场景一致、照片级真实观测。自动任务执行检查筛选成功轨迹用于渲染与策略学习。
AI.result: 视觉质量与动作—视频一致性提升；生成数据训练的策略优于纯仿真训练，并接近等量真实演示训练的性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种自动化、可扩展的真实感机器人演示合成管线，兼具物理接地与动作监督，可作为VLA/VLA类策略的数据增强来源。

title: RoboEvo$^2$: Recursive Robot Self-Improvement via Harness-Policy Co-Evolution
summary: Robots should adapt to unfamiliar environments and acquire new skills through interaction, then execute those skills efficiently with practice. Vision-language-action policies provide efficient control, but often need additional human demonstrations to handle unfamiliar settings; reasoning agents can discover solutions using broad prior knowledge and robot-control APIs, but repeated deliberation and repair are costly. Inspired by human learning through reasoning and practice, we propose RoboEvo$^2$, a framework for recursive harness-policy co-evolution. In Policy-to-Harness (P2H) evolution, policy failures guide a coding agent to search complementary Code, Code+ICL, and Code+Policy routes, consolidating verified solutions into reusable skills, routing strategies, and experience memory. In Harness-to-Policy (H2P) evolution, verified trajectories provide supervised training, while Counterfactual Preference Distillation (CPD) teaches the policy to favor successful corrections over failures from the same starting state. The improved policy provides stronger motor skills for subsequent search, while its remaining failures redirect harness evolution, closing the reciprocal loop. Through recursive co-evolution without additional human demonstrations, RoboEvo$^2$ improves standalone success from 11.0% to 84.1% and hybrid success from 30.4% to 90.5% on LIBERO-PRO, with similar gains and reduced agentic costs on RoboTwin C2R. Further experiments demonstrate autonomous task acquisition, cross-embodiment harness transfer, and 95.0% hybrid success on the Unitree G1-D. Our models and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: RoboEvo²：策略与"执行外壳(harness)"递归协同演化框架，用P2H（策略失败驱动编码智能体搜索Code/Code+ICL/Code+Policy三路线并沉淀为可复用技能与经验记忆）与H2P（验证轨迹做监督训练 + 反事实偏好蒸馏CPD）闭环互促，无需额外人工示教。
AI.motivation: VLA策略控制高效但面对陌生场景需额外人类示教；推理型智能体可凭先验知识与机器人控制API探索解法，但反复推理与修复代价高。作者希望像人类一样"推理+练习"结合：推理发现技能，练习把它内化为高效策略。
AI.method: 递归式harness-policy共演化。P2H：由策略失败触发编码智能体在Code、Code+ICL、Code+Policy三种路由上搜索，并将已验证解法固化为可复用技能、路由策略与经验记忆。H2P：以验证轨迹做监督微调，并提出反事实偏好蒸馏(CPD)，使策略在同一初始状态下偏好成功的纠错轨迹而非失败轨迹。改进后的策略提供更强运动技能以支撑后续搜索，剩余失败再回流驱动harness演化，形成双向闭环。
AI.result: LIBERO-PRO上单机（standalone）成功率11.0%→84.1%，混合（hybrid）成功率30.4%→90.5%；RoboTwin C2R上取得相近增益且智能体成本下降；另展示自主任务获取、跨本体harness迁移，Unitree G1-D上混合成功率95.0%。模型与代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 以"推理-练习"共演化替代人工示教，可同时提升VLA策略本体能力与推理智能体的求解效率，并在仿真基准与真机人形平台上验证了有效性与迁移性。

title: Neural Rendering Compiler: Generative Video Models as Programmable Renderers
summary: Generative video models are becoming powerful renderers, yet lack the predictable control interfaces of conventional systems such as HTML/CSS engines or Blender. Their capabilities emerge implicitly from training, making it difficult to determine what they can reliably execute. We present Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo), which automatically probes frozen video models to construct model-specific capability manuals describing which semantic requirements they can reliably satisfy. NeurCo represents user intent in a model-agnostic intermediate representation of objects, constraints, events, and cameras, then compiles it into model-specific execution strategies. Reliable requirements remain unchanged, while unreliable ones are selectively rewritten or compiled into alternative execution strategies. We introduce VComBench, a benchmark of 380 compositional, multi-requirement tasks spanning text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation. NeurCo improves requirement satisfaction from 46.8% to 52.3% on Wan and from 66.5% to 69.3% on Minimax H3, and achieves further gains when combined with prompt enhancers, including on Seedance 2.5. Our analysis reveals model-specific differences in control capabilities and trade-offs between controllability and photorealism, highlighting capability-guided compilation as a promising approach to programmable generative video rendering.

AI.tldr: 提出 Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo)，通过自动探测冻结的视频生成模型，构建"能力手册"并将用户意图编译为模型特定执行策略；同时发布 VComBench 评测基准。
AI.motivation: 生成式视频模型能力由训练隐式涌现，缺少类似 HTML/CSS 或 Blender 的可预测、可控接口，难以判断其能可靠执行哪些语义要求。
AI.method: 以模型无关的中间表示（对象、约束、事件、相机）刻画用户意图；自动探测冻结视频模型得到模型特定能力手册；据此将需求编译为模型特定执行策略：可靠需求保留，不可靠需求被选择性改写或重编译为替代执行路径（可与提示增强器组合）。
AI.result: 在 380 项组合式多需求任务基准 VComBench 上，需求满足率 Wan 由 46.8% 提升至 52.3%，Minimax H3 由 66.5% 提升至 69.3%；与提示增强器结合（含 Seedance 2.5）有额外增益；分析揭示模型间控制能力差异及可控性—照片真实感权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将"能力探测—编译"范式引入视频生成，实现可编程的生成式视频渲染；但增益幅度有限，仍属早期探索。

title: Find the Clue, Not the Scene: Rethinking Reasoning for Entity Recognition in Vision-Language Models
summary: Answering a knowledge-based visual question requires first recognizing the entity in the image and then recalling knowledge about it. Thinking vision-language models (VLMs) reason for thousands of tokens before answering, yet it remains underexplored how well such thinking VLMs perform each of these two steps. We therefore analyze thinking VLMs on this task and make two key observations. (1) Recognition is the bottleneck, since 76.3% of errors across four models on ViQuAE stem from misrecognizing the entity, and 84.9% of these failures are resolved once the entity name is provided in the question. (2) Recognition is driven by entity-recall clues rather than by general descriptions of the image. An entity-recall clue is a distinctive visual detail that helps the model recall the entity, such as keys, a traditional attribute of Saint Peter. Based on these findings, we propose ClueRL, a reinforcement learning approach that extends Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with an advantage localized to the entity-recall clue in the thinking trace. Rather than injecting new entity knowledge, ClueRL changes how VLMs think: it leads them to attend more closely to visual details and spot these clues, helping them use the knowledge they already have. Consequently, it outperforms both GRPO and a perception-reward baseline on three entity recognition benchmarks. Moreover, this clue-seeking behavior generalizes beyond entity recognition, the only task used for training. Since recognition is the bottleneck, the gains carry over to knowledge-based visual question answering. They even extend to general multimodal reasoning, raising Qwen3.5-4B by 4.4 and 4.0 points on the ScienceQA and MMMU subsets of MMStar, respectively.

AI.tldr: 分析thinking VLM在知识型VQA中的两个步骤，发现实体识别是瓶颈，且识别依赖"实体召回线索"；提出ClueRL——在GRPO基础上将优势局部化到思维链中实体召回线索处的RL方法，提升实体识别与知识型VQA性能。
AI.motivation: 知识型视觉问答需先识别实体再回忆知识。现有thinking VLM虽会生成长达数千token的推理，但其"识别"与"回忆"两步各表现如何尚不清楚。作者实验发现识别是主要瓶颈（ViQuAE上76.3%错误源于实体误识别，给出实体名后84.9%失败被解决）。
AI.method: 提出ClueRL：将GRPO与"实体召回线索"局部化优势结合，把优势计算/归因限定在thinking trace中承载关键视觉细节的线索位置，引导模型关注视觉细节而非注入新知识。对比GRPO与感知奖励基线。
AI.result: 在三个实体识别基准上优于GRPO和感知奖励基线；线索寻求行为可泛化到训练外任务，并提升知识型VQA与通用多模态推理（MMStar上Qwen3.5-4B的ScienceQA子集+4.4、MMMU子集+4.0）。
AI.conclusion: 识别是瓶颈，"如何思考"比"补知识"更关键；局部化线索级优势的RL可迁移泛化。

title: ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models
comment: 23 pages, including appendix. Video examples provided as ancillary files
summary: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path. We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives. Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions. We construct a matched multi-future dataset to train alternative continuations from a common state; shared-history tree execution and fused commitment make their preparation efficient. On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures. In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment. Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes. These results establish complementary roles for fine-grained commitment and advance preparation, with measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency. ShowNow turns playback-time computation into responsive visual interaction. Project: this https URL .

AI.tldr: ShowNow proposes a fine-grained speculative streaming framework for interactive video world models: it exploits idle playback-time compute to pre-generate multiple action-conditioned "futures" via single-latent commitment and shared-history tree execution, cutting input-to-display latency from 620ms to 208ms at 480p/16fps on a single H100.
AI.motivation: Real-time throughput alone does not solve interactivity: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generating after input arrives adds the whole generation cost to the response path. The authors want latency hiding rather than raw speedup.
AI.method: Fine-grained speculative streaming: decide/commit at single-latent granularity to allow frequent action injection; pre-prepare 1–8 action-conditioned futures during playback; a matched multi-future dataset trains alternative continuations from a shared state; shared-history tree execution plus fused commitment keeps the batch of futures cheap. Evaluated as a 5B model on one H100 at 480p/16fps and deployed in ViZDoom vs. a native-block SolarWM-FT baseline.
AI.result: 480p@16fps with 8 prepared futures on a single H100; median input-to-display latency 620→208ms; restart empty ticks 1.56%→0.09% (94% reduction) under matched policy; better on-time response to action changes; measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency.
AI.conclusion: Fine-grained commitment and advance preparation play complementary roles; speculative playback-time compute converts world-model inference into responsive visual interaction. Main caveats: fidelity/long-horizon consistency trade-offs and domain-limited (ViZDoom) interactive evidence.

title: Seeing the Right Context: Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Remote Sensing
summary: Remote sensing scene understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to interpret queried targets in relation to nearby objects and surrounding structures, which serve as spatial references or define the scope of an answer. However, standard answers and bounding boxes often leave these contextual relationships implicit. Thus, we construct GeoContext-5K to make them explicit in 5,394 training pairs for visual question answering (VQA), with spatial cues, visual facts, and supporting regions. GeOPD uses these annotations for on-policy distillation, guiding a frozen teacher with region marks on the full image and a visual fact while preserving surrounding spatial references. It prioritizes teacher corrections that agree with the shift in the student's next token distribution when evidence is restored. A complementary objective weights the contrast between the student's scores on the two views by how much masking lowers the teacher's log probability for the same sampled token. Experiments on five remote sensing VQA benchmarks show that GeOPD outperforms the evaluated open-source MLLMs and matched post-training baselines, improving over the 4B and 9B base models by 5.81 and 2.97 percentage points on average. The dataset and code will be publicly released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: GeOPD：构建遥感VQA数据集GeoContext-5K，将空间参照/上下文关系显式化，并用区域标注+视觉事实做on-policy蒸馏，以学生分布变化为依据筛选教师纠正，提升遥感场景理解。
AI.motivation: 遥感场景理解要求MLLM将查询目标与邻近物体、周边结构关联起来解读，但标准答案与边界框往往把这种上下文关系留作隐含信息，模型难以学到空间参照推理。
AI.method: 构建GeoContext-5K（5,394条VQA训练对，含空间线索、视觉事实、支撑区域）；GeOPD基于该标注做on-policy蒸馏：冻结教师模型在带区域标记的全图+视觉事实上提供纠正，优先选取与学生恢复证据后下一token分布偏移方向一致的教师纠正；辅以对比目标，按遮蔽导致教师对同一采样token对数概率下降的幅度，对学生两视图得分差进行加权。
AI.result: 在五个遥感VQA基准上优于所评测的开源MLLM及匹配的后训练基线，相对4B与9B基座模型平均提升5.81与2.97个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式上下文标注结合证据条件下的on-policy蒸馏可有效提升遥感MLLM的空间参照推理能力；数据集与代码将公开。

title: Effect of class proportion shifts on classifier curvature
summary: Changing the class mix can alter mean loss without changing the classifier. To distinguish this reweighting from changes in the model itself, we studied ten-class CIFAR-10 classification in separate branches for two target classes, measuring the trace of the loss Hessian with respect to the output-layer parameters on fixed images of each target class. Across ten new initialisations, after 60 updates to the output layer with frozen features, the trace changed by -0.152% on average in branches where the target class share rose from 10% to 19%, and by +0.071% in branches where it fell to 1%, relative to each branch's initial trace. These changes do not isolate the effect of class share from that of the assigned training images. We developed a forecast based on initial class gradients after examining the first experiment's results and then tested it prospectively without modification. For direct increases from 10% to 19%, rather than increases after a deficit, its mean absolute error was 0.022 percentage points on the initial-trace scale, compared with 0.152 for a zero-change forecast and 0.104 for equally weighted gradients. Using the assigned class proportions improved the forecast of how much the trace would change.

AI.tldr: 通过冻结特征下仅更新输出层的CIFAR-10十类分类实验，在两条目标类分支上测量损失Hessian迹（可理解为输出层曲率/锐度代理量）随类别比例变化，发现从10%升到19%时平均变化-0.152%、降到1%时+0.071%，并基于初始类别梯度提出可预测该变化的预报公式（MAE 0.022个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 改变类别混合比例会在不改变分类器的情况下改变平均损失，这可能被误读为模型本身变化；作者希望把"重加权带来的损失变化"与"模型性质变化"区分开，并检验类比例信息是否能预测输出层损失Hessian迹的变化。
AI.method: 十类CIFAR-10，在两个目标类上各设分支，固定图像测量输出层参数相关的损失Hessian迹；十次新初始化，冻结特征仅做60次输出层更新；再依据首次实验的初始类别梯度构造一个预报式，并在后续实验中不加修改地进行前瞻性检验，与零变化、等权梯度两种基线比较。
AI.result: 目标类占比10%→19%的分支平均迹变化-0.152%，10%→1%的分支+0.071%（相对各自初始迹）；直接10%→19%（非先亏后补）情形下，预报MAE为0.022个百分点，显著优于零变化预报0.152和等权梯度0.104。作者亦承认这些变化未能把类别占比效应与具体训练图像效应分离。
AI.conclusion: 类别比例的变化在几乎不改变模型的情况下即可引起可测的损失曲率变化，且利用分配到的类别占比可改进对该变化的预测；但该效应在小规模线性探针式设置中测得，外推性受限。

title: Reading, Not Adapting: Unlocking Frozen Visual Knowledge for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Generalization to unseen image generators has driven efforts to adapt pretrained visual representations for detection. Yet recent findings show that vision foundation models already encode transferable detection knowledge, while further adaptation can impair generalization. This motivates a shift from backbone adaptation to knowledge readout. Conventional linear probing offers a direct way to read this knowledge but is limited to final-layer RGB features. Multi-cue detectors broaden the evidence base, but their designs introduce other tradeoffs: adaptation may compromise pretrained transferability, heterogeneous encoders complicate feature integration, and late fusion precludes intermediate cross-view interaction. To overcome these limitations, we propose ReMoT, a Mixture-of-Transformers-inspired framework that reads complementary knowledge from spatially aligned RGB and wavelet views within a fully frozen visual foundation. ReMoT employs staged joint attention to enable controlled local and global cross-view interaction, while learnable fusion queries progressively read complementary evidence across Transformer depth without writeback. ReMoT achieves 91.2% average accuracy across eight benchmark groups with 3,074 trainable parameters, attaining the highest overall average among the evaluated methods. These results support structured knowledge readout as a promising alternative to backbone adaptation. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ReMoT：在完全冻结的视觉基础模型中，通过Mixture-of-Transformers式跨视角（RGB+小波）知识读取框架做AI生成图像检测，仅3,074个可训练参数，八组基准平均91.2%。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型已编码可迁移的检测知识，进一步适配骨干反而损害泛化性；线性探针受限于最后一层RGB特征，多线索检测器则面临适配破坏可迁移性、异构编码器难融合、晚融合缺乏中间层跨视角交互等问题。
AI.method: 提出ReMoT：冻结视觉基础模型，在空间对齐的RGB与小波两视角上读取互补知识；采用分阶段联合注意力实现受控的局部/全局跨视角交互；可学习的fusion queries在Transformer各深度渐进式读取互补证据，且不回写（no writeback）。
AI.result: 在八个基准组上平均准确率91.2%，仅3,074个可训练参数，整体平均为所评估方法中最高。
AI.conclusion: 结构化知识读取可作为骨干微调的有效替代方案，兼顾泛化性与参数效率。

title: LiDAR Intensity Reconstruction with Limited Real Data: An Architecture Benchmark under Fixed-Epoch Training
summary: Physics-derived simulation can supplement scarce real-world LiDAR intensity measurements, but its effectiveness depends on the learning architecture and the amount of real training data available. We benchmark nine neural architectures for LiDAR intensity reconstruction from depth, semantic labels, incidence angle, and material reflectance, using real SemanticKITTI and synthetic VoxelScape range-image data. All models follow a fixed 20-epoch protocol; this controls the number of training passes, not the computational cost across architectures. We report mean absolute error (MAE), mean squared error (MSE), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity (SSIM), inference timing, and spectral-energy agreement. We also evaluate four selected architectures with fixed-size training mixtures containing 0\%, 1\%, 5\%, 10\%, 20\%, 50\%, or 100\% real frames. With real-only training, UNet-V2 achieves the best reported reconstruction metrics (MAE 0.234, MSE 0.140, PSNR 8.64 dB, and SSIM 0.647), followed by a denoising diffusion model (DDPM). In several mixtures containing 1--10\% real data, DDPM achieves lower error and higher image-quality metrics than the evaluated deterministic alternatives, whereas UNet-V2 leads with 100\% real data. Spectral analysis additionally reveals architecture-dependent discrepancies across frequency bands. These findings characterize reconstruction trade-offs under the stated data mixtures and fixed-epoch protocol, without establishing compute-matched superiority or isolating the diffusion objective from backbone differences.

AI.tldr: 该文在真实SemanticKITTI与合成VoxelScape距离图上，以固定20轮训练协议对9种神经网络架构进行LiDAR强度重建基准测试，并评估UNet-V2、DDPM等4种架构在0%–100%真实数据混合比例下的表现。结果显示全真实数据时UNet-V2最优（MAE 0.234、PSNR 8.64 dB、SSIM 0.647），而1–10%真实数据混合时DDPM误差更低、图像质量更高，频谱分析还揭示不同频段的架构依赖差异。
AI.motivation: 真实LiDAR强度测量稀缺，物理衍生仿真数据可作补充，但其有效性取决于学习架构与可用真实训练数据量；作者希望厘清在给定数据混合与训练预算下各架构的重建取舍与仿真数据利用效率。
AI.method: 以深度、语义标签、入射角与材质反射率为输入重建LiDAR强度；在SemanticKITTI（真实）与VoxelScape（合成）距离图像上端到端基准9种神经架构，统一20轮固定训练协议；报告MAE、MSE、PSNR、SSIM、推理时延与频谱能量一致性；并对4种选定架构在真实帧占比0/1/5/10/20/50/100%的固定规模混合训练集上做对比。
AI.result: 纯真实训练时UNet-V2重建指标最佳（MAE 0.234、MSE 0.140、PSNR 8.64 dB、SSIM 0.647），DDPM次之；在含1–10%真实数据的多种混合配置中，DDPM在误差与图像质量指标上优于所评估的确定性模型；频谱分析显示误差在频带上呈现架构相关差异。
AI.conclusion: 结论限于所述数据混合与固定轮数协议，仅刻画重建权衡，未确立计算量对齐下的优越性，也未将扩散目标与骨干网络差异解耦。

title: WorldInteract: Controllable Streaming Video Generation for Multi-Material Interactions
summary: Video world models aim to create interactive physical worlds that capture how diverse materials move and interact. Yet material-dependent dynamics remain underexplored in controllable video generation, limiting reliable control in scenes with different materials. We present WorldInteract, a streaming video generation framework that decomposes cross-material interaction into material-dependent behavior generation and contact response computation. External pushes and contact impulses are expressed through a shared velocity-increment interface, allowing material behaviors learned from interaction-free videos to be reused in interacting scenes. A physics controller predicts contacts and computes velocity increments from estimated masses and restitution coefficients, while a causal generator executes these increments using learned material behaviors. This separation enables cross-material interaction without supervised contact videos spanning diverse material pairings and contact configurations. We train the generator on 30k simulated interaction-free videos spanning 22 material classes and introduce Material-Aware RL, using verifiable physical rewards to refine material behavior and control execution. WorldInteract substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Physics-IQ and delivers more reliable push control on real-world images.

AI.tldr: WorldInteract 提出流式视频世界模型框架，将跨材质交互分解为"材质相关行为生成"与"接触响应计算"，用统一的速度增量接口复用无交互视频中学到的材质动力学，并用物理控制器与可验证物理奖励强化学习实现可控推动交互。
AI.motivation: 现有可控视频生成对材质相关的动力学建模不足，跨材质交互场景缺乏可靠的物理控制；而直接用监督信号学习接触交互需要覆盖大量材质组合与接触构型的标注视频，数据代价极高。
AI.method: (1) 将外部推力与接触冲量统一表示为速度增量（velocity-increment）接口；材质行为从 30k 条、覆盖 22 类材质的"无交互"仿真视频中学习，并可在交互场景中复用；(2) 物理控制器基于估计的质量与恢复系数预测接触并计算速度增量；(3) 因果（streaming）生成器执行这些增量；(4) 训练中使用 Material-Aware RL，以可验证物理奖励精修材质行为与控制执行；(5) 解耦设计使跨材质交互无需成对的接触监督视频。
AI.result: 在 Physics-IQ 基准上大幅优于现有 SOTA；在真实世界图像上实现更可靠的推动控制。
AI.conclusion: 通过"行为学习 + 物理接触求解 + 速度增量接口"的解耦，可在无接触监督数据下实现跨材质可控交互视频生成，为物理一致的世界模型提供了可扩展范式。

title: Was the Model Given the Right Action? Auditing and Repairing Action Interfaces in Navigation World Models
summary: World models are evaluated by predicting future observations from actions. These evaluations assume that actions are prepared the same way as during training, but an unchecked mismatch can make a model appear less accurate than it is. We audit this assumption in Navigation World Models (NWM) and find three interacting differences between its training and rollout code. Correcting the inputs, without retraining, reduces mean visual prediction error by 42%, measured with DreamSim on the RECON navigation dataset. The correction also changes the ranking of NWM checkpoints in an exploratory analysis and removes or reduces two alternative models' measured advantages. Correcting only the normalization offset instead increases error, showing why interacting mismatches must be checked together. To test whether sensitivity to input preparation extends beyond NWM, we deliberately introduce encoding errors into two alternative models; both become less accurate. We introduce ActRosetta, a tool that checks whether action encoding matches training, identifies supported causes of disagreement, and repairs inputs when sufficient information is available. Repair helps little where predictions barely respond to actions, the tool's diagnosis has limited coverage, and improved control remains unproven. For any action-conditioned world model, the lesson is the same: before reporting rollout error, verify that evaluation encodes actions exactly as training did.

AI.tldr: 论文审计了Navigation World Models (NWM)的训练与rollout代码，发现三处相互作用的行为编码不一致；仅修正输入而不重训即可将RECON数据集上的平均视觉预测误差（DreamSim）降低42%，并改变checkpoint排名，同时提出检查/修复工具ActRosetta。
AI.motivation: 世界模型通常以“预测未来观测”来评测，但隐含假设评测时动作的准备方式与训练一致。作者怀疑NWM存在训练-推理输入不匹配，导致模型被错误地低估精度，从而扭曲方法比较与checkpoint选择。
AI.method: 对NWM的训练与rollout代码进行审计，定位三处相互作用的动作编码差异；分别和联合修正输入（包括归一化偏移）做控制实验；在RECON导航数据集上用DreamSim指标衡量视觉预测误差；检验checkpoint排序与替代模型相对优势的变化；另对两个替代模型人为注入编码错误以测试敏感性；开发ActRosetta工具用于检测动作编码是否与训练一致、诊断不一致原因并修复输入。
AI.result: 修正输入后（无需重训）平均视觉预测误差下降42%；修正改变了探索性分析中NWM各checkpoint的排序，并使两个替代模型测得的优势被消除或削弱；仅修正归一化偏移反而使误差上升，说明多处不匹配必须联合检查；人为注入编码错误后两个替代模型精度均下降，表明敏感性不限于NWM。
AI.conclusion: 动作条件世界模型的评测必须先验证动作编码与训练严格一致，否则rollout误差结论不可靠。ActRosetta可辅助诊断与修复，但预测对动作响应弱时修复收益有限、诊断覆盖率有限、控制性能提升尚未被证实。

title: ELMO: Emergent Representations In Imitation Learning Via Dynamic Hierarchical Action Chunking
summary: Robot trajectories naturally decompose into variable-length phases with distinct semantic intents, such as reaching, grasping, and lifting. However, training policies to minimize MSE treats all actions as equal, obscuring their semantic structure. While latent action models attempt to create a structured prediction target by compressing action chunks into latent representations, existing approaches rely on two-stage training and context-blind decoders. Consequently, their representations are context-agnostic motion codes (e.g., "move down") which fail to capture behavioural intent (e.g., "pick up the block"). To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce the Emergent Latent-action MOdel (ELMO), an end-to-end framework that encodes robot trajectories as grounded semantic codes -- representations that ground task-level behavioural intent in the current environment. ELMO jointly trains a VLA planner and an observation-conditioned decoder over dynamically chunked trajectories, learning a semantically grounded action space without separate pretraining. Across standard benchmarks, ELMO outperforms comparable prior methods by 9.6 percentage points on LIBERO-Plus and by 0.75 in average task length on CALVIN. Furthermore, on Blocks -- our shortcut-free simulation and real-world generalization benchmark -- ELMO reaches a 38.6% success rate while all baselines remain below 5%, demonstrating its ability to capture the semantic structure of demonstrations. Website: this https URL

AI.tldr: ELMO proposes an end-to-end framework that jointly trains a VLA planner with an observation-conditioned decoder over dynamically chunked trajectories, learning grounded semantic latent action codes without two-stage pretraining, and reports large gains on LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN, and a new Blocks benchmark (38.6% vs. <5% baselines).
AI.motivation: MSE-based policy training treats all actions equally and obscures the variable-length semantic phase structure of robot trajectories (reaching, grasping, lifting). Existing latent action models rely on two-stage training and context-blind decoders, yielding context-agnostic motion codes (e.g., "move down") that lack behavioural intent (e.g., "pick up the block").
AI.method: ELMO encodes trajectories as grounded semantic codes via end-to-end joint training of a VLA planner and an observation-conditioned decoder on dynamically chunked variable-length trajectory segments, so the latent action space is learned in a single stage and conditioned on current observation context.
AI.result: +9.6 percentage points on LIBERO-Plus and +0.75 average task length on CALVIN versus comparable prior methods; on the shortcut-free Blocks benchmark (simulation plus real-world generalization) ELMO achieves 38.6% success while all baselines stay below 5%.
AI.conclusion: Observation-conditioned, end-to-end learned latent action spaces yield semantically grounded action representations that outperform two-stage, context-blind latent action models, indicating that capturing demonstration semantic structure matters for VLA generalization beyond in-distribution shortcuts.

title: How Well Do Vision-Language Scene Graphs Serve as Memory for Embodied Question Answering?
comment: Accepted at the HOUR workshop, WACV 2027 (non-archival). 16 pages (4-page main paper, references, supplementary material), 9 figures, 22 tables. Divyansh Pandey and Shubh Garg contributed equally
summary: Embodied QA needs memory, but answer accuracy mixes retained evidence, reading errors and question priors. For a simulated multi-room scene-graph pipeline we define answerability: the fraction of questions a fixed rule-based reader answers correctly from the graph alone. The baseline recovers 24.1% of visible object types and its room labels flicker. Four targeted repairs double recall, raise answerability from 27.2% to 37.4%, and improve retrained QA from 71.4% to 75.9%, yet better object F1 can lower answerability. A question-type prior beats this reader on every predicted graph. In one real-video test, graph memory lowers accuracy. These exploratory findings favour scoring retained evidence alongside accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出"可答性(answerability)"指标：在模拟多房间场景图管线中，用固定规则reader仅凭图回答问题的正确率，以此分离记忆保留的证据与阅读误差和问题先验的贡献。
AI.motivation: 具身问答(endpoint QA)的答案准确率混合了记忆保留、阅读错误与问题先验三种因素，难以诊断记忆系统本身的好坏，需要一种只衡量"保留证据"质量的度量。
AI.method: 构建模拟多房间场景图管线，定义answerability为固定规则式reader仅从场景图回答问题的正确比例；基线仅恢复24.1%可见物体类型且房间标签抖动；实施四项针对性修复（消融式诊断改进），并与问题类型先验基线对比，外加一个真实视频测试。
AI.result: 四项修复使召回翻倍，answerability从27.2%升至37.4%，重训练QA从71.4%升至75.9%；但更高的物体F1反而可能降低answerability；问题类型先验在每个预测图上都优于该reader；真实视频中图记忆反而降低准确率。
AI.conclusion: 准确率不能单独作为记忆系统评价标准，应同时报告保留证据（answerability）指标；作者自述为探索性发现。

title: SOLVE: Sparse, Ordered Keyposes Make LLM Agents Versatile and Efficient Robot Manipulator
summary: LLM agents have made remarkable progress in robot manipulation, yet they suffer from expensive inference, dense step-by-step control, and tool bottlenecks. We introduce SOLVE, a training-free, versatile and efficient agent policy: a multimodal LLM agent writes a sparse, ordered sequence of 6-DoF end-effector keyposes per call, observes the result, and writes the next, while a motion planner interpolates between them. The agent decides the number and spacing of keyposes for both fast long-range motion and fine-grained manipulation. This granularity matches the sparsity of teleoperated manipulation: most demonstrations in DROID can be compressed into a few keyposes instead of dense actions. SOLVE grounds keyposes with sparse depth queries answered by noisy sources, such as multi-view triangulation, stereo, or monocular depth, and copes with that noise itself. It also improves from execution feedback, reflecting on its own rollouts and distilling a few rules per task. SOLVE reaches state-of-the-art performance of 74.5% on RoboDojo and 84.5% on RoboLab, with only $1.7 per episode on average, 12x less than previous dense-control agent policies. On a real robot, the same agent achieves an 88% success rate (75 of 85 episodes) over 16 challenging zero-shot tasks. Our project page is at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SOLVE: 免训练的多模态LLM智能体策略，稀疏输出6-DoF末端关键位姿序列，由运动规划器插值，并用稀疏深度查询进行位姿落地，配合执行反馈自反思蒸馏规则。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在机器人操作中推理成本高、需稠密逐步控制、受工具瓶颈限制；而遥操作数据本身高度稀疏（DROID演示可压缩为少量关键位姿），启发采用稀疏关键位姿接口。
AI.method: 免训练agent policy：多模态LLM每次调用写出一段稀疏有序的6-DoF末端关键位姿序列，观察执行结果后再写下一段，中间由运动规划器插值；智能体自行决定关键位姿数量与间距以兼顾远距离快速运动与精细操作；用多视角三角化/双目/单目深度等含噪源的稀疏深度查询对关键位姿进行3D落地，并由智能体自身处理噪声；通过反思自身rollout为每个任务蒸馏少量规则以改进。
AI.result: RoboDojo 74.5%、RoboLab 84.5% 达SOTA，平均每回合仅 $1.7（比稠密控制智能体策略低12倍）；真实机器人16个零样本挑战任务成功率88%（85次中75次）。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏关键位姿+规划器插值的智能体接口可显著降低推理成本并保持强泛化，真实机器人零样本表现验证了其实用性。

title: Anytime-Valid Sequential Verification for Sensing-Efficient Robot Navigation under Perception Uncertainty
summary: When a robot navigates an unfamiliar grid, noisy sensor readings can make it hard to tell whether the cells along its next move are free. Additional scans can reduce that uncertainty, but a fixed scan count spends the same sensing effort at every position. In a static-grid simulation, a sequential rule uses a Gaussian likelihood ratio to determine when the cells newly covered by the robot's footprint have enough evidence of free space. On 324 held-out scenarios from 18 public maps, the sequential gate and a four-scan reference chosen on validation data both completed every mission without an observed collision. With their respective validation-selected routing weights, the gate averaged 123.15 scans per episode versus 224.13 for the reference, a reduction of 45.05% (95% map-stratified bootstrap interval: 42.21--48.95%). In a retrospective check on the same scenarios with routing weights held equal, the reductions were 43.91% and 43.37% at the two tested weights, with all missions completed. On 216 scenarios from 12 previously unused maps, allocating more of the same certification error budget near the initial start--goal rectangle cut the sequential gate's scan count by a further 11.58%. The spatial variant completed 206 missions versus 208 for the original gate and increased computation time. The collision bound depends on the assumed observation model and footprint geometry. In a stress test with persistent per-cell bias, the original gate completed 0 of 54 missions.

AI.tldr: 提出基于高斯似然比的序贯扫描门控规则，自适应决定机器人每一步需要多少激光扫描才足以节点自由证据，在324个留出场景上将扫描数较四扫描参考基线降低约45%。
AI.motivation: 固定扫描次数在每个位置消耗相同感知开销，而噪声传感器读数使新覆盖栅格的自由性判断不确定；希望按需感知，仅在证据不足时追加扫描。
AI.method: 静态栅格仿真中，用高斯似然比对机器人足迹新覆盖单元的自由空间证据做序贯检验，累积足够证据即停止扫描；并尝试将认证误差预算的空间分配偏向初始起点—目标矩形区域的变体，以及不同路径权重设置。
AI.result: 324场景（18张公开地图）全部完成且无碰撞，门控平均123.15次扫描 vs 四扫描参考224.13次（降低45.05%，95% bootstrap区间42.21%–48.95%）；等权重回溯检验降低43.91%与43.37%；12张新地图216场景上空间变体再降11.58%，但完成206/208且计算时间增加；持续逐单元偏置压力测试中原始门控54个任务全部失败。
AI.conclusion: 序贯证据门控可显著降低感知开销并保持零碰撞，但碰撞界依赖观测模型与足迹几何假设，对系统性传感器偏置缺乏鲁棒性；空间预算分配带来边际收益与算力代价。

title: Toward Agentic Robotics: A Large-Scale Study of Harness Design for Robot-Use Agents
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can act as robot-use agents that understand diverse scenes and control robots through policy code and tools. However, they predict 3D gripper poses poorly even with extended reasoning, struggling with precise manipulation. Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models are the opposite: they execute fast, smooth control on trained tasks, yet fail under domain shifts or when tasks require long-horizon memory and reasoning. Agentic robots therefore combine VLM reasoning and perception with precise VLA/WAM control through a policy harness. Yet harness design spans thousands of configurations, shifting success by tens of points with the same models. Moreover, testing even one design takes thousands of rollouts at high API and GPU cost, so prior works often commit to a single design chosen from few alternatives. To guide harness design, we evaluate over 470,000 rollouts across eight simulation benchmarks, six VLMs, and 15 VLA/WAM checkpoints. Seven controlled studies show effective harnesses must adapt to both VLM and VLA/WAM capabilities. Our findings specify what structure the VLM's policy code needs, where VLA manipulation needs help from tools and policy code, and when to involve the VLM at test time. The reference recipe X-Harness shows that these findings compose without weight updates, lifting base policies up to $+42.8$ points across memory, reasoning, and domain shifts.

AI.tldr: 提出对"VLM 推理 + VLA/WAM 精确控制"的 agentic 机器人策略框架(harness)进行系统性实证研究,基于 47 万次 rollout 提炼出 7 条设计准则,并给出无需权重更新的参考配方 X-Harness,最高提升 42.8 个点。
AI.motivation: VLM agent 在 3D 夹爪位姿预测与精细操作上很差;VLA/WAM 执行快但缺乏长程记忆、推理与域迁移能力。混合二者的 harness 设计空间巨大,同一组模型因配置不同成功率可相差数十点,而单次评测成本极高(数千 rollout、高 API/GPU 开销),因此需要大规模实证来指导设计。
AI.method: 在 8 个仿真基准、6 个 VLM、15 个 VLA/WAM checkpoint 上共评估 47 万+ rollouts,开展 7 组受控研究,分析 VLM 策略代码应具备的结构、VLA 需要工具与策略代码介入的环节,以及测试时何时调用 VLM;据此提出组合式参考配方 X-Harness(无权重更新)。
AI.result: 7 项结论表明有效 harness 必须同时适配 VLM 与 VLA/WAM 能力;X-Harness 在记忆、推理与域迁移三类场景下将基础策略提升至多 +42.8 点。
AI.conclusion: harness 设计是 agentic 机器人中决定成败的关键杠杆,单一架构选择不足;将 VLM 推理、工具与 VLA/WAM 控制按能力互补方式组合,可在零微调下显著提升鲁棒性与长程任务表现;但结论主要来自仿真,真实机器人验证与交互式在线策略改编尚未覆盖。

title: Comparative Study of Deep Learning Architectures for Brain Tumour Classification
summary: Accurate and early classification of brain tumours from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for treatment planning, yet many published deep learning studies are trained and tested on small, single-source datasets, reporting accuracies that may not hold outside these datasets. This study compares six deep learning architectures for four-class classification (healthy, meningioma, glioma and pituitary tumour): a baseline convolutional neural network (CNN), an attention-based CNN, ShuffleNet, and EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50 and Xception augmented with the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). The models were trained on a corpus assembled from four publicly available MRI datasets. Because these datasets carry no patient identifiers, a leakage-aware pipeline was developed that removes exact duplicates using MD5 hashing (550 images) and near-duplicates using perceptual hashing (8,024 images), and assigns visually similar images to the same fold during 5-fold group cross-validation. A leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) test on a fully held-out dataset was used to measure cross-dataset generalisation. Under a conventional random split, ShuffleNet achieved 97.1% accuracy with 1.2M parameters. Under leakage-aware group K-fold cross-validation, ShuffleNetV2 (98.41%) and EfficientNet-B0 (98.23%) were statistically indistinguishable (paired t-test, p = 0.19), and both significantly outperformed the custom CNNs. On the held-out dataset, accuracy dropped for every model: EfficientNet-B0 generalised best (78.4%), while ShuffleNetV2 fell to 66.2%. Glioma-meningioma confusion was the dominant error mode, and Grad-CAM maps showed that predictions were driven by tumour regions. These results indicate that in-distribution accuracy alone overstates real-world performance and that leakage-aware and cross-dataset evaluation should be reported alongside it.

AI.tldr: 比较6种深度学习架构（自定义CNN、注意力CNN、ShuffleNetV2、EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50+CBAM、Xception+CBAM）用于四类脑肿瘤MRI分类，并构建去泄漏（MD5去重550张、感知哈希去近重复8024张）的分组交叉验证与留一数据集（LODO）跨数据集评估流程。
AI.motivation: 现有脑肿瘤MRI深度学习研究多在小型单源数据集上训练与测试，报告的准确率难以泛化到其他数据集，缺乏对数据泄漏与跨数据集泛化能力的严格评估。
AI.method: 从4个公开MRI数据集汇成语料；用MD5哈希去除精确重复、感知哈希去除近重复，并按视觉相似性将图像分配到同一折，进行5折分组交叉验证；以完全留出的数据集做LODO测试；对比6种架构；辅以配对t检验与Grad-CAM可视化误差模式。
AI.result: 随机划分下ShuffleNet以1.2M参数达97.1%准确率；泄漏感知交叉验证中ShuffleNetV2（98.41%）与EfficientNet-B0（98.23%）统计上无显著差异（p=0.19），均显著优于自定义CNN；留出数据集上所有模型性能下降，EfficientNet-B0泛化最佳（78.4%），ShuffleNetV2降至66.2%；主要错误为胶质瘤-脑膜瘤混淆，Grad-CAM显示预测由肿瘤区域驱动。
AI.conclusion: 分布内准确率会高估真实场景性能，脑肿瘤分类研究应同时报告泄漏感知评估与跨数据集泛化结果。

title: Generation as Reverse Encoding
summary: Pretrained visual representations accelerate generative learning by abstracting away appearance and spatial detail. Yet the same abstraction makes the return to pixels far harder, shifting much of the burden onto a larger decoder. We ask why the representation-to-pixel path should be learned independently when the encoder already provides a learned pixel-to-semantics path (the semantic encoding path). We introduce RevFlow, based on the principle of generation as reverse encoding. RevFlow uses intermediate representations of a frozen encoder as successive generative targets, first generating deep semantic representations, then shallow representations that retain appearance and spatial detail, before decoding to pixels. To learn these transitions without training a separate generator for each stage, we develop HyC-DiT, a unified generative model with a standard DiT backbone shared across stages and stage-specific condition injection. We further show that native matching in semantic representation space enables few-step generation. RevFlow accelerates both learning and sampling. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, RevFlow reaches 1.96 FID at 690M and 1.74 FID at 1.55B after only 5 training epochs. It also achieves 30.25 dB reconstruction PSNR with an 89M decoder. After a short native-matching adaptation phase, RevFlow-XL achieves 2.85 FID using a single sampling step in each stage. Our code repository is at this https URL

AI.tldr: RevFlow 把冻结编码器的中间层表征当作逐级生成目标，用共享 DiT 主干（HyC-DiT）实现反向编码生成，5 epoch 即在 ImageNet 256 达 1.96 FID，并支持每阶段单步采样。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉表征通过抽象外观与空间细节加速生成学习，但同样带来"表征→像素"回译困难，负担被转移到更大的解码器上；作者质疑：既然编码器已提供一条学习好的"像素→语义"路径（语义编码路径），"表征→像素"路径为何还要独立学习。
AI.method: 提出 RevFlow，以"生成即反向编码"为原则：把冻结编码器的中间表征作为逐级生成目标，先生成深层语义表征，再生成保留外观与空间细节的浅层表征，最后解码到像素；为避免每阶段单独训练生成器，提出 HyC-DiT——由共享的标准 DiT 主干加阶段特定条件注入构成的统一生成模型；并指出语义表征空间中的原生匹配（native matching）支持少步生成。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256 上，690M 模型 5 个 epoch 达到 1.96 FID，1.55B 模型达 1.74 FID；89M 解码器实现 30.25 dB 重建 PSNR；经短暂 native-matching 适配后 RevFlow-XL 每阶段单步采样取得 2.85 FID。学习与采样均被加速。
AI.conclusion: 将生成建模为冻结编码器的反向逐级解码（语义→浅层→像素）并共享 DiT 主干，可同时显著提升收敛速度与采样效率，且可配合小解码器；为视觉生成提供新的"反向编码"范式。

title: SceneDesigner3D: Agentic Evolutionary Search for Principled Rearrangement of 3D Indoor Scenes
comment: Project page: this http URL , Video: TBD
summary: Scene rearrangement is an essential task for 3D content creation applications, requiring generation of diverse, aesthetic and functional scene rearrangements. We present SceneDesigner3D, an agentic evolutionary search method for 3D indoor scene rearrangement that systematically explores the design space of 3D scenes and generates multiple solutions according to common interior design principles. Given an input scene and a text prompt, SceneDesigner3D represents the rearrangement as an editable program and evolves a population of candidate layouts. Starting from distinct design ideas, a VLM agent mutates the programs by refining promising candidates, exploring new rearrangement strategies or redesigning from scratch, while verifying the layouts for physical validity. Proposals are scored by a VLM judge for adherence to the input prompt and satisfaction of design principles such as balance, zoning and emphasis, as well as numerically computed principles such as circulation and clutter. An archive of top-performing, structurally varied candidates further increases diversity of rearrangements. Experiments on the SAGE-10k and SceneSmith datasets show that SceneDesigner3D improves prompt adherence and computed design principle scores over baselines by up to 5.1% and 15.2%, respectively. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: SceneDesigner3D 将 3D 室内场景重排表示为可编辑程序，用 VLM 智能体驱动的进化搜索（变异/探索/重设计 + 物理校验 + VLM 评判 + 档案库多样性）生成多样且符合设计原则的布局。
AI.motivation: 3D 内容创作中的场景重排需要同时满足多样性、美观性与功能性，现有方法难以系统探索设计空间并兼顾多项室内设计原则。
AI.method: 把重排方案编码为可编辑程序；从多个不同设计起点初始化种群；VLM 智能体执行三类变异算子（精修高分候选、探索新重排策略、从零重设计），并做物理有效性校验；由 VLM 评判器按提示词遵循度及均衡、分区、重点等设计原则打分，并结合流通性、杂乱度等数值化指标；维护结构多样化的高分档案库以提升多样性。
AI.result: 在 SAGE-10k 与 SceneSmith 数据集上，提示词遵循度提升最高 5.1%，计算式设计原则得分提升最高 15.2%。
AI.conclusion: 进化式智能体搜索可有效生成多样化、符合设计原则的场景重排；属场景级布局生成，与物体级重建/生成智能体仅部分相关。

title: CIRKDV2: Cross-Image Relational Knowledge Distillation with Contextual Modeling for Efficient Semantic Segmentation
summary: Existing Knowledge Distillation (KD) methods for semantic segmentation often guide the student to mimic the teacher's structured information generated from an individual image. However, they ignore the global semantic relations across various images that are valuable for KD. This paper proposes Cross-Image Relational KD V2 (CIRKDV2), which focuses on transferring structured pixel-to-pixel, pixel-to-region, and channel-to-channel relations modeled from global images in the dataset. A large teacher network often constructs a well-structured feature space in terms of global contextual dependencies. CIRKDV2 makes the student mimic the better structured semantic relations of the teacher, thus improving the feature representational capability. Beyond relational distillation, we further propose contextual feature distillation by using context aggregation to augment student pixel embeddings to match the semantic level with the teacher. This avoids the semantic gap problem between the teacher and student occurred in traditional feature distillation studies. Experimental results on Cityscapes, ADE20K, Pascal VOC, and COCO-Stuff-164K demonstrate that CIRKDV2 outperforms the state-of-the-art semantic segmentation distillation methods by large margins across various network architectures. Our code and pre-trained models are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CIRKDV2 提出跨图像关系知识蒸馏，将全局像素-像素、像素-区域、通道-通道关系迁移给学生，并用上下文聚合的特征蒸馏对齐语义层级。
AI.motivation: 现有分割知识蒸馏只让学生模仿单张图像内部的结构信息，忽略了数据集中跨图像的全局语义关系；同时传统特征蒸馏存在教师与学生的语义层级鸿沟。
AI.method: 在全局图像记忆库上建模像素-像素、像素-区域、通道-通道三类关系并约束学生模仿；另引入上下文聚合模块增强学生像素嵌入以匹配教师语义层级，避免语义差距。
AI.result: 在 Cityscapes、ADE20K、Pascal VOC、COCO-Stuff-164K 上，跨多种骨干架构均大幅优于现有分割蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式迁移跨图像全局结构关系并结合语义层级对齐，是提升分割蒸馏特征表示能力的有效途径；代码与预训练模型已公开。

title: Guidance as Variance Matching
summary: Guidance repels the prediction of a diffusion model away from a weaker reference prediction. It substantially improves sample quality, but its mechanism remains poorly understood. We first find that, at the scales used in practice, guidance does not improve the prediction of the posterior mean (the model's training target); it makes the prediction worse, while samples improve. Second, posterior-mean predictions have less variance than the data, and we find that guidance restores it. We introduce variance-matched guidance: a closed-form rule that picks the guidance scale by matching the variance of the guided predictions to that of the data. Without tuning, it recovers the hand-picked scales of eleven widely used models across image, video, audio, motion, and world generation; to our knowledge, no previous explanation of guidance predicts them. Applied per noise level, it yields a schedule without tuned hyperparameters that users prefer to hand-crafted ones on SD 3.5 Medium. Third, we offer an interpretation of the mechanism behind guidance: each model makes a random error in predicting the posterior mean, and guidance rescales the difference of these errors into a sample with the posterior's covariance, which improves sampling. This view also suggests two new hypotheses that our experiments support: guidance can work with negative scales, and guiding a model with its own checkpoint needs a larger scale than guiding it with an independently trained model.

AI.tldr: 本文分析扩散模型 guidance 的作用机理：guidance 并不改善后验均值预测（反而变差），而是恢复预测的方差；据此提出方差匹配 guidance（闭式选取 scale），无需调参即可复现 11 个主流模型的人工选取 scale，并可推广到负 scale 与自引导需要更大 scale 的现象。
AI.motivation: Guidance 大幅提升扩散模型采样质量，但其机制理解不足。作者想要回答：guidance 到底改变了预测的什么性质，从而改善采样。
AI.method: 1）实验发现实际使用的 guidance 尺度下，模型对后验均值的预测反而变差，而样本质量提升；2）发现后验均值预测方差低于数据方差，guidance 起到方差恢复作用；3）提出 variance-matched guidance：以闭式规则令引导预测方差匹配数据方差来确定 guidance scale，并逐噪声水平应用形成无需调参的 schedule；4）提出“每个模型在后验均值预测中存在随机误差，guidance 将误差差重缩放为具有后验协方差的样本”的机理解释。
AI.result: 无需调参即复现 11 个广泛使用模型（图像、视频、音频、运动、world generation）的人工选取 guidance scale；在 SD 3.5 Medium 上生成的 schedule 优于手工设计 schedule（用户偏好实验）；验证两个新假设：负 guidance scale 可行，以及用模型自身 checkpoint 自引导比用独立训练模型需要更大 scale。
AI.conclusion: Guidance 的收益来自方差校正与误差差的重缩放，而非更准的均值预测；方差匹配给出无超参的通用 scale 选取规则，并为 guidance 机制提供了可检验的理论解释。

title: WorldExpand: Building Coherent 3D Worlds via Sparse Joint Panoramic Expansion
summary: Constructing complete 3D worlds from a single panorama is challenging because large portions of the scene remain unobserved. Existing panoramic-video methods expand spatial coverage through dense sequential generation, but neighboring frames contain substantial redundancy, long trajectories accumulate errors, and independently generated directions may be inconsistent. We present WorldExpand, which formulates single-panorama world expansion as the generation of sparse, complementary, and high-resolution panoramic observations. This representation concentrates the generation budget on informative scene regions and preserves the fine-grained details required for 3D construction. WorldExpand addresses two key challenges: where to observe and how to synthesize. Our Coverage-Guided View Selection identifies informative target locations using scene-adaptive quadrants and warp-based coverage scores, while our Joint Panoramic Diffusion uses Gaussian-splatting-based geometric warps to jointly synthesize four pose-grounded and cross-view-consistent panoramas. A diagnostic-guided global--local attention schedule retains global attention only in sensitive layers, reducing the training and inference costs of high-resolution joint generation. The resulting posed panoramas can be directly fed into an existing reconstruction pipeline to build an explicit 3D representation. Experiments show that WorldExpand recovers content behind occluders and around distant corners, improves both novel-view synthesis and downstream 3D reconstruction metrics across various datasets, and generalizes robustly to diverse in-the-wild scenes. WorldExpand runs significantly faster than the state-of-the-art panoramic-video method while producing higher-resolution observations with stronger cross-view consistency.

AI.tldr: WorldExpand 将单张全景图的3D世界扩展重构为"稀疏、互补、高分辨率全景观测"的生成问题：用场景自适应象限与warp覆盖评分选择目标视角，再用基于高斯泼溅几何warp的联合全景扩散一次性生成4张位姿锚定且跨视角一致的全景图，最终送入现成重建管线得到显式3D表示。
AI.motivation: 单全景构建3D世界时大量区域未被观测，需生成补全。现有全景视频方法靠密集序列生成扩大覆盖，但相邻帧冗余大、长轨迹误差累积、独立生成的方向之间不一致，且生成预算被浪费在低信息区域。
AI.method: (1) Coverage-Guided View Selection：以场景自适应象限划分与warp-based覆盖分数定位高信息量目标视角；(2) Joint Panoramic Diffusion：用高斯泼溅几何warp作为条件，联合合成4张位姿锚定、跨视角一致的高分辨率全景；(3) 诊断引导的global–local注意力调度，仅在敏感层保留全局注意力，降低高分辨率联合生成的训练与推理开销；(4) 生成的带位姿全景直接接入已有重建管线构建显式3D表示。
AI.result: 实验显示可补全遮挡物背后与远处转角内容，在多个数据集上提升新视角合成与下游3D重建指标，并在多样化in-the-wild场景中稳健泛化；相比SOTA全景视频方法运行显著更快，同时观测分辨率更高、跨视角一致性更强。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏互补的高分辨率多视角联合生成，比稠密序列生成更适合单全景世界扩展：既节省生成预算又保留重建所需细节，为"生成式补全+显式重建"的单图世界构建提供高效范式。

title: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
summary: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet visual corruption can disrupt the resulting policies. We introduce HOG-WAM, which adds future Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) as structural supervision derived directly from demonstration images. An auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) module reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, allowing its objective to shape the visual representation used for control. The module is used only during training and removed at inference, preserving FastWAM's RGB-to-action architecture. We evaluate four controlled observation corruptions through a visual-corruption extension of RoboTwin, termed RoboTwin-Plus; HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the compared policies under all four. Mixed-noise success increases from 78.86% to 82.86% relative to FastWAM, with comparable performance on clean scenes. On LIBERO Plus, overall success increases from 74.49% to 75.26%, with the largest gain under sensor noise, from 74.14% to 78.89%. Across four Franka tasks, average success increases from 40% to 59% under clean observations and from 17% to 24% under noisy observations. A representation ablation favors combining RGB observations with auxiliary HOG prediction over replacing RGB with HOG. These findings support future-gradient prediction as complementary supervision for visually robust control, with larger absolute gains on physical tasks than in simulation. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: HOG-WAM 在 World-Action Model 训练时引入未来 HOG（方向梯度直方图）作为辅助监督，通过非对称注意力的 HOG DiT 塑造控制用视觉表征，推理时移除该模块，提升视觉扰动下的策略鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: World-action models 联合预测未来观测与动作，但其策略对视觉损坏（噪声、遮挡等）敏感，原因是 RGB 表征缺乏对几何结构的显式约束。作者希望通过从演示图像中直接提取的结构化监督（HOG）增强视觉表征的鲁棒性，且不增加推理开销。
AI.method: 提出 HOG-WAM：保留 FastWAM 的 RGB→action 主干，附加一个仅在训练期使用的 HOG 扩散 Transformer 辅助模块，该模块通过非对称注意力读取 RGB 特征并预测未来帧的 HOG，从而反向影响控制所用的视觉表征；推理时删除该模块。构建 RoboTwin-Plus（RoboTwin 视觉损坏扩展）评估四类受控观测损坏，另在 LIBERO Plus 与四个 Franka 真机任务上验证，并做了表征消融（RGB+HOG 辅助预测 vs. 以 HOG 替代 RGB）。
AI.result: RoboTwin-Plus 上四类损坏场景成功率均为最高，混合噪声从 78.86%→82.86%，干净场景持平；LIBERO Plus 总体从 74.49%→75.26%，传感器噪声下 74.14%→78.89%；四个 Franka 任务平均成功率干净条件 40%→59%、含噪条件 17%→24%。消融显示 RGB 观察加辅助 HOG 预测优于用 HOG 替代 RGB。
AI.conclusion: 未来梯度（HOG）预测作为互补监督可提升视觉鲁棒控制，真机物理任务的绝对增益明显大于仿真；证明显式结构监督可作为 world-action model 的低成本训练期正则手段。

title: Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
summary: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out? The paradigm is considered advantageous because the reasoning is native to the visual medium, unfolding directly in the frames rather than through language or code. Whether this native route is in fact the more reliable path to visual reasoning has not been tested against a symbolic alternative under the same conditions. We therefore pose the same tasks, with identical inputs, output specification and evaluator, to both media: rather than denoising pixels, a coding agent writes a program that renders the answer video, which an unmodified rule-based evaluator scores. On VBVR-Pro-Bench (Xu et al., 2026), a 500-instance suite spanning five cognitive categories with symbolic ground truth, the agent receives the same first frame and prompt as the video model, with no access to ground truth, metadata or generation models, and one attempt per instance.
